৬৫৮ টি নাতে রাসূল (ﷺ)

১

Naat poetry for the prophet

২

Aai Nasimey Kue Muhammad Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam

Aai Nasimey Ku-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Khinch Ne Laga Dil Su-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Kaa'bah Hamaara Ku-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Mushafey Imaan Ru-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Leke Muraade Dil Aa-Ein Gey, Mar Jaa-Ein Gey, Mit Jaa-Ein Gey Pahonchey To Hum Ta Ku-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Tuba Ki Jaanib Tak Ne Waalon, Aankhein Kholo, Hosh Sambhaalo Dekho Qade Dil Juw-Aey Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Naam Isi Ka Baabe Karam Hai, Dekh Yehi Mehraabe Haram Hai Dekh Khamey Abroowe Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Hum Sab Ka Rukh Su-E Kaa'bah, Su-E Muhammad Ru-E Kaa'bah Kaa'bey Ka Kaa'bah Ku-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Bhini, Bhini, Khushboo Laheki, Bedam Dil Ki Duniya Maheki Khul Gaye Jab Geisoo-E Muhammad, Sallallaahu Alaihi Wa Sallam

৩

Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan

Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan Aamina Da Raajdulhara Aagaya Khirr Payi Gulzaar Main Bismillah Karaan Ji Bismillah Karaan Main Bismillah Karaan Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan Gowd Wich Leke Halima Ne Keya Aaja Mere Laal Main Bismillah Karan Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan Aakheya Rabb Ne Raat Meraj Di Aaja Mere Yaar Main Bismillah Karan Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan Eho Dua Mangda Baghdadi Har Wele Khwaab Wich Howe Nazara Aaqa Da Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan Madina-E-Paak Da Sohna Chan Aa Gaya Sajiyan Galliyan Baazar Main Bismillah Karan Aa Gaye Sarkaar Main Bismillah Karan Nabian De Sardaar Main Bismillah Karan

৪

Aa Jaaye Bulawa Mujhe Aqa Tere Dar Se

Aa Jaaye Bulawa Mujhe Aqa Tere Dar Se Jis Dar Ki Ghulaami Ko To Jibreel Bhi Tarse Paidal Hi Nikalte Hain, Masaafat Ka Nahin Khauf Thakte Hi Nahin Ham To Madine Ke Safar Se Sunnat Pe Teri Chalne Ka Aa Jaaye Qareena Ye Abr-E-Karam Kaash Mere Dasht Pe Barse Zarrah Bhi Lage Gohar-O-Almaas Se Badh Kar Dekhe To Koii Khaak-E-Arab Meri Nazar Se Ek Main Hi Nahin Taalib-E-Jalwa Mere Aqa! Har Ek Musalmaan Tere Deed Ko Tarse Naamoos-E-Muhammad Ke Liye Jaan Bhi Doon Ga Ho Jaaun Ga Waaqif Main Shahaadat Ke Hunar Se Dunya Ke Faqat Chand Hi Lamhaat The Guzre Ho Aaye Payambar Mere Sadiyaun Ke Safar Se Jo Shaam-O-Sahar Salle Alaa Kehta Rahe Ga Aaye Ga Bulawa Usay Aqa Ke Nagar Se Kuch Khauf Nahin Mujh Ko Kadee Dhoop Ka Amjad Saaya Mujhe Miltaa Hai Risaalat Ke Shajar Se

৫

Aa Mil Yaar Saar Le Meri (Kalam E Bulleh Shah)

Aa Mil Yaar Saar Le Meri Meri Jaan Dukhan Ne Gheri Ander Khuwab Wichora Hoya, Khaber Na Pindi Teri Sanji Bin Wich Lutti Sayiaan, Sur Palang Ne Gheri Mulla Qazi Raah Batawan, Din Bharum De Phere Eh Taan Thag Jagat De Jhior, Lawan Jaal Chophere Karam Sharaa De Dharam Batawan, Sangal Pawan Perin Zaat Mazhab Eh Ishaq Na Puchda, Ishaq Shara Da Weri Nadiyon Paar Mulak Sajan Da, Laher Lobh Ne Gheri Satgor Beri Phari Khalote, Tain Kiun Laii Aweri Bullah Shah, Shoh Tenun Milsi, Dil Noon De Daleri Peetum Paas, Te Tolna Kis Noon, Bhul Giun Shakar Dopehari Aa Mil Yaar Saar Le Meri Meri Jaan Dukhan Ne Gheri

৬

Aaa Gai Mustafa Ki Sawari

Khaliq Ney Apney Nuur Ka, Jalwa Dikha Diyaa Sab Nuur Ko Mila Kay Muhammad Bana Diya Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Dey Rahey Hain Farishtey Salaami Tum Duruudo Ki Maala Banaa Loo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Apney Mangto Ko Wo Paaltey Hain Wo Bhala Kis Ko Kab Taaltey Hain Sadqa Hasnain O Ghausul Waraa Ka Ya Nabi Meri Jholi May Daalo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Ker Kay Naato Sey Her So Charaaga Youu Manaaey Gay Jashney Bahaara Aashiqo Aamad-E-Mustafa Hay Deep Khushiyoo Kay Her Suu Jala Lo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Waqt Chamkey Ga Aik Din Hamaarey Dekh Lain Gay Wo Dilkash Nazaarey Aap Ko Jo Bhi Sab Sey Hain Pyaarey Un Kay Sadqey May Ham Ko Bula Lo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Jin Kay Haatho May Hay Un Ka Daaman Naam-E-Ahmad Hay Jis Dil Ki Dharkan Jo Hay Pehchaan Hum Aashiqo Kee Jhuum Ker Un Ka Naara Laga Lo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Puuray Ho Jaeingay Un Kay Armaan Ker Rahey Hain Wo Bakhshish Ka Samaan Jashne Milaad Ki Barkato Sey Apney Qalbo Nazer Jag Maga Lo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Midhat-E-Mustafa Hee Kay Sadqey Hay Moin Apney Sab Kaam Bantey Her Ghari Zikr Ho Mustafa Ka Iss Ko Apna Wazeefa Bana Lo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo Dey Rahey Hain Farishtey Salaami Tum Duruudo Ki Maala Banaa Loo Aagae Mustafa Ki Sawaari Apne Ghar Ko Diyo Sey Saga Loo

৭

Aagaii Jag De Vich Bahaar

Aagaii Jag De Vich Bahaar Ban Ke Aaya Kamli Waala Nabiyaan Da Sardaar Kamli Waala Je Na Oanda, Rab Vi Na Koii Cheez Banonda Sohne Da Ai Sadqa Banya Ai Saara Sansaar Rab Aakhe Tun Dilbar Mera, Mera Sab Kujh Sohniyaan Tera Meri Har Shei Da Mahbuba Tu Maalik Mukhtaar Oganhaaro Na Ghabra-O! Ral Mil Khushiyaan Yaar Mana-O Dukhiyaan De Dukh Wanddan Waala Agaya Rab Da Yaar Kyun Na Geet Nabi De Gaayi-Ai, Kyunkar Na Milad Manaayi-Ai Kul Nabiyaan Da Sarwar Aaya Sunniyaan Da Mantthaar! Chumke Jaalyiaan Seene Laayi-Ai, Roze Paak Da Darshan Paayi-Ai Ral Mil Challi-Ai Shehr Madine Aajaawe O Waar Aahda-Ai Ashfaaqi Challa, Je Karna-Ai Raazi Allah Pharrh Lei Feir Sohne Da Palla Lag Jaawain G Apaar

৮

Aaj Ashq Mere Naat Sunaye To Ajab Kya

Aaj Ashq Mere Na'at Sunaye To Ajab Kya Sun Kar Wo Mujhe Pas Bulaye To Ajab Kya Un Par To Gunahgar Ka Sab Hal Khula Hai Us Par Bhi Wo Daman Main Chhupaye To Ajab Kya Munh Dhanp Ke Rakhna Ke Gunahgar Bahut Hu Mayyat Ko Meri Dekhne Aye To Ajab Kya Didar Ke Qabil To Nahi Chasme Tamnna Lekin Wo Kabhi Khawab Main Aye To Ajab Kya Ne Zad Safar Hai Na Koi Kam Bhale Hai Phir Bhi Mujhe Sarkar Bulaye To Ajab Kya Deedar Key Qabil To Nahin Chashm E Tamana Lekin Woh Kabhi Khwaab Main Aaein To Ajab Kya. Deedar Ke Qabil To Kahan Meri Nazar Hai Lakin Woh Kabhi Khawab Mein Aayein To Ajab Kiya. Yeh Nisbat E Shah E Madni Aur Yeh Aansoo Mehshar Mein Aik Gham Say Shuraein To Ajab Kiya. Main Aisa Khatawar Hoon Kuch Had Bhi Nahin Jis Ki Phir Bhi Meray Aeboon Ko Chupaein To Ajab Kiya. Paband Nawa To Nahin Faryad Ki Rasmein Yeh Ishq Mera Haal Sunayein To Ajab Kiya. Paband Nawa To Nahin Faryad Ki Rasmein Aansoo Hi Mera Hal Sunaein To Ajab Kiya. Hasil Jinhain Aqa Ki Ghulami Ka Saraf Hai Thokar Se Wo Murdo Ko Jilaye To Ajab Kya Aey Joshe Janoo Paase Adab Bazm Hai Jin Ki Is Bazm Mein Tashrif Woh Laaein To Ajab Kya Hai Wo Husne Do 'aalam Hai Adeeb Unke Qadam Se Sehra Main Agar Phool Khil Aye To Ajab Kya

৯

Aaj Milaad-E-Nabi Hai

Aaj Milaad-E-Nabi Hai, Kya Suhana Noor Hai, Aa Gaya Woh Noor Wala, Jiska Saara Noor Hai. Aankh Walo Aao Dekho, Mah-E-Taiba Ki Ziya. Asmaan Ke Chand Mein To, Pheekha Peekha Noor Hai. Tu Na Hota To Na Hota Do Jahaan Ka Intezaam. Tu Zameen Ka Noor Hai, Tu Asmaan Ka Noor Hai. Jiss Ne Jo Kuch Noor Paya, Sab Teri Sarkar Se. Toor Ki Sarkar Ka Tu Sab Se Pehla Noor Hai. Teri Nasl-E-Paak Mein Hai Bacha Bacha Noor Ka. Tu Ayn-E-Noor, Tera Sab Gharana Noor Ka. Main Gadda Tu Badshah, Bhar De Pyala Noor Ka. Noor Din Duna Tera, De Daal Sadqa Noor Ka. Jis Taraf Wo Uth Gayi, Alaam Munnawar Ho Gaye. Main Teri Ankhon Ke Sadqe, Inn Mein Kitna Noor Hai. Mustafa Ke Noor Mein Hai Zaat-E-Baari Jalwargar. Mustafa Ka Noor Hi Kahye Khuda Ka Noor Hai. Aaj Milaad-E-Nabi Hai, Kya Suhana Noor Hai, Aa Gaya Woh Noor Wala, Jiska Saara Noor Hai.

১০

Aaj Muhammad Aye Moray Ghar

Aaj Muhammad Aye Moray Ghar Dai Haleema Kehti Thi Ghar Ghar Mehndi Lagau Ghar Ko Sajau Mai Angan Me Naachu Gaau Tann Mann Waaru Unke Charan Par Subh E Azzal Hai Mukhra Unka Shaam E Awad Hai Zulf Ka Saya Unse Huwa Har Qalb Munawwar Dosh Pe Yun Gesu Lehraye Bheeni Bheeni Khusboo Aye Rang O Nighat Saara Manzar Amina Bi Ka Raaj Dulara Kitna Anokha Kitna Pyaara Chaand Uttar Aaya Hai Zameen Par Ankhon Mein Maazagh Ka Surma Sar Par Taaj Warafa Na Ka Husn E Mujassam Allahu Akbar Aao Sakhio Mill Kar Gaye Apne Piya Ka Jashn Manaye Salle Alaa Ki Dhoom Hai Ghar Ghar Rim Jhim Barse Noor Ki Barkha Aaya Hai Mehraj Ka Dulha Dharti Aur Aakaash Se Behtar Banke Shab E Mehraj Mein Dulha Pohnche Jab Aflaak Pe Aaqa Naghma Tha Har Ek Ki Zuban Par Tal Jaayegi Saari Musibat Aajayega Door E Rahat Ab Toh Mujhe Dekhenge Nazar Bhar Anjum Bekass Aap Ka Mangta Dijiye Bakshish Jagg Ke Data Boond Hu Mai Aur Aap Samandar

১১

Aamad E Mustafa Se Hai Phoola Phala Chaman Chaman

Aamad E Mustafa Se Hai Phoola Phala Chaman Chaman Aayi Bahar Har Taraf Khilne Laga Chaman Chaman Shadi Hai Har Makam Me Nakhl Me Sab Kiyam Hai Daaliya Hai Salaam Me Sar Hai Jhuka Chaman Chaman Thandi Hawaye Aati Hai Kaliya Bhi Muskurati Hai Bul-Bule Cheh-Chahati Hai Khilne Laga Chaman Chaman Jhoomte Hai Shajar Shajar Taaza Huwa Hai Phool Phool Sabza Hui Ravish Ravish Ghul Se Bhara Chaman Chaman Kaliya Tamaam Khil Gayi Shaakhe Khushi Se Hil Gayi Bulbule Ghul Se Mil Gayi Hasne Laga Chaman Chaman Baad-E-Khizaa Ko Chaant Ti, Khushbu Se Sabko Aant Ti Phirti Hai Itr Baant Ti, Baad-E-Saba Chaman Chaman Naat Me Keelo-Kaal Ho Midhat E Zuljalaal Ho Akbare Khush Makaal Ho Nagma-Sara Chaman Chaman

১২

Aane Walo Yeh To Batao

Aane Walo Yeh To Batao Sheher Madina Kaisa Hai. Sar Unke Qadmon Mein Rakhkar Jhuk Kar Jeena Kaisa Hai... Aane Walo Yeh To Batao Sheher Madina Kaisa Hai. Gumbadh Khazra Ke Saaye Mein Baith Ke Tum Tu Aaye Ho... Us Saaye Mein Rab Ke Aage Sajda Karna Kaisa Hai... Aane Walo Yeh Tu Batao Sheher Madina Kaise Hai. Dil Aankhein Aur Rooh Tumhaari Lagti Hai Sairab Mujhe Dar Pe Unke Baith Ke Aabe Zam Zam Pina Kaisa Hai... Aane Walo Yeh To Batao Sheher Madina Kaisa Hai. Deewano Aankhon Se Tumhari Itna Pooch To Leno Do Waqt Dua Roze Pe Unke Aansoo Bahana Kaisa Hai... Aane Walo Yeh Tu Batao Sheher Madina Kaisa Hai... Waqt Ruqsat Dil Ko Apne Chod Wahan Tum Aaye Ho Yeh Batlaao Ishrat Unke Dar Se Bichad Na Kaisa Hai... Aane Walo Yeh Tu Batao Sheher Madina Kaisa Hai.

১৩

Aankhen Ro Ro Ke Sujaane Wale

Aankhen Ro Ro Ke Sujaane Wale Jaane Wale Nahi Aane Waale Koi Din Mein Yeh Saraa Oojad Hai Are O Chauni Chaane Wale Zabha Hote Hain Watan Se Bichde Des Kyun Gaate Hain Gaane Wale Are Bad Faal Buri Hoti Hai Des Ka Jangla Sunaane Wale Sun Le(N) Aa’da Main Bigadne Ka Nahi Woh Salamat Hain Banaane Wale Aankhen Kuch Kehti Hain Tujh Se Paigaam O Dare Yaar Ke Jaane Wale Phir Na Karwat Li Madine Ki Taraf Are Chal Jhoote Bahaane Wale Nafs Main Khaak Hua Tu Na Mita Hai ! Meri Jaan Ke Khaane Wale Jeete Kya Dekh Ke Hain Aye Hooro Taiba Se Khuld Mein Aane Wale Neem Jalwe Mein Do Aalam Gulzaar Wah Wa Rang Jamaane Wale Husn Tera Sa Na Dekha Na Suna Kehte Hain Agle Zamaane Wale Wohi Dhoom Un Ki Hai Masha-Allah Mit Gaye Aap Mitaane Wale Labe Sairaab Ka Sadqa Paani Aye Lagi Dil Bujhaane Wale Saath Lelo Mujhe Main Mujrim Hoon Raah Mein Padte Hain Thaane Wale Ho Gaya Dhak Se Kaleja Mera Haaye Rukhsat Ki Sunaane Wale Khalq To Kya Ki Hain Khaaliq Ko Azeez Kuch Ajab Bhaate Hain Bhaane Wale Kushtaye Dashte Haram Jannat Ki Khidkiyaa(N) Apne Sirhaane Wale Kyun Raza Aaj Gali Sooni Hai Uth Mere Dhoom Machaane Wale

১৪

Aankhon Ka Taara Naame Muhammad

Aankhon Ka Taara Naame Muhammed Dil Ka Ujaala Naame Muhammed Salla Llahu Alayhi Wa Sallam Salla Llahu Alayhi Wa Sallam Puche Ga Maula Laya Hein Kya Kya Mai Ye Kahunga Naame Muhammad Daulat Jo Chaaho Dona Jahaan Ki Karlo Wazifa Naame Muhammed Allah U Akbar Rab'bul Ulaane Har Sheh Pe Likka Naame Muhammed Roze Qayaamat Mizano Pul Par Dega Sahaara Naame Muhammed Pyaare Sahaba Pe Qurbaan Jaoon Un Se Hai Seekha Naame Muhammed Bera Tabaahi Mein Aagaya Hein Dede Sahaara Naame Muhammed Sheda Na Kyu Ho Is Par Musalmaan Rab Ko Hein Pyaara Naame Muhammed Salle Ala Ka Sehra Sajaakar Dulha Banaaya Naame Muhammed Paayi Muraade Donoh Jahaan Mein Jisne Pukaara Naame Muhammed Parti Durood E Doregi Hoore Laasha Jo Lega Naame Muhammed Aankhon Mein Aakar Dil Mein Samaakar Rangat Rachaaja Naame Muhammed Ahmed Raza Ke Qurbaan Jaoon Jisne Sikhaaya Naame Muhammed Hai Naam Yun To Kasrat Se Lekin Sab Se Hai Pyaara Naame Muhammad Saare Chaman Mein, Laakho Gulon Mein Gul Hai Hazaara, Naame Muhammad Moamin Ko Kyon Ho Khatra Kahin Par Dil Par Hai Kunda, Naame Muhammad Gham Ki Ghataaein Chaai Hain Sar Par Kar Do Ishaara, Naame Muhammad Rakh-Kho Lahad Mein, Jis Dam Azizo Mujh Ko Sunaa-Na, Naame Muhammad Apne Jameel E Razvi Ke Dil Mein Aaja Samaaja Naame Muhammed Apne, Jameel E Razvi, Ke Dil Par Marham Lagaana, Naame Muhammad

১৫

Aankhon Ko Woh Pur Kaif Nazare Nahin Bhule

Aankhon Ko Woh Pur Kaif Nazare Nahin Bhule Woh Din Jo Madine Mein Guzare Nahin Bhule Bechain Hai Ik Baar Uthe Phir Wohi Ungli Mohtaab Ko Aqa Ke Ishare Nahin Bhule Ghir Jaon Main Ji Chahe Mera Phir Se Bhanwar Mein Aqa Ne Diye The Jo Sahare Nahin Bhule Islam Ke Gulshan Ko Bachaya Tha Jinhon Ne Karbal Ko Woh Zahra Ke Dulare Nahin Bhule Taiba Ki Haseen Raat Mein Faarooqi Humari Taqdeer Ke Chamke Jo Sitare Nahin Bhule

১৬

Aankhon Mein Bas Gaya Hai Madina Huzoor Ka

Aankhon Mein Bas Gaya Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Be Kas Ka Aasra Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Phir Ja Rahe Hai Ahle Mohabbat Ke Qaafle Phir Yaad Aa Raha Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Taskine Jaan Hai Raahte Dil Wajeh Anbasaat Har Dard Ki Dawa Hai, Madinah Huzoor Ka Nabiyon Mein Jaise Afzal-O-A’ala Hai Mustafa Shehron Mein Baadshah Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Hai Rango Noor Jisne Diya Do Jahaan Ko Woh Noor Ka Diya Hai, Madinah Huzoor Ka Jab Se Qadam Pade Hai Risalat Ma’aab Ke Jannat Se Badh Gaya Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Har Zarra Zarra Apni Jagah Mahtaab Hai Kya Jagmaga Raha Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Qudsi Bhi Chumte Hai Adab Se Yahaan Ki Khaak Qismat Mein Jhomta Hai Madina Huzoor Ka Ho Naaz Kyun Na Is Ko Niyazi Naseeb Par Jis Ko Bhi Mil Gaya Hai Madina Huzoor Ka

১৭

Aao Mere Nabi Ki Shaan Suno

Aao Mere Nabi Ki Shaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Habeeb Pyaara Nazar Uthaaye To Maula Qibla Badal De Kahi Ye Chaahat Kahi Ye Kehna Aye Moosa Aana Sambhal Ke Khuda Hai In Pe Meherbaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Nabi Ka Sajda Hua Hai Lamba Hussain Pusht Pe Baithe Tere Nawaase Ke Jin Ke Jode Khuda Ne Khuld Se Bheje Hai Jibraeel Bhi Darbaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Namaze Di Thi Pachaas Rab Ne Nabi Ne Paanch Karaayi Hai Dekho Kitna Khayale Ummat Hai Nabi Ne Baat Banaayi Wahi Hai Arsh Ka Mehmaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Nabi Ke Aashique Bilaal E Habshi Hai Jin Ke Arsh Pe Charche Bilaal Jab Bhi Azaan Dete Sahaba Ishq Me Rote Bilaal E Habshi Ki Azaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Hussaini Jazba Ubhaarta Hai Ali Ke Naam Ka Naara Yazeediyo Ko Pachadta Hai Ali Ke Naam Ka Naara Ali Hai Mustafa Ki Shaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Nabi Ke Azmat Pe Pehra Dena Raza Ne Hum Ko Sikhaaya Nabi Ka Dushman Hai Apna Dushman Raza Ne Hum Ko Bataya Raza Se Ishq Ki Pehchaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno Nabi Ke Nazre Rahe Ujaagar Isi Se Apna Guzaara Nabi Ka Saaya Rahe Salaamat Yahi Hai Apna Sahaara Nabi Ke Kitne Hai Ehsaan Suno Nabi Hai Bolta Qur’an Suno

১৮

Aap Ke Darbar Se Khali Gaya Koi Nahi

Aap Ke Darbar Se Khali Gaya Koi Nahi Hain Sakhi Lakhon Yahaan Par Aap Sa Koi Nahin Aap Ke Hote Hue Main Kyun Musibat Mein Rahon Kya Kaheinge Log Ke Mushkil Kusha Koi Nahin Aap Ke Dohar Mein Dono Jahaan Ki Nematein Aap Ke Lutf-O-Karam Ki Intihaa Koi Nahin Jab Liya Naam-E-Muhammad Mushkilein Hall Ho Gayin Kaun Kehta Hai Ke Tere Naam Ka Assar Nahin Aye Darbar Dar-E-Yaar-E-Muhammad Aasiyo Aitaraf-E-Jurm Karlo To Sazzaa Koi Nahin Kaun Buje Aye Niyazi Dard-E-Dil Ka Majira Hub-E-Muhammad Hai Humara Aasraa Koi Nahin Aap Ke Darbar Se Khali Gaya Koi Nahi Hain Sakhi Lakhon Yahaan Par Aap Sa Koi Nahin

১৯

Aap Mehmaan Huwe La Makaan Ke

Aap Mehmaan Huwe La Makaan Ke Mustafa Mustafa Ho Mubarak Arshe Haq Se Bhi Aage Gaye Mustafa Jagmagane Lage Hai Makaa La Makaa Shah Dulha Bane Shamiyane Lage Shadiyaane Baje Hai Makaa La Makaa Choome Jibreel Ne Mustafa Ke Qadam Aur Kaha Ba Adab Chaliye Shahe Umam Aap Mehmaan Hai Khaas Meraj Ke Aur Sajaaye Gaye Hai Makaa La Makaa Aaj Hooron Malak Saare Jinno Bashar Kya Shajar Kya Hajar Kya Hai Shams O Qamar Manzile Udnu Minni Pe Sarkaar Hai Ye Sada De Rahe Hai Makaa La Makaa Munham Ik Naat Me Ambiya Sab Ke Sab Aur Aqsaame Phir Ambiya Saf Ba Saf Zebo Zeenat Bhi Jannat Ki Badhne Lagi Aur Sajne Lage Hai Makaa La Makaa Aqle Insaan Kya Samjhe Is Raaz Ko Waqiya Hai Ujaagar Khirad Se Wara Sayyidul Ambiya Pohche Is Shaan Se Sir Jhukaate Rahe Hai Makaa La Makaa

২০

Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya

Ya Rasula Llah, Ya Habiba Llah Salla Alayka Ya Rasula Llah Wa Sallam Alayka Ya Habiba Llah Ahlan Wa Sahlan Marhaba, Ya Rasula Llah Charoon Taraf Noor Chahya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Khushiyon Ka Pegham Laya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Shams-O-Qamar Aur Taaray Kyun Na Ho Khush Aaj Saaray Unse Hee Tou Noor Paaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Khushiyan Manatay Hain Wohi Dhoomein Machatay Hain Wohi Jinn Per Hua Unka Saaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Ghar Ko Sajatay Hain Wohi, Jhanday Lehratay Hain Wohi, Jin Par Hua Unka Saaya, Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Hai Shaad Har Ek Musalmaan Karta Hai Ghar Ghar Charaghaan Galiyun Ko Bhi Jagmagaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Mukhtar-E-Kul Maanay Jou Unhe Noori Bashar Jaanay Jou Unhe Naara Ussi Ne Lagaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Jou Aaj Mehfil Mein Aaye Mun Ki Muradein Woh Paaye Sab Par Karam Ho Khudaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Ghous Ul Wara Aur Data Ne Mere Raza Aur Khuwaja Ne Sab Ne Hee Din Ye Manaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Naat-E-Nabi Tum Sunao Ishq-E-Nabi Ko Barhao Hum Ko Raza Ne Sikhaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Jiss Ko Shajar Jaantay Hain Kehna Hajar Maantay Hain Aisa Nabi Hum Ne Paaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Dil Jagmaganay Lagay Hain Sab Muskaranay Lagay Hain Ik Kaif Sa Aaj Chahya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya Kar Ae Ubaid Unki Midhat Tujh Per Khuda Ki Ho Rehmat Tu Ne Muqqadar Ye Paaya Aaqa Ka Milad Aaya

২১

Aaqa Ke Ghulamo Ko Ab Eid Manane Do

Aaqa Ke Ghulamo Ko Ab Eid Manane Do Sarkaar Ki Aamad Hai Raaho Ko Sajane Do Charcha Hai Yahi Har-Su Kehte Hai Ye Har Koi Tashreef Nabi Laye Mehfil Ko Sajane Do Ghar Ghar Ye Charaga Hai Rehmat Ka Ujala Hai Aaqa Ki Sana Karke Taqdeer Jagane Do Khushiya Hai Sabhi Karte Sarkaar Ki Aamad Par Ik Naat E Nabi Yaaro Mujhko Bhi Sunane Do Payda Jo Huwey Sarwar Buth Khaaney Ke Buth Toote Anwaar-E-Ilahi Se Qismat Ko Jagaaney Do Gowdi Main Aminah Key Woh Noor-E-Mujasam Hai Kehti Hain Halimah Bhi Qurbaan Ho Jaane Do Hai Noor E Muhammad Ki Sab Roushni Duniya Me Sab Kuch Hai Basheer Unka Sadqa To Lutane Do

২২

Aaqa Meriyan Akhiyan Madine Wich Reh Gayan

Oh Shehar Madina Jad Main Takeya Mere Thand Pai Gayi Vich Sinay Othay Main Reh Ke Aa Gaya Sadiq Akhan Reh Giyan Shehar Madinay Aaqa Meriyan Akhiyan Madine Wich Reh Gayan Muk Gaya Visa Tay Judaiyan Phir Pai Gaiyan Tusan Te Menoon Dar Te Sadeya, Wele Mainu Shehroon Kadiya Tere Dar Diyan Sohniyan Yaadan, Aaqa Mera Saath Na Chadeya Nit Diyan Sochan Hun, Jind Meri Legaiyan Aabe Zamzam Peende Reyan, Do Din Sukh Naal Jeende Reyan Tere Ghar Di Chaukat De Assi, Mangte Roz Sadende Reyan Mangiyan Muraadan Si Jo, Chauli Meri Pai Gaiyan Phir Main Wekhan Roza Tera, Soh Rab Di Dil Karda Mera Je Kidre Manzoori Howe, Laalaan Othe Pakka Dera Lakhan Majburiyan Ne, Rawan Wich Pai Gaiyan Aaqa Teri Shaan Nu Wekhan, Chuk De Kul Jahaan Nu Wekhan Jere Tere Kol Ne Suthe, Umar, Siddique, Usman Nu Wekhan Jina Tere Kadman Wich, Thaawan Aaqa Le Laiyan Jad Main Takya Sher E Madina, Roshan Hogeya Mera Seena Soh Salaan Tu Wadh Lagda Si Pawein Si Oh Ik Maheena Sadiq Ghumbad E Khazra Tak Ke, Tandan Mainoon Pai Gaiyan Aaqa Meriyan Akhiyan Madine Wich Reh Gayan Muk Gaya Visa Te Judaiyan Phir Pai Gaiyan

২৩

Aarize Shamso Qamar Se Bhi Hain Anwar Ediyaan

Aarize Shamso Qamar Se Bhi Hain Anwar Ediyaa(N) Arsh Ki Aankhon Ke Taare Hain Woh Khushtar Ediyaa(N) Jaa Bajaa Partau Figan Hain Aasmaa(N) Par Ediyaa(N) Din Ko Hain Khursheed Shab Ko Maaho Akhtar Ediyaa(N) Najme Gardoo(N) To Nazar Aate Hain Chote Aur Woh Paau Arsh Par Phir Kyun Na Ho(N) Mahsoos Laagar Ediyaa(N) Dab Ke Zere Paa Na Gunjaaish Samane Ko Rahi Ban Gaya Jalwa Kafe Paa Ka Ubhar Ka Ediyaa(N) Unka Mangta Paau Se Thukra De Woh Duniya Ka Taj Jis Ki Khatir Mar Gaye Mun’am Ragad Kar Ediyaa(N) Do Qamar, Do Panjaye Khur, Do Sitaare, Dus Hilaal Unke Talwe, Panje, Nakhun, Paaye Athar Ediyaa(N) Haaye Us Patthar Se Us Seene Ki Qismat Fodiye Be Takalluf Jis Ke Dil Mein Yu(N) Kare(N) Ghar Ediyaa(N) Taaje Roohul Quds Ke Moti Jise Sajda Kare(N) Rakhti Hain Wallah Woh Paakeeza Gohar Ediyaa(N) Ek Thokar Me Uhud Ka Zalzala Jaata Raha Rakhti Hain Kitna Waqaar Allahu Akbar Ediyaa(N) Charkh Par Chadte Hi Chandi Mein Siyahi Aa Gayi Kar Chuki Hai Badr Ko Taksaal Bahar Ediyaa(N) Aye Raza Toofane Mehshar Ke Talatum Se Na Dar Shaad Ho! Hain Kashtiye Ummat Ko Langar Ediyaa(N)

২৪

Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Bu Jehel Ke Haathon Mein Kankari Banaa Hotaa Apne Aaqa Ke Aage Kalima Tou Padhaa Hota Ghayb Daa(N) Nabi Ka Eik Mo’jizaa Banaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Mein Bhi Kaabe Ki Chatt Per Buth Banaa Khadaa Hotaa Aaqa Ke Ishaare Per Ondhaa Giraa Hotaa Aur Unnke Qadmon Ka Bosaa Le Liyaa Hotaa Khaake Paaye Aqdass Ka Hissa Bann Gayaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Kaash Mein Haleema Ki Bakri Hee Rahaa Hotaa Aaqa Mujhko Le Jaate, Bann Mein Charr Rahaa Hotaa Doodh Dohtey Aaqa Apne Daste Aqdass Se Aaj Tak Muqaddar Per Naaz Kar Rahaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Eik Chattan Ki Soorat Kaash Mein Rahaa Hotaa Aaqa Paaon Rakh Dete, Moum Bann Gayaa Hotaa Noori Aqs Qadmon Ka Dil Mein Bhar Liyaa Hotaa Unnke Jaannisaaron Ke Dil Mein Bass Gayaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Kaash Apne Aaqa Ka Na’ale Paak Hee Hotaa Hamaa Waqt Qadmon Se Liptaa Hi Rahaa Hotaa Jabb Kabhi Mein Phatt Jaata, Apne Haath Se Guth-Te Taajdaaron Ke Sarr Ka Taaj Bann Gayaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa Nazmi Tum Tou Bhole Ho, Aisaa Kiyun Huaa Hotaa Aale Faatima Honaa Rabb Ne Jabb Likhaa Hotaa Ahle Bayt Mein Honaa Rabb Ne Jabb Likhaa Hotaa Aale Mustafa Honaa Rabb Ne Jabb Likhaa Hotaa Aarzooein Kaisi Hain Kaash Yun Huaa Hotaa

২৫

Aaya Hai Bulawa Mujhe Darbar E Nabi Se

Paigham Saba Layi Hai Yeh Gulzaar E Nabi Se Aaya Hai Bulawa Mujhe Darbar E Nabi Se Har Aah Gaee Arsh Peh Yeh Aah Ki Qismat Har Ashk Peh Ik Khuld He Her Ashk Ki Qimat Tohfa Yeh Mila He Mujhe Sarkar E Nabi Se Aaya Hai Bulawa Mujhe Darbar E Nab Se Shukar Khuda Ke Aaj Ghadi Us Safar Ki Hai Jis Par Nisaar Jaan Falah O Zafar Ki Hai Garmi Hai Tap Hai Dard Hai Kulfat Safar Ki Hai Na Shukr Yeh Toh Dekh ২৭

Aaya Ramzaan Ka Mahina Khafila Chala Soo-E-Madina

Aaya Ramzaan Ka Mahina Khafila Chala Soo-E-Madina Mujhe Bhi Do Izn-E-Madina Aane Ki Sarkare Madina Mujhe Na Aaya Bulawa Kitni Hai Dil Me Tamanna Kash Aqa Mai Bhi Dekh Leta Bahar-E-Ramzaan-E-Madina Meri Qismat Ko Bhi Khudara Tum Sajana Hasnain Ke Sadqe Me Dikhana Baar Baar Madina Kahaan Jaun Kahaan Daman Pasaroon Mai Malik-E-Madina Aas Lagai Hamne Tumhare Dar Se Ae Shahinsha-E-Madina Kaheen Aisa Na Ho Seene Me Dafn Karke Gham-E-Madina Mai Duniya Se Chala Jaon Bin Deed Ke Madina Ghamaun Ke Sailab Me Dooba Jaraha Hoon Sultan-E-Madina Lillah Imdad Ko Aao Meri Sarwar-E-Madina Iss Saal Zaroor Mujh Aasi Ko Sarkar Bulana Rauda-E-Anwar Aur Gumbade Khizra Dikhana Chamka Kar Meri Aankhaun Ko Jalwa Dikha Dena Dekh Loon Aankh Bharke Tum Ko Shahe Madina Duniya Ki Mohabbat Dil Se Nikal Jae Aqa-E-Madina Rahe Chashm-E-Nam Dil Me Bas Gham-E-Madina Maana Ke Nahi Qabil Hoon Jo Dekhoon Tumhara Madina Phir Laoon Kahaan Se Wo Aamal Mai Sarkar-E-Madina Nahi Jaber Ke Paas Koi Zar Jo Dekhe Pyara Madina Itna To Ho Karam Khabaun Me Ise Dikhado Madina

২৮

Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale

Do Jag De Wich Hoye Ujaale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Rahmatan Waale Barkatan Wale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Hooran Ral Mil Wekhan Aaya Aamina Taa Iih Wehrre Wadhayan Khullan Bahishta De Aj Taale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Wekh Ke Khalqat Hoi Deewani Pyaari Pyaari Shakal Noorani Kul Nabiya Toh Hayn Pyaare Niraale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Aaqa Jalwa Paak Wikhao Mukhre Ton Kamli Nu Hattao Khullan Raaz Muzamil Waale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Dil Bechain Nu Chayn Na Aawe Ishq Sataawe Birhon Jalaawe Kausar De Bhar Deyn Pyaale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Bekas O Ganhaar Na Thaawan Darr Tera Chad Kis Dar Jawan Tussi Na Sambhalo Te Kaun Sambhale Aaye Muhammad Rahmatan Wale Unj Te Ghareeb Haan Par Dil Te Ameer Ey. Main Jo Kuch Wi Desaan, Desaan Rajja Ke. Ikk Wari Aaja, Seene Noor Pa Ja. Ikk Wari Aaja, Deedar Wi Kara Ja.

২৯

Ab Kahan Jaon Tarap Ke

Ab Kahan Jaon Tarap Ke Dil Ki Yeh Khwahish Nikaal Ae Madine Ki Zameen Meri Bhi Gunja-Ish Nikaal Ae Rahe Ishq E Nabi Kar Ke Fanah Tak Rahbari Mujh Se Aasi Ki Bhi Koi Soorat E Bakhshish Nikaal Aye Fiza Taiba Ki Mere Gird Halqa Khench Kar Mudat E Umr E Rawan Se Arsa E Gardish Nikaal Bargah E Mustafa Mein Dil Se Yeh Aai Sada Aaj Ki Taareekh Se Taareekh E Paidaish Nikaal Pesh Kar De Na Qamar Sarmaya E Naat E Nabi Hashr Mein Jab Hukm Ho Ga Nama E Pursish Nikaal

৩০

Ab Meri Nigahon Mein Jachta Nahi Koi

Ab Meri Nigahon Mein Jachta Nahi Koi Jaisay Meray Sarkaar Hain Waisa Nahi Koi Tumsa To Hasin Aankh Ne, Dekha Nahin Koi Yeh Shaane Lataafat Hai, Ke Saaya Nahin Koi Aey Zarfe Nazar Dekh, Magar Dekh Adab Se Sarkaar Ka Jalwah Hai, Tamaasha Nahin Koi Yeh Tajrubaa-E Imaan Hai, Aey Rehmate Aa鱈am Fariyaad Tumhaare Siwa Sunta Nahin Koi Yeh Toor Se Kehti Hai Abhi Tak Shabe Me坦aaj Didaar Ki Taaqat Ho To Parhdah Nahin Koi Woh Aankh Jo Roti Hai Ghame Ishqe Nabi Mein Us Aankh Se Ruposh To Jalwah Nahin Koi Socho To Kabhi Nisbate Rehmat Ke Nataaij Taslim Ke Hum Logon Mein Ach-Cha Nahin Koi Shamshir Wasila Hai Sipar Rehmate Haqq Hai Sarkaar Ki Ummat Mein Nihatta Nahin Koi Bekaar Hai Har Waar Tera Gardishe Dauraan Woh Humdamo Gham Khwaar Hain Tanha Nahin Koi Ezaaz Yeh Haasil Hai To, Haasil Hai Zamin Ko Aflaak Pe To Gumbade Khazra Nahin Koi Hota Hai Jahaan Zikr Muhammad Ke Karam Ka Us Bazmein Mehrume Tamanna Nahin Koi Darmaan-E Ghamo Dardo Shifaa-E Dile Bimaar Juz Aap Ke Aey Jaane Masiha Nahin Koi Sarkaar Ki Rehmat Ne, Magar Khoob Nawaaza Yeh Sach Hai Ke, Khalid Sa Nikamma Nahin Koi

৩১

Ab To Bas Ek Hi Dhun Hai Ke Madina Dekhoon

Akhri Waqt Me Kya Raunaq E Duniya Dekhun Ab To Bas Ek Hi Dhun Hai Ke Madina Dekhun Aqibat Meri Sawar Jaye Jo Taiba Dekhun Dast-E-Imroz Me Aiyinaye Farda Dekhun Jaliyan Dekhun Ke Deewar-O-Dar-O-Baam E Haram Apni Mazoor Nigahon Se Main Kya Kya Dekhun Main Kahan Hoon Ye Samajh Loon To Uthaun Nazren Dil Zara Sambhle To Main Janib-E-Khazra Dekhun Maine Jin Ankhon Se Dekha Hai Kabhi Shahr-E-Nabi Aur In Ankhon Se Ab Kya Koi Jalwa Dekhun Mere Maula Meri Ankhen Mujhe Wapas Kar De Take Is Baar Main Jee Bhar Ke Madina Dekhun Jin Gali Kuncho Me Guzre Ho Kabhi Mere Huzoor In Me Ta-Hatte Nazar Naqshe Kafe Paa Dekhun Take Ankhon Ka Bhi Ehsaan Utana Na Pare Qalb Khud Aiyina Ban Jaye Mai Itna Dekhun Kash Iqbal Yunhi Umr Basar Ho Meri Subah Kaabe Me Ho Aur Sham Ko Taiba Dekhun Apni Be Noor Nigahon Se Mai Kya Kya Dekhun Ab To Bas Ek Hi Dhun Hai Ke Madina Dekhun ---------------Other------------------- --------------Version------------------ Chod Kar Aapka Darbar Phir Mai Kya Dekhu Ab To Bas Ek Hi Dhun Hai Ke Madina Dekhu Jaliyan Dekhu Sunehri Kabhi Rauza Dekhu Tik-Tiki Baandh Ke Mai Gumbad E Khazra Dekhu Unke Labhaye Mubarak Ke Tabassum Ke Tufail Gulshane Dil Ki Bhi Kaliyon Ka Mai Khilna Dekhu Ho Durood Aur Salaamo Ke Zuban Par Nagme Abre Rehmat Ka Mai Phir Zor Barasna Dekhu Unke Darbaar Me Unko Mai Sunaau Naate Ishq Me Unke Gulamo Ka Machalna Dekhu Unke Qadmain Sharifain Ka Bosa Le Kar Misle Khursheed Mai Zarro Ka Chamakna Dekhu Dafn Hone Ko Mayassar Jo Ho Taiba Ki Zameen Phir To Duniya Hi Se Jannat Ka Mai Zeena Dekhu Mere Maula Tere Rizwan Ki Dua Hai Tujh Se Naz'aa Ke Waqt Mai Sarkar Ka Jalwa Dekhu

৩৩

Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah

Qallat Hee Lati Anta Waseelati Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Ghatayein Gham Ki Chaayein Dil Pareshan Ya Rasoolallah Tumhi Ab Kuch Karo Maah-E-Risalat Ya Rasoolallah Ghatayein Gham Ki Chaayein Dil Pareshan Ya Rasoolallah Tumhi Ho Mere Dard-O-Dukh Ka Darmaan Ya Rasoolallah Safeenay Ke Parakhchay Urr Chukkay Hain Zor-E-Tufaan Se Sambhalo Mein Bhi Dooba Aey Meri Jaan Ya Rasoolallah Gunahoon Ki Nahi Jaatei Hai Aadat Ya Rasoolallah Tumhi Ab Kuch Karo Maah-E-Risalat Ya Rasoolallah Mein Bachna Chahta Hoon Haaye Phir Bhi Bach Nahi Paata Gunahoon Ki Parri Hai Aisi A?adat Ya Rasoolallah Humein Haryalay Gumbad Ke Tallay Qadmon Mein Maut Aaye Salamat Lekay Jaayein Deen-O-Imaan Ya Rasoolallah Mujhe Marna Hai Aaqa Gumbad-E-Khizra Ke Saaye Mein Watan Mein Margaya Tou Kia Karoonga Ya Rasoolallah Bohot Kamzoor Hoon Qabil Nahi Hargiz Azaboon Ke Khudara Saath Letay Jaana Jannat Ya Rasoolallah Yahan Jaisay Hamari A?eb Pooshi Aap Kartay Hain Wahan Bhi Aap Rakhlejiyega Izzat Ya Rasoolallah Mera Ye Khuwaab Hojaye Shaha Sharminda-E-Ta?beer Madinay Mein Piyoon Jaam-E-Shahadat Ya Rasoolallah Madina Meetha Meetha Hai Madina Pyara Pyara Hai Madinay Se Mujhe Beyhud Hai Ulfat Ya Rasoolallah Meri Har Dharkan-E-Dil Se Madinay Ki Sada Niklay Rahay Zikr-E-Madina Lub Pe Har Dam Ya Rasoolallah Shaha Attar Per Har Aan Rehmat Ki Nazar Rakhna Karay Din Raat Buss Sunnat Ki Khidmat Ya Rasoolallah Shaha Attar Ko Dou Gaz Madinay Mein Zameen Dejiye Waheen Ho Dafn Tera Ye Sana Khuwaan Ya Rasoolallah ---------------------- Other ---------------------- --------------------- Version --------------------- Qallat Hee Lati Anta Waseelati Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Habeeballah... Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Ya Rasool Allah, Bulaalo Ab Madine Mey Bulaalo Ya Rasool Allah... Satate Hain Jo Duniya Wale Is Ka Kuch Nahi Hain Gham, Mujhe Bas Apna Keh Kar Tum Bulaalo Ya Rasool Allah... Sunehri Jaaliyon Key Saamne Pohcha Hoon Mey Aaqa, Mujhe Apni Ziyaarat Tum Karaado Ya Rasool Allah... Meri Qismat Buree Ho To Khudara Tum Bhalee Kardo, Sanwaaro Meri Qismat Ko Sanwaaro Ya Rasool Allah... ‘ataa Ho ‘ilm Ki Daulat ‘ataa Ho Deed Ki Daulat, Damey Aakhir Madina Bhi ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah... Shafa’at Ka Sawali Hoon Sawali Hoon Mai Rehmat Ka, Ijaabat Se Nawaazo Tum Nawaazo Ya Rasool Allah... Mo’in-E-Raah-E-Taiba Hain Mere Khwaja Mo’inuddeen, Mo’in-E-Raah-E-Jannat Bhi Banaado Ya Rasool Allah... Tasadduq Ghaus E A’azam Ka Tawassul A’ala Hazrat Ka, Baqee-E-Paak Ke Qaabil Banaado Ya Rasool Allah... Nigah-E-Mufti-E A’azam Ney Zinda Kardiya Dil Ko, Unhi Ka Saath Mehshar Me ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah... Tamanna Ye Liye Jaata Hai Aaqa Shakir E Razvi, Ise Izne Madina Phir ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah. ---------------------- Other ---------------------- --------------------- Version --------------------- Qallat Heelati Anta Waseelati Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Adrikni Ya Rasoolallah Nazar Aata Nahi Koi Kinaaraa Ya Rasoolallah Bhanwar Ki Gardishon Se Tum Bachaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Nahi Hai Koi Apna Juz Tumhaare Is Zamaane Main Gunahgaaron Ko Apna Tum Banaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Madeenah Aana Jaana Ho Dil E Muztar Ki Hasrat Hai Mujhe Har Saal Taibah Main Bulaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Sunehri Jaaliyaan Hon Or Parhun Jab Aap Ki Naatain Rukh E Anwar Se Tab Pardah Uthaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Naza Ke Waqt Karna Tum Meri Sab Mushkilen Aasaan Hamain Imaan Pe Dunya Se Uthaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Shaha Dar Dar Ki Thokar Se Bacha Kar Ye Sharaf De De Baqi E Paak Ban Jaaye Thikaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Lahad Ki Raat Ho Taareek Or Wahshat Nakeeron Ki Thapak Kar Chen Se Us Dam Sulaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Sar E Mahshar Lage Jab Bheer Sab Kawsar Ke Pyaason Ki Mujhe Bhi Jaam Kawsar Ka Pilaanaa Ya Rasoolallah Shaha Abid Ke Dil Ki Bas Yahi Ummeed O Khwaahish Hai Qiyaamat Main Bhi Is Ko Tum Nibhaanaa Ya Rasoolallah

৩৬

Aey Ishq E Nabi Meray Dil Mein Bhi Sama Jaana

Ae Ishq-E-Nabi Meray Dil Mein Bhi Sama Jana Mujh Ko Bhe Muhammad(S.a.w) Ka Deewana Bana Jana Jo Rang Kay Jami Par Roomi Pey Charhaya Tha Us Rang Ki Kuch Rangat Mujh Pay Bhi Charha Jana Qudrat Ki Nigahein Bhe Jis Chehra E Anwar Ko Taktee Hein Us Chehra E Anwar Ka Deedaar Kara Jana Jis Khwab Mey Ho Jaey Deedaar E Nabi(S.a.w) Hasil Aey Ishq Kabhi Mujh Ko Neend Aesi Sula Jana Ae Kaash Riyaaz Aey Pegham Madina Paak Say Sarkar(S.a.w) Bulatay Hein, Tum Naat Suna Jana Deedaar E Muhammad(S.a.w) Ki Hasrat To Rahey Baki Juz Is Key Har Ik Hasrat Is Dil Sey Mita Jana Duniya Sey Niyaaz Ho Jab Uqbaa Ki Taraf Jaana Daagh-E-Gham-E-Ahmad Sey Seeneh Ko Sajaa Jaana

৩৭

Aey Mawla Ik Baar Dikhadey Jalwa Kamli Waley Ka

Aey Mawla, Ik Baar Dikhadey Jalwa Kamli Waley Ka Tan Man Wara Jis Ney Deykha Chehra Kamli Waley Ka Ghaus Qutb Abdaal Kalandar, Sab Unkey Gun Gaathey Hai Farshain Zameen Par Arshay Bareen Par, Charcha Kamli Waley Ka Qabr Mey Jab Poonchein Gey Farishtey Apna Ta'ruf Peysh Karo Tho Keh Dun Ga Unsey, Keh Mey Hun Mangta Pyaray Aqa Ka Har Neymat Deyta Hai Khuda, Par Waar Keh Un Par Deta Hai Khataa Hai Alam Sara Sadqah Kamli Waley Ka Ho Gi Talab Meri Yeh Puri, Duur Woh Karein Gey Wo Duuri Insha'allah Ham Deykhein Gey Rowza Kamli Waley Ka

৩৮

Agar Koi Apna Bhala Bhahta Hai

Agar Koi Apna Bhala Chahta Hai Usey Chahe Jisko, Khuda Chahta Hai Durood Un Pe Bejo Salaam Un Pe Bejo Yahi Momino Se, Khuda Chahta Hai Khuda Ki Raza, Mustafa Chahtey Hai Khuda Mustafa Ki, Raza Chahta Hai Faqiron Ke Malja, Yeh Mangta Tumhara Madine Mein Thori, Silja Chahta Hai Banaley Mujhey Apna Mehman Aaqa Yeh Har Aik Shaho Ghada Chahta Hai. Sana Khwan Banaya, Sana Go Banaya Sahi Dum Se Tu, Aur Kya Chahta Hai Karey Khuld Hasil Habib E Khuda Ka, Jo Insaan Kurbe Khuda Chahta Hai Agar Koi Apna Bhala Chahta Hai Usey Chahi Jisko, Khuda Chahta Hai

৩৯

Ahle Siraat Ruhe Ameen Ko Khabar Karen

Ahle Siraat Ruhe Ameen Ko Khabar Karen Jaati Hai Ummate Nabavi Farsh Parr Kare(N) Inn Fitanhaye Hashr Se Kahdo Hazar Kare(N) Naazo Ke Paale Aate Hai Rah Se Guzar Kare(N) Badd Hai To Aapke Hai Bhale Hai To Aapke Tukdo Se To Yaha(N) Ke Pale Rukh Kidhar Kare(N) Sarkaar Hum Kameeno Ke Atvaar Par Na Jaye Aaqa Huzoor Apne Karam Par Nazar Kare(N) Unki Haram Ke Khaar Kashida Hai Kis Liye Aankho Me Aaye Sar Pe Rahe Dil Me Ghar Kare(N) Jaalo Pe Jaal Padd Gaye Lillah Waqt Hai Mushkil Kushayi Aap Ke Nakhun Agar Kare(N) Manzil Kadee Hai Shane Tabassum Karam Kare Taaro(N) Ki Chaanv Noor Ke Tadke Safar Kare(N) Kilke Raza Hai Khanjare Khu-Khwar Barq-Baar A'ada Se Kehdo Khair Manaye Na Shar Kare(N)

৪০

Aie Taiba

Ragoon Mein Woh Lahoo Baki Nahin Hai Woh Dil, Woh Arzoo Baki Nahin Hai Namaz O Roza O Qurbani O Hajj Yeh Sab Baki Hain, Tu Baki Nahin Hai. Aie Taiba, Aiy Taiba, Ummat Ka Safeena Roh E Zameen Per Koi Nahin Hai, Aisa Hai Madina. Kuch Makki, Kuch Madani, Ayetein Qura'ani Hijrat Ki, Tha Hukmay Rabbani Khairul Anam, Darood O Salaam, Muhammad! Ishq E Rasool, Duaein Houn Qabool, Azmat E Madina. Ya Tayba, Ya Tayba, Ya Dawa Al-Ayyana Eshta'nalik Wil Hawa Nadana, Wil Hawa Nadana Qiblaati Baitullahi Saabir, Al-Laani Yaumal-Laki Zaayeer Ya Turah Haltaraani Naazir, Lilkaaba Tug Murnib Aamaana Tug Murnib Aamaana. Aie Tayba, Aiy Tayba, Ummat Ka Safina Rooh E Zameen Per Koye Nahin Hai, Aisa Hay Madina. Maidan E Badr, Jabl E Ohad, Jazba E Imani Ajm O Arab Teri Hee Sultani Fatima, Ali, Hassan O Hussain Gharana App Rashadi, Khalqa E Sahaba, Kiya Hoga Woh Zamana... Aie Taiba, Aiy Taiba, Ummat Ka Safeena Roh E Zameen Per Koi Nahin Hai, Aisa Hai Madina. Kuch Makki, Kuch Madani, Ayetein Qura'ani Hijrat Ki, Tha Hukmay Rabbani Khairul Anam, Darood O Salaam, Muhammad! Ishq E Rasool, Duaein Houn Qabool, Azmat E Madina. Ya Tayba, Ya Tayba, Ya Dawa Al-Ayyana Eshta'nalik Wil Hawa Nadana, Wil Hawa Nadana

৪১

Aisa Tujhe Khaliq Ne Tarahdaar Banaya

Aisa Tujhe Khaliq Ne Tarahdaar Banaya Yusuf Ko Tera Taalibe Dedaar Banaya Tal’at Se Zamane Ko Pur Anwaar Banaya Nikhat Se Gali Kucho Ko Gulzaar Banaya Deewaro Ko Aaina Banate Hai Wo Jalwe Aaino Ko Jin Jalwo Ne Deewar Banaya Aye Nazme Risalat Ke Chamakte Hue Makte Tune Hi Use Matlaaye Anwaar Banaya Kaunain Banaye Gaye Sarkar Ki Khatir Kounain Ki Khatir Tumhe Sarkar Banaya Kunji Tumhe Di Apne Khazano Ki Khuda Ne Mehboob Kiya Maalik O Mukhtaar Banaya Allah Ki Rehmat Hai Ke Aise Ki Ye Kismat Aasi Ka Tumhe Haami O Gamkhaar Banaya Aainaye Zaate Ahadi Aaphi Thehre Wo Husn Diya Aisa Tarahdaar Banaya Anwaar Tajalli Se Wo Kuch Hairate Chaayi Sab Aaino Ko Pusht Badewaar Banaya Aalam Ke Salateen Bhikari Hai Bhikari Sarkar Banaya Tumhe Sarkar Banaya Ye Lazzate Pa Bos Ke Paththar Ne Jigar Me Nakshe Qadame Sayyed E Abrar Banaya Khuddam To Bande Hai Tere Husne Khalk Ke Pyare Tujhe Badkharo Ka Gamkhaar Banaya Be Parda Wo Jab Khaak Nasheeno Me Nikal Aaye Har Zarre Ko Khursheede Pur Anwaar Banaya Aye Maahe Arab Mehre Ajam Mai Tere Sadqe Zulmat Ne Mere Din Ko Shabe Taar Banaya Lillah Karam Mere Bhi Veeranaye Dil Par Sehra Ko Tere Husn Ne Gulzaar Banaya Allah Ta’ala Bhi Hua Uska Tarafdaar Sarkar Tumhe Jisne Tarafdaar Banaya Gulzaar Jinaa Tere Liye Haq Ne Banaaye Apne Liye Tera Gule Gulzaar Banaya Be Yaar O Madadgaar Jinhe Koi Na Pooche Aiso Ka Tujhe Yaar O Madadgaar Banaya Har Baat Bad Amaliyon Se Maine Hai Bigaadi Aur Tumne Meri Bigdi Ko Har Baar Banaya Us Jalwaaye Rangeen Ka Tasadduk Tha Ke Jisne Firdaus Ke Har Takht Ko Gulzaar Banaya Us Roohe Mujassam Ke Tabarruk Ne Masiha Jaan Bakhsh Tumhe Yu Dame Guftaar Banaya Us Chehraye Pur Noor Ki Wo Bheek Thi Jisne Mehrooma Wo Anjum Ko Pur Anwaar Banaya Un Haatho Ka Jalwa Tha Ye Aye Hazrat E Moosa Jisne Yadi Biza Ko Ziya Baar Banaya Unke Labe Rangi Ki Nichawar Thi Wo Jisne Paththar Me Husn Laalaye E Pur Anwaar Banaya

৪২

Ajab Rang Par Hain Bahaar E Madina

Ajab Rang Par Hain Bahaar E Madina Ke Sab Jannatein Hain Nisaar E Madina Sarkaar Ka Madina Sarkaar Ka Madina Sarkaar Ka Madina Sarkaar Ka Madina Suhaana Suhaana Dulaara Madina Har Aashiq Ki Aankho Ka Taara Madina Pahado Pe Di Husn Kaate Bhi Dil Kash Hai Qudrat Ne Kaisa Sawaara Madina Khula Hain Sabhi Ke Liye Baab E Rehmat Wahan Koi Rutbe Mein Adna Na Aali Muraadon Se Daaman Nahi Koi Khaali Qitare Lagaye Khade Hai Suwaali Main Pehle Pehel Jab Madine Gaya Tha To Thi Dil Ki Haalat Tadap Jaane Wali Wo Darbaar Sach Much Mere Saamne Tha Abhi Tak Tasavvur Tha Jiska Khayali Main Ek Haath Se Dil Sambhale Hue Tha To Thi Dusre Haath Me Thi Unki Jaali Dua Ke Liye Haath Uthte To Kaise Na Ye Haath Khaali Na Wo Haath Khaali Jo Poocha Kisi Ne Ke Tum Nazr Karne Ko Kya Le Gaya Tha To Tafseel Sun Lo, Tha Naaton Ka Ek Haar Ashkon Ke Moti, Duroodon Ka Gajra, Salaamon Ki Daali Yahaan Pyaara Kaaba, Wahaan Sabz Gumbad Ye Makkah Bhi Meetha To Pyaara Madina Khuda Gar Qayamat Me Farmaye Maango Lagaayenge Deewane Naara Madina Madina Madina Humara Madina Hume Jaan O Dil Se Hai Pyara Madina Suhana Suhana Dilara Madina Har Aashiq Ki Aankhon Ka Taara Madina Pahado Pe Bhi Husn, Kaante Bhi Dilkush Hain Qudrat Ne Kaise Sawaara(N) Madina Khuda Gar Qayamat Mein Farmaye Maango Lagayenge Deewane Naara Madina Rage Ghul Ki Jab Naazuki Dekhta Hu Mujhe Yaad Aate Hain Khaar E Madina Mubarak Rahe Andalibo Tumhe Gull Hume Gull Se Behtar Hain Kahaar E Madina Rahe Unke Jalwe Base Unke Jalwe Mera Dil Bane Yaadgaar E Madina Murad E Dil Bul Bule Be Nawade Khudaya Dikha De Bahaar E Madina Jidhar Dekhiye Baage Jannat Khula Hai Nazar May Hai Naqsh O Nigaar E Madina Sharaf Jinse Haasil Hua Ambiya Ko Wahi Hai Hasan Iftekhaar E Madina.

৪৩

Ajj Sik Mitraan Di Wadheri Aey Keyoon Dilrhii Udaas Gharii Aey Loon Loon Wich Showq Changerii Aey Ajj Nennan Laayaan Keyon Jarhyaan Mukh Chand Badar Sha'shaanii Aey Mathey Chankey Laat Nooraanii Aey Kaalii Zulf Te Akh Mastaanii Aey Makhmoor Akheen Han Mad Bharyaan Do Abro Kos Misal Day Saan Jadoon Nokay Mujhday Teer Chutan Laban Surkh Akhan Kay Lal E Yaman Chitay Dan Moti Diyan Hen Lariyan Is Soorat Noon Main Jaan Aakhaan Jaanaan Kih Jaan-E-Jahaan Aakhaan Sach Aakhaan Te Rab De Main Shaan Aakhaan Jis Shaan Theen Shaanaan Sab Banyaan Aehaa Soorat Shaalaa Pesh-E-Nazar Rahey Waqt-E-Naz'a Te Roz-E-Hashar Wich Qabar De Pul Theen Jad Hosii Quzar Sab Khotiyaan Thiisan Tadh Kharyaan Laaho Mukh Theen Mukhttat Burde Yaman Man Bhaanwrii Jhalak Dekhaa'o Sajan Ohaa Mithiyaan Gaaleen Alaao Mithan Jo Hamraa Waadii San Karyaan Aenaan Sikhdiyaan Te Kurlandiyaan Te Lakh Waarii Sadqey Jandiyaan Te Aenaan Burdiyaan Muft Wekaandiyan Te Shaalaa Wat Wi Aawan Oh Gharhyaan Subhan'allah Maa Ajmalaka Maa Ahsanaka Maa Akmalaka Kithey Mehar Ali Kithey Terii Sanaa Gustakh Akheen Kithey Jaa Larhyaan

৪৪

Akhee Sohnay Nuu Waye Nee

Akhee Sohnay Nuu Waye Nee, Jay Tayra Guzar Ho Way May Mar Kay V Nae Marda, Jay Tayri Nazar Ho Way Dam Dam Naal Ziker Karaa, May Tayriyaa Shaanaa Daa Tayray Naam Tou Waar Dey Vaa, Jinni Meri Ummer Ho Way Dewaanay O Baythay Ravvoo, Mehfil Nuu Saja Kay Tay Shayad Mayra Aaqa Daa, Itthou V Guzer Ho Way Ay Ho Dil Wich Niyaazi Day, Ikko Aas Charoukni Ay Sohnay Day Shaher Ander, Kittay Meri Kabar Ho Way Oodi Zaat Tay Her Waylay, Phool Charan Duruuda Day Charcha Mayray Aaqa Da, Her Shaam-O-Saher Ho Way Akhee Sohnay Nuu Waye Nee, Jay Tayra Guzar Ho Way May Mar Kay V Nae Marda, Jay Tayri Nazar Ho Way

৪৫

Akhiyan Vich Sohne Mahi Di

Akhiyan Vich Sohne Mahi Dee Tasveer Sajayi Phirna Aa Kee Jaanan Duniya Dil Vich Main Kee Dard Lukaee Phirna Aa Tere Naa Di Maala Gal Paake Saare Jag Diyan Khushia Thukraa Ke Jera Dard Ditta Teri Furqat Ne Seene Naal Lai Phirna Aa Akhiyan Vich Sohne Mahi Dee Tasveer Sajayi Phirna Aa Kee Jaanan Duniya Dil Vich Main Kee Dard Lukaee Phirna Aa Tera Naam Ziyarat Thakda Nahi Kisse Ghair Valley Main Takda Nahi Jis Din Dee Khaak Madine Di Akhiyan Vich Paai Phirna Aa Akhiyan Vich Sohne Mahi Dee Tasveer Sajayi Phirna Aa Kee Jaanan Duniya Dil Vich Main Kee Dard Lukaee Phirna Aa Koi Oganhaar Nai Mere Jeya Koi Parda Posh Nai Tere Jeya Aese Lai Teri Rahmat Te Umeed Lagaai Phirna Aa Kee Jaanan Duniya Dil Vich Main Kee Dard Lukaee Phirna Aa Akhiyan Vich Sohne Mahi Dee Tasveer Sajayi Phirna Aa Sanu Murshid Kamil Mil Gaya Ae Sada Khul Gaya Buha Dil Da Ae Mainu Kalmah Parhan Da Das Ke Te Insaan Banaya Murshid Ne Kinna Murshid Da Ehsaan Hoya Dil Da Pura Arman Hoya Meri Ungli Pakarr Ke Jis Wele Meinu Naal Chalaya Murshid Ne Sach Kehnda Han Dandi Maarda Nai Main Tan Hor Kise Kam Kaar Da Nai Dewan Peer/murshid/sohne Da Hoka Gali Gali Jis Kam Murshid Meinu Laa Chaddeya

৪৬

Akss E Rab E Zul Jalaal Allah Hi Allah

Akss E Rab E Zul Jalaal Allah Hi Allah Amma Amina Day Laal Allah Hi Allah Ummati Nuun Jaduun Koii Gham Oanday Nay Mayray Aqa Madinay Tarrap Jaanday Nay Sun-Day Sab Di Kissay Da Ni Dil Ttaawan-Day Mayri Sarkar Sab Da Pala Chaawan-Day Kinnay Aqa Lajpaal Allah Hi Allah Jag Tuun Wakhhraa Maza Aqa Day Pyaar Da Lamha Lamha Karam Wajaan He Maar Da Khhulla Rehnda Sada Booha Sarkar Da Oas Darbar Tay Har Gunahgar Da Poora Hunda Ay Sawaal Allah Hi Allah Jayrra Mahboob Koii Iradah Karay Oas Waylay Khuda Oa Nuun Poora Karay Jiss Tuun Khaliq Kadi Wi Na Parda Karay Jiss Nuun Kaba E Alam Wi Sajda Karay Shaan Sohnay Da Kamaal Allah Hi Allah Ghar Sajaanday Nay Aqa Diyaan Mehfilaan Ddayray Laandiyaan Nay Rab Diyaan Rahmataan Oaday Ghar Wich Sada Rehndiyaan Barkataan Duur Ho Jaandiyaan Sariyaan Ghurbataan Banda Rehnda Khush Haal Allah Hi Allah Peda Jiss Thhaan Huay O Makaan Saj Gya Aap A-Ay Zameen Aasmaan Saj Gya Saari Mehfil Saji Naat Khawaan Saj Gya Nuur Day Naal Saara Jahaan Saj Gya Waah Husn O Jamaal Allah Hi Allah

৪৭

Alaa Yaa Ayyuhas Saaqi Adir Kasan Wa Naa Wilhaa

Alaa Yaa Ayyuhas Saaqi Adir Kasan Wa Naa Wilhaa, Keh Bar Yaad-E-Shahe Kausar Bana Saazeym Mehfilhaa. Balaa Baareed Hubb-E-Shaikh Najdi Bar Wahaabiya, Keh Ishq Aasaan Namood Awwal Wale Uftaad Mushkilhaa. Wahaabi Gar Che Ikhfaami Kunad Bughz-E-Nabi Lekin, Nihaa(N) Key Maanad Aan Raaz-E-Kaz-O-Saazand Mehfilhaa. Tawahhub Gaah Mulk-E-Hind Iqaamat Raa Namie Shaayad, Jaras Fariyaad Mee Daarad Keh Bar Bandeed Mahmilhaa. Salaa-E-Majlisam Dar Gosh-E-Aamad Bee(N) Bia Bishinaw, Jaras Mastaana Mee Goyad Keh Bar Bandeed Mahmilha. Magar Daa(N) Roo Azin Mehfil Rah-E-Arbaab-E-Sunnat Rau, Keh Saalik Bey Khabar Nabood Ze Raah-O-Rasm Manzilha. Darin Jalwat Biyaa Az Raah-E-Khalwat Taa Khuda Yaabi, Mataa Maa Talqa Man Tahwaa Da’iduniya-Wa-Amhilhaa. Dilam Qurbaanat Aay Dood-E-Charaag-E-Mehfil-E-Maulid, Ze Taab-E-Ja’d-E-Mushkeenat Che Khoo(N) Uftaad Dar Dilha. Ghareeq-E-Behr-E-Ishq Ahmadiem Az Farhat-E-Maulid, Kujaa Daanand Haal-E-Maa Sabaksaaraan-E-Saahilha. Raza Mast-E-Jaam-E-Ishq Saaghar Baaz Mee Khwaahad, Alaa Yaa Ayyuhas-Saaqi-Adir Ka’-San Wa Naa Wilhaa.

৪৯

Alfaaz Nahi Milte Sarkaar Ko Kya Kahiye

Alfaaz Nahi Milte Sarkaar Ko Kya Kahiye Jibreel Salaami De Darbaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Akhalqe Muhammad Ki Kya Shaan Niraali Hai Dushman Bhi Padhe Kalma Kirdaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Misaqe Azal Me Jo Iqraare Bala Thehra Jaari Hai Wo Mehshar Tak Iqraar Ko Kya Kahiye. Bas Ek Palak Jhapki Meraaj Hui Poori Us Saahibe Rif’at Ki Raftaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Thi Nutqe Muhammad Me Taasire Kalaame Rab Fusha Bhi Bane Gunge Guftaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Ek Ek Sahabi Par Firdaus Bhi Naazaan Hai Siddique Umar Usman Karraar Ko Kya Kahiye. Aye Toor Tujhe Shayad Wo Baat Na Bhooli Ho Israar Ko Kya Kahiye Inkaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Woh Gaar Ke Jisne Ek Tareekh Banaayi Hai Us Gaar Ko Kya Kahiye Us Yaar Ko Kya Kahiye. Nazmi Teri Naato Ka Andaaz Niraala Hai Mazmoon Anokhe Hai Ash’aar Ko Kya Kahiye.

৫০

Allah Allah Ke Nabi Se

Allah Allah Ke Nabi Se Fariyaad Hai Nafs Ki Badee Se Din Bhar Khelon Mein Khaak Udaayi Laaj Aayi Na Zarro Ki Hansi Se Shab Bhar Sone Hee Se Garaz Thi Taaron Ne Hazaar Daant Peese Imaan Pe Maut Behtar O Nafs Teri Naapaak Zindagi Se O Shahad Numaaye Zahar Dar Jaam Gum Jaaoon Kidhar Teri Badee Se Gehre Pyare Purane Dilsoz Guzra Main Teri Dosti Se Tuj Se Jo Uthaaye Main Ne Sadme Aise Na Mile Kabhi Kisi Se Uf Re Khud Kaam Be Murawwat Padta Hai Kaam Aadmi Se To Ne Hi Kiya Khud Se Naadim Tu Ne Hi Kiya Khazil Nabi Se Kaise Aaqa Ka Hukm Taala Hum Mar Mite Teri Khud-Saree Se Aati Na Thi Jab Badee Bhi Tujh Ko Hum Jaante Hain Tujhe Jabhi Se Had Ke Zaalim Sitam Ke Katthar Patthar Sharmaayen Tere Jee Se Hum Khaak Mein Mil Chuke Hain Kab Ke Nikla Na Gubaar Tere Jee Se Hai Zaalim! Main Nibahoon Tujh Se Allah Bachaye Us Ghadi Se Jo Tum Ko Na Jaanta Ho Hazrat Chaalen Chaliye Us Ajnabi Se Allah Ke Saamne Who Gun The Yaaron Main Kaise Muttaqi Se Rehzan Ne Loot Lee Kamaayi Fariyaad Hai Khizr Haashmi Se Allah Koonye Main Khud Gira Hoon Apni Naalish Karu(N) Tujhi Se Hain Pushte Panah Gause Aa’zam Kyun Darte Ho Raza Kisi Se

৫১

Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein

Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Seekhne Zindagi Ke Kareene Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Jis Se Bujhti Har Rooh Ki Tishnagi Ham Us Hi Aab E Rehmat Ko Peene Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Aaj Tak Zindagi Zindagi Hi Na Thi Zindagi Ko Mubarak Ho Jeene Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Is Taraf Haath Phailaye Pahunche Ghulam Us Taraf Rehmaton Ke Khazeene Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Allah Allah Yeh Aabru E Uruj Ham Madine Chalein Ham Madine Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein Yeh Unhi Ka Karam Hai Ke Behzad Ham Zakhm E Qalb E Shikasta Ko Seene Chalein Allah Allah Phir Ham Madine Chalein

৫২

Allah Da Karam Hoya Sohna Duniya Te Aaya Eh

Allah Da Karam Hoya, Sohna Duniya Te Aaya Eh, Aamina Da Chan Tak Ke, Eh Chan Sharmaaye Eh, Allah Da Habeeb Aaya, Rukh Phir Gaye Khizaawaan De, Rehmat Payi Bardi Eh, Rukh Dasde Hawawaan De, Allah Da Karaam Hoya, Badal Noor Da Chaa Gaya Eh, Allah Da O Yaar Sohna, Aaj Duniya Te Aagaaya Eh, Allah Da Habeeb Aaya, Wekho Ka’be Wee Phir Gaye Ne, Pathran Wi Parhe Kalme, Bu’t Qadman Vich Gir Gaaye Ne, Allah Da Habeeb Aya, Eho Wajde Paye Naare Ne, Rab Wee Darood Parhda, Naale Noori Wee Sare Ne, Allah Da Habeeb Aaya, Phul Khirre Ne Ghulaab Jaye, Sohna A Churra Lesi, Gunahgaar Shahaab Jaaye, Allah Da Karam Hoya, Sohna Duniya Te Aaya Eh, Aamina Da Chan Tak Ke, Eh Chan Sharmaaye Eh,

৫৩

Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida

Zindagi Da Koi Tay Maeyaar Hona Chahida Kujh Te Hayaati Da Mayaar Huna Chahi Da Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Saanu Yaar-E-Ghaar Nay Dassayya Ey Dosto Sab Kujh Sohnay Tou Nisaar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Aqa Jaddo Yaad Karo Apne Gulama Nuu Sadda Wi Ghulama Wich Shumaar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Aur Houn Jaan Saaday Tay, Allah Ay Enayataa Kay Juunday Juunday Sohnay Da Dedaar Ho Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Aur Koi Tamanna See, Siddique Yaar-E-Ghaar De Kay Yaar Naalay Yaar Da Mazaar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Hasan Tay Hussain Tou, Jind Jaan Waar Kay Ali Day Gulama Cho Shumaar Hona Chahi Da Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Jayray Tairay Naam Diya Mehfala Sajaunday Nay Inha Bayliya Da Bayra Paar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida Ay Labba Tay Niyaazi Ho, Saa Jaddo Aakhri Uss Wailay Sohnay Da Dedaar Hona Chahida Allah De Habeeb Naal Piyaar Hona Chahida

৫৪

Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina

Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Aati Hai Yahi Lab Pe Dua Rozo Shabina Ramzan Me Umre Ki Sa'adat Mujhe De De Aaqa Ki Ma-E-Yeth Mile Haj Ka Qazina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Aati Hai Yahi Lab Pe Dua Rozo Shabina Sehri Ki Woh Raunak Dare Sarkar Pe Dekhe Allah Mera Ghar Bhi Ho Mehroom Kahi Na Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Aati Hai Yahi Lab Pe Dua Rozo Shabina Iftar Karu Masjide Nabawi Ke Sehan Me Mil Jaye Meri Zeest Ko Lamhate Sakina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Aati Hai Yahi Lab Pe Dua Rozo Shabina Ramzane Madina Jo Guzar Jaaye Karam Se Phir Eid Ujagar Ki Ho Ha Eid E Madina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Allah Dikha De Mujhe Ramzane Madina Aati Hai Yahi Lab Pe Dua Rozo Shabina

৫৫

Allah Hi Allah Mere Nabi Di

Allah Hi Allah Mere Nabi Di, Sab Toh Shaan Niraali Eh, Sab De Aayb Chupaawaan Waali, Aaqa Di Zaat Niraali Eh, Teriya Ummeeda Da Gulshan, Harya Barya Rehnda Eh, Jis Din To Main Sabz Gumbad Di, Wekh Laayi Haryaali Eh, Lakh Rawe Koi Karda Bhawe, Dil Vich Allah Allah Hoo, Je Nahi Sil Vich Ishq Nabi Da, Samjho O Bhandha Khaali Eh, Us Di Misl Misaal Na Koi, Oo De Jeya Lajpaal Na Koi, Sohniya De O Dil Vi Rehde, Koojea Da Wee O Saaiin Eh, Dil Vich Ishq Da Chaanan Howe, Fer Niazi Wekh Zara, O Sarkaar Da Roza Jisda, O Sarkaar Di Jaali Eh, Menu Sud Bud Hor Na Koi, Eni Gal Samjha Dewa, Jis Te Sohna Ho Gaya Raazi, Oho Hi Karma Waali Eh,

৫৬

Allah Kare Ke Ho Jaaye Guzar Taiba Ki Galliyon Se

Allah Kare Ke Ho Jaaye Guzar Taiba Ki Galliyon Se, Main Saari Zindagi Kar Doon Bassar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Hua Jo Aamina Bi Ki Goad Mein Tera Zahoor Aaqa, Khud Jibriel Ne Yeh Di Khabbar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Jo Dekha Gumbad-E-Khadra Ke Saaye Mein Kharre Ho Kar, Jamaal-E-Mustafa Aaya Nazar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Tere Darbaar Ka Darba Banoo Main Bhi Kabhi Aaqa, Mere Dilbar Mujhe Bhi Ho Fakhar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Hawaaein Rehmaton Ki Wahaan Subho O Shaam Chalti Hain, Barasta Noor Hai Sham O Sahar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Tere Dar Ke Galli Kooche Jo Palkhon Par Uthaoon Main, Meri Saari Guzar Jaaye Ummar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Jo Tukre Ho Gaya Tha Mere Aaqa Ke Ishaare Par, Najdi Tum Ne Nahi Dekha Qamar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Du’a Rabb Se Yeh Karta Hoon Subho Se Shaam Ro Ro Kar, Ali Akbar, Teri Bhi Ho Qabar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein. Hua Jo Aamina Bi Ki Goad Mein Tera Zahoor Aaqa, Khud Jibriel Ne Yeh Di Khabbar Taiba Ki Galliyon Mein.

Aqa Bachalo Is Aasi Ko Jo Duba Huva Hai Gunaho Me Ab Aap Hi Ise Bachana Ya Rasula Llah Mai Qatakaar Hoo Mai Gunahgaar Hoo Mai Siyakar Hoo Mujh Bad Ko Aap Hi Bachana Ya Rasula Llah Tum Malik-O-Muqtaar Ho Jise Chahe Jo Chahe Use Ataa Karde Meri Bhi Jholi Bhardena Ya Rasula Llah Mere Bad Aamal Ke Sabab Mujh Par Azab Ho Jab Qabr Me Mujhe Tum Bachane Aana Ya Rasula Llah Sunta Hoo Logon Se Ke Aqa Ghar Tashrif Laye Qaab Me Mere Qaab Me Bhi Tum Aana Ya Rasula Llah Tere Dar Ki Haazri Ke Liye Kab Se Hoo Shaha Betab Mujhe Dar Pe Tum Bulana Ya Rasula Llah Ghamo Ke Samandar Me Dubta Ja Raha Hai Mera Safina Ho Jai Nazre Karam Kinare Lag Jai Mera Safina Ya Rasula Llah Kuch Amal Nahi Is Aasi Ke Paas Sar Ta Pa Gunaho Me Duba Huva Hai Mahshar Me Tum Hi Bharam Rakhna Ya Rasula Llah Hoga Jab Khuda Jalal Me Puche Jab Mujh Se Mera Amal Mujhe Mahshar Me Tum Bachana Ya Rasula Llah Nikle Meri Rooh Tere Hi Dayar Me Sabz Gumbad Ke Saye Me Is Waqt Mujhe Apna Didar Bhi Karana Ya Rasula Llah Gar Hind Me Israiel Meri Rooh Lene Aaye Kahdena Tahro Ise Aajane Do Madina Ya Rasula Llah Hogaye Hai Dur Mujh Se Mere Dost-O-Ahbab Mujh Se Tum Na Dur Ho Jana Ya Rasula Llah Hubbe Duniya Se Bachakar Mujhe Apni Kambli Me Chupalena Bas Mai Banjau Tera Hi Diwana Ya Rasula Llah Jaber Jo Aap Ke Dar Ki Hazri Ke Liye Tadap Raha Hai Ise Jald Taiba Me Bulana Ya Rasula Llah

৭৫

Aqa Ko Pukaar Bandey, Aqa Ko Pukaar! Insha'allah Ho Jaey Ga Insha'allah Ho Jaey Ga Insha'allah Ho Jaey Ga Tera Beyra Paar Un Ke Haath Main Kul-Kunji Hai Rab Ne Unhe Mukhtar Kiya Ham Ko Un Ka Mangta Banaya Aur Unhe Sarkaar Kiya Jo Sarkar Ke Dar Ka Gada Hai, Wo Khud Hai Mukhtar Aala Hazrat Ne Yaro Ye Sabaq Hume Sikhla Hai Jo Gustakh-E-Khuda O Nabi Hai Apna Nahi Wo Paraya Hai Haan Aaise Gustakhon Par Moula Ki Hai Phitkaar Kya Kehna Darbar E Nabi Ka, Uski Shaan Aali Hai Hargiz Na Mehroom Wo Lauta Us Dar Ka Jo Sawali Hai Aao Chale Aab Suye Madina, Chorr Ke Sab Gharbaar Jab Se Hosh Samhala Maine Unki Naate Padta Hoon Gustaqi Na Hojae Mai Samhal Samhal Ke Chalta Hoon Maa Ki Duaon Ke Sadqe Me Hoga Bedha Paar Kyu Gham-Geen Hai Tu Ay Sayyed Dar Par Wo Bulwaenge Ranj-O-Gham Sab Door Karainge Soye Bhaag Jagayaenge Aur Bhi Koi Unke Siwa Hai Dukhiyo Ka Gham Khaar Summa Dana Fatadalla Ka Mansab Sarkaar Ko Hasil Hai Pohoch Na Paya Koi Us Jaah, Jo Sarkaar Ki Manzil Hai Asraa Ki Shab Udnu Minni Rab Ki Thi Pukaar Apni To Pehchan Yahi Hai Apni To Hai Shaan Yahi Daman Me Kuch Aur Nahi Hai Dil Me Hai Armaan Yahi Itni Padu Mai Unki Naate Raazi Ho Sarkaar Yade Nabi Me Tu Aye Rizwan Unki Midhat Karta Ja Dewaano Ke Dil Bhar Aaye Jhoom Ke Naate Padta Ja Jaldi Madine Jayega Tu Lagte Hai Aasar

৭৬

Aqsa Mein Khitabat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne

Aqsa Mein Khitabat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Nabiyon Ki Imaamat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Azaaz Nahi Koi Is Mojize Se Badh Kar Allah Ki Ziyarat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Jo Panch Namaazein Hain Meraaj Ka Tohfa Hai Aasaani E Ummat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Asra Ki Gawahi Di Bu Bakr Hue Siddique Han Rab Ki Ziyarat Ki Meraj Mein Aaqa Ne Yun Guzre Falak De Paar Chashme Se Ho Nazrein Paar Aur Lamhon Mein Raja’at Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Woh Qurb E Khuda Mein Bhi Bhoole Nahi Ummat Ko Ki Baat Shafa’at Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Har Khaki Wa Noorie Par Nabiyon Pe Sharaf Unka Do Jagg Mein Sayadat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne Meraaj Ki Jismaani Bedaar Nigaahon Se Be Parda Ziyarat Ki Meraaj Mein Aaqa Ne

Aqse Roo E Mustafa Se Aisi Zebayi Mili Khil Utha Rang E Chaman Phoolon Ko Raanaayi Mili Sabz Gumbad Ke Manazir Dekhta Rehta Hoon Main Ishq Me Chashme Tassawur Ko Wo Gehrayi Mili Arze Taiba Me Muyassar Aa Gayi Do Gaz Zameen Yuh Hamare Muntashir Ajza Ko Yaqtayi Mili Behre Ishq-E-Mustafa Ka Majra Ho Kya Bayaan Lutf Aaya Dubne Ka Jitni Gehrayi Mili Unke Khadmo Me Hai Taaj-O-Taqt Haft Aqleem Ke Aap Ke Adna Ghulamo Ko Wo Darayi Mili Chadar E Zahra Ka Saaya Hai Mere Sar Par Naseer Faiz E Nisbat Dekhiye Nisbat Bhi Zahraayi Mili Jis Taraf Utthi Nigahein Mehfile Kaunain Mein Rehmatallil-Aalamin Ki Jalwa Farmaee Mili Allah Allah Ye Nigahein Mustafa Ka Mo'jaza Sang-Reze Bol Utthe Unko Goyaee Mili Chadare Zohra Ka Saya Hai Mere Sar Par Naseeb Faize Nisbat Dekhiye Nisbat Bhi Zohraee Mili

৮০

Arsh Se Aage Jaake Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They

Arsh Se Aage Jaake Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Noore Mujassam Ban Ke Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Chand Hua Shak Suraj Palta Unke Ek Ishare Se Tum Bhi Zara Ye Kar Ke Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Summa Dana Fatadalla Unki Qurb Ki Manzil Ka Hai Bayaa Hai Gar Mumkin Tum Bhi Jao Phir Kehna Hum Jesethey Hazrat E Jabir Ki Dawat Me Jaise Hazaro Sair Huve Dawat Aisi Tum Bhi Khilao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Khoob Baha Panjabe Rehmat Khub Hue Sairaab Sabhi Pani Aisa Tum Bhi Pilao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Hirni Wapas Laut Ke Aai Unse Wafa Ka Dars Diya Aisi Huqumat Tum Bhi Chalao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Unka Yad Beshak Hai Yadullah Unka Kalaam Allah Ka Kalaam Dasto Zubaan Apne To Dekhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Maana Bashar Wo Bhi Hai Lekin Yuha Ilaiya Bhi To Padho Koi Wahi Ek Tum Bhi Laao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Inna Aatayna Kal Kausar Aur Rafana Laka Zikrak Sura E Toaba Padhte Jao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Wo Hai Luab E Paak Nabi Ka Khari Kooye Meethey Hue Meetha Tum Bhi Karke Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Daste Mubarak Ki Barkat Se Tooti Haddi Thik Hui Haath Zara Apna Bhi Badhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They Shaan Hai Ye Khuddame Nabi Ki Murdo Ko Bhi Zinda Kiya Tum Bhi Zara Thokar Se Jilao Phir Kahna Hum Jaise They Shan Hai Ye Guas E Aazam Ki Murdo Ko Bhi Zinda Kiya Tum Bhi Zara Thokar Se Jilao Phir Kahna Hum Jaise They Unki Zuban Hai Kun Ki Kunji Seerat Unki Hai Qur’an Aisi Ata Gar Ho To Batao Phir Kahna Hum Jaise They Unke Sanakhawa Hazat E Hassan Naat Hai Saara Hi Qur’an Koi Muhammad Aur Batao Phir Kahna Hum Jaise They Khulke Azeem Akhlak Hai Kiska Arsh Ka Dulha Ksun Bana Aur Koi Aisa Hai Batao Phir Kahna Hum Jaise They Pooch To Rizwan Unke Adu Se Saani Kaha Se Laoge Aao Zara Saya To Dikhao Phir Kehna Hum Jaise They

৮১

Arshe Haq Hai Masnade Rifat Rasoolullah Ki

Arshe Haq Hai Masnade Rif'at Rasoolullah Ki Dekhni He Hashr Me Izzat Rasoolullah Ki Laa Wa Rabbil Arsh Jisko Jo Mila Unse Mila Bat'ti He Kownain Me Ne'mat Rasoolullah Ki Sooraj Ulte Paaw Palte Chaand Ishaare Se Ho Chaak Andhe Najdi Dekhle Qudrat Rasoolullah Ki Tujhse Aur Jannat Se Kya Matlab Wahabi Duur Ho Hum Rasoolullah Ke, Jannat Rasoolullah Ki Hum Bhikaari Wo Kareem, Unka Khudaa Unse Fazoo Aur Naa Kehna Nahee Aadat Rasoolullah Ki Wo Jahannum Me Gaya Jo Unse Mustaghni Huwa Hai Khalleelullah Ko Haajat Rasoolullah Ki Qabr Me Lehrayenge Tha Hasr Chashme Noor Ke Jalwah Farma Hogi Jab Tal'at Rasoolullah Ki Kaafiro Par Taighe Waala Se Giri Bakre Ghazab Abr-Aasa Cha Gayi Haibat Rasoolullah Ki Zikr Roke Fazal Kaate Naqs Ka Juya(N) Rahe Phir Kahe Mardak Ke Hu Ummat Rasoolullah Ki Najdi Usne Tujhko Mohlat Di Ki Iss Aalam Me Hai Kaafiro Murtad Pe Rehmat Rasoolullah Ki Ahle Sunnat Ka He Bera Paar Ashaabe Rasool Najm He Aur Naav Hai Itrat Rasoolullah Ki Khaaq Ho Kar Ishq Me Aaram Se Sona Mila Jaan Ki Akseer Hai Ulfat Rasoolullah Ki Toot Jaa-Enge Gunaahgaro Ke Fawran Qaid-O-Bund Hashr Ko Khuljaaegi Taaqat Rasoolullah Ki Ya Rabb Ik Saa'at Me Dhul Jaa-E Siyaahkaro Ke Jurm Josh Par Aa Jaaye Ab Rehmat Rasoolullah Ki Hai Ghule Baaghe Qudus Rukhsaar E Zeba E Huzoor Sarve Ghulzaar E Qadam Kaamat Rasoolullah Ki Ae Raza Khud Saahibe Quraan Hai Mud'daahe Huzoor To Mujhse Kab Mumkin He Phir Midhat Rasoolullah Ki

৮৩

Arze Jannat Kaun Chahe Arze Taiba Dekh Kar

Arze Jannat Kaun Chahe Arze Taiba Dekh Kar, Unka Rauza Dekh Kar Kaabe Ka Kaaba Dekh Kar. Ruk Gaye Jibreel Jab Miqat-E-Sidra Dekh Kar, Badhne Wale Badh Gaye Qurbat Ka Lamha Dekh Kar. Banke Shamshir-E-Mujassam Ibn-E-Khattab Aaye The, Apna Sauda Kar Gaye Aaqa Ka Chehra Dekh Kar. Ya Muhammad 'irfa-Rasak' Jab Khuda Farmayega, Jee Uthegi Ummate Mehshar Ka Sajda Dekh Kar. Najdiya Pachtayega Tu Insha Allah Hashr Me, Mere Daye Hath Me Aamal Naama Dekh Kar. Hazrat-E-Jaabir Ka Imaan Aur Pukhta Ho Gaya, Sainkdo Hatho Me Barkat Ka Niwala Dekh Kar. Aaya Tha Shaitan Par Maayus Ho Kar Chal Diya, Mere Dil Par Ulfat-E-Ahmed Ka Pehra Dekh Kar. Kaabe Se Poocha Kya Tera Bhi Koi Qibla Hua, Kaaba Karta Hai Ishara Simt-E-Taibah Dekh Kar. Mujko Jeete Ji Zameen Par Lutf-E-Jannat Mil Gaya, Unka Mimbar Dekh Kar Mehrab-E-Sajda Dekh Kar. Rashq Se Jhoomenge Saare Ambiya Mehshar Ke Din, Noori Shano Par Shafa’at Ka Doshala Dekh Kar. Mujko Jannat Khud Bulayegi Yahi Ummeed Hai, Meri Gardan Me Pada Barkaati Patta Dekh Kar. Zaair-E-Raah-E-Madina Tujko Kuch Maaloom Hai, Rashq Karti Hai Iram Tera Irada Dekh Kar. Sayyed-Ush-Shohda Laqab Jin Ko Mila Sarkaar Se, Qudsiyo Ko Rashq Aaye Shaan-E-Hamza Dekh Kar. Naat Goi Nazmi Ne Seekhi Hassaan-Ul-Hind Se, Naat Kehte The Bareli Me Jo Taibah Dekh Kar.

৮৪

As Sub Hu Bada Min Talati Hii

As Sub Hu Bada Min Tal’ati Hii Wal- Laylu Dajaa Minv Wafrati Hee Hai Noor-E-Sahar Chehre Say Tere Aur Shab Ki Raunak Zulfoon Say. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah Kanz-Ul-Karami Mowl-An-Ni’ Amii Haad-Il-Umami Li Shari’ati Hii. Nimat Ka Khazina Hain Mawla Ganjina-Yi Rehmat Ke Hai Aqaa Hadi Hai Tammam-I Ummat Ke Aur Rahnuma Hai Shariat Kay. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah Sa’at-Ish-Shajaruu Nataq-Al-Hajaruu Shaqq-Al-Qamaruu Bi Ishaaratihii Ungli Ke Ishare Pair (Trees) Chale Eijaz Se Pathar Bol Uthe Aur Chand Huwa Hai Dhoo Tukre Angusht Ke Aik Ishare Se. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah Jibrilu Ataa Laylata Asraa W-Ar-Rabbu Da’aa Fii Hadrati Hii Jibril-I Amin Paigham-I Khuda Lekar Aye Thay Shab-I Asra Allah Hane Arsh Pay Bulvayaa Kurbat Ka Sharaf Unko Bakhsha. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah Fa Muhammaduna Huwa Sayiduna Fal Iszulana Li Ijaabetihi So Mohammad Hai Apne Aqaa Isi Naam Se Apni Izzo Baqaa. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah As Subhu Badaa Min Tal’ati Hii Wal- Laylu Dajaa Minv Wafrati Hee Hai Noor E- Sahar Chehre Se Teray Aur Shab Ki Raunak Zulfoon Se. Allahu Allahu Allahu Allah --------------------Translation---------------------- The Light Of Dawn Is From The Radiance Of His Face The Sparkle Of The Night Is From The Glimmer Of His Hair He Is The Treasure Of Grace, The Treasure Of Mercy The Guide Of The Nation Towards His Shariah (Islamic Law) The Tree Began To Walk, The Stone Began To Speak The Moon Split Into Two Upon The His Order Jibril (Angel) Came On The Night Of Me'raaj (Ascension) The Almighty Invited Him To The Heaven Muhammed (Pbuh) Is Our Benefactor. He (Pbuh) Is Our Leader. This Blessed Name Of Muhammed (Pbuh) Will Preserve Our Dignity.

৮৯

Aye Khuda Hind Me Rakhna Mera Imaan Mehfooz

Aye Khuda Hind Me Rakhna Mera Imaa(N) Mehfooz, Khaar Ke Beech Ho Jaise Gule Khandaa(N) Mehfooz. Iski Aayat Me Tahreef Nahi Ho Sakti, Rab Ka Waada Hai Rahega Yunhi Qur’an Mehfooz. Aaj Ke Daur Me Achhai Ki Baate Sahab, Hai Ganimat Ke Rahe Aapka Imaa(N) Mehfooz. Iltija Rab Se Yahi Hai Ke Rahe Mehshar Tak, Saare Aalam-O-Masaaib Se Musalmaa(N) Mehfooz. Jab Talak Aaye Na Achhai Burai Ki Tameez, Kaise Reh Sakta Hai Insaan Ka Imaa(N) Mehfooz. Rab Ki Hikmat Ke Bina Hil Nahi Sakta Patta, Uski Marzi Thi Rahe Yusuf-E-Kin’aa(N) Mehfooz. Naat Ke Baare Me Poocha To Ye Nazmi Ne Kaha, Us Se Rehti Hai Meri Jaan Mera Imaa(N) Mehfooz.

৯০

Aye Qaza Thehar Ja Unse Karlu Zara

Aye Qaza Thehar Ja Unse Karlu Zara Ik Haseen Guftagoo Aaakhri Aaakhri Aur Koi Tamanna Nahi Ba Khuda Hai Yahi Aarzoo Aakhri Aakhri Aansoon Ki Jo Rut Hai Badal Jaayegi Jaan Aaraam Se Phir Nikal Jaayegi Pooch Le Gar Zara Haal Haazra Mera Baith Kar Rubaru Aaakhri Aaakhri Mere Ghar Mein Woh Jis Waqt Aa Jaayenge Unke Daaman Se Pal Pal Lipat Jaayenge Saamne Unke Naino Ko Kar Waayenge Aasuoon Se Wuzu Aaakhri Aaakhri Meri Halat Ba Zaahir To Kamzor Hai Unke Gham Se Badi Saans Ki Dor Hai Pohoch Jaau Faaqat Unke Qadmon Talak Hai Yahi Justajoo Aakhri Aakhri Isse Pehle Ke Uth Kar Chale Jaaye Woh Kissa E Gham Mukammal Na Sun Paaye Woh Hosh Kar Be-Khabar Waqt Hai Mukhtasar Bol De Lafz Tu Aakhri Aakhri Unki Basti Mein Le Chal Mujhe Chaara Gar Dekhni Hai Wo Galiyaan Faaqat Ik Nazar Chahati Hai Nigaah Unki Ho Baargah Dekhlu Chaarsoo Aakhri Aakhri Raat Dhalte Hi Yeh Lafz Ruk Jaayegi Toot Kar Shaakh Saanson Ki Jukh Jaayegi Aise Lagta Hai Ab To Yeh Hakim Mujhe Hogi Subho Namoon Aakhri Aakhri

৯১

Aye Sarware Dunya O Deen

Aye Sarware Dunya O Deen Teri Niraali Shaan Heh Dar Heh Tera Rashke Haram Chehra Tera Quraan Heh Khatme Rasool, Mukhtare Gul Nabiyo Ka Thu Sultaan Heh Surat Teri, Husne Azal Tujhpe Jaha Qurbaan Heh Mangtoh Ko Aaka Rak Baram Karde Karam Shahe Umam Dookiyo Ki Mushkil Taalna Tere Liye Asaan Heh Mehraj Ka Doolha Heh Thu Khaliq Ke Dar Pochcha Heh Thu Thu Heh Habibe Kibriya Thu Arsh Ka Mehmaan Heh Darse Tere, Vaabastagi Dono Jaha Ki Behtari Nisbat Teri Yaa Mustafa Imaan Ki Pehchaan Heh

৯২

Aye Shafaye Umam Shahe Zeen Jaah Le Khabar

Aye Shafaye Umam Shahe Zee(N) Jaah Le Khabar Lillah Le Khabar Meri Lillah Le Khabar Dariya Ka Josh, Naav Na Beda Na Naakhuda Main Dooba, Tu Kaha(N) Hai Mere Shah Le Khabar Manzil Kadi Hai Raat Andheri Main Na Balad Aye Khizr Le Khabar Meri Aye Maah Le Khabar Pahuche Pahuchne Wale To Manzil Magar Shaha Unki Jo Thak Ke Baithe Sare Raah Le Khabar Jungle Darindo(N) Ka Hai Main Be Yaar Shab Kareeb Ghere Hai Chaar Samt Se Bad Khwah Le Khabar Manzil Nayi Azeez Juda Log Na Shanaas Toota Hai Kohe Gham Mein Pare Kaah Le Khabar Woh Sakhtiya(N) Sawaal Ki Woh Surate(N) Muhibb Aye Ghamzado(N) Ke Haal Se Aagaah Le Khabar Mujrim Ko Bargaahe Adalat Mein Laaye Hain Takta Hai Be Kasi Mein Teri Raah Le Khabar Ahle Amal Ko Unke Amal Kaam Aayenge Mera Hai Kaun Tere Siwa Aah Le Khabar Purkhaar Raah, Barhana Pa, Tishna Aab Door Maula Padi Hai Aafate Jaankaah Le Khabar Bahar Zabaane(N) Pyaas Se Hain, Aaftaab Garm Kauthar Ke Shah Kath-Tharahu-Llah Le Khabar Maana Ki Sakht Mujrimo Naakaara Hai Raza Teri Hi To Hai Bandaye Dargaah Le Khabar

৯৩

Azal Ki Khushboo Ho Jismein Pinhaan

Azal Ki Khushboo Ho Jismein Pinhaa’n Koi Batae Tu Naam Aisa Wo Naam-E-Ahmed Ke Phool Barsein Bayan Aisa Kalam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Wohi Hai Qur’an Wohi Ha Furqa’n Wohi Hai Rab Jiska Hai Sama Khaa’n Farishte Pardh Pardh Ke Jhoomte Hain Durood Aisa Salam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Hai Deen-E-Haq Mein Jamal-E-Yazdaan Hai Arsh Bhi Jispe Naaza’n Wohi Tu Laya Hai Deen Aisa Wohi Tu Laya Nizaam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Wo Jis Ka Saya Tu Arsh Par Hai Wo Jis Ka Zaroon Ke Dil Mein Ghar Hai Wohi Jo Chamka Tu Phir Na Dooba Wohi Hai Mahe Tamam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Nazar Be Yaqsaa’n Ghulam-O-Aaqa Buzurgon Par Tar Hai Sirf Taqwa Koi Jahan Mein Hai Deen Aisa Kahin Hai Koi Nizaam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Woh Jis Andheri Gali Se Guzra Badal Diya Noor Mein Andhera Dilon Ki Dunia Badal Ke Rakhdi Dia Dilon Ko Payam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Aqeel Aisa Khalil Aisa Jalil Aisa Jamil Aisa Na Riffaton Mein Na Azmaton Mein Kisi Ne Paya Maqam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Qala’t Aisi Sa’adat Aisi Riya’zat Aisi ‘iba’da’t Aisi Wo Jispe Kaabe Ko Washjd Aaya Sujood Aisa Qayam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo Azal Ki Khush Boo Ho Jismein Pinhaa’n Koi Batae Tu Naam Aisa Woh Naam-E-Ahmed Ke Phool Barsein Bayan Aisa Kalam Aisa Azal Ki Khushboo

৯৪

Azmate Mustafa Jaanne Ke Liye

Azmate Mustafa Jaanne Ke Liye Sidq Dil Aur Fikre Raza Chahiye Qurbate Rab Hai Is Baat Par Munhasir Dil Ki Dhadkan May Salle Ala Chaiye. Hum Madine Ki Galiyon Me Jaa Kar Basen Raat Din Un Ke Qadmon Me Lota Karen Apne Aaqa Ka Sadqa Utaara Karen Hum Ghulaamon Ko Bas Aur Kya Chahiye. Jab Haraarat Gunaahon Ki Had Se Badhe Mehre Roze Qayamat Saron Par Chadhe Aisi Naazuk Ghadi Mein Khuda Ki Qasam Daamane Mustafa Ki Hawa Chahiye. Sabz Gumbad Ki Ziyaarat Jise Mil Gayi Uski Qismat Ki Goya Kali Khil Gayi Yun Madine Ko Jaayen Ke Laute Na Hum Ishq Kehta He Aisi Dua Chahiye. Khaandaane Nabi Se Hai Rishta Mera Phir Bhi Jannat Pe Mera Ijaara Nahi Neko Saaleh Banoon Baa Shariyat Rahoon Aap Logon Ki Itni Dua Chahiye. Gause Aazam Ka Saaya Hai Sar Par Mere Mujh Pe Khwaja Ki Bhi Hai Nigaahe Karam Shaahe Barkat Ke Dar Ka Mai Darbaan Hoon Mujh Ko Peeron Ki Noori Ziya Chahiye. Faiz Nazmi Ko Murshid Ke Dar Se Mila Is Ko Bhi Naat Kehne Ka Fan Aa Gaya Par Abhi Pukhtagi Is Me Aayi Nahin Thodi Taaseere Kilke Raza Chahiye.

৯৫

Baat Jo Kijiye Aur Jab Kijiye

Baat Jo Kijiye Aur Jab Kijiye, Saath Mein Zikr-E-Mehboob-E-Rab Kijiye. Chahtay Ho Milay Zoq Ansu Bahain, Lab Baaton Say Band Apnay Lub Kijiye. Loh Woh Minar-O-Gumbad Nazar Aa Gaye, Ab Salam Arz Sub Ba-Adab Kijiye. Subz Gunbad Kay Saaye Talay Hain Kharay, Khoob Taqdeer Par Rashk Aab Kijiye. Woh Nawaazein Gay Khali Na Lotaayein Gay, Unsay Jo Chahiye Wo Talab Kijiye. Dar Pe Aakar, Bhikari Phirein Namurad, Yeh Gawara Bhala Aap Kab Kijiye. Ru Baroo Jaalion Kay Kharay Hain Hazoor, Ab Ataa Bheek Shah-E-Arab Kijiye. Aap Kay Dar Kay Hotay Kidhar Jaayein Hum, Ab Ataa Bheek Shah-E-Arab Kijiye Dijiye Hum Ko Khairat Deedar Ki, Aab Karam Ya Nabi Behr-E-Rab Kijiye. Mar Raha Hoon Gunahoon Kay Amraaz Say, Ek Nazar Janib-E-Jaan Balab Kijiye. Qalb-E-Tareek Par Rakh Kay Apna Qadam, Chaandna Mere Mah-E-Arab Kijiye. Sun Kay Faryad Imdaad Ko Aa Gaye, Yaad Ubaid-E-Raza Unko Jab Kijiye. Unkay Nisar, Koi Kaisay Bhi Ranj Mein Ho, Jab Yaad Aagaye Hain, Sub Gham Bhula Diye Hain, Yaad Ubaid-E-Raza Un Ko Jab Kijiye. Walah Woh Sun Lein Gay, Faryad Ko Pohnchein Gay, Itna Bhi To Ho Koi, Jo Aah Karay Dil Say, Yaad Ubaid-E-Raza Unko Jab Kijiye. Baat Jo Kijiye Aur Jab Kijiye, Saath Main Zikr-E-Mehboob Kijiye.

৯৬

Baat Kar Madine Ki Zikr Kar Madine Ka

Baat Kar Madine Ki Zikr Kar Madine Ka Ik Yehi Sahara Hai Is Jahan Mein Jeene Ka Wo Tujhe Bachaenge Paar Bhi Lagaenge Un Pey Chor Dey Kashti Ghum Na Kar Safeene Ka Kyun Bhatakta Phirta Hai Puch Apne Murshid Se Wo Bataen Ge Tujhko Raasta Madine Ka Sehnay Gulshan Mein Bhi Aur Gulon Mein Bhi Har Taraf Numaya Hai Mojza Paseenay Ka Aap Ke Qadam Jab Se Aye Hain Madine Mein Zarra Zarra Roshan Hai Aaj Bhi Madine Ka Ey Aleem Chal Tu Bhi Rah Ley Madine Ki Bas Vahin Se Milta Hai Raaz Harr Khazine Ka

৯৭

Badi Kareem Teri Zaat Ya Rasoolallah

Badi Kareem Teri Zaat Ya Rasoolallah Tere Karam Ki Hai Kya Baat Ya Rasoolallah Bhari Hai Jholiyan Tune Sada Faqeeron Ki Hume Bhi Deed Ki Khairaat Ya Rasoolallah Khudaayi Us Muqaddar Pe Rashk Karti Hai Jise Mila Hai Tera Saath Ya Rasoolallah Nazar Ke Samne Ho Jalwe Sabz Gumbad Ke Kabhi To Aaye Woh Lamhaat Ya Rasoolallah Karam Nawaaz Teri Zaat Dono Aalam Mein Idhar Bhi Nazre Inayat Ho Ya Rasoolallah Tamam Umr Sajdo Sabhi Woh Afzal Hai Tere Madine Ki Ik Raat Ya Rasoolallah

৯৮

Badi Shaan Waala Madine Ke Waali

Badi Shaan Waala, Madine Ke Waali Bade Se Bada, Jin Ke Dar Ke Sawali Farishte Bi Meri, Jabeen Choomte Hain Mein Jab Choomloun Unke Roze Ki Jaali Jahan Mein Anokha, Hai Unka Madina Zaamane Mein Hain, Unki Choukat Nirali Mile Unki Rehmat Ki Khayraat Sabko Geya Koi Bi Unke Dar Se Na Khaali Kahan Yeh Huzoori, Kahan Mein Zuhoori Mein Adna Se Adna, Wo Aali Se Aali

৯৯

Badi Shay Hai Nisbat E Mustafa

Badi Shai Hai Nisbate Mustafa Hai Waseela Apni Najaat Ka Shahe Ambiya Ki Jo Aal Hai Barha Uska Jaaho Jalaal Hai Nahi Uski Koi Misaal Hai Wo Habeebe Haq Ka Jamaal Hai Nahi Kaal Is Mein Ye Haal Hai Mila Usko Kaisa Kamaal Hai Ye Khudaye Paak Ki Hai Ataa Badi Shai Hai Nisbate Mustafa Hai Waseela Apni Najaat Ka Wo Jo Ahle Bait Ke Hain Imaam Bade Muttaqi Bade Nek Naam Wo Hain Badshah To Hain Hum Ghulam Bane Unke Madha Sara Tamaam Bada Ooncha Har Ek Ka Hai Maqaam Huwe Pehle Hazrat Ali Imaam Jinhe Sab Ne Asadullah Kaha Badi Shai Hai Nisbate Mustafa Hai Waseela Apni Najaat Ka Ye Hain Aal Aulade Ali Kahi In Mein Alwi Aur Fatimi Yahi Nasl Aale Nabi Bani Hai Mohabbat Inse To Wajibi Hai Riyaz Huqme Khuda Yahi Yahi Hai Hadees Huzoor Ki Kahoon Kyun Na Phir Main Barmala Badi Shai Hai Nisbate Mustafa Hai Waseela Apni Najaat Ka Hain Hassan Imam Hussain Bhi Hain Ali Raza Wo Naqi Taqi Hain Imam Baqir-O-Kazmi Kahin Abdi Kahin Ja’fari Koi Mahdi Koi Hai Askari Hai Har Ek Rasool Ki Raushni Mili Unse Duniya Ko Hai Zia Badi Shai Hai Nisbate Mustafa Hai Waseela Apni Najaat Ka

১০০

Bagh E Jannat Me Nirali Chaman Aarai Hai

Bagh E Jannat Me Nirali Chaman Aarai Hai Kya Madine Pe Fida Hoke Bahar Aayi Hai Unke Gesu Nahi Rehmat Ki Ghata Chaayi Hai Unke Abru Nahi Do Qiblo Ki Yakjayi Hai Sarewala Unhe Rehmat Ki Ghata Laayi Hai Haal Bigda Hai Toh Beemaar Ki Ban Aayi Hai Jiske Haatho Ke Banaye Huye Hai Husno Jamal Aye Haseen Teri Adaa Usko Pasand Aayi Hai Tere Jalwo Me Ye Aalam Hai Ki Chashme Aalam Taab Deedar Nahi Fir Bhi Tamashaayi Hai Jab Teri Yaad Me Duniya Se Gaya Hai Koi Jaan Lene Ko Dulhan Ban Ke Kaza Aayi Hai Darde Dil Kisko Sunao Mai Tumhare Hote Bekaso Ki Isi Sarkar Me Sunwayi Hai Chashme Be Khwaab Ke Sadqe Me Hai Bedaar Naseeb Aap Jaago Toh Hume Chain Ki Neend Aayi Hai Na Ummido Tumhe Muzda Ki Khuda Rehmat Unhe Mehshar Me Tumhare Hi Liye Laayi Hai Aye Hasan Husne Jahaan Taab Ke Sadqe Jau Zarre Zarre Se Aaya Jalwa E Zebayi Hai

১০১

Bahar E Jaan Fiza Tum Ho Naseem E Gulsitaan Tum Ho

Bahar E Jaan Fiza Tum Ho, Naseem E Gulsitaan Tum Ho Bahare Baagh E Rizwan Tum Se Hai Zaibe Jinaa Tum Ho Khuda Ki Saltanat Ka Do Jahan Mein Kaun Dulha Hai Tum Hi Tum Ho, Tum Hi Tum Ho Yahan Tum Ho Wahan Tum Ho Haqeeqat Se Tumhari Juzz Khuda Aur Kaun Waqif Hai Kahe To Kiya Kahe Koi Chuni Tum Ho Chuna Tum Ho Nazar ‘arif Ka Har Alam Main Aya Aap Ka ‘alam Na Hote Tum Tu Kya Hota, Bahar E Har Jahan Tum Ho Kuja Hum Khaak Uftada Kahan Tum Aye Shahe Waala Agar Misle Zameen Hum Hain To Misle Asmaan Tum Ho Ye Kya Maine Kaha Misle Sama Tum Ho Ma’azallah Munazza Misl Se Bartar Ze Har Wehmo Gumaan Tum Ho Main Bhoola Aapki Rif’at Se Nisbat Hi Humein Kya Hai Woh Kehne Bhar Ki Nisbat Thi Kahan Hum Hain Kahan Tum Ho Humein Umeed Hai Roz E Qayamat Unki Rehmat Say Ke Farmaaye Idhar Aao Na Mayoos Az Jina Tum Ho Sitamkaaro Siyahkaro Khatakaro Jafaakaro Humare Daaman E Rehmat Mein Aajao Kahan Tum Ho Tumhare Hote Saare Dardo Dukh Kise Kahoon Pyare Shafiye Aasiyan Tum Ho Wakeele Mujriman Tum Ho Riyazat Ke Yahi Din Hain Budhape Mein Kahan Himmat Jo Kuch Karna Hai Abhi Karlo Abhi Noori Jawaan Tum Ho Faqat Nisbat Ka, Jaise Hoon Haqeeqi Noori Ho Jaaoon Mujhe Jo Dekhe Keh Uthe Miyan Noori Miyan Tum Ho

১০২

Baithe Baithe Kaam Saara Ho Gaya

Baithe Baithe Kaam Saara Ho Gaya Sabz Gumbad Ka Nazaara Ho Gaya Kar Liya Allah Ne Us Ko Pasand, Jo Mere Aaqa Ka Pyaara Ho Gaya Mil Gaya Sadqa Mujhe Aaqa Ka, Zindagi Bhar Ka Guzaara Ho Gaya Naam Naame Mustafa Salle Ala, Besahaaron Ka Sahaara Ho Gaya Aap Ke Darbaar Gohar Baar Se, Saare Mangton Ka Guzaara Ho Gaya Zindagi Bhar Naat Main Padhta Raha Meri Bakshish Ka Sahaara Ho Gaya Mohsin Aasi Hai Yaqeen Ye Hashr Mein Woh Kahenge Tu Hamaara Ho Gaya

১০৩

Bakhshish Ka Silsila Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai

Bakhshish Ka Silsila Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Rehmat Ka Aasra Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Jo Mango Mil Raha Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Ye Faiz Aur Sakha Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Aye Bekaso Aye Mujrimo Aye Aasiyo Suno Gaffaar Kibriya Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Har Lehza Barasti Hai Jo Rehmat Ki Barishe Ye Rab Ka Mahina Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Bakhsha Gaya Jo Aamade Ramzan Pe Khush Hua Kya Paya Martaba Hai Ramzan Kareem Hai Isko Mila Sharaf Hai Nuzule Qur’an Ka Jo Rehmato Shifa Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Shaitaan Hai Fikar Na Dozakh Ka Koi Darr Dar Khuld Ka Bhi Wa Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Tujhko Naseeb Hogi Bahare Haram Bhi Ab Tune Jo Paaliya Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai Sayyed Khuda Ka Shukr Aada Kar Ke Zeest Me Baare Digar Mila Hai Ye Ramzan Kareem Hai

১০৪

Bakhte Kufta Ne Mujhe Roze Pe Jaane Na Diya

Bakhte Kufta Ne Mujhe Roze Pe Jaane Na Diya Chashmo Dil Seene Kaleje Se Lagane Na Diya Aah Qismat Mujhe Dunya K Ghamoo Ne Roka Ha'ay Taqdeer K Taiba Mujhe Jaane Na Diya Paoon Thak Jaate Agar Paoon Banata Sar Ko Sar Ke Bal Jaata Magar Zouf Ne Jaane Na Diya Sar To Sar Jaan Se Jaane Ki Mujhe Hasrat He Mot Ne Ha'ay Mujhe Jaan Se Jaane Na Diya Sharbat E Deed Ne Or Aag Laga De Dil Mein Tapsh E Dil Ko Barhaya He, Bujaane Na Diya Ab Kahaan Jae Ga Naksha Tera Mere Dil Se Tehh Me Rakha He, Ise Dil Ne Gumane Na Diya Sajda Karta Jo Mujhe Is Ki Ijazat Hoti Kya Karoon Izn Mujhe Is Ka Khuda Ne Na Diya! Mere A'amal Ka Badla To Jahannum Hi Tha Mein To Jaata, Mujhe Sarkar Ne Jaane Na Diya Mere A'amale Siyah Ne Kiya Jeena Dobar Zahr Khata, Tere Irshad Ne Khane Na Diya Nafse Badkaar Ne Dil Par Yeh Qiyamat Tori Amal E Naik Kiya B To Chupane Na Diya Itna Kamzor Kiya Zoa'afa E Quwa Ne Mujh Ko Paanv To Paanv Mujhe Sarr Bhi Uthane Na Diya Kabhi Beemar E Muhabbat Bhi Hue Hai Achhe Roz Afzu(N) Hai Marz Kaam Dawa Ne Na Diya Aur Chamakti Si Ghazal Koi Padho Aye Noori Rang Apna Abhi Jamne Shu'ara Ne Na Diya

১০৫

Balaghal Ula Bi Kamalihi Kasha Fadduja Bijamalihi (Sallu Alayhi Wa Aalihi)

Balaghal 'ula Bi Kamalihi, Kasha Fadduja Bijamalihi Hasunat Jami'u Khisaalihi Sallu 'alayhi Wa Aalihi Wo Kamaal-E-Husn-E-Huzoor Hay, Kay Gumaan-E-Naqs Jahaan Naheen Yay-Hee Phool Khaar Say Duur Hay, Yay-Hee Sham'a Hai Kay Dhu-Aan Naheen Do Jahan Ki Behtariyan Nahi, Ke Amaniye Dilo Jaan Nahi Kaho Kya Hain Wo Jo Yaha Nahi, Magar Ik Nahi Ki Wo Haan Nahi Teyray Aagay Youn Hayn Dabbay Lachay, Fu-Saha A'rab Kay Barray Barray Ko-Ee Jaanay Muh Mayn Zubaan Naheen, Naheen Balkay Jism Mein Jaan Naheen Ba Khuda Khuda Ka Yay-Hee Hay Darr, Nahin Aur Koi Maffar Maqqar Joe Wahaan Say Ho Yaheen Aakay Ho, Jo Yahaan Naheen Tou Wahan Naheen Sar-E-'arsh Per Hai Teree Guzar, Dil-E-Farsh Per Hai Teree Nazar Malakoot-O-Mulk Mayn Ko-Ee Shay, Naheen Wo Tujh Pay A'yaan Naheen Karuun Tayray Naam Pay Jaan Fida, Na Bas Eyk Jaan Do Jahaan Fida Do Jahan Say Bhi Nahiin Ji Bhara, Karun Kya Karoron Jahan Nahiin Sare La Makan Se Talab Hui, Sue Muntaha Wo Chale Nabi Koi Hadd Hai Unke Urooj Ki, Balaghal 'ula Bi Kamalihi Wo Khuda Ke Noor Ko Dekh Karbhi, Jahaan Walon Me Agae Sar-E-'arsh Jaana Kamaal Tha, Ke Waha Se Aana Kamaal Hai Main Nisaar Tere Kalaam Par Mili Yun To Kisi Ko Zabaan Nahi Wo Sikhan Hai Jisme Sukhan Na Ho Wo Bayaan Hain Jiska Bayaan Nahi Hain Unhi Ke Noor Se Sab Ayaan Hain Unhi Ke Jalwo Me Sab Nihaan Bane Subha Taabishe Mehar Se Rahe Peshe Mehar Yeh Jaan Nahi Wahi Noor E Haq Wahi Jille Rab Hain Unhi Se Sab Hain Unhi Ka Sab Nahi Unki Milk Mein Aasmaan Ki Jameen Nahi Ki Jamaan Nahi Wo-Hee Noor-E-Haq Wo-Hee Zillay Rub Hai Unhee Say Sub Hai Unhee Ka Sub Naheen Unkee Milk Meyn Aasmaan Ke Zameen Nahin Ke Zamaan Naheen Wo-Hee Laa Makaan Kay Makeen Huay Sar-E-'arsh Takht Nasheen Huay Wo Nabee Hai Jiss Kay Hain Yay Makaan Wo Khuda Hai Jiss Ka Makaan Naheen Kare Mustafa Ki Ihaanatain Khule Bando Uss Pe Yein Jur’ate, Ke Mein Kya Nahin Hoon Muhammadi? Arey Haan Nahin Arey Haan Nahin. Woh Sharf Key Qat’a Hain Nisbatain Wo Karam Key Sab Sey Qareeb Hain, Koi Keh Do Yaas-O-Ummid Sey Wo Kaheen Nahin Wo Kahaan Nahin. Yeh Nahin Key Khuld Na Ho Neko Wo Nekoi Ki Bhee Hay Aabroo, Magar Aay Madinah Ki Aarzoo Jise Chahe To Wo Samaa(N) Nahin. Tera Qad To Naadire Daher Hay Koi Misl Ho To Misaal Dey, Nahin Gul Key Paudo Mein Daaliya Key Chaman Mein Saro Chamaa Nahin. Nahin Jis Key Rang Ka Dusra Na To Ho Koi Na Kabhi Huwa, Kaho Us Ko Gul Kahe Kiya Koi Key Gulo Ka Dher Kahaa Nahin.
