১০৬

Ban Jaa Tuun Vi Yaar Madine Waaley Da

Ban Jaa Tuun Vi Yaar Madine Waaley Da Je Karna Deedare Madine Waaley Da Kade Nai Ja Sakhda O Wich Jahannam De Jide Dil Wich Pyaare Madine Waaley Da Oona Da Muur Dil Naai Lagda Kidhre Wii Takaja Jinnah Darbare Madine Waaley Da Allah Kare Main Mur Wi Ja Ke Weekh Lawaan Oo Noori Darbaare Madine Waaley Da Tere Saare Roog Gawawe Qa Mola Naam Te Le Ik Waare Madine Wale Da Peere Faqeer Ameer Wazeer Shehansha Wi Sadka Kande Yaar Madine Waaley Da Tere Haj Namaaz Zakaataan Kis Kaari Dil Wich Nai Je Pyaare Madine Waleey Da Shukre Nayazi Main Karna Haan Allah Da Menoon Milja Pyaar Madine Waley Da.

১০৭

Ban Kar Faqeer Jao Sarkaar Ki Gali Me

Ban Kar Faqeer Jao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Dil Ki Muraad Pao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Aisa Kareem Koi, Tujh Ko Na Phir Millay Ga Baithay Raho Gadao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Sunta Nahi Tumhaari, Koi Agar Kahaani Dil Khol Kar Sunao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Jannat May Rehnay Waali, Huurou Say Koi Keh Day Aik Tum Bhi Ghar Banao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Jaisa Bhi Zakhm Hoga, Acha Zaroor Hoga Qhaake Shafaa Lagaao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Mai So Gaya Hoon Shayad, Qwabon Me Hi Wo Aaye Mujh Ko Na Tum Jagao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Aane Ko Agae Hai, Ghar Par Zaroor Lekin Dil Apna Rehgaya Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Mar Kar Bhi Meri Mayyat, Nasir Yahi Kahe Gi Turbat Meri Banao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Kis Kis Ko May Bataou, Khud Ja Kay Koi Daikhay Jannat Ka Der Khulla Hay, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me ---------------------- Other ---------------------- --------------------- Version --------------------- Mat Poochiye Ke Kya Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Ek Jashn Sa Bapa Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Kis Kis Ko Mai Bataon, Khud Jaake Koi Dekhe Jannat Ka Dar Khula Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Tum Ko Kareem Aisa, Kahi Aur Na Milega Baithay Raho Gadao, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Koi Maange Ya Na Maange, Ye Hai Gada Ki Marzi Bin Maange Mil Raha Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Arshi Bhi Aa Rahe Hai, Farshee Bhi Jaa Rahe Hai Mela Laga Hua Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Wo Karbala Me Pohchan Deen E Nabi Khaatir Naazo Se Jo Pala Hai, Sarkaar Ki Gali Me Wakte Nizaja Bae, Sab Log Keh Rahe Ho Ki Dawa Hai Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Duniya O Aakhirat Ki Har Shai Waha Se Paayi Jo Maanga Mil Gaya Hai Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Saaya Kiye Huwe Hai Joodo Sakha Ke Baadal Mangta Khada Hua Hai Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Aale Nabi Ka Sadqa Milta Hai Har Gadaa Ko Jaari Ye Silsila Hai Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Aaqa Mujhe Sambhalo Jaisa Bhi Hu Nibhalo Meri Yahi Dua Hai Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Sufi Khalil Tune Kaisa Naseeb Banda Milne Ko Kareebe Hazrate Qaadir Gaya Lam-Aye Baatin Mein Gumne Jalwaye Zaahir Gaya Teri Marzi Pagaya Suraj Fira Ulte Qadam Teri Ungli Uth Gayi Mah Ka Kaleja Chir Gaya Badh Chali Teri Ziya Andher Aalam Se Ghata Khul Gaya Gesu Tera Rehmat Ka Baadal Ghir Gaya Bandh Gayi Teri Hawa Saawah Me Khaak Udhne Lagi Badh Chali Teri Ziya Aatash Pe Paani Fir Gaya Teri Rehmat Se Safiyyullah Ka Beda Paar Tha Tere Sadqe Se Najiyyullah Ka Bajra Tir Gaya Teri Aamad Thi Ki Baitullah Mujre Ko Jhuka Teri Haibat Thi Ki Har But Thar Thara Kar Gir Gaya Momin Unka Kya Hua Allah Uska Ho Gaya Kaafir Unse Kya Fira Allah Hi Se Fir Gaya Woh Ki Us Dar Ka Hua Khalqe Khuda Us Ki Huyi Woh Ki Us Dar Se Fira Allah Usse Fir Gaya Mujh Ko Deewana Batate Ho Main Woh Hoshiyaar Hoon Paao Jab Taufe Haram Mein Thak Gaye Sar Fir Gaya Rehmatullil Aalamee(N) Aafat Mein Hoon Kaisi Karu(N) Mere Maula Main To Is Dil Se Bala Mein Ghir Gaya Main Tere Haathon Ke Sadqe Kaisi Kankariya(N) Thi Woh Jinse Itne Kaafiro Ka Daf-Atan Muh Fir Gaya Kyun Janabe Bu Huraira Tha Woh Kaisa Jaame Sheer Jisse Sattar Sahibo(N) Ka Doodh Se Muh Fir Gaya Waasta Pyare Ka Aisa Ho Ki Jo Sunni Mare Yoo(N) Na Farmaye Tere Shahid Ki Woh Faajir Gaya Arsh Par Dhoome Mache(N) Woh Momine Saaleh Mila Farsh Se Maatam Uthe Woh Tayyibo Taahir Gaya Allah Allah Ye Uluwwe Khaas Abdiyat Raza Banda Milne Ko Qareebe Hazrate Qaadir Gaya Thokare Khate Firoge Unke Dar Par Pad Raho Qafila To Aye Raza Awwal Gaya Aakhir Gaya

Bara Rabi Ul Awwal Ke Din Abre Bahara Chaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Amina Tere Ghar Aa Kar Jibreel Payam Yeh Laaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Door Hua Duniya Se Andhera, Aaye Aaqa Hua Sawera Abdullah Ke Ghar Aangan Khushiyon Ke Baadal Chaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Sookhi Thi Gulshan Me Kaliyan, Sooni Thi Makke Ki Galiya Unke Qadam Se Charo Jaanib Ho Gaye Noor Ke Saaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Jo Hai Sab Nabiyo Ke Rehbar, Jaane Masiha Khalq Ke Rehbar Jholi Bharna Kaam Hai Jinka Aaj Woh Daata Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mushkil Teri Tal Jayegi Sookhi Kheti Phal Jayegi Dai Halima Tere Soye Bhaag Jagane Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mujh Ko Mila Paigam Yeh Mohsin Duniya Ko Batla De Mohsin Jo Hai Nabi Ka Chahne Wala Apne Ghar Ko Sajaye Mere Sarkar Aaye Mere Sarkar Aaye

Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Rehmat E Aalam Ban Kar Aaya, Dono Jahaan Par Unka Saaya Malik E Kul Mehboob E Quda Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Taha Yaseen Aur Muzam'il Sahe Madina Ahmed E Mursal Shaafe O Nafe Roza Jazaa Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Dono Aalam Sadqa Jinka Subh O Shaam Hai Charcha Jinka Virde Malaaik Salle Alaa Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Arsh Pe Aane Jaane Wale Rehmat E Aalam Haq Ke Ujaale Wo Mehboob E Rab E Ulaa Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Unke Karam Ki Baat Hai Aasee Rab Ka Karam Aur Dunya Raazi Wo Hai Maqzan Jood O Saqaa Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi Mai Kuch Bhi Nahi ***************************** ******punjabi Version******** ******punjabi Version******** ***************************** Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa Main Kuch Wi Nahi Main Kuch Wi Nahi Main Koja Te Rajj Ke Koja Koja Jiwein Hanera Oh Sohna Te Rajj Ke Sohna Sohna Jiwein Sawera Ik Sohna Utton Moun Da Mitha Naale Qaatil Nain Nasheele Tauba Tauba Kaun Bachaye Ethe Lutte Gaye Ne Qabeele Zulf De Har Har Kundal Utte Aashiq Da Dil Dole Wekh Ke Sohneya Soorat Teri Kaafir Kalima Bole Khulq Tere Ne Moh Layi Dunya Koi Wirla Jaan Bachaawe Edda Sohna Maahi Sanu Kitte Wi Nazar Na Aawe Kakh Sawad Na Mishri Andar Assan Khandan Wi Chakh Ditthiyaan Enna Sariyan Cheezan Naalon Gallan Maahi Diyan Mitthiyaan Main Kuch Wi Nahi Main Kuch Wi Nahi Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa Bas Mera Maahi Salle Alaa

১১৫

Basa Hua Hai Nabi Ka Dayar Aankhon Main

Basa Hua Hai Nabi Ka Dayar Aankhon Main Sajaye Baithha Hoon Ek Jalwa Zaar Aankhon Main Diar-E-Pak Ka Her Manzar-E-Haseen-O-Jameel Rahe Ga Ka’ba Qaza Yaad Gaar Aankhon Main Ata Kia Jo Madinay Ke Basion Nay Mujhe Mehak Ruha Hay Ab Tak Voh Piar Aankhon Main. Ab Iss Se Badh Ke Koi Surma Aur Kia Ho Ga? Samait Laaya Hoon Main Kuch Ghubar Aankhon Main. Baghair Dekhe Madina Inhe Nazar Aaya Hain Munfarid Meri Aankhain Hazar Aankhon Main. Tarap Hai Dil Main Madine Ke Jalva Zaron Kee! Aur Intizar-E-Safar Bayqarar Aankhon Main. Sunaoun Ga Voh Kahani Huzoor Ko Ja Ker Chchupaye Baitha Hoon Jo Ashkbar Aankhon Main Hay E’etmad Bhee Iqbal Ko Shafa’at Per Saza Ka Khouf Bhee Hay Gunahgar Aankhon Main Basa Huva Hay Nabee Ka Diar Aankhon Main Sajaye Baitha Hoon Ik Jalvazaar Aankhon Main

১১৬

Bazme Tasawwuraat Saji Thi Abhi Abhi

Bazme Tasawwuraat Saji Thi Abhi Abhi Nazron Me Mustafa Ki Gali Thi Abhi Abhi Seene Me Ruk Gaya Tha Mere Dam Isi Liye Taiba Se Dil Dor Hili Thi Abhi Abhi Itna Karam Hua Ke Muqaddar Badal Gaye Un Ke Karam Ki Baat Chali Thi Abhi Abhi Maaloom Kar Rahe The Farishton Se Jibraeel Kis Ki Zubaan Pe Naate Nabi Thi Abhi Abhi Shabbir Chashme Tar Ki Haqeeqat Na Poochiye Maahe Arab Se Aankh Mili Thi Abhi Abhi

১১৮

Bekhud Kiye Dete Hain Andaaz E Hijabana Aa Dil Main Tujhay Rakhloon Aie Jalwa E Janana Kyun Aankh Mila'ee Thi Kyun Aag Laga'ee Thi Ab Rukh Ko Chupa Beyt-Hay Kar Kay Mujhay Deewanah Jis Ja Nazar Aathay Ho Sajday Wahi Kartha Hoon Iss Say Nahi Kuch Matlab Kaba Ho Ya Buth Khana Ji Chahta Hey Thofay Mey Dey Doon Mey Unhin Ankheyn Darshan Ka Tho Darshan Ho Nazranay Ka Nazrana Mey Howsh Howaas Apnay Iss Baath Pey Kho Beyt-Ha Hans Kar Jo Kaha Thu Nay Aaya Mera Deewanah Duniya Mey Mujhay Thu Nay Gar Apana Banaya Hey Mehshar Mey Bhi Keh Deyna Yeh Hey Mera Deewanah Ithna To Karam Karna Aey Nargis Masthana Jab Jaan Labo Par Ho Tum Deed Kara Janana Baydam Meri Qismath Mey Sajday Hey Isi Dar Key Choowta Hey Na Choowtay Ga Sang Dar Jananah Ji Chahta Hey Thofay Mey Dey Doon Mey Unhin Ankheyn Darshan Ka Tho Darshan Ho Nazranay Ka Nazrana Jis Ja Nazar Atte Ho Sajde Wahin Karta Houn Is Se Nahi Kuch Matlab Kabba Ho Ja Butkhana Maidane Mehshar Me Tum Saath Khaday Rehna Na Jane Khuda Kuch Pooche, Aur Na Jane Kya Kehde Ye Diwana Peenay Ko Tho Pee Lounga, Par Shart Zara Si Hey Ajmer Ka Saki Ho, Baghdad Ka Mehana Peene Ko To Peelunga, Par Shart Zara Si Hai Baghdad Ka Saqi Ho, Sarhind Ka Maiqana Sar Shaar Muje Kar Dei Aik Jaam Laba Lab See Tahashar-E Rahe Saki Abaad Ye Maiqanaa Dil Apne Chamak Utheeemaan Ki Talat See Kar Ankheen Bhi Noraani Aa Jalwa Aa Janana Har Phool Mein Boo Teri Har Shama Mein Zoo Teri Bulbul Hai Tera Bulbul Parwana Hai Parwana Zahid Meri Kismat Mein Sajday Hain Usi Dar Kay Chuta Hai Na Chuthay Ga Sange Dar E Janana Kiya Lutf Ho Mehshar Mein Main Shikway Kiye Jaoon Woh Haskay Kahay Jayein Deewana Hai Dewana Saaki Teray Aatay Hee Yeh Josh Hai Masti Ka Sheshay Pay Gira Sheesha Pemanay Paymana Maloom Nahin Baydam Mein Kon Houn Aur Kiya Hoon Youn Apnoon Main Apna Houn Baiganoon Mein Baygana

Bhar Do Jholi Meri Ya Muhammad Lautkar Main Na Jaaunga Khaali Bhar Do Jholi Meri Ya Muhammad Lautkar Main Na Jaaunga Khaali Kuchh Nawaason Ka Sadqa Ataa Ho Dar Pe Aaya Hoon Bankar Sawaali Tum Zamaane Ke Mukhtaar Ho Ya Nabi Bekason Ke Madadgaar Ho Ya Nabi Sab Ki Sunte Ho Apne Ho Ya Ghair Ho Tum Ghareebon Ke Gham-Khwaar Ho Nabi Tumhaare Aastaane Se Zamaana Kya Nahin Paata Koi Bhi Dar Se Khaali Deen-E-Khuda Ki Shaan Badhaayi Hussain Ne Bakhshi Hai Jisne Mazhab-E-Islam Ko Hayaat Jitni Azeem Hazrat-E-Shabbir Ki Hai Zaat Maidaan-E-Karbala Mein Shah-E-Khush Khisaal Ne Sajde Mein Sar Kataa Ke Mohammad Ke Laal Ne Zindagi Bakhsh Di Bandagi Ko Aabroo Deen-E-Haq Ki Bachaali Mere/pyare Aqa Ka Pyara Nawaasa Jisne Sajde Mein Gardan Kataali Hashr Mein Unko Dekhenge Jis Dam Ummati Ye Kahengey Khushi Se Aa Rahey Hain Wo Dekho Mohammad Jinke Hai Shaan Sab Se Niraali Har Nazar Kaap Utthe Gi Mehshar Ke Din Qauf Se Har Kaleja Dehal Jaae Ga Muskurate Hue Aap Aajainge Hashr Ka Sara Naqsha Badal Jaae Ga Aa Rahey Hain Wo Dekho Mohammad Jinke Hai Shaan Sab Se Niraali Kaash Purnam Dyaar E Nabi Mein Jeete Ji Ho Bulaawa Kisi Din Haal-E-Dil Mustafa Ko Sunaaoon Thaam Kar Unke Rauze Ki Jaali Hum Hain Ranj-O-Museebat Ke Maare Hue Saqt Mushkil Mein Hain Gham Se Haare Hue Ya Nabi Kuchh Khudaara Humein Bheek Do Dar Pe Aaye Hain Jholi Pasaare Hue Hai Mukhaalif Zamaana Kidhar Jaaein Hum Haalat-E-Bekasi Kisko Dikhlaaye Hum Hum Tumhaare Bhikaari Hain Ya Mustafa Kiske Aage Bhalaa Haath Phailaayein Hum Mehshar Ke Roz Pesh-E-Khuda Hongey Jis Ghadi Hogi Gunahgaaron Mein Kis Darjaa Bekali Aate Hue Nabi Ko Jo Dekhenge Ummati Ek Doosre Se Sab Ye Kahengey Khushi Khushi Aa Rahey Hain Wo Dekho Mohammad Jinke Kaandhe Pe Kambli Hai Kaali Sar-E-Mehshar Gunahgaaron Se Purzish Jis Ghadi Hogi Yaqeenan Har Bashar Ko Apni Bakhshish Ki Parhi Hogi Sabhi Ko Aas Us Din Kambli Waale Se Lagi Hogi Ke Aise Mein Mohammad Ki Sawaari Aa Rahi Hogi Pukaarega Zamaana Us Ghadi Dukh Dard Ke Maaron Na Ghabraao Gunahgaaron Na Ghabraao Gunahgaaron Aa Rahey Hain Wo Dekho Mohammad Jinke Kaandhe Pe Kambli Hai Kaali Aashiq-E-Mustafa Ki Azaan Mein Allah Allah Kitna Asar Thha Sachaa Ye Waaqiya Hai Azaan-E-Bilaal Ka Ek Din Rasool-E-Paak Se Logon Ne Yun Kahaa Ya Mustafa Azaan Ghalat Dete Hain Bilaal Kahiye Huzoor Aapka Is Mein Hai Kya Khayaal Farmaaya Mustafa Ne Ye Sach Hai To Dekhiye Waqt-E-Sahar Ki Aaj Azaan Aur Koi De Hazrat Bilaal Ne Jo Azaan-E-Sahar Na Di Khudrat Khuda Ki Dekho Na Mutlaq Sahar Hui Aaye Nabi Ke Paas Kuchh As’haab-E-Baasabaa Ki Arz Mustafa Se Ay Shah-E-Ambiya Hai Kya Sabab Sahar Na Hui Aaj Mustafa Jibreel Laaye Aise Mein Payghaam-E-Kibriya Pehle To Mustafa Ko Adab Se Kiya Salaam Baad As Salaam Unko Khuda Ka Diya Payaam Yun Jibraeel Ne Kahaa Khair Ul Anaam Se Allah Ko Hai Pyar Tumhaare Ghulaam Se Farmaa Raha Hai Aap Se Ye Rabb-E-Zuljalaal Hogi Na Subha Dengey Na Jab Tak Azaan Bilaal Aashiq-E-Mustafa Ki Azaan Mein Allah Allah Kitna Asar Thha Arsh Waale Bhi Sunte Thhey Jisko Kya Azaan Thi Azaan-E-Bilaali Shah-E-Madeena Suno Ilteja Khuda Ke Liye Karam Ho Mujh Pe Habeeb-E-Khuda Khuda Ke Liye Huzoor Ghuncha-E-Ummeed Ab To Khil Jaaye Tumhaare Dar Ka Gadaa Hoon To Bheek Mil Jaaye Bhar Do Jholi Meri Ya Muhammad Lautkar Main Na Jaaunga Khaali

১২০

Bheeni Suhani Subh Mei Thandak Jigar Ki Hai

Bheeni Suhani Subh Mei Thandak Jigar Ki Hai Kaliyaa(N) Khili Dilo Ki Hawa Ye Kidhar Ki Hai. Khubti Huwi Nazar Mei Adaa Kis Sahar Ki Hai Chubhti Huwi Jigar Mei Sadaa Kis Gajar Ki Hai. Daaley Hari Hari Hai To Baaley Bhari Bhari Kishte Amal Pari Hai Ye Barish Kidhar Ki Hai. Hum Jaye Aur Qadam Se Lipat Kar Haram Kahey Sounpa Khuda Ko Ye Azmat Kis Safar Ki Hai. Hum Girdey Kaaba Phirte They Kal Tak Aur Aaj Wooh Hum Par Nisaar Hai Ye Iradat Kidh’ar Ki Hai. Kalik Jabee(N) Ki Sajdaaye Dar Se Chudaavogey Mujh Ko Bhi Le Chalo Ye Tamanna Hajar Ki Hai. Dooba Huwa Hai Shouq Mei Zam Zam Aur Aankh Se Jhaale Baras Rahey Hai Ye Hasrat Kidhar Ki Hai. Barsa Ke Jaane Walo Pa Ghouhar Karu Nisaar Abrey Karam Se Arz Ye Mizaabey Zar Ki Hai. Aagooshe Shouq Kholey Hai Jin Ke Liye Hateem Woh Phir Ke Dekhte Nahi Ye Dhun Kidhar Ki Hai. Haa’n Haa’n Rahey Madina Hai Ghafil Zara Tu Jaag Wo Paav Rakhne Waley Ye Jaa Chashmo Sar Ki Hai. Waaru Qadam Qadam Pa Kay Har Dam Hai Jaane Nao Ye Raahey Jaa(N) Fiza Mere Moula Ke Dar Ki Hai. Ghadiya Gini Hai Barso Ke Ye Shubh Ghadi Phiri Marmar Ke Phir Ye Sil Mere Seene Se Sar Ki Hai. Allaho Akbar Apne Qadam Aur Ye Khaakey Pak Hasrat Malai’ka Ko Jahaan Waz’ye Sar Ki Hai. Mea’raj Ka Sama Hai Kaha Pahonchey Zae’roo Kursi Se Onchi Kursi Usi Pak Ghar Ki Hai. Ushhaq Rouza Sajdey Mei Suye Haram Jhukey Allah Jaanta Hai Ke Niyyat Kidhar Ki Hai. Ye Ghar Ye Dar Hai Uska Jo Ghar Dar Se Paak Hai Muzhdah Ho Be-Gharo Kay Salaa Achchey Ghar Ki Hai. Mehboobe Rabbe Arsh Hai Is Sabz Qubba Mei Pahlu Mei Jalwa Gah Ateeqo Umar Ki Hai. Chaye Malaika Hai Lagaatar Hai Durood Badley Hai Pahrey Badli Mei Barish Durar Ki Hai Sa’dayn Ka Qiraan Hai Pahluye Maah Mei Jhurmut Kiye Hai Taarey Tajalli Qamar Ki Hai. Sattar Hazaar Subh Mei Sattar Hazaar Shaam Yun Bandagiye Zulfo Rukh Aatho Pahar Ki Hai. Jo Ek Baar Aye Dobara Na Ayenge Rukhsat Hi Bargah Se Bas Is Qadar Ki Hai. Tadpa Karey Badal Ke Phir Aana Kaha Naseeb Bey Hukm Kab Majaal Parinde Ko Par Ki Hai. Ay Waye Beikasiye Tammana Ke Ab Ummeed Din Ko Na Shaam Ki Hai Na Shab Ko Sahar Ki Hai Ye Badliya(N) Na Ho To Karooro(N) Ki Aas Jaye Aur Bargaahe Marhamate Aaam Tar Ki Hai. Masoom Ko Hai Umr Mei Sirf Ek Bar Bar Aasi Padey Rahe To Sila Umr Bhar Ki Hai. Zinda Rahe To Haazriye Baargaah Naseeb Mar Jaye To Hayaate Abad Aysh Ghar Ki Hai. Moflis Aur Aisey Dar Se Phirey Be-Ghani Huve Chandi Har Ek Tarah To Yaha Gadiya Gar Ki Hai. Jaana Pe Takiya Khaak Nihali Hai Dil Nihaal Han Be-Nawa’o Khoob Ye Sorat Guzar Ki Hai. Hai Chatro Takht Saya-E Dewaaro Khaake Dar Shaho Ko Kab Naseeb Ye Dhaj Karro Far Ki Hai. Iss Paak Ku Mei Khaak Ye Basar Sar-Ba-Khaak Hai, Samjhe Hai Kuch Yahi Jo Haqiqat Basar Ki Hai. Kyo Taajdaaro! Khwaab Mei Dheki Kabi Ye Shai Jo Aaj Jholiyo Mei Gadhayaane Dar Ki Hai. Jaaru-Kasho Mei Chehre Likhey Hai Mulook Ke Wo Bhi Kaha Naseeb Faqat Naam Bhar Ki Hai. Taiba Mei Mar Ke Thande Chaley Jaav Aankhey Bandh Seedhi Sadak Ye Shahre Shafa’t Nagar Ki Hai. Aasi Bhi Hai Chahitey Ye Taiba Hai Zahido! Makka Nahi Ke Jaanch Jaha Khair O Shar Ki Hai. Shaane Jamaal Taiba Jana Hai Naf’a Mahaz Wus’at Jalale Makka Mei Soodo Zar Ki Hai. Kaba Hai Beshak Anjum-Aara Dulhan Magar Saari Bahar Dhulhano Mei Dulha Ke Ghar Ki Hai. Kaba Dhulhan Hai Turbate At-Har Nayi Dulhan Ye Rashk E Aftaab Wo Gairat Qamar Ki Hai. Dono Bani Sajeeli Aneeli Bani Magar Jo Pe’ Ke Paas Hai Wo Suhagan Kun’war Ki Hai. Sar Sabze Wasl Ye Hai Siyaa Poshey Hijr Wo Chamki Dupatto Se Hai Jo Haalat Jigar Ki Hai. Ma Wo Shuma To Kya Ke Khaleel E Jaleel Ko Kal Dhekna Ki Unse Tamanna Nazar Ki Hai. Apna Sharaf Dua Se Hai Baaki Raha Kabool Ye Jaane Unke Haath Mei Kunji Asar Ki Hai. Jo Chahey Unse Maang Ki Dono Jahaa’n Ki Khair Zar Na-Khareeda Ek Kaneez Unke Ghar Ki Hai. Roomi Ghulam Din Habshi Baandiya(N) Shab’e Ginti Kaneez Zaado Mei Shaamo Sahar Ki Hai. Itna Ajab Bulandiye Jannat Pe Kisliye Dekha Nahi Ke Bheek Ye Kis Unchey Ghar Ki Hai. Arshe Bari Pe Kyo Na Ho Firdous Ka Dimaagh Utri Huvi Shabeeh Tere Baamo Dar Ki Hai. Wo Khuld Jismei Utregi Abrar Ki Baraat Adna Nichawar Uss Mere Dulha Ke Sar Ki Hai. Amber Zamee(N), Abeer Huwa Mushke-Tar Gubaar Adna Si Ye Shanaakhat Teri Rahguzar Ki Hai. Sarkaar Hum Gawaro Mei Tarze Adab Kaha Humko To Bas Tameez Yahi Bheek Bhar Ki Hai. Maangenge Maange Jayenge Muh Maangi Payenge Sarkar Mei Na Laa Hai Na Hajat Agar Ki Hai. Uff Be-Hayayi’aa Ke Ye Muh Aur Tere Huzoor Ha Tu Kareem Hai Teri Khu’ Dar Guzar Ki Hai. Tujh Se Chupau Muh To Karu Kiske Saamne Kya Aur Bhi Kisi Se Tawaqqo Nazar Ki Hai. Jaavu Kaha Pukaru Kisey Kiska Muh Taku Kia Pursish Aur Ja’ Bhi Sagey Be-Hunar Ki Hai. Baab E At’a To Ye Hai Jo Bahka Idhar Udhar Kaisi Kharaabi Uss Nagharey Dar-Ba-Dar Ki Hai. Aabad Ek Dar Hai Tera Aur Tere Siwa Jo Baargah Dekhiye Ghairat Khandar Ki Hai. Lub Wa Hai Aankhey Bandh Hai Phayli Hai Jholiya Kitne Maaze Ki Bheek Tere Paak Dar Ki Hai. Ghera Andheriyo Ne Duh’ee Hai Chand Ki Tanha Hu Kaali Raat Hai Manzil Khatar Ki Hai. Kismat Mei Laakh Pech Ho Sau Bal Hazaar Kaj Ye Saari Ghutthi Ik Teri Seedhi Nazar Ki Hai. Aisi Bandhi Naseeb Khule Mushkiley Khuli Dono Jaha Mei Dhoom Tumhari Kamar Ki Hai. Jannat Na Dey Na Dey Teri Ruyat Ho Khair Se Is Ghul Ke Aagey Kisko Hawas Bargho Bar Ki Hai. Sharbat Na Dey Na Dey To Karey Baat Lutf Se Ye Shahad Ho To Phir Kise Parwa Shakar Ki Hai. Mai Khana-Zaad Kohna Hu Surat Likhi Huwi Bando Kaneezo Mei Mere Madar Pedar Ki Hai. Mangta Ka Haath Uth-Te Hi Daata Ki Dayn Thi Doori Qubool O Arz Mei Bas Haath Bhar Ki Hai. Sanki Wo Dekh Baad’e Shafat Ki De Hawa Ye Aabru Raza Tere Damaan E Tar Ki Hai

১২১

Bigri Bhi Banaeinge Jalwe Bhi Dikhaeinge

Bigri Bhi Banaeinge Jalwe Bhi Dikhaeinge Ghabrao Na Deewano Sarkar Bolain Ge Ghabrao Na Deewano Sarkar Bolain Ge Hum Masjid E Nabawi Key Dekhe Ge Minaron Ko Aur Gumbad E Khazran Key Purnoor Nazaron Ko Hum Ja Key Madina Phir Wapis Nahi Aay Ge Dil Ishq E Nabi Mey Tum Kuch Aur Tarapne Do Is Deed Ki Atish Ko Kuch Aur Bharakne Do Hum Tishna Dily Chal Kar Zam Zam Sey Bojhay Ge Jab Hashar Key Medan Mey Eik Hashar Bapaa Ho Ga Jab Fesla Ummat Ka Karny Ko Khuda Ho Ga Ummat Ko Shahe Bat Haa Kamli Mey Chupain Ge Mil Jay Gi Tabirein Eik Rooz To Khawaboo Ki Gir Jay Gein Dewarein Sab Dekhna Rahoo Ki Hum Roza E Aqdas Par Jab Ansoo Bahain Ge Li Llah Muhammad Sey Rodad Meri Kehna Ye Poch Key Aaqa Sey Ey Hajion Tum Ana Ishrat Ko Dare Aqdas Kab Aap Bolain Ge

১২২

Bismillah (I Am A Muslim)

I Am A Muslim, The Things I Say In Everything I Do Everyday We Are Muslims, The Things We Say In Everything We Do Everyday Oooh, Bismillah, Oooh, Alhamdullillah I Am A Muslim And This I Know I Need To Eat So That I Will Grow We Are Muslims And This We Know We Need To Eat So That We Will Grow When We Eat We Say Bismillah When We're Full, We Say Alhamdullillah Water, Juice And Milk, These I Think Are So Delicious For Me To Drink Water, Juice And Milk, These We Think Are So Delicious For Us To Drink When We Drink We Say, Bismillah When We're Done We Say Alhamdullillah Going Out With My Mum And Dad Coming Home, Oh What Fun We Had Going Out With Our Mum And Dad Coming Home, Oh What Fun We Had Driving In The Car, Bismillah Coming Safely Home, Alhamdullillah I Go To Sleep Saying Allah's Name And In The Morning I Do The Same We Go To Sleep Saying Allah's Name And In The Morning We Do The Same When We Sleep We Say Bismillah When We Rise We Say Alhamdullillah

১২৩

Bohot Din Ho Gaye Taiba Ke Raste Dekh To Aaye

Bohot Din Ho Gaye Taiba Ke Raste Dekh To Aaye Chalo Us Shehr Ko Ik Baar Phir Se Dekh To Aaye Utar Jaayegi Mehroomi Ki Chaadar Shehre Taiba Mein Chamak Uthenge Qismat Ke Sitaare Dekh To Aaye Judaayi Ke Dhulenge Naqsh Gehre Dil Ki Takhti Se Chadhega Range Qurbat Wo Nazaare Dekh To Aaye Usi Din Aarzuon Ke Khandar Mein Raushni Hogi Dare Sarkaar Ke Raushan Ujaale Dekh To Aaye Huzoori Ki Woh Pehli Pehli Saa'at Khoob Rulaati Hai Nigaahon Ko Ussi Dar Ki Talab Hai Dekh To Aaye Haseen Palkhon Ka Chilman Kholenge Jaa Kar Madine Mein Sadaa Aankhon Mein Rakhenge Woh Jalwe Dekh To Aaye Mehekti Khushbuen Khud Hi Pata Us Shehar Ka Dengi Ujaagar Uttho Himmat Karlo Chal Ke Dekh To Aaye

১২৪

Bulalo Phir Mujhay Ey Shahe Bahrobar Madinay Main

Bulalo Phir Mujhay Ey Shahe Bahrobar Madinay Main Main Phir Rota Huwa Aaoon, Teray Dar Par Madinay Mein. Mein Pohunchoon Koey Jana Mein, Ghareeban Chak Seena Chak Gira Day Kash Mujhko Showk Tarpa Kar Madinay Mein. Mein Unka Deewana, Madinay Mein Bari Shaan Gaya Chak Dil, Chak Jigar, Chak Ghareeban Gaya. Madinay Jaaney Waalo Jaao Jaao Fi Aman'illah Kabi Toh Apna Bhi Lag Jaey Ga Bistar Madinay Main. Salaam-E-Showq Kehna Haajio Meraa Bhi Ro Ro Kar Tumhe Aae Nazar Jab Roza E Anwar Madinay Mein. Zahe Muqaddar Huzur-E-Haq Say Salaam Aaya Payam Aaya Jhukao Nazreen Bichao Palkeen Adab Ka Aala Maqam Aaya. Yeh Rahe-Haq Hai Sambhal Ke Chalna Yahan Hai Manzil Qadam Qadam Par Pohanchna Dar Par To Kehna Aaqa Salaam Lijiye Ghulam Aaya. Yeh Kehna Aaqa Bohat Se Aashiq Taraptey Se Choor Aaya Hoon Mein Bulawe Ke Muntazir Hain Lekin Na Subah Aaya Na Sham Aaya. Payame Showk Letay Jao Mera Kafilay Walo Sunaana Dastaney Gham Meri Ro Kar Madinay Main. Paye Tableegay Sunnat Tu Jahan Rakay Maghar Aae Kash Main Khawaboon Mein Puhanchta Hee Rahoon Aqsar Madinay Mein. Madina Is Liye Attar Jaan-O-Dil Say Hai Pyara Key Rehtay Hain Meray Aaqa, Meray Dil Bar Madinay Main. Na Dowlat Dey Nah Showhrat Dey, Mujhay Bas Yeh Sahaadat Dey Teray Kadmo Main Marjaoon, Main Ro Ro Kar Madinay Main. Meraa Gham Bhi Toh Dekho, Main Paraa Hoo Duur Tayba Sey Sukoon Aey'ga Bas Meraa Dil-E-Muztar Madinay Main. Wahan Ik Saas Miljaye Yehi Hai Zeest Ka Haasil Vo Kismet Ka Dhani Hao Jo Gaya Dam Bhar Madiney Mein. Chalo Chaukat Pe Unki Rak Ke Sar Qurbaan Ho Jaye Hayat E Jaan Vidaani Paayengey Mar Kar Madiney Mein. Madina Is Liye Attar Jaan-O-Diil Sey Hai Pyaara Key Rehtay Hain Meray Aqa Meray Diil Bar Madinay Main.

১২৫

Bulwaya Jo Rauze Par Ek Nazre Karam Kardo

Bulwaya Jo Rauze Par Ek Nazre Karam Kardo Tum Hi Ho Mere Sarwar Ek Nazre Karam Kardo Dil Mere Kiya Chalni Apne Ho Ke Begaane Lafzon Ke Diye Nashtar Ek Nazre Karam Kardo Bigdi Huwi Banti Hai Har Baat Madine Me Haajat Hai Ayaa Tum Par Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do Tum Raafat O Rehmat Ho Tum Qaasime Ne’mat Ho Shafqat Ke Ho Tum Paikar Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do Bardo Meri Jholi Ko Badi Door Se Aaya Hu Baitha Hu Main Chaukhat Par Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do Kyun Kis Se Kahu Dil Ki Tum Sunte Ho Sab Dil Ki Haalaat Ho Ab Behtar Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do Tehreek Ke Daa’i Ko Daaman Me Panaah De Do Rehmat Ho Sada Hum Par Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do Kya Khoob Nibhaya Hai Shakir Ko Shaha Tum Ne Apne Ho Tumhi Yaawar Ek Nazre Karam Kar Do

১২৬

Chaayaa Hai Kaif Dil Par Qadmon Me Baith Kar

Chaayaa Hai Kaif Dil Par Qadmon Me Baith Kar Hai Auj Par Muqaddar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Khushboo E Mustafa Sey ‘aalam Mehak Raha Hai Main Bhi Huwa Mu’attar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Taskeen E Qalb Mujh Ko Phir Sey Huwi Hai Haasil Roodaad E Gham Sunaa Kar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Kya Ab Bhi Meyre Rab Ka Mujh Par Karam Na Hoga Phailey Hain Haath Dar Par Qadmon Me Baith Kar Taiba Me Rehmaton Ki Baarish Baras Rahi Hai Deykha Hai Pyaara Manzar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Ghaus O Raza Key Sadqey Khwaaja Piya Key Sadqey Iftaar Hai Mayassar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Noor E Nabi Se ‘aalam Roshan Huwa Hai Shakir Dil Bhi Huwa Munawwar Qadmon Me Baith Kar Sultan E Do Jahan Ka Tujh Par Karam Hai Shakir Aankhain Huwi Hain Phir Tar Qadmon Me Baith Kar

Chamak Tujhse Paate Hain Sab Paane Waale

Chamak Tujhse Paate Hain Sab Paane Waale Mera Dil Bhi Chamka De Chamkane Waale Barasta Nahi Dekh Kar Abr E Rehmat Badoo(N) Par Bhi Barsa De Barsane Waale Tu Zinda Hai Wallah Tu Zinda Hai Wallah Mere ১৩১

Chamane Taiba Mein Sumbul Jo Sawaare Gesu

Chamane Taiba Mein Sumbul Jo Sawaare Gesu Hoor Badh Kar Shikane Naaz Pe Waare Gesu Ki Jo Baalon Se Tere Rauze Ki Jaaroob Kashi Shab Ko Shabnam Ne Tabarruk Ko Hain Dhaare Gesu Hum Siyah Kaaron Pe Ya Rab Tapishe Mahshar Mein Saaya Afgan Hon Tere Pyare Ke Pyare Gesu Charche Hooron Mein Hain Dekho To Zara Baale Burraq Sumbule Khuld Ke Qurban Utare Gesu Aakhire Hajj Ghame Ummat Mein Paresha(N) Ho Kar Teerah Bakhton Ki Shafa’at Ko Sidhare Gesu Gosh Tak Sunte The Fariyad Ab Aaye Taa Dosh Ki Bane Khana Badoshon Ko Sahare Gesu Sukhe Dhano(N) Pe Humare Bhi Karam Ho Jaaye Chaye Rehmat Ki Ghata Ban Ke Tumhare Gesu Ka’baye Jaa(N) Ko Pinhaya Hai Gilafe Mushkee(N) Udh Ke Aaye Hain Jo Abr Pe Tumhare Gesu Silsila Paa Ke Shafa’at Ka Jhuke Padte Hain Sajdaye Shukr Ke Karte Hain Ishare Gesu Mushk Boo Koocha Ye Kis Phool Ka Jhada Un Se Hooriyo Ambare Saara Huye Saare Gesu Dekho Qur’an Me Shabe Qadr Hai Ta Matlaye Fajr Ya’ni Nazdeek Hain Aariz Ke Woh Pyare Gesu Bheeni Khushboo Se Mahak Jaati Hain Galiya(A) Wallah Kaise Phoolo Mein Basaye Hain Tumhare Gesu Shaane Rehmat Hai Ki Shaana Na Juda Ho Dam Bhar Seena Chaakon Pe Kuch Is Darja Hain Pyare Gesu Shaana Hai Panjaye Qudrat Tere Baalon Ke Liye Kaise Haathon Ne Shaha Tere Saware Gesu Uhade Paak Ki Choti Se Ulajh Le Shab Bhar Subah Hone Do Shabe Eid Ne Haare Gesu Muzda Ho Qibla Se Ghanghor Ghatayen Umdee Abroouon Par Woh Jhuke Jhoom Ke Baare Gesu Taare Sheerazaye Majmuaye Kaunain Hain Yeh Haal Khul Jaaye Jo Ik Dum Hon Kanare Gesu Tel Ki Boonde Tapakti Nahi Baalon Se Raza Subhe Aariz Pe Lutate Hain Sitare Gesu.

১৩২

Chamka Mahe Noor Ka Hilal Marhaba

Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Bay Kasun Say Hai Jinhay Pyar Wohi Aaye Hain, Jo Do Aalam Kay Hain Ghum Khaar Wohi Aaye Hain. Ek Nazar Asmaan Per Daal, Marhaba, Chamka Mah-E-Noor Ka Hilal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Jhanday Lagao Galiyan Sajao, Karlo Charaghan Ghar Jagmagao, Razi Ho Ga Rab-E-Zuljalal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Mehfil Sajaayein Naatein Sunaein, Aaqa Ki Aamad Ki Dhoomain Machayein, Roz-O-Shab Yehi Ho Apna Haal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Laaraib Nabiyon Kay Saalar Aaye, Aaye Do Aalam K Ghum Khaar Aaye, Shahkaar-E-Rab-E-Zuljalal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Aashiq Key Dil Jagmaganay Lagay Hain, Dekho Zara Muskuranay Lagay Hain, Deedni Hain Unkay Khad-O-Khaal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba Sadqa Wiladat Ka Jalwa Dikha Do, Dil Ki Lagi Ab To Aaqa Bujha Do, Dikhla Do Apna Ab Jamaal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Jood-O-Sakhawat Hai Aadat Tumhari, Phailaaye Daaman Kharay Hain Bhikari, Kar Do Karam Amna K Laal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba, Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba. Jaam-E-Shahadat Piya Hai Jinho Ne, Ahle-Sunan Ko Jila Di Unho Na, Yaad Aayengay Wo Har Saal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba Shaadi Kay Naghmay Sunatay Rahengay, Jashn-E-Wiladat Manaatay Rahengay, Waar Daingay Tum Pay Jaan-O-Maal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba Parhnay Laga Jab Ubaid Un Ki Naatein, Honay Lageen Chaar Soo Us Ki Baatein, Faiz-E-Raza Ka Hai Sub Kamaal, Marhaba. Ya Rasool Allah Marhaba Marhaba Ya Habib Allah Marhab Marhaba

১৩৩

Chand Se Unke Chehre Par Ghesue Mushk Faam Do

Chand Se Unke Chehre Par Ghesue Mushk Faam Do Din Hai Khila Hua Magar Waqte Sahar Hai Sham Do Khair Se Din Khuda Wo Laye Dono Haram Hame Dikhaye Zamzam O Beer E Fatima Ke Piyenge Chalke Jaam Do Talwo Se Unke Chaar Chand Lag Gaye Mahromah Ko Hai Yeh Unhi Ki Tabishe Aur Hain Unhi Ke Naam Do Haatho Se Chaar Yaar Ke Hum Ko Milenge Chaar Jaam Daste Hasan Husain Se Aur Milenge Jaam Do Unki Jabeen E Naaz Par Zulf E Siyaah Bikhar Gayi Jam'a Hain Ek Waqt Me Jiddain E Subha Wa Shaam Do Zaate Hasan Husain Hai Ahle Shabeehe Mustafa Zaat Hain Ek Nabi Ki Zaat Aur Hain Unhi Ke Naam Do Aarize Noor Bar Se Bikhri Hui Hati Jo Zulf Ek Andheri Raat Me Nikle Mahe Tamaam Do Pike Pila Ke Maiksho Kuch To Bachi-Kuchi Hi Do Qatra Do Qatra Hi Sahi Kuch To Barah-E-Naam Do Ab To Madine Lo Bula Gumbad E Sabz Do Dikha Haamid O Mustafa Tere Hind Me Hain Ghulaam Do -------------------More---------------------- ------------------Verses--------------------- Chand Se Unke Chehre Par Ghesue Mushk Faam Do Ek Anokhi Hai Sahar Jisse Baham Hai Sham Do Dono Taraf Hai Chehre Pe Zulfe Ziya Hai Faam Do Do Do Sahar Hai Beech Me Pehlu Me Unke Sham Do Unki Jabeen E Naaz Par Zulf E Siyaah Bikhar Gayi Shab Ke Haseen Parde Me Chamke Mahe Tamaam Do Ghuncha-E-Dil Khilaiye Jalwa-E-Rukh Dihaiye Jaam-E-Nazar Pilaiye Daur Chale Hudam Do Unki Amaan Me Rahe Jinke Karam Se Milgaye Unke Chaman Ke Pasba Hussam Aur Humaam Do Kashti Ye Zindagi Meri Ab To Kinare Aa Lagi Kehti Hai Tumse Zindagi Ab To Mae Dawaam Do Maidane Naat-E-Shahe Deen Akhtar Hai Purq Tar Zameen Ye Majlise Ghazal Nahi Muh Ko Zara Lagaam Do

১৩৪

Chand Taare Hi Kya Dekte Reh Gaye

Chand Taare Hi Kya Dekte Reh Gaye Unko Arzo Sama Dekhte Reh Gaye Ham Daray Mustafa Dekhtay Reh Ga-Ay, Noor Hi Noor Tha, Dekhtay Reh Ga-Ay. Par Ke Rooh Ul Amin Soorah E Wadduha Soorat E Mustafa Dekhte Reh Gaye Woh Imamat Ki Shab Woh Saf E Ambiya Muqtadi Muqtada Dekhte Reh Gaye Woh Gaye Arsh Tak Aur Rooh Ul Amin Sidrah Tul Muntaha Dekhte Reh Gaye Nek O Badh Par Hua Unka Yaksa Karam Log Acha Bura Dekhte Reh Gaye Kya Khabar Kis Ko Kab Jaam E Kauthar Mila Hum Toh Unki Ada Dekhte Reh Gaye Ho Ke Gum Aye Naseer Unke Jalwo Me Hum Shaan E Rabul Ulaa Dekhte Reh Gaye Baar Baar Tauba Ki Aur Phir Torr Di Woh Habib-E-Khuda Maaf Karte Rahe Ya Rasul Llah Ya Habiba Llah Mere Sar Ko Haram Ki Fiza Chahiye Ya Rasool Llah Ya Habiba Llah Mere Dil Ko Dar-E-Mustafa Chahiye Fazl-E-Rabb-Ul-‘ula Aur Kya Chahiye Mil Gaye Mustafa Aur Kya Chahiye Chand Taaray Hi Kyaa, Dekhtay Reh Ga-Ay, Unko Arzo Samaa Dekhtay Reh Ga-Ay.

১৩৫

Changa Nabi Da Naam Ay

Changa Nabi Da Naam Ay Changian Nabi Diyan Shaanan Zikr Nabi Da Kar Deya Rehna Changa Lagda Ey Ais Bahane Ral Mil Behna Changa Lagda Hai Masjid Nabawi De Wich Jaakeh Nukre Hoke Bai Jaana Roz-E-Paak Nu Tak Deya Rehna Changa Lagda Ey Aale Nabi Di Izzat Khaatir Which Ukhaare De Shaykh Junaid Da Jaan Keh Taina Changa Lagda Ey Jaaliyan Koul Khalouna Uchi Saah Na Lehna Ro Lehna Boulan Naaloun Chup Kar Rehna Changa Lagda Ey

১৩৬

Charche Hain Yehi Ghar Ghar Eidon Ki Hai Eid Aayi

Charche Hain Yehi Ghar Ghar Eidon Ki Hai Eid Aayi Aaye Hain Nabi Sarwar Eidon Ki Hai Eid Aayi Kiya Koonch Hawaaon Ne Di Khabar Fizaaon Ne Badle Hai Sabhi Manzar Eidon Ki Hai Eid Aayi Rehmat Ka Phera Huwa Sab Door Andhera Huwa Gayi Raat Aur Aayi Sahar Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Kaha Baagh Bahaaron Ne Sayyaar Sitaaron Ne Kehte Hain Shamso Qamar Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Khush Momin Hone Lage Aur Shaitaan Rone Lage Jis Waqt Suni Ye Khabar Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Na Kabhi Ghabraaya Kar Tu Jashn Manaaya Kar Khush Ho Ke Yahi Sagar Eidon Ki Eid Aayi

১৩৭

Chor Fikr Duniya Ki Chal Madine Chalte Hain

Chor Fikr Duniya Ki, Chal Madine Chalte Hain, Mustafa Ghulamo Ki Qismatein Badal Te Hain Rehmato Ke Badal Ke Saaye Saath Chalte Hain Mustafa Ke Deewane, Ghar Se Jab Nikalte Hain Aamena Ke Pyare Ka, Sabz Gumbad Waale Ka Jashn Hum Manate Hain Jalne Waale Jalte Hain Humko Roz Milta Hain Sadqa Pyare Aaqa Ka Unke Dar Ke Tukdo Par Khush Naseeb Palte Hain Naqsh Kar Le Seene Par Naam Sarwar E Deen Ka Yay Wo Naam Hain Jis Se Sab Azaab Ttaltay Hain Sirf Saari Duniya Me, Wo Taibah Ki Galiya(N) Hain Jis Jagah Pe Hum Jaise, Khote Sikke Chalte Hain Sach Hain Gair Ka Ehsaan, Wo Kabhi Nahi Lete Ay Aleem Aaqa Ke Jo Tukdo Pe Palte Hain Naat E Mustafa Sunn Kar Aag Sard Hoti Hain Zikr E Mustafa Sunn Kar Sangay Dil Pigaltay Hain Ziker E Shahebatha Ko, Wird Ab Bana Legiye Ye Wo Ziker He Jis Se, Gham Khoshi Me Dalte Hain Un Ko Kia Zarorat He, Iter Mushk Amber Ki Khaak Jo Madina Ki, Apne Tan Pe Malte Hain

১৩৮

Daagh E Furqate Taiba Qalb Muzmahil Jaata

Daagh-E-Furqate Taiba Qalb Muzmahil Jaata Kaash Gumbade Khazraa Dekhne Ko Mil Jaata Mera Dam Nikal Jaata Unke Aastane Par Unke Aastaane Ki Khaak Mai Mein Mil Jaata Mere Dil Se Dhul Jaata Daaghe Furqate Taiba Taiba Mai Fanaa Ho Kar Taiba Mai Hi Mil Jaata Maut Le Ke Aa Jaati Zindagi Madine Mein Maut Se Gale Mil Kar Zindagi Mein Mil Jaata Khuld Zaare Taiba Ka Is Tarha Safar Hota Peeche Peeche Sar Jaata Aage Aage Dil Jaata Dil Pe Jab Kiran Parti Unke Sabz Gumbad Ki Uski Sabz Rangat Se Baagh Ban Ke Khil Jaata Furqate Madina Ne Woh Diye Mujhe Sadme Koh Par Agar Padte Koh Bhi To Hil Jaata Dil Pe Woh Qadam Rakhte Naqshe Paa Yeh Dil Banta Yaa To Khaak-E-Paa Ban Kar Paa Se Muttasil Jaata Un Ke Dar Pe Akhtar Ki Hasratein Hui Poori Saaile Dare Aqdas Kaise Munfa`il Jaata

১৩৯

Dar Pe Bulawo Makki Madni Bigri Banawo Makki Madni

Madine Punchun Ga Yaaaro, Mujhe Yaqeen To Hai Keh Yeh Safar Mere Hathon Ke Lakiron Mein Hai Dar Pe Bulawo Makki Madni, Bigri Banawo Makki Madni Mai Aaoun Madine Meri Auqaa Nahi Hai, Gar Aap Bulalen To Badi Baat Nahi Hai, Dar Pe Bulawo Makki Madni, Deed Teri Ho Eid Meir, Eid Meri Deed Karao Makki Madni, Dar Pe Bulao Makki Madni Mehshar Me Ho Lab Pe Mere Mujh Ko Bachawo Makki Madni Dar Pe Bulawo Makki Madni Ghumbad Ke Khazra Ke Saye Tale Mujh Ko Sulao Makki Madni, Dar Pe Bulao Makki Madni Apne Nawason Ka Sadqa Dukhre Mitao Makki Madni, Dar Pe Bulao Makki Madni Asdi Gunaho Me Dooba Huwa Hai Jaisa He Nibhao Makki Madni, Dar Pe Bulao Makki Madni. Hai Aarzoo Hai Mere Seene Mein Dam Nikle Mera Madine Mein Madad Ko Aayo, Makki Madni. Mangta Hu(N) Me Sawaali Hoon, Ishq-E-Nabi Ka Pujaari Hu(N), Thokaren Khaata Hu(N) Dar Dar Ki, Har Saas Me Madinah He, Muskhkil Ab Mera Jeena He, Dil Mein Tamanna Hai Tayba Ki, Barso(N) Say Akhiya Tarsi, Jalwa Dikhawo Makki Madni, Dar Pe Bulawo Makki Madni

১৪০

Dard E Dil Chahiye Chashm E Tar Chahiye

Dard E Dil Chahiye Chashm E Tar Chahiye Dard E Dil Chahiye Chashm E Tar Chahiye Mujh Ko Aaqa Ki Pyaari Nazar Chaahiye Mujh Ko Aaqa Ki Pyaari Nazar Chaahiye Hai Munawwar Ziya Sey Yeh Saara Jahan Sab Key Dil Ki Haqeeqat Hai Unpar ‘ayaan Merey Dil Ki Tamanna Hai Jaan E Jahan Noor Ki Eyk Kiran Ab Idhar Chaahiye Sarwarey Do Jahan Ka Hai Behad Karam Zaatey Waala Sey Qaayim Hai Mera Bharam Mujh Ko Aaqa Dikhaatey Ho Apna Haram Aap Ki Deed Ko Chashm E Tar Chaahiye Khud Khudaa Ney Banaaya Hai Tum Ko Habeeb Aur Uss Ney Banaaya Hai Tum Ko Tabeeb Marz E ‘isyaan Sey Ab To Shifa Ho Naseeb Sunnaton Par ‘amal ‘umr Bhar Chaahiye Ya Nabi Mujh Pey Ho Eyk Karam Ki Nazar Baar E ‘isyaan Sey Ab To Jhuki Hai Kamar Koi Husn E ‘amal To Nahin Hai Magar Mujh Ko Bakhshish Ka Zaad E Safar Chaahiye Bheek ‘ilm O ‘amal Ki ‘ataa Keejiye Apni Sunnat Ka Paikar Banaa Deejiye Jaam E ‘ulfat Mujhey Ab Pilaa Deejiye Waqt E Aakhir Mujhey Wo Nazar Chaahiye Sharf E Khidmat ‘ataa Ho Gulaamon Ko Ab Jitney ‘ushaaq Hain Sab Rahey Baa Adab Khuld Maskan Baney Aur Raazi Ho Rab Har Du’a Mey Meyri Wo Asar Chaahiye Jo Mujaahid Philisteen Mey Hain Shahaa Aas Tum Par Laga Kar Hee Paayain Jilaa Khaak Mey Zaalimon Ki Miley Ab Jafaa ‘aashiqon Key Liye Ab Zafar Chaahiye Mujh Ko Aaqa Madiney Bulatey Rahey Shakir E Bey Nawaa Ko Nibhatey Rahey Apna Mehmaan Hameysha Banaatey Rahey Aakhree Waqt Mujh Ko Yeh Dar Chaahiye

১৪১

Dard E Dil Chashme Nam Chahiye

Dard E Dil Chashme Nam Chahiye Aitebaar E Karam Chahiye Unse Hi Lao Lagae Rakhe Jisko Apna Bharam Chahiye Hum Gire To Samhale Huzoor Ye Ataa Har Qadam Chahiye Sabz Gumbad Nazar Me Rahe Kab Mujhe Jaam E Jam Chahiye Azeem E Bargah E Nabi Pehle Taofe Haram Chahiye Hum Madine Ke Mushtaq Hai Hum Ko Baagh E Iram Chahiye Hoon Gadaa Bheek Sarkaar Ki Paiba Paidam Badam Chahiye Nisbat E Mustafa Ki Qasam Kuch Kulaho Me Qam Chahiye Anjum Unki Sana Jo Kare Mujh Ko Aisa Khalam Chahiye

১৪২

Darde Dil Kar Mujhe Ata Ya Rab

Darde Dil Kar Mujhe Ata Ya Rab De Mere Dard Ki Dawa Ya Rab Laaj Rakh Le Gunaahgaaron Ki Naam Rehmaan Hai Tera Ya Rab Aib Mere Na Khol Mahshar Mein Naam Sattaar Hai Tera Ya Rab Be Sabab Bakhsh De Na Pooch Amal Naam Gaffaar Hai Tera Ya Rab Bhool Kar Bhi Na Aaye Yaad Apni Mere Dil Se Mujhe Bhula Ya Rab Khaak Kar Apne Aastaane Ki Yoon Humein Khaak Mein Mila Ya Rab Teri Jaanib Yeh Mushte Khaak Ude Bhej Aisi Koi Hawaa Ya Rab Sabqat Rehmatee Ala Gadhabee Tu Ne Jab Se Suna Diya Ya Rab Yuh Gumoo Ke Mai Tujh Se Mil Jau Yuh Gumaa Is Tarha Mila Ya Rab Har Bhale Ki Bhalai Ka Sadqa Mujh Nikamme Ko Kar Bhala Ya Rab Meri Ankhe Mere Liye Tarse Mujh Se Aisa Mujhe Chupa Ya Rab Tu Aasra Hum Gunahgaro Ka Aur Mazboot Ho Gaya Ya Rab Ahle Sunnat Ki Har Jamat Par Har Jaga Ho Teri Ata Ya Rab Dushmanon Ke Liye Hidayat Ki Tujh Se Karta Hu Iltija Ya Rab Meri Maan Meri Behnain Bhanjay Sab Pa’ayn Araam-E-Do Sara Ya Rab Aur Bhi Jitne Pyaare Hai Hajatain Sab Ki Ho Rawa Ya Rab Mere Ahbab Par Bhi Fazl Rahe Tera Tere Habeeb Ka Ya Rab Teens Kam Ho Na Dard E Ulfat Ki Dil Tadapta Rahe Mera Ya Rab Aasraa Hum Gunaahgaaron Ka Aur Mazboot Ho Gaya Ya Rab Tu Ne Mere Zaleel Haathon Mein Daamane Mustafa Diya Ya Rab Kar Diya Tu Ne Qadri Mujh Ko Teri Qudrat Ke Main Fida Ya Rab Tu Hasan Ko Utha Hasan Kar Ke Ho Ma'al-Khair Khaatima Ya Rab

১৪৩

Dare Nabi Par Para Rahoon Ga Parre Hi Rehne Se Kaam Hoga

Dare Nabi Par Para Rahoon Ga, Parre Hi Rehne Se Kaam Hoga Kabhi To Qismat Khule Gi Meri, Kabhi To Mera Salam Hoga Khilafe Maashooq Kuch Huwa Hai, Na Koi Aashiq Se Kaam Hoga Khuda Bhi Hoga Wahi Pe Aye Dil, Jidhar Woh Aali Maqam Hoga Kiye Hi Jaoon Ga Arz Matlab, Milega Jab Tak Na Dil Ka Matlab Na Shaam E Matlab Ki Subha Hogi, Na Yeh Fasana Tamam Hoga Jo Dil Se Hai Ma’il-E-Payambar, Yeh Is Ki Pehchan Hai Muqarrar Ke Har Dam Is Be Nawa Ke Lab Par, Durood Hoga Salam Hoga Isi Tawaqqo Pe Ji Raha Hoon, Yehi Tamanna Jila Rahi Hai Nigahe Lutfo Karam Na Hogi, To Mujh Ko Jeena Haram Hoga Dare Nabi Par Para Rahoon Ga, Parre Hi Rehne Se Kaam Hoga Kabhi To Qismat Khule Gi Meri, Kabhi To Mera Salam Hoga

১৪৪

Dare Nabi Par Yeh Umr Beete Ho Hum Pe Lutfe Dawaam Aisa

Dare Nabi Par Yeh Umr Beete Ho Hum Pe Lutfe Dawaam Aisa Madine Waale Kahe Maqaami Ho Unke Dar Par Qayaam Aisa Yeh Rifate Zikre Mustafa Hai Nahi Kisi Ka Maqaam Aisa Jo Baad Zikre Khuda Hai Afzal Hai Zikre Khairul Anaam Aisa Jo Ghamzadon Ko Gale Laga Le Buron Ko Daaman Me Jo Chupa Le Hai Doosra Kaun Is Jahaan Me Siwaae Khairul Anaam Aisa Bilal Tujh Par Nisaar Jau Ke Khud Nabi Ne Tujhe Khareeda Naseeb Ho To Naseeb Aisi Ghulam Ho To Ghulam Aisa Namaaz Aqsa Me Jab Padhayi To Ambiya Aur Rusul Yeh Bole Namaaz Ho To Namaz Aisi Imaam Ho To Imaam Aisa Mai Khalid Apne Nabi Pe Qurban Hai Jin Ka Khulq-E-Azeem Qur'aan Hai Roshni Jis Ki Do Jahan Me Kaheen Hai Maah-E-Tamaam Aisa

১৪৫

Darpesh Ho Taiba Ka Safar Kaisa Lage Ga

Darpesh Ho Taiba Ka Safar Kaisa Lage Ga Guzrain Jo Wahan Shaam O Sehar Kaisa Lage Ga Jab Door Se Hai Itna Haseen Gumbad-E-Hazra Iss Paar Ye Aalum Hai Udhaar Kaisa Lage Ga Kismat Se Jo Ajaye Mere Ghar Me Shahedi Mai Kaisa Lagoon Ga Mera Ghar Kaisa Lage Ga Rakh Loonga Imame Pe Jo Naalyne Muqadas Shaahon Ke Muqabil Mere Sar Kaisa Lage Ga Sarkar Ne Dar Pe Tujhe Bulwaya Hai Mangte Jab Koi Tumhe Dega Khabar Kaisa Lage Ga Ghaosul Wara Se Puchlo Ek Roz Ye Chal Kar Baqdaad Se Taiba Ka Safar Kaisa Lage Ga Ae Kash Madine Main Mujhe Maot Youn Aye Kadmoon Main Ho Sarkar Ke Sar Kaisa Lage Ga Ae Pyare Khuda Dekhoon Main Sarkar Ka Jalwa Mil Jaye Dua To Jo Asar Kaisa Lage Ga Aa Jayen Mere Ghar Main Agar Rehmat-E-Aalim Main Kesa Lagoon Ga Mera Ghar Kesa Lage Ga Taiba Ki Saadath To Youn Pathe Hain Hazaroon Murshid Ka Saath Ho Jo Safar Kaisa Lage Ga Payee Munawar Ne Kazza Dar Pe Nabi Ke Aajaye Watan Aesi Habbar Kaisa Lage Ga.

১৪৬

Das Ni Haleema Saadia Kitho Le Aayi Ay Sohna Laal

Das Ni Haleema Saadia Kitho Le Aayi Ay Sohna Laal. Akhiyan Mazaagh Al-Bassar, Wa-Layl De Wingrhe (Kundle) Waal, Lukda Phirda Chan Asmaani, Wekh Ke Husn O Jamal. Das Ni Haleema Saadia, Kitho Le Aayi Ay Sohna Laal. Teri Daachi Si Kamzoor Barri, Kiwein Ho Gayi Ay Shahzor Barri, Tu Lang Gayi Ay Picche Reh Gayia, Tenu Tak Tak Sochdi Reh Gaiya, Jad Da Sohna Madni Aaya Eh, (Jad Da Sawaar Haseen Aaya) Teri Ho Gayi Wakhri Shaan (Chaal). Das Ni Haleema Saadia, Kitho Le Aayi Ay Sohna Laal. Oh Bole Taan Farmaan (Sultaan) Bane, Odhe Hont Hillan Quran Bane, 'allam Nashrah Laka Sadrak. Warafa'na Laka Zikrak. Sohne Di Tareef Karaan Main, Jidda Wasif Ay Zul Jalaal. Das Ni Haleema Saadia, Kitho Le Aayi Ay Sohna Laal.

১৪৭

Deewane Jo Wi Mangde Ne

Deewane Jo Wi Mangde Ne Shah-E-Abrar (Mere Sarkar) Dende Ne Karam (Nazar) Karde Ne Jis Wele Te Naslan Taar Dende Ne Jadon Ae Bewafa Dunya Meinu Akhiyan Wikhondi Ae Dilaase Pyaar De Meinu Mere Ghamkhwaar Dende Ne Qasam Rabb Di Nabi De Nan Ton Wik Jande Ne Diwaane Ae Kuj Wi Kol Nai Rakhde Ae Sab Kuj Waar Dende Ne Ali Haidar De Bacheyaan Di Main Ljapali Ton Sadqe Jaan Koi Ik War Mangda Ae Au Sau Sau War Dende Ne Jerre Lamhe Nabi Sarwar De Zikr-E-Paak Wich Guzran Dilaan Nu Chain Dende Ne Te Seene Thaar Dende Ne Ghulamaan Da Aqeeda Ae, Mera Imaan-E-Farooqi Kammi Rehndi Nai Fer Koi Jaddon Sarkar Dende Ne Deewane Jo Wi Mangde Ne Mere Sarkar Dende Ne Nazar Karde Ne Jis Wele Te Naslan Taar Dende Ne

১৪৮

Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda

Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Khalq Ke Rehbar Aa Pohche Haq Ke Payambar Aa Pohche Shafaye Mehshar Aa Pohche Saaqiye Kausar Aa Pohche Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Saaqiye Kausar Behre Khuda Aaj To Aisa Jaam Pila Uth Jaaye Parda Judaayi Ka Jalwaye Zeba Hum Ko Dikha Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Jism Se Jab Ho Jaan Juda Hum Ko Mile Firdaus Me Jaa Loote Hum Qurbat Ka Maza Aap Ki Aye Mehboobe Khuda Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Jannat Ki Jab Sair Kare Hum Bhi Sab Hum Raah Chale Hauze Kausar Par Pohche Haath Se Aap Ke Jaam Piye Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Jo Is Bazm Me Shamil Ho Us Par Rehmat Naazil Ho Jis Ghar Me Ye Mehfil Ho Izzat O Barkat Daakhil Ho Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah Daawar E Kul Aye Rabbe Ula Sadqa Zaat E Muhammad Ka Jaari Rahe Ta Rauze Jaza Mazhab Ahle Sunnat Ka Dekhte Kya Ho Ahle Safa Aa Pohche Mehboobe Khuda Yaani Ho Chuke Jalwa Numa Shaahe Haq Shaahe Batha La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah La Ilaha Illallah Aamanna Bi Rasoolillah

১৪৯

Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho

Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho Sabhaan De Sarkaar Tussi Ho Main Ki Dassan Dunya Kehndi Nabiyaan De Sardaar Tussi Ho Meriyan Sochaan De Wich Har Damm Hor Nahi Sarkaar Tussi Ho Taade Hondeyan Kaadiyan Fikraan? Maalik Te Mukhtaar Tussi Ho Aap Di Aal Da Main Haan Kammi Mere Baagh-O-Bahaar Tussi Ho Jinna Naal Zia Diyan Izzataan Oh Aali Sarkaar Tussi Ho Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho Sabhaan De Sarkaar Tussi Ho Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho Dil Da Chain Qaraar Tussi Ho

১৫০

Dil Dard Se Bismil Ki Tarah Laot Raha Ho

Dil Dard Se Bismil Ki Tarah Laot Raha Ho Seene Pe Tasalli Ko Tera Haath Dhara Ho Gar Waqte Ajal Sir Teri Chaukhat Pe Jhuka Ho Jitni Ho Qaza Ek Hi Sajde Me Ada Ho Tum Zaat E Khuda Se Na Judaa Ho Na Khuda Ho Allah Ko Ma'alum Hai Kya Jaaniye Kya Ho Ye Kyu Kahu Mujhko Ye Ataa Ho Ye Ataa Ho Wo Do Ke Hamesha Mere Ghar Bhar Ka Bhala Ho Dekha Unhe Mehshar Me To Rehmat Ne Pukara Aazad Hain Jo Aapke Daaman Se Bandha Ho Firdous Ke Baagho Se Udhar Mil Nahi Sakta Jo Koyi Madine Ke Bayaba Me Ghuma Ho Mangta To Hain Mangta Koi Shaho Me Dikha De Jisko Mere Sarkaar Se Tukda Na Mila Ho Mitti Na Ho Barbaad Pase Marge Ilahi Jab Khaaq Ude Meri Madine Ki Hawaa Ho Aata Hain Faqeero Pe Unhe Pyar Kuch Aisa Khud Bheekh De Khud Kahe Mangta Ka Bhala Ho Dhundha Hi Kare Sadr Qayamat Ke Sipahi Woh Kisko Mile Jo Tere Daaman Me Chupa Ho Shaabaash Hassan Aur Chamakti Si Ghazal Parh Dil Khol Kar Aaina E Iman Ki Jilaa Ho De Daaliye Apne Lab E Jaa Baksh Ka Sadqa Ay Chara E Dil Dard E Hasan Ki Bhi Dawa Ho

১৫১

Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro

Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro Sache Rab De Wekh Kamal Rehnada Ae Har Wele Tere Naal Sar Ton Dukh Denda Ae Taal Kar Ke Munh Apna Qibla Ru Karda Ro Allah Allah Hu Uthdeyan Baindeya Chaldeyan Phirdeyan Dam Ohda Hi Barda Ro Har Ik Da Oh Palan Wale, Har Ik Da Oh Sahara Ae Auhdiyan Ne Ae Qul Tajalliyan Ohda Chanan Sara Ae Shae Rag Ton Wi Nerhe Hai Au Qaul Quran Da Pyaara Ae Shaam Saware Khulla Rehnda Auhda Paak Dawara Ae Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro Alif Allah Chambe Di Booti Murshid Man Wich Lai Hu Nafi Ithbat Da Pani Mileya Har Rage Har Jaye Hu Andar Booti Mushk Machaya Jaan Phullan Te Ai Hu Jiwe Murshid Kamil Bahu Je Ae Booti Lai Hu Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro Ey Tan Mera Chashma Howe Murshid Wekh Na Rajjan Hu Loon Loon De Mud Lakh Lakh Chashma Ik Kholan Hik Khajjan Hu Inna Ditheya Sabr Na Away How Kidde Wal Bhajja Hu Murshid Da Deedar Hai Bahu Lakh Karoran Hajjan Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro Rakhe Jinun Raz Khuda Ao Raaz Kisse De Khulda Nai Jinnun Maula Izzat Dewe Lakh Koi Role Rulda Nai Sadqe Jawan Sohail Farooqi Rab Di Karam Nawazi Ton Banda Aunun Bhul Janda Ae Au Bande Nun Bhulda Nai Dil Di Tasbih Utte Bandeya Allah Allah Karda Ro

১৫২

Dil Ki Dua Hai Maula Imaan Dil Pe Likh De

Dil Ki Dua Hai Maula Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Mehboob Ka Waseela Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Imaan Par Hi Mera Ho Khaatima Khudaya De Panjatan Ka Sadqa Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Rehmat Ke Phool De De Hubbe Rasool De De Dil Hai Bada Shakista Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Imaan Dene Waale Imaan Ki Kar Hifaazat Mehroom Ho Na Banda Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Noore Muhammadi De Dil Raushni Se Bhar De Anmol De Khazaana Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Ummat Mein Sab Se Zyada Imaan Mila Hai Jis Ko Bu Bakr Ka Waseela Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Imaan Par Ho Jeena Imaan Par Ho Marna Imaan Ka De Gehna Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Imaan Chin Na Jaaye Hain Ghaat Mein Lootere Imaan Mera Bachana Imaan Dil Pe Likh De Maula Se Aye Ujaagar Kar Ye Dua Barabar Ho Umr Bhar Ka Naata Imaan Dil Pe Likh De

১৫৩

Dil Ki Duniya Ko Sajaao Aaqa

Dil Ki Duniya Ko Sajaao Aaqa Apni Ulfat Me Jilaao Aaqa Hubbe Duniya Se Bachaana Mujh Ko Mujh Ko Apna Hee Banaao Aaqa Shauq E Deedar Me So-Un Jis Shab Apna Deedar Karaao Aaqa Mere Dil Ki Hai Tamanna Har Dam Apna Ghar Isko Banao Aaqa Fikr E Duniya Me Na Aansoo Nikle Apni Ulfat Me Rulaao Aaqa Jitney Mo’min Hain Pareshaan Shaaha Sab Ki Bigdi Ko Banaao Aaqa Aakhri Dum Bhi Adaa Ho Sunnat Peer Ke Din Jo Qaza Ho Aaqa Dil Tarapta Hai Huzoori Ko Huzoor Sadqe Murshid Ke Bulaao Aaqa Mujh Ko Phir Dushmano Ne Ghera Hai Apne Daaman Me Chupaao Aaqa Shakir E Razvi Hai ‘aasi Shaaha Muzda Bakhshish Ka Sunaao Aaqa

১৫৪

Dil Ko Unse Khuda Judaa Na Kare

Dil Ko Unse Khuda Judaa Na Kare Bekasi Loot Le Khuda Na Kare Is Me Rauze Ka Sajda Ho Ki Tawaaf Hosh Mein Jo Na Ho Who Kya Na Kare Ye Wohi Hain Ki Baksh Dete Hain Kaun In Jurmo(N) Par Saza Na Kare Sab Tabeebo Ne De Diya Hai Jawaab Aah Isaa Agar Dawa Na Kare Dil Kaha(N) Le Chala Haram Se Mujhe Are Tera Bura Khuda Na Kare Uzr Umeede Afw Gar Na Sune(N) Roo Siyah Aur Kya Bahana Kare Dil Mein Rausahn Hai Shama-E Ishqe Huzoor Kaash Joshe Hawas Hawa Na Kare Hashr Mein Hum Bhi Sair Dekhenge Munkir Aaj Unse Iltijaa Na Kare Zau'f Maana Magar Yeh Zaalim Dil Unke Raste Mein To Thaka Na Kare Jab Teri Khoo Hai Sab Ka Jee Rakhna Wohi Achcha Jo Dil Bura Na Kare Dil Se Ik Zauqe Mai Ka Taalib Hoon Kaun Kehta Hai Ittiqa Na Kare Le Raza Sab Chale Madine Ko Main Na Jaaoon Are Khuda Na Kare

১৫৫

Dil Me Ishqe Nabi Ki Ho Aesi Lagan

Dil Me Ishqe Nabi Ki Ho Aesi Lagan Rooh Tarapti Rahe Dil Machalta Rahe Zindagi Ka Maza He Ke Har Sans Se Yaa Mohammad Mohammad Nikalta Rahe Yaa Mohammad Mohammad Mein Kahta Raha Noor Ke Motiyon Ki Larri Ban Gai Aayaton Se Milaata Raha Aayatain Phir Jo Deka To Naate Nabi Ban Gai Jo Bi Ansoo Bahe Mere Mehboob Ke Sab Ke Sab Abr Rahmat Ke Chhinte Banain Chah Gai Raat Jab Zulf Lehra Gai Jab Tabassum Kiya Chandni Ban Gai Yeh To Maana Ke Jannat He Baaghe Hasin Khubsurat Hai Sab Khuld Ki Sar Zamin Husn E Jannat Ko Pir Jab Sameta Gaya Sarware Ambiya Ki Gali Ban Gai Jab Chira Tazkira Un Ke Rukhsaar Ka Waduha Par Lia Walqamar Keh Diya Sooraton Kee Tilwata Be Hotee Rahee Naat Bee Ho Gaee Baat Bee Ban Gaee Sab Sey Saaim Zamanain Main Maazoor Tha Sab Sey Beykas Tha Beybas Tha Majboor Tha Un Ko Rehm Agaya Mere Halaat Par Meree Azmat Meree Beybasi Ban Gaee

১৫৬

Dil Me Kisi Ko Aur Basaaya Na Jaayega

Dil Me Kisi Ko Aur Basaaya Na Jaayega Zikre Rasoole Paak Bhulaaya Na Jaayega Woh Khud Hi Jaan Lenge Jataaya Na Jaayega Hum Se To Apna Haal Sunaaya Na Jaayega Hum Ko Jazaa Milegi Muhammad Se Ishq Ki Dozakh Ke Aas Paas Bhi Laaya Na Jaayega Kehte The Ye Bilal Tashadud Pe Kufr Ke Ishqe Nabi To Dil Se Nikaala Na Jaayega Beshak Huzoor Shaafae Mehshar Hain Munkiron Kya Un Ka Saamne Tumhe Laaya Na Jaayega Maanega Unki Baat Khuda Hashr Me Naseer Bin Mustafa Khuda Ko Manaaya Na Jaayega

১৫৭

Dil Mein Nabi Ki Yaad Ne Dera Jama Liya

Dil Mein Nabi Ki Yaad Ne, Dera Jama Liya Saare Ghamon Mein Aapke Gham Ne Bacha Liya Jab Tak Bike Na The, To Koi Poochta Na Tha Sarkar Ne Khareed Ke Anmol Kar Diya Dunya Mein Mujhe Tum Ne, Jab Apna Banaya Hai Mehshar Mein Bhi Keh Dena, Yeh Hai Mera Deewana Jab Tak Bike Na The, To Koi Poochta Na Tha Sarkar Ne Khareed Ke Anmol Kar Diya Murshid Tere Aane Se, Yeh Josh Hai Masti Ka Sheeshe Pe Gira Sheesha, Paimane Pe Paimana Nazron Se Mila Nazre Bhar De Mera Paimana Aabaad Khuda Rakhe Murshid Tera Ma Khana Ahsan Tera Bhoole Ge Murshid Na Ham Kabhi Nazre Pila Ke Aapne Rabb Se Mila Diya Kyoun Aankh Ladai Thi, Kyoun Aag Lagai Hai Khud Rukh Ko Chupa Baithe Kar Ke Hame Deewana Aey Ishq Tere Sadqe Jalne Se Chute Saste Jo Aag Bhuja Degi Woh Aag Lagai Hai Sarshar Kar Diya Hamein Be Khud Bana Diya Aey Chasme Peer Tu Ne Hamein Kya Pila Diya Bigri Bhi Banaeinge Jalwe Bhi Dikhaeinge Sarkar Bulaeinge Veerania Na Aeinge Ankhon Mein Ab Kabhi Maine Madinah Aapka, Dil Mein Basa Liya Jee Chahta Hai Tohfe Mein Bhejhoun Unhe Aankhein Darshan Ka To Darshan Ho Nazrane Ka Nazrana Aaqa Teri Mehfil Ka Aey Rang Judagana Ham Ne To Jisse Dekha To Dekha Tere Diwana Data Bana Diya Koi Khawaja Bana Diya Bandon Ko Tere Ishq Ne Kya Kya Bana Diya Dil Mein Nabi Ki Yaad Ne Dera Jama Liya Saare Ghamon Mein Aapke Gham Ne Bacha Liya

১৫৮

Dil Thikaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai

Dil Thikaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Jalwa Khaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Har Zamaane Ki Aap Rehmat Hai Har Zamaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Aik Pal Mein Hazaar Alam Mein Aana Jaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Jin Pe Uthree Hai Aaya-E-Thath-Hir Woh Gharaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Nematay Sab Wohi Khilathay Hai Daana Daana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Mujh Sa Aassee Kahan Madine Kahan Yeh Bulaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Roz Mehshar Jo Bakshwa’ay Ga Woh Bahaana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Hashr Mein Unke Saath Uthay Ga Jo Deewana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai Zikr Shamil Namaaz Mein Khalid Panjagana Mere Huzoor Ka Hai

১৫৯

Dil Yaar Da Nazraana Le Yaar De Kol Aaye

Dil Yaar Da Nazraana, Le Yaar De Kol Aaye Mere Yaar Di Marzi Eh, Gall Laawe Ya Thukraawe Naal Apne Urra Le Jaa, Mere Athroo Hawaae Ni, Mahboob Noo Rowaan Gi, Sanu Hor Na Tarhpaawe, Jannat Di Nahi Khwahish, Mere Mola Eh Tamanna Eh, Sarkaar De Qadman Vich, Meri Jaan Nikal Jaawe, Kaun Enna Noon Samjhaawe, Kehn Apne Jeya Ohnu, Jiddi Kaaliyan Zulfaan Di, Rabb Aap Kasaam Khaawe, Raah Yaar Da Takna Eh, Fir Aes Rah To Na Hattna Eh, Mahboob Di Marzi Eh, Oh Aawe Ya Na Aawe, Jannat Vich Mazaa Aawe, Sarkaar Je Farmaawan, Le Aao Zahoori Noon, Aethe Naat Suna Jaawe, Dil Yaar Da Nazraana, Le Yaar De Kol Aaye Mere Yaar Di Marzi Eh, Gall Laawe Ya Thukraawe

১৬০

Dildaar Barhe Aaey Mahboob Barhe Dekhey

Dildaar Barhe Aa'ey Mahboob Barhe Dekhey Jo Dekhey Sabhii Un Keh Qadmon Main Parhe Dekhey Sardaare Do 'aalam Ki Ta'ziim Keh Kiyaa Kehne Mursal Bhii Sabhii Jin Ki Raahon Main Karhe Dekhey Yaad Un Keh Madinah Ki Jab Dil Main Utar Aai Palkon Keh Kinaaron Pih Moti Seh Jurhe Dekhey Mahboob Ki Midhat Main Hai Taab Sukhan Kis Ko Sab Ahle Sukhan Main Ne Hairat Main Garhe Dekhey Un Jaisaa Zuhurii Ab Aaey Gaa Nah Duniya Main Dildaar Barhe Aa'ey Mahboob Barhe Dekhey

১৬১

Diloun Ke Gulshan Mahek Rahe Hain

Diloun Ke Gulshan Mahek Rahe Hain Yeh Kaif Kyon Aaj Aa Rahe Hai Kuch Aisa Mehsoos Ho Raha Hai Huzoor Tashrif La Rahe Hai Nawazishon Par Nawazishayn Hai Inaayatoun Par, Inaayatein Hai Nabi Ki Na’atein, Suna, Suna Kar Ham Apni Qismat Jaga Rahe Hai Kahiin Pay Ronaq Hai Mekashon Ki Kahiin Pay Mehfil He Dil Jalon Ki Wo Kitnay Khush Bakht Heyn Jo Apnay Nabi Ki Mehfil Saja Rahay Hai Na Paas Pi Ho To Soona Saawan Wo Jiss Say Raazi Wohi Suhaagan Jinhon Nay Pakra Nabi Ka Daaman Unhi Kay Ghar Jagmaga Rahay Heyn Kahaan Ka Mansab, Kahaan Ki Daulat Qasam Khuda Ki, Yeh Hai Haqiqat Jinhe Bulaaya, Hai Mustafa Ne Wohi Madiney Ko, Ja Rahe Hai Main Apne Khayrul Wara Ke Sad’qe Inki Shaane Ata Ke Sad’qe Bhara Hai Aibon Se Mera Daaman Huzoor Phir Bhi Nibaah Rahe Hai Habibe Daavar, Gharib Parwar Rasoole Akram, Karam Ke Pekar Kisi Ko Dar Par Bula Rahe Hai Kisi Ke Khawboun Mein Aa Rahe Hai Banega Jaane Ka Phir Bahaana Kahega Aakar Koi Diwaana Chalo Niyazi, Tumhe Madiney Madiney Waale Bula Rahe Hai

১৬২

Do Jahaan Ke Waali Ka Do Jahaan Pe Saaya Hai

Do Jahaan Ke Waali Ka Do Jahaan Pe Saaya Hai Un Ko To Khuda Ne Un Ki Marzi Se Banaaya Hai Noori Noori Jalwe Hain Kaise Pyaare Jalwe Hai Chaand Unke Jalwon Ki Bheek Lene Aaya Hai Waduha Ka Chehra Hai Taaha Ka Sehra Hai Unke Muskurane Se Zamaana Jagmagaaya Hai Toor Pe Kaha Rab Ne Lantarani Moosa Ko Lekin Mere Aaqa Ko Arsh Pe Bulaaya Hai Nabiyon Ne Salaami Di Waliyon Ne Ghulami Ki Sar Pe Un Ke Khaaliq Ne Taaj Wo Sajaaya Hai Lete Hain Dua’en Woh Karte Hain Jafaa’en Woh Seene Se Laga’en Usko Jis Ne Bhi Sataaya Hai Barkaton Ke Rele Hain Nooriyon Ke Mele Hain Haleema Teri Kuttya Me Kaun Muskuraaya Hai

১৬৩

Dunya Ke Ae Musafir Manzil Teri Qabar Hai

Dunya Ke Ae Musafir Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Manzil Teri Qabar Hai, Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Tai Kar Raha Hai Jo Tu, Do Din Ka Yeh Safar Hai Manzil Teri Qabar Hai, Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Jab Se Bani Hai Dunya, Lakhon Karoron Aaaye Lakhon Karoron Aaaye Baki Raha Na Koi, Mitti Main Sab Samaye Mitti Main Sab Samaye Mat Bhoolna Yaha Par, Sab Ka Yahi Hashar Hai Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Dunya Ke Ae Musafir Yeh Aali Shaan Bangle Kissi Kaam Ke Nahi Hain Mehloon Main Sonay Wale, Mitti Main So Rahe Hain Mitti Main So Rahe Hain Do Gaz Zameen Ka Tukra Chota Sa Tera Ghar Hai Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Dunya Ke Ae Musafir Ankhon Se Tun Ne Apni Dekhe Kayi Janaze Dekhe Kayi Janaze Hathon Se Tu Ne Dafnaaye Kitne Murde Dafnaaye Kitne Murde Anjaam Se Tu Apne, Kiun Itna Tu Bekhabar Hai Manzil Teri Qabar Hai Dunya Ke Ae Musafir

১৬৪

Dunya Te Aaya Koi Teri Na Misaal Da

Dunya Te Aaya Koi Teri Na Misaal Da Main Lab Ke Le Awan Kithon, Sohna Tere Naal Da Makke Rehan Waleya, Madine Aun Waleya Thaddey Khawan Waleyan Noon Seene Lawan Waleya Tere Bina Diggiyan Noon Koi Nah Sanbhalll Daa Mukh Teraa Noor Wande, Saarii Kaenaat Noon Rabb Wee Durood Bhejay, Teri Paak Zaat Noon Har Paase Charcha, Tere Husn-O-Jamaal Daa Shaan Niraali Teri, Zaat Teri Aali Ey Bhar De Tu Jholi Ajj, Jedi Jedi Khaali Ey Mangta Niazi Tere Thon, Sadqa Teri Aal Daa Soneya Daroood Bhejhe, Rabb Teri Zaat Nu, Mukh Tera Noor Wande, Saare Kainaat Nu Shedaey Zamaana, Tere Husnu Jamaal Da, Teriyan Te Siftaan Da Koi Wee Hisab Nai Toon Te Kithe Terayan Ghulaman Da Jawaab Nai Horaan Tey Roop Wandan Habshi Bilaal Daa Ho Kapeya Dewee Tere, Sacheya Piyaara Da, Joondaye Zahoori Naa. Laike Tere Yaaran Da Golaye Tera, Tere Dard Da, Tere Yaal Da Dunya Te Aaya Koi Teri Na Misaal Da Main Lab Ke Le Awan Kithon, Sohna Tere Naal Da

১৬৫

Durood Lab Par Khayal Dil Mein

Durood Lab Par Khayal Dil Mein Aur Ashq Aankhon Mein Aa Rahe Hain Huzoor Ke Dar Pe Jaa Rahe Hain To Iss Khareene Se Jaa Rahe Hain Rasool E Akram Zameen E Rabb Par Kisi Tarha Ghum Nibha Rahe Hain Jahan E Tarik Mein Lahu Se Charagh E Ulfat Jala Rahe Hain Charagh Tera Hai Noor Tera Badan Bhi Tera Lahu Bhi Tera Ye Sab Teri Milkiyat Hai Aaqa Ke Hum To Karza Chuka Rahe Hain Hum Apni Nafsaniyat Ke Chahkar Tumhara Haq Kya Adaa Karenge Bas Ik Tumhara Karam Hai Aaqa Ke Jis Pe Takiya Laga Rahe Hain Main Dayr Se Aa Sakunga Aaqa Gunah Ki Gathriyan Lagi Hain Ba Teri Rehmat Ke Aasre Par Qadam Qadam Badhte Jaa Rahe Hain Janaab E Adam Bhi Keh Rahe Hain Madad Kisi Aur Darr Se Maango Kaleem O Isa Bhi Mere Aaqa Tumhari Janib Hi Aa Rahe Hain Barouz E Mehshar Tumhara Mujrim Tumhare Daman Mein Aake Chhupta Magar Wahan Auliya Jama Hain Jo Sur Sun Sun Ke Aa Rahe Hain Mein Sakht Maayus Ho Chuka Tha Ke Ghous E Azam Pukar Uthhe Mere Aaqa Mere Muridon Ko Jaane Kab Se Bula Rahe Hain Humara Ghumkhwar Bhi Hai Koyi Kisi Ko Humse Bhi Hai Mahabbat Tumhari Naatein Suna Suna Kar Zamane Bhar Ko Jata Rahe Hain Teri Ghulmai Ki Tabedari Ko Badshahi Mukabala Hai Ke Ba-Yazeed O Junaid Jaise Sifarishein Leke Aa Rahe Hain Tumhari Sarkar Aala Shah Mein Huroof E Ashraf Ki Aabru Kya Wahan To Hassan Naat Khwan Hain Raza Bhi Nagme Suna Rahe Hain ------------------------------ ------------Nazar------------- ------Owais Raza Qadri-------- ------------------------------

১৬৬

Dushmane Ahmed Pe Shiddat Kijiye

Dushmane Ahmed Pe Shiddat Kijiye Mulhidon Ki Kya Murawwat Kijiye Zikr Unka Chediye Har Baat Mein Chedna Shaitaa(N) Ka Aadat Kijiye Misle Faaris Zalzale Ho Najd Mein Zikre Aayaate Wilaadat Kijiye Gaiz Mein Jal Jaayen Be Deeno Ke Dil Ya Rasoolallah Ki Kasrat Kijiye Kijiye Charcha Unhi Ka Subho Shaam Jaane Kaafir Par Qayaamat Kijiye Aap Dargaahe Khuda Mein Hain Wajeeh Haan Shafa'at Bil Wajaahat Kijiye Haq Tumhe Farma Chuka Apna Habeeb Ab Shafa'at Bil Mahabbat Kijiye Izn Kab Ka Mil Chuka Ab To Huzoor Hum Ghareebon Ki Shafa'at Kijiye Mulhidon Ka Shaq Nikal Jaaye Huzoor Jaanibe Mah Phir Ishaarat Kijiye Shirk Thehre Jis Mein Taa'zeeme Habeeb Us Bure Mazhab Pe Laa'nat Kijiye Zaalimo! Mehboob Ka Haq Tha Yehi Ishq Ke Badle Adaawat Kijiye Wadduha, Hujraat, Alam Nashrah Se Phir Momino! Itmaame Hujjat Kijiye Baithte Uthte Huzoore Paak Se Iltijaa Wa Istiaanat Kijiye Ya Rasoolallah Duhaaee Aap Ki Goshmaale Ahle Bid'at Kijiye Gause Aa'zam Aap Se Fariyaad Hai Zinda Fir Yeh Paak Millat Kijiye Ya Khuda Tujh Tak Hai Sab Ka Muntaha Auliya Ko Huqme Nusrat Kijiye Mere Aaqa Hazrate Achche Miyaan Ho Raza Achcha Woh Soorat Kijiye

১৬৭

Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi

Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eid E Milad Un Nabi Hai Kya Suhana Noor Hai Aagaya Wo Noor Wala Jiska Sara Noor Hai Noori Noori Hai Fazaen Gati Hai Hawaen Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Duniya Yun Jagmagai, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Qalqat Bhi Muskurai, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Khush Haal Har Gharana, Shadaab Hai Zamana Kya Mast Hai Khudai, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Islam Ki Do Eiden, Is Ke Sabab Se Payi Sab Ka Zahoor Lai, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Aye Deen Agar Na Honda, Duniya Te Kuch Na Honda Jindri In Hato Payi, Eida Di Eid Aayi Eida Di Eid Aayi, Eida Di Eid Aayi Har Dard Ke Andhere, Ab Door Ho Rahe Hai Khushiyon Ke Deep Lai, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Sarkar Jalwa Farma, Jis Din Hue Ujagar Rehmat Quda Ki Chayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi Eidon Ki Eid Aayi, Eidon Ki Eid Aayi

১৬৮

Eid E Milad Un Nabi Hai Dil Bada Masroor Hai

Eid E Milad Un Nabi Hai Dil Bada Masroor Hai Eid Dewaanon Ki Tu Bara Rabi Un Noor Hai Is Taraf Jo Noor Hai Tu Us Taraf Bhi Noor Hai Zarra Zarra Sab Jahaan Ka Noor Se Ma'amoor Hai Har Malak Hai Shadman Khush Aaj Har Ek Hoor Hai Haan Magar Shaitan Baham Rufka Bada Ranjoor Hai Amade Sarkar Se Dil Mast Hoi Kafoor Hai Kiya Zameen Kiya Aasman Har Samt Chaya Noor Hai Jashne Milad Un Nabi Hai Kyun Na Jhoome Aaj Hum Muskurati Hain Bahare Sab Faza Purnoor Hai Gham Ke Badal Chat Gaye Har Gham Ka Maara Jhoom Utha Aa Gaya Khushiyan Liye Mahe Rabi Un Noor Hai Aamina Tujh Ko Mubarak Shah Ki Milad Ho Tera Aangan Noor Balke Ghar Ka Ghar Sab Noor Hai Hoon Ghulame Mustafa Attaar Ka Dawa Hai Ye Kash Aaqa Bhi Ye Farmayen Hume Manzoor Hai

১৬৯

Eide Nabvi Ka Zamana Aa Gaya

Eide Nabvi Ka Zamana Aa Gaya Lab Pe Khushiyon Ka Tarana Aa Gaya Har Sitare Ko Mili Hai Raushni Har Kali Ko Muskurana Aa Gaya Har Taraf Salle Ala Ki Dhoom Hai Wajd Mein Saara Zamana Aa Gaya Parchame Deene Muhammad Ho Buland Kaafir Ko Gardan Jukana Aa Gaya Kyun Na Ho Qismat Key Maron Paas Rehmat Ka Khazana Aa Gaya Aaj Chamkado Daro Deewar Ko Aashiqon Ka Din Suhaana Aa Gaya Shaad Honton Pe Hai Naat Mustafa Haath Bakhshish Ka Bahana Aa Gaya

১৭০

Ek Ajab Lutf Is Tarah Jeene Mein Hai

Ek Ajab Lutf Is Tarah Jeene Mein Hai Main Yahaan Hoon Mera Dil Madine Mein Hai Maut Aaye Dayaare Nabi Mein Mujhe Bas Yehi Ek Armaan Seene Mein Hai Jis Se Sharmaaye Khushbooe Baaghe Jinaa Woh Mahek Rooh Parwar Paseene Mein Hai Chahta Hoon Jo Naazir Madawa-E-Gham Woh Nabi Ki Mubarak Kareemi Mein Hai

১৭১

Ek Baar Madine Mein Ho Jaey Mera Jaana

Ek Baar Madine Mein, Ho Jaey Mere Jaana Phir Aur Na Kuch Maangein, Sarkaar Ka Diwana Pal Pal Mera Dil Tarpe, Din Raat Kare Zaaari Kab Aoun Madine Mein? Kab Aey Meri Baari? Kab Ja Ge Main Dekhoun Ga, Darbaar Woh Shahaana? Ek Baar Madine Mein Ho Jaey Mera Jaana Is Aas Par Jiita Houn, Ik Roz Bulaey Ge Aur Gunbad-E-Khazra Ka, Didar Karaein Ge Phir Pesh Karru Gaa Main, Ashiqo Bhara Nazrana Ek Baar Madine Mein Ho Jaey Mera Jaana Bechain Nighahon Ko Dedaar ‘ata Kar Do, Daman Mera Kuch Owse Yaa Shah-E-Ummam Barh Do Abad Khuda Rakhe Aaqa Tera Maikhana Ek Baar Madine Mein Ho Jaey Mera Jaana Itni Si Tamana Hai, Ho Jaey Agar Puuri Jaane Ko Madina Main, Ho Jaey Jo Manzuuri Bin Diide Ki Aey Shaahan, Mar Jaey Na Diwana Ek Baar Madina Mein Ho Jaey Mera Jaana Phir Aur Na Kuch Maange, Sarkaar Ka Diwaana

১৭২

Ek Khwab Sunawan

Ya Nabi Salam Alayk Ya Rasool Salam Alayk Ya Nabi Salam Alayk Ya Rasool Salam Alayk Salawa Tula Alayk Ya Rasool Salam Alayk Ya Nabi Salam Alayk Ya Habib Salam Alayk Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Purnoor Fiza Waa'n Aaqa Da Mohalla Jenu Arsh Nu Aala Kadi Aan Farishte Kadi Jaan Farishte Sade Azlon Jud Gaye Aaqa Nal Rishte Oh Karma'n Nal Weda Palkan Nal Chumda'n Jaawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Rab Le Gaya Menu Jado Shaher Madine Ek Haji Laya Menu Kut Ke Sine Kadi Piwan Zamzam Kadi Pada'n Namazan Meri Pahonch Jetho Tak Mein Deya Niyazan Rab Sohne Pal Wich Suneya Mere Dil Diya'n Sab Duawaan Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Aaqa Da Weda Palkan Di Dhari Dil Kare Guzara Othe Umar Mein Sari Kaabe De Chakkar Mein Le Paj Paj Ke Mein Hajre Aswad Chumeya Raj Raj Ke Mere Sir Te Rabb Ne Kitiya'n Rehmat Diya'n Thandiya'n Chhawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Oh Soniya'n Galiya'n Wich Rehmat Rabb Di Mera Aaqa Sohna Gal Sunda Sab Di Mere Amal Di Chadar Utte Daag Hazara'n Kis Maan Te Waaja'n Tere Karam Nu Maara'n Kede Munh Naal Bakhshish Manga Menu Aandhiya'n Baat Haya-Aa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Chup Reh Ke Begaya Roze De Nede Hoya Noor Da Channan Mere Dil De Wede Fir Supna Tuteya Oho Kachi Kulli Mein Ropeya Sa'dat Meri Akh Kyun Khulli Fir Aaqa Sadya Dar Te Hoiyan Dil Diya'n Puriya Chawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Purnoor Fiza Waa'n Aaqa Da Mohalla Jenu Arsh Nu Aala Kadi Aan Farishte Kadi Jaan Farishte Sade Azlon Jud Gaye Aaqa Nal Rishte Oh Karma'n Nal Weda Palkan Nal Chumda'n Jaawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n Ek Khwab Sunawa'n

১৭৩

Ek Main Hi Nahi Un Par Qurban Zamana Hai

Ek Main Hi Nahi Un Par Qurban Zamana Hai, Jo Rab E Do Aalam Ka Mahboob Yagana Hai. Kal Pul Say Hamein Jis Nay Khud Paar Lagana Hai, Zahra Ka Woh Baba Hai Hasnain Ka Nana Hai. Iss Hashmi Dulha Per Konain Ko Main Waroon, Jo Husn O Shumail Mein Yakta E Zamana Hai. Izzat Say Na Marjayein Kyun Naam E Muhammad Par, Youn Bhi Kisi Din Hum Ne Duniya Say Toh Jana Hai. Yoon Shah E Madina Ki Mein Pusht Panahi Mein, Kiya Iski Mujhe Parwah Dushman Jo Zamana Hai. Soh Bar Agar Tauba Tuti Bhi To Kiya Hairat, Bakhshih Ki Riwayat Mein Toba To Bahana Hai. Pur Noor Si Rahein Hain, Gunbad Pay Nigahein Hai, Jalwey Bhi Anokhay Hain, Manzar Bhi Suhana Hai. Yeh Keh Kay Dar E Haq Say Li Maut Mein Kuch Mohlat, Milad Ki Aamad Hai Mehfil Ko Sajana Hai. Aao Dar E Zahra Par Phalaye Hue Daman, Yeh Nasal Kareemon Ki Lajpal Gharana Hai. Qurban Us Aaqa Per Kal Hashr Ke Din Jisnay, Iss Ummat E Aasi Ko Kamli Mein Chupana Hai. Har Waqt Woh Hain Meri Duniya E Tasawar Mein, Aie Shoq Kahin Ab To Aana Hai Na Jana Hai. Hum Kyun Na Kahein Unsay Rodad E Alam Apni, Jab Unka Kaha Khud Bhi Allah Nay Mana Hai. Mehroom E Karam Is Ko Rakhiye Na Sar E Mehshar, Jaisa Hai Naseer Aakhir, Sahil Toh Purana Hai.

১৭৪

Ek Roz Hoga Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Me

Ek Roz Hoga Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Hoga Wahi Thikana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Aankhe Toh Dekhne Ko Pehle Hi Mujhtarib Thi Dil Bhi Hua Ravana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Kabhi Ho Hasi Tasawwur Kabhi Khud Jau Chalkar Rahe Yu Hi Aana Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Dil Me Nabi Ki Yaade Lab Par Nabi Ki Naate Jaana Toh Aise Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Go Paas Kuch Nahi Hai Lekin Yeh Dekh Lega Ek Din Hame Jamana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Kabhi Ho Khiza Pe Pehre Kabhi Do Ghadi Bahare Mausam Sada Suhana Sarkar Ki Gali Me Hain Kaheen Khazaan Ke Pehray Kaheen Do Gharhii Bahaaray Mosam Sadaa Suhana Sarkar Ke Gali Main Samajhen Ge Hum Niyazi Unki Karam Nawazi Jis Roz Hoga Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Me

১৭৫

Faaslaun Ko Takalluf Hai Hum Se Agar

Faaslaun Ko Takalluf Hai Hum Se Agar, Hum Bhi Bay Bus Nahi, Bay Sahara Nahi Khud Unhi Ko Pukarenge Hum Door Se, Raaste Me Agar Paoon Thak Jaenge Jaise Hi Sabz Gumbad Nazar Aega, Bandagi Ka Qareenah Badal Jaega Sar Jhuka Ne Ki Fursat Milegi Kise, Khud Hi Aankhaun Se Sajde Se Tapak Jaenge Hum Madine Me Tanha Nikal Jaenge, Aur Galiyaun Me Qasdan Bhatak Jaenge Hum Wahaan Jakay Wapas Nahi Aenge, Dhoond Te Dhoond Te Log Thak Jaenge Naam Unka Jahaan Bhi Liya Jaega, Zikr Unka Jahaan Bhi Kiya Jaega Noor Hi Noor Seenaun Me Bhar Jaega, Sari Mehfil Me Jalwe Lapak Jaenge Ai Madine Ke Zaer Khuda Ke Liye, Daastanay Safar Mujh Ko Yoon Mat Suna Dil Tadap Jaega, Baat Badh Jaegi, Mere Muhtaat Aansoon Chalak Jaenge Unki Chasme Karam Ko Hai, Iss Ki Khabar, Kis Musafir Ko Hai Kitna Shauqe Safar Hum Ko Iqbal Jab Bhi Ijazat Mili, Hum Bhi Aqa Ke Darbaar Tak Jaeng

১৭৬

Faisla Nabi Ka Hai Sunni Bakhshe Jaaenge

Faisla Nabi Ka Hai Sunni Bakhshe Jaaenge Garmiye Qayaamat Se Hum Najaat Paaenge Jitne Hai Adu Pyare Sarware Do Alam Ke Aatishe Jahannam Me Woh Jalaaye Jaaenge Noor Se Chamak Utthi Bil-Yaqeen Lahad Meri Qabr Me Mere Aaqa Muskuraate Aaenge Roze Hashr Kausar Ka Jaam Apni Ummat Ko Apne Daste Aqdas Se Mustafa Pilaate Jaaenge Inke Dar Pe Jaane Ka Gar Sharf Mila Hum Ko Naate Mustafa Nadim Hum Sunaate Jaenge.

১৭৭

Falak Ke Naazaro Zameen Ki Bahaaro

Falak Ke Naazaro Zameen Ki Bahaaro Sub Eidein Manao Huzoor Agaye Hain Uttho Gham Ke Maaro Chalo Bay Saharo Khabar Ye Sunao Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain Anokha Niraala Woh Zee Shaan Ayaa Woh Saray Rasoolaun Ka Sultan Ayaa Aray Kaj Kula'ho Aray Baadshaho Nigahein Jhukao Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain Huwaa Char Su Rahmataun Ka Ba'sayra Ujaala Ujaala' Sawera, Sawera Halima Ko Pohnchi Khabar Aaminah Ki Mere Ghar Main Aao, Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain Hawaun Mein Jazbaat Hain Marhaba Ke Fazaun Mein Naghmaat Salle'alla Ke Daroodaun Ke Gajrey, Salamaun Ke Tohfay Ghulamo Sajaao, Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain Sama Hai Sana E Habeeb E Khuda Ka Ye Meelad Hai Sarwaray Ambiya Ka Nabi Ke Gadao Sub Ek Doosre Ko Khabar Ye Sunao, Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain Kahaan Mai Zahuri Kahaan Unki Batein Karam Hi Karam Hain Ye Din Aur Ratein Jahaan Par Bhi Jaao Dilaun Ko Jagao Yahi Kehte Jaao, Huzoor Agaye Hain Huzoor Agaye Hain, Huzoor Agaye Hain

১৭৮

Farishtay Jis Kay Zaair Hain Madinay Main Woh Turbat Hay

Farishtay Jis Kay Zaair Hain Madinay Main Woh Turbat Hay Yeh Woh Turbat Hay Ji Ko Arsh E Azam Pur Fazeelat Hay! Bhala Dasht E Madinah Say Chaman Ko Koi Nisbat Hai Madinay Ki Fazaa Rashk E Bahaar E Baagh E Jannat Hai. Madinah Gar Salamat Hay To Phir Sab Kuch Salamat Hai Khuda Rakhay Madinay Ko, Issi Ka Damm Ghaneemat Hai. Madinah Aisa Gulshan Hai Jo Har Gulshan Ki Zeenat Hai Bahaar E Baagh E Jannat Bhi Madinay Ki Ba-Dawlat Hai. Madinah Chor Kar Sayr E Jinaa(N) Ki Kya Zaroorat Hai Yeh Jannat Say Bhi Behter Hai Yeh Jeete Jee Ki Jannat Hai. Humee(N) Kya Haqq Ta'aala Ko Madinay Say Muhabbat Hai Madinay Say Muhabbat Un Say Ulfat Ki `alaamat Hai! Ilahi!! Woh Madinay Kaisi Basti Hay Dikhaa-Dayna Jahaa(N) Rahmat Barasti Hay Jahaa(N) Rahmat Hi Rahmat Hay. Madinah Chor Kar Jannat Ki Khushboo Mil Nahi(N) Sakti Madinay Say Mahabbat Hay To Jannat Ki Zamanat Hay. Zamee(N) Pur Woh Muhammad Hain, Woh Ahmad Asmaano(N) Main Yahaa(N) Bhi Un Ka Charcha Hay - Wahaa(N) Bhi Un Ki Midhat Hay. Yahaa(N) Bhi Un Ki Chalti Hay, Wahan Bhi Un Ki Chalti Hay Madinah Raajdhaani Hay Do `aaalam Pur Hukoomat Hay! Ghazab Hi Kardiya Akhtar, Madinay Say Chalay Aa'aey Yeh Woh Jannat Hay Jis Ki `arsh Waalo(N) Ko Bhi Hasrat Hay. Madinah Chor Kar Akhtar Bhala Kyu(N) Jaa'ayn Jannat Ko Yeh Jannat Kya Har Ik Ni`mat Madinay Ki Ba-Dawlat Hay.

১৭৯

Farsh Pe Reh Kar Arsh Pe Jaana

Farsh Pe Reh Kar Arsh Pe Jaana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Jaa Ke Khuda Ko Dekh Ke Aana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Fakhr Se Boli Dai Haleema Godh Me Le Kar Aaqa Ko Aamina Bi Ke Laal Ko Paana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Eezaa Sehkar Haste Haste Bole Bilal Aaqa Se Yoon Ishq E Nabi Me Kode Khaana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Kar Ke Ishaara Mere Nabi Ne Chand Ke Tukde Farmaya Dooba Suraj Ko Paltana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Jaane Mubarak Ko Khatre Me Daal Ke Ishq E Ahmed Me Saap Ke Bil Me Edi Rakhna Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Mera Alauddin Hai Saabir Bole Sab Se Baba Fareed Bhooka Reh Kar Khana Khilana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Yoon To Taranum Ke Maahir Hai Laakhon Shakir Duniya Me Jhoom Ke Aisi Naat Sunana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai -------------------------------- ------------- More ------------- ------------ Verses ------------ -------------------------------- Mutthi Me Abu Jahel Ke Kiya Hai Kon Ye Gaib Bataye Ga Kankar Se Kalma Padhwana Sab Ke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Jaao Dhondo Aur Kisi Ko Sub Nabiyo Ne Farmaya Ummat Ko Daman Me Chupana Sub Ke Bus Ki Baat Nahi Charo Taraf Hai Deen Ke Dushman Beech Me Mere Aaqa Hai Aise Me Islam Bachana Sub Ke Bus Ki Baat Nahi Jinpar Khas Karam Wo Karde Wohi To Bazm Sajate Hai Naat-E-Nabi Ka Sunna Sunana Sub Ke Bus Ki Baat Nahi Yu Tu Jahaan Mein Peer Bahut Hain Aye Barkati Diwano Mera Raza Ka Murshid Hona Sabke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Charu Taraf The Deen K Doshman Bich Mein Tanha Mera Raza Aise Mein Islaam Ko Bachana Sabke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai Hafiz O Qari Aalim O Mufti Har Koi Ban Sakta Hai Mufti E Aazam Banke Dikhana Sabke Bas Ki Baat Nahi Hai

১৮০

Fauze Ghum Ki Baraa Bar Chadhayi Hai

Fauze Ghum Ki Baraa Bar Chadhayi Hai Dafa E Ghum Tumhari Duhayi Hai Umr Khelo(N) Me Humne Gawayi Hai Umr Bhar Ki Yahi To Kamayi Hai Tumne Kab Aankh Humko Dikhayi Hai Tumne Kab Aankh Humse Firayi Hai Tu Khuda Ka Huwa Aur Khuda Tera Tere Qabze Me Saari Khudayi Hai Jab Khuda Khud Tumhara Huwa To Fir Kaun Si Cheez Hai Jo Parayi Hai Ambiya(N) Ko Rasaayi Mili Tum Tak Bass Tumhari Khuda Tak Rasaayi Hai Mera Beda Kinare Lage Pyare Nuuh Ki Naa(N)v Kisne Tirayi Hai Aagh Ko Baagh Kisne Kiya Pyare Tum Ne Tumne Hi Qudrat Ye Paayi Hai Kaash Wo Hashr Ke Din Kahe Mujhse Naare Douzakh Se Tujhko Rihaayi Hai Taybah Jau Waha Se Na Wapas Aau Mere Jee Me To Abb Ye Samayi Hai Shouqe Deedaar E Noori Me Ay Noori Rukh Kheench Kar Abb Aankhon Me Aayi Hai

১৮১

Fazle Rabbul Ula Aur Kya Chahiye

Fazle Rabbul Ula Aur Kya Chahiye Mil Gaye Mustafa Aur Kya Chahiye Daamane Mustafa Jis Ke Haathon Mein Hai Us Ko Roz E Jazaa Aur Kya Chahiye Unke Darbaar Me Haaziri Hogai Mil Gaya Mudda'a Aur Kya Chahiye Bheek Dekar Mujhe Mere Sarkaar Ne Muskura Kar Kaha Aur Kya Chahiye Gumbade Sabz Khwabon Mein Aane Laga Haazri Ka Silaa Aur Kya Chahiye Bheek Ke Saath Hi Un Ke Darbaar Se Mil Rahi Hai Dua Aur Kya Chahiye Ye Jabeen Aur Riyaaz Ul Jannah Ki Zameen Ab Qaza Ke Siwa Aur Kya Chahiye Hai Sikandar Sana Khwaan Shaahe Umam Izzato Martaba Aur Kya Chahiye ************************************ **********other Version************* Fazl E Rab Ul Ula Aur Kya Chahiye Mil Gaye Mustafa Aur Kya Chahiye Mere Sar Ko Haram Ki Fazaa Chahiye Mere Dil Ko Dar E Mustafa Chahiye Manzile Saari Aasaan Ho Jaye Gi Ya Nabi Aap Ka Aasra Chahiye Chup Khara Mein Raha Aur Wo Kehte Rahe Maanglo Maanglo Aur Kya Chahiye Pooch Ne Aagaye Mujh Ko Mere Huzoor Isse Bar Ke Mujhe Aur Kya Chahiye Waqt E Aakhar Zahoori Mehek Jaaye Ge Un Ke Daaman Ki Thandi Hawaa Chahiye

১৮২

Fida Kar Ishq E Nabi Par Jaan

Fida Kar Ishq-E-Nabi Par Jaan Muqammal Karle Tu Iman Zamana Yaad Karega Jab Yaad Nabi Ki Aati Hai Ik Kaif Sa Aalam Hota Hai Jab Zikre Nabi Chhid Jata Hai Ik Wajd Ka Mosam Hota Hai Yahi To Kahta Hai Qur'an Ke Aaqa Hai Jaan-E-Iman Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega Sarkar Se Tu Hai Door Magar Sarkar To Tujh Se Door Nahi Kyu Khoya Khoya Rehta Hai Mukhtar Hai Tu Majboor Nahi Nabi Ko Pahle Dil Se Maan, Nabi Par Sab Kuch Kar Qurbaan Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega Aslaf Ki Hai Taarikh Yahi Sahil Pe Jala Di Hai Kashtee Daudaye Hain Ghode Dariya Par Kya Ishq-E-Nabi Ki Masti Thi Tumhi Ho Wo Mard-E-Maidan Zara Dhundo Apni Pahchan Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega Sarkar Ke Jalwo Se Raushan Iman-O-Amal Ki Duniya Hai Sarkar Ke Deewano Ki Sada Taqleed Zamana Krta Hai Nabi Ka Dekh Zara Faizaan Ki Taza Ho Jaye Iman Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega Darbare Wilayat Kya Kehna Jab Unka Ishara Milta Hai Baarah Barso Ki Doobi Kashti Ko Ik Pal Me Kinara Milta Hai Asad Ye Ghaus Ka Hai Faizan Hai Jis Se Fikr-O-Nazar Hairan Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega Jo Baat Thi Aa'la Hazrat Ki Wo Aaj Kisi Molwi Me Nahi Wo Ishq-E-Nabi Ke Paikar The, Tharrate The Unse Dushman Bhi Diya Humko Kanzul Iman Ye Hai Hum Par Unka Ehsaan Zamana Yaad Karega Zamana Yaad Karega

১৮৩

Fir Utha Walwala E Yaade Mugilaane Arab

Phir Utha Walwala-E-Yaad-E-Mugheelaan-E-Arab, Phir Khincha Daaman-E-Dil Sooye Bayaabaan-E-Arab. Bagh-E-Firdous Ko Jaate Hain Haazaaraan-E-Arab, Haaye Sehra-E-Arab Haaye Bayaabaan-E-Arab. Meethi Baatein Teri Deen-E-Ajam Imaan-E-Arab, Namkeen Husn Tera Jaan-E-Ajam Shaan-E-Arab. Ab To Hay Girya-E- Khoon Gauhar-E-Daamaan-E-Arab, Jismein Do La’al The Zahra Key Woh Thee Kaan-E-Arab. Dil Wohi Dil Hay Jo Aankhon Sey Ho Hairaan-E-Arab, Aankhein Wo Aankhein Hain Jo Dil Sey Hon Qurbaan-E-Arab. Haaye Kis Waqt Lagi Phaans Alam Ki Dil Mein, Ke Bohot Door Rahe Khaar-E-Mugheelan-E-Arab. Fasl-E-Gul Lakh Na Ho Wasl Ki Rakh Aas Hazaar, Phoolte Phalte Hain Be Fasl Gulistaan-E-Arab. Sadqe Hone Ko Chale Aate Hain Laakhon Gulzaar, Kuch Ajab Rang Sey Phoola Hay Gulistaan-E-Arab. Andaleebi Pe Jagharte Hain Kate Marte Hain, Gul-O-Bulbul Ko Laraata Hay Gulistaan-E-Arab. Sadqe Rahmat Key Kahaan Phool Kahaan Khaar Ka Kaam, Khud Hay Daaman Kash-E-Bulbul Gul-E-Khandaan-Arab. Shaadi-E-Hashr Hay Sadqe Mein Chutenge Qaidi, Arsh Par Dhoom Sey Hay Daawat-E-Mehmaan-E-Arab. Charche Hote Hain Ye Kamhlaaye Huey Phoolon Mein, Kyoon Ye Din Dekhte Paate Jo Biyabaan-E-Arab. Tere Be Daam Key Bande Hain Raeesaan-E-Ajam, Tere Be Daam Key Bandi Hain Haazaaraan-E-Arab. Hasht-E- Khuld Aayein Wahan Kasb-E-Latafat Ko Raza, Chaar Din Barse Jahan Abr-E-Bahaaran-E-Arab.

১৮৪

Firaaq E Madinah Mein Dil Ghamzada Hai

Firaaq-E-Madinah Mein Dil Ghamzada Hai, Jigar Tukray Tukray Hua Ja Raha Hai. Chura Kar Madinah Mera Chain Cheena, Bata Nafs-E-Zalim Tujhe Kia Mila Hai. Meri Aankh Se Cheena Taiba Ka Manzar, Yeh Kis Baat Ka Tu Ne Badla Lia Hai. Sikhaya Hai Phir Yeh Muqaddar Ne Mujh Ko, Na Shikwa Kisi Se Na Koi Gila Hai. Rahoon Bus Isi Ghum Mein Bay Chain Sarwar, Muqaddar Ne Jo Daagh-E-Furqat Dia Hai. Muqaddar Se Jis Ja Rahoon Per Shaha Ho, Nazar Mein Madinah Meri Iltija Hai. Mere Dil Kay Armaan Rahe Dil Hi Dil Mein, Yehi Ghum Mere Dil Ko Tarpa Raha Hai. Sukoon Tha Mujhe Koocha-E-Mustafa Mein, Watan Mein Mera Sub Sukoon Lut Gaya Hai. Na Dunya Ki Fikrain Na Ghum Tha Wahan Per, Yahan Aa Kar Dil Aafaton Mein Phansa Hai. Na Chootay Mere Haath Se Un Ka Daaman, Jiyun Jab Talak Ya Khuda Yeh Dua Hai. Mein Lafzon Mein Kaise Bata Doon Kisi Ko, Kay Kia Kia Mujhe Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Paharon Ki Dilkash Sitaron Kay Jalway, Woh Manzar Mujhe Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Unhe Choomna Haath Lehra Kay Paiham, Woh Lamha Mujhe Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Aqeedat Se Khaak-E-Madinah Utha Kar, Use Choomna Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Kabhi Deed-E-Sarwar Ki Hasrat Mein Minbar, Ko Takna Woh Chup Chup Kay Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Haseeno Jamil Piyaari Woh Jannat Ki Kiyari, Wahan Baithna Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai. Kabhi Dekh Kar Subz Gumbad Ka Manzar, Jhukana Nazar Aaj Yaad Aa Raha Hai.

১৮৫

Furqate Taiba Ki Wahshat Dil Se Jaaye Khair Se

Furqate Taiba Ki Wahshat Dil Se Jaaye Khair Se Mai Madine Ko Chalu Wo Din Phir Aaye Khair Se Dil Mein Hasrat Koi Baaki Reh Na Jaaye Khair Se Raahe Taiba Mein Mujhe Yoon Maut Aaye Kahir Se Mere Din Phir Jaaye Ya Rab Shab Wo Aaye Khair Se Dil Me Jab Maahe Madina Ghar Banaaye Khair Se Raat Meri Din Bane Unki Baqaaye Khair Se Qabr Me Jab Unki Tal’at Jagmagaaye Khair Se Wo Khiraame Naaz Farmaaye Jo Paaye Khair Se Kya Bayaan Woh Zindagi Ho Dil Jo Paaye Khair Se Hai Ghani Ke Dar Pe Hum Bistar Jamaaye Khair Se Khair Ke Taalib Kaha Jaaenge Jaaye Khair Se Mar Ke Bhi Dil Se Na Jaaye Ulfate Baage Nabi Khuld Me Bhi Baag Janaa Yaad Aaye Khair Se Ranjo Gham Hon Be Nishaan Aaye Bahaare Be Khizaa Mere Dil Me Baage Janaa Ki Hawaaye Khair Se Is Taraf Bhi Do Qadam Jalwe Khiraam Naaz Ke Reh Guzar Me Hum Bi Hain Aankhen Bichaaye Khair Se Ho Mujhe Seere Gulistaane Madina Yoon Naseeb Main Bahaaron Me Chalu Khud Ko Gumaaye Khair Se Zindabaad Aye Aarzooye Baaghe Taiba Zindabaad Tere Dum Se Hai Zamaane Ke Sataaye Khair Se Jhanhk Lo Aankhon Me Unki Hasrate Taiba Liye Zaaire Taiba Ziyaae Taiba Laaye Khair Se Najdiyo Ki Cheera Dasti Ya Ilaahi Tabake Ye Balaaye Najd Ye Taiba Se Jaaye Khair Se Hai Ye Taiba Ka Payame Taalibe Aaishe Dawaam Jannate Taiba Me Aahistee Mitaaye Khair Se Sange Dar Se Aa Mile Taiba Me Ab To Jaa Mile Aa Gaye Dar Pe Tere Tere Dar Pe Bulaaye Khair Se Gosh Bar Aawaaz Hu Qudsi Bhi Is Ke Geet Par Baaghe Taiba Me Jab Akhtar Gungunaaye Khair Se
