Gali Hondi Madine Di Turran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda Je Baagh Honde Kajjhian De Phirran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda Eh Seena Jaali Naal Honda Sabz Gumbad Di Chaan Hondi Assan Muddatan De Sarreyaan Noon Tharran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda Kadi Je Deed Mil Jawndi Ohde Mazaagh Nainaan Di Main Dubda Roz Chup Kar Ke Tarran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda Eh Kund Walail Zulfa Da Hatta Chadde Je Mukhre Ton Deedar-E-Mustafa Yaaro Karann Da Taan Mazza Awnda Gali Hondi Madine Di Turran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda Je Baagh Honde Kajjhian De Phirran Da Taan Mazaa Awnda

১৮৭

Gar Talab Se Bhi Kuch Ma Siwa Chahiye

Gar Talab Se Bhi Kuch Ma Siwa Chahiye Unka Daaman Nahi Chhorna Chahiye Dil Ko Deed E Rukh E Mustafa Chahiye Aainey Ke Liye Aaina Chahiye Haath Mein Daamane Mustafa Agaya Ik Gunnahgar Ko Aur Kiya Chahiye Le Chalo Ab Madine Ko Jaga Karo Mujhko Tayba Ki Aab O Hawa Chahyey Tum Mile To Do Aalam Ki Daoulat Mili Is Se Barh Kar Humain Orr Kiya Chahyey Naimatain Donon Aalam Ki Dekar Mujhay Puchtay Hain Bata Orr Kiya Chahyey Saamnay Sarwar E Do Jahan Agaye Hashr Mein Orr Bismil Ko Kiya Chahyey Gar Talab Se Bhi Kuch Ma Siwa Chahiye Un Ka Daman Nahi Chorna Chahiye

১৮৮

Gham Ho Gaye Beshumar Aaqa Banda Tere Nisaar Aaqa

Gham Ho Gaye Beshumar Aaqa Banda Tere Nisaar Aaqa Bigda Jaata Hai Khel Ye Mera Aaqa Aaqa Sawaar Aaqa Manjhdaar Pe Aake Naav Tooti De Haath Ki Hu Main Paar Aaqa Tooti Jaati Hai Peeth Ye Meri Lillah Ye Bojh Utaar Aaqa Majboor Hai Hum To Fikr Kya Hai Tumko To Hai Ikhtiyaar Aaqa Main Door Hu Tum To Ho Mere Paas Sun Lo Meri Pukaar Aaqa Mujhsa Koi Ghamzada Na Hoga Tumsa Nahi Gham Gusaar Aaqa Girdaab Me Padh Gayi Hai Kashti Dooba Dooba, Utaar Aaqa Halka Hai Agar Hamara Palla Bhari Hai Tera Viquar Aqa Tum Woh Ki Karam Ko Naaz Tum Se Main Woh Ki Badi Ko Aar Aaqa Phir Muh Na Pade Kabhi Khaza Ka De De Aisi Bahaar Aaqa Jiski Marzi Khuda Na Taale Mera Hai Woh Naamdaar Aaqa Hai Mulke Khuda Pe Jis Ka Qabza Mera Hai Woh Kaamgaar Aaqa Soya Kiye Nabakaar Bande Roya Kiye Zaar Zaar Aaqa Kya Bhool Hai Inke Hote Kehlaaye Duniya Ke Ye Tajdaar Aaqa Unke Adna Gada Pe Mit Jaaye Aise Aise Hazaar Aaqa. Be Abre Karam Ke Mere Dhabbe La Tagsilul Bihaar Aaqa Itni Rehmat Raza Pe Kar Lo La Taqrubuhul Bawaar Aaqa.

১৮৯

Ghame Hijre Musftafa Mein Meri Jaan Sulag Rahi Hai

Ghame Hijre Musftafa Mein Meri Jaan Sulag Rahi Hai Kabhi Unki Ho Ziyarat Yahi Loh Lagi Hui Hai Teri Yaad Mera Imaan Tera Zikr Zindagi Hai Muje Dard Se Nawaza Teri Banda Parwari Hai Mein Chala Hun Apne Ghar Se Yahi Soch Kar Madine Mera Kam Justaju Hai Tera Kam Rahbari Hai Na Hua Hai Koi Tujsa Na Jahan Mein Koi Hoga Tu Habibe Kibriya Hai Tuje Zaib Sarwari Hai Muje Aye Fida Yakin Hai Kabhi Deed Unki Hogi Mera Dil Tadap Raha Hai Meri Aankh Mein Nami Hai Ghame Hijre Musftafa Mein Meri Jaan Sulag Rahi Hai Kabhi Unki Ho Ziyarat Yahi Loh Lagi Hui Hai

১৯০

Ghamzado Ki Sadaa Sunlo Aaqa Mere

Ghamzado Ki Sadaa Sunlo Aaqa Mere Ek Nigah E Karam Kardo Aaqa Mere Daag Seeney Ki Kis Ko Dikhaaye Huzoor Phir Ilaaj E Jigar Kardo Aaqa Mere Tishnagi ‘ilm Ki Roz Badhti Rahe ‘ilm E Naaf’e ‘ataa Kardo Aaqa Mere Dil Ki Dharkan Se Aaye Sadaa E Durood Kaif Aisa ‘ataa Kardo Aaqa Mere Phir Chalaa Hoon Madine Se Rota Huwa Rabbe Sallim Du’a Kardo Aaqa Mere Izzat E Haazri Mujh Ko Milti Rahe Izn E Daayim ‘ataa Kardo Aaqa Mere Haazir E Dar Huwa Shakir E Be Nawaa Ma’af Jurm O Khataa Kardo Aaqa Mere Saa-Il E Dar Huwa Shakir E Be Nawaa Daaman E ‘aasiyan Bhardo Aaqa Mere

১৯১

Ghulamo Ko Madine Me Bulana Ya Rasool Allah

Ghulamo Ko Madine Me Bulana Ya Rasool Allah Tumhi Ho Be-Thikano Ka Thikana Ya Rasool Allah Karam Se Paas Bulwa Kar Kaleja Kijiye Thanda Judai Ke Sitam Kab Tak Uthana Ya Rasool Allah Kisi Hile Bahane Se Dikha Do Chaand Si Surat Kaha Tak Aankh Se Aansu Bahana Ya Rasool Allah Irada Dil Ka Pura Ho Tamanna Dil Ki Puri Ho Dua Abke Meri Khali Na Jana Ya Rasool Allah Safar Ab Ke Baras Humko Mayasar Ho Madine Ka Kaha Tak Dil Ko Samjhana Manana Ya Rasool Allah Tere Kehla Ke Yu Bekal Rahoon Dar Dar Phiroon Kab Tak Bas Ab Nazdeek Khadmo Ke Bulana Ya Rasool Allah Khuda Ka Wasta Aur Fatima Hasnain Ka Sadkha Madina Jald Shayiq Ko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah Madina Jald Hum Sab Ko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah

১৯২

Gunahgaaron Ko Haatif Se Naveede Khush Maaali Hai

Gunahgaaron Ko Haatif Se Naveede Khush Ma-Aali Hai Mubarak Ho Shafa'at Ke Liye Ahmed Sa Waali Hai Qazaa Haq Hai Magar Is Shauq Ka Allah Waali Hai Jo Un Ki Raah Mein Jaaye Woh Jaan Allah Waali Hai Tera Qadde Mubarak Gulbune Rehmat Ki Daali Hai Ise Bo Kar Tere Rab Ne Bina Rehmat Ki Daali Hai Tumhari Sharm Se Shaane Jalaali Haq Tapakti Hai Khame Gardan Hilaale Aasmaane Zul Jalaali Hai Zahe Khud Gum Ho Gum Hone Pe Yeh Dhoonde Ki Kya Paaya Are Jab Tak Ki Paana Hai Jabhi Tak Haath Khaali Hai Main Ik Mohtaaj Be Waq-At Gada Tere Sage Dar Ka Teri Sarkaar Waala Hai Tera Darbaar Aali Hai Teri Bakhshish Pasandi, Uzr Jooee, Tauba Khwahi Se Umoome Be Gunaahi, Jurm Shaane Laa Ubaali Hai Abu Bakro Umar Usmano Haidar Jis Ke Bulbul Hain Tera Sarve Sahee Us Gulbune Khoobi Ki Daali Hai Raza Qismat Hi Khul Jaaye Jo Gilaa(N) Se Khitaab Aaye Ki Tu Adna Sage Dargaahe Khuddaame Ma-Aali Hai

১৯৩

Guzre Jis Raah Se Woh Sayyide Wala Hokar

Guzre Jis Raah Se Woh Sayyide Wala Hokar Reh Gayi Saari Zamee(N) Ambare Saara Hokar Rukhe Anwar Ki Tajalli Jo Qamar Ne Dekhi Reh Gaya Bosa Dahe Nakshe Kafe Pa Hokar Waye Mehroomiye Qismat Ki Main Phir Ab Ki Baras Reh Gaya Hum-Rahe Zawware Madina Hokar Chamane Taiba Hai Woh Baagh Ki Murge Sidra Barso Chahke Hain Jaha Bulbule Shaida Hokar Sar-Sare Dashte Madina Ka Magar Aaya Khayaal Rashke Gulshan Jo Bana Gunchaye Dil Waa Hokar Goshe Shah Kehte Hain Fariyaad Rasi Ko Hum Hain Wa’daye Chashm Hai Bakhshaenge Goya Hokar Paaye Shah Pe Gire Ya Rab Tapushe Mehar Se Jab Dil Betab Ude Hashr Mein Para Hokar Hai Ye Ummeed Raza Ko Teri Rehmat Se Shaha Na Go Zindaaniye Dozakh Tera Banda Hokar

১৯৪

Haajiyo Aao Shahenshah Ka Roza Dekho

Haajiyo Aao Shahenshah Ka Roza Dekho Kaaba To Dekh Chuke Kaabe Ka Kaaba Dekho Rukn E Shaami Se Miti Wah'shate Shaame Ghurbat Ab Madine Ko Chalo Subhe Dil Aaraa Dekho Aabe Zam-Zam To Piyaa Khoob Bujhaa-Ee Pyaase Aao Joode Shahe Kowsar Ka Bi Darya Dekho Zayre Mizaab Mile Khoob Karamke Cheente Abre Rehmat Ka Yaha Zowr Barasnaa Dekho Dhoom Dekhi Hai Dare Kaaba Pe Betaabo Ki Unke Mushtako Me Hasrat Ka Tadapna Dekho Misle Parwana Phiri Karte The Jis Sham'a Ke Gird Apni Uss Sham'a Ko Parwana Yaha Ka Dekho Khoob Aankho Se Lagaaya He Gilaafe Kaaba Qasre Mehboob Ke Parde Ka Bhi Jalwa Dekho Wa(N) Mutiyo Ka Jigar Khauf Se Pani Paaya Ya(N) Siyahkaaro Ka Daaman Pe Machalna Dekho Awwali Khana E Haq Ki To Ziyaye Dekhi Aakhri Bait E Nabi Ka Bhi Tajalla Dekho Jinte Kaaba Me Tha Laakh Aruso Ka Banav Jalwa-Farma Yaha Kaunain Ka Dulha Dekho Aymane Tur Ka Tha Rukne Yamani Me Farog Shola E Tur Yaha Anjuman-Aara Dekho Mehre Madar Ka Maza Deti Hai Aagosh E Hateem Jin Pe Maa Baap Fida Ya(N) Karam Unka Dekho Kar Chuki Rif'ate Kaaba Pe Nazar Par-Vaze Topi Ab Thaam Ke Khaaq E Dar E Wala Dekho Be-Niyazi Se Waha Kaapti Payi Ta'at Joshe Rehmat Pe Yaha Naaz Gunah Ka Dekho Multazim Se To Gale Lag Ke Nikale Armaan Adab O Shouq Ka Yaha Baham Ulajhna Dekho Khoob Mas'a Me B-Ummide Safa Daud Liye Rahe Jana(N) Ki Safaka Bhi Tamasha Dekho Zeenate Kaaba Me Tha Laakh Arooso Ka Banaw Jalwa Farma Yaha Kownain Ka Doolhaa Dekho Dho Chuka Zulmate Dil Bosaa-E Sunge Aswad Khaak Bosi-E-Madina Ka Bhi Rutbaa Dekho Jum'ma-E Makkah Tha Eid, Ahle Ibaadat Keliye Mujrimo! Aawo Yaha Eide Do Shamba Dekho Raqse Bismilki Bahaare To Minaa Me Dekhi Dil Khonaa Be Fishaa Ka Bhi Tarapna Dekho Gowr Se Sun To Raza Kaaba Se Aati He Sadaa Meri Aankho Se Mere Pyaare Ka Rozaa Dekho

১৯৫

Haale Dil Kisko Sunae Aap Ke Hote Hue

Haale Dil Kisko Sunae Aap Ke Hote Hue Kyu Kisi Ke Dar Pe Jaayen Aap Ke Hote Hue Mein Gulame Mustafa Hu Ye Meri Pehchan Hai Gham Muje Kyun Kar Satayen Aap Ke Hote Hue Apna Jeena Apna Marna Ab Isi Chokhat Pe Hai Ham Kaha Sarkar Jaayen Aap Ke Hote Hue Keh Raha Hai Aapka Rabb Ant Fihim Aap See Kyu Inhe Mein Dun Sazaen Aap Ke Hote Hue Samne Hai Aye Ali Ke Laal Usvaa Apka Kyu Kisi Ka Khauf Khayen Aap Ke Hote Hue Mein Ye Kaise Maan Jaoon Sham Ke Darbar Mein Chhin Le Koi Ridayen Aap Ke Hote Hue Ye To Ho Sakta Nahin Ye Baat Munkin Hi Nahi Mere Ghar Alam Aae Aap Ke Hote Hu Kaun Hai Altaf Apna Haale Dil Jis Se Kahe Zakhme Dil Kis Ko Dikhae Aap Ke Hote Hu

১৯৬

Habib E Khuda Ka Nazaara Karoon Mein

Habib-E-Khuda Ka Nazaara Karoon Mein Dil-O-Jaan Un Par Nisaara Karoon Mein Teri Kakshe Pa Yu Savaara Karoon Mein Ke Palko Se Usko Buhaara Karoon Mein Mera Deen-O-Iman Farishte Jo Puche Tumhari Hi Janib Ishaara Karoon Mein Tere Naam Par Sar Ko Qurbaan Karke Tere Sar Se Sadqe Utaara Karoon Mein Yeh Ek Jaan Kiya Hai Agar Ho Karoron Tere Naam Par Sab Ko Wara Karoon Mein Tere Dar Ke Hote Kahan Jawoon Pyare Kahan Apna Daaman Pasaaraa Karoon Mein Salasil Masaib Ke Abru Se Kato Kaha Tak Masaib Gavara Karu Mai Teri Rehmate Aam Hai Phir Bhi Pyare Ye Fadmate Furqat Sahara Karu Mai Khuda Khair Se Laye Wo Din Bhi Noori Madine Ki Galiya Bulaara Karoon Mein Mein Kiyu Ghair Ki Thokre Khane Jao Tere Dar Se Apna Guzaara Karoon Mein Dam-E-Wapsi Tak Tere Geet Gau Muhammad Muhammad Pukara Karoon Mein Tera Zikr Lab Par Khuda Dil Ke Andar Yuhi Zindagani Guzaara Karoon Mein Khudara Ab Aawo Ke Dam Hai Labo Par Dame Wapasi To Nazaara Karoon Mein Mujhe Apni Rehmat Se To Apna Karle Siwa Tere Sab Se Kinaaraa Karoon Mein Khudaa Aisi Kuwat De Mere Qalam Mein Ke Bad-Mazhabon Ko Sudhaaraa Karoon Mein

১৯৭

Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah

Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah Talib Ka Pata Matloob Ko Hai Matloob Hai Talib Se Wakif Parde Mein Bula Kar Mil Bhi Liye Parda Bhi Raha Subhanallah Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah Hairaan Hue Barq Aur Nazar Ik Aan Hai Aur Barso Ka Safar Raakib Ne Kaha Allahu Ghani Markab Ne Kaha Subhanallah Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah Hai Abd Kaha Ma’bood Kaha Meraj Ki Shab Hai Raaze Nihaa Woh Noor Hijaabe Noor Mein The Khud Rab Ne Kaha Subhanallah Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah Samjhe Hamid Insaani Kya Ye Raaz Hai Husn O Ulfat Ke Khaliq Ka Habibi Kehna Tha Khalqat Ne Kaha Subhanallah Hai Arshe Bari Par Jalwa Figan Mehboobe Khuda Subhanallah

১৯৮

Hai Kalaam E Ilahi Me Shamsuz Zuha

Hai Kalaam E Ilahi Me Shamsuz'zuha, Tere Chehr E Noor E Faza Ki Qasam Qasam E Shab E Taar Me Raaz Yeh Tha, Ke Habeeb Ki Zulfe Duta Ki Qasam Woh Khuda Ne Hai Martaba Tujh Ko Diya, Na Kisi Ko Mile Na Kisi Ko Mila Ke Kalaam E Majeed Ne Khaee Shaha, Tere Shehro Kalamo Baqa Ki Qasam Tera Masnade Naaz Hai Arshe Baree, Tera Mehrame Raaz Hai Rooh E Ameen Tu Hi Sarware Har Do Jahaan Hai Shaha, Tera Misl Nahi Hai Khuda Ki Qasam Yehi 'arz Hai Khaliq E Ard O Sama, Woh Rasool Hai Tera, Mai Bandah Tera Mujhe Unki Jawaar Me Day Woh Jagah, Ke Hai Khuld Ko Jiski Safa Ki Qasam Tu Hi Bandaun Pa Karta Hai Lutf O 'ata, Tujhi Pe Bharosa Hai Tujhi Se Dua Mujhe Jalwah E Pak Rasool Dikha, Tujhe Apne Hi Izz O 'ala Ki Qasam Mere Gar Chay Gunah Hai Had Se Siwa, Magar Un Se Ummed Hai Tujh Se Rija Tu Raheem Hai Unka Karam Hai, Gawah Woh Kareem Hai Teri 'ata Ki Qasam Tere Khulq Ko Haq Ne Azeem Kaha, Teri Khilq Ko Haq Ne Jameel Kiya Koee Tujh Sa Huwa Hai Na Hoga Shaha, Tere Khaliqe Husn O Ada Ki Qasam Yehi Kehti Hai Bulbule Baagh E Jina, Ke Raza Ki Tarha Koee Sehre Bayaan Nahi Hind Me Wasif Shahe Huda, Mujhe Shaukhe Tabae Raza Ki Qasam

১৯৯

Hai Karam Aap Ka Sarkaar Rasool E Arabi

Hai Karam Aap Ka Sarkaar Rasool E ‘arabi Phir Dikhaaya Mujhe Darbaar Rasool E ‘arabi Aise ‘aasee Ko Banaaya Madine Ka Mehmaan Jo Hai Sartaapa Khataakaar Rasool E ‘arabi Bhardo Aaqa Mere Aaqa Meri Jholi Bhardo Main Bhi Hoon Haazir E Darbaar Rasool E ‘arabi Sadqa Hasnain Ka Dedo Mere Aaqa Mujh Ko Main Karam Ka Hoon Talabgaar Rasool E ‘arabi Waasta Pyaare Raza Ka Tumhe Detaa Hoon Shahaa Apna Kehdo Sag E Darbaar Rasool E ‘arabi Arz E Shakir Mere Aaqa Hai Yeh Waqt E Rukhsat Phir Dikhaana Mujhe Darbaar Rasool E ‘arabi

২০০

Hai Yehi Qahesh Ke Raat Din Likhta Rahu Naat E Mustafa

Hai Yehi Qahesh Ke Raat Din Likhta Rahu Naat-E-Mustafa Isse Badkar Aur Kiya Hogi Aata-E-Mustafa Sajate Raho Mahafil Aqidat Se Aur Mohabbat Se Phir Jald Hogi Mahafil Me Amad-E-Mustafa Wala Soufa Yuu Tika Rabbuka Fatarza Kaha Hai Quraan Me Rab Ne Dekho Khuda Bhi Chahta Hai Raza-E-Mustafa Chale The Farooq Khatl-E-Huzoor Ke Liye Badal Diye Irada Jab Dekha Chehra-E-Mustafa Padte Raho Durood-O-Salam Aqa-E-Do Jahan Par Yaqinan Hogi Wajib Shafaat-E-Mustafa Karde Moula Ab Fazlo Karam Jaber Pe Take Ye Bhi Ban Jaye Aashiq-E-Mustafa (Ameen Ya Allah) (Ameen Ya Allah)

২০১

Haleema Main Tere Muqaddran To Sadqay

Haleema Main Tere Muqaddran To Sadqay Tu Madani Da Jhoola Jhulendi Wee Hosay Wo Sohden Da Mukhda Noorani Noorani Tu Takdee Tey Raiyan Choomedee Wee Hosay Mohabbat Che Aake Bose Di Khatir Laba Naal Lab To Milendee Wee Hosay Main Manya Zamane De Rahmat Noo Lutke Ada Shukr Rab Da Karedi Wee Hosay Undhi Ungli Tho Phadke Wede De Andar Khuda De Sajad Nu Tu Rehndi Wee Hosay Ke Arshan Da Chan Vi Khilondan Ae Jisda Tu Us Be Missil Nu Khide Di Wee Hosay Kadi Laal Hasdana Chukdi Vi Sohna Aur Usda Wee Hosee Tu Mane Di Wee Hosee Nawa Ke Saja Ke De Surma Wee Paa Ke Tu Dhodi Hila Ke Hase Dee Wee Hosay ************other Version***************** Haleema Main Tere Muqaddran To Sadqay Tu Madani Da Jhoola Jhulendi Wee Hosay Ke Sohnay Da Mukhra Noorani Noorani Tu Takdi Te Rahi Hain Chumendi Wee Hosay Eh Ungli Naapaak Eh Tu Werre De Andhar Khuda De Sajjan Noo Turendi Wee Hosay Te Arsha Da Chan Eh Khillona Wee Jis Da Te Tu Uss Bemisal Noo Khidendi Wee Hosay Kadi Naal Terey Nazakat Thi Sohna O Rusda Wee Hosee Manandi Wee Hosay Nawa Ke Sajaa Ke Te Gajla Vee Paake Te Thodi Hilaa Ke Hasendi Wee Hosay Zamane Di Tattiyan Hawawa De Kolon Nabuvat De Phool Nu Lukendi Wee Hosay Haleema Main Tere Muqaddran To Sadqay Tu Madani Da Jhoola Jhulendi Wee Hosay

২০২

Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le

Sa'af Karan Gi Mein, Bakrian Da Wara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Teriaan Bakrian, Noon Pavan Gi Mein Chara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Jithay Jithay, Chalein Gi Toonutay Utay Java Gi Nuss Kay Bazaroon, Tera Sodah Wi Liawaangi Tera, Kam Mein Karan Gi Sara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Chula, Tera Balaan Gi Tay Rotiaan Pakawan Gi Amna, Day Chann Da Mein Jhula Wi Jhulawan Gi Bas Karan Gi Mein Sohnay Da Nazara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Teri Ainhan, Bakrian Da Dudh Wi Mein Chuva Gi, Pandey Wi Mein Maanjan Gi, Tey Kapray Wi Dhovan Gi Tera Lipan Gi, Mein Kakhan Wala Tara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Jay Toon Pawein Kuj Kawain, Uff Wi Ni Karan Gi Teray Ghar Jivan Gi, Mein Teray Ghar Maran Gi Mil Jaaye, Menoo Bakshish Da Sahara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Mintaan Wi, Kardi Tay Tarle Ve Pawaan Gi Rakh Le Halima, Teri Nokari Mein Karan Gi Mani Waasta Na Laveen Menoo Laraa Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Sun Ni, Halima Teri Kuli Si Eh Kakhan Di Aa Gaya Aye Sohna, Teh Eh Ho Gayi Lakhan Di Teri Goud, Wich Allah Da Piyara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le Hafiz Younis, Bara Shaan Halima Da Jinday Ghar Khaiday Pia Wali Yateeman Da Sada Ais Bin Hona Nai Guzara Halima Menoo Naal Rakh Le

২০৩

Ham Dare Aaqa Pe Sar Apna Jhuka Lete Hain

Ham Dare Aaqa Pe Sar Apna Jhuka Lete Hain Sach Bataana Are Duniya Tera Kya Lete Hain Us Ko Aankhon Pe Bithaatye Hain Zamaane Waale Jis Ko Mehboobe Khuda Apna Bana Lete Hain Waqt Ki Kaid Nahi Hai Ye Karam Ki Baatein Jab Bhi Sarkaar Ki Marzi Ho Bula Lete Hain Gham Ke Maaro Ka Tabeebo Na Karo Koi Ilaaj Ham Ghame Ishqe Nabi Me Bhi Maza Lete Hain Patharon Tum To Ho Pathar Magar Aaqa Mere Tum Se Gar Chahe To Kalma Bhi Padha Lete Hain Jab Nahi Milti Kahi Se Bhi Suqoon Ki Daulat Teri Mehfil Tere Dewaane Sajaa Lete Hain Ye Bhi Sarkaar Ki Rehmat Hai Karam Hai Unka Ham Jahaa Jaaye Waha Rang Jamaa Lete Hain Gumbade Khazra Khuda Tujh Ko Salaamat Rakhe Dekh Lete Hain Tujhe Pyaas Bujha Lete Hain Jab Se Dekha Hai Niyazi Wo Riyazul Jannah Hum To Ghar Baith Ke Jannat Ki Hawa Lete Hai

২০৪

Hame Apna Woh Kehte Hain Muhabbat Ho To Aisi Ho

Hame Apna Woh Kehte Hain Muhabbat Ho To Aisi Ho Hame Nazron Me Rakhte Hain Inaayat Ho To Aisi Ho Woh Pathar Maarne Waalo Ko Dete Hain Dua Aksar Koi Laao Misaal Aisi, Sharaafat Ho To Aisi Ho Ishaara Jab Woh Famaaye To Pathar Bol Uthte Hain Nabuwwat Ho To Aisi Ho Risaalat Ho To Aisi Ho Mere Aaqa Ki Wiladat Par Huwe Sab Ko Ata Dete Isse Milaad Kehte Hain Wilaadat Ho To Aisi Ho Namaze Asr Ko Qurbaan Kar Ke Ki Hasti Par Ali Maula Ne Batlaaya Ibaadat Ho To Aisi Ho Hussain Ibne Ali Ne Karbala Me Ye Kiya Saabit Rahe Jaari Jo Neze Par Tilaawat Ho To Aisi Ho Waha Mujram Ko Milti Hain Panaaein Bhi Jadaaein Bhi Madine Me Jo Lagti Hain Adalat Ho To Aisi Ho Aur Muhammad Ki Wiladat Par Hooain Sab Ko Ataa Baitain Isse Milad Kehte Hain Wiladat Ho To Aisi Ho Aur Hussain Ibn-E-Ali Ne Karbala Me Ye Kiya Sabith Rahe Jaari Jo Nezay Par Tilawat Ho To Aisi Ho

২০৫

Hanjuan Nal Ghusl Dewan

Hanjuan Nal Ghusl Dewan Sarkar De Wedhe Nun Ik Waar Je Wekh Lawan Dildar De Wedhe Nun Jithe Nur Di Kinmin Hai Jithe Barish Rahmat Di Rab Sukkan Nai Denda Dildar De Wedhe Nun Rab Arshan Ton Sutda Phul Apni Rahmat De Khusboo Wal Lutaunda Ae Dildar De Wedhe Nun Dil Karda Ae Akhiyan De Sheeshe Wich Main Jadh Lan Us Rab De Manmohne Shahkar De Wedhe Nun Har Pason Phut Paiyan Aj Kirnan Noor Diyan Ik Yaar Sajaya Ae Ik Yaar De Wedhe Nun Meri Kismat Phad Ungli Lae Chal Tun Madine Nun Main Mar Ke Wi Nai Chad-Da Dildar De Wedhe Nun Akhiyan Wich Lae Athroo Jadon Chadeya Madine Nun Main Murr Murr Takda San Sarkar De Wedhe Nun Jedha Wekh Lawe Sadiq Sukh Pawe Hayatin De Rab Sharf Ae Bakhsheya Ae Dildar De Wedhe Nun Akh Khol Ke Wekh Te Sai Kis Dar Te Khalotan Ae Hun Sadiq Chaddi Na Sarkar De Wedhe Nun Hooran Wi Karan Sajde Jhukde Ne Malaik Wi Jannat Da Hai Roop Ditta Dildar De Wedhe Nun Jithe Nur Di Kinmin Hai Jithe Barish Rahmat Di Rab Sukkan Nai Denda Murshid De Wedhe Nun Sohne Pir De Wehde Nun Meri Kismat Phad Ungli Lae Chal Tun Madine Nun Main Mar Ke Wi Nai Chad-Da Murshid De Wedhe Nun Sohne Pir De Wedhe Nun

২০৬

Haqeeqat Me Woh Lutfe Zindagi Paya Nehi Karte

Haqeeqat Me Woh Lutfe Zindagi Paya Nehi Karte Jo Yaad E Mustafa Se Dil Ko Behlaya Nahin Kartay. Zaban Per Shikwae Ranj O Alam Laya Nahin Karte Nabi Kay Naam Lewa Gham Say Ghabraya Nahin Karte. Yeh Darbaar E Mohammad Hai Yahan Apnoon Ka Kiya Kehna Yahaan Se Hath Khali Gheir Bhi Jaya Nehi Karte. Are O Na Samaj Qurbaan Hoja Inke Roze Par Yeh Lamhe Zindagi Me Baar Baar Aya Nehin Karte. Yeh Hai Darbaar Aqa Ka Yahaan Milta Hei Bemange Are Nadan Yahaan Daman Ko Phelaya Nehi Karte. Madinay Jo Bhi Jata Hai, Woh Jholi Bhar Kay Lata Hai Sakhi Data Hain Khali Haath Lotaya Nahin Kertay. Mohammad Mustafa Key Bagh Key Sabh Phool Aise Hain Jo Bepani Ke Tar Rehte Hain Murjaya Nahi Karte. Nadamat Sath Le Kar Hashr Mein Ae Aasio Jana Suna Hei Sharm Waloon Ko Woh Sharmaya Nehi Karte. Jo Unke Damaan E Rehmet Say Wabasta Hai Ae Hamid, Kisi Kay Samnay Woh Haath Phelaya Nehi Karte. Mohammad Mustafa Ki Shaan E Rehmet To Zarah Dekho, Sittam Sehte To Hain Lekin Sittam Daya Nehi Karte. Aggar Ho Jazba E Sadiq To Aksar Humne Dekha He, Woh Khud Tashreef Le Ate Hain Tarpaya Nehi Karte. Jo Inke Damaan E Rehmet Se Wabasta Hain Ae Hamid, Kissi Ke Samne Woh Hath Phelaya Nehi Karte Haqeeqat Me Woh Lutfe Zindagi Paya Nehi Karte, Jo Yaad E Mustafa Se Dil Ko Garmaya Nehi Karte.

২০৭

Har Dum Ho Mera Vird Madina Hi Madina

Har Dum Ho Mera Vird Madina Hi Madina Bas Yaad Teri Dil Me Rahe Roz-O-Shabina Wo Lamha Wo Din Aur Wo Aajaye Mahina Phir Kash Tadapta Huva Pahunchu Mai Madina Sina Ho Madina Mera Sina So Madina Ban Jaye Mera Dil Teri Ulfat Ka Khazina Aaye Noo-E-Khuda Noor Bhari Dil Pe Nazar Ho Ho Noor Se Pur Noor Ye Be Noor Nagina Sarkar Tamanna Hai Yuhi Umr Basar Ho Bas Teri Mohabbat Me Ho Marna Jina Saqi Muhje Jaam Aaisa Mohabbat Ka Pilade Utre Na Kabhi Iska Nasha Aai Sha-E-Madina Tum Khak-E-Madina Mere Lashe Pe Chidakna Phir Malna Kafan Par Jo Mile Un Ka Pasina Attar Talab Gaar Hai Bas Unke Karam Ka Lillah Karam Jane Karam Bahre Madina

২০৮

Har Nazar Kaanp Utthegi Mehshar Ke Din

Har Nazar Kaanp Utthegi Mehshar Ke Din Khauf Se Har Kaleja Dehel Jaayega Par Ye Naaz Un Ke Bande Ka Dekhenge Sab Thaamkar Unka Daaman Machal Jaayenga Maujh Katra Ke Hum Se Chalee Jayegi Rukh Mukhalif Hava Ka Badal Jaayega Jab Ishaarah Karenge Wo Naa Khuda Apna Beda Bhanvar Se Nikal Jaayega Yoon To Jeeta Hu Hukme Khuda Se Magar Mere Dil Ki Hai Unko Yaqeenan Khabar Haasile Zindagi Hoga Wo Din Mera Unke Kadmon Mein Jab Dam Nikal Jaayega Rabbi Sallim Wo Farmaane Wale Mile Kyun Satate Hai Aye Dil Tujhe Waswase Pul Se Guzrenge Hum Wajd Karte Huwein Kaun Kehta Hai Paau Fisal Jayega Akhtar E Khasta Kyun Itna Beychen Hai Tera Aaqa Shehenshahe Kaunain Hai Lau Lagaa To Sahin Shahe Laulaak Se Gham Masarrat Ke Sanche Me Dhal Jayenga

২০৯

Har Soo Hai Izhaar Madine Waale Ka

Har Soo Hai Izhaar Madine Waale Ka Noorani Darbaar Madine Waale Ka Le Ke Chalo Ab Mujh Ko Madine Leke Chalo Main To Hoon Bimaar Madine Waale Ka Mujhko Hoga Naaz Ke Jab Ye Log Kahe Ye Mangta He Sarkaar Madine Waale Ka Mere Dil Ki Yehi Ek Tamanna Hai Ke Ho Jaaye Deedar Madine Waale Ka Meri Dua Hain Mehfil Mein Maujood Hain Jo Sab Dekhe Darbaar Madine Waale Ka Jannati Hai Woh Jannati Hai Woh Jannati Hai Jis Le Dil Mein Hai Pyaar Madine Waale Ka Shakir O Rizwan Par Ho Karam Ki Khaas Nazar Yeh Karte Hai Parchaar Madine Waale Ka ----------------- More ----------------- ---------------- Verses ---------------- Apna Thikana Wo Dozakh Me Payega Jisne Kiya Inkar Madine Wale Ka Apne To Apne Haan Dushman Bhi Bol Uthe Aala Hai Kirdar Madine Wale Ka Mohsin Ek Din Jayenge Hum Bhi Taiba Me Dekhenge Darbar Madine Wale Ka

২১০

Har Soo Jahaan Wale Khushiya Mana Rahe Hai

Har Soo Jahaan Wale Khushiya Mana Rahe Hai Dono Jahaan Ke Dulha Tashreef Laa Rahe Hai Ye Mo’jiza To Dekho Sardare Ambiya Ka Mutthi Me Kankaro Se Kalma Padha Rahe Hai Najdi Wahabi Shaitaan Sab Baithe Ro Rahe Hai Hum Aashiqe Nabi Hai Khushiya Mana Rahe Hai Ishqe Nabi Basaa Kar Jo Shakhs Mar Gaya Hai Us Laash Ko Farishte Kaandha Laga Rahe Hai Mehsoos Ho Raha Hai Is Bazme Qaadri Me Sarkaare Gause Aazam Tashreef La Rahe Hai Ye Sach Hai To Hai Zinda Qur’an Keh Raha Hai Is Waaste Hum Sunni Chaadar Chada Rahe Hai Ye Martaba Kisi Ne Paaya Hai To Bataao Jibreel Mustafa Ko Jhoola Jhoola Rahe Hai Mehshar Ki Bheed Me Hum Ghairo Se Ye Kahenge Woh Dekho Mere Aaqa Tashreef La Rahe Hai

২১১

Har Taraf Anwaar Ki Barsaat Hai

Allah Hoo, Allah Hoo Allah Allah Allah Allah Hoo Allah Har Taraf Anwaar Ki Barsaat Hai, Aamad E Sarkaar Ki Kya Baat Hai, Mehfil E Sarkaar Ki Kiya Baat Hai. Raat Jo Guzri Nabi Kay Zikr Mein, Din Se Behtar Woh Hamari Raat Hai. Aagaya Hai Amena Bibi Laal, Ab Yaqeenan Sab Ka Beda Paar Hai. Yoon To Gumbad Hai Jahaan Mein Har Jagah, Gumbad E Khazra Teri Kya Baat Hai. Kya Bigade Gaa Zamaana Ab Mera, Sar Pe Mere Peer Ka Jab Haat Hai. Kyun Mein Mangoon Jab Mere Kashkol Main, Naqsh E Naal E Pak Ki Khairaat Hai. Kyun Pareshan Hoon Mein Uqhba Key Liye, Shafa E Rauzay Jaza Woh Zaat Hai. Wali E Kaun O Makaan Kay Zikr Say, Wajd Mein Yeh Sari Kainaat Hai. Nausha E Bazme Jina Kay Waaste, Anbiya Ki Saf Ba Saf Baraat Hai. Kis Tarha Likhoon Main Midhat Aap Ki, Jab Madha Khawan Khud Khuda Ki Zaat Hai. Kis Qadar Rehaan Khush Qismat Hai Tu, Teri Bakhshish Ka Wasila Naat Hai. Har Taraf Anwaar Ki Barsaat Hai, Mehfil E Sarkar Ki Kya Baat Hai, Mehfil E Sarkaar Ki Kiya Baat Hai.

২১২

Har Waqt Tasawwur Mein Madine Ki Gali Ho

Har Waqt Tasawwur Mein Madine Ki Gali Ho Aur Yaad Muhammad Ki Mere Dil Me Basi Ho Do-Soz Bilal Aqa Mile Dard Raza Sa Sarkar Ataa Ishq Owais-E-Qarni Ho Aye Kaash Mai Banjau Madine Ka Musafir Phir Rooti Huwi Taibah Ko Baraat Chali Ho Phir Rehmat-E-Bari Se Chaloon Soo-E-Madina Ai Kaash! Muqaddar Se Mayas'sar Woh Ghadi Ho Jab Aau Madine Me Toh Har Chaak Girebaan Aankhon Se Barasti Huwi Ashkon Ki Jhadi Ho Aye Kaash Madine Me Mujhe Maut Yuh Aaye Qadmon Me Tere Sar Ho Meri Rooh Chali Ho Jab Leke Chalo Gharibaan Ko Janazah Kuch Khaak Madine Ki Mere Munh Pe Saji Ho Jis Waqt Nakirein Meri Qabr Mein Aaein Us Waqt Mere Lab Pe Saji Naat E Nabi Ho Allah Karam Aisa Kare Tujh Par Jahan Me Aye Dawate Islami Teri Dhoom Machi Ho Aaqa Ka Gada Hoon Aye Jahannam Tu Bhi Sunle Woh Kaise Jalay Jo Ke Ghulam E Madani Ho Sadqa Mere Murshid Ka Karoon Door Balaein Pura Mera Sarkaar Har Armaan Dili Ho Allah Ki Rehmat Se To Jannat Hi Milegi Ai Kaash! Mahille Me Jagah Unke Mili Ho Mehfooz Sada Rakhna Shaha Be Adbaun Se Aur Mujhse Bhi Sarzor Kabhi Be Adbi Ho Attar Hamara Hai Saray Hashr Ai Kaash! Daste Shaha Batha Se Yehi Chit'thi Mili Ho

২১৩

Hawa Ki Khushbu Bata Rahi Hai

Hawa Ki Khushbu Bata Rahi Hai Woh Zulf Apni Sajaa Rahe Hain Sawaari Taiba Se Chal Padi Hai Huzoor Tashreef Laa Rahe Hain Kahi Pe Mehfil Hai Mehkasho Ki Kahi Pe Mehfil Hai Dil Jalo Ki Ye Kitne Khushbakht Hain Jo Nabi Ki Mehfil Sajaa Rahe Hain Na Paas Bhi Ho To Soona Saawan Woh Jis Pe Raazi Wohi Suhaagan Jinho Ne Pakda Nabi Ka Daaman Unhi Ke Ghar Jagmagaa Rahe Hain Habeebe Daawar Ghareeb Parwar Rasoole Akram Karam Ke Paikar Kisi Ko Dar Pe Bula Rahe Hain Kisi Ke Khawaabo Me Aa Rahe Hain Mai Apni Khairul Waraa Ke Sadqe Mai Unki Shaane Ata Ke Sadqe Bhara Hai Aibo Se Mere Daaman Huzoor Phir Bhi Nibha Rahe Hain Banega Jaane Ka Phir Bahaana Kahega Aakar Koi Deewaana Chalo Niyaazi Chale Madine Madine Waale Bula Rahe Hain

২১৪

Hayya Alas Salah Hayya Alal Falah

Di Hazrate Bilal Ne Kaabe Se Jab Sada Haiya Alas Salah Haiya Alah Falah Aalam Me Aam Naraa E Tauheed Ho Gaya Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Irshade Kibriya Hai Ye Farmaane Mustafa Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Paida Hue Rasool To Rehmat Baras Padi Thi Arsh Se Zameen Talak Noor Ki Jhadi Daee Haleema Goud Me Lekar Jo Chal Padi Beemar Ootni Me Ajab Jaan Pad Gayi Baade Saba Ne Jhoom Ke Kaano Me Yoon Kaha Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Pahucha Jo Unke Dar Pe Muqaddar Sawar Gaya Marehra Se Hai Shehre Bareili Ka Silsila Bagdaad Se Hai Shehre Madina Ka Raabta Gausul Wara Ke Naam Se Dil Ko Sukoon Mila Jibreel Aaye Nasbe Alam Kaabe Par Kiya Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Islam Ke Alam Ko Uthaya Hussain Ne Baatil Ke Aage Sar Na Jhukaya Hussain Kya Cheez Hai Namaaz Bataya Hussain Ne Sajde Me Apne Sar Ko Kataya Hussain Ne Ye Dashte Karbala Se Abhi Aati Hai Sadaa Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Meraj Me Jo Rab Ne Bulaya Huzoor Ko Jibraeel Aaye Aur Jagaya Huzoor Ko Haq Ki Raza Ka Jaam Pilaya Huzoor Ko Chalne Lage To Rab Ne Bataya Huzoor Ko Ummat Se Jaake Kehna Yehi Tohfa Hai Mila Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Daadhi Tamaam Nabiyon Ki Sunnat Hai Momino Islam Ka Shi'ar Hai Rehmat Hai Momino Sarkar Ki Ghulami Ki Nisbat Hai Momino Sunnat Pe Jo Chala Use Jannat Hai Momino Jannat Me Bhi Milega Hume Qurbe Mustafa Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah Meraj Rooh E Ahle Baseerat Namaaz Hai Afzal Tareen Shughl Sa'adat Namaaz Hai Mere Nabi Ki Aankho Ki Thandak Namaaz Hai Momin Ke Waaste To Sa'adat Namaaz Hai Yeh Hai Kaleem Mazhar E Altafe Kibriya Haiyya Alas Salah Haiyya Alal Falah

২১৫

Hirze Jaan Zikre Shafaat Kijiye

Hirze Jaa(N) Zikre Shafa'at Kijiye Naar Se Bachne Ki Soorat Kijiye Unke Naqshe Paa Pe Gairat Kijiye Aankh Se Chup Kar Ziyaarat Kijiye Unke Husne Baa Malaahat Par Nisaar Sheeraye Jaa(N) Ki Halaawat Kijiye Unke Dar Par Jaise Ho Mit Jaaiye Natawaano Kuch To Himmat Kijiye Frr Deeje Panjaye Deve Laee Mustafa Ke Bal Pe Taaqat Kijiye Doob Kar Yaade Labe Shadaab Mein Aabe Kauthar Ki Sabaahat Kijiye Yaade Qaamat Karte Uthiye Qabr Se Jaane Mehshar Par Qayaamat Kijiye Unke Dar Par Baithiye Ban Kar Faqeer Be Nawaao Fikre Sarwat Kijiye Jiska Husn Allah Ko Bhi Bhaa Gaya Aise Pyaare Se Muhabbat Kijiye Hayy Baaqee Jiski Karta Hai Sana Marte Dum Tak Uski Midhat Kijiye Arsh Par Jiski Kamaanen Chad Gayi Sadqe Us Baazoo Pe Quwwat Kijiye Neem Wa Taiba Ke Phoolon Par Ho Aankh Bulbulo Paase Nazaakat Kijiye Sar Se Girta Hai Abhi Baare Gunaah Kham Zara Farqe Iraadat Kijiye Aankh To Uthti Nahi Kya De(N) Jawaab Hum Pe Be Pursish Hi Rehmat Kijiye Uzr Badtar Az Gunah Ka Zikr Kya Be Sabab Hum Par Inaayat Kijiye Naa'ra Kije Ya Rasoolallah Ka Mufliso Saamaane Daulat Kijiye Hum Tumhare Hoke Kis Ke Paas Jaaye Sadqa Shehzaadon Ka Rehmat Kijiye Man Ra Aani Qad Ra Al Haq Jo Kahe Kya Bayaa(N) Uski Haqeeqat Kijiye Aalime Ilme Do Aalam Hain Huzoor Aapse Kya Arze Haajat Kijiye Aap Sultane Jahaa(N) Hum Benawaa Yaad Humko Waqte Ne'mat Kijiye Tujh Se Kya Kya Aye Mere Taiba Ke Chaand Zulmate Gham Ki Shikaayat Kijiye Dar Badar Kab Tak Fire(N) Khasta Kharaab Taiba Mein Madfan Inaayat Kijiye Har Baras Woh Qaafilo Ki Dhoom Dhaam Aah Suniye Aur Gaflat Kijiye Phir Palat Kar Muh Na Us Jaanib Kiya Sach Hai Aur Daa'waye Ulfat Kijiye Aqribaa Hubbe Watan Be Himmati Aah Kis Kis Ki Shikaayat Kijiye Ab To Aaqa Muh Dikhane Ka Nahi Kis Tarah Raf-E Nadaamat Kijiye Apne Haatho Khud Luta Baithe Hain Ghar Kis Pe Daa'waye Bizaa'at Kijiye Kis Se Kahiye Kya Kiya Kya Ho Gaya Khud Hi Apne Par Malaamat Kijiye Arz Ka Bhi Ab To Muh Padta Nahi Kya Ilaaje Darde Furqat Kijiye Apni Ik Meethi Nazar Ke Shehad Se Chaaraye Zehre Musibat Kijiye De Khuda Himmat Ki Ye Jaane Hazee Aap Par Waaren Woh Soorat Kijiye Aap Hum Se Badh Ke Hum Par Meherbaan Hum Kare Jurm Aap Rehmat Kijiye Jo Na Bhoola Hum Ghareebon Ko Raza Yaad Uski Apni Aadat Kijiye

২১৬

Ho Gaey Bazme Jahan Mey Khwaar Ham

Ho Gaey Bazme Jahan Mey Khwaar Ham Chahthay Hai Ik Nazar Sarkar Ham Ham Buray Hai Ya Balay Jeysay Bhi Hai, Aap Key Hai Aey Shahe Abrar Ham Kasthi Milath Bhanwar Main Phans Gaee, Ya Rasulullah Uthray Paar Ham Ab Tho Qismath Mey Andheyrey Reh Gaey, Roshni Key Thay Kabhi Minaar Ham Ley Gaey Kirdar Ki Dolath Aduw, Ab Hai Khaali Saahibe Gafthaar Ham Aasi-Wo-Khaathi Sahi Leykin Hazoor, Aap Ki Ulfath Say Hai Sarshaar Ham Ab Na Khali Haath Lowtein Ya Nabi, Ho Gaey Hain Haazre Darbaar Ham Ho Gaey Bazme Jahan Mey Khwaar Ham Chahthay Hai Ik Nazar Sarkar Ham

Ho Karam Sarkar Ab To Ho Gaey Gham Beshumaar Jaan-O-Dil Thum Par Fida Aey Do Jahan Key Taajdaar Mey Akeyla Aur Maas'il Zindagee Key Beshumaar Aap Hi Kuch Kijiey Na Ey Shahey Aali Waqar Yaad Atha Hey Tawafe Khanaey Ka'ba Mujhay Aur Lipatna Multazam Say Waley Khana Bar Bar Sange Aswad Chuum Kar Milta Mujhay Keyf-O-Saroor Chayn Patha Deykh Kar Dil Mustajab-O-Mustajar Ya Khuda Dikhlahathi Mey Pak Mizan Woh Maqam Aur Safa Marwa Mujhay Behray Rasoole Zi Waqar Ja Raha Hey Kaafila Taiba Nagar Rotha Huwa Mey Raha Jatha Hun Thanha Aey Habibey Kirdgaar Jald Phir Thum Lo Bula Aur Sabz Ghumbad Do Dikha Hazri Ki Aarzo Ney Kardiya Phir Beykaraar Choom Kar Khake Madinah Jhoomtha Phirtha Tha Mey Yaad Athay Hey Madinay Kay Mujhay Leyl O Nahar Ghumbaday Khazra Key Jalway Aur Woh Iftariya Yaad Athi Hey Bohoth Ramadhan Taibah Ki Bahar Ya Rasula Llah Sun Li Jey Meri Faryaad Ko Kown Hai Jo Key Sunay Teray Siwa Meri Pukaar Haal Par Meray Karam Ki Ik Nazar Farmaey Dil Mera Ghamgeen Hai Aey Ghamzadon Kay Ghamgusaar Kaflay Walo Suno Yaad Aey Tho Mera Salam Arz Karna Rothay Rothay Ho Sakey Tho Bar Bar Ghamzada Yun Na Huwa Hotha Obaid-E-Qadri Iss Baras Bhi Deykhtha Ghar Sabz Ghumbad Ki Bahar

২১৯

Hui Umeed E Barawar Madina Aane Wala Hai

Hui Umeed E Barawar Madina Aane Wala Hai Jhuka Lo Ab Adab Se Sar Madina Aane Wala Hai Pila De Saqiya Saghar Madina Aane Wala Hai Ata Ab Kaif O Masti Kar Madina Aane Wala Hai Teher Ja Rooh E Muztar Tu Nikal Jana Madine Me Khudara Ab Na Jaldi Kar Madina Aane Wala Hai Wasila Char Yaro Ka Uhad Ke Jaan Nisaro Ka Dikha Do Ek Jhalak Dilbar Madina Aane Wala Hai Meri Ho Arzoo Puri Mujhe Miljaye Manzoori Baqi E Paak Ki Sarwar Madina Aane Wala Hai Ata Ho Mujhko Chashm E Tar Mujhe Dedo Dil E Muztar Zara Jaldi Mere Dilbar Madina Aane Wala Hai Tadap Ne Ka Qarina Do Mujhe Do Chaak Sina Do Pae Shabeer Aur Shabar Madina Aane Wala Hai Mubarak Ho Gunahgaro Khatakaro Siyahkaro Tumhe Ab Asiyo Kya Dar Madina Aane Wala Hai Utho Attar Ab Utho Zara To Ghor Se Dekho Wo Chaya Noor Har Shae Par Madina Aane Wala Hai

২২০

Hum Apni Hasrate Dil Ko Mitane Aaye Hai

Hum Apni Hasrate Dil Ko Mitane Aaye Hai Hum Apni Dil Ki Lagi Ko Bujhane Aaye Hai Dil E Hazi Ko Tassalli Dilane Aaye Hai Ghum E Firaq Ko Dil Se Mitane Aaye Hai Ajab Karma Hai Ke Khud Mujrimo Ke Hamee Hai Gunah Gaaron Ki Baqshih Karaane Aaye Hai Kareem Hai Wo Nigah E Karam Se Dekhenge Hai Daagh-Daagh Dil Apna Dikhane Aaye Hai Huzoor Bahre Khuda Daastaan E Ghum Sun Le Ghum E Firaaq Ka Kissa Sunane Aaye Hai Khuda Ne Ghaib Diya Hai Inhe Hai Sab Raushan Jo Khatre Dil Hi Me Chupne Chupane Aaye Hai Nigaah E Lutf O Karam Hogi Aur Fir Hogi Ki Zakhm E Dil Pe Ye Marham Lagane Aaye Hai Faqeer Aapke Darr Ke Hai Hum Kaha Jaye Tumhare Kuche Me Dhuni Ramaane Aaye Hai Daba Nahi Wo Falak Se Buland O Bala Hai Tale Zameen Jise Sarwar Sulane Aaye Hai Naseeb Jaag Utha Uska Chayn Se Soya Wo Jisko Kabr Me Sarwar Sulane Aaye Hai Naseeb Tera Chamak Uthha Dekh To Noori Arab Ke Chand Lahad Ke Sir-Hane Aaye Hai

২২১

Hum Bazm Sada Unke Sajaate Hi Rahenge

Hum Bazm Sada Unke Sajaate Hi Rahenge Sarkaar Ka Meelad Manate Hi Rahenge Jo Dono Jahaanon Mein Sahara Hai Humara Geet Unki Inaayat Ke Gaate Hi Rahenge Haq Wale Sada Sayyade Shabbir Ke Gham Mein Ro Ro Ke Zamaane Ko Rulate Hi Rahenge Aise Hi Duroodon Ki Salaamon Ki Fiza Mein Ushshaq Unhe Ghar Mein Bulate Hi Rahenge Jo Naate Nabi Sun Kar Tadap Jaate Hai Saaim In’aam Wo Sarkaar Se Paate Hi Rahenge

২২২

Hum Bhi Aye Kaash Madine Mein Bulaaye Jaate

Hum Bhi Aye Kaash Madine Mein Bulaaye Jaate Shahe Kaunain Ke Mehmaan Banaaye Jaate Wajd Mein Hoke Bhi Ek Hosh Ki Dunya Hoti Parde Aankhon Se Meri Itne Hataaye Jaate Zindgaani Ko Bhi Jeene Ka Saleeqa Aata Raat Bhar Unki Huzoori Mein Jagaaye Jaate Ek Jhadi Aansuon Ki Nazre Aqeedat Karte Daaghe Isyaan Bhi Isi Tarha Mitaaye Jaate Aap Ke Qurb Ki Khushbu Ki Sa’adat Ka Nasha Dekhte Rauza E Purnoor Ko Aate Jaate Martaba Apna Bhi Shahon Se Zyada Hota Unki Dehleez Pe Jab Shaad Bithaaye Jaate.

২২৩

Hum Khaak Hain Aur Khaak Hi Maawa Hai Hamaara

Hum Khaak Hain Aur Khaak Hi Maawa Hai Hamaara Khaki To Wo Aadam Jadd-E-Aala Hai Hamara Allah Hamein Khaak Kare Apni Tallab Mein Ye Khaak To Sarkaar Se Tamgha Hai Hamara Jis Khaak Pe Rakhte The Qadam Sayyid-E-Aalam Us Khaak Pe Qurbaan Dil-E-Shaida Hain Hamara Kham Ho Gayi Pushte Falak Is Ta’ne Zamee Se Sun Humpe Madina Hai Woh Rutba Hai Humara Usne Laqabe Khaak Shahenshaah Se Paaya Jo Haidar-E-Karraar Ke Maula Hai Hamara Aye Muddaiyo Khaak Ko Tum Khaak Na Samjho Iss Khaak Mein Madfoon Shah-E-Batha Hai Hamaara Hai Khaak Se Taameer Mazaar-E-Shah-E-Konain Ma'moor Isi Khaak Se Qibla Hai Hamara Ham Khaak Uraeinge Jo Wo Khaak Na Paayi Aabaad Raza Jiss Pe Madina Hai Hamara Hum Khaak Hain Aur Khaak Hi Maawa Hai Hamaara Khaki To Wo Aadam Jadd-E-Aala Hai Hamara

২২৪

Hum Sar Pe Kafan Bandhe Maidan Mein Nikle Hain

Hum Sar Pe Kafan Bandhe Maidan Mein Nikle Hain Batil Ke Mehlon Ko Hum Daahne Nikle Hain Himmat Hai Hume Toke Dam Hai To Hume Roko Hum Naara-E-Risalat Ko Pehlane Nikle Hain Har Des Main Gunjega Ab Ya Rasool Allah Har Shakhs Pukarega Ab Ya Rasool Allah Hum Saari Duniya Mein Halchal Si Macha Denge Sarkar Ke Aashiq Hai Rang Apna Jamaa Denge Milad-E-Nabi Karna Ye Khoon Mein Shamil Hai Is Mission Ki Khatir Hum Din Raat Lagaa Denge Sarkaar Ki Naaton Se Pur Josh Hai Deewane Milad Ki Mehfil Mein Maahol Bana Denge Kyun Kar Na Manayen Hum Ye Sunni Saqhafat Hai Milad Manane Par Sarkar Jagaa Denge Sauda Na Karenge Hum Imaan Na Bechenge Naamus-E-Risalat Par Duniya Ko Hilaa Denge Har Nasl Ka Naara Hai Har Qaum Ka Naara Hai Is Naare Se Logon Ko Aapas Me Milaa Denge Islam Jo Mazahab Hai Paigham-E-Mohabbat Hai Is Aman Ke Parcham Ko Har Ghar Main Jagaa Denge Sarkaar Ki Izzat Par Marna Hai Hume Logon Ye Wada Hamara Hai Sab Kuch Hi Lutaa Denge Hum Ne Yehi Thani Hai Mannat Yehi Maani Hai Is Des Ki Matti Par Khoon Apna Bahaa Denge Hai Aal-E-Nabi Piyare Ashaab Sitaren Hain Dono Ki Mohabbat Ko Hum Dil Main Basaa Denge Aaye Hain Ujaagar Sang Amjad-O-Tahir Bhi Paigham-E-Nabi Denge Ahkaam-E-Khuda Denge

২২৫

Hum Tere Se Aisa Pyar Karte Hain

Sallallah 'ala Muhammad Sallallah 'alay Wasallam Hum Tere Se Aisa Pyar Karte Hain Hum Sab Jaante Hain, Insaano Mein Tere Jaisa Koi Nahin Hain, Hum Sab Maante Hain, Teri Azmat Ka Hum Ko Aur Allah Ko Aisa Yaqeen Hai Tu Hi Sadiq Hai Tu Hi Amin Hai Jaanta Asmaan Aur Zameen Hai Aey Muhammad Tujhey Salaam Hum Tere Se Aisa Pyar Karte Hai Sallallah ’ala Muhammad Sallallah ’alay Wasallam Ghaare Hira Se Jo Nikli Awaaz, Phaili Jahan Mein Phir Sach Ki Pukaar Zulmat Ke But Ko Kiya Pash Pash, Insaan Ka Sab Se Bada Rahnuma Tu, Jahaan Pe Hai Tere Karam Beshumaar Aey Muhammad Tujhey Salaam Hum Tere Se Aisa Pyar Karte Hai Sallallah ’ala Muhammad Sallallah ’alay Wasallam Ghareebo Ka Saathi, Yateemon Ka Baap, Be-Qasson Ka Sahara, Sakhi Be Hisaab Khuda Ki Khudai Ko Samjhane Wala Zalim Ke Seene Pe Hai-Badd Ka Saaya Baaqi Jahan Ke Liye Sirf Pyar Aey Muhammad Tujhey Salaam Hum Tere Se Aisa Pyar Karte Hai Sallallah ’ala Muhammad Sallallah ’alay Wasallam Ham Sab Jaante Hai, Insaano Mein Tere Jaisa Koi Nahin Hai, Hum Sab Maante Hain, Teri Azmat Ka Hum Ko Aur Allah Ko Aisa Yaqeen Hai. Tu Hi Sadiq Hai Tu Hi Amin Hai Jaanta Asmaan Aur Zameen Hai

২২৬

Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah

Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Kabhi To Sabz Gumbad Ka Ujala Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Dharakh Uthey Ga Ye Dil Yaa Dharakhna Bhool Jaaye Gaa Dilley Bismill Ka Uss Darpar Tamasha Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Aadab Se Haath Bandhe Unke Rozey Par Kareh Ho Gay Sunheri Jaaliyon Kaa Yoo Nazaara Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Darrey Dolatt Se Lottahya Nahi Jata Koi Khalli Waha Khairaaat Ka Batna Khudayaa Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Barasti Gumbade Khizra Se Takraati Huwee Bhoondey Wahaa Par Shaan Se Baarish Barasnaa Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Guzaare Rath Din Apne Issee Umeed Par Hamne Kisee Din Toh Jamaal E Roohey Zaibah Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Damey Rukhsat Kadam Man Bahr Ke Hai Mehsoos Karte Hain Kise Hai Jakhe Lowtane Ka Yaara Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Pohnch Ja'enge Jis Din Aey Ujagar Un Ke Khadmo Mein Kise Kehte Hai Jannat Ka Nazaara Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah Kabhi To Sabz Gumbad Ka Ujala Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humhey Bulwaaye Gay Aaqa Madina Hum Bhi Dekhe Gay Humko Bulana Ya Rasool Allah, Humko Bulana Ya Habeeb Allah

২২৭

Husne Mehboob Ne Aalam Ko Saja Rakha Hai

Husne Mehboob Ne Aalam Ko Saja Rakha Hai Rishta Makhlooq Ka Khaliq Se Mila Rakha Hai Chaand Taare Hai Jabhi Noor Nazar Ko Dete Unki Nalain Ka Surma Jo Laga Rakha Hai Phoolon Mein Chaand Mein Taaron Mein Tabassum Unka Unke Jalwon Ke Siwa Duniya Mein Kya Rakha Hai Naat Kehta Hu To Aati Hai Fiza Mein Masti Jaam Taiba Ka Khayalon Ko Pila Rakha Hai Sadqe Taiba Ke Azaab Aata Nahi Hum Par Shehre Mehboob Ne Duniya Ko Bacha Rakha Hai Jab Bhi Tu Chahe Sada Dene Sawaali Aaja Mere Mehboob Ne Darwaza Khula Rakha Hai Jinke Tukdon Pe Jahaan Palta Hai Saara Saaim Unki Sarkaar Mein Daaman Ko Bicha Rakha Hai

২২৮

Huzoor Aisa Koi Intizam Ho Jaye

Huzoor Aisa Koi Intizam Ho Jaye, Ke Phir Madina Rawana Ghulam Ho Jaye. Naseeb Waalon Mein Mera Bhi Naam Ho Jaye, Jo Zindagi Ki Madinay Mein Shaam Ho Jaye. Main Shaad Shaad Maroon Ga, Agar Dum-E-Akhir, Naseeb Jalwa E Kahirul Anam Ho Jaye. Zubaan Pe Jaari Muhammad Ka Naam Ho Jaye Fuzool Goi Say Bach Jaye Yeh Zaban Meri, Mera Kalaam Durood-O-Salaam Ho Jaye. Pia Raza Ne Pia Jo Murshid Nay, Ataa Mujhe Shaha Aisa Jaam Ho Jaye. Shaha Ubaid-E-Raza Dar Badar Phiray Kab Tak, Huzoor Is Ka Madinah Maqam Ho Jaye. Ubaid Mar Kay Madinah Mein Paa Chuka Hai Baqi, Khabar Watan Mein Kabhi To Yeh Aam Ho Jaye. *****************other***************** ****************version**************** Huzor Aisa Koi Intezam Ho Jaaye Salam Ke Liye Hazir Gulam Ho Jaaye Mai Sirf Dekh Lu Ek Baar Sub’he Tayba Ko Nazar Se Chum Lu Ek Baar Sabz Gumbad Ko Bala Se Fir Meri Duniya Tamaam Ho Jaaye Huzor Aap Jo Sun Le To Baat Ban Jaaye Huzor Aap Jo Keh De To Kaam Ho Jaaye Tajalliyat Se Bhar Lu Mai Apna Kasa E Jaan Kabhi Jo Un Ki Gali Mai Kayam Ho Jaaye Huzor Aap Jo Chahe To Kuchh Nahi Mushkil Simat Ke Fasla Ye Chand Gaam Ho Jaaye Maza To Jab Hai Farishte Ye Kabr Mai Keh De Sabih Mid’hat E Khairul Anam Ho Jaaye Huzor Aisa Koi Intezam Ho Jaaye Salam Ke Liye Hazir Gulam Ho Jaaye Woh Bazm-E-Khaas Jo Darbaar-E-Aam Ho Jaye Umeed Hai Keh Hamara Salaam Ho Jaye Idher Bhi Ik Nigaah-E-Lutf-E-Aam Ho Jaye Ke Aashiqon Mein Hamara Bhi Naam Ho Jaye Tere Ghulam Ki Shaukat Jou Dekh Le Mehmood Abhi Ayaaz Ki Surat Ghulam Ho Jaye Mein Qayal Aap Ke Rauzay Ka Hoon Woh Qayal Tur Kaleem Se Na Kissi Din Kalaam Ho Jaye Madinay Jaon Phir Aaon Dobara Phir Jaon Tamaam Umar Issi Mein Tamaam Ho Jaye Bulao Jald Madinay Mein Hai Ameer Ko Khauf Kaheen Na Umar Do Roza Tamaam Ho Jaye Tumhari Naat Parhon Mein Sunoo Likhoon Har Dum Ye Zindagi Meri Yunhi Tamaam Ho Jaye Meri Namaz-E-Janazah Ki Yun Ibadat Ho Ke Do Jahan Ke Aaqa Imam Ho Jaye Piya Raza O Ziya Ne Piya Jou Murshid Ne A’ta Mujhay Bhi Shah Aisa Jaam Ho Jaye

২২৯

Huzoor Jaante Hain

Jo Ho Chuka Hai Jo Hoga, Huzoor Jante Hain, Teri Aata Say Khudaya, Huzoor Jante Hain. Aie Ilm E Ghaib Kay Munkir Khuda Ko Dekha Hai? Aur Tujhay Bhi Kehna Padega, Huzoor Jante Hain. Munafiqoon Ka Aqeeda Woh Gaibdaan Nahin, Aur Sahabiyoon Ka Aqeeda, Huzoor Jante Hain. Woh Mominon Ki To Janoon Say Bhi Kareeb Huye, Kahan Say Kisnay Pukara, Huzoor Jante Hain. Haran Ye Kehne Lagi Chor De Mujhe Saiyaad, Mai Laut Aaungi Wallah, Huzoor Jante Hain. Haran Ne Oonth Ne Chiryoon Ne Ki Yehi Faryaad, Ke Unkay Gham Ka Madawa, Huzoor Jante Hain. Bula Rahe Hai Nabi Jaake Itna Bol Use Darakht Kaise Chale Ga, Huzoor Jante Hain. Kahan Marein Gay Abu Jahal O Utba O Sheiba, Ke Jang E Badr Ka Naqsha, Huzoor Jante Hain. Isiliye To Sulaya Hai Apne Pehlu Mein, Ke Yaar E Ghar Ka Rutba, Huzoor Jante Hain. Umar Nay Tan Say Juda Kar Diya Tha Sar Jis Ka, Woh Apna Hai Ke Paraya, Huzoor Jante Hain. Nabi Ka Faisla Na Maan Kar Woh Jaan Say Gaya, Mizaaj Umar Ka Hai Kaisa, Huzoor Jante Hain. Wohi Hai Paikar E Sharm O Haiya O Zul Nuraian, Maqaam Unki Haya Ka, Huzoor Jante Hain. Yeh Khud Shaheed Hain, Betay Nawasay Potay Shaheed, Ali Ki Shaan E Yagana, Huzoor Jante Hain. Hain Jiske Moula Huzoor Uske Hain Ali Moula, Abu Turab Ka Rutba, Huzoor Jante Hain. Main Unki Baat Karoon Yeh Nahin Meri Auqaat, Ke Shaan E Fatma Zahra, Huzoor Jante Hain. Jina Mein Kaun Hain Sardaar Nojawanoon Kay, Hasan, Hussain Ke Nana, Huzoor Jante Hain. Nahi Hai Zaad E Safar Pass Jin Ghulamoon Ke, Unhein Bhi Dar Pe Bulana, Huzoor Jante Hain. Khuda Hi Jaanay Ubaid Unko Hai Pata Kiya Kiya, Hamein Pata Hai Bus Itna, Huzoor Jante Hain. Malaika Ne Kiya Youn To Sajda Adam Ko, Dar Asal Kis Ko Tha Sajda, Huzoor Jante Hain. Woh Kitna Fasla Tha, Aur Kalaam Tha Kaisa, Aao Adna Aur Ma Aaoha, Huzoor Jante Hain. Milay Thay Rah Mein 9 Bar Kis Liye Musa, Yeh Deed E Haq Ka Bahana, Huzoor Jante Hain. Main Chup Khara Houn Mawaja Pay Sar Jhukaye Huye, Sunaoon Kaise Fasana, Huzoor Jante Hain. Chupa Rahe Hai Lagatar Mere Aiyboon Ko, Main Kis Qadar Houn Kameena, Huzoor Jante Hain. Main Unki Baat Karoun Yeh Nahin Meri Auqaat, Ke Shaan E Fatma Zahra, Huzoor Jante Hain. Jo Ho Chuka Hai Jo Hoga, Huzoor Jante Hain, Teri Aata Say Khudaya, Huzoor Jaante Hain. Khuda Ko Dekha Nahin Aur Eik Maan Liya, Ke Jantay Thay Sahaba, Huzoor Jantay Hein. Khabar Bhi Hai? Ke Khabar Sabki Hai Unhein Kab Say, Ke Jab Na Ab Tha Na Kab Tha, Huzoor Jante Hain.
