২৩০

Ik Baar Madiney Jaawa Mey

Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Ik Baar Madiney Jaawa Mey, Feyr Murkey Kadee Na Awaan Mey Lokee Labdey Phiran Meynu Galiya Dey Wich Kalee Kamlee Thaley Chup Jaawa Mey Kar Zikr Madiney Waley Da Ey Dey Wich Balaee Teri Ey Ik Baar Tu Hoja Sohna Da Feyr Saaree Khudaee Teri Ey Jittey Meray Nabi Da Deyra Ey Othey Reynda Sada Saweyra Ey Wich Qabr Dey Aqa Aakhan Gey Eynu Chad Deyo Ey Tey Meyra Ey Lajpaal Jida Rakwaala Ey O Nu Kaun Mitaawan Waala Ey Sadi Uss Sohney Nal Lag Gaey Ey Jera Toor Nibawan Walaa Ey Manmohney Nabi Makki Madani Ham Par Bhi Karam Farma Ja Na Teray Deed Key Pyasey Beytey Hai Meray Shaha Pyaas Bujaa Ja Na

২৩১

Ilahi Madad Kar Madad Ki Ghari Hai

Ilahi Madad Kar, Madad Ki Ghari Hai, Gunaahon Kay Darya Mein Kashti Phansi Hai. Mere Tan Pay Ghaflat Ki Chaadar Pari Hai, Nahoosat Gunaahon Ki Chaei Hui Hai, Yahi Baat Hum Nay Barhon Say Suni Hai, Na Ho Banagi Gar To Kia Zindagi Hai, Ae Abr-E-Karam Aa Baras Ja, Baras Ja, Ajab Aag Isyaan Ki Mujh Mein Lagi Hai, Nahi Pass Husn-E-Amal Meray Mola, Nazar Meri Tere Karam Per Lagi Hai, Ubaid-E-Raza Naikyon Say Hai Khali, Gunaahon Mein Hasil Ise Bartari Hai, Lab-E-Mustafa Say Khudaya Suna Day, Ubaid-E-Raza Naar Se Tu Bari Hai

২৩২

Imaan Hai Qaale Mustafayi

Imaan Hai Qaale Mustafayi Qur'ane Hai Haale Mustafayi Allah Hi Saltanat Ka Dulha Naqshe Timsaale Mustafayi Kul Se Baala Rusul Se Aa'la Ijlaalo Jalaale Mustafayi Ashaab Nujoome Rahnuma Hain Kashti Hai Aale Mustafayi Idbaar Se Tu Mujhe Bacha Le Pyare Iqbaale Mustafayi Mursal Mustaaqe Haq Hain Aur Haq Mushtaaqe Wisaale Mustafayi Khwahaane Wisaale Kibriyaa Hain Jooyaane Jamaale Mustafayi Allah Na Choote Daste Dil Se Daamaane Khayaale Mustafayi Hain Tere Sipurd Sab Ummeeden Aye Joodo Nawaale Mustafayi Raushan Kar Qabr Be Kaso(N) Ki Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Andher Hai Be Tere Mera Ghar Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Mujh Ko Shabe Gham Dara Rahi Hai Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Aankhon Mein Chamak Ke Dil Mein Aa Ja Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Meri Shabe Taar Din Bana De Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Chamka De Naseebe Bad Naseeba(N) Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Qazzaaq Hain Sar Pe Raah Gum Hai Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Chaaya Aankhon Tale Andhera Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Dil Sard Hai Apni Lau Lagaa De Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Ghanghor Ghataye Gham Ki Chaayi Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Bhatka Hoon Tu Raasta Bata Ja Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Fariyaad Dabaati Hai Siyaahi Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Mere Dile Muda Ko Jilaa De Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Aankhen Teri Raah Tak Rahi Hai Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Dukh Mein Hai Andheri Raat Wale Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Tareek Hai Raat Ghamzado Ki Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Ho Dono Jahaa(N) Mein Muh Ujaala Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Taareekiye Gor Se Bachana Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Purnoor Hai Tujh Se Bazme Aalam Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Hum Teerah Dilon Pe Bhi Karam Kar Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Lillah Idhar Bhi Koi Fera Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi Taqdeer Chamak Utthe Raza Ki Aye Sham'ae Jamaale Mustafayi

২৩৩

In Nilti Ya Ri Hassaba Yawman Ila Ardil Haram (Qaseeda Imam Zain Ul Abideen)

In Nilti Ya Ri Hassaba Yawman Ila Ardil Haram Balligh Salaami Rawdatan Fihan Nabiyyul Mohtaram Bade Saba Tera Guzar Ho Gar Kabhi So E Haram Roze Pe Le Jana Salaam Jis Me Nabi Hai Mohtaram Man Wajhohu Shamsud Doha Man Khadduhu Badrud Doja Man Zaa’tuhu Noorul Hoda Man Kaffuhu Bahrul Himam Chera Tera Shamsud Doha Ruqsaar Hai Badrud Doja Noor E Hida Yat Zaat Hai Aur Haat Hai Daste Karam In Nilti Ya Ri Hassaba Yawman Ila Ardil Haram Balligh Salaami Rawdatan Fihan Nabiyyul Mohtaram Jo Guzar Nasib Ho Aey Saba, Kisi Din Diyaare Hijaaz Mei(N) To Mera Salaame Niyaaz Kehna, Harime Bandaah Nawaaz Mei(N) Man Wajhohu Shamsud Doha Man Khadduhu Badrud Doja Man Zaa’tuhu Noorul Hoda Man Kaffuhu Bahrul Hamam Wohi Jinke Ruey Munir Par, Kisi Mehromaah Ka Gumaan Hai Tu Himam Ka Ik Yame Bekaraa(N), Hai Karam Ke Daste Daraaz Mei(N) Qur’anuhu Burhaanona Naskhan Le Adya Nim Madat Iz Jaa-Ana Ahkaamuhu Kullus Suhuf Saaral Adam Huey Fiskh Ehde Kohan Ke Deen, Woh Jo Laaey Qur’ane Mubi(N) Woh Dalile Roshano Aakhri(N), Ke Hai Deene Haqqe Jawaaz Mei(N) Akbado Na Majruhatun Min Sayfe Hijril Mustafa Tuba Le Aih’l-E Baldatin Fihan Nabiyyul Muhtasham Zahesa Kinaane Haram Jahaa(N), Shahe Do Jahaa(N) Ka Qayaam Hai Bara Dil Phigaar Hu(N) Mei(N) Yahaa(N), Ghame Hijre Sina Gudaaz Mei(N) Ya Laytani Kunto Kaaman Yattba’a Nabiyyan Aliman Yawman Wa Laylan Daaeman Warzuq Kazaali Bil Karam Aey Khusha Woh Mo’mine Khush Amal, Ke Muti-Aey Hukme Rasool Hai Hai Yeh Aarzoo Meri Zindagi, Bhi Ho Waqf Sharaaey Niyaaz Mei(N) Li Hasratun Isma’a Kazaalema Lam Aasefil Mustafa Fi Kulle Hi-Nin Qad Mada Fil Haale Ma Yahsul Behim Thi Azal Se Dil Mei(N) Tarap Yehi, Ke Ho Madd-Ha Shaane Hazoor Ki Hui Harfo Saut Se Aashna, Jo Fugaa(N) Thi Pardaaey Saaz Mei(N) Lasto Berajin Mufradan Bal Aqrebaee Kullohum Fil Qabre Shifa’a Ya Shaafio Bissaade Wan Nunil Qalam May(N) Aur Sab Mere Aqraba, Hai(N) Ik Shafa’at Ke Gada Ho(N) Ba Saado Nuno Qalam Ata, Woh Lahad Ki Manzile Raaz Mei(N) Ya Mustafa, Ya Mujtaba, Irham Ala Isyaanena Majburatun Aamaalona, Tam-An Wazanban Wazzulm Karam Aey Shahewaala, Hasham Ke Hai(N), Aaj Muntazire Karam Woh Asire Gham Ke Shikasta Par, Hai(N) Gunaah Ke Daamane Aaz Mei(N) Ya Rahmatan Lil Aa’lameen Anta Shafiul Muznebin Akrim Lana Yawmal Hazina Fadlan Wajudow Wal Karam Sare Hashr Aap Ke Haath Hai, Mere Hashr-O-Nasr Ki Aabru Ke Kalide Rehmate, Do Jahaa(N), Hai Nabi Ke Daste Majaaz Mei(N) Ya Rahmatan Lil Aa’lameen Adrik Le Zaynil Abedeen Mahbuse Aydiz Zaalemin Fil Mawkabe Wal Muzdaham Lillaah Zaynil Abedeen, Pe Bhi Nigaahe Lutfe Huzoor Ho Ke Sitam Nasib Rahine Gham, Hai Udu Ki Qaide Daraaz Mei(N)

২৩৪

Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada

Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada Jo Karam Mujpe Mere Nabi Ne Kiya Main Sajata Tha Sarkar Ki Mehafile Mujko Har Gam Se Rab Ne Bari Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Lamha Lamha Hai Mujpar Nabi Ki Ata Dosto Or Mangu Main Maula Se Kya Kya Ye Kam Hai Ke Mere Khuda Ne Muje Apne Mehbub Ka Ummati Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Zikr Sarkar Ki Hai Bari Barkate Mil Gai Rahate Azamate Rifa-Ate Main Gunahgaar Tha Be-Amal Tha Magar Mustafa(Saw) Ne Muje Jannati Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Jo Dare Mustafa(Saw) Ke Daga Ho Gae Dekhte Dekhate Kya Se Kya Ho Gae Aisi Chasme Karam Hai Sarkar Ne Har Daga Ko Shafi Ne Wali Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Koy Mayus Lota Na Darbar Se Jo Bhi Manga Mila Mere Sarkar Se Sadake Jau ‘niyazi’ Mai Lajpal Ke Dono Aalam Mai Mujko Sakhi Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Jo Bhi Aaya Hai Mehfil Main Sarkaar Ki, Haazari Mil Gaee Jiss Ko Darbaar-E-Ki, Koee Siddeeq-E-Farooq, Usmaan Huwe, Aur Kissee Ko Nabi Nay Ali Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr……………………… Mere Shaahe Madina Ki Kya Baat Hai, Un Ki Dar Say Millee Sab Ko Khairaat Hai, Sadqay Jaaon Nay-Yaazi Main Lajpaal Kay, Har Gadaa Ko Sakheenay Sakhee Kar Diya Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr………………………

২৩৫

Ishk E Ahmed Rang Lana Chahiye

Ishk-E-Ahmed Rang Lana Chahiye Ab Unhe Surat Dikhana Chahiye Peeliya Hai Jab Maye Ishq-E-Nabi Hosh Me Hargis Na Aana Chahiye Khaja-E-Alam Ka Daaman Mil Gaya Daaman Ab Sab Se Bachana Chahiye Aagayi Hai Sarhad-E-Sher E Nabi Wajd Me Ab Hamko Aana Chahiye Lab Pe Aaye Jab Bhi Naam-E-Mustafa Be Khudi Me Doob Jaana Chahiye Ek Dil Hai Ek Ki Ulfat Mile Ek Zubaa(N) Hai Ek Fasaana Chahiye Jaane Kis Rukh Se Chale Aaye Nabi Har Taraf Aankhen Bichana Chahiye Apne Bal Par Koun Jaata Hai Waha Bas Muqaddar Aazmana Chahiye Naatiya Ash'aar Keh Kar Muttaqui Apne Rab Se Daad Paana Chahiye

২৩৬

Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar

Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jaein Jab Afkaar To Khulte Hein Ghulaamon Pe Wo Asraar Ke Rehte Hein Wo Tawseef Sanaae Shahe Abraar Me Har Lehzaa Guhar Baar Warna Wo Sayyide Aale Nasabi Han Wohi Ummi Laquabi Hashmi O Muttalabi O ‘arabi O Farashi O Madani Aur Kahan Hamse Gunahgaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Aarzoo Ye He Ke Ho Qualb Muattar Wo Mutahhar Wo Munawwar Wo Mujalla Wo Musaffa Durehaalaa Jo Nazar Aae Kahin Jalwaae Roue Shahe Abraar Jin Ke Qadmon Ki Chamak Chaand Sitaaron Me Nazar Aae Jidhar Se Wo Guzar Jaae Wohi Raah Chamak Jae Damak Jae Mahak Jae Bane Rawnaque Gulzaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Soung Loun Khushbue Gesue Muhammad Wo Siya Zulf Nahin Jis Ke Muquaabil Ye Banafsha Ye Suyunti Ye Chambeli Ye Gule Laalaa O Champaa Ka Nikhaar Jis Ki Nakhat Pe Hein Qurbaan Gulo Bargo Saman Naafaae Aahoue Khutan Bade Chaman Buwe Chaman Naaze Chaman Noure Chaman Range Chaman Saaraa Chaman Zaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Ik Shahanshah Ne Bakhshe Jo Samarkand O Bukhaaraa Kissi Mahboub Ke Rukhsaar Ke Til Par Magar Eh Sayyade Aali Teri Namos Teri Azmat Par Aey Rasul E Madani Eik Nahin Laakhon Hein Qurbaan Gahe Ishq Ke Har Kuchao Bazaar Me Sar Apnaa Hatheli Pe Liye Phirte Hein Karne Ko Nisaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Aap Ke Zikr Me Hein Dam Masaalaa Sare Huda Kawne Arab Naghma Nigaaraane Ajam Shawkate Alfaaz Adab Azmate Kirtaas O Qalam Baate Sabaa Mohje Naseen Dahne Bulbule Shiri Lahane Umriyo Toti Shafe Mahtaab Sitaare Malak O Hour Jinaa Jin Ki Nawahon Me Duroodon Ka Hisaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Warafahnaa Lakazikrak Ki Iss Aayaa E Tawseef Ki Tawseef Me Tafseer Me Tashreekh Me Tawzikh Me Tanween Me Har Ehd Ki Shaamil He Zabaan. Labe Hassan O Ravaahaa Wo Labe Fatimah Zahraa Wo Ali Aabide Bimaar Busairi Dahane Ourtiyo Jaame Labe Sahti O Razaa Sab Sar Shaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jaae Muhajir Ho Ke Pakhtoun Balonchi Ho Ke Punjabi O Sindhi Kissi Khitte Ki Kabile Ki Zaban Isse Nahin Koyi Sarokaar Jaamae Ishqe Muhammad Jo Pehenletaa He Har Haar Ko Wo Phool Banaa Letaa He Dunyaa Ko Jhukaaletaa He Kartaa He Zamaane Ko Muhabbat Ka Shikaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Ye Muhaajir Ki He Saf Aur Ye Punjabi Ki Pakhtoun Ki Sindhi Ki Balonchi Ki Juda Par Ke Dikhao To Kissi Shehr Ki Masjid Me Kabhi Eisi Namaz Harame Kaabaa Me Arafaat Ke Maidaan Me Ya Rawza-E-Sarkaar Pe Kyun Shaane Milaate Wahan Karte Nahin Rang Ka Aur Nasl Katum Apni Shoumaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Yaa Nabi ! Aap Ka Ye Adbi Sanaakhwane Dare Rahmat Ka Gada Detaa He Dar Dar Ye Sadaa Detaa He Aap Se Chaahat Ka Salaa Apni Zaban Me Taasir Soun Ke Sab Ahle Chaman Ous Ka Sukhan Oun Ko Bhi Aajaae Hayaa Sar Ho Nidaamat Se Jhukaa Aur Nazar Dekhe Wo Islaaf Ki Oulfat Ka Nazaaraa Eik Baar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar Eh Aadeeb! Ab Youn Hi Alfaaz Ke Ambaar Me Ham Doubte Reh Jaein Magar Haqqe Sanaa Goyi Adaa Phir Bhi Naa Kar Paein Ye Jazbaat O Zabaan O Kalam O Fikr O Khayaal Oun Ki Midhat To Malaaik Ka Wazifaa He Sahaaba Ka Tariqaa Heibaadat Ka Saleeqaa He Ye Khaaliq Ka Pasandeeda He Quraan Ka He Iss Me Shyaar Ishq Ke Rang Me Rang Jao Mere Yaar

২৩৭

Itna Kaafi Hai Zindagi Ke Liye

Itna Kaafi Hai Zindagi Ke Liye Rakh Le Aaqa Jo Naukri Ke Liye Tak Ke Unko Ayyub Ke Ghar Mein Mahel Tarse Hain Jhonpdi Ke Liye Aa Gaye Qabr Mein Bhi Chhurwaane Dard Kitna Hai Ummati Ke Liye Lambe Sajde Kiye Nabi Ne Kaha Aye Nawaase Teri Khushi Ke Liye Chaand Taare Bhi Unke Qadmon Mein Roz Aate Hain Roshni Ke Liye Doobe Suraj Ko Phirse Paltaaya Apne Pyare Maula Ali Ke Liye Khud Darakht Bhi Jadein Ukhade Aate Hain Paas Unke Haazri Ke Liye Mehfile Amaad Saji Rahe Ta Umar Iltija Yehi Hai Zindagi Ke Liye Aye Kash Aaye Woh Maqaam Bhi Jiye Bas Ham Aaqa Ki Aashiqui Ke Liye Deed Maangi Hai Unki Aye Haakim Maine Bas Waqte Aakhri Ke Liye

২৩৮

Jaam Ulfat Ka Pilado Ya Rasool

Jaam Ulfat Ka Pilado Ya Rasool Apna Deewana Banado Ya Rasool Meri Qismat Ko Jagaa Do Ya Rasool Ek Jhalak Apni Dikha Do Ya Rasool Khwaab Me Tashreef La Kar Ek Baar Deed Ka Sharbat Pilaa Do Ya Rasool Umr Bhar Teri Sanaa Khwaani Karu Har Rukaawat Ko Hataa Do Ya Rasool Aa Gaya Beemaar Aye Mere Tabeeb To Shifaaye Kaamila Do Ya Rasool Woh Kabhi Bhi Uth Nahi Sakta Jise Tum Nigaahon Se Giraa Do Ya Rasool Umr Isiyaan Ke Sabab Barbaad Hai Tum Khataaye Bakshwa Do Ya Rasool Na Kahu Tum Se To Phir Kis Se Kahu Meri Bigdi Ko Banaa Do Ya Rasool Baksh Dega Har Khata Meri Khuda Tum Zara Lab Ko Hilaa Do Ya Rasool Chaand Ko Ungli Se Mehde Paak Me Jis Taraf Chaaho Jhuka Do Ya Rasool Tum Jo Chaho To Phira Kar Shams Ko Raat Ko Bhi Din Bana Do Ya Rasool Sooi Mil Jaaye Andhera Bhi Ho Gar Tum Jo Aa Kar Muskura Do Ya Rasool Tum Jo Aa Kar Muskura Do Ya Rasool Gair Ke Dar Par Mai Jaau Kis Liye Jab Talab Se Tum Siwaa Do Ya Rasool Hai Bada Weeran Shaha Qalbe Ubaid Apne Jalwon Se Basaa Do Ya Rasool

২৩৯

Jab Gumbad E Khazra Ke Anwaar Nazar Aye

Jab Gumbad-E-Khazra Ke Anwaar Nazar Aye Anwaar Ke Jhurmat Mein Sarkar Nazar Aye Taiba Ke Tasawwur Ne Jeene Ka Maza Bakhsha Main Kaise Kahoon Jeena Dushwaar Nazar Aye Naghmat Daroodon Ke Honton Pe Hue Jaari Jab Shehr-E-Muhabbat Ke Aasar Nazar Aye Makke Se Madine Tak Mehdood Nahi Jalwe Ushaak Ko Har Janib Sarkar Nazar Aye Aankhein Meri Roshan Ho Jayein Jigar Thanda Jis Waqt Mujhe Mera Manthar Nazar Aye

২৪০

Jab Gumbad E Khizra Pe Woh Pehli Nazar Gayi

Jab Gumbad-E-Khizra Pe Woh, Pehli Nazar Gayi, Aankhon Kay Raastay Meray Dil Mein Uttar Gayi. Sar Kham Tha, Lab Khamoosh Thay, Aankhein Thein Ashkbaar, Ik Sa’at-E-Bedaar Thei Jou Ke Guzar Gayi. Barsi Thei Iss Qadar, Ke Naha Sa Gaya Udher, Woh Barish-E-Karam Mere Daaman Ko Bhar Gayi. Dil Bhi Hai Shad Shad, Tabiyat Hai Pur Bahar, Lagta Hai Aaj Meri Madinay Khabar Gai. Jo Keh Sakaa Na Lab Say, Mili Woh Murad Bhi, Mere Sukoot Per Bhi Shaha Ki Nazar Gayi. Taiba Se Lautna, Kissi Aashiq Se Puchiye, Aisa Lagay Kay Rooh Badan Say Guzar Gayi. Awaz Ubaid Teri Ba Faizan-E-Naat Hee, Seenoon Mein Aashiqan Nabi (Saw) Kay Utar Gayi. Mar Kar Bhi Na Marunga Mai Allah Ki Qasam, Yeh Jaan Unke Zikr Mey Meri Agar Gayee.

২৪১

Jab Husn Tha Unka Jalwa Numa Anwaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga

Jab Husn Tha Unka Jalwa Numa Anwaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Har Koee Fida Hai Bin Dekhe, Deedaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jis Waqt The Qidmat Me Unki, Abubakar Omar Usman Ali Us Waqt Rasool-E-Akram Kay, Darbaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Ek Simt Ali Ek Simt Umar, Siddiq Idhar Uthmaan Udhar In Jug Mug Jug Mug Taraun May, Sarkaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jis Waqt Haleemah Ki Godi, Anwaare Khuda Say Raushan Thi Us Waqt Haleemah Daee Kay, Ghar Baar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jab Inke Gada Bhar Detay Hain, Shahaanay Zamana Ki Jholi Mohtaaj Ka Jab Yeh Alam Ha, Mukhtaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Chahay To Ishaaraun Say Apne, Kaya Hi Palat Day Duniya Ki Yeh Shaan Hai Unke Ghulamau’n Ki, Sardaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Sun Sun Kay Sahaba Ki Batein, Kuffar Musalmaan Hotay Thay Phir Mere Rasool-E-Akram Ki, Guftaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Taibah Say Hawaein Atee Hai Baikal Ko Sukoon Mil Jata Hai Iss Paar Ka Jab Yeh Alam Hai, Uss Paar Ka Alam Kya Hoga

২৪২

Jab Ke Paida Hue Hai Hamare Nabi

Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Jab Ke Paida Hue Hai Hamare Nabi Bhole Bhale Nabi Pyare Pyare Nabi Dono Aalam Ki Ankhon Ke Taare Nabi Apne Naazuk Laboun Se Pukare Nabi Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Jab Sataane Lage Kafir-O-Mushrikeen Haq Ta'ala Ne Farmaya Ae Shah-E-Deen Tum Kaho To Karoon Inko Gharat Yahi Bole Hazrat Nahi Ye Na Hoga Kabhi Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Is Qadar Thi Mohabbat Ki Khairul Bashar Rakh Ke Sajde Me Sar Hogae Chashm Tar Kehte The Aye Khuda Malik O Behrobar Baqsh Do Ummat Ko Hai Dua Ye Meri Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Toli Jaegi Jis Waqt Neki Badi Phir Na Hargiz Sune Ga Kisi Ki Koi Nafsi Nafsi Pukare Ge Saare Nabi Aap Us Waqt Bhi Kehte Honge Yahi Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Inko Ankhein Tu De Mujhko Pehchan Le Mujhko Pehchan Le Tujhko Bhi Jaan Le Sidq Teri Sadaaqat Ko Pehchan Le Tu Khila De Mere Maula Dil Ki Kali Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati Ummati

২৪৩

Jab Masjid E Nabawi Kay Miinaar Nazar Aay

Jab Masjid E Nabawi Kay Miinaar Nazar Aa-Ay Allah Ki Rahmat Kay Aasaar Nazar Aa-Ay Bas Yaad Raha Itna Siinay Say Lagi Jaali Phir Yaad Nahiin Kya Kya Anwaar Nazar Aa-Ay Makkay Ki Fiza-On Mayn Teba Ki Hawa-On Mayn Ham Nay To Jidhar Daykha Sarkaar Nazar Aa-Ay Makkay Se Madine Tak Mehdoon Nahi Jalwe Ushaaq Ko Har Janib Sarkaar Nazar Aa-Ay Chhorr Aaya Zahoori Meyn Dil O Jaan Madinay Mayn Ab Jiina Yahaan Mujh Ko Dushwaar Nazar Aa-Ay Taiba Ki Ziyarat Ne Jeene Ka Mazaa Baqsha Mai Kaise Kahoon Jeena Dhuwaar Nazar Aa-Ay Manzar Ho Bayaan Kesay Alfaaz Nahiin Miltay Jiss Waqt Muhammad Ka Darbaar Nazar Aa-Ay Dukh Dard Kay Maaron Ko Gham Yaad Nahiin Rehtay Jab Saamnay Aankhon Kay Gham-Khuar Nazar Aa-Ay

২৪৪

Jagaa Do Meri Qismat Bhi Khudara Ya Rasulullah

Jagaa Do Meri Qismat Bhi Khudara Ya Rasulullah Dikhado Mujh Ko Rozah Ka Nazarah Ya Rasulullah Tumahara Naam-E-Naami Hai Sukoon-E-Qalb Ka Ba’is Nazar Ka Noor Hai Rozah Tumhara Ya Rasulullah Meri Duniya Sanwar Jaey Meri ‘uqba Sadhar Jaey Agar Ho Jaey Rahmat Ka Isharah Ya Rasulullah Zamanah Choot Jaey Ruth Jaey Khalq To Kya Gham Na Choote Haath Sey Daman Tumharah Ya Rasulullah Jabeen-E-Showq Mas Hoti Hai Jab Rowzah Ki Jaali Sey Chamak Jata Hai Qismat Ka Sitarah Ya Rasulullah Tamana-E-Sikandar Hai Dam-E-Aakhar Shah-E-Bat-Ha Rahey Wird-E-Zuban Kalmah Tumhara Ya Rasulullah

২৪৫

Jahan Roza E Pak E Khairul Wara Hai

Jahan Roza E Pak E Khairul Wara Hai Wo Jannat Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai Kahaan Mai Kahaan Yeh Madine Ke Galiyaan Yeh Qisamt Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai Muhammed (Saw) Ki Azmath Ko Kya Poochte Ho Ke Wo Sahibe Qaba Qausain Tehre Bashar Ki Sare Arsh Mehmaan Nawazi Yeh Azmath Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai Jo Aasi Ko Kamli Me Apne Chupa Le Jo Dushman Ko Bhi Zakhm Khakar Dua De Use Aur Kya Naam Dega Zamana Wo Rehmat Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai Qayamat Ka Ek Din Muaiyan Hai Lekin Hamare Liye Har Nafas Hai Qayamat Madine Se Hum Jaan Nisaraun Ki Doori Qayamat Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai Tum Iqbal Yeh Naat Kehto Rahe Ho Magar Yeh Bhi Soncha Ke Kya Kar Rahe Ho Kahaan Tum Kahaan Madhe Mamduhe Yazdaan Ye Jurrat Nahi Hai To Phir Aur Kya Hai

২৪৬

Jald Ham Aazmi E Gulzar E Madina Honge

Jald Ham Aazmi-E-Gulzar-E-Madina Honge Hazir-E-Dargah-E-Sardar-E-Madina Honge Sabz Gumbad Ki Waha Khub Bahare Hongi Rubaru Phir Mere Minar-E-Madina Honge Wajd Aajaiga Khismat Ko Bhi Us Dam Walla Samne Jab Mere Sarkar-E-Madina Honge Khafile Ki Yuun Madine Se Judai Hogi Muztar O Gham Zada Zaw'ar-E-Madine Honge Mere Sarkar Ka Aaiga Bulawa Unko Jo Koi Dil Se Talab Gaar-E-Madina Honge Hashar Se Kyun Ho Pareshaan Gunah Gaaro Tum Apne Haami Waha Sarkar-E-Madina Honge Hashar Me Jainge Attar Yu Inshallah Apni Darhi Me Saje Khaar-E-Madina Honge Hashr Ka Qouf Na Rakho Aae Ghulam-E-Nabi Apne Haami Waha Sarkar-E-Madina Honge Ab To Noorani Chaman Zaar-E-Madina Honge Samne Ab Mere Kohsar-E-Madina Honge Unki Rahmat Se Jo Miljai Baqi-E-Markhad Bil Haqeeqat Qabr Me Anwar-E-Madina Honge Unko Haasil Mere Aqa Ki Shafaat Hogi Jo Koi Hazir-E-Darbar-E-Madina Honge

২৪৭

Jalwa E Janaan (Junaid Jamsheed)

Jalwa-E-Janaan, Jalwa-E-Janaan Jalwa-E-Janaan, Jalwa-E-Janaan Maula Yaa Salli Wa Sallim Da’aiman Abadan Ala Habibika Khairi Khlaqi Kulli’ini Na Koi Aap Sa Ho Ga Na Koi Aap Jesa Tha Koi Yusaf Say Poochay Mustafa Ka Husn Kaisa Tha Zameen-O-Aasmaan Main Koi Bhi Misaal Na Mili Maula Yaa Salli Wa Sallim Da’aiman Abadan Ala Habibika Khairi Khlaqi Kulli’ini Daleel-E-Zindagi Wo Hain Kamaal-E-Bandagi Wo Hain Koi Bhi Daur Ho Us Main Meraj-E-Aadmi Wo Hain Wohi Toh Deen-O-Duniya Hai Jo Baatain Aap Nay Kahin Maula Yaa Salli Wa Sallim Da’aiman Abadan Ala Habibika Khairi Khlaqi Kull’ini Rasulullah Habibulllah Imam Al Mursaleen Rasulullah Habibulllah Imam Al Mursaleen Koi Bhi Baat Ho Har Hukm Unka Mutabar Aisa Kay Un Ka Haan Nahin Kehna Bhi Hai Quran Kay Jesa Hadith-E-Paak Kehlaain Jo Baatein Aap Nay Kahin Maula Yaa Salli Wa Sallim Da’aiman Abadan Ala Habibika Khairi Khlaqi Kull’ini Durrod Un Par Salaam Un Par Yehi Kehna Khuda Ka Hai Khuda Kay Baad Jo Hai Martaba Salle Ala Ka Hai Wohi Sardaar-E-Alam Hain Wohi Gham`khwaar-E-Ummat Hian Wohi Toh Hashar Kay Maidan Main Sab Ki Shifa’at Hain Shifa’at Kay Liye Sab Ki Nazar Un Par Lagi Ho Ge Maula Yaa Salli Wa Sallim Da’aiman Abadan Ala Habibika Khairi Khlaqi Kulli’ini

২৪৮

Jannat Mein Lay Kay Jaey Ghi Chahat Rasool Ki

Kyun Kar Na Meray Dil Mein Ho Ulfat Rasool Ki, Jannat Mein Lay Kay Jaey Ghi Chahat Rasool Ki. Chalta Hoon Mein Be Qafelay Walo Ruko Zara, Milnay Do Bus Mujhay Bhi Ijazat Rasool Ki. Phochain Jo Deen-O-Iman Nakerain Qabr Mein Us Waqt Meray Lab Pay Ho Midhat Rasool Ki. Qabr Mein Sarkar Aayein To Mein Qadmoon Mein Giroon, Gar Farishtay Bhi Uthaein To Mein Unsay Yoon Kahoon, Ab To Paye Naaz Say Mein Aye Farishto Kyon Uthoon, Mar Kay Pohncha Hoon Yahan Is Dilruba Kay Wastay. Tarpa Kay Un Kay Kadmoon Mein Mujh Ko Gira Day Shok, Jis Waqt Ho Lahad Mein Ziyarat Rasool Ki. Sarkar Nay Bula Kay Madina Dikha Dia, Ho Ghi Mujhay Naseeb, Shafa’at Rasool Ki. Ya Rab Dikha Day Aaj Ki Shab Jalwa E Habib, Ik Bar To Aata Ho Ziarat Rasool Ki. In Ankh Ka Warna Koi Hasrat Hi Nahin Hai, Sarkar Tumhara Woh Khazaiba Nazar Aaye, Ya Rab Dikha Day Aaj Ki Shab Jalwa E Habib, Ik Bar To Aata Ho Ziarat Rasool Ki. Damen Mein Un Kay Lay Lo Pannah Aaj Munkiro, Mahengi Paray Ghi Warna Adawat Rasool Ki. To Hai Ghulam Un Ka Ubad-E-Raza Teray, Mahshar Mein Ho Ghi Saath Himayat Rasool Ki. Kyun Kar Na Meray Dil Mein Ho Ulfat Rasool Ki. Jannat Mein Lay Kay Jaey Ghi Chahat Rasul Ki.

২৪৯

Jashn E Meelad Hum Manaaenge

Jashn E Meelad Hum Manaaenge Rab Se Sadqa Nabi Ka Paaenge Door Dil Ki Siyahee Karne Ko Mehfil E Na’at Ham Sajaaenge Aaj Ki Shab Hai Rehmaton Ki Shab Rab Ki Rehmat Me Hum Nahaaenge Dekh Kar Qabr Me Huzoor Ko Hum Na’at E Salle ‘alaa Sunaaenge Maang Deewane Unse Taiba Ko Sadqe Meelad Ke Bulaaenge Paak Karle Nigaah Ashkon Se Aaqa Jalwah Tujhe Dikhaaenge Kaash Farmade Hashr Me Aaqa Aaja Shakir Tujhe Bachaaenge

২৫০

Jashne Amade Rasool Allah Hi Allah

Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Jab Kay Sarkaar Tashreef Laane Lage, Huro Gilma Bhi Khusiyan Manaane Lage Har Taraf Noor Ki Rosheni Chagayi, Mustafa Kiya Milay Zindagi Milgayi, Aie Halima Teri Goad Mein Aa Gaye, Dono Alam Ke Rasool, Allah Hee Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Chehra-E-Mustafa Jab Dikhaya Gaya Jhook Gaye Taarey Aur Chaand Sharmaa Gaya Amina Dekh Kar Muskuraney Lageen Hawwa Maryam Bhi Khushiyaan Manane Lageen Amina Bibi Sub Se Kehney Lageen Dua Ho Gayi Qabul, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Shaadiyaaney Khoshi Ke Bajaaey Gaaey Shaadi Ke Naghmey Sab Ko Sonaaney Gaaey Har Taraf Shaur Salli ‘ala Hogaya Aaj Paida Habib-E-Khuda Hogaya Phir Tu Jibreel Ne Bhi Ye Ailan Kiyaa Ye Khudaa Ke Hain Rasul, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Unka Saya Zameen Par Na Paya Gaya Noor Se Noor Dekho Juda Na Hua Hum Ko Abid Nabi Par Bada Naaz Hai Kya Bhala Mere Aqa Ka Andaaz Hai Jisne Rukh Par Mali Wo Shifa Pa Gaya Khak-E-Taiba Teri Dhool, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Noor Ki Tann Gaeen Chaadrain Chaarsoon Hoor-O-Gilmaan Ki Poori Hoii Arzoo Mustafa Mujtaba Shah-E-Kono Mukaam Rub Ki Sarkaar Jub Hogaey Roh Baroh Phir Khuda Ne Khaha Mere Mahboob Tum Ho Rasuloon Ke Rasul, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Farsh Se Arsh Tak Noor Ka Hai Samaa Laaey Tashreef Doniyan Main Khair-Ul-Waraa Aasi Ummat Ki Kismal Sawarney Lagii Barishain Rehmatoon Ki Barasney Lageen Ay Haleema Teri Looriyoon Keyliye Rabb Ke Aagaey Rasul, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Boodd Girey Tooth Kar Khaaq Main Attak Gaaey Kufr Ke Phele Baadal Sabhi Chatt Gaey Jub Rukh-E-Mustafa Ki Pari Roshni Ye Zameenon Zamaan Khood Main Butt Gaaey Hoor-O-Gilman Malaik Sabhi Aaj Hain Zikr Ahmed Main Mashgool, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Chehra Quraan Ki Tafseer Hai Noor Hi Noor Hai Haq Ki Tasveer Hai Mussaf-E-Mustafa Ke Oojaalon Ke Rung Rehmatoon Se Sajii Ek Tasveer Hai Jaane Kaunay Ju Hai Shafee-Ul-Waraa Aysey Piyaare Hain Rasul, Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah Unki Khaatir Ye Dunya Banaai Gai Dono Aalam Ki Har Shay Sajaai Gai Wo Jo Aae Jahan Me Bahaar Aagaee Har Taraf Rehmato Ki Ghata Chaa Gai Aise Banke Aae Phool Allahi Allah Jashne Amade Rasool, Allah Hi Allah Bibi Amna Ke Phool, Allah Hi Allah

২৫১

Jashne Nabi Se Pyar Hai

Jashne Nabi Se Pyar Hai Hamme Jashne Nabi Se Pyar Hai Aamad Hai Mebhoob-E-Khuda Ki Sab Ka Bera Paar Hai Mubarak Ho Mohammad Mustafa Tashreef Lei Aye Abbhie Jibreal Utre Bhi Na The Ka’abe Ke Mimbar Se Ke Itne Mein Sada Ayi Ye Abdullah Ke Ghar Se Tahashar Sada Gunje Ghi Youn Sale Ala Ke Tarane Aate Hai Horu Malaik Aamad Ka Jashane Manane Seine Pei Tasveere Madina Rab Pei Darood Ka Haar Hai Mitha Hai Naam-E-Mohammad Mithi Hai In Ki Boli Deedar-E-Mohammad Karne Aye Nabiyoun Ki Toli Aalaane Khuda Khud Karta Hai Ye Mera Shahkaar Hai Jab Rehmat Ban Kar Aya Wo Amina Bi Ka Pyara Hai Donno Jahan Mein Chamka Wo Arsh Bari Ka Tara Mera Aqa Noor Hedayat Ka Roshan Minaar Hai Dar Dar Na Jao Gadao Sarkar Se Mang Ke Dekho Gham Mith Jaye Gei Sare Gham Khaar Se Mang Ke Dekho Dei De Gein Hasnaain Ka Sadqa Ye To Sakhi Darbar Hai Hazir Nazir Hai Aqa Bas Ye Mera Imaan Hai Tum Kalma Par Ke Dekho Kalma Is Ki Pehchaan Hai Aane Uthe Ke Dekh Zara Khud Rab Ka Ye Iqraar Hai Wara Faana La Ka Zikrak Ki Quraan Bhi Sada Deta Hai Rashid Ye Karam Kya Kam Hai Tu Un Ki Sana Karta Hai Pyar Nabi Ke Karne Wala Jannat Ka Haq Daar Hai

২৫২

Jis Ka Koi Saani Nahi Wo Nabi Hamara Hai

Jis Ka Koi Saani Nahi Wo Nabi Hamara Hai Mustafa Ki Azmat Ka Had Hai Na Kinaara Hai Zor Par Ho Tufaa(N) Bhi Aur Dagmagaayi Nayya Bhi Aap Gar Karam Kar De To Saamne Kinaara Hai Is Ummeed Par Mein Bhi Aa Khada Hu Chaukhat Par Wo Kabhi To Poochenge Kaun Gham Ka Maara Hai Jo Habeebe Daawar Hai Jo Makeene Khizra Hai Sayyida Ka Baba Hai Amina Ka Pyaara Hai Aap Ki Hi Chaukhat Ke Ya Nabi Bhikaari Hai Aap Hi Ke Tukdon Pe Ya Nabi Guzaara Hai Naat-E-Mustafa Sunli Naat-E-Mustafa Padli Mai Ne Apni Zindagi Ka Waqt Yun Guzaara Hai Hum Ko Bhi Ataa Kardo Sadqa Apne Yaaron Ka Aap Ke Siwa Aqa Koun Ab Hamaara Hai Bhoole Na Niyaazi Kabhi Bhool Kar Bhi Yaade Nabi Un Ko Bhool Jaana Hi Asal Main Khasaara Hai Har Ghadi Rulata Hai Bhool Ta Nahi Mujhko Mustafa Ke Qadmo Me Waqt Jo Guzaara Hai

২৫৩

Jis Ke Khatir Ye Quran Nazil Hua

Jis Ke Khatir Ye Quran Nazil Hua Wo Muhammad Madine Me Moujood Hai Hum Ne Ankhon Se Dekha Nahi Hai Magar Unki Tasveer Sine Me Moujood Hai In Hawao Se Kehdo Na Aaye Idhar Aisi Khushbu Ki Mujhko Zaroorat Nahi Jis Ki Khushbu Se Mehka Hai Sara Jahan Wo Nabi Ke Pasine Me Moujood Hai Garmi Roz-E-Mehshar Sataye Gi Kya Mujko Naar-E-Jahannam Jalaye Gi Kya Pura Quran Nahi Ek Aayat Sahi Har Musalman Ke Sine Me Moujood Hai Aabe Zamzam Ko Pine Chale Dosto Aao Aao Madine Chale Dosto Bheek Lene Karam Ki Chale Dosto Aao Aao Madine Chale Dosto Phool Khilte Hai Padh Padh Ke Salle Ala Jhoom Kar Keh Rahi Hai Ye Bade Saba Aisi Khushbu Gulo Ke Chaman Me Kaha Jo Nabi Ke Pasine Me Moujood Hai Maine Mana Ke Jannat Bohot Hai Haseen Chor Kar Mai Madina Najaoun Kahi Yun To Jannat Me Sab Hai Madina Nahi Aur Jannat Madine Me Moujood Hai Chorna Tera Taiba Gawara Nahi Sari Duniya Me Aisa Nazara Nahi Aisa Manzar Zameen Pe Na Dekha Kahi Jaisa Manzar Madine Me Moujood Hai Jabke Toofan Safine Se Takra Gaya Mai Ne Us Se Ye Be Saqta Keh Diya Kya Bigare Ga Tu Kashti E Deen Ka Na Khuda Jab Safine Me Moujood Hai

২৫৪

Jis Taraf Chashme Muhammad Ke Ishaare Ho Gaye

Jis Taraf Chashme Muhammad Ke Ishaare Ho Gaye Jitne Zarre Saamne Aaye Sitaare Ho Gaye /(Or) Jis Taraf Nazarein Utahi Sab Tumhaare Ho Gaye Doob Ne Walo Ne Jab Naam-E-Muhammad Le Liya Halka-E-Toofan Me Haasil Kinaare Ho Gaye Ya Muhammad Aap Ki Nazaron Ka Ye Ajaaz Hai Jitne Zarre Saamne Aaye Sitaare Ho Gaye /(Or) Jis Taraf Nazarein Utahi Sab Tumhaare Ho Gaye Mauja-E-Toofan Me Naam-E-Muhammad Le Liya Doob Ti Kashti Ke Tinke Bhi Sahaare Ho Gaye Main Hoon Aur Yaadein Madina Aur Hai Tanhaaiyaan Apne Begaane Sabhi Mujh Se Kinaare Ho Gaye Apni Kamli Ka Zara Saaya Inaayat Ho Mujhe Dil Ke Dushman Ja Muhammad Dil Se Pyaare Ho Gaye Sabz Ghumbad Ke Ishaare Sagar Marhaba Jag Maga Kar Zindagi Ke Maah Paare Ho Gaye

২৫৫

Jitna Diya Sarkar Ne Mujhko Utni Meri Auqat Nahi

Jitna Diya Sarkar Ne Mujhko Utni Meri Auqat Nahi Yeh To Karam Hain Unka Varna Mujh Mein To Aisi Baat Nahi Tu Bhi Wahin Par Jake Jahaa Par Sab Ki Bhigri Banti Hain Ik Teri Taqdeer Bana Na Unke Liye Koi Baat Nahi Jo Hain Meri Jaan-O-Iman Kya Mein Unki Nazar Karon? Paas Mere Ashko Ke Ilava Or Koi Saugat Nahi Ishq-E-Shahe-Batha Se Pehle Muflis-O-Khasta-Haal Tha Mai Naam-E-Muhammad Ke Mai Qurban Ab Woh Mere Haalat Nahi Zikre-Nabi Mein Din Jo Guzrein Woh Din Sab Se Behtar Hain Yaad-E-Nabi Mein Raat Jo Guzrein Iss Se Behtar Raat Nahi Gaur To Kar Sarkar Ki Tujh Pe Kaisi Khas Inayat Hain Kausar Tou Hain Unka Sanakha Ye Mamoli Baat Nahi Jitna Diya Sarkar Ne Mujhko Itni Meri Auqat Nahi Yeh To Karam Hain Unka Varna Mujh Mein To Aisi Baat Nahi. Yaad E Nabi Mai Din Jo Guzre Vo Din Sabse Behtar Hai Jee Yaad E Nabi Mai Raat Jo Bite Us Se Behtar Raat Nahi

২৫৬

Jitna Mere Khuda Ko Hai Mera Nabi Azeez

Jitna Mere Khuda Ko Hai Mera Nabi Azeez Konain Me Kisi Ko Na Hoga Koi Azeez Kyu Jaaye Hum Kahi Ke Ghani Tum Ne Kar Diya Ab To Ye Ghar Pasand Ye Dar Ye Gali Azeez Jo Kuch Teri Raza Hai Khuda Ki Wahi Khushi Jo Kuch Teri Kushi Hai Khuda Ko Wahi Azeez Khak E Madina Par Mujhe Allah Maut De Wo Murda Dil Hai Jisko Na Ho Zindagi Azeez Go Hum Namak Haram Nikamme Gulaam Hai Qurbaan Phir Bhi Rakhti Hai Rehmat Teri Azeez Shaan E Karam Ko Achche Bure Se Garaz Nahi Usko Sabhi Pasand Hai Usko Sabhi Azeez Mangta Ka Haat Utha To Madina Hi Ki Taraf Tera Hi Dar Pasand Hai Teri Gali Azeez Us Dar Ki Khak Par Mujhe Marna Pasand Hai Takhte Shahi Pe Kisko Nahi Zindagi Azeez Konain De Diye Hai Tere Ikhtiyaar Me Allah Ko Bhi Kitni Hai Khatir Teri Azeez Mehshar Me Do Jaha Ko Khuda Ki Khushi Ki Chah Mere Huzoor Ki Hai Khuda Ko Khushi Azeez Quraan Kha Raha Hai Usi Khaak Ki Qasam Hum Kon Hai Khuda Ko Hai Teri Gali Azeez Dil Se Zara Ye Keh De Ke Unka Gulaam Hu Har Dushman E Khuda Ho Khuda Ko Abhi Azeez Taiba Ke Hote Khuld E Bari Kya Karu Hasan Mujh Ko Yahi Pasand Hai Mujh Ko Yahi Azeez

২৫৭

Jo Hijr E Nabi Mein Rote Hain

Jo Hijr E Nabi Mein Rote Hain Wo Dar Pe Bhulay Jaate Hain Deedar Ki Nimat Milti Hai Har Shay Jo Lutay Jaate Hain Sarkaar Ki Pyaari Ghaliyoun Mein Kya Lutf Hai Unki Taliyoun Mein Jibril Ameen Se Poocho Zara Jo Lutf Uthaay Jaate Hain Sarkaar Ki Midhat Ka Yeh Sila Deta Hai Mujhe Youn Mera Khuda Mein Naate Nabi Jab Parta/sunta Hu Mere Ayeb Mithay Jaate Hain Mein Naate Nabi Jab Liktha Hun Jibril Madad Ko Aate Hain Touseef Nabi Ke Yeh Unwaan Jannat Se Mangwaay Jaate Hain

২৫৮

Jo Madina Hum Bhi Jaate To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti

Jo Madina Hum Bhi Jaate To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Wahi Raah Bhool Jaate, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Ye Hawa Ke Mast Jhoke Jo Iram Se Aarahe Hai Yehi Taiba Hoke Aate, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Meri Aankh Jab Bhi Khulti Teri Rehmato Se Aaka Tujhe Saamne Jo Paata, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Muje Zehr Dene Wale Bare Kam Nazar Hai Aaka Tere Naam Par Pilaate To, Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Mein Madine Ko Gaya Tha Ye Bara Sharap Hai Lekin Wohi Dam Jo Toot Jata To, Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Ye Sitaaron Ka Tabassum Hai Nazar Nawaaz Lekin Mere Aaka Muskuraate, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Duniya Ke Gham Mein Yeh Jo Mere Aansoo Behrahe Hai Tera Gham Agar Rulaata, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti Ye Jo Naat-E Paak Bekal Mehfil Mein Par Rahe Hai Yehi Taiba Mein Sunaate, To Kuch Aur Baat Hoti

২৫৯

Jo Saamne Hai Madina To Dekhta Kya Hai

Jo Saamne Hai Madina To Dekhta Kya Hai Yehi To Kaabe Ka Kaaba Hai Sochta Kya Hai Mere Huzoor Ko Aye Khud Sa Bolne Wale Tu Unki Zaat Ke Baare Mein Jaanta Kya Hai Ba Roze Hashr Khuda Khud Kahega Bandon Se Jo Mustafa Ko Na Maane Woh Maanta Kya Hai Teri Gali Ko Hi Maanga Hai Ja Ke Jannat Mein To Is Pe Bole Farishte Yeh Maangta Kya Hai Agar Nahin Hai Paseena Gulon Mein Aaqa Ka To Phir Bataao Ke Gulshan Ka Mehakna Kya Hai Lage Na Jis Pe Qadam Mustafa Ke Aye Hakim Woh Jaye Suye Haram Bhi To Raasta Kya Hai

২৬০

Jo Shehr-E-Nabi May Jaey Ga

Jo Shehr-E-Nabi May Jaey Ga Wo Waapis Kaisey Aaey Ga Jab Bichray Gaa Mar Jaey Ga Ono Shehr Madina Bhulna Nae Ono Shehr Madina Bhulna Nae Dukhiyoo Ka Ghamkhaar Wohi Hay Aalam Ka Mukhtaar Wohi Hay Hay Har Aik Baat Kareenay May Aik Dard Rahey Ga Seenay May Hay Jis Ki Jaan Madine May Jannat Par Kuu Jee Lalchaey Shehr Madina Bhool Na Paey Jo Shehr Nabi Ki Raatein Hain Qudrat Ki Wo Sogaatein Hain Jissay Yaad Wahaa Ki Baatein Hain Sab Ki Aankein Baras Rahi Hain Sab Ki Nazrein Taras Rahi Hain Jo Aap Ka Sag Kehlaata Hay Jo Aap Kay Tukray Khaata Hay Jo Dekh Kay Taiba Ata Hay Koun Uss Shehr Ki Baat Sunaey Khud Quraan Qaseedeh Gaey Rehmat Kay Ajab Ja Millay Hain Husnain Jahaa Per Khailay Hain Jissay Yaad Wahaa Kay Mailay Hain Jab Uss Shehr Ki Baat Challey Ge Hijr Ki Kaali Raat Kattey Ge Jis Dil May Madina Rehta Hay Jiss Aankh Say Dariya Behta Hay Dil Maira Naat Kehta Hay Ruumi Habshi, Misri Shaami Ho Jaawey Maula Na Jaa We Koi Khaaki Hay Ya Nuuri Hay Kab Us Ko Gawaara Duuri Hay Har Aashiq Ki Majbuuri Hay

২৬১

Jobano Par Hai Bahare Chaman Aaraaiye Dost

Jobano(N) Par Hai Bahare Chaman Aaraaiye Dost Khuld Ka Naam Na Le Bulbule Shadaaiye Dost Thak Ke Baithe To Dare Dil Pe Tamannaiye Dost Kaun Se Ghar Ka Ujaala Nahi Zaibaaiye Dost Arsaye Hashr Kuja Mauqife Mahmood Kuja Saaz Hungamo(N) Se Rakhti Nahi(N) Yaktaaiye Dost Mehr Kis Munh Se Jilau Daariye Jaana(N) Karta Saaye Ke Naam Se Bezaar Hai Yaktaaiye Dost Marne Waalo Ko Yaha(N) Milti Hai Umre Javed Zinda Chchodegi Kisi Ko Na Masihaaiye Dost Unko Yakta Kiya Aur Khalq Banayi Ya’ni Anjuman Karke Tamaasha Kare Tanhaaiye Dost Kaa’ba Wa Arsh Mein Kohraam Hai Naakaami Ka Aah Kis Bazm Me Hain Jalwaye Yaktaaiye Dost Husne Be Parda Ke Parde Ne Mita Rakkha Hai Dhoonde Jaaye(N) Kaha(N) Jalwaye Harjaaiye Dost Shauq Roke Na Ruke Paao Uthaye Na Uthe Kaisi Mushkil Mein Hain Allah Tamannaaiye Dost Sharm Se Jhukti Hai Mehraab Ki Saajid Hain Huzoor Sajda Karwati Hai Kaa’be Se Jabee(N) Saaiye Dost Taajwalo Ka Yaha Khaak Me Maatha Dekha Saare Daaraao(N) Ki Daaraa Huyi Daaraaiye Dost Toor Par Koi, Koi Charkh Pe Ye Arsh Se Paar Saare Baalaao Pe Baala Rahi Baalaiye Dost Anta Feehim Ne Adu Ko Bhi Liya Daaman Mein Aishe Javed Mubarak Tujhe Shaidaaiye Dost Ranje Aa’da Ka Raza Chaara Hi Kya Hai Jab Unhe Aap Gustaakh Rakhe Hilmo Shikaibaaiye Dost

২৬২

Juma Kareem Hai

Jo Yaum Sab Ayaam Me Sab Se Azeem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jo Din Pasandidaye Gafoorur Raheem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jis Din Ke Waste Mere Aaqa Ne Farmaye Juma Rab Ne Momin Ke Liye Eid Banaya Jo Din Nigahe Aaqa Me Itna Azeem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Kyu Na Karu Salaam Dino Ke Imaam Ko Sunte Jab Khud Aaqa Durudo Salaam Ko Jis Me Qoobuliyat Ki Ghadi Bhi Muqim Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jis Din Hui Thi Pyare Hazrat Adam Ki Takhleeq Jis Din Hua Tha Aap Ka Wisaale Ba Kamaal Jo Din Khuda Ke Nazdeek Itna Azeem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jis Deen Azaan Bhi Izaafi Aata Huyi Machli Se Jis Deen Zaate Yunoos Riha Huyi Hoga Isi Deen Mehshar Hadishe Azeem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jo Deen Azaabe Qabr Se Rakhta He Bacha Ke Bakhshe Jaate He Muzrim Bhi Dojakh Se Bulake Ye To Akeel Farmane Durrey Yatim Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jo Yaum Sab Ayaam Me Sab Se Azeem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai Jo Din Pasandidaye Gafoorur Raheem Hai Woh Juma Kareem Hai Juma Kareem Hai

২৬৩

Kaabay Kay Dar Kay Saamnay Maangee Hai Ye Dua Faqat

Ka'abay Kay Dar Kay Saamnay Maangee Hai Ye Dua Faqat Haathon Mein Hashar Tak Rahay Daaman-E-Mustafa Faqat Naza’a Kay Waqt Jab Meri Saanson Mein Intishaar Ho Meri Nazar Kay Saamnay Gumbad Ho Woh Hara Faqat Apnay Karam Say Ae Khuda Ishq-E-Rasool Kar Ataa Aakhree Dum Zubaan Pay Ho Sallay A’la Sadaa Faqat Tayba Kee Sayr Ko Chalein Qadmon Mein Unki Jaan Dein Dafn Hoon Unkay Shehar Mein Hai Yehee Iltija Faqat Duniya Kee Saari Ne’ymatein Meri Nazar Mein Hainch Hoon Rakhnay Ko Sar Pay Gar Milay Na’lein-E-Mustafa Faqat Munkar Nakeer Qabar Mein Hum Say Sawaal Jab Karein Aisay Mein Wird Hum Rakhein Aap Kay Naam Ka Faqat Na’at-E-Rasool-E-Paak Hai Nazmi Ka Maqsad-E-Hayaat Qabr Mein Bhi Laboon Pay Ho Sarkaar Kee Sana Faqat

২৬৪

Kabhe Da Ghulaf Kala Duroun Lehraye Ni

Kabhe Da Ghulaf Kala, Duroun Lehraye Ni Mangho Ni Duoen Moula Sab Nou Bulaye Ni Paak Madine Diya Shana Ni Sunawaan Main Roze Paak Dei Nazare Ki Ki Batawa Main Othe Raab Rehmaataan Da Meen Barsaye Ni Khane Kabhe Hajji Ja Ke Kar Dei Tuwafni Nale Hajji Ronde Naale Chumde Ghulaaf Ni Kabhe Da Khatab Othe Sonah Mil Jaye Ni Aisi Intezari Wich Umar Guzari We Allah Jane Kaddo Ani Aajezaan Di Wari Ae Othe Jayejithe Dukh Mukh Jande Ne Sari Nii

২৬৫

Kabhi Barbaad Aqa Zindigi Hone Nahi Dete

Kabhi Barbaad Aqa Zindigi Hone Nahi Dete Ata Ki Barishon Mein Woh Kami Hone Nahi Dete Mere Sab Kaam Balte Hain Karam Sarkar Karte Hain Koi Deewar Raste Mein Khari Hone Nahi Dete Jo Unka Hai Hamara Hai Yehi Dil Ko Bataya Hai Adoo Se Unke Dil Ki Dosti Ko Hone Nahi Dete Hamesha Woh Hamein Ehzaz Par Ehzaz Dete Hain Nikamma Hone Ka Ehsas Bhi Hone Nahi Dete Nabi Ke Naam Ki Jo Har Jaga Mehfil Sajate Hain Phir Unke Naam Ko Neecha Nabi Hone Nahi Dete Lab E Kawthar Aansuon Ko Lab A Lab Jaam Dete Hain Sar E Mehshar Kisi Ko Tishnagi Hone Nahi Dete Inhi Ke Yaad Se Aabaad Hai, Dil Bhi Ujaagar Ka Kabhi Veeraan Woh Dil Ki Gali Hone Nahi Dete

২৬৬

Kadi Wich Khaab Dey Howey Nazarah Ya Rasulullah

২৬৭

Kaliyaan Zulfaa Wala Dukhi Dillan Daa Sahaara

Kaliyaan Zulfaa Wala Dukhi Dillan Daa Sahaara Qassam Khudaa Dii Maynoon Sab Naloon Pyaara. Dassan Ki Main Mustafa Di Kaydi Sohnii Shaan Hai Aap Di Tareef Which Sara Hee Qur’an Hai, Parh Kay Tu Weykh Jeyra Marzi Sipaara Qassam Khuda Di Meinoon Sab Naloon Pyara. Eyda Sohna Nabi Koi Duniya Tay Aaya Nahin Yaar Ey Ho Jiyaa Koyi Rab Nay Banaya Naheen, Deed Meray Nabi Di Hai Rab Da Nazaara Qassam Khuda Di Meinoon Sab Naloon Pyara. Denday Nay Gawahi Zaray Zaray Koay Toor Day Wekhday Naseeban Walay Jalway Hazoor Day, Aamina Da Chan Tay Halima Da Dhulara Qassam Khuda Di Meinoon Sab Naloon Pyara. Kar Kay Ishara Sohna Suraj Noon Morda Aapay Chaan Torda Tay Aapay Chan Jorda, Bigari Banaway Meray Nabi Da Ishaara Qassam Khudaa Dii Maynoon Sab Naloon Pyaara. Kehndi Aye Heleema Mukh Wekh Lajpal Da Lab Kay Leyawaan Kithoon Sohna Teray Naal Da, Aamina Da Chan Tay Halima Da Dhulara Chohdween Da Chaand Tay Arshaan Da Tara Qasam Khuda Di Mainoon Sub Naloon Pyara. Kaliyan Zulfan Wala Dukhi Dilaan Da Sahara. Kalian Zulfan Vala Duky Dilan Daa Sahara.

২৮৮

Khake Madina Hoti Mein Khak-Sar Hota Hoti Rahe Madina Mera Hubar Hota Aaqa Agar Karam Se Tayba Muje Bulate Roze Par Sadke Hota Unpar Nisar Hota Mar Mitke Khub Lagti Mitti Meri Thikane Ghar Unki Rah-Guzar Par Mera Mazar Hota Ye Aarazu Hai Dil Ki Hota Wo Sabz Gumbad Aur Mein Gubar Ban Kar Us Par Nisar Hota Tayba Mein Ghar Muyassar Do Gaz Zameen Hoti Unke Kareeb Basta Dil Ko Karar Hota Bechain Dil Ko Ab Tak Samja Buja Ke Rakha Magar Ab To Is Se Aaqa Nahin Intezar Hota Wo Bekason Ke Aaqa Bekas Ko Ghar Bulate Kyun Sab Ki Thokaron Par Padh Kar Khuwar Hota Salik Hue Ham Unke Wo Bhi Hue Hamare Dile Muztarib Ko Lekin Nahin Intezar Hota

২৮৯

Khake Taiba Mere Seene Se Laga Di Jaaye

Khake Taiba Mere Seene Se Laga Di Jaaye, Haan Basharat Mujhe Jannat Ki Suna Di Jaye. Mehfil-E-Naat Phir Ek Baar Saja Di Jaaye, Qalbe Dushman Ki Jalan Aur Badha Di Jaaye. Hosh Aayega Na Duniya Ki Dawaao Se Mujhe, Naale Sarkaare Do Aalam Ki Hawa Di Jaaye. Jis Paseene Ki Mahak Makke Ki Galiyon Me Rachi, Wohi Khushboo Mujhe Ek Baar Sungha Di Jaaye. Ibne Khattab Ko Farooq Banaaya Jisne, Wohi Tasveer Mere Dil Me Bitha Di Jaaye. Ishq Gar Jurm Hai Faansi Ki Saza Do Mujh Ko, Dare Mehboob Pe Lekin Ye Saza Di Jaaye. Ya Nabi Mujhko Bhi Haasil Hai Ghulami Ka Sharaf, Meri Naato Me Bhi Taasire Raza Di Jaaye. Hashr Ke Roz Mai Aaqa Ki Sunaau Naate, Rab Kahe Nazmi Ko Firdous Me Jaa(N) Di Jaaye

২৯০

Kharab Haal Kiya Dil Ko Pur Malaal Kiya

Kharab Haal Kiya Dil Ko Pur Malaal Kiya Tumhare Kooche Se Rukhsat Kiya Nihaal Kiya Na Ruye Gul Abhi Dekha Na Buye Gul Soonghi Kaza Ne Laake Qafas Mein Shikasta Baal Kiya Woh Dil Ki Khoo(N) Shuda Armaan The Jis Mein Mal Dala Fugaa(N) Ki Gore Shaheeda(N) Ko Paayemaal Kiya Ye Rai Kya Thi Waha Se Palatne Ki Aye Nafs Sitamgar Ulti Choori Se Hume Halaal Kiya Ye Kab Ki Mujhse Adawat Thi Tujhko Aye Zaalim Chchuda Ke Sange Dare Paak Sar Wabaal Kiya Chaman Se Phenk Diya Aashiyaan E Bulbul Ujada Khanaye Bekar Bada Kamaal Kiya Tera Sitamzada Aankhon Ne Kya Bigada Tha Ye Kya Samayi Ki Door In Se Woh Jamaal Kiya Huzoor Unke Khayale Watan Mitana Tha Hum Aap Mit Gaye Achcha Faraagh Baal Kiya Na Ghar Ka Rakha Na Us Dar Ka Haaye Nakaami Humari Bebasi Par Bhi Na Khuch Khayal Kiya Jo Dil Ne Mar Ke Jalaya Tha Mannato Ka Charaag Sitam Ki Arz Rahe Sar Sare Zawaal Kiya Madina Chchod Ke Viraana Hind Ka Paaya Ye Kaisa Haaye Hawaaso(N) Ne Ikhtilaal Kiya Tu Jis Ke Waaste Chchod Aaya Taiba Sa Mehboob Bata To Us Sitam Aara Ne Kya Nihaal Kiya Abhi Abhi To Chaman Me The Chahchahe Nagaah Ye Dard Kaisa Utha Jis Ne Jee Nidhaal Kiya Ilahi Sunle Raza Jeete Jee Ki Maula Ne Sagaane Koocha Mein Chehra Mera Bahaal Kiya

২৯১

Khayal Aata Hai Dil Me Ye Gar Hua Hota

Khayal Aata Hai Dil Me Ye Gar Hua Hota Unhi Ke Daur Me Maine Janam Liya Hota Woh Chalte Aage Mere Shane Dilrubayi Se Mai Peeche Unki Sawari Ke Daudta Hota Mere Bhi Sar Pe Tasalli Ka Haath Rakhte Woh Yateem Gar Mai Usi Daure Paak Ka Hota Woh Leke Jaate Mujhe Roz Kaash Sehra Me Haleema Daai Ki Bakri Hi Ban Gaya Hota Mujhe Bhi Aisi Namazon Ka Gar Sharaf Milta Mai Unke Rooe Munawaar Ko Tak Raha Hota Woh Aake Mere Janaze Pe Jab Khade Hote Kafan Hata Ke Mai Unko Hi Tak Raha Hota Ameen E Khasta Ka Uthta Janaza Taiba Mein Muraad Apni Bechaara Ye Paa Gaya Hota

২৯২

Khoob Khushiya Manao Huzoor Aa Gaye

Khoob Khushiya Manao Huzoor Aa Gaye Naat-E-Ahmed Sunao Huzoor Aa Gaye Unke Sajde Ko Mehraab E Kaaba Jhuki Apna Dil Tum Jhukao Huzoor Aa Gaye Boli Daayi Haleema Unhe Dekh Kar Noori Jhoola Jhulao Huzoor Aa Gaye Dushmani Chchod Do Sab Muhobbat Karo Dil Se Dil Ko Milao Huzoor Aa Gaye Padh Ke Kalma Ye Kankar Bhi Kehne Lage Logo Imaan Laao Huzoor Aa Gaye But Shikan Aaya But Sar Ke Bal Gir Pade Parchame Haq Uthao Huzoor Aa Gaye Hai Lakad Jaa-A-Kum Dekho Quran Me Padh Ke Sab Ko Sunao Huzoor Aa Gaye Yaad Ummat Ko Waqte Wilaadat Kiya Yaad Ab Tum Manao Huzoor Aa Gaye Jhoom Kar Khoob Rizwan Naate Padho Sab Ko Muzda Sunao Huzoor Aa Gaye

২৯৩

Khuda Ka Zikr Kare Zikre Mustafa Na Kare

Khuda Ka Zikr Kare Zikre Mustafa Na Kare Hamare Munh Me Ho Aisi Zubaan Khuda Na Kare Aseer Jis Ko Bana Kar Rakhen Madine Me Tamaam Umar Rihayi Ki Woh Dua Na Kare Madina Ja Ke Nikalna Na Shehar Se Baahar Khuda Na Khwasta Ye Zindagi Wafaa Na Kare Kaha Khuda Ne Shafa’at Ki Baat Mehshar Me Mera Habeeb Kare Koi Doosra Na Kare Sha-Oore Naat Bhi Ho Aur Zubaan Bhi Ho Adeeb Woh Aadmi Nahi Jo Unka Haq Adaa Na Kare Hamare Dard-E-Jigar Ki Koi Dawa Na Kare Kami Ho Ishk-E-Nabi Me Kabhi Khuda Na Kare Hamare Dekhe Hue Hai Madine Ke Zarre Batado Mehar Ko Ab Daawa-E-Ziya Na Kare Razae Namasiya Ka Kaha Thikaana Hai Shafa’at Iski Jo Mehshar Me Mustafa Na Kare Dare Rasool Pe Aisa Kabhi Nahi Dekha Koi Sawaal Kare Aur Woh Ataa Na Kare Nabi Ke Qadmon Pe Jis Dam Ghulaam Ka Sar Ho Qaza Se Keh Do Ke Ik Lamha Bhi Kaza Na Kare

২৯৪

Khuda Ki Azmate Kya Hai Muhammad Mustafa Jaane

Khuda Ki Azmate Kya Hai Muhammad Mustafa Jaane Maqaam-E-Mustafa Kya Hai Muhammad Ka Khuda Jaane. Sada Karna Mere Bas Me Tha Maine To Sada Kardi Woh Kya Denge Mai Kya Loonga Shaha Jaane Gadaa Jaane Kaha Jibreel Ne Sidra Talak Meri Rasaayi Thi Hai Kitni Manzile Aage Nabi Jaane Khuda Jaane Madine Haazri Ki Maangte Rehna Dua Yaaro Asar Hoga Nahi Hoga Nabi Jaane Khuda Jaane Meri Mitti Madeeni Shehar Ki Raah Me Bichaa Dena Kaha Le Jaati Hai Mujh Ko Madine Ki Hawaa Jaane Mujhe To Sur Khuroo Hona Hai, Aaqa Ki Nigaahon Me Zamaane Ka Hai Kya Naasir Buraa Jaane Bhala Jaane Darana Mujh Ko To Kyoun Hai Azaab-E-Kabbar Se Wahid Wahan Sarkaar Aye Gei Khata Jane Atta Jane

২৯৫

Khuda Ne Mujh Ko Diya Maa Teri Duaon Se

Khuda Ne Mujh Ko Diya Maa Teri Duaon Se Mila Hai Jo Bhi Mila Maa Teri Duaon Se Jahaa Jahaa Bhi Gaya Log Dil Bichane Lage Ye Ehteram Mera Maa Teri Duaon Se Ye Kaamyabi Ya Shohrat Qadam Qadam Pe Mili Naseeb Aisa Mila Maa Teri Duaon Se Mujhe Girane Pe Haasid Tule Hue The Magar Main Dushmanon Se Bacha Maa Teri Duaon Se Tawaaf Maine Kiya Ki Saei-E-Marwah Bhi Jo Maine Umrah Kiya Maa Teri Duaon Se Qasam Hai Isme Ujaagar Ka Kuch Kamal Nahin Urooj Isko Mila Maa Teri Duaon Se

২৯৬

Khushiyo Ki Bahare Laya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya

Khushiyo Ki Bahare Laya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Dil Joom Ke Mera Gaya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Qur'an Ki Tilawat Hogi Bharpoor Ibaadat Hogi Qur'an Ka Tohfa Laya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Sehri Ki Ajab Rahat Hai Iftar Me Woh Rounaq Hai Ik Kaif Ajab Hai Chaya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Roze Ki Ye Lazzat Dekho Na Pyaas Ki Shiddat Hai Woh Kya Sabr Hai Hum Ne Paaya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Ramzan To Hai Us Ki, Ho Saath Me Maa Jiski Turkee Ne To Ashk Bahaya Jab Ramzan Mubarak Aaya Allah Meri Maa Ko Ramzan Ke Sadqe Me Sab Maaf Gunah Karde Jannat Bhi Ataa Karde Zahra Ka Mile Saaya Ramzan Mubarak Aaya

২৯৭

Khusravi Achhi Lagi Na Sarwari Achhi Lagi

Khusravi Achhi Lagi Na Sarwari Achhi Lagi Hum Faqeero Ko Madine Ki Gali Achhi Lagi Mai Na Jaunga Kahi Bhi Darr Nabi Ka Chor Kar Mujhko Ko-E Mustafa Ki Chaakri Achhi Lagi Rakh Diye Sarkaar Ke Qadmo Me Sultaano Ne Sarr Sarwar E Kouno Makaa Ki Saadgi Achhi Lagi Naaz Kar Tu Ay Haleema Sarwar E Kounain Par Gar Lagi Achhi To Teri Jhopdi Achhi Lagi Jinko Karni Hai Shahenshaho Ki Taarefe Kare Mujhko Aaqa Bas Tumhari Naat Hi Achhi Lagi Qabr Roushan Ho Gayi Noor E Nabi Se Is Tarah Aashiqo Ko Maut Bhi Aur Qabr Bhi Achhi Lagi Maut Jo Maangi Dayar E Mustafa Ke Saamne Maut Ko Bhi Aarzu Meri Badi Achhi Lagi Mahro Mah Ki Roushni Maana Ki Achhi Hai Magar Sabze Ghumbad Ki Mujhe To Roushni Achhi Lagi Duur The To Zindagi Be-Rang Thi Be-Kaif Thi Unke Kooche Me Gaye To Zindagi Achhi Lagi Aaj Mehfil Me Niyazi Naat Jo Maine Padhi Aashiqane Mustafa Ko Wo Badi Achhi Lagi

২৯৮

Ki Ki Na Kita Yaar Ney Eik Yaar Waste

Ki Ki Na Kita Yaar Ney Eik Yaar Waste Rab Mehfilan Sajayan Ney Sarkar Waste Dil Yaad Lai Banaya Wey Tareef Lai Zuban Akhian Banaian Sohne De Deedar Waste Sadqa Nabi Di Aall Da Bakhshy Khuda Shifa Mango Duawan Mery Jay Bimar Waste Kaian Noo Rooz Hondy Ney Dedar Aap Dey Kai Taras Dey Ney Sohne De Deedar Waste Rehmat Udey Ne Ley Liya Apni Panah Dey Wich Pay Jado Mey Sohne De Do Char Waste Guzry Niazi Zindage Ishq E Nabi Dey Wich Naatan Mey Parh Da Rawan Sohne Sarkar Waste Ki Ki Na Kita Yaar Ney Eik Yaar Waste Rab Mehfilan Sajayan Ney Sarkar Waste

২৯৯

Kis Cheez Ki Kami Hai Maula Teri Gali Me

Kis Cheez Ki Kami Hai Maula Teri Gali Me Duniya Teri Gali Main Uqba Teri Gali Me Deewangi Pe Meri Haste Hai Aql Wale Rasta Teri Gali Ka Poocha Teri Gali Me Deewana Kar Diya Hai Deewana Ho Gaya Hoon Dekha Hai Maine Aisa Jalwa Teri Gali Me Mauto Hayaat Meri Dono Tere Liye Hai Marna Teri Gali Me Jina Teri Gali Me Kis Tarah Pau Rakhe Ya Sahibe Baseerat Aankhen Bichi Huwi Hai Har Jaa Teri Gali Me Suraj Tajalliyon Ka Har Dam Chamak Raha Hai Dekha Nahi Kisi Din Saya Teri Gali Me Amjad Ko Aaj Tak Ham Adna Samajh Rahe The Lekin Maqaam Uska Paya Teri Gali Me

৩০০

Kiske Jalwe Ki Jhalak Hai Ye Ujala Kya Hai

Kiske Jalwe Ki Jhalak Hai Ye Ujala Kya Hai Har Taraf Dedaye Hairat Zada Takta Kya Hai Maang Man Maanti Muh Maangi Muraaden Lega Na Yaha 'naa' Hai Na Mangta Se Ye Kehna 'kya Hai' Pand Kadwi Lage Naaseh Se Tursh Ho Aye Nafs Zehre Isyaa(N) Mein Sitamgar Tujhe Meetha Kya Hai Hum Hain Unke Woh Hain Tere To Huwe Hum Tere Isse Badhkar Teri Samt Aur Waseela Kya Hai Unki Ummat Mein Banaaya Unhen Rehmat Bheja Yoon Na Farma Ki Tera Rehmat Mein Da'wa Kya Hai Sadqa Pyare Ki Hayaa Ka Ki Na Le Mujh Se Hisaab Bakhsh Be Pooche Lajaaye Ko Lajaana Kya Hai Zaahid Unka Main Gunahgaar Woh Mere Shaafe' Itni Nisbat Mujhe Kya Kam Hai Tu Samjha Kya Hai Be Basi Ho Jo Mujhe Pursishe Aa'maal Ke Waqt Doston Kya Kahu Us Waqt Tamanna Kya Hai Kaash Fariyaad Meri Sunke Ye Farmaaye Huzoor Haan Koi Dekho Yeh Kya Shor Hai Ghogha Kya Hai Kaun Aafat Zada Hai Kis Pe Bala Tooti Hai Kis Musibat Mein Giraftaar Hai Sadma Kya Hai Kis Se Kehta Hai Ki Lillah Khabar Lije Meri Kyun Hai Betaab Yeh Bechaini Ka Rona Kya Hai Iski Bechaini Se Hai Khaatire Aqdas Pe Malaal Be Kasi Kaisi Hai Poocho Koi Guzra Kya Hai Yoon Malaaik Karen Maa'rooz Ki Ik Mujrim Hai Usse Pursish Hai Bata Tune Kiya Kya Kya Hai Saamna Qahar Ka Hai Daftare Aa'maal Hain Pesh Dar Raha Hai Ki Khuda Hukm Sunata Kya Hai Aap Se Karta Hai Fariyaad Ki Ya Shaahe Rusul Banda Bekas Hai Shaha Rehem Mein Waqfa Kya Hai Ab Koi Dum Mein Giraftaare Bala Hota Hoon Aap Aa Jaayen To Kya Khauf Hai Khatka Kya Hai Sun Ke Arz Meri Behre Karam Josh Mein Aaye Yoon Malaaik Ko Ho Irshaad Theherna Kya Hai Kis Ko Tum Mooride Aafat Kiya Chahte Ho Hum Bhi To Aake Zara Dekhe Tamasha Kya Hai Unki Aawaaz Pe Kar Utthu(N) Main Be Saakhta Shor Aur Tadap Kar Ye Kahoon Ab Mujhe Parwa Kya Hai Lo Woh Aaya Mera Haami Mera Gham Khwaare Umam Aa Gayi Jaa(N) Tane Be Jaa(N) Mein Ye Aana Kya Hai Phir Mujhe Daamane Aqdas Mein Chupa Le(N) Sarwar Aur Farmaye Hato Is Pe Takaazaa Kya Hai Banda Aazaad Shuda Hai Ye Humare Dar Ka Kaisa Lete Ho Hisaab Is Pe Tumhara Kya Hai Chchod Kar Mujhko Farishte Kahen Mahkoom Hai Hum Hukme Waala Ki Na Taa'meel Ho Zahra Kya Hai Ye Samaa Dekh Ke Mehshar Mein Uthe Shor Ki Wah Chashme Bad-Door Ho Kya Shaan Hai Rutba Kya Hai Sadqe Is Reham Ke Is Saaya E Daaman Pe Nisaar Apne Bando Ko Musibat Se Bachaya Kya Hai Aye Raza Jaane Anaadil Tere Nagmon Ke Nisaar Bulbule Baage Madina Tera Kehna Kya Hai

৩০১

Kiya Majal Kisi Ki Jo Sarkar Ki Barabari Kare

Kiya Majal Kisi Ki Jo Sarkar Ki Barabari Kare Ungli Se Hishara Karde Chand Ke Tukde Ho Jai. Sarkar Ke Aqlaq Ki Quran Jo Taarif Kare Pyare Aqa Ke Aqlaq Se Kafer Bhi Musalma Ho Jai Mere Aqa Muqtar Hai Majboor Nahi Pyare Mangta Aya Jo Wo Sultan Ho Jai Sarkar Namaz Me Kabe Ki Samt Ruq Kare Sahaba Kahte The Jo Sarkar Kare Wo Ho Jai Namaz-E-Asr Ali(Raziallahu Talla Anhu) Khaza Nahi Ada Kare Sarkar Hishara Karde Duba Huva Suraj Wapis Ho Jai Ho Nazre Inayat Hum Asiyo Par Sarkar Mere Taake Hamari Qismat Ke Sab Gardishe Dur Ho Jai Sarkar Jaber Pe Ho Jai Karam Ki Nazre Madine Me Iska Lasha Dafn Ho Jai

৩০২

Koi Kaise Samajh Payega Rutba Sabz Gumbad Ka

Koi Kaise Samajh Payega Rutba Sabz Gumbad Ka Ke Khutba Pad Raha Hai Khud Hi Kaba Sabz Gumbad Ka Jo Poocha Maine Jannat Se Teri Bhi Koi Jannat Hai To Jannat Ne Diya Mujhko Hawala Sabz Gumbad Ka Raza Ke Chahney Walon Ne Ek Soorat Nikali Hai Ke Bareli Se Vo Karte Hai Nazara Sabz Gumbad Ka Nabi Ko Noor Jo Samjhe Wahi Ye Raj Janegaa Kya! Na Saya Mustafa Ka Hai Na Saya Sabz Gumbad Ka Badi Hasrat Se Takti Hai Nigahein Asman Isko Zami Nein Jab Se Bandha Hai Amama Sabz Gumbad Ka Hare Patton Ko Aksar Dekhkey Ye Mehsoos Hota He Darakhton Ne Saja Rakha Hai Thogra Sabz Gumbad Ka Chale Aye Yahan Khich Khich Ke Ashiq Sabz Gumbad Ke Asad Ne Jis Gadi Cheda Tarana Sabz Gumbad Ka Koi Kaise Samajh Payega Rutba Sabz Gumbad Ka Ke Khutba Pad Raha He Khud Hi Kaba Sabz Gumbad Ka

৩০৩

Koi Khilqat Mein Un Say Nahi Bada

Koi Khilqat Mein Un Say Nahi Bada Woh Habeeb-E-Khuda Unki Kya Baat Hai Hum Gunahgar Hain Hum Siyah Kar Hain Woh Shafi-Ul-Wara Unki Kya Baat Hai Aur Kis Ko Urooj Jitna Hasil Huwa Sara Quran Hi Un Pay Nazil Huwa Zeenat-E-Arsh Hain Azmat-E-Farsh Hain Woh Makeen-E-Hira Unki Kya Baat Hai Sab Say Afzal Do Aalam Main Zaat Unki Hai Woh Hi Mahboob-E-Rab Kainat Unki Hai Rabb-E-Akbar Nay Jo Kuch Bhi Hum Ko Diya Unke Sadqay Mila Unki Kya Baat Hai Jo Bhi Un Say Mila Usko Rab Milgaya Bay Adab Zindagi Ko Adab Milgaya Rab Se Woh Aashna Un Say Rab Ashna Woh Daleel-E-Khuda Unki Kya Baat Hai Unki Khatir Do Aalam Banaye Gaye Unke Anwaar Se Phir Sajaye Gaye Unke Rutbe Ko Jitney Badaye Gaye Akhl Se Mawara Unki Kya Baat Hay Zindagi Ka Safar Ho Na Jaye Tamam Un Pey Aijaz Bhejo Durood O Salam Woh Karam Hi Karam Woh Ataa Hi Ataa Woh Dua Hi Dua Unki Kya Baat Hai

৩০৪

Koi Saleeqa Hai Aarzoo Ka Na Bandagi Meri Bandagi Hai

Koi Saleeqa Hai Aarzoo Ka Na Bandagi Meri Bandagi Hai Ye Sab Tumhara Karam Hai Aaqa Ke Baat Ab Tak Bani Hui Hai Kisi Ka Ehsan Kyun Uthaaye Kisi Ko Haalat Kyun Bataaye Tumhi Se Maangege Tum Hi Doge Tumhare Dar Se Hi Lau Lagi Hai Ataa Kiya Mujh Ko Dared Ulfat Kaha Thi Ye Pur Khata Ki Qismat Mein Is Karam Ke Kaha Tha Qaabil Huzoor Ki Banda Parwari Hai Sha-Oor O Fikro Nazar Ke Daire Had Ka In Se Aage Badh Na Paaye Na Choo Sake Un Bulandiyon Ko Jahaa Maqaame Muhammadi Hai Tajaliyon Ke Kafeel Tum Ho Muraad Qalbe Khaleel Tum Ho Khuda Ki Raushan Daleel Tum Ho Ye Sab Tumhari Hi Raushni Hai Basheer Kahiye Nazeer Kahiye Unhe Siraaje Muneer Kahiye Jo Sar Ba Sar Hai Kalaame Rabbi Woh Mere Aaqa Ki Zindagi Hai Amal Ki Mere Asaas Kya Hai Bajuz Nadamat Ke Paas Kiya Hai Rahe Salaamat Tumhari Nisbat Mera To Ek Aasra Yehi Hai Hai Kaaba Bhi Marjaye Khalaaiq Bohat Numaaya Hai Ye Haqaaiq Magar Jo Maqsoode Aashiqui Hai Huzoor Ke Dar Ki Haazri Hai Yehi Hai Khalid Asaqse Rehmat Yehi Hai Khalid Binaa-E-Azmat Nabi Ka Irfan Zindagi Hai Nabi Ka Irfan Bandagi Hai......!!

৩০৫

Konain De Wali Da Darbar Bara Sohna

Konain De Wali Da Gharbar Bara Sohna So Rab Di Madine Da Darbaar Baraa Sohna Mujhe Masjid-E-Nabvi Di Har Cheez Bari Sohni Jeraa Roze Dey Naal Jureya Minaar Baraa Sohna Sab Rastey Madinay Dey Sanu Jaan Toh Vadh Pyaarey Jeraa Roze Nu Jaanda Ey Bazaar Baraa Sohna Sadiq, Umar, Usman, Haider Toh Mey Vaari Jaa Meray Sohne Sohne Aqa Da Har Yaar Baraa Sohna Duniya Diya Safaran Toh Banda Thak Vi Teh Jaanda Ey Par Safar Madinay Da Har Baar Baraa Sohna Wekho Na Zahoori Nu Nisbat Nu Zaraa Wekho Main Kohja Haan Par Meraa Ghumkhwar Baraa Sohna Ungli Nu Hutawndey Ney Pey Chan Nu Hilawndey Ney So Rab Di'ey Chan Falki Aqa Da Khilonaey Sarkar Jeya Sohna Aya'e Na Awna Ey Na Rab Ney Banaya Ey Na Rab Ney Banawna Ey Konain Dey Waali Da Darbaar Baraa Sohna So Rab Di Madinay Da Darbaar Baraa Sohna

৩০৬

Koyi Kya Jane Jo Tum Ho Khuda Hi Jaane Kya Tum Ho

Koyi Kya Jane Jo Tum Ho Khuda Hi Jaane Kya Tum Ho Khuda To Keh Nahi Sakte Magar Shaane Khuda Tum Ho Nabiyoun Me Ho Tum Aise Nabiyul Ambiya Tum Ho Haseenoun Me Tum Aise Ho Ke Mehboob E Khuda Tum Ho Tumhara Husn Aisa Hai Ki Mehboob E Khuda Tum Ho Mahe Kaamil Kare Kasbe Ziya Wo Mahlika Tum Ho Uluwe Martabat Pyaare Tumhara Sab Pe Raushan Hai Makeen E La Makaan Tum Ho Shah E Arshe Ula Tum Ho Tumhari Hamd Farmaee Khuda Ne Apne Quran Me Muhammad Aur Mumajjad Mustafa O Mujtaba Tum Ho Jo Sab Se Pichla Hoga Uska Pichla Ho Nahi Sakta Ki Wo Pichla Nahi Agla Hua Usse Wara Tum Ho Tumhi Se Fatha Farmaee Tumhi Par Qatm Farmaee Rasool Ki Ibteda Tum Ho Nabi Ki Intehaa Tum Ho Khuda Ne Zaat Ka Apni Tumhe Mazhar Banaya Hai Jo Haq Ko Dekna Chahe To Uske Aaina Tum Ho Tumhi Batin Tumhi Zahir Tumhi Awwal Tumhi Aaqir Niha Bhi Ho Ayaa Bhi Mubtada O Muntaha Tum Ho Munawwar Kar Diya Hai Aap Ke Jalwo Ne Aalam Ko Maho Khursheed Ko Baqshi Ziya Noor E Quda Tum Ho Mita Di Kufr Ki Zulmat Tumhare Roo E Raushan Ne Sawera Shirk Ka Tumne Kiya Shams O Duha Tum Ho Jahan Taarik Tha Saara Andhera Hi Andhera Tha Tum Aaye Zulmate Tumse Miti Badrudduja Tum Ho Mera Mu Kya Ke Mai Madh O Sataish Me Zuba Kholoon Mere Aqa Tum Aise Ke Mumdoohe Khuda Tum Ho Rafa'na Se Tumhari Rifat E Baala Huwi Zahir Ke Mehboob Bane Rab Me Sab Se Aali Martaba Tum Ho Uloowe Rutba E Sarkaar E Aali Sab Pe Raushan Hai Makeen E La Makaan Tum Ho Shahe Arshe Ula Tum Ho Shabe Mearaj Se Ay Sayyide Kul Ho Gaya Zaahir Rasool Hai Muqtadi Saare Imam Ul Ambiya Tum Ho Na Hote Tum Na Hote Wo Ke Asle Jumla Tum Hi Ho Qabar The Wo Tumhari Mere Maula Mubtada Tum Ho Tumhare Chahne Wale Ko Kuch Aisi Mohabbat Hai Udhar Ho Jae Wo Maula Jidhar Sadrul Wara Tum Ho Tumhare Chahne Wale Use Mehboob Hai Saare Kuch Is Andaaz Ke Pyaare Habeeb E Kibriya Tum Ho Tumhare Baad Paida Ho Nabi Koyi Nahi Mumkin Nubuvvat Khatam Hai Tum Par Ki Khatmul Ambiya Tum Ho Ye Kya Maine Kiya Kyu Dhoond Dala Arsa E Mehshar Hame Maloom Tha Pyaare Hamara Mud Da'aa Tum Ho Magar Aisa Na Kyu Hota Ke Mehshar Me Ye Khulna Tha Shafi E Mujrima Peshe Khuda Tanha Shaha Tum Ho Giraftaar E Balaa Hazir Hue Hai Toote Dil Le Kar Ki Har Bekal Ki Kal Toote Dilo Ka Aasra Tum Ho Khabar Lije Khudara Mere Maula Mujh Se Bekas Ki Ki Har Bekas Ke Kas Bebas Ke Bas Roohi Fida Tum Ho Musallat Kardiya Tumko Khuda Ne Apne Ghaibo Par Nabi E Mujtaba Tum Ho Rasool E Murtuza Tum Ho Chamak Jaaye Dile Noori Tumhare Paak Jalwo Se Mita Do Zulmat E Dil Ki Mere Noor Ul Huda Tum Ho

৩০৭

Kuch Aisa Kar De Mere Kirdgaar Aankho Me

Kuch Aisa Kar De Mere Kirdgaar Aankho Me Hamesha Naqsh Rahe Roo-E-Yaar Aankho Me Unhe Na Dekha To Kis Kaam Ki Hai Ye Aankhe Ke Dekhne Ki He Saari Bahaar Ankho Me Ajab Nahi Ke Likha Lauh Ka Nazar Aaye Jo Naqshe Paa Ka Laga’o Ghubaar Aankho Me Basar Ke Saath Basirat Bhi Khub Roshan Hai, Lagaoun Khake Qadam Baar Baar Aankhon Me. Farishto Poochte Ho Mujh Se Kis Ki Ummat Ho Lo Dekh Lo Ye Hai Tasweer-E-Yaar Aankho Me Karam Ye Mujh Pe Kiya He Mere Tassawur Ne Ke Aaj Khinch Di Tasweer-E-Yaar Aankho Me Piyaa He Jaam-E-Muhabbat Jo Aap Ne Noori Hamesha Us Ka Rahega Khumaar Aankho Me Wo Noor De Mere Parwardigar Aankhon Me Ki Jalwagar Rahe Rukh Ki Bahaar Aankhon Me Tumhaare Qadmo Pe Moti Nisaar Hone Ko Hain Be Shumaar Meri Ashkbaar Aankho Me Nazar Me Kaise Samayenge Phool Jannat Ke Ke Bus Chuke Hai Madine Ke Khaar Aankho Me Khule Hain Deeda-E-Ushaaq Khwaabe Marg Me Bhi Ke Us Nigaar Ka He Intizaar Aankho Me Wo Subz Subz Nazar Aa Raha He Ghumbad-E-Subz Qaraar Aa Gaya Yoo Be Qaraar Aankho Me Ye Kya Sawaal He Mujh Se Ke Kis Ka Banda He Me Jis Ka Banda Hoo He Noor Baar Aankho Me Wahee Mujhe Nazar Aaye Jidhar Nigah Karu Unhi Ka Jalwa Rahe Aash Kaar Aankho Me Ye Dil Tarap Ke Kahee Aankho Me Na Aajaye Ke Phir Rahaa Hai Kisi Ka Mazaar Aankho Me Basa Huva Hai Koi Gul Azaar Aankhon Me, Khila Hai Chaaron Taraf Lalazaar Aankhon Me. Fir Aayen Din Mere Akhtar Shabe Huzuri Me, Karam Se Jalwa Kare Jab Nigaar Aankhon Me. Nigah E Mufti E Aazam Ki Hai Yeh Jalwahgiri, Chamak Rahe Hai Jo Akhtar Hazaar Aankhon Me.

৩০৮

Kya Ajab Noor Ka Behta Hai Jo Darya Dil Me

Kya Ajab Noor Ka Behta Hai Jo Darya Dil Me Dil Hai Taiba Mein Mera Aur Hai Taiba Dil Me Gham Ki Chaadar Jo Kabhi Odh Ke So Jaata Hoon Jaagti Rehti Hai Aaqa Ki Tamanna Dil Me Dil Isi Waaste Reh Reh Ke Dhadakta Hai Mera Kyun Ke Rehte Hain Hamesha Mere Aaqa Dil Me Us Ghari Meri Madad Karte Hain Mere Aaqa Jab Bhi Ho Jaati Hai Uljhan Koi Paida Dil Me Ek Ek Cheez Mujhe Sabz Nazar Aati Hai Bas Gaya Jab Se Sakhi Gumbade Khazra Dil Me

৩০৯

Kya Hai Kisi Se Kaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad

Kya Hai Kisi Se Kaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Sab Ko Mera Salaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Koi Tabeeb Bhi Mera Karta Sada Ilaaj Bas Aa Gaya Araam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Jalwa Kisi Ka Ho Ya Tajalli Kisi Ki Ho Hai Dekhna Haraam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Jisko Bhi Tune Jaam E Muhabbat Pila Diya Wo Kya Karega Jaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Meri Raah E Hayaat Ke Dushwaar Marhale Hal Ho Gaye Tamaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Sajda Karun Toh Kufr Hai Na Sajda Karun Toh Kufr Aaya Hai Woh Makaam Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Sajda Jarun Ke Nakshe Kadam Choomta Rahun Ghar Kaaba Bann Gaya Hai Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Ham Aa Ke Tere Shehar Se Waapis Na Jaayenge Yeh Faisla Kiya Hai Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Lakhon Haseen Saamne Aaye Nigah Na Ki Ankhon Ko See Liya Hai Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Sajda Tha Sang E Dar Pe Tere Sar Tha Arsh Par Aisi Padi Namaaz Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Sajda Karunga Toh Mujhe Kaafir Kahenge Log Yeh Kaun Sochta Hai Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Mehmood Ka Ayaz Toh Bas Ek Hi Raha Lakhon Banein Ayaz Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad Khoyi Hui Si Rehti Hai Har Waqt Ab Hi Na Yeh Haal Ho Gaya Hai Tumhein Dekhne Ke Baad ******************************************* ************ Other Version **************** Kese Sukoon Paon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad. Ab Kia Ghazal Sunaon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad. Awaaz De Rahi Hai Meri Zindagi Mujhe. Main Jaon Ya Na Jaon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad. Kaabay Ka Ehtaraam Bhi Meri Nazar Main Hai. Sar Kis Taraf Jhukaon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad. Teri Nigah-E-Mast Ne Makhmor Kar Dia. Kia Mai-Kaday Ko Jaon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad. Nazron Main Tab-E-Deed Hi Baqi Nahi Rahi. Kis Se Nazar Milaon Tujhe Dekhne Ke Baad.

Kya Hi Zauk Afza Shafa’at Hain Tumhari Wah Wah Karz Leti Hain Gunah Parhezgari Wah Wah Khama-E-Qudrat Ka Husn-E-Dastkaari Wah Wah Kya Hi Tasveer Apne Pyare Ki Sawaari Wah Wah Ashk Shab Bhar Intezar-E-Afwe Ummat Mein Bahe(N) Main Fida Chaand Aur Yu Akhtar Shumari Wah Wah Ungliya(N) Hain Faiz Par Toote Hain Pyase Jhoom Kar Nadiya(N) Panj Aab E Rehmat Ki Hain Jaari Wah Wah Noor Ki Khairaat Lene Daudte Hain Mehre Maah Uthti Hain Kis Shaan Se Gard Sawaari Wah Wah Neem Jalwe Ki Na Tab Aaye Qamar Saa To Sahi Mehar Aur Un Talwo Ki Aaina Daari Wah Wah Nafs Ye Kya Zulm Hain Jab Dekho Taaza Jurm Hain Naatwa(N) Ke Sar Par Itni Bojh Bhari Wah Wah Mujrimo Ko Dhundhti Phirte Hain Rehmat Ki Nigaah Taaliye Bargashta Teri Saazgaari Wah Wah Arz Begi Hain Shafa’at Afw Ki Sarkaar Mein Chat Rahi Hain Mujrimo Ki Fard Saari Wah Wah Kya Madine Me Saba Aayi Ki Phoolo Me Hain Aaj Kuch Nayi Buu Bheeni-Bheeni Pyari-Pyari Wah Wah Khud Rahe Parde Me Aur Aaina Akse Khaas Ka Bhej Kar Anjaano Se Ki Rahdaari Wah Wah Is Taraf Rouze Ka Noor Us Samt Mimbar Ki Bahaar Beechme Jannat Ki Pyari Pyari Kyari Wah Wah Sadqe Is In’aam Ke Qurbaan Us Ikraam Ke Ho Rahi Hain Dono Aalam Me Tumhari Wah Wah Para-E-Dil Bhi Na Nikla Dil Se Tohfe Me Raza Un Sagane Ku Se Inti Jaan Pyari Wah Wah

Kya Khabar Kya Saza Mujko Milti

Kya Khabar Kya Saza Mujko Milti Mere Aqa Ne Izzat Bachali Farde Isyaan Meri Mujse Le Kar Kali Kamli Mein Apni Chhupali Wo Ata Par Ata Karne Wale Aur Ham Bhi Nahin Talne Wale Jaisi Dewdi Hai Waise Bhikhari Jaisa Data Hai Waise Sawali Mein Gada Hun Magar Kiske Dar Ka Wo Jo Sultan E Kauno Makan Hein Ye Gulami Badi Mustanad Hai Mere Sar Par Hai Taaje Bilali Mein Madine Se Kya Aa Gaya Hun Zindagi Jaise Buj Si Gayi Hai Ghar Ke Andar Faza Suni Suni Ghar Ke Bahar Sama Khali Khali Meri Umar E Rawan Bas Thaher Jaa Ab Safar Ki Zarurat Nahi Hai Unke Kadmon Mein Meri Zabeen Hai Aur Haathon Mein Roze Ki Jaali Mein Fakat Naam Leva Hun Unka Unki Tausif Mein Kya Karunga Mein Na Iqbal Khusru Na Sa'di Mein Na Kudsi Jaami Na Haali Kya Khabar Kya Saza Mujko Milti Mere Aqa Ne Izzat Bachali Farde Isyaan Meri Mujse Le Kar Kali Kamli Mein Apni Chhupali

৩১৩

Kya Mahekte Hain Mahekne Wale

Kya Mahekte Hain Mahekne Wale Boo Pe Chalte Hain Bhatakne Wale Jagmaga Uthi Meri Gor Ki Khaak Tere Qurbaan Chamakne Wale Mahe Bedaag Ke Sadqe Jaaun Yun Damakte Hain Damakne Wale Arsh Tak Phaili Hai Taab E Aariz Kya Jhalakte Hain Jhalakne Wale Gul E Taiba Ki Sana Gaate Hain Nakhl E Tooba Pe Chahekne Wale Aasiyo! Thaam Lo Daaman Un Ka Wo Nahin Haath Jhatakne Wale Abr E Rehmat Ke Salaami Rehna Phalte Hain Paude Lachakne Wale Arey Ye Jalwa Gaahe Jaanan Hain Kuch Adab Bhi Hain Phadakne Wale Sunniyo! Un Se Madad Maange Jao Pade Bakte Rehte Hain Bakne Wale Sham'e Yaad E Rukh E Jaanan Na Bujhe Khaaq Ho Jaaye Bhadakne Wale Maut Kehti Hai Ke Jalwa Hai Qareeb Ek Zaraa So Lein Bilakne Wale Hum Bhi Khumhlaane Se Gaafil The Kabhi Kya Hansa Gunche Chatakne Wale Nakhl Se Chhutke Ye Kya Haal Huwa Aah! O Patte Khadakne Wale Jab Gire Munh Sooye Maikhana Tha Hosh Mein Hai Ye Behekne Wale Dekh O Zakhm E Dil Aape Ko Sambhal Phoot Behte Hain Tapakne Wale Mae Kahaan Aur Kahaan Main Zaahid Yun Bhi To Chhakte Hain Chhakne Wale Kaf E Dariya E Karam Mein Hai Raza Paanch Fawware Chhalakne Wale

Lab Pe Jaari Sadaa Kardo Aaqa Karam Lab Pe Jaari Sadaa Kardo Aaqa Karam Dar Pe Pohcha To Dil Ney Kaha Barmalaa Ma’af Ho Sab Khataa Kardo Aaqa Karam Kis Ki Jaanib Chaloon Kis Ka Moonh Main Takoon Chor Kar Dar Tera Kardo Aaqa Karam Aap Haazir Bhi Hain Aap Naazir Bhi Hain Yak Nazar Soo E Maa Kardo Aaqa Karam Marz E Isyaan Sey Ab To Mey Choor Huwa Deydo Kaamil Shifa Kardo Aaqa Karam Kaun Deyta Hai Deyney Ko Moonh Chaahiye Haath Phailaa Diya Kardo Aaqa Karam Saa-Il E Dar Huwa Shakir E Bey Nawaa ‘ilm E Naaf’e ‘ataa Kardo Aaqa Karam Jaaliyon Key Qareeb Shakir E Khush Naseeb Aankh Kardee Hain Nam Kardo Aaqa Karam

৩১৮

Lab Pe Naate Paak Ka Naghma

Lab Pe Naate Paak Ka Naghma Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Meri Nabi Se Mera Rishta Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Past Who Kaise Hosakta Hai Jis Ko Haqq Ne Buland Kiya Dono Jahan Me Un Ka Charcha Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Aur Kissi Jaanib Kyu Jaae Aur Kissi Ko Kyu Dekhe Apna Sub Kuch Ghumbade Khazra Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Fikr Nahein Hai Hum Ko Kuch Bhi Dukh Ki Dhoop Ghari To Kya Hum Par Unke Fazl Ka Saaya Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Batla Do Ghustaaq-E-Nabi Ko Ghairat Muslim Zinda Ho Deen Pe Mar Mitne Ka Jazba Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai In Ke Dar Se Sub Ho Aaye Jaana Saka To Ek Sabhi Ye Ke Ekh Tasweer Tamanna Kal Bhi Ta Aur Aaj Bhi Hai

৩১৯

Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya

Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Aaqa De Gulaman Da Main Adna Ghulam Aan Loki Kehnde Khas Main Te Amaan Tu Wii Aam Aaan Parda Je Paaya Hai Te Paayi Rakhin Sohniya Changay Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Hun Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Hashr Dihare Jaddon Amlan To Tolran Sharm De Maare Main Tay Kujh Wii Nayi Bolna Damin Wich Apnay, Chupayi Rakhin Soniya Change Aan Ke Manday Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Kisay Nu Main Apna Dukhra Sunaya Nayi Tere Baajon Kisse Meno Seene Naal Laaya Nayi Seene Naal Laaya Aey Te Laaye Rakhin Sohnya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Naa’m Tera Le Ke Aaqa, Shaan Main Wii Payi Aay Teray Haath Dor Sanyaan Apay Tu Charhai Aay Charhi Hui Guddi Nu Charhai Rakhein Sohnaya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Ziya Teri Aal Da Banya Ghulam Aey Aeday Naloon Aur Lena Ki Inam Aey Banya Ghulam Hai Banayi Rakhein Sohnaya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Naa Tera Leyke Aaqa, Ghulaam Sarey Sajey Nay, Kasam Khuda Dee Tusan Aib Saarey Kajey Nay, Lukkay Huey Aiban Nu Lukayi Rajhi Soniya, Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Zia O Diyaal Da, Baniya Ghulaam Mein, Ehdey Naalo Wad Aur Leyna Ki Naam Aey, Bharya Ghulaam Tey, Bharayi Rakhi Soniya, Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya Lagiyan Ne Mojan Honr Laayi Rakh Soniya Change Aan Ke Mande Aan Nibhayi Rakhin Soniya

৩২০

Lahad Mein Ishqe Rukhe Shah Ka Daagh Le Ke Chale

Lahad Mein Ishqe Rukhe Shah Ka Daagh Le Ke Chale Andheri Raat Suni Thi Chiraagh Le Ke Chale Tere Ghulamon Ka Naqshe Qadam Hai Raahe Khuda Woh Kya Behak Sake Jo Yeh Suraagh Le Ke Chale Jinaa(N) Banegi Muhibbaane Chaar Yaar Ki Qabr Jo Apne Seene Mein Yeh Chaar Baagh Le Ke Chale Gaye, Ziyaarate Dar Ki, Sad Aah Waapas Aaye Nazar Ke Ashk Puche Dil Ka Daagh Le Ke Chale Madina Jaane Jinaano Jahaa(N) Hai Woh Sun Le Jinhe Junoone Jinaa(N) Suye Jaagh Le Ke Chale Tere Sahaabe Sukhan Se Na Nam Ki Nam Se Bhi Kam Baleegh Bahre Balaaghat Balaagh Le Ke Chale Huzoore Taiba Se Bhi Koi Kaam Badh Kar Hai Ki Jhoote Heelaye Makro Faraagh Le Ke Chale Tumhare Wasfe Jamaalo Kamaal Mein Jibreel Muhaal Hai Ki Majaalo Masaagh Le Ke Chale Gilaa Nahi Hai Mureede Rasheede Shaitaan Se Ki Us Ke Wus'ate Ilmi Ka Laagh Le Ke Chale Har Ek Apne Bade Ki Badaayi Karta Hai Har Ek Mugbacha Mug Ka Ka Ayaagh Le Ke Chale Magar Khuda Pe Jo Dhabba Darogh Ka Thopa Ye Kis Laee(N) Ki Ghulami Ka Daagh Le Ke Chale Wuquye Kizb Ke Maa'ni Durust Aur Quddoos Hiye Ki Foote Ajab Sabz Baagh Le Ke Chale Jahaa(N) Mein Koi Bhi Kaafir Sa Kaafir Aisa Hai Ki Apne Rab Pe Safaahat Ka Daagh Le Ke Chale Padi Hai Andhe Ko Aadat Ki Shorbe Hi Se Khaaye Bater Haath Na Aayi To Zaagh Le Ke Chale Khabees Bahre Khabeesa Khabeesa Bahre Khabees Ki Saath Jins Ko Baazo Kulaagh Le Ke Chale Jo Deen Kawwo(N) Ko De Baithe Un Ko Yaksaa(N) Hai Kulaagh Le Ke Chale Ya Ulaagh Le Ke Chale Raza Kisi Sage Taiba Ke Paau Bhi Chume Tum Aur Aah Ki Itna Dimaagh Le Ke Chale

Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Tera Sadqa Mast Nazaare Tere Noor To Chamkan Taare Tere Naal Ne Sab Roshnaiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Tu Menu Sohneya Rangeyaa Main Jinni Waar Wi Mangeyaa Tu Khayraan Jholi Paiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Eho Kehnde Ne Aashiq Saare Tere Warge Laal Pyaare Kaddon Jammdiyan Ne Nit Maiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Kaddi Turrda Te Kaddi Rukda Chand Badlaan Ohle Lukda Tere Mukh Diyan Wekh Safaiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Tu Kita Karam Kareemaa Tenu Lay Gayi Naal Halima Hath Maldiyaan Reh Gaiyan Daiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Har Ghaus, Abdaal, Qutub Nu Dainda Ay Maula Sab Nu Tere Aal Da Sadqa Saiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan Lajpaala Mereya Saiyaan Tere Naal Baharaan Aiyaan

৩২২

Lajpal Nabi Mere Darda Di Dawa Dena

Lajpal Nabi Mere Darda Di Dawa Dena Jad Waqt E Nazaa Aave Daaman Di Hawa Dena Mai Naat Teri Padna Mai Zikr Tera Karna Is Zikr Di Barkat Naal Meri Qabr Wasa Dena Dil Ronda Hai Jandene Jad Lok Madine Nu Hun Saanu Vi Yaa Aaqa Darbaar Dikha Dena Sarkaar Di Mehfil Vich Jholiyan Bicha Baithe Laj Rakh Laive Lajpaala Khali Na Utha Dena Mare Chaliya Ve Ro Ro Ke Wich Hijr De Mehbooba Hun Saanu Vi Ya Aaqa Dedaar Kara Dena Saaim Di Tamanna Hai Rawe Aake Madine Vich Paawe Taibe De Kutteyan De Pairanch Bitha Dena Khairat Ata Karna, Sarkar Di Marzi Aay. Mera Tay Si Kam Mangna, Jholi Nu Wicha Dena. Aasi Di Tamanna Aay, Rahwe Aake Madiney Wich. Bhawe Taiba De Kutteyan De, Qadmaan Wich Bitha Dena.

৩২৩

Lam Ya’ati Naziro Kafi Nazrin

Lam Ya’ati Naziro Kafi Nazrin, Misle To Na Shud Paida Jaana. Jag Raaj Ko Taaj Torey Sar So, Hai Tujh Ko Shahey Do Sara Jaana. Ana Fi Atshiv Wa Sakha Ka Atam, Aey Gesu-Aey Paak, Aey Abr E Karam, Barsan Haare Rimjhim, Rimjhim, Do Boond Idhar Bhi Gira Jaana. Al Bahro Alaa Wal Mavjo Tagha, Man Bekaso Tufaan Hosh Ruba, Manjdhaar Mein Houn Bigri Hai Hawaa, Mori Nayya Paar Laga Jaana. Ar Rooho Fida Ka Fazid Harka, Yak Shola Digar Barzan Ishqa, Mora Tan, Man, Dhan, Sab Phoonk Diya, Yeh Jaan Bhi Pyaare Jala Jaana. Al Qalbo Shyjivm Wal Hamo Shujut, Dil Dar Chuna Jaan Zer Chuno, Pat Apni Bhi Pat Mein Kaaisay Kahoun, Mera Koun Hai Teray Siva Jaana. Bas Khaama-Aey Khaam Nawaaey Raza, Na Yeh Taraz Meri Na Yeh Rang Mera, Irshaade Ahibba Na’atik Tha, Nachaar Is Raah Para Jaana. Subhan Allah Ma Ajmala Ka, Ma Ahsaana Ka, Ma Akmala Ka, Kithay Mehr-E-Ali Kithay Teri Sana, Gustaakh Akhiyan Kithay Ja Ariyan. Ya Shamso Nazrate Ila Layli, Chun Ba Tai’bah Rasi Arze Ba Kuni, Tori Jyot Ki Jhal, Jhal Jag Mein Rachi, Meri Shab Ne Na Din Hona Jaana. Laka Badrun Fil Wajhil Ajmal, Khat Haaley Maah Zulf Abre Ajal, Tore Chandan Chandra Par Kundal, Rehmat Ki Bharan Barsa Jaana. Ya Kaafelati Zidi Ajalak, Rahme Bar Hasrate Tishna Labak, Mora Jiyera Larje Dharak, Dharak, Tai’bah Se Abhi Na Suna Jaana. Waahan Li Suway’aatin Zahabat Aa Ahde Huzoor Baar Gahat Jab Yaad Aawat Mohe Karna Parat Dardaawah Madeene Kaa Jaanaa

৩২৪

Likh Raha Hoon Naate Sarwar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar

Likh Raha Hoon Naate Sarwar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Kaif Taari Hai Qalam Par Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Hai Muqaddar Yaawri Par Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Phir Na Kyun Jhoome Sanaagar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Masjide Nabwi Pe Pohonche Marhaba Salle Ala Ho Gaya Jaari Zubaan Par Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Aap Ki Galiyon Ke Mangte Mujh Se To Ache Rahe Hai Sakoon Unko Mayassar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Aap Se Bus Aap Hi Ko Maangta Hai Ya Nabi Aap Ka Adna Gadagar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Dhoop Rozaana Madina Choomti Hai Jhoom Kar Aur Lipat Jaati Hai Jaakar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar Aah! Aye Attar Tujhse Itna Bhi Na Ho Saka Jaan Kar Deta Nichawar Sabz Gumbad Dekh Kar

৩২৫

Likha Hai Ek Zaifa Thi Ke Jo Mekkah Me Rahti Thi

Likha Hai Ek Zaifa Thi Ke Jo Mekkah Me Rahti Thi Wo In Baton Ko Sunti Thi Magar Khamosh Rahti Thi Wo Sunti Thi Muhammad Hai Koi Hashim Gharane Me Wo Kahta Hai Khuda Bas Ek Hai Sare Zamane Me Wo Sunti Thi Hubul Ki Laat Ki Tazleel Karta Hai Wo Apne Haq Ke Farmane Ki Yun Tameel Karta Hai Wo Sunti Thi Jo Uske Saath Hai Wo Hai Ghulam Uska Musalman Ho Hi Jata Hai Jo Sunta Hai Kalaam Uska Likha Hai Wo Zaifa Ek Din Kaaba Me Jaa Pahunchi Hubul Ke Paaon Par Sar Rakh Ke Usne Ye Dua Mangi Main Tujh Ko Poojti Hun Aur Khuda Bhi Tujh Ko Kahti Hun Bara Afsos Hai Jo Aaj Kal Main Ranj Sahti Hun Wo Gham Ye Hai Muhammad Hai Koi Hashim Gharane Me Wo Kahta Hai Khuda Bas Ek Hai Saare Zamane Me Mita Do Uski Hasti Ko Na Le Phir Koi Naam Uska Jigar Chhalni Hua Jata Hai Sun Sun Kar Kalam Uska Dua Karke Uthi Sajde Se Aur Wo Apne Ghar Ayi Samajhti Thi Ye Dil Me Ab Meri Ummeed Bhar Ayi Zaifa Ko Khushi Thi Ab Hubul Bijli Gira Dega Muhammad To Muhammad Saathiyon Ko Bhi Mita Dega Magar Kuchh Din Guzarne Per Na Jab Ummeed Bhar Ayi Dua Karke Hubul Se Apne Dil Me Khoob Pachhtayi Garaz Tarqeeb Usne Soch Lee Ye Khud Hi Ghar Aa Kar Ke Chhorungi Ye Basti Mai Rahungi Aur Kahin Ja Kar Garaz Ek Din Subah Ko Usne Apni Ek Gathri Lee Nikal Kar Ghar Se Apne Aur Darwaze Pe Aa Baithi Zaifa Sochti Thi Ab Koi Mazdoor Milta Hai Use Yeh Kya Khaber Thi Ek Khuda Ka Noor Milta Hai Fareeza Subah Ka Karke Ada Sarkar Do Aalam Chale Jaate The Kaaba Ki Taraf Wo Rahmat-E-Alam Jalon Me Aap Ke Shams-O-Qamar Maloom Hote The Paye Tasleem Sajde Me Shajar Maloom Hote The Zaifa Muntazir Mazdoor Ki Baithi Thi Ghabrayi Yakayak Samne Se Chaand Si Surat Nazar Ayi Zaifa Ne Kaha Beta Yahan Aana Bata Kya Naam Hai Tera Kaha Mazdoor Hoon Amma Bata Kya Kaam Hai Tera Kaha Mazdoor Hai Agar Tu To Chal Gathri Meri Lekar Main Khush Kar Dungi Aye Mazdoor Mazdoori Teri Dekar Ye Sun Kar Aapne Gathri Utha Kar Apne Sar Par Li Zaifon Ki Madad Karna Ye Aadat Thi Payamber Ki Garaz Gathri Ko Lekar Manzil-E-Maqsood Par Ayi Kaha Dil Se Ke Aye Dil Ab Teri Ummed Bhar Aayi Kaha Beta Jo Thi Dil Me Tamanna Ho Gayi Puri Muhammad To Muhammad Sathiyon Se Ho Gayi Doori Lagi Dene Jo Mazdoori Zaifa Aap Ko Us Dam To Farmane Lage Us Dam Huzur-E-Sarwar-E-Aalam Ye Koi Kaam Hai Amma Mai Lun Ab Jiski Mazdoori Koi Agar Our Khidmat Ho To Wo Bhi Main Karun Poori Ye Farmate Huye Ki Aapne Jane Ke Tayyari Zaifa Se Ijazat Chahate Then Rahmat-E-Baari Zaifa Ne Kaha Beta Zara Thahro Chale Jaana Mujhe Ek Baat Kahni Hai Zara Sun Kar Chale Jaana Yaqeen Jaano Ki Ab Makkah Me Jhagra Hone Wala Hai Main Samjhati Hun Tujh Ko Isliye Tu Bhola Bhala Hai Wo Makke Me Qabeela Hashmi Naam-O-Laqab Wale Wohi Beta Jo Hain Sardar Abdul Muttalib Wale Unhi Me Ek Jawan Hai Jo Suna Jaata Hai Saahir Hai Ke Is Fan Me Magar Beta Wo Apne Khoob Mahir Hai Wo Asar Hota Hai Jiske Dil Tukhm-E-Ulfat Bo Ke Rahta Hai Jo Sunta Hai Kalam Uska Wo Uska Hoke Rahta Hai Hamesha Bach Ke Chalna Usse Bole Koi Naam Uska Naseehat Hai Yehi Meri Na Sunna Tu Kalam Uska Nabi Budhiya Ke Dil Me Noor-E-Wahdat Bharne Wale Then Naseehat Sun Rahe Then Jo Naseehat Karne Wale Then Zaifa Ne Kaha, ‘beta Bhala Kya Naam Hai Tera’ Tera Aaghaz Kya Hai Aur Kya Anjaam Hai Tera Kaha Hazrat Ne Budhiya Se, ‘tujhe Kya Naam Batlaun’ Main Kya Kaam Batlaun, Main Kya Anjaam Batlaaun Main Banda Hun Khuda Ka Aur Mujassam Noor-E-Zad Hoon Kaha Gardan Jhuka Kar Aapne, ‘mai Hi Muhammed Hun’ Main Hoon Maasoom Duniya Me Mera Dushman Zamana Hai Khuda Waahid Hai Aalam Me Mujhe Bas Ye Batana Hai Ye Sunna Tha Ke Bas Aakhon Se Aansu Ho Gaye Jaari Nabi Ke Ishq Ki Ek Chot Si Dil Per Lagi Kaari Zaifa Ne Kaha Beta Karo Mushkil Meri Aasan Mai Aisi Jeet Ke Sadqe Me Aisi Haar Ke Qurban Hua Phir Haal Par Uske Jo Fazle Eezan-E-Baari Zaifa Ke Zubaan Se Khud Ba Khud Kalma Hua Jari Laailaha Illallah Muhammadur Mawlaya Salli Wassalim (Qasida E Burda Sharif)

Mawlaya Salli Wassalim Da-Iman Abadan Ala Habi Bika Khairil Khalqi Kullimi Muhammadun Sayyidul Kawnayni Wath-Thaqalayn, Wal Fareeqayni Min ‘urbiw-Wa Min ‘ajami. Huwal Habeebul-Ladhee Turja Shafaa’atuhu Li Kulli Hawlim-Minal Ahwali Muqutahimi. Thumar Rida 'an Abi Bakarin Wa 'an Umarin Wa 'an Aliyin Wa 'an Uthmana Dhil Karami Ya Rabbe Bil Mustafa Ballig Maqasedna Wag Fir Lana Ma Madaya Wase Al Karami Da’a Ilallahi Fal Mustamsi Koona Bihi Mustamsi Koona Bi Hablin Ghayri Munfasimi. Huzita Fil Lahilam Tuhzam Wa-Lam Tahimi Hataa Ghuwadad Ummatal Islami Finujoomi Habiballah Rasoolallah Imam-Al Mursaleen Habiballah Rasoolallah Imam-Al Mursaleen Saraytan Min Haramin Laylan Ila Haramin, Kama Saral Badru Fitajin Minazulameen Wa-Bita Tan Qa Ila Anil Ta Manzilatan Min Qamikaw Sayinal Tudrak Wa-Lam Turami Faqan Nabiyyina Fi Khalqiw-Wa Fi Khuluqin Wa Lam Yudaanuhu Fi ‘ilmiw-Wa La Karami. Famablaghul ‘ilmi Feehi Annahu Basharun Wa Annahu Khayru Khalqillahi Kullihimi. Nabiyyunal Amirun-Nahi Fala Ahadun, Abarra Fi Qawli La Minhu Wa La Na’ami. Wal Aali Was-Sah-Bi Thummat Tabi'ieena Fahum Ahlut Tuqa Wan Nuqa Wal Hilmi Wal Karami Amintazak-Koori Jiraa Nim Bidhee Salami Maazaj Ta Dam An Jaraa Mim Muqlatim Bidami Ya Akramal Khalqi Maali Man Aluzubihi Siwaaka Inda Huloolil Haadisil Amami

Na Koi Aap Sa Hoga Na Koi Aap Jaisa Tha Koi Yusuf Se Poochay Mustufa Ka Husn Kaisa Tha Zameen O Asmaan Mein Koi Bhi Misaal Na Mili Mawlaya Salli Wassalim Da-Iman Abadan, Ala Habi Bika Khairil Khalqi Kullimi. Muhammadun Sayyidul Kawnayni Wath-Thaqalayn, Wal Fareeqayni Min ‘urbiw-Wa Min ‘ajami Wo Muhammad Faqre Alam Badshah-E-Inso Jaan Sarwar-E-Kaonain Sultan-E-Arab Shahe Ajam Ek Din Jibreel Se Kehne Lage Shahe Umam Tumne Dekha Hai Jahaan Batlao To Kaise Hai Hum Arz Ki Jibreel Ne Aye Shahidi Aye Mohtaram Aap Ka Koi Mumasil Hi Nahi Rab Ki Qasam Huwal Habeebul-Ladhee Turja Shafaa’atuhu, Li Kulli Hawlim-Minal Ahwali Muqutahimi.
