৩৮১

Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai

Mera Roop Wi Nai, Mera Rang Wi Nai, Menu Madni Manaun Da Dhang Wi Nai. Mera Ishq Wi Rumi Warga Nai, Meri Jaami Wangu Torr Wi Nai. Par Main Qasm Khuda Ki Khana Waan, Menu Sohne Jeya Koi Hor Wi Nai. Kyunke Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Lokan De Horr Sahare Ne, Par Mera Toh Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Seahiyan Mujh Mein, Daagh Mujh Mein, Jalley Ussi Ke Chiragh Mujh Me. Assasa-E-Qalb-O-Jaan Wohi Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Tera To Sab Kuch Tera Nabi Hai. “mere Gunahon Pe Uska Parda, Woh Meri Dhaal Mera Sahara.” Woh Meri Manzil Bhi, Humsafar Bhi. Woh Saamne Bhi, Pass-E-Nazar Bhi. Wohi Mujhe Door Se Pukare, Ussi Ki Parchayi Ruh Par Bhi. Woh Rang Mera, Woh Meri Khushboo. Main Usski Muthi Ka Eik Jugnu. Woh Mere Andar Ki Roshni Hai. Ussi Ke Qadmon Mein Rah Meri, Ussi Ki Pyaasi Hai Chah Meri. Ussi Ki Mujrim Meri Khatayein, Ussi Ki Rehmat Gawah Meri. Ussi Ka Gham Mujhko Saath Rakhe, Wohi Mere Dil Pe Haath Rakhe. Woh Dard Bhi Hai, Sukoon Bhi Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Azal Ke Chehre Pe Noor Uska, Zahoor-E-Alaam Zahoor Uska. Khud Uski Awaaz Gufta-E-Haqq, Khud Uski Tanhai Toor Uska. Bohat Se Aalimaqaam Aaye, Khuda Ke Baad Uska Naam Aaye. Woh Awwaleen Hai Woh Akhreen Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai. Na Mujhse Baar-E-Ammal Uthe Ga. Na Azl Hi Saath Koi Dega. Aggar Kahega To Roz-E-Mehshar, Khuda Se Mera Nabi Kahega. Siyahiyaan, Daagh Saaf Karde. Isse Bhi Maula Maaf Karde. Yeh Mera Ashiq Hai, Warsi Hai. Mera To Sab Kuch Mera Nabi Hai.

৩৮২

Mera Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Mera Dil Maqam E Habeeb Hai

Mera Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi, Mera Dil Maqam E Habeeb Hai Mai Mariz E Ishq E Rasool Hoon, Wo Habeeb Mera Tabeeb Hai Main Behak Sakoon Yeh Majaal Kiya, Mera Rahmnuma Koi Aur Hai, Mujhe Khoob Jaan Lein Manzilein, Ye Shikasta Pa Koi Aur Hai. Jo Tumhari Jali Se Muttasilm, Hai Sutho Ke Picche Khajil Khajil, Nahi Main Nahin Woh Marize Dil, Na Meray Siwa Koi Aur Hua. Mein Buron Say Laakh Bura Sahi, Magar Un Say Hai Mera Waasta Meri Laaj Rakhna Mere Khuda, Ye Tayray Habeeb Ki Baat Hai Hai Tujhe Khabar Shahe Einoaan, Meri Wajhe Raahate Qalbo Jaan, Na Tere Siwa Koi Aur Tha, Na Tere Siwa Koi Aur Hai. Main Jo Door Arze Haram Se Tha, Hoi Khulde Gosh Haseen Sada, Hai Isi Mein Majide Be Nawa, Ke Yeh Kaafila Koi Aur Hai. Tayray Zikr Ki Hai Ye Barkatayn Mere Bigray Kam Sanwar Ga-Ay Jahaan Teri Yaad Ho Dilnasheen Wahiin Rahmaton Ka Nazool Hai Teri Deed Jisko Naseeb He Wo Naseeb Qaabil E Deed Hai Tera Daykhna Mayri Eid He Tera Rukh Kalaam E Majeed Hai Ho Daruud Tujh Pay Bhi Aminah Tere Chaand Par Bhi Salam Ho Teri Goad Kitni Azeem Hai Mila Tujh Ko Maah E Tamaam Hai Hai Ye Aarzu Jo Ho Surkhru Milay Do Jahaan Ki Aabru Meyn Kahun Ghulam Huun Apka Wo Kahayn Kay Hamko Qabul Hai Meri Iltija Hai Yeh Dosto, Kabhi Tum Jo Soove Haram Chalo, To Bana Ke Sarko Qadam Chalo, Ke Yeh Rasta Koi Aur Hai Ye Ghumaan Tha Kahin Saal Say, Yeh Yaqeen Hai Kahin Roz Se, Meray Dil Se Ghumbad E Sabz Ka, Yeh Muamla Koi Aur Hai. Aaway Karma Wali Fayr O Gharii Phira Meyn Madinay Gali Gali Fayr Saadi Wi Howay Haazri Saaday Waastay Koii Dua Karay Balaghal Ula Bikamali Kasha Fadduja Bijamalihi Hasunat Jamiu Hisaalihi Sallu Aleyhi Wa Aalihi.

৩৮৩

Meray Sohneya Madinay Vich Rehn Valea

Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Kadi Meynu Vi Bulaley Us Dar Pey, Kadi Meri Vi Tamana Poori Kardey Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a, Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Dam Dam Yaad Teri Diil Vich Rehndi’ey, Rohndi’ya Ney Akhiya Tey Neendar Na Pendi’ey Sanu Sabz Gumbad Dikh’ladey, Kadi Meri Vi Tamana Poori Kardey Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a, Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Kali Kali Zulf Tey Ankh Mastani’ey, Sohney’a Hai Saab Teri Duniya Deewani’ey Eyk Noori Jaalakh Dikh’ladey, Kadi Meri Vi Tamana Poori Kardey Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a, Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Sadqa Shahida Da Dur Hovan Duriya, Sadlo Jii Kowl Mukh Javan Majbooriya Sarey Suthey Naseeb Jaga Dey, Kadi Meri Vi Tamana Poori Kardey Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a, Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a Hijr Di Raat Lambi Keray Pasey Java Main, Dill Diya Gaala Keynu Adaab Suna Va Main Tuhi Sunley Kowl Bulaley, Kadi Meri Vi Tamana Poori Kardey Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a, Meray Sohney’a Madinay Vich Rehn Vale’a

৩৮৪

Mere Aaqa Aao Ke Muddat Hui Hai

Mere Aaqa Aao Ke Muddat Hui Hai, Teri Rah Me Ankhiya Bichate Bichate. Teri Hasrato Me Teri Chahato Me, Bade Din Hue Ghar Sajaate Sajaate. Mera Hai Ye Imaan Ye Mera Yaqeen Hai, Mere Mustafa Sa Na Koi Haseen Hai. Ke Rukh Unka Dekha Hai Jab Se Qamar Ne, Nikalta Hai Munh Ko Chupate Chupate. Qayamat Ka Manzar Bada Pur Khatar Hai, Magar Mustafa Ka Jo Deewana Hoga. Woh Pul Se Guzar Jaayega Wajd Karte, Ye Naara Nabi Ka Lagate Lagate. Mere Lab Pe Maula Na Koi Sadaa Hai, Faqat Mujh Nikamme Ki Yehi Dua Hai. Meri Rooh Nikle Dar-E-Mustafa Pe, Ghame Dil Nabi Ko Sunate Sunate. Ye Maana Ke Ik Din Aani Qaza Hai, Magar Dosto Tumse Ye Iltijaa Hai. Shehre Muhammad Ki Har Ek Gali Se, Jaanaza Uthana Ghumate Ghumate. Hai Kaabe Ki Azmat Bhi Apni Jagah Par, Magar Dil Me Haakim Tamanna Yahi Hai. Jo Mil Jaaaye Naqshe Kafe Paaye Ahmed, To Mar Jaaye Sar Ko Jhukate Jhukate. Mere Aaqa Aao Ke Muddat Hui Hai, Teri Rah Me Ankhiya Bichate Bichate. Teri Hasrato Me Teri Chahato Me, Bade Din Hue Ghar Sajaate Sajaate. Yeh Dil Jab Se Ishq E Nabi Mein Para Hai, Na Din Ki Khabar He Na Shab Ka Pata Hai Ab Tu Basarat Be Kam Ho Gaye Hai, Teray Gham Mein Aansu Bahate Bahate

৩৮৫

Mere Aaqa Da Husno Jamal

Mere Aaqa Da Husn O Jamal Subhanallah Nahi Sohne Di Koi Misaal Subhanallah Asi Karna Ey Aaqa Da Mil Ke Zikr Jeda Chaunda Ey Jannat Wich Paawe Shajjar Oh Mil Ke Kahe Mere Naal Subhanallah Jinna Kaabe Di Chat Te Wi Ditti Azaan Ohdi Saare Ghulama Cho Wakhri Ey Shaan Mere Aaqa Da Aashiq Bilal Subhanallah Aayi Makke Wich Aakhir Te Dayi Halima Jadon Aaqa Nu Bhaaya Te Thehri Kitte Na Aaye Halima Teri Oonthni Di Chaal Subhanallah Jidde Zikr Nu Kita Buland Khuda Ne Ohnu Kaun Ghatawe Ohnu Kaun Mitawe Nahi Aydi Kisse Di Majjaal Subhanallah Sadda Karna Ey Ahmad Ne Zikr E Nabi Aes Zikr E Nabi Toh Bin Ey Kuch Wi Nai Rawe Nisbat Je Naatan De Naal Subhanallah Mere Aaqa Da Husn O Jamal Subhanallah Nahi Sohne Di Koi Misaal Subhanallah

৩৮৬

Mere Aaqa Ka Husno Jamaal

Mere Aaqa Ka Husno Jamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Nahi Sohne Koi Misal Subhanallah Subhanallah Hogai Jispe Aaqa Ki Nazre Karam Kaaba Bhi Chumta Hai Usi Ke Qadam Mere Aaqa Ka Hai Wo Bilaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Mulqe Faras Ka Aatash Kada Bhuj Gaya Aur Qaaba Bhi Tazeem Ko Jhuk Gaya Aaya Jab Aamina Bee Ka Laal Subhanallah Subhanallah Ummey Mabud Ke Ghar Mustafa Jab Gaye Sookhi Bakri Ke Thun Doodh Se Bhar Gaye Kar Diya Aaqa Ne Malamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Aay The Qatl Karne Umar Jis Ghadi Chhut Ke Talwaar Qadmo Me Khud Gir Padi Deykha Jab Mustafa Ka Jamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Dhoom Se Din Nabi Ka Manaya Karo Najdiyo Ko Hamesha Jalaya Karo Arey Masto Machao Dhamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Unki Ulfat Ki Shamaye Jalaya Karo Geet Unki Muhabbat Ke Gaya Karo Roz-O-Shab Ho Yahi Apna Haal Subhanallah Subhanallah Leyke Makke Se Jabke Haleema Chali Uontni Me Ajab Jaan Si Padh Gayi Mere Aaqa Ka Hai Ye Kamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Marz E Isiya Se Aaqa Shifa Chahiye Hai Khabar Aapko Humko Kya Chahiye Ya Nabi Aapki Bas Raza Chahiye Aapke Dar Pe Aake Qaza Chahiye Poora Kar Dijaye Mera Sawaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Bu Bakar Me Hai Sidq O Safa Dekhiye Aur Umar Me Hai Adlo Wafa Dekhiye Unki Usma Me Shaane Sakha Dekhiye Babul Ilm Aur Sheyre Khuda Dekhiye Sab Me Hai Mustafa Ka Kamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Noor E Awwal Hai Shamsudduha Aap Hai Naiyyare Burje Badrudduja Aap Hai Bu Bakar Bhi Na Samjhe Ke Kya Aap Hai Ya Nabi Jo Hai Baad’az Khuda Aap Hai Koi Laaye Kaha Se Misaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Qutb E Kokan Ke Dar Pe Gada Aaye Hai Lene Khairaat Is Shab Yaha Aaye Hai Apne Dilme Tamanna Sabhi Laaye Hai Aaj Kar Denge Ye Malamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah Murshidi Shah Akhtar Ki Khairaat Hai Ishq Ki Tere Daaman Me Saugaat Hai Rashid E Razvi Kya Teri Auqaat Hai Jo Bhi Kuch Hai Faqat Naat Ki Baat Hai Naate Sarvar Ka Hai Ye Kamaal Subhanallah Subhanallah

৩৮৭

Mere Aaqa Ki Hai Shaan Sabse Alag

Mere Aaqa Ki Hai Shaan Sabse Alag Jaise Rutbe Me Qur’an Sabse Alag Shaane Khairul Basher Khatamul Ambiya Ik Payambar Ik Insaan Sabse Alag Shafqate Be-Sabab Rehmate Be-Talab Unki Bakshish Ka Unwaan Sabse Alag Arsh Qadmo Me Payvand Poshak Me Hai Do Aalam Ke Sultaan Sabse Alag Unko Dekha Nahi Fir Bhi Pehchan Le Meri Aankho Ka Imaan Sabse Alag Unke Darr Ke Gada Sar Pe Taaje Ana Hum Faqeero Ki Pehchan Sabse Alag Naat Kehte Hai Dil Ki Zameeno Me Hum Shayar Apna Hai Maidan Sabse Alag

৩৮৮

Mere Aaqa Mere Sultan Madine Waale

Mere Aaqa Mere Sultan Madine Waale Tum Pe Sau Jaan Se Qurbaan Madine Waale Dekh Kar Aap Ke Gumbad Ka Wo Haseen Manzar Nikle Dil Se Sabhi Armaan Madine Waale Zaa-Ir E Qabr E Munawwar Ki Shafaa’at Hogi Hai Yahi Aap Ka Farmaan Madine Waale Na’at Mey Likhta Rahoon Na’at Faqat Parhta Rahoon Ho Yahi Zeest Ka Saamaan Madine Waale Khidmat E Deen Ke Jazbe Ko Salaamat Rakhna Taake Barhta Rahe Imaan Madine Waale Shakir E Razvi Pe Aaqa Ho Nigah-E-Rehmat Yeh Bechaara Hai Pareshaan Madine Waale

৩৮৯

Mere Aqa Dete Hain

Mere Aqa Dete Hain Jholi Sab Ki Bhar Te Hain Jis Ne Manga Us Ne Paya Mere Aqa Dete Hain Mangte Khali Haath Na Lotein Kitni Mili Khairat Na Poocho Un Ka Karam Hia Un Ka Karam Hai Un Ke Karam Ki Baat Na Poocho Ishq-E-Nabi Ko Nain Ki Daulat Ishq-E-Nabi Baqshih Ki Zamaanat Isse Badkar Dast-E-Talab Mein Hai Koi Saughaat Na Poocho Rashke Jina Taiba Ki Galiyaan Har Zarra Firdos Badama Charo Taraf Anwaar Ka Alam Rehmat Ki Barsaat Na Poocho Zahir Me Taskeen-E-Dil O Jaan Batin Me Mehraaj-E-Dil O Jaan Naam-E-Nabi Phir Naam-E-Nabi Hai Naam-E-Nabi Ki Baat Na Poocho Main Kya Aur Kya Meri Haqiqat Yeh Sab Hai Sarkar Ki Nisbat Main To Bura Hoon Lekin Meri Laaj Hai Kis Ke Haath Na Poocho Haal Agar Kuch Apna Sunaya Un Ke Karam Ka Shikwa Ho Ga Main Apne Halaat Mein Khush Hoon Mujh Se Mere Halaat Na Poocho Akhir Main Bas Itna Kahoon Ga Jaag Utha Ashkon Ka Muqadar Yaad-E-Nabi Mein Rote Rote Kaise Kati Hai Raat Na Poocho

৩৯০

Mere Dil De Werhe Udikan De Dere

Mere Dil De Werhe, Udikan De Dere Te Hanjoa De Dive, Akhan De Banere Ay Sunji Haveli, Te Dukhan De Saaye Kadi Aa Mukao, Ghama De Hanere Ae Dunya Di Dal Dal, Choun Kad Ke Te Molaa Naseeban’ach Likh De, Madine De Phere Moafi Mile Gi, Dare Mustafa Te Nadamat De Athroo, Wagawan Di Dher Ay Ita,at Khuda Di, Ita,at Mustafa Di Ae Farmaya Rabb Ne, Jo Tere O Mere Riaz Ae Madeena, Di Koil Je Howan Karan Oth Ke Koo Koo, Swere Swere

৩৯১

Mere Dil Pe Sarkar Chaye Hue Hai

Mere Dil Pe Sarkar Chaye Hue Hai Rag-O-Pay Me Meri Samaye Hue Hai Madine Me Jab Se Aaye Hue Hai Do Aalam Ko Dil Se Bhulaye Hue Hai Jo Taiba Me Daaman Bichaye Hue Hai Maze Khuld Ke Bas Wo Paye Hue Hai Jin Aakhon Se Aansoo Bahaye Hue Hai Un Aakhon Me Sarkar Aaye Hue Hai Jo Sarak Se Dil Lagaye Hue Hai Wo Har Gham Ko Dil Se Bhulaye Hue Hai Mukaddar Fiza Thi Mu'attar Hui Hai Mere Ghar Me Sarkar Aaye Hue Hai Dil Aaqa Ke Khadmoun Me Wo Leke Aaye Bajaz Dil Jo Sab Kuch Lutaye Hue Hai Unhe Muttaqui Log Kehte Hai Shayad Jo Taiba Me Dhoni Rumaye Hue Hai

৩৯২

Mere Mehboob Ka Meelad Manane Walo

Mere Mehboob Ka Meelad Manane Walo Khush Hua Tum Pe Khuda Bazm Sajane Walo Tum Ko Paigham Madine Se Hai Aane Wala Ho Gaya Tum Pe Karam Naat Sunane Walo Unki Zulfon Ki Qasam Loge Muraade Saari Unki Sarkaar Mein Daaman Ko Bichaane Walo Apne Honton Pe Duroodon Ke Taraane Rakhna Shahe Kaunain Ke Darbaar Mein Aane Walo Ya Rasoolallah Ke Naaro Ko Sajaalo Lab Par Ghar Mein Sarkaar Ko Bulaane Walo Haq Ne Tatheer Ka Khal’at Hai Sajaaya Tum Ko Aye Mere Paak Muhammad Ke Gharane Walo Loot Lo Aapki Rehmat Ke Khazaane Saaim Sadqa Mehboob Ki Aamad Ka Lutaane Walo

৩৯৩

Mere Nabi Ne Itna Nawaza

Mere Nabi Ne Itna Nawaza Jhuk Geya Sar Shukrane Mein Lamha Lamha Guzra Mera Un Ki Yaad Manane Mein Thori Thori Peeta Rahounga Kab Tak Tere Mehfil Mein Mekhana Hai Daal De Saqi Aaj Mere Peymane Mein Apni Nazar Ke Jaam Pila Kar Sab Kay Hosh Urra Saqi Mekharon Kee Bheer Lagee Hey Aaj Terey Mekhanay Main Barson Beet Gaey Hein Aaqa Aas Lagaey Beta Hoon Aap Ka Ik Din Aana Hoga Merey Be Kaashanay Main Rabb Ka Hai Ihsan Niazi Aur Yeh Khaas Inayat Hey Jeewan Gariyan Beet Rahee Hein Peet Kee Preet Nibhanay Main

৩৯৪

Mere Sarkaar Madine Me Bulaatey Rehna

Mere Sarkaar Madine Me Bulaatey Rehna Gham E Duniya Gham E ‘uqba Se Bachate Rehna Koi Mushkil Nahi Aisee Jo Na Taali Tum Ney Mere Daata Meri Bigdi Ko Banaate Rehna Hashr Ki Pyaas Mujhe Jab Ke Pareshan Karde Jaam E Kauthar Ka Mujhe Aap Pilaate Rehna Kaash Jalwa Mere Aaqa Jo Dikhaayain Mujh Ko Me To Kehdunga Isey Aap Dikhaate Rehna Koi Neki Nahi Daaman Me Mere Ya Madani Mujh Siyaahkaar Ko Sarkaar Nibhaate Rehna Hai Masaa-Ib Me Ghiree Aap Ki Ummat Aaqa Zulm-O-Zaalim Se Ise Aap Bachaate Rehna Aaj Phir Se Mujhe Taiba Ka Banaaya Zaa-Ir Meri Qismat Ko Isee Tarha Jagaate Rehna Dar Pe Sarkaar Ke Haazir Hain Gulam E Ajami Laaj Is Ki Mere Mukhtaar Bachaate Rehna Aaj Taiba Se Chala Hoon Mein Watan Ki Jaanib Apne Dar Par Mere Mukhtar Bulaate Rehna Wehshat-E-Qabr Se Ghabraaye Jo Shakir Aaqa Thapkiyaan Deke Use Aap Sulaate Rehna

৩৯৫

Mere Sarkaar Mere Ghar Ko Sajaaney Aaein

Mere Sarkaar Mere Ghar Ko Sajaaney Aaein Dil Ki Duniya Main Woh Anwaar Lutaane Aaein Joh Khazaan Daar Parhaa Rotaa Hai Ik Jhoownke Ko Us Kii Jaanib Bhii Bahaaron Keh Zamaane Aaein Shiddat E Peyaas Hai Ik Bosyah E Paa Ki Jin Ko Aese Peyaason Ko Bhii Diidar Karaane Aaein Taab E Furqat Bhii Qiyamat Hai Mujhe Wasl Keh Baad Woh Mere Ghar Seh Nah Jane Keh Bahaane Aaein Jin Keh Biimar Ho Muddat Se Woh Aein Ge Zuruur Un Kii Galiyon Seh Hawaaein Yeh Bataane Aaein Jin Ki Umeed Peh Tufano Main Ham Kud Parhe Naa Khuda Kashtiyon Ko Paar Lagaane Aaein Raat Bhar Yaad Sitaaron Neh Keyaa Ro Ro Kar Kaash Woh Chand Merii Bazm Sajaane Aaein Aey Madinay Keh Musaafir Dar E Jibriil Keh Paas Kehnaa Gham Khaar Seh Ham Haal Sunaane Aaein

৩৯৬

Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra

Khuda Ki Nazron Mein Rehta Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Voh Noor E Haq Ka Hai Jalwa Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Yahi Hai Rashk E Mehruma Yahi To Hai Shahe Khuban Hasinon Se Hasin Chehra Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Hue Ummat Mein Voh A’la Sahaba Ban Gaye Voh Log Jinhon Ne Ankhon Se Dekha Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Hazaron Parde The Haaye Magar Fir Bhi Chamak Esi Ke Jaise Chand Ka Tukda Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Kadam To Chand Se Thehre Bhala Chehre Ko Kya Dekhun Harr Ik Tashbeeh Se Baala Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Qasam Hai Husne Yusuf Ki Jahan Bhar Mein Nahi Koi Misal Aisi Jawab Aisa Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Bilal E Habshi Hai Kaba Ki Chat Per Rukh Kahan Karte Azan Dene Ka Ab Qibla Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra Nakeeron Ne Jo Pucha Qabr Mein Yeh Kis Ka Jalwa Hai Ujagar Jhoom Kar Bola Mere Sarkar Ka Chehra

৩৯৭

Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu

Mere Rab Ko Bhi Hai Pyare Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Uruje Husn Se Aage Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Ghumati Umm E Salma Paani Me Muye Mubarak Ko Mareezo Ko Shifa Dete Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Fakat Is Waste Khalid Ne Har Ek Marka Jeeta Unhone Topi Me Rakhe Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Mina Mein Baal Katwa Kar Diya Jab Huqm Aaqa Ne Abu Talha Ne Phir Baate Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Nabi Gesu Tarashwate Sahaba Lete Haatho Par Zameen Par Kaise Gir Pate Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Mere Aaqa Ne Sajdo Me Zameen Ko Bhi Nawaza Tha Zameen Ne Baarha Chume Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Nikal Aati Bina Kanghi Ke Ek Ek Maang Zulfo Me Kuch Aaise Beech Se Hat’te Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Ziyarat Gesuwo Ki Hai Nabi Ki Deed Ka Hissa Wo Hai Khush Bakht Jo Dekhe Mere Sarkar Ke Gesu Na Gungarale Na Bilkul Sidhe Wo Gaisoo Hamida Hein Gane Aur Rang Mein Kale Mere Sarkar Ke Gaisoo Ada Karte Hein Wo Sunnat Sahaba Ki Jinhone Bhi Tabarruk Jaan Kar Rakhe Mere Sarkar Ke Gaisoo

৩৯৮

Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi

Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Mera Dil Maqam E Habib Hai Main Mariz E Ishq E Rasool Hoon Wo Habib Mera Tabib Hai Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Mera Dil Maqam E Habib Hai Main Mariz E Ishq E Rasool Hoon Wo Habib Mera Tabib Hai Mera Us Gali Se Hai Raabta Jahan Sar Jhukate Hain Ambia Mera Us Gali Se Hai Raabta Jahan Sar Jhukate Hain Ambia Jahan Rehmaton Ka Nazool Hai Jahan Rehmaton Ka Nazool Hai Wo Jo Arsh E Haq Ke Qarib Hai Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Main Bara Ameer O Kabeer Hoon Shah E Do Sara Ka Aseer Hoon Main Bara Ameer O Kabeer Hoon Shah E Do Sara Ka Aseer Hoon Dar E Mustafa Ka Faqeer Hoon Dar E Mustafa Ka Faqeer Hoon Mera Riffaton Mein Naseeb Hai Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Main Gham O Alam Mein Hoon Mubtala Koi Kiya Kare Ga Meri Dawa Main Gham O Alam Mein Hoon Mubtala Koi Kiya Kare Ga Meri Dawa Mera Do Jahan Mein Tere Siwa Mera Do Jahan Mein Tere Siwa Shah Or Kon Tabib Hai Mere Wird E Lab Hai Nabi Nabi Wo Bhi Khoob Din The Jo Malaika Mere Saamne The Jo Sar Nigoon Wo Bhi Khoob Din The Jo Malaika Mere Saamne The Jo Sar Nigoon Wo Mera Urooj E Kamal Tha Ye Zawal Kitna Ajeeb Hai Main Mariz E Ishq E Rasool Hoon Wo Habib Mera Tabib Hai

৩৯৯

Meri Baat Ban Gayi Hai Teri Baat Karte Karte

Meri Baat Ban Gayi Hai Teri Baat Karte Karte Tere Sheher Me Mai Aau Teri Naat Padhte Padhte Tere Ishq Ki Badaulat Mujhe Zindagi Mili Hai Mujhe Maut Aaqa Aaye Tera Zikr Karte Karte Kis Cheez Ki Talab Hai Na Hai Aarzoo Bhi Koi Tu Ne Itna Bhar Diya Hai Kashkol Bharte Bharte Mere Soone Soone Ghar Me Kabhi Raunaqe Ata Ho Main Deewaana Ho Gaya Hu Teri Raah Takte Takte Hai Jo Zindagaani Baaqi Ye Iraada Kar Liya Hai Tere Munkiron Se Aaqa Mai Marunga Ladte Ladte Nasir Ki Haazri Ho Kabhi Aastaan Pe Tere Ke Zamaana Ho Gaya Hai Mujhe Aahein Bharte Bharte Mai Na Jaoon Ga Darbaar Kabhi Chor Ke Ye Galiyaan Ke Mai Pouncha Hoon Yaha Tak Mere Yaar Marte Marte

৪০০

Meri Barbaad Basti Ko Basaa Do Ya Rasoolallah

Meri Barbaad Basti Ko Basaa Do Ya Rasoolallah Kinare Par Meri Kashti Laga Do Ya Rasoolallah Mere Taareek Dil Par Noor Ki Barsaat Ho Jaaye Mere Qalbe Siyaah Ko Jagmaga Do Ya Rasoolallah Ghira Hoon Marze Isiyaan Me Gariftaare Masaa-Ib Hoon Mujhe Is Kaid Se Lillah Bacha Do Ya Rasoolallah Mera Maskan Madina Ho Mera Madfan Madina Ho Mera Seena Madina Hi Bana Do Ya Rasoolallah Yeh Aankhen Aap Ke Deedar Ki Taalib Hai Muddat Se Rukhe Pur Noor Se Parda Hata Do Ya Rasoolallah

৪০১

Meri Dhadkan Mein Ya Nabi Meri Saanson Mein Ya Nabi

Meri Dhadkan Mein Ya Nabi Meri Saanson Mein Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Koi Guftugu Ho Lab Par Tera Naam Aa Gaya Hai Tera Zikr Karte Karte Ye Maqaam Aa Gaya Hai Dare Mustafa Ka Manzar Meri Chasme Tar Ke Andar Kabhi Subha Aa Gaya Hai Kabhi Shaam Aa Gaya Hai Do Jahaan Ki Ne’maton Se Tere Dar Se Jo Bhi Maanga Mere Daamane Talab Mein Woh Tamaam Aa Gaya Hai Ye Talab Thi Ambiya Ki Rukhe Mustafa Ko Dekhe Ye Namaz Ka Waseela Unhe Kaam Aa Gaya Hai Jise Pee Ke Shaykh Saadi Balaghal Ula Pukaare Mere Daste Na Tawaan Mein Wohi Jaam Aa Gaya Hai Woh Adeeb Jis Ne Mehshar Mein Bapa Kiya Hai Mehshar Woh Kahenge Aao Dekho Ye Ghulaam Aa Gaya Hai

৪০২

Meri Jholi Ko Bharde Aye Khuda

Meri Jholi Ko Bharde Aye Khuda Sadqe Muhammad Ke Gunahgaron Ka Bhi Kar De Bhala Sadqe Muhammad Ke Hamare Haal Pe Daata Karam Apna Sadaa Rakhna Tuhi Shaitaan Se Imaan Waalon Ko Bacha Rakhna Har Ik Toofaan Mein Dena Aasra Sadqe Muhammad Ke Samajhti Hai Ye Dunya Apna Hum Imaan De Denge Magar Imaan Ki Khaatir Hum Apni Jaan De Denge Hume Is Aazmaish Se Bacha Sadqe Muhammad Ke Teri Rehmat Ko Ro Ro Ke Hum Aye Maalik Jagaa Denge Ye Parde Aasman Ke Hum Duaon Se Gira Denge Hume Noore Khuda Se Phir Mila Sadqe Muhammad Ke Jahaan Me Be Sahaaron Ko Faqat Tera Sahaara Hai Nahi Hai Koi Bhi Apna Bas Ik Tu Hi Humara Hai Jo Bichde Hain Unhe Tu Phir Mila Sadqe Muhammad Ke Meri Kashti Hai Toofaan Me Kinaare Par Laga Dena Mere Mawla Meri Saari Khataaon Ko Bhula Dena Meri Soye Naseebon Ko Jagaa Sadqe Muhammad Ke

৪০৩

Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke

Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Azal Se Kha Raha Hai Ye Gada Tukhe Muhammad Ke Padi Hai Kya Mujhe Shahon Ke Dar Se Jaake Mai Maangun Khilata Hai Mujhe Mera Khuda Tukde Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Inhe Khaakar Abu Bakr O Umar Usman Bante Hain Ye Rutbe Mein Hain Kuch Aise Juda Tukde Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Hain Shehre Ilm Khud Aaqa Ali Hain Uska Darwaza Tu Darwaza Se Aa Aur Khaeja Tukde Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Mere Maula Ali O Fatima Hasnain Ke Sadqe Meri Naslon Ko Bhi Karna Ata Tukde Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Koi Salmaane Faras Aur Janaabe Qur Se Pooche Ke Wafadaaron Ko Milte Hai Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Mere Raste Ki Har Muskil Guzzar Jati Hai Qutraa Kar Ke Deta Hain Mujhe Mushkil Kushaa Tukre Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke Tera Daman Kabhi Altaf Khali Reh Nahi Sakta Ke Dete Hain Tujhe Aal-E-Aba Tukre Muhammad Ke Meri Jholi Mein Rehte Hain Sada Tukde Muhammad Ke

৪০৪

Meri Saari Izzat Muhammad Se Hai

Meri Saari Izzat Muhammad Se Hai Ye Daulat Ye Shohrat Muhammad Se Hai Ye Mera Sukhan Ye Meri Khamoshi Qalam Ki Ye Rif’at Muhammad Se Hai Mujhe Chahte Hai Sabhi Toot Kar Ye Nazre Inayat Muhammad Se Hai Hai Thandak Nigaho Me Aur Noor Bhi Dilo Me Hararat Muhammad Se Hai Na Kyun Saara Aalam Ho Un Par Fida Ke Aalam Me Rehmat Muhammad Se Hai Abu Bakr Siddique Ka Martaba Aur Inki Sadaqat Muhammad Se Hai Woh Farooq E Aazam Umar Ba Safa Aur Unki Adaalat Muhammad Se Hai Hussain Ibne Haider Ki Har Ek Ada Aur Unki Shahadat Muhammad Se Hai Woh Meraj O Meelad Ki Sa’ate Woh Khalwat Ye Jalwat Muhammad Se Hai Woh Roza Namaz Ho Ke Haj O Zakaat Ye Zauke Ibaadat Muhammad Se Hai Tilawat Sakhawat Duroodo Salaam Sabhi Me Halawat Muhammad Se Hai Woh Gaus O Qutub Hon Ke Abdaal Hon Sabhi Ki Karamat Muhammad Se Hai Sana Unki Shewa Hai Rizwan Ka Ise Khaas Nisbat Muhammad Se Hai

৪০৫

Meri Ulfat Madine Se Yun Hi Nahi

Hooron Ne Kaha Jab Bismillah Ghilmaa Ne Pukara Illallah Khud Rab Ne Kaha Mashalallah Mehboob Hamaara Aawat Hai. Maazaag Ka Gajra Nain Bhare Wash-Shams Ka Bhatna Mukh Pe Male Hai Meem Ka Ghoonghat Sehre Tale Woh Arsh Ka Taara Aawat Hai. Muhammad Ka Roza Kareeb Aa Raha Hai, Bulandi Pe Apna Naseeb Araha Hay Muhammad Kaa Roza Kareeb Araha Hai, Bulandi Pe Apna Naseeb Araha Hay Farishto Ye De Do Paighaam Unko, Khabar Ja Kay Dedo Unko Farishto Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed Aa Raha Hai, Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed Aa Raha Hay Madina Madina Madina Madina, Bara Lutf Deta Hai Naam E Madina Wafa Tum Na Dekho Gay Hargiz Kisi Mein, Zamana Woh Aesa Qareeb Araha Hay Hifazat Karo Apnay Imaan O Deen Ki, Zamana Woh Aesa Ajeeb Araha Hay Muhammad Ka Rozza Qareeb A Raha Hai, Bulandi Pe Apna Naseeb A Raha Hai Farishto Ye De Do Paighaam Unko, Khabar Ja Kay Dedo Unko Farishto Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed A Raha Hai, Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed Araha Hai Madina Madina Madina Madina, Bara Lutf Deta Hai Naam E Madina Tumhain Kuch Khabar Hai Kahan Ja Raha Hoon, Rasool E Khuda Hain Wahan Ja Raha Hoon Tumhain Kuch Khabar Hai Mai Kiya Paa Raha Hoon, Mohabbat Ka Unki Maza Pa Raha Hoon Chalo Jaa Ke Rehna Madinay Mein Ab Tou, Qayamat Ka Manzar Qareeb Araha Hai Farishto Ye De Do Paighaam Unko, Khabar Ja Kay Dedo Unko Farishto Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed A Raha Hai, Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed Araha Hai Madina Madina Madina Madina, Bara Lutf Deta Hai Naam E Madina Nigaahon Mein Sultaniyat Heech Hogi, Jo Paaye Ga Dil Mein Payam E Madina Sukoon E Jahan Tum Kahan Dhoondte Ho, Woh Sukoon E Jahan Hai Nizam E Madina Madina Madina Madina Madina, Bara Lutf Deta Hai Naam E Madina Muhammad Kaa Roza Qareeb Araha Hay, Bulandi Pe Apna Nasib Araha Hai Muhammad Ka Rozaa Kareeb A Raha Hai, Bulandi Peh Apna Naseeb A Raha Hai Farishto Ye De Do Paighaam Unko, Khabar Ja Kay Dedo Unko Farishto Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed A Raha Hai, Keh Khadim Tumhara Saeed Aa Raha Hai Madina Madina Madina Madina Bara Lutf Deta Hai Naam E Madina

৪২০

Muhammad Mazhar E Kaamil Hain Haq Ki Shaan E Izzat Ka

Muhammad Mazhar E Kaamil Hain Haq Ki Shaan E Izzat Ka, Nazar Aata Hay Is Kasrat Mein Kuch Andaaz Wahdat Ka. Yahi Hay Asl E Aalam E Maadah Ijaad E Khalqat Ka, Yahaan Wahdat Mein Barpa Hay Ajab Hangaama Kasrat Ka. Gadaa Bhi Muntazir Hay Khuld Mein Nekon Ki Da’wat Ka, Khuda Din Khair Sey Laaye Sakhi Key Ghar Ziyafat Ka. Gunah Maghfoor, Dil Raushan, Khanak Aankhein, Jigar Thanda, Ta’ala Allah Maah E Taiba Aalam Teri Tal’at Ka. Na Rakhi Gul Key Josh E Husn Ne Gulshan Mein Jaa Baaqi, Chatakta Phir Kahaan Ghuncha Koi Baagh E Risaalat Ka. Barhaa Ye Silsila E Rahmat Ka Daur E Zulf E Waala Mein Tasalsal Kaale Koson Reh Gaya Isiyan Ki Zulmat Ka. Saf E Maatam Uthe Khaali Ho Zindaan Tootein Zanjeerain, Gunahgaaro Chalo Mawla Ne Dar Khola Hay Jannat Ka. Sikhaaya Hay Yeh Kis Gustaakh Ne Aaina Ko Yaa Rab, Nazaarah Rooye Jaanaan Ka Bahaana Kar Key Hairat Ka. Idhar Ummat Ki Hasrat Par Udhar Khaaliq Ki Rahmat Par, Niraala Taur Hoga Gardish E Chashme Shafa’at Ka. Barhein Is Darja Maujein Kasrat E Afdaal E Waala Ki, Kinaarah Mil Gaya Is Neher Sey Daryaa E Wahdat Ka. Kham E Zulf E Nabi Saajid Hay Mehraab E Do Abru Mein, Ke Yaa Rab Tu Hi Waali Hay Siyah Kaaraan E Ummat Ka. Madad Aay Joshish E Girya Baha De Kooh Aur Sehra, Nazar Aa Jaaye Jalwah Be Hijaab Us Paak Turbat Ka. Hue Kam Khwaabi-E-Hijraan Mein Saaton Parde Kam Khwaabi, Tassawwur Khoob Baandha Aankhon Ne Astaar E Turbat Ka. Yaqeen Hay Waqt E Jalwah Laghzishain Paaye Negah Paaye, Mile Josh E Safaaye Jism Sey Paa Bos Hazrat Ka. Yahaan Chirka Namak Waa Marham E Kafoor Haath Aaya, Dil E Zakhmi Namak Parwardah Hay Kis Ki Malaahat Ka. Ilaahi Muntazir Hoon Woh Khiraam E Naaz Farmaaein, Bicha Rakha Hay Farsh Aankhon Ne Kam Khwaab E Basaarat Ka. Na Ho Aaqa Ko Sajdah Adam O Yusuf Ko Sajdah Ho, Magar Sad E Zaraay’ E Daab Hay Apni Shari’at Ka. Zabaan E Khaar Kis Kis Dard Sey Un Ko Sunaati Hay, Tarapna Dasht E Taiba Mein Jigar Afgaar Furqat Ka. Sirhaane Un Key Bismil Key Ye Betaabi Ka Matam Hay, Shahe Kausar Tarahham Tishnah Jaata Hay Ziyaarat Ka. Jinhein Marqad Me Taa Hashr Ummati Keh Kar Pukaroge, Hamain Bhi Yaad Kar Lo Un Mein Sadqa Apni Rahmat Ka. Woh Chamke Bijliyan Yaa Rab Tajalli Haaye Jaanaan Sey, Ke Chashm E Toor Surma Ho Dil Mushtaaq Rooyat Ka. Raza E Khasta Josh E Behr E ’isiyaan Sey Na Ghabraana, Kabhi To Haath Aajaayega Daaman Unki Rahmat Ka.

৪২৪

Muhammad Naam Pe Qurban Meri Jaan Ho Jaey

Muhammad Naam Pe Qurban Meri Jaan Ho Jaey Isi Ke Sadqay Mein Kaamil Mera Iman Ho Jaey Mere Mushkil Kusha Hasanain Ka Sadqa Ata Kar De Balaen Door Hon Mushkil Meri Aasan Ho Jaey Mere Aamal Ka Badla Tabahi Hay Magar Piyaray Mein Jannat Ko Sidharon Jo Tera Farmaan Ho Jaey Madinay Paak Ke Kutton Ki Khidmat Ka Sharaf Paaon Sagaan-E-Taybah Ka Khadim, Meri Pehchan Ho Jaey Mein Jaun Daar-E-Faani Se Mera Emaan Salamat Ho Teri Chahat Teri Ulfat Mera Saman Ho Jaey Mere Shafay' Sawali Hun Nijaat-E-Aakhirat Ka Mein Sar-E-Mehshar Shafa’at Ka Teri Aey’laan Ho Jaey Mein Hun Sunni, Rahun Sunni, Jeeun Sunni, Marun Sunni Karam Aey Sayyid-E-Aalam Tera Ihsaan Ho Jaey Teri Naatien Parrhun Teri Sana Mein Mast Ho Jaon Paey Akhtar Nigaah-E-Hazrat-E-Hassan Ho Jaey Teri Madh-O-Sana Sunn Kar Sarray Munkir Karay Maatam Magar Jab Bhi Koi Sunni Sunay Farhaan Ho Jaey Khurooj-O-Rafz Ke Shar Se Mera Aur Meri Naslon Ka Salamat Deen-O-Iman Aey Mere Sultan Ho Jaey Mein Baghdad-E-Mu’alla Aanay Ko Tayyar Hun Kab Se Izn Bas Haazri Ka Az Shah E Jeelan Ho Jaey Bareilly Hziri Dun Phr Chaloon Ajmer Ko Khwajah Raza Ke Faiz Se Mujh Par Tera Faizan Ho Jaey Mere Ghous O Raza Ka, Mere Khwaja, Mere Daata Ka Mere Murshid Ka Mujh Pe Daaimi Faizan Ho Jaey Meri Naslain Chalain Raah E Sunan Par Taa Dam E Aakhir Meri Aulaad Aaqa Aalim-E-Quran Ho Jaey Karam Karna Karam Walay Bharam Rakhna Bharam Walay Teri Namoos Pe Qurban Yeh Irfan Ho Jaey

৪২৫

Muhammad Nabina (Arabic Version)

Muhammad Nabina Binuru Atina Min Makkah Habibi Nuru Sata' Aal Madinah Min Salla Salatu, Wet'hala Bsifatu Ya Bakht Elli Fdhelou Mechi, Yechfa'alu Fimamatu Muhammad Our Prophet Guides Us With His Light From Makkah, O Beloved His Light Was Glowing Over Madinah He Who Prays His Prayers And Tries To Imitate His Attitudes Oh How Lucky He Is Who Walks In His Presence And Gains His Intercession After Death Ya Imamna Ya Ameen Ya Sanad Lil Muslimeen Ya Habibi Ya Muhamad Ya Ibn Abdullah. Tammet Irrisalat Tamam, Wel Habib Misk Elkhitam Tul Hayati Wfslati Bad'i Assalli Warah Oh Our Imam, The Trustworthy One Oh Guardian & Support To All Muslims Oh My Beloved Muhammad (S.a.w), The Son Of Abdullah You Completed The Prophecies Completely And The Beloved One Is The Sweetest Seal (Of The Prophets) Min Awel Youm Fi O'mri, Seme't Abuya Wommi Bisallu Aalih Allah Umma Salli Aalih Habbibni Fil Iman, Hassesni Bil Amen, We T'ala't Bih Allahuma Salli Wasallem Wabarek Aalih Allahuma Salli Wasallem Wabarek Aalih Nefsi Achufak Fil Manam... Ya Rasulallah. Waabki Aala Kitfak Wanam... Ya Habiballah. Wanul Charaf Lu'a Sohbitak Wakhatti Fi Sfuf Ummitak Wat'hama Fik Throughout All My Life And In My Prayers, I Make A Supplication To Pray Behind Him [in The Next Life] From The First Day In My Life That I Heard My Mother And Father Praying Upon Him He Endeared Faith To Me, Granted Peace To Me & Made Me Love Him Oh Allah Send Blessings & Peace Upon Him Oh Allah Send Blessings & Peace Upon Him I Wish To See You In My Dreams, O Messenger Of God And I Cry On Your Shoulder & Sleep There, O Beloved Of God And I Attain Honor With Your Accompaniment And I Walk Among The Ranks Of Your Ummah And I Am Protected By You Ya Habibi Ya Taha, Ya Nagat Mel Mataha Ghayart Edonya Fi I'inina Bin Lila Wdhu'haha Min Salla Salatu, Wet'hala Bsifatu Ya Bakht Elli Fdhelou Mechi, Yechfa'alu Fimamatu Oh Beloved, O Pure One, You Who Had Survived The Maze You Changed The World In Our Eyes Between A Night And Its Morning [referring To The Night Journey] He Who Prays His Prayers And Tries To Improve His Attributes How Lucky Is He Who Walks In His Shadow And Adds To Him With His Death

৪২৬

Muhammad Nabiyyina (Urdu Version)

Muhammad Nabiyyina, Muhammad Nabiyyina, Ya Shahe Madina, Ya Shah-E-Madina Teri Judai Mein Pal Pal Jalta Hai Yeh Seena, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada Yeh Betaab Nigaahein, Har Damm Ashq Bahaaye, Dil Deta Hai Sadaaye, Qadmon Mein Bulaaye, Gardish Mein Hai Sitaara, Mushkil Ho Gaya Jeena. Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada Tez Bohat Hai Dhaara, Mera Koun Sahaara, Kar Do Ek Ishaara, Toofan Banne Kinaara Tere Hawale Hai Aaqa, Yeh Mera Safeena. Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada Waqt-E-Naza Jab Aa Jaaye, Mujh Pe Karam Yeh Ho Jaaye, Aal-E-Aba Ke Ho Saaye, Naam Tera Lab Pe Jab Aaye, Mohsin Ko Ho Jaaye Ata, Bas Khaak-E-Madina. Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada Muhammad Nabiyyina, Muhammad Nabiyyina, Ya Shah-E-Madina, Ya Shah-E-Madina Teri Judai Mein Pal Pal Jalta Hai Yeh Seena, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada, Muhammada

৪২৭

Muhammad Se Dil Ko Laga Kar To Dekho

Muhammad Se Dil Ko Laga Kar To Dekho Muqaddar Zara Aazma Kar To Dekho Zara Unko Dil Me Basa Kar To Dekho Zara Khud Ko Dil Se Bhula Kar To Dekho Mala'ik Qadam Choom Lenge Tumhare Zara Unki Basti Me Jaa Kar To Dekho Idhar Saari Duniya Jhuka Degi Sar Ko Sar Apna Udhar Tum Jhuka Kar To Dekho Andhere Badal Jaayen Ge Raushni Se Charagh-E-Mohabbat Jala Kar To Dekho Wahi Wo Numaya Hai Surat Me Unki Zara Parda-E-Meem Utha Kar To Dekho Muqaddar Badal Ta Hai Unke Karam Se Unhe Haal Apna Suna Kar To Dekho Na Andwoh'e Mehshar Na Dozaq Ki Parwah Bas Ek Baar Tum Muskura Kar To Dekho Tumhari Mohabbat Ne Kya Kar Diya Hai Zara 'muttaqui` Ko Bula Kar To Dekho

৪২৮

Mujh Ko Sarkar Ka Aastan Mil Gaya

Mujh Ko Sarkar Ka Aasta(N) Mil Gaya Main Zamee(N) Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Aap Ko Maang Kar Aur Maangu Mai Kya Mustafa Mil Gaye Kul Jahan Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Ham Musibat Mein Ho Dil Dukhe Aapka Dekho Kaisa Hamein Mehrban Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Hum Se Ache Hai Bas Wo Kabootar Jinhe Us Gali Me Kaheen Ashiyaan Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Taaj Daron Ke Mehlo Ko Mera Salaam Mujko Taiba Darul Ama Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Aake Baitha Hoon Dehleez-E-Sarkaar Par Maine Jo Chaha Mujh Ko Yaha Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Hum The Gumnaam Apni Qabar Tak Na Thi Aap Aye To Apna Nishaan Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Aapke Dar Ki Khayrat Kya Mil Gayi X 3 Mujh Se Pucho To Sara Jahan Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya Mere Sarkaar Ki Sab Inayaat Hai Tuj Ko Altaf Range Bayaan Mil Gaya Main Zameen Tha Mujhe Aasman Mil Gaya

৪২৯

Mujh Ko Taiba Bulaa Hi Lete Hain

Mujh Ko Taiba Bulaa Hi Lete Hain Apna Mangta Banaa Hee Lete Hain Mere Haalaat Unpe Hain Roshan Tab To Bigri Banaa Hi Lete Hain Koi Husn E ‘amal Nahi Phir Bhi Mere Aaqa Nibhaa Hi Lete Hain Jab Tadaptaa Hai Deed Ko Koi Apna Jalwa Dikhaa Hi Dete Hain Apne Shakir Ki Laaj Rakhte Hain Apna Mehmaan Banaa Hee Lete Hain

৪৩০

Mujh Ko Taiba Main Bula Lo Shahe Zamani

Mujh Ko Taiba Main Bula Lo Shah-E-Zamani Shah-E-Zamani Aka Maki Madani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Nagar Nagar Aur Dagar Dagar Phirta Hoon Mara Mara Mujh Dukhiya Ka Is Duniya Main Koi Nahin Sahara Tumhi Senay Say Laga Lo Shah-E-Zamani Shah-E-Zamani Aqa Makki Madani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Jo Bhi Aya Tumhare Dar Par Lauta Kabhi Na Khali Har Mangte Ki Jholi Tumne Rehmat Se Bhar Daali Tum Ho Aise Hi Dayalu Shahe Jamani Hum Ko Taiba Me Bulalo Shahe Jamani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Teri Ziarat Kay Hain Talib Kardo Dur Yeh Doori Humain Dikha Do Apna Jalwa Kardo Hasrat Puri Chehra Noorani Dikhado Shah-E-Zamani Shah-E-Zamani Aka Maki Madani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Haryale Gunbat Ka Manzar Jannat Se Hai Pyara Kabay Ka Kaba Hai Roza Pyaray Nabi Tumhara Jali Rozay Ki Dikha Do Shah-E-Zamani Shah-E-Zamani Aka Maki Madani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Rotay Rotay Omer Guzari Milan Ki Sham Na Aaee Kiya Mairay Aaka Aap Ko Mairee Ata Pasand Na Aaee Phir Kuoon Tum Nay Dair Lagaee Shah-E-Zamani Shah-E-Zamani Aqa Makki Madani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani Dua Karo Sab Milkar Ki Shahbaz Madine Jaye Jaakar Yeh Darbar E Nabi Me Apne Sees Navaye Kehna Qadmo Me Bulalo Shahe Jamani Hum Ko Taiba Me Bulalo Shahe Jamani Dil Ki Hasrat Yeh Nikalo Shah-E-Zamani

৪৩১

Mujh Mein Unki Sana Ka Saleeqa Kahaan

Mujh Mein Unki Sana Ka Saleeqa Kahaan Woh Shaahe Do Jahaan Woh Kahaan Main Kahaan Un Ka Mad-Ha Saraa Khaaliqe Asraa Woh Rasoole Zamaan Woh Kahaan Main Kahaan Un Ke Daaman Se Wabasta Meri Nijaat Unpe Qurbaan Meri Hayaato Mamaat Main Gunahgaar Woh Shaafaye Aasiyaan Bekason Ki Amaan Woh Kahaan Main Kahaan Woh Madina Nagina Jo Hai Arsh Ka Woh Madina Bharam Jo Bana Farsh Ka Woh Madina Jahaan Rehmate Bekaraan Main Bhi Pahuchu Wahaan Woh Kahaan Main Kahaan Shak Nahi Aye Riyaz Is Mein Hargiz Zara Main Saraapa Khata Woh Saraapa Ata Naam Un Ka Rahe Kyun Na Wirde Zubaan Hai Jo Taskine Jaan Woh Kahaan Main Kahaan

৪৩২

Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon

Sallay Ala Nabiyenna Sallay Ala Muhammadin Sallay Ala Shafiyena Sallay Ala Muhammadin Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rab Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Mein Sadqay Ya Rasoolallah Mein Sadqay Ya Habiballah Dhoom Unn Ki Naat Khuwaani Ki Machatay Jayeinge Ya Rasoolallah Ka Na’ra Lagatay Jayeinge Na’t Khuwaani Maut Bhi Hum Se Chura Sakti Nahi Qabr Mein Bhi Mustafa Ke Geet Gaatay Jayeinge Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Kitna Bara Hai Mujh Pe Ye Ahsaan-E-Mustafa Kehte Hain Log Mujh Ko Sana Khuwaan-E-Mustafa Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Beher-E-Bakhshish Pass Apne Kuch Nahi Iske Siva Umar Bhar Naatein Suneinge Aur Sunatay Jayeinge Naat Khuwani Ka Nasha Nas Nas Mein Aisa Chah Gaya Qabr Mein Bhi Geet Ubaid Ab Mustafa Ke Gayeinge Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Koi Guftugu Ho Lab Per Tera Naam Agaya Hai Tera Zikr Kartay Kartay Ye Maqaam Agaya Hai Jissay Peekay Sheikh Sa’di Balaghal Ula Pukarein Mere Dast-E-Na Tawaan Mein Wohi Jaam Agaya Hai Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Tera Wasf Bayaan Ho Kisse Teri Kon Karega Barayei Iss Gard-E-Safar Mein Gum Hai Jibreel-E-Ameen Ki Rasayei Aey Raza Khud Sahib-E-Qur’an Hai Madaah-E-Rasool Tujhse Kab Mumkin Hai Phir Midhat Rasoolallah Ki Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Jitna Diya Sarkar Ne Mujhko Itni Meri Auqaat Nahi Ye Tou Karam Hai Unka Warna Mujhe Mein Tou Aisi Baat Nahi Ghaur Tou Kar Sarkar Ki Mujhper Kitni Khaas Inayat Hai Kausar Tou Hai Unka Sana Khuwaan Ye Ma’mooli Baat Nahi Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Gham Nahi Chordey Ye Saara Zamana Mujhko Mere Aaqa Tou Hain Seenay Se Laganay Ke Liye Bakhsh Dei Naat Ki Daulat Mere Aaqa Ne Mujhe Kitnay Pyara Waseela Sarkar Ko Paanay Ke Liye Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Seenay Mein Bhara Hai Teri Naaton Ka Khazana Aalam Mein Lutata Hoon Kamayei Tere Dar Ki Mujh Pe Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Maula Ka Karam Hai Unki Naatein Parhta Hoon Daaman Apna Rub Ki Rehmat Se Mein Har Dum Bharta Hoon Ab Ke Baras Bhi Hoonton Pe Unki Sana Rahei Ab Ke Baras Bhi Wajd Mein Ghar Ki Fiza Rahei Ab Ke Baras Bhi Madha Ke Khiltay Rahay Gulab Ab Ke Baras Bhi Kasht-E-Dil-O-Jaan Sawar Rahi Ab Ke Baras Bhi Lab Pe Taraana Tha Naat Ka Ab Ke Baras Bhi Chaar Sou Mehki Saba Rahi Ab Ke Baras Bhi Sheher-E-Sukhan Mein Thei Ronaqein Ab Ke Baras Bhi Raqs Mein Meri Sada Rahi Ab Ke Baras Bhi Shayr-O-Sukhan Se Theu Dosti Ab Ke Baras Bhi Doston Hamd-O-Sana Rahei Ab Ke Baras Bhi Tazkira-E-Mustafa Rahei Ab Ke Baras Bhi ৪৩৩

Mujhay Ataa Koii Naam Hoga Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun

Mujhay Ataa Koii Naam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun Mayra Bhi Koii Maqaam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun Madina E Paak Kay Safar Mayn Wo Marhalay Aa-Ayn Gay Yaqeenan Safar Simatt Kar Dogaam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun Jahaan Ghulamaan E Mustafa Kay Hazaar Haan Qaafilay Rukayn Gay Wahaan Mayra Bhi Qayaam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun Huzur Ki Bazm E Khaas Hogi Huzur Say Arz E Haal Hogi Mujhay Bhi Izn E Kalaam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun Huzur Farma-Ayn Gay Yay Mujh Say, Hamayn Bhi Naatayn Sunaaii Ja-Ayn Qaseedah Gustar Ghulaam Hoga, Issi Tawaqqo Pay Ji Raha Huun

৪৩৪

Mujhe Apna Bana Lo Tum Khudara Ya Rasoolallah

Mujhe Apna Bana Lo Tum Khudara Ya Rasoolallah Karo Lutfo Karam Ka Ik Ishaara Ya Rasoolallah Na Chedo Mujhko Aada Tum Ghulaam-E-Shaah-E-Bathaa Hu Chali Aayegi Nusrat Gar Pukaara Ya Rasoolallah Chupaao Jab Ke Daaman Mein Ghulaamo Ko Sar-E-Mahshar Mile Mujko Bhi Chaadar Ka Kinaara Ya Rasoolallah Tumhi Ho Qaasim-E-Ne’mat Milee Tum Se Hi Sab Ne’mat Tumhare Tukdo Par Mera Guzaara Ya Rasoolallah Ataa Ilme Ladunni Ho Mujhe Sadqe Me Haidar Ke Jihaalat Ko Ho Mujh Se Ab Kinara Ya Rasoolallah Meri Jholi Mein Sadqa Ghaus Ka Rakhde Huzoor-E-Man Isi Ummeed Par Daaman Pasaara Ya Rasoolallah Banaa Kar Saail-E-Taiba Meri Qismat Jagaayi Hai Bulandi Par Hai Shaqkir Ka Sitaqra Ya Rasoolallah Karo Maqbool Sunni Dawate Islami Ko Aaqa Kare Hai Arz Ye Shakir Tumhara Ya Rasoolallah

৪৩৫

Mujhe Bhi Madine Bula Mere Maula

Mujhe Bhi Madine Bula Mere Maula Karam Ki Tajalli Dikhaa Mere Maula Bohot Bekaraari Ke Alam Me Hu Mai Meri Bekaraari Mita Mere Maula Suna Hai Madina Karam Hi Karam Hai Tu Rakhta Jahan Main Sabhi Ka Bharam Hai Tujhay Wasta Tere Pyare Nabi Ka Meri Ab Tho Bigri Bana Mere Mola Jisay Tu Nay Chaha Main Us Pay Fida Hoon Main Tere Muhammad Ke Der Ka Gada Hoon Tujhe Wasta Sayyed-E-Karbala Ka Mujhe Her Bala Se Bacha Mere Mola Muhammad Ko Tu Ne Jo Quran Deya Hai Karoroon Diloon Main Mukamal Chupa Hai Ay..quran Ke Khaliq Guzarish Hay Tujh Se Mere Dil Main Quran Basa Mere Mola Nigaho Se Pinhaa Kyun Manzil Meri Hai Kyu Majdhar Me Naao Meri Phasi Hai Khathaoo Ka Mara Bhi Paale Ga Sahil Gar Aabid Ke Dil Me Samaa Mere Maula Yeh Dono Jahan Tere Zer-E-Aser Hai Jo Tujh Ko Na Maanain Bare Bekhaber Hai Naheen Jante Jho Tere Ghazab Ko Unhe Ghaflatoon Se Jaga Mere Mola Shafa’t Ka Wada Keya Tu Nay Jis Se Gunnah Gaaar Umeed Rekhtey Hai Tujh Se Shafa’t Kerain Tujh Ss Ummat Ki Aqa Tu Kerna Sabhi Ka Bhala Mere Mola Meri Mushkile Gar Tera Ibtegha Hai To Har Gham Qasam Se Khushi Ka Sama Hai Gunaho Ki Mere Agar Ye Saza Hai To Phir Mushkilo Ko Mita Mere Maula

৪৩৬

Mujhe Dar Pay Phir Bulana Madani Madine Wale

Mujhe Dar Pay Phir Bulana, Madani Madine Wale Mae Ishq Bhi Pilana, Madani Madine Wale Meri Aankh Me Samana, Madani Madine Wale Banay Dil Tera Thikana, Madani Madine Wale Teri Jab Ke Deed Hogi, Jabhi Meri Eid Hogi Mere Khwaab Me Tum Ana, Madani Madine Wale Mujhe Sab Sata Rahe Hain, Mera Dil Dukha Rahe Hain Tumhi Hausla Badhana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Sab Azeez Chootay, Mere Yaar Bhi To Roothay Kaheen Tum Na Rooth Jana, Madani Madine Wale Mai Agar Chay Hoon Kamina, Tera Hoon Shahe Madina Mujhe Seenay Se Lagana, Madani Madine Wale Tere Dar Se Shaha Behtar, Tere Aastaan Say Badhkar Hai Bhala Koee Thikana, Madani Madine Wale Tera Tujh Se Hoon Sawali, Shaha Phairna Na Khali Mujhe Apna Tum Banana, Madani Madine Wale Yeh Mareez Mar Raha Hai, Tere Haath Me Shafa Hai Ai Tabeeb Jald Aana, Madani Madine Wale Tu Hi Anbiya Ka Sarwar, Tu Hi Do Jahaan Ka Yawar Tu Hi Reh-Baray Zamana, Madani Madine Wale Tu Hai Be-Kasaun Ka Yawar, Ai Mere Ghareeb Parwar Hai Sakhi Tera Gharana, Madani Madine Wale Tu Khuda Ke Baad Behtar, Sabhi Say Mere Sarwar Tera Haashmi Gharana, Madani Madine Wale Teri Farsh Par Hukumat, Teri Arsh Par Hukumat Tu Shahinsha E Zamanah, Madani Madine Wale Tere Khalq Sab Say A’ala, Tera Husn Sab Say Pyara Fida Tujh Pay Sab Zamanah, Madani Madine Wale Kahoon Kis Say Aah Jakar, Sunay Kaun Mere Dil-Bar Mere Dard Ka Fasana, Madani Madine Wale Ba-A’ata E Rabb Daem, Tu Hi Rizq Ka Hai Qasim Hai Tera Sab Aabo-Danah, Madani Madine Wale Mai Ghareeb Bay-Sahara, Kahaan Aur Hai Guzara Mujhe Aap Hi Nibhana, Madani Madine Wale Yeh Karam Bada Karam Hai, Tere Haath Me Bharam Hai Sar-E-Hashr Bakhsh-Wana, Madani Madine Wale Kabhi Jau Ki Moti Roti, To Kabhi Khajoor Pani Tera Aisa Sada Khana, Madani Madine Wale Hai Chataee Ka Bichona, Kabhi Khaak Hi Pay Sona Kabhi Haath Ka Sar-Hana, Madani Madine Wale Teri Saadgi Pay Lakho, Teri Aajizi Pay Lakho Ho Salaam-E-Ajizana, Madani Madine Wale Mile Naza Me Raahat, Rahoon Qabr Me Salamat Tu Azaab Say Bachana, Madani Madine Wale Ai Shafi E Roz E Mehshar! Hai Gunah Ka Bojh Sar Par Mai Phasaan Mujhe Bachana, Madani Madine Wale Gup Andheri Qabr Me Jab, Mujhe Chor Kar Chale Sab Meri Qabr Jug Magana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Shah! Waqt E Rukhsat, Mujhe Meetha Meetha Sharbat Teri Deed Ka Pilana, Madani Madine Wale Pas Marg Sabz Gumbad, Ki Huzoor Thandi Thandi Mujhe Chaoon Me Sulana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Walidain Mehshar Mein, Go Bhool Jae Sarwar Mujhe Tum Na Bhool Jana, Madani Madine Wale Shaha Tangi Badi Hai, Yahaan Dhoop Bhi Kadi Hai Shahe Hauz E Kauthar Aana, Madani Madine Wale Mujhe Aafatun Ne Ghera, Hai Musibataun Ka Dayra Ya Nabi Madad Ko Aana, Madani Madine Wale Koee Is Taraf Bhi Phera, Ho Ghamaun Ka Door Andhera Ai Sarapa Noor Aana, Madani Madine Wale Kooe Pae Bakht War Gar, Hai Sharaf Shahi Se Badhkar Teri Na’al E Pak Uthana, Madani Madine Wale Mera Seena Ho Madina, Mere Dil Ka Aabgina Bhi Madina Hi Banana, Madani Madine Wale Ai Habeeb E Rabbe Bari, Hai Gunah Ka Bojh Bhari Tumhi Hashr Me Churana, Madani Madine Wale Meri Adatein Ho Behtar, Banu Sunnatun Ka Paikar Mujhe Muttaqi Banana, Madani Madine Wale Shaha Aisa Jazbah Paoon, Ke Mai Khoob Seekh Jaoon Teri Sunnatein Sikhana, Madani Madine Wale Tere Naam Par Ho Qurbaan, Meri Jaan Jane Jana Ho Naseeb Sar Katana, Madani Madine Wale Teri Sunnatun Par Chalkar, Meri Rooh Jab Nikal Kar Chale Tum Gale Lagana, Madani Madine Wale Hai Muballigh Aqa Jitne, Karo Door Unse Fitne Buri Maut Say Bachana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Ghouse Ka Waseela, Rahe Shaad Sab Qabeela Inhe Khuld Me Basana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Jis Qadar Hai Ahbaab, Inhe Karde Shaha Betaab Milay Ishq Ka Khazana, Madani Madine Wale Meri Anay Wali Naslein, Tere Ishq Hi Me Machlein Unhe Nake Tum Banana, Madani Madine Wale Milay Sunnataun Ka Jazbah, Mere Bhai Choray Maula Sabhi Dadiyaan Mu’ndhaana, Madani Madine Wale Mere Jis Qadar Hai Behne, Sabhi Kaash Burqa Pehne Ho Karam Shahe Zamana, Madani Madine Wale Do Jahaan Kay Khazanay, Diye Haath Me Khuda Ne Tera Kaam Hai Lutana, Madani Madine Wale Teri Gham Me Kaash Attar, Rahe Har Ghadi Giraftaar Gham E Maal Say Bachana, Madani Madine Wale

৪৩৭

Mujhe Mere Aaqa Bulaate Rahenge

Mujhe Mere Aaqa Bulaate Rahenge Madine Ka Mangta Banaate Rahenge Dikhaa Sabz Gumbad To Boli Yeh Aankhen Ke Palkon Ke Moti Lutaate Rahenge Jinhey Ishq E Ahmed Ki Daulat Mili Hai Unhen Simt E Jannat Bulaate Rahenge Mujhe Qabr Ki Ab Nahi Koi Wehshat Huzoor Apna Jalwah Dikhaate Rahenge Hai Ai’zaaz Chaukhat Pey Baitha Hoon Unki Yeh Qaasim Hain Ne’mat Lutaate Rahenge Huwa Tum Pey Ramzan Mey Naazil Yeh Qur’an Sunain Gey Usey Aur Sunaate Rahenge Baney Wird E Salley ‘alaa Jis Ki ‘aadat Usey Apna Keh Kar Bulaate Rahenge Hai Shakir Ko Aaqa Karam Par Bharosa Yahaan Bhi Wahaan Bhi Bachaate Rahenge

৪৩৮

Mujhe Taiba Mein Le Jao Madina Yaad Aya Hai

Mujhe Taiba Mein Le Jao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Mere Aqa Ko Bulwaao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Teri Mehfil Sajate Hai Tere Ham Geet Gaate Hai Sarre Mehfil Chale Aao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Chale Hai Kafile Taiba Akela Chor Kar Mujh Ko Mujhe Taiba Mein Ponchao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Teri Furkat Ne Mara Hai Teri Rehmat Sahara Hai Kareebe Maarg Houn Aao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Meri Mayiyat Ko Le Jaao Madina Paak Mein Yaaro Mujhe Taiba Mein Dafnaao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Hoyi Hai Jaan Ki Dushman Tere Tahir Ki Ye Duniya Isse Kamli Mein Chupaao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Ye Tahir Tera Dewana Teri Ummat Ka Khadim Hai Mission Is Ka Bhi Pahlaao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Gunah Garo, Khatakaro, Seyakaro Ke Aqa Ho Na Jelani Ko Tukhrao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Meri Tehreekiye Dil Ka Madawa Tera Ana Hai Mere Aqa Chale Aao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Teri Umaat Ko Mil Kar Gherouen Se Apno Ne Lota Hai Issi Azmat Ko Lotao Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Main Jetaa Roz Marta Hoon, Judaa’ii Seh Naheen Saktaa Meray Aqa Ko Batlaao, Madinah Yaad Ayaa Hai Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Madina Yaad Aya Hai Madina Yaad Aya Hai, Madina Yaad Aya Hai

৪৩৯

Mujko Darpesh Hai Fir Mubarak Safar Kaafla Fir Madine Ka Taiyyar Hai

Mujko Darpesh Hai Fir Mubarak Safar Kaafla Fir Madine Ka Taiyyar Hai Nakiyo Nahi Ka Nahi Tosha Nahi Faqat Meri Jholi May Ashqo Ka Ik Haar Hai. Jurm Isyan Pe Apne Lajata Hua, Aur Ashqe Nadamat Bahata Hua Teri Rehmat Pe Nazre Jamata Hua, Dar Pe Hazir Ye Tera Gunahgaar Hai Koi Sajdo Ki Saugat Hai Na Koi Sohzo Taqwa Mere Paas Sarkar Hai Chal Pada Hoo Madine Ki Janib Magar Haii Sar Par Gunaho Ka Ambar Hai. Mujrimo Ko Saha Bakswata Hai Ti Sari Ummat Ki Bigdi Banata Hai Tu Gam Ke Maaro Ko Seene Lagata Hai Tu Bekaso Gamzado Ka Tu Gamkhwar Hai Tera Shani Kahan Shah E Kono Makan, Mujsa Aashin Ummat May Hoga Kahan Tere Afwa Karam Shah E Do Jahan, Kya Koi Mujse Badhkar Bhi Haqdaar Hai. Thokare Darbadar Kab Talak Khaoo May, Fir Madine Muqaddar Se Kab Aaoo May Kash Qadmo May Sarkaar Mar Jaoo May, Ya Nabi Ye Tamnna E Attar Hai.

৪৪০

Mujrim Huwa Hai Haazir Jaali Ke Saamne

Mujrim Huwa Hai Haazir Jaali Ke Saamne Nazre Karam Ho Naazir Jaali Ke Saamne Jurm O Gunaah Mere Had Se Siwaa To Kya Gham Bulwaa Liyaa He Aakhir Jaali Ke Saamne Hasnayn Ke Tasadduq Qismat Chamak Gayi Ab Mangtey Huwe Jo Haazir Jaali Ke Saamne Ban Jaaye Uski Bigri Jis Par Nazar Hey Daali Iss Waaste Hoon Haazir Jaali Ke Saamne Kyun Kar Phiroon Mai Dar Dar Jab Hoon Tera Gadaagar Mangtaa Hoon Aagaya Phir Jaali Ke Saamne Maqbool Hogi Beshak Har Ek Duaein Teri Maangi He Jo Bhi Shakir Jaali Ke Saamne

৪৪১

Munawwar Meri Aankho Ko Mere Shamshudduha Kar De

Munawwar Meri Aankho Ko Mere Shamshudduha Kar De Ghamo Ki Dhoop Me Wo Saayae Zulfe Dota Kar De Jahaan Bani Ataa Kar De Bhari Jannat Hiba Kar De Nabi Mukhtare Qul Hai Jiss Ko Jo Chahe Ataa Kar De Jahan Me Unki Chalti Hai Wo Dam-Me Kya Se Kya Kar De Jameen Ko Aasmaa Kar De Suraiya Ko Sara Kar De Fazaa Me Udne Waale Yu Na Itraye Nida Kar De Wo Jab Chahe Jise Chahe Usme Farma Rawa Kar De Meri Mushkil Ko Yu Aasaa Mere Muskil Kusha Kar De Har Aik Mauje Balaa Ko Mere Maula Nakhuda Kar De Ataa Ho Bekhudi Mujhko Khudi Meri Hawa Kar De Mujhe Yu Apni Ulfat Me Mere Maula Fanaa Kar De Jahaan Me Aam Paighame Shahe Ahmad Raza Kar De Palat Kar Peeche Dekhe Fir Se Tajdeede Wafa Kar De Nabi Se Jo Ho Begana Use Dil Se Juda Kar De Pidar Madar Biradar Maalo Jaan Un Par Fida Kar De Kisi Ko Wo Hasaate Hain Kisi Ko Wo Rulaate Hain Wo Yu Hi Aazmate Hain Wo Ab To Faisla Kar De Gile Taibah Me Mil Jau Gulome Milke Khiljau Hayaate Jaavedaani Se Mujhe Yu Aashna Kar De Mujhe Kya Fikr Ho Akhtar Mere Yaawar Hain Wo Yaawar Balao Ko Meri Jo Khud Giraftare Balaa Kar De

৪৪২

Muntazir Dono Aalam The Jin Ke Liye

Muntazir Dono Aalam The Jin Ke Liye Aaye Wo Aur Faili Khushi Har Taraf Unke Aate Hi Zulmat Ke Badal Chaten Chayi Tauheed Ki Roshni Har Taraf Aaye Jibreel Noorie Sawari Liye La Makaa(N) Ki Taraf Mustafa Chal Diye Farsh Se Arsh Tak Noor Hi Noor Tha Dono Aalam Me Thi Sar Khushi Har Taraf. Noor Kaisa Wo Gaare Hira Se Chala Aaj Tak Jiski Nooraniyat Kam Nahi Kitne Seene Me Wo Noor Mehfooz Hai Chan Rahi Hai Wohi Raushni Har Taraf. Taajdare Madina Chale Badr Ko Teen Sau Terah(313) Noorie Sipaahi Liye Utre Jibreel Malkooti Lashkar Liye Khil Uthi Fatha Ki Chandni Har Taraf. Jab Uhad Me Mere Aaqa Zakhmi Hue Khalbali Mach Gayi Saare Ashaab Me Chand Taiba Ka Palbhar Ko Kya Chup Gaya Cha Gayi Thi Faza Me Maatami Har Taraf. Ye Lua’be Nabi Ka Hi Ajaaz Tha Dukhti Aankhen Ali Ki Bhali Ho Gayi Baabe Khaibar Ukhaada Ba Chasme Zadan Goonj Utha Naara E Haidari Har Taraf. Sabz Gumbad Ki Ranaaiya Kya Kahu Mamba E Noor Hai Qibla E Ahle Dil Yaan Wo Aaram Farmaan Hai Jinke Liye Rab Ne Takhleeq Ki Zindagi Har Taraf. Urse Sayyed Miyan Ka Wo Shohra Hua Is Qadar Ra’ub Barkaatiyat Ka Badha Saare Dushman Pareshano Hairan Hai Unke Halqo Me Hai Khalbali Har Taraf. Nazmi Tere Liye Naat Ne’mat Bani Ye Meem E Muhammad Ka Ajaaz Hai Noor O Nikhat Ka Haamil Hai Tera Qalam Kar Raha Hai Jo Zikre Nabi Har Taraf.

৪৪৩

Muraadein Mil Rahi Hain Shaad Shaad Unka Suwali Hai

Muraadein Mil Rahi Hain Shaad Shaad Unka Suwali Hai Labo(N) Par Iltija Hai Haath Mein Rouze Ki Jaali Hai Teri Soorat Teri Seerat Zamane Se Nirali Hai Teri Har Har Adaa Praye Daleel E Be-Misaali Hai Wo Hain Allah Waale Jo Tujhe Waali Kahein Apna Ke Tu Allah Waala Hai Tera Allah Waali Hai Faqeero(N) Be-Nawao(N) Apni Apni Jholiya(N) Bhar Lo Ke Bara Bat Raha Hai Faiz Par Sakaar E Aali Hai Nikala Kab Kisi Ko Bazme Faiz E Aam Se Tumne Nikali Hai To Aane Waalo(N) Ki Hasrat Nikali Hai Khuda Shahid Ke Rouz E Hashr Ka Khatka Nahi Rehta Mujhe Jab Yaad Aata Hai Ke Mera Koun Waali Hai Hasan Ka Dard O Dukh Mouquf Farma Kar Bahaali Do Tumhare Haath Mein Dunya Ki Mouqufi Bahaali Hai

৪৪৪

Muskura Do Do Alam Badal Jaega

Muskura Do Do Alam Badal Jaega Yeh Nizame Do Alam Sambhal Jaega Ya Nabi Ya Nabi… Ya Nabi Ya Nabi… Aap Ae Zamana Fida Hogeya Arsh Jhuk Kar Adab Se Khara Hogeya Lamakan Pe Bhi Shor Bhapha Hogeya Aaj Paida Habibe Khuda Hogeya Kyoun Manaye Na Id-E-Milad Nabi Aaj Ke Din The Ae Hamare Nabi Aisi Rahmat Karam Ki Si Baad Chali Asiyon Ko Kare Ik Nazr Mein Wali Aaj Jhumo Ke Ae Hain Khayr Ul-Bashar Aaj Gao Ke Thanda Hai Rabb Ka Sahar Un Ke Hote Hue Ke Sadr Kya Fikr Waste Hamare Kya Ji Qadr Torre Qadmoun Ko Chumo Yeh Dil Ki Lagan Torre Jute Uthane Ko Machle Yeh Man Torre Pao Dabao Kahe Mera Man Shaha Kuch To Mujhe Mere Man Ki Lagan Zaate Ahmad Se Dil Ko Taharat Mille Dil Ko Taskin, Ruh Ko Sarawat Mille Dil Lagane Se Tum Ko Phir Allah Mille Woh Muhammad Hain Unse Sab Kuch Mille Torri Chokat Pe Baitha Rahun Har Ghari Torra Darwaza Khatta Rahun Har Ghari Torri Naatein Shaha Main Likhoun Har Ghari Torri Rahmat Ko Takta Har Ghari

৪৪৫

Mustafa Aa Gaey Mustafa Aa Gaey

Chaar Su Rahmatoon Ke Ujaale Huwey Bazm-E-Kowneyn Ke Peyshwaa Aa Gaey Zaraey Aflaak Se Baatein Karney Lagey Mustafa Aa Gaey Mustafa Aa Gaey Gham Ke Maarey Huwey Muskaraaney Lagey Zulmatoon Ke Makeen Jagmagaane Lagey Be Kasoon Ke Muqaddar Thekaaney Lagey Sab Ke Muhsin Habeeb-E-Khuda Aa Gaey Hazrat-E-Musa Jin Ko Taraste Rahey Ibn-E-Maryam Bhi Jin Ki Khabar Dey Gaey Pehley Aaey Huwey Jin Ke Peechay Kharhey Aaj Woh Khaatim-Ul-Anmbiya Aa Gaey Be Zabaanon Ko Tarz-E-Sadaa Bakhsh Di Fani Insaaniyat Ko Baqaa Bakhsh Di Dushman-E-Jaan Ki Har Ik Khata Bakhsh Di Ban Key Rehmat Shafi-Ul-Waraa Aa Gaey Shab Gazeedah Ko Nur-E-Sahar De Diya Kor-E-Deedah Ko Zowq-E-Nazar De Diya Be Nawa Ko Dua Ka Asar De Diya Saari Makhlooq Ka Aasra Aa Gaey Zikr Keysey Karon Wasf Sarkar Ka Kya Bayan Ho Samaan Un Ke Darbaar Ka Dil Zahuri Bana Matla’ Anwaar Ka Jab Tasawwur Mein Woh Dilrubaa Aa Gaey

৪৪৬

Mustafa Aap Ke Jaisa Koi Aaya Hi Nahi

Mustafa Aap Ke Jaisa Koi Aaya Hi Nahi Ata Bhi Kaise Jab Allah Ne Banaya Hi Nahi Koi Sani Na Hai Rab Ka Na Mere Aaqa Ka Ek Ka Jism Nahi Ek Ka Saya Hi Nahi Zulf Vallayl Hai, Rukh Wadduha Mazad Aakhen Is Tarha Rab Ne Kisi Ko Bhi Sajaya Hi Nahi Aap Ne Jab Se Nawaza Hai Ya Rasulallah Maine Daman Kisi Chokhat Pe Bichhaya Hi Nahi Jisne Sarkar Ke Chehre Ki Ziyarat Ki Hai Us Ki Nazron Me Koi Aur Samaya Hi Nahi Jab Kha Kabr Me Sarkar Ne Ye Mera Hai Fir Farishto Ne Mujhe Haath Lagaya Hi Nahi Laut Kar Aa Gaya Makke Se Madine Na Gaya Kaise Jata Tuje Aaqa Ne Bulaya Hi Nahi Jabse Darwaze Pe Likha Maine Ala Hazrat Koi Gustakh E Nabi Ghar Mere Aya Hi Nahi Jab Talak Pusht Pe Shabbir Rahe Aye Faizy Sar Ko Sajde Se Payambar Ne Uthaya Hi Nahi ------------------ Other ------------------ ----------------- Version ----------------- Mustafa Aap Ke Jaisa Koi Aaya Hi Nahi Aap Ke Jaisa Koi Rab Ne Banaya Hi Nahi Har Fazilat Mein Hai Yakta Mere Madani Aaqa Aapka Saani To Kya Aapka Saaya Hi Nahi Lamha Lamha Mere Aaqa Ki Inayat Mujh Par Mujh Ko Tanhaai Ka Ehsaas Dilaya Hi Nahi Aapki Shaan Rosool E Arabi Kya Kehna Khali Daman Kisi Mangta Ko Phiraya Hi Nahi Shab E Meraj Ke Dulha Ke Siwa Auro Ko Apna Jalwa Mere Maula Ne Dikhaya Hi Nahi Qasim E Neymat E Rab Ki Ye Qana'at Dekho Peyt Bhar Ke Kabhi Sarkar Ne Khaya Hi Nahi Kabhi Aisa Na Hua Unke Karam Ke Sadqe Maine Manga Hai Aur Aaqa Ne Dilaya Hi Nahi Wo To Kuch Asia Karam Karte Hai Mujh Aasi Par Zindagi Mein Gham Maine Uthaya Hi Nahi Jism Rizwan Ka Har Aan Safar Karta Hai Dil Madine Se Palta Kar Kabhi Aaya Hi Nahi

৪৪৭

Mustafa E Zaat E Yakta Aap Hain

Mustafa E Zaat E Yakta Aap Hain Yak Ne Jisko Yak Banaya Aap Hain Aabo Gil Mein Noor Ki Pehli Kiran Jaane Aadam Jaane Hawwa Aap Hain La Makaan Tak Jis Ki Phaili Raushni Wo Charaage Aalam Aara Aap Hain Hai Namak Jis Ka Khameer E Husn Mein Wo Maleehe Husn Aara Aap Hain Naazish E Arsho Waqaar E Arshiyaan Saahibe Qausain O Adna Aap Hain Aap Ki Tal'at Khuda Ka Aaina Jis Mein Chamke Haq Ka Jalwa Aap Hain Aap Jaisa Koyi Ho Sakta Nahi Apni Har Khoobi Mein Tanha Aap Hain Aapko Rab Ne Kiya Apna Habeeb Saari Khalqat Ka Khulasa Aap Hain Aapki Tal'at Ko Dekha Jaan Di Qabr Mein Pohcha To Dekha Aap Hain Aapki Khatir Banaye Do Jahaan Apni Khatir Jo Banaya Aap Hain Jaan Tui Jaanam Qaraare Jaan Tui Jaane Jaan Jaane Maseeha Aap Hain Aapse Khud Aap Ka Saail Hun Main Jaane Jaan Meri Tamanna Aap Hain Bar Darad Aamad Gada Behre Salaam Ho Bhala Akhtar Ka Daata Aap Hain

৪৪৮

Mustafa Ka Khuda Aur Khud Mustafa

Mustafa Ka Khuda Aur Khud Mustafa Kyu Kahu Mera Koi Sahara Nahi Unke Dar Ka Gada Aur Mayoos Ho, Mere Sarkar Ko Yeh Gawara Nahi. Mai Madine Se Lekin Bohot Door Hu Yeh Khalish Mere Dil Ko Gawara Nahi Aap Ka Ishq Hai Ishq E Rab Ul Ula Aap Ka Zikr Hai Khaas Zikre Khuda Khud Khuda Ne Yeh Quran Me Ailaan Kiya Joh Tumhara Nahi Woh Hamara Nahi Thokaro Ke Siwa Aur Payega Kya Jiski Manzil Ko Koi Na Ho Rahnuma Apni Manzil Pe Hargiz Na Pahuchega Woh Hath Me Jike Daaman Tumhara Nahi Ism E Ahmed Ki Ta`azim Ke Munqeero Unki Azmat Ko Quran Me Dekh Lo Be Laqab Unka Ism E Mubarak Kabhi Unke Ma`bood Ne Bhi Pukara Nahi Aql E Jinn O Bashar Ka Yaha Zikr Kya Sidrah Waale Jaha Dang O Hairan Hai Rif`at E Mustafa Ki Mile Hadh Kisse Yeh Who Dariya Hai Jiska Kinara Nahi Wohi Roaze Pe Bulwayege Ek Din Aye Sikandar Zara Sabr Se Kaam Le Unke Dar Ka Gadha Aur Mayoos Ho Mere Sarkar Ko Yeh Gawara Nahi Ya Nabi Apni Ulfat Ki Soughaat De, Apni Shayan-E-Shah Mujhko Khayraat De. Iss Se Matlab Nahi Hai, Siwa Ho Ke Kamm, Shaala Wasda Raawe Tera Sohna Haram. Mere Haathon Mein Kaasa Hai Umeed Ka, Hoon Bhikari Shaha Teri Deed Ka. Ik Jhalak Hi Dikha De Nabi Mohtasham, Shaala Wasda Rawe Tera Sohna Haram. Mere Haathon Mein Kaasa Hai Umeed Ka, Hoon Bhikari Shaha Teri Deed Ka. Main Gada-E-Haram, Tu Nabi Mohtasham, Shaala Wasda Rawe Tera Sohna Haram.

৪৪৯

Mustafa Khairul Wara Ho

Mustafa Khairul Wara Ho Sarware Har Do Sara Ho Apne Achho Ka Tasadduq Hum Bado(N) Ko Bhi Niba Ho Kiske Fir Ho Kar Rahe Hum Gar Tumhi Humko Na Chaho Badd Ha(N)se Tum Unki Khaatir Raat Bhar Rouo Karaho Badd Kare Har Dam Burayi Tum Kaho Unka Bhala Ho Hum Wahi Nashusta Ru Hai Tum Wahi Bahre Ataa Ho Hum Wahi Shayane Rad Hai Tum Wahi Shaan E Sakhaa Ho Hum Wahi Be Sharmo Badd Hai Tum Wahi Kaan E Haya Ho Hum Wahi Nange Zafa Hai Tum Wahi Jaan E Wafa Ho Hum Wahi Kabil Saz Ke Tum Wahi Rehme Khuda Ho Charkh Badle Dahar Badle Tum Badalne Se Wara Ho Ab Hume Ho Sahw Hasha Aisi Bhulo Se Juda Ho Umr Bhar To Yaad Rakha Waqt Par Kyu Bhulna Ho Waqte Paidaish Na Bhule Qaif Yansa Kyo Kaza Ho Ye Bhi Maula Arz Kar Du Bhul Agar Jaao To Kya Ho Wo Ho Jo Tum Par Gira(N) Hai Wo Ho Jo Hargiz Na Chaho Wo Ho Jiska Naam Lete Dushmano Ka Dil Bura Ho Wo Ho Jiske Radd Ki Khaatir Raat Din Wakf E Dua Ho Mar Mite Barbaad Bande Khana Aabad Aagh Ka Ho Shaad Ho Ibleese Mal-U(N) Ghum Kise Is Kahar Ka Ho Tumko Wo Wallah Tum Ko Jaan O Dil Tum Par Fida Ho Tumko Ghum Se Haq Bachaye Ghum Adu Ko Jaa(N) Guza Ho Tumse Ghum Ko Kya Ta'alluk Be-Kaso Ke Ghumzada Ho Haq Durude Tum Pe Bheje Tum Mudaam Usko Saraho Wo Ataa De Tum Ataa Lo Wo Wahi Chahe Jo Chaho Bar Tu Uu Paashad Tu Bar Ma Ta Abad Ye Silsila Ho Kyu Raza Mushkil Se Dariye Jab Nabi Mushkil Kusha Ho

৪৫০

Mustafa Se Jab Tumhara Silsila Mil Jayega

Mustafa Se Jab Tumhara Silsila Mil Jayega Khud Ba Khud Aye Dhoodne Waaalo Khuda Mil Jayega Kya Bataoon Unke Dar Pe Jaake Kya Mil Jayega Jo Talab Hogi Talab Se Bhi Siwaa Mil Jayega Gham Nahi Gum Ho Bhi Jayein, Raahe Firdouse Baree Mustafa Ka Naam Lunga, Raasta Mil Jayega Unke Sadqe Mein Khuda Se Maang Kar Dekhe Koi Mudda’i Ke Lab Hilenge Mudda’a Mil Jayega Naam Unka Waqte Muskhil Le Ke Dekho To Zaraa Na Umeedi Mein Bhi Dil Ko Aasra Mil Jayega

৪৫১

Muzdabaad Aye Aasiyo Shaafe Shahe Abraar Hai

Muzdabaad Aye Aasiyo Shaafe' Shahe Abraar Hai Tehniyat Aye Mujrimo Zaate Khuda Gaffaar Hai Arsh Sa Farshe Zamee(N) Hai Farshe Pa Arshe Baree(N) Kya Niraali Tarz Ki Naame Khuda Raftaar Hai Chand Shaq Ho Ped Bole(N) Jaanwar Sajde Kare(N) 'baarak-Allah' Marjaye Aalam Yehi Sarkaar Hai Jin Ko Suye Aasmaa(N) Failaa Ke Jal Thal Bhar Diye Sadqa Un Haatho(N) Ka Pyare Hum Ko Bhi Darkaar Hai Lab Julaale Chashmaye Kun Mein Gundhe Waqte Khameer Murde Zinda Karna Aye Jaa(N) Tum Ko Kya Dushwaar Hai Gore Gore Paau(N) Chamka Do Khuda Ke Waaste Noor Ka Tadka Ho Pyare Gor Ki Shab Taar Hai Tere Hi Daaman Pe Har Aasi Ki Padti Hai Nazar Ek Jaane Be Khata Par Do Jahaa(N) Ka Baar Hai Joshe Toofaa(N) Behre Be Paayaa(N) Hawa Na-Saazgaar Nooh Ke Maula Karam Kar Le To Beda Paar Hai Rehmatullil Aalamee(N) Teri Duhaai Dab Gaya Ab To Maula Be Tarah Sar Par Gunah Ka Baar Hai Hairate(N) Hain Aaina Daare Wufoore Wasfe Gul Un Ke Bulbul Ki Khamoshi Bhi Labe Izhaar Hai Goonj Goonj Utthe Hain Nagmaate Raza Se Bostaa(N) Kyun Na Ho Kis Phool Ki Midhat Mein Waa Minqaar Hai

৪৫২

Na Aasmaan Ko Yun Sar Kashida Hona Tha

Na Aasmaan Ko Yun Sar Kashida Hona Tha Huzoore Khaake Madina Khameeda Hona Tha Agar Gulon Ko Khaza Na Raseeda Hona Tha Kanaare Khaare Madina Dameeda Hona Tha Huzoor Unke Khilafe Adab Thi Betaabi Meri Umeed! Tujhe Aarmeeda Hona Tha Nazara Khaake Madina Ka Aur Teri Aankh Na Is Qadar Bhi Qamar Shokh Deeda Hona Tha Kanaare Khaake Madina Mein Rahate Mili Dile Hazee(N)! Tujhe Ashke Chakeeda Hona Tha Panahe Daamane Dashte Haram Mein Chain Aata Na Sabre Dil Ko Gazale Rameeda Hona Tha Ye Kaise Khulta Ki Unke Siwa Shafee’ Nahi Abas Na Auro Ke Aage Tapeeda Hona Tha Hilaal Kaise Na Banta Ki Maahe Kaamil Ko Salaame Abruye Shah Me Rameeda Hona Tha La Amla Anna Jahannam Tha Wa’daye Azli Na Munkiro Ka Abas Bad Aqeeda Hona Tha Naseem Kyun Na Shameem Unki Taiba Se Laati Ki Subhe Gul Ko Gireeba(N) Dareeda Hona Tha Tapakta Range Junoo(N) Ishqe Shah Me Har Gul Se Rage Bahaar Ko Nishtar Raseeda Hona Tha Baja Tha Arsh Pe Khaake Mazare Paak Ko Naaz Ki Tujhsa Arsh Nashee(N) Aafreeda Hona Tha Guzarte Jaan Se Ik Shore ‘ya Habeeb’ Ke Saath Fugaa(N) Ko Naalaye Halqe Bureeda Hona Tha Mere Kareem Gunah Zahar Hai Magar Aakhir Koi To Shahde Shafa’at Chasheeda Hona Tha Jo Sange Dar Pe Jabee(N) Saaiyon Mein Tha Mitna To Meri Jaan Sharaare Jaheeda Hona Tha Teri Qaba Ke Na Kyun Neeche Neeche Daaman Ho Ki Khaaksaaro Se Ya(N) Kab Kasheeda Hona Tha Raza Jo Dil Ko Banana Tha Jalwa Gaahe Habeeb To Pyare Qaide Khudi Se Raheeda Hona Tha

৪৫৩

Na Arsh Aiman Na Inni Zaahib Mein Mehmaani Hai

Na Arsh Aiman Na 'inni Zaahib' Mein Meh-Maani Hai Na Lutfe 'udnu Ya Ahmed' Naseebe 'lan-Taraanee' Hai Naseebe Dostaa(N) Gar Unke Dar Par Maut Aani Hai Khuda Yoon Hi Kare Phir To Humesha Zindagaani Hai Usi Dar Par Tadapte Hain Machalte Hain Bilakte Hain Utha Jaata Nahin Kya Khoob Apni Na-Tawaani Hai Har Ik Deewaro Dar Par Mehr Ne Ki Hai Jabee(N) Saaee Nigaare Masjide Aqdas Mein Kab Sone Ka Paani Hai Tere Mangta Ki Khaamoshi Shafa'at Khwaah Hai Uski Zabaane Be Zabaani Tarjumaane Khasta Jaani Hai Khule Kya Raaze Mehboobo Muhib Mastaane Gaflat Par Sharaabe 'qad-Ra-Al-Haq' Zaibe Jaame 'man-Ra-Aanee' Hai Jahaa(N) Ki Khaak-Roobi Ne Chaman-Aara Kiya Tujh Ko Saba Humne Bhi Un Galiyon Ki Kuch Din Khaak Chaani Hai Shahaa Kya Zaat Teri Haq Numa Hai Farde Imqaa(N) Mein Ki Tujhse Koi Awwal Hai Na Tera Koi Saani Hai Kahaa(N) Us Kushke Jaane Jinaa(N) Mein Zar Ki Naqqashee Iram Ke Taaire Range Pareeda Ki Nishaanee Hai 'ziyabun Fee Thiyaabin' Lab Pe Kalma Dil Mein Gustaakhi Salaam Islaamo Mulhid Ko Ki Tasleeme Zabaani Hai Ye Aksar Saath Unke Shaa-Nao Miswaak Ka Rehna Bataata Hai Ki Dil-Resho(N) Pe Zaaid Meherbaani Hai Isi Sarkaar Se Dunya Wa Dee(N) Milte Hai Saail Ko Yahi Darbaare Aali Kanze Aamaalo Amaani Hai Duroode Soorate Haala Muheete Maahe Taiba Hain Barasta Ummate Aasi Pe Ab Rehmat Ka Paani Hai Ta'aa-Lallah Istigna Tere Dar Ke Gadaaon Ka Ki Inko Aar Farro Shaukate Saahib Kiraani Hai Woh Sargarme Shafa'at Hain Araq Afshaa(N) Hai Peshaani Karam Ka Itr Sandal Ki Zamee(N) Rehmat Ki Ghaani Hai Yeh Sar Ho Aur Woh Khaake Dar Woh Khaake Dar Ho Aur Ye Sar Raza Woh Bhi Agar Chaahen To Ab Dil Mein Yeh Thaani Hai

৪৫৪

Na Baharein Na Hi Gulzaar Nazar Aate Hain

Na Baharein Na Hi Gulzaar Nazar Aate Hain Jiss Taraf Dekh Lo Sarkar Nazar Aate Hain Aaj Bik Jaun, Ke Yeh Mauka Na Ayega Kabhi Aaj Woh Khud Hi Kharidaar Nazar Aate Hain Aise Lagta Hai Mere Aaqa Challe Aate Hain Raqs Karte Dar-O-Deewar Nazar Aate Hain Ankh Se Ansoo Nahi, Sajde Gira Karte Hain Jab Tere Gumbad-O-Minaar Nazar Aate Hain Jis Ki Qismat Mein Ho Taiba Ki Galli Ke Phere Woh Na Jannat Ke Tallabgaar Nazar Aate Hain Aise Lagta Hai Mere Aaqa Challe Aate Hain Wajd Karte Dar-O-Deewar Nazar Aate Hain Qadmon Ka Kaam Hai Yeh Dagmaagate Hain Dil To Gir Jaayein Jahaan Wahin Parre Rehte Hain Unke Aane Ki Gharri Hai Woh Hain Aane Waale Mere Sarkar Ki Mehfil Ko Hum Saajaye Hue Hain Maine Meraj Ki Shab Baat Yeh Jaani Hai Sammi Jo Ho Dilbar Unhein Dildaar Nazar Aate Hain Na Baharein Na Hi Gulzaar Nazar Aate Hain Jiss Taraf Dekh Lo Sarkar Nazar Aate Hain

৪৫৫

Na Chedo Zirk E Jannat Ab Madinah Yaad Aya Hai

Na Chedo Zirk E Jannat Ab Madinah Yaad Aya Hai Nabi Ka Sabz Gumbad Dil Ki Aankhaon Me Samaya Hai Mila Karti Hai Mooh Maange Muradein Unke Rauze Par Ghulamau Ne Tere Dar Se Jo Maanga Hai Woh Paya Hai Khuda Ki Sultanat Ke Tum Ho Dulha Ya Rasoolullah Tumhare Waaste Rabb Ne Yeh A’alam Sajaya Hai Shabe Asra Mubarak Baad Dee Yeh Hooraun Ne Muhammed Ko Khuda E Pak Ne Dulha Banaya Hai Namazaun Me Azaan Me Kalmah Me Aur Arsh Par Har Ja Khuda Ne Naam Tera Naam Se Apne Milaya Hai Zameen Ko Cheerte Daude Huwe Aae Hai Khidmat Me Darakhtaun Ne Isharah Aapka Jis Waqt Paya Hai Tumhari Zaat Par Kyun Kar Bharosa Ho Na Alam Ko Gunah-Garaun Ko Tumne Naar E Dozakh Se Bachaya Hai Ijabat Ne Liya Bosah Tumhare Pyare Hotaun Ka Dua Ke Waaste Jis Waqt Tum Ne Lab Hilaya Hai Koee Pur Saane Haal Apna Nahi Hai Ya Rasoolullah Jo Apna Hai To Tu Hai Aur Baqi Sab Paraya Hai Sana E Mustafa Woh Bhi Rawayat E Sahiha Se Jameele Qadri Kya Khoob Tere Paas Maya Hai

৪৫৬

Na Ho Aram Jis Bimar Ko Saarey Zamaaney Sey

Na Ho Aram Jis Bimar Ko Saarey Zamaaney Sey Utha Ley Jaaey Thori Khak Unkey Aastaney Sey Tumharey Dar, Ke Tukron Sey, Bara Palta Hai Ik Aalam Guzaara Sab Ka Hota Hey, Issee Muhtaj Khaaney Sey. Koi Firdous Ho Ya Khuld Ho, Hum Ko Ghalat Mutlab Lagaya Ab To Bistar Aap Hee Key Aastaney Sey. Na Kyun Un Kee Taraf Allah, So So Piyaar Sey Deykey. Jo Apni Aankey Maltey Hain, Tumhaarey Aastaney Sey. Tumhaarey To Woh Ihsaan Aur Na-Farmaaniyan Apni Hamein To Sharam See Aathi Hai Tum Ko Munh Dikhaaney Sey Bahaarey Khuld Sadqey Ho Rahi Hey Ruuh-E Aashiq Par Killi Jaatee Hain Kaliyan Dil, Teree Muskaraney Sey Zamin Thori See Dey Dey Bahr-E Madfan Un Key Kuchey May Laga Dey Merey Piyaaray Meri Mittee Bhi Tikaaney Sey Falak Ka Hai Jo Zaahir Uss Sey Kehta Hai Naseeb Us Ka Arey Ghaafil Kaza Behtar,yahaan Say Phir Ke Jaaney Sey Bulalo Apney Dar Par Ab, To Hum Khaanah Nadoshoo Ko Phirey Kub Tak Zaleel-O Khwaar Be Dar Dar Tikaaney Sey Na Pahunchey Un Key Kadmoh Tak, Na Kuch Husn-E Amal Hee Hey Hassan Kiya Puchtey Ho Hum Gayeh Guzrey Zamaaney Sey Na Ho Araam Jis Bimaar, Ko Saarey Zamanay Sey Utha Ley Jaaey Thori Khaak Unkey Aastaney Sey.

৪৫৭

Na Kaleem Ka Tasawwur Na Khiyaale Ture Sinaa

Na Kaleem Ka Tasawwur Na Khiyaal-E-Tur-E-Sinaa Meri Aarzu Muhammad Meri Justuju Madinah Main Gadaae Mustafa Hun Meri Azmatein Nah Poocho Mujhe Deykh Kar Jahannam Ko Bhi Aa Geya Paseenah Mujhe Dushmano Nah Cherho Mera Koi Hai Jahaan Main Main Abhi Pukaar Lun Ga Naheen Dur Hai Madinah Main Mareez-E-Mustafa Hun Mujhe Cherho Nah Tabibo Meri Zindagi Jo Chaaho Mujhe Le Chalo Madinah Meray Dubne Main Baqi Nah Koi Kasar Rahi Thi Kahaa “almadad Muhammad” Tho Ubhar Geyaa Safinah Siwaa Is Ke Meray Dil Mein Koi Aarzu Nahein Hai Mujhe Mowt Bhi Jo Aaey Tho Ho Saamne Madinah Kabhi Aey Shakeel Dil Se Nah Mite Khiyaal-E-Ahmad Isi Arazu Mein Marna Isi Arazu Mein Jeena.

৪৫৮

Naare Dozakh Ko Chaman Kar De Bahare Aariz

Naare Dozakh Ko Chaman Kar De Bahare Aariz Zulmate Hashr Ko Din Kar De Nahare Aariz Main To Kya Cheez Hoon Khud Sahibe Qur’an Ko Shaha Laakh Mushaf Se Pasand Aayi Bahare Aariz Jaise Qur’an Hai Wird Use Gule Mehboobi Ka Yun Hi Qur’aa(N) Ka Wazifa Ha Waqare Aariz Garche Qur’aa(N) Hai Na Qur’aa(N) Ki Barabar Lekin Kuch To Hai Jis Pe Hai Woh Madha Nigaare Aariz Toor Kya Arsh Jale Dekh Ke Woh Jalwaye Garm Aap Aariz Ho Magar Aainaye Daare Aariz Turfa Aalam Hai Woh Qur’an Idhar Dekhe(N) Udhar Mushafe Paak Ho Hairane Bahare Aariz Tarjama Hai Ye Sifat Ka Woh Khud Aainaye Zaat Kyun Na Mushaf Se Zyada Ho Waqare Aariz Jalwa Farmaye(N) Rukhe Dil Ki Siyahi Mit Jaye Subha Ho Jaaye Ilahi Shabe Taare Aariz Naame Haq Par Kare Mehboob Dilo Jaa(N) Qurbaa(N) Haq Kare Arsh Se Ta Farsh Nisaare Aariz Mushk Bu Zulf Se Rukh Chehre Se Baalo(N) Mein Shu-Aa’ Mo’jiza Hai Halabe Zulfo Tataare Aariz Haq Ne Bakhsha Hai Karam Nazre Gadaya(N) Ho Qabool Pyare Ik Dil Hai Woh Karte Hain Nisaare Aariz Aah Be Mayagiye Dil Ki Raza-E-Mohtaj Le Kar Ik Jaan Chala Bahre Nisaare Aariz

৪৫৯

Naat Sarkar Ki Parta Hoon Mein

Naat Sarkar Ki Parta Hoon Mein Bas Issi Baat Say Ghar Mein Meri Rahmat Hogi Ik Tera Naam Waseela He Mera Ranj O Gham Mey Bhi Iss Naam Sey Rahat Hogi Ye Suna Hey Kay Bahot Ghor Andheri Hogi Qabar Ka Khowf Na Rakna Ey Dil Waha Sarkar Ke Chehre Ki Ziarat Hogi Kabhi Yaseen Kabhi Tauha Kabhi Walail Aaya Jis Ki Kasmein Mera Rab Khata Hai Kitni Dil Kash Meray Mehboob Ki Surat Hogi. Hashr Ka Din Bhi Ajab Dekhne Wala Hoga Zulf Lehra Key Wo Jab Ayengey Phir Qiyamat Mein Bhi Ik Aur Qiayamat Hogi Unko Mukhtar Banaya Hai Merey Mola Ney Khuld Mein Bas Wahi Ja Sakta Hein Jisko Hasnain Kay Nana Ki Ijazat Hogi Do Jahan Main Usay Phir Koun Panah Main Lay Le Ga Ho Ga Ruswa Wo Sar-E-Hashr Jisay Syeda Zahra Kay Bachoon Say Adawat Hogi. Unki Chokhat Pay Pare Hain To Bari Mauj Main Hain Laut Kay Aayein Gay Jab Us Dar Say Meray Dil Tu Hi Bata Kiya Teri Halat Ho Gi. Rushk Say Dur Kharey Dekhtay Houn Gay Zahid Jab Sar E Hashr Gunahgaroon Par Meray Aaqa Ka Karam Ho Ga Inayat Ho Gi. Mayray Sarkaar Bulaa Ain Gay, Un Ki Chokat Pay, Wo Nazaara Phir May Daykoon Ga, Daykh Kar Gumbad E Khazra, Mayri Ulfat Hogi Mera Daman To Gunahoon Say Bhara Hai Altaf Ik Sahara Hai Kay Hum Teray Hain Isi Nisbat Say Sar E Hashar Shafa’at Ho Gi.

৪৬০

Naat Sunta Rahoon Naat Kehta Rahoon

Naat Sunta Rahoon Naat Kehta Rahoon Aankh Purnam Rahay Dil Machalta Rahay Najm-E-Naam-E-Muhammad Zuban Par Rahay Zikr Hota Rahay Saans Chalta Rahay Baisaharoon Ka Koi Sahara Nahin Mustafa Kay Siwa To Guzara Nahin Unki Chasm-E-Karam Ho To Kuch Ghum Nahin Chahay Sara Zamana Badalta Rahay Ishq Ahmad Si Duniya Main Naimat Nahin Mal O Zar Ki Bhi Koi Haqiqat Nahin Badshaoon Say Behtar Bhikari Hai Woh Unkay Dar Pay Tukrhoon Pay Jo Palta Rahay Kiya Bhala Asakay Zindagi Kay Mazay Door Reh Kar Habib-E-Khuda Say Mujhay Uski Halat Karoon To Karoon Kia Biyan Har Ghari Jo Furkat Main Jalta Rahay Yeh Dua Hai Salamat Sada Ghum Rahay Ta Abad Rab Tais-E-Qayam Rahay Aatishay Ishq Har Dum Bharhakti Rahay Khoon Roota Rahoon Dil Pighalta Rahay Mustafa Ki Nazar Jis Gharhi Ho Gaee Uski Takdeer Khoti Khari Hogaee Usko Thukrae Sara Jahan Bhi Agar Girne Wala Magar Phir Sanbhalta Rahay Najm Ki Ae Khuda Aarzoo Hai Yehi Aashiq-E-Zaar Ki Aabroo Hai Yehi Aakhri Waqt Sar Unkay Kadmoon Pay Ho Deed Hoote Rahay Dum Nikalta Rahay

৪৬১

Nabi Ka Jashn Aaya Chaand Taaron Jhoomtay Rehna

Nabi Ka Jashn Aaya Chaand Taaron Jhoomtay Rehna Nabi Ke Naam Per Ae Naamdaaron Jhoomtay Rehna Jahaan Mein Noor Leykar Noor Wala Aanay Wala Hai Meray Hamraah Tum Bhi Dil Ke Taaron Jhoomtay Rehna Galli Koochay Sajadena Harray Jhanday Lagadena Taqaaza Ishq Ka Hai Mere Yaaron Jhoomtay Rehna Nabi-E-Sarwar-E-Konain Ki Aamad Ke Lamhoon Mein Durood-E-Pak Parhtay Parhtay Saaron Jhoomte Rehna Musawaat-O-Akhuwat Ka Payaam-E-Dil Nasheen Laaye Khushi Mein Aey Ghareebon Maaldaaron Jhoomte Rehna Woh Aaye Gham Qaday Mein Ek Khushi Ki Roshni Phooti Khuda Ke Shukar Mein Aey Gham Ke Maaron Jhoomte Rehna Khushi Ik Dil Pe Hai Chaayei Wiladat Ki Ghari Aayei Arey Aey Gul Aaro Maah Paaron Jhoomte Rehna Bujhay Na Ishq-E-Ahmed Ki Agan Qalb-E-Ujagar Se Dharakna Aur Ae Dil Ke Shararon Jhoomte Rehna

৪৬২

Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai

Meri Kismat Jagaane Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah Ghamo Ki Doop Ho Ya Phir Hawaa-Ain Tayz Chaltee Ho, Mayray Iss Aashiyaan Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Khushi Ho Ya Koee Gham Ho, Nabi Ka Naam Layta Ho, Kay Har Ik Gham Bulaanay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Nabi Ka Naam Layta Hoon, Sukoon-E-Qalb Miltaa Hai, Nabi Kay Iss Deewaanay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Jo Poocha Kamli Waalay Nay, Kahaa Siddeeq Akbar Nay, Mayray Saaray Garaanay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Soolagti Aag Par Habshi, Kay Honton Say Sadaa Aa Ee, Mayree Bigree Banaanay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai. Yayhee Kehta Hai Shahid Be, Yayhee Sab Log Kehtay Hai, Kay Iss Saaray Zamaanay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai, Hazaaron Gham Mittaa Nay Ko, Nabi Ka Naam Kaafi Hai.

৪৬৩

Nabi Kay Ishq Nay Jis Ko Haseen Banaaya Hai

Nabi Kay Ishq Nay Jis Ko Haseen Banaaya Hai Wohi Fareed, Wohi Data Ban Kay Aaya Hai Jahaa Kahee Bhi Kadam Maira Dagmagaaya Hai Sahaara Denay Karam Aapka He Aaya Hai Sata Sakkay Gee Na Humko Ye Garmiy-E-Mehsher Hamaaray Ser Pay Habeebay Khuda (S.a.w.w) Ka Saaya Hai Issi Tamanna May Jeeta Hoo Koi Ye Keh Day Ya Rasoolallah Challo Challo Tumhai Sarkaar Nay Bulaaya Hai Bura Samajh Kay Jahaan Nay Jo Tak Diya Jiss Ko Tairey Karam Nay Ussay Bhi Gallay Lagaaya Hai Farishtay Aatay Hain Rehmat Kay Uss Kay Ghar Jiss Nay Tumhari Zikr Ki Mehfil Say Ghar Sajaaya Hai Jo Sang Kha Kay Bhi Ta’if May Muskuraaya Hai Wo Koi Aur Nahi Aamna Ka Jaaya Hai Ghammay Habeebay Khuda Nay Jissay Nawaaz Diya Aleem Aalamay Gham May Bhi Muskuraaya Hai Nabi Kay Ishq Nay Jis Ko Haseen Banaaya Hai Wohi Fareed, Wohi Data Ban Kay Aaya Hai

৪৬৪

Nabi Ki Yaad Se Roshan Maere Dil Ka Nagina Hai

Nabi Ki Yaad Se Roshan Maere Dil Ka Nagina Hai Wo Mayray Dil Mean Rehtay Heyn Mayra Dil Bhi Madina Hai Madinay Ki Judaii Meyn Sulagta Mayra Seena Hai Parrha Huun Duur Teba Say Yay Jeena Keisa Jeena Hai Nabi Ki Aal Ka Sadqa Jahaan Ki Nay’matayn Maango Khuda Say Maangnay Ka Yay Barrha Achha Qareena Hai Jhukoon Kyun Gheyr Kay Dar Par Kisi Say Bhik Kyun Maangun Mayray Daaman Meyn Ishqay Sarwaray Deen Ka Khazeena Hai Nazar Afroz Hai Ranginiay Fardos Ki Laykin Jo Taskinay Dil O Jaan Hai Wo Aqa Ka Madina Hai Hamay Khatra Nahiin Koii Niazi Duub Janay Ka, Kay Ham Jis Meyn Heyn Betthay Wo Muhammd Ka Qareena Hai

৪৬৫

Nabi Sarware Har Rasoolo Wali Hai

Nabi Sarware Har Rasoolo Wali Hai Nabi Raazdaare Ma-Allahi-Lee Hai Woh Naami Ki Naame Khuda Naam Tera Raufo Raheemo Aleemo Ali Hai Hai Betaab Jis Ke Liye Arshe Aa'zam Woh Is Reh-Rawe Laa Maqaa(N) Ki Gali Hai Nakeerain Karte Hain Taa'zeem Meri Fida Hoke Tujh Par Ye Izzat Mili Hai Talaatum Hai Kashti Pe Toofaane Gham Ka Yeh Kaisi Hawaaye Mukhaalif Chali Hai Na Kyunkar Kahoon Ya Habeebi Agithni Isi Naam Se Har Museebat Tali Hai Saba Hai Mujhe Sar-Sare Dashte Taiba Isi Se Kali Mere Dil Ki Khili Hai Tere Charon Hardum Hai Yak Jaan Yak Dil Abu Bakr Faarooq Usmaa(N) Ali Hai Khuda Ne Kiya Tujh Ko Aagaah Sab Se Do Aalam Mein Jo Kuch Khafi Wa Jali Hai Karoon Arz Kya Tujh Se Aye Aalimussirr Ki Tujh Par Meri Haalate Dil Khuli Hai Tamanna Hai Farmaaiye Roze Mehshar Ye Teri Rihaayi Ki Chitthi Mili Hai Jo Maqsad Ziyarat Ka Bar Aaye Phir To Na Kuch Qasd Keeje Ye Qasde Dili Hai Tere Dar Ka Darbaa(N) Hai Jibreele Aa'zam Tera Madha Khwaa(N) Har Nabi Wa Wali Hai Shafa'at Kare Hashr Me Jo Raza Ki Siwa Tere Kisko Ye Qudrat Mili Hai

৪৬৬

Nabiyun Nabiyun Nabiyun Nabi

Yaa Wajeehad Deenee Wal Karamee Wa Halefal Ilmee Wal Hikamee Nabiyun Nabiyun Nabiyun Nabi (2times) Ya Rasool Allahee Salamun Alayk Ya Rafee’aa Shanee Wa Darajee Rasulun Rasulun Rasulun Rasul(2 Times) Yaa Wafeeyal Ahadi Wa Deemaee Waa Hamidas Sayi Wa Shiyami Aminun Aminun Aminun Amin(2 Times) Ya Rasul Allahee Ya Imdatanaa Ya Imaamal Ambiyaa Il Umanaa Khatimun Khatimun Khatimun Khatimun(2 Times) Wal Fakeedil Mhadi Muttarifun Minhu Bil Lflaasi Wal Adami Rahimun Rahimun Rahimun Rahim(2 Times) Wa Salaatulaahi Khaaliqinaa Tataghash-Sha Sayyidal Umamee Mustafa Mustafa Mustafa Mustafa(2 Times) Ahmadal Mukharee Sayyidinaa Addadal Auraqi Wad Diyami Kamilun Kamilun Kamilun Kamil(2 Times) Khaira Annal Fadla Muntaqabun Min Azimil Fadli Wal Karamee Karimun Karimun Karimun Karim(2 Times)

৪৬৭

Naematein Baanta Jis Samt Woh Zeeshaan Gaya

Naematein Baant-Ta Jis-Samt Woh Zeeshaan Gaya Saath Hii Munshi-E-Rahmat Ka Qalamdaan Gaya Lay Khabr Jald Kay Ghairon Kii Taraf Dhayaan Gaya Mere Mawla, Mere Aaqa, Tere Qurbaan Gaya Aah Woh Aankh Jo Nakaame Tamanna Hi Rahi Haye Wo Dil Jo Tere Darr Se Pur-Armaan Gaya Dil Hai Voh Dil Jo Teri Yaad Se Mamoor Raha Sar Hai Voh Sar Jo Tere Qadmon Pe Qurbaan Gaya Unhe Jaana, Unhe Maana Na Rakha Gair Se Kaam Lillahil Hamd Main Duniya Se Musalmaan Gaya Aur Tum Par Mere Aaqa Kii 'inaayat Na Sahii Najdiyo Kalimah Parhaanay Ka Bhi Ehsaan Gaya Aaj Lay Unki Panaah, Aaj Madad Maang Unsay Phir Na Maaneingay, Qayamat Mein Agar Maan Gaya Uff Re Munkir Ye Badha Joshe Ta-Assub Aakhir Bheed Me Haath Se Kambakht Ke Imaan Gaya Jaan O Dil Hosh O Khird Sab Tau Madinay Paunchay Tum Nahin Chaltay Raza Saara Tou Saamaan Gaya

৪৬৮

Nahi He Koi Duniya Main Hamara Ya Rasool Allah

Nahi He Koi Duniya Main Hamara Ya Rasool Allah Faqat Hay Aap Hee Ka Ik Sahara Ya Rasool Allah Sarapa Maaseaat Hoon Baar Hay Bay Had Gunahoon Ka Bachana Nar-E-Dozakh Say Khuda Raa Ra Rasool Allah Talatum Khaiz Hay Daria Bhanwar Main Hay Mairi Kashti Nazar Aata Naheen Koi Kinara Ya Rasool Allah Faqat Aamal Kay Badlay Naan Paye Ga Koi Janat Naan Ho Ga Jab Talak Tera Ishara Ya Rasool Allah Haqeeqat Main Bohat Berh Kar Hay Arsh-E-Mo’ala Sey Zameen Jiss Par Ho Naqsh-E-Paa Tumhara Ya Rasool Allah Tarapta Hay Maira Dil Aur Tarasti Hain Bohat Aankhaien Bula Loophir Madinay Main Dobara Ya Rasool Allah Gunahgaaraan-E-Ummat Ka Khajal Hoona Saza Pana Tairi Rehmat Ko Kab Ho Ga Gawara Ya Rasool Allah Dam-E-Aakhir Zara Hassam Par Itna Karam Karna Keh Uss Kay Lab Par Hoo Kalma Tumhara Ya Rasool Allah Naheen Hay Koi Dunia Main Hamara Ya Rasool Allah Faqat Hay Aap Hee Ka Ik Sahara Ya Rasool Allah

৪৬৯

Nahi Tumsa Koi Haseen Ya Muhammad

Nahi Tumsa Koi Hasee(N) Ya Muhammad Jhuka Te Hai Yousuf Jabee(N) Ya Muhammad Nasha Paye Aqdas Ka Ho Jis Zameen Par Hai Jannat Hamari Wahi Ya Muhammad Ho Duniya Wo Deen Khabar Ho Ya Ke Mehshar Nazar Aa Rahe Ho Tumhi Ya Muhammad Khuda Ki Qasam Ab Na Uth'the Gi Hargis Jhuki Hai Jo Dar Par Jabee(N) Ya Muhammad Musalmaan Kya Kafiroune Hamesha Pukaara Hai Tumko Amee(N) Ya Muhammad Kuch Itne Ho Nazdeek Tum Apne Rab Se Habeeb-E-Khuda Ho Tumhi Ya Muhammad Ho Duniya Ke Aqba Do Aalam Me Aaqa Milega Na Tumsa Kahee(N) Ya Muhammad Wohi To Hai Dil Me Basaane Ke Laayaq Wo Nazrein Jo Tum Tak Gayi Ya Muhammad Ye Allah Ne Khud Hi Farma Diya Hai Rahega Hamesha Ye Dee(N) Ya Muhammad Tumhare Ghulamoun Me Hai Muttaqui Bhi Karam Uspe Ya Shahe Dee(N) Ya Muhammad

৪৭০

Nai Koii Auqaat Oganhaar Di

Nai Koii Auqaat Oganhaar Di Jeho Jaii Wi Haan Mein Haan Sarkaar Di Kyun Phiraan Mein Mangtiyaan Ton Mangdi Mein Te Mangti Haan Khuda De Yaar Di Allah Di Sonh Saani Koii Bhukh Naiin Bhukhh Hei Te Hei Tere Deedaar Di Onaan Nuun Changi Naiin Lagdi Koii Shei Jhalk Wekhi E Jinna Sarkaar Di Koii Sun Ke Khush Naiin Hunda Na Howe Gal Karni E Assaan Sarkaar Di Mehrbaanaa Sohniyaa Man Mohniyaa Wekh Ja Haalat Kade Beemaar Di Jo Mili Izzat Niyaazi Jag Tay Mehrbaani Hei Ayh Sab Sarkaar Di

৪৭১

Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha Mitha Lagta Hai
