Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Yade Nabi Ka Gulshan Mehka, Mehka Lagta Hai Mehfil Mein Maujud Hain Aqa Aisa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Lab Par Naghmey Salley Ala Ke Hathon Mein Kashkol Dekho To Sarkar Ka Mangta Kaisa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Ghauso, Qutb, Abdaal, Qalandar, Sab Unke Mohtaj Mera Aqa Sab Waliyon Ka Aqa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Yade Nabi Mein Har Dam Rona Achchha Lagta Hai Hum Bhi Taibah Jaengey Ab Aisa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Yade Nabi Mein Rone Wala Hum Diwanon Ko Lakh Paraya Ho Woh Phir Bhi Apna Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Unke Dar Se Palne Wale, Apna Aap Jawab Koi Ghaus Al Azam, Koi Khwaja Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Siddique-O-Umar, Usman-O-Ali, Aur Khalid-O-Zaid-O-Bilal Baithe Hon Darbare Nabi Mein Kaisa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai Zikre Nabi Se Raushan Anjum, Sara Jag Pur Noor Salley Ala Tum Parh Ke Dekho Kaisa Lagta Hai Namey Muhammad Kitna Mitha, Mitha Lagta Hai Donon Jahan Sarkar Ka Sadqa Aisa Lagta Hai

৪৭২

Namey Muhammad Salley Ala Ankhon Ki Thandak Dil Ki Jila

Namey Muhammad Salley Ala, Ankhon Ki Thandak Dil Ki Jila Aao Unka Zikr Karein, Jo Hai Dafa-Aey Ranjo Bala Jin Ko Unka Qurb Mila Hai, Ban Gaye Hadi-O-Raah Numa Sab Par Unki Chashme Karam Hai, Wah Re Shaane Judo Sakha Dekh Ke Apni Farze Amal Ko, Aasi Jab Sharmaen Gey Ummat Se Kuch Pyar Hai Aisa, Khud Woh Karam Farmaen Gey Un Par Apna Tan Man Warun, Warun Husne Kouno Makaa’n Haasil Unke Sadqey Mein Hai, Izzat-O-Azmat Naam-O-Nishan Mehfiley Naat Ki Baat Na Pucho, Khud Woh Karam Farmatey Hain Jin Pe Karam Hota Hai Unka, Unke Din Phir Jate Hain Unki Bhik Pe Sab Paltey Hain, Unke Mungtey Shahon Gada Dar Se Koi Khali Na Lauta, Daata Ki Yeh Shaane Ata Jab Koi Mushkil Pesh Aai Hai, Dil Ne Unko Pukara Hai Anjum Apna To Yeh Yaqin Hai, Unka Karam Ho Jata Hai Namey Muhammad Salley Ala, Ankhon Ki Thandak Dil Ki Jila Aao Unka Zikr Karein, Jo Hai Dafa-Aey Ranjo Bala

৪৭৩

Naseeban Waaleyan Nu Yaar De Dedaar Hondey Ne

Naseeban Waaleyan Nu Yaar, De Dedaar Hondey Ne Tarap De Nein Jo Aj Yaaro, Oh Kal Darbaar Hondey Ne Gunahgaaran Ghareeban Ley, Dine Raati Dua Karni Aenu Kehnde Ney Ghamkhaari Te Inj Ghamkhaar Hondey Ne Sawaari Karan Ley Jinno, Milan Kande Muhammad Dey Nawabi/shaahi Is No Kehnde Ney, Te Inj Sardaar Hondey Ne Hussain Ibne Ali Daseya, Lutaa Ke Ghar Da Ghar Saara Raza Je Yaar Di Howe, Kadooun Inkaar Hondey Ne

৪৭৪

Nazar Ik Chaman Se Do Chaar Hai Na Chaman Chaman Bhi Nisaar Hai

Nazar Ik Chaman Se Do Chaar Hai Na Chaman Chaman Bhi Nisaar Hai Ajab Uske Gul Ki Bahaar Hai Ki Bahaare Bulbule Zaar Hai Na Dile Bashar Hi Figaar Hai Ki Malak Bhi Uska Shikaar Hai Yeh Jahaa(N) Ki Hazda Hazaar Hai Jise Dekho Uska Hazaar Hai Nahi Sar Ki Sajda Kuna(N) Na Ho Na Zabaa(N) Ki Zamzamaa Khwaa(N) Na Ho Na Woh Dil Ki Uspe Tapaa(N) Na Ho Na Woh Seena Jis Ko Qaraar Hai Woh Hai Bheeni Bheeni Waha(N) Mahak Ki Basa Hai Arsh Se Farsh Tak Woh Hai Pyari Pyari Waha(N) Chamak Ki Waha(N) Ki Shab Bhi Nahaar Hai Koi Aur Phool Kaha(N) Khile Na Jagah Hai Joshishe Husn Se Na Bahaar Aur Pe Rukh Kare Ki Jhapak Palak Ki To Khaar Hai Yeh Saman Yeh So-Sano Yaasman Yeh Banfasha Sumbulo Nastaran Gulo Sarwo Laalah Bhara Chaman Wohi Ek Jalwa Hazaar Hai Yeh Saba Sanak Woh Kali Chatak Yeh Zabaa(N) Chahak Labe Joo Chalak Yeh Mahak Jhalak Yeh Chamak Damak Sab Usi Ke Dam Ki Bahaar Hai Wohi Jalwa Shahar Ba Shahar Hai Wohi Asle Aalamo Dahar Hai Wohi Bahar Hai Wohi Lahar Hai Wohi Paat Hai Wohi Dhaar Hai Woh Na Tha To Baagh Mein Kuch Na Tha Woh Na Ho To Baagh Ho Sab Fanaa Woh Hai Jaan Jaan Se Hai Baqaa Wohi Bun Hai Bun Se Hi Baar Hai Yeh Adab Ki Bulbule Benawa Kabhi Khul Ke Kar Na Sake Nawaa Na Saba Ko Tez Rawish Rawa Na Chalakti Nehro(N) Ki Dhaar Hai Ba Adab Jhuka Lo Sare Wilaa Ki Main Naam Loo(N) Gulo Baagh Ka Gule Tar Muhammade Mustafa Chaman Un Ka Paak Dayaar Hai Wohi Aankh Un Ka Jo Munh Take Wohi Lab Ki Mehw Ho Na'at Ke Wohi Sar Jo Unke Liye Jhuke Wohi Dil Jo Un Pe Nisaar Hai Yeh Kisi Ka Husn Hai Jalwagar Ki Tapaa(N) Hain Khoobon Ke Dile Jigar Nahi(N) Chaak Jaibe Gulo Sahar Ki Qamar Bhi Seena Figaar Hai Wohi Nazre Shah Mein Zare Nikoo Jo Ho Unke Ishq Mein Zard Roo Gule Khuld Usse Ho Rang Joo Yeh Khazaa(N) Woh Taaza Bahaar Hai Jise Teri Saffe Ni'aal Se Mile Do Niwaale Nawaal Se Woh Bana Ki Uske Ugaal Se Bhari Saltanat Ka Udhaar Hai Woh Uthi(N) Chamak Ke Tajalliyaa(N) Ki Mita Di Sab Ki Tajalliyaa(N) Dilo Jaa(N) Ko Bakhshi Tasalliyaa(N) Tera Noor Baarido Haar Hai Rusulo Malak Pe Durood Ho Wohi Jaane Unke Shumaar Ko Magar Ek Aisa Dikha To Do Jo Shafi'e Roze Shumaar Hai Na Hijaab Charkho Maseeh Par Na Kaleemo Toor Nihaa(N) Magar Jo Gaya Hai Arsh Se Bhi Udhar Woh Arab Ka Naaqa Suwaar Hai Woh Teri Tajalliye Dilnasheen Ki Jhalak Rahe Hain Falak Zamee(N) Tere Sadqe Mere Mahe Mubee(N) Meri Raat Kyun Abhi Taar Hai Meri Zulmate(N) Hain Sitam Magar Tera Mah Na Mehr Ki Mehr-Gar Agar Ek Cheent Pade Idhar Shabe Daaj Abhi To Nahaar Hai Gunahe Raza Ka Hisaab Kya Woh Agarche Laakhon Se Hain Siwaa Magar Aye Afooww Tere Afw Ka Na Hisaab Hai Na Shumaar Hai Tere Deene Paak Ki Woh Ziya Ki Chamak Uthi Rahe Istafaa Jo Na Maane Aap Sakar Gaya Kahi(N) Noor Hai Kahi(N) Naar Hai Koi Jaan Bas Ke Mahak Rahi Kisi Dil Mein Us Ke Khatak Rahi Nahi Uske Jalwe Mein Yak-Rahi Kahi(N) Phool Hai Kahi(N) Khaar Hai Woh Jise Wahabiya Ne Diya Hai Laqab Shaheedo Zabeeh Ka Woh Shaheede Lailaaye Najd Tha Woh Zabeehe Taige Khiyaar Hai Yeh Hai Dee(N) Ki Taqwiyat Us Ke Ghar Yeh Hai Mustaqeem Siraate Shar Jo Shaqee Ke Dil Mein Hai Gaau Khar To Zabaa(N) Pe Choodha Chamaar Hai Woh Habeeb Pyara To Umr Bhar Kare Faizo Jood Hi Sar Basar Are Tujh Ko Khaaye Tape Sakar Tere Dil Mein Kis Se Bukhaar Hai Woh Raza Ke Neze Ki Maar Hai Ki 'adoo Ke Seene Mein Ghaar Hai Kise Chaara Jooee Ka Waar Hai Ki Ye Waar Waar Se Paar Hai

৪৭৫

Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Ya Rasool Allah

Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Tum Nibhaalo Ya Rasool Allah Bulaalo Ab Madine Mey Bulaalo Ya Rasool Allah Satate Hain Jo Duniya Wale Is Ka Kuch Nahi Hain Gham Mujhe Bas Apna Keh Kar Tum Bulaalo Ya Rasool Allah Sunehri Jaaliyon Key Saamne Pohcha Hoon Mey Aaqa Mujhe Apni Ziyaarat Tum Karaado Ya Rasool Allah Meri Qismat Buree Ho To Khudara Tum Bhalee Kardo Sanwaaro Meri Qismat Ko Sanwaaro Ya Rasool Allah ‘ataa Ho ‘ilm Ki Daulat ‘ataa Ho Deed Ki Daulat Damey Aakhir Madina Bhi ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah Shafa’at Ka Sawali Hoon Sawali Hoon Mai Rehmat Ka Ijaabat Se Nawaazo Tum Nawaazo Ya Rasool Allah Mo’in-E-Raah-E-Taiba Hain Mere Khwaja Mo’inuddeen Mo’in-E-Raah-E-Jannat Bhi Banaado Ya Rasool Allah Tasadduq Ghaus E A’azam Ka Tawassul A’ala Hazrat Ka Baqee-E-Paak Ke Qaabil Banaado Ya Rasool Allah Nigah-E-Mufti-E A’azam Ney Zinda Kardiya Dil Ko Unhi Ka Saath Mehshar Me ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah Tamanna Ye Liye Jaata Hai Aaqa Shakir E Razvi Ise Izne Madina Phir ‘ataa Ho Ya Rasool Allah

৪৭৬

Nigaare Ambiya Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye

Nigaare Ambiya Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Rasoole Do Sara Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Zamee(N) Se Ta Falak Ik Noor Ka Sailaab Aaya Hai Nabi Mahe Laqa Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Bahaare Aa Gayi Hai Aamina Ke Paak Hujre Mein Karaare Walida Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Gareebon Bekason Ka Bebason Ka Aasra Ban Kar Yateemon Ki Dua Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Unhe Qad-Jaa-Akum Noorun Kaha Hai Rabbe Aalam Ne Sarapa Noor Ka Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Hui Thi Aap Hi Se Ibtida Imkaane Aalam Ki Hain Sab Ki Intiha Ban Kar Muhammad Mustafa Aaye Andhere Mit Gaye Saara Jahaa(N) Raushan Hua Saaim Ziyaaon Ki Ziya Ban Kar Muhammad Musfafa Aaye

৪৭৭

Noor Se Apne Sarwar E Aalam Duniya Jagmagane Aaye

Noor Se Apne Sarwar E Aalam Duniya Jagmagane Aaye Ghum Ke Maaro Dukhyaro Ko Seene Se Lagane Aaye Noore Nigare Ambiya, Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Shano Nishaan E Kibriya Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Nikhra Hua Hai Rue Gul Faili Hui Hai Bue Gul Banke Bahaar E Jaa(N) Fiza Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Arsh E Baree Ki Rounake Farsh E Zamee Par Aa Gayi Sajde Ko Jhuk Gaya Aasmaa(N) Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Ashqo Se Bhar Ke Jholiya Aankhe Bicha Do Raah Me Salle Alaa Ki Do Sadaa Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Chatki Hui Hai Chaandni Faili Hui Hai Roshni Dariya Rawa(N) Hai Noor Ka Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Mehfil Ko Ab Sawaar Lo Dil Ka Chaman Nikhar Lo Kardo Charaga Jaa-Baja Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye Sayim Kalaam E Zouk Se Kalbo Nazar Ko Shauk Se Raho(N) Me Aaj Do Bicha Mere Huzoor Aa Gaye

৪৭৮

Noor Wala Aya Hai

Noor Wala Aya Hai Noor Lay Kar Aya Hai Sara Alam May Yah Dekho Kaisa Noor Chaya Hai Ass Salato Was Salamo Alay Kay Ya Rasoolallah Ass Salato Was Salamo Alay Kay Ya Habiballah Jab Talak Yah Chand Tare Jheel Meelate Jayange Tab Talak Jasne Wiladat Hum Manate Jayange Naate Mahbooba Khuda Sunte Sunate Jayange Ya Rasoolallah Ka Nara Lagate Jayange Char Janib Hum Diye Ghee Kay Jalate Jayange Ghar Toh Ghar Sara Mohalle Ko Sajate Jayange Eid A Milad-Un-Nabi Ki Shab Charaga Kar Kay Hum Kabr A Noor-A-Mustafa Say Jagmagate Jayenge Tum Karo Jasnay Wiladat Ki Kushi May Roshni Woh Tumhari Gor-A-Teera Jagmagata Jayenge Hashr May Zayre Livay Hamd-A-Attar Hum Naat-E-Sultana Madina Gongunate Jayenge Zikr-E-Milad E Mubarak Kaise Chore Hum Bhala Jinka Khate Hai Unhi Ke Geet Gaate Jayenge

৪৭৯

Noori Mehfil Pe Chadar Tani Noor Ki

Noori Mehfil Pe Chadar Tani Noor Ki, Noor Phela Huwa Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Chandni Mein Hain Dubay Huwey Do Jahan, Kon Jalwa Numa Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Farsh Per Dhoom Hai, Arsh Per Dhoom Hai Badnasibi Hai Uski Jo Mehroom Hai, Phir Milay Gi Yeh Shab Kisko Maloom Hai Aam Lutfay Khuda Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Abray Rehmat Hai Mehfil Pay Chaye Huwey Aasman Say Malaik Hain Aaye Huey Khud Muhammed Hain Tashreef Laye Huwey Kis Kadar Jaan Fiza Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Manglo Mang Lo Chashme Tar Mang Lo Dard E Dil Aur Husn E Nazar Manglo Kamli Wale Ki Nagri Mein Ghar Manglo Mangnay Ka Maza Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Momino Aaj Ganj E Sakha Lutlo Lutlo Aie Marizo Shifa Lootlo Asiyo Rehmat E Mustafa Lootlo Babay Rehmat Khula Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Khoob Honay Do Ashkoon Ki Barsat Ko Do Salami Muhammed Ki Barat Ko Choom Lo Chum Lo Aaj Ki Raat Ko Shab Qadar Kay Guman Aaj Ki Raat Hai. Waqt Laye Khuda Sabh Madinay Chalein Lutnay Rehmatoon Kay Khazinay Chalein Sabh Ki Manzil Ki Janib Safinay Chalein Meri Sa’aim Dua Aaj Ki Raat Hai.

৪৮০

Noori Mukhra Te Zulfan Ne Kaliyan

Noori Mukhra Te Zulfa’an Ne Kaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliyan Pyaar Mere Aaqa Da Seene Wich Howe Juggi Ek Rehn Layi Madine Wich Howe Banda Raj Raj Ke Chumme Fer Jaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliyan Noori Mukhra Te Zulfa’an Ne Kaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliyan Beliya Huzoor Diyan Mehfila’n Sajaya Kar Din Raat Sohne Te Darood Tu Pounchaya Kar Ghar Rehn Giyan Sada Khush Haliya’n Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliyan Noori Mukhra Te Zulfa’an Ne Kaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliyan Pak Qura’n Deyan Akhr’an Noon Wekh Lo Soorta’an No Wekho Ya Ke Sattran No Wekh Lo Jiven Aqa Diyan Zulfa’an Ne Kaliya’an Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliy Noori Mukhra Te Zulfa’an Ne Kaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliy Sadqa Nawasiya’an Da Sad Lo Madine Wich Thand Paa Lawa’n Aaqa Balde Main Seene Wich Chumma Jeunde Jeunde Roze Diyan Main Jaliya’n Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliy Noori Mukhra Te Zulfa’an Ne Kaliyan Rab Bhejda Durood’an Diyan Daaliy

৪৮১

Nooriyo Aao Zara Qasmi Jalsa Dekho

Nooriyo Aao Zara Qasmi Jalsa Dekho Noori Chehro Se Naya Noor Chalakta Dekho Shah E Qasim Ka Yeh Darbar Sajaa Shaahana Noor In’aam Har Ek Gaam Pe Bat Ta Dekho Nisbate Apni Yaha Aake Karo Mustahkam Arze Marehra Me Barkat Ka Dariya Dekho Achche Suthre Ki Tab O Taab Pe Waari Jau Aale Ahmed Ka Har Ek Simt Ujala Dekho Qadri Maikada Phir Saj Gaya Marehra Me Maye Baghdad Se Har Jaam Chalakta Dekho Qutbe Kaaki Ki Tausat Se Mili Chishtiyat Meer Sughra Me Rukhe Khwaja Ka Jalwa Dekho Arze Marehra Pe Ajmer Ke Noori Saaye Khwaja E Chishti Ka Mazboot Ye Qila Dekho Aao Barkaatiyo Murshid Ke Kareeb Aa Jao Aur Nazdeek Se Noorani Yeh Chehra Dekho Peer Ka Chehra Sajaaye Rakho Dil Ke Andar Chashme Dil Kholo Zara Peer Ko Qibla Dekho Peere Bepeer Ko Tum Peer Na Karna Apna Bikne Barkat Me Bas Zikr Raza Ka Dekho Partawe Kilke Raza Hai Miya Nazmi Ka Qalam Iski Tehreer Me Bas Rang Raza Ka Dekho

৪৮২

Paat Woh Kuch Dhaar Ye Kuch Zaar Hum

Paat Woh Kuch Dhaar Ye Kuch Zaar Hum Ya Ilaahi Kyun Kar Utre Paar Hum Kis Bala Ki Mai Se Hain Sarshaar Hum Din Dhala Hote Nahi(N) Hushiyaar Hum Tum Karam Se Mushtari Har Aib Ke Jin Se Na Maqboole Har Bazaar Hum Dushmano(N) Ki Aankh Mein Bhi Phool Tum Dosto(N) Ki Bhi Nazar Mein Khaar Hum Lagzishe Pa Ka Sahara Ek Tum Girne Waale Lakho(N) Na Hanjaar Hum Sadqa Apne Baazuo Ka Al Madad Kaise Tode(N) Ye Bute Pindaar Hum Dam Qadam Ki Khair Aye Jaane Maseeh Dar Pe Laaye Hain Dile Beemar Hum Apni Rehmat Ki Taraf Dekhe Huzoor Jaante Hain Jaise Hain Badkaar Hum Apne Mehmaano(N) Ka Sadqa Ek Boond Mar Mite Pyaase Idhar Sarkaar Hum Apne Kooche Se Nikala To Na Do Hain To Had Bhar Ke Khudai Khwar Hum Haath Uthakar Ek Tukda Aye Kareem Hain Sakhi Ke Maal Mein Haqdaar Hum Chandni Chatki Hai Unke Noor Ki Aao Dekhe(N) Saire Tooro Naar Hum Himmat Aye Zo’f Unke Dar Par Gir Ke Ho(N) Be Takalluf Saayae Deewar Hum Ba Ata Tum Shah Tum Mukhtar Tum Benawa Hum Zaar Hum Nachaar Hum Tumne To Laakhon Ko Jaane(N) Fer Di(N) Aisa Kitna Rakhte Hain Aazaar Hum Apni Sattari Ka Ya Rab Waasta Ho(N) Na Ruswa Bar Sare Darbaar Hum Itni Arze Aakhri Keh Do Koi Naav Tooti Aa Pade Manjdhaar Hum Muh Bhi Dekha Hai Kisi Ke Afw Ka Dekh O Isyaa(N) Nahi Be Yaar Hum Main Nisaar Aisa Muslamaa(N) Kijiye Tod Daale(N) Nafs Ka Junnaar Hum Kab Se Failaye Hain Daaman Taige Ishq Ab To Paaye(N) Zakhm Daaman Daar Hum Sunniyat Se Khatke Sab Ki Aankh Mein Phool Hokar Ban Gaye Kya Khaar Hum Na Tuwani Ka Bhala Ho Ban Gaye Naqshe Paaye Taalibaane Yaar Hum Dil Ke Tukde Nazre Haazir Laaye Hain Aye Sagaane Koochaye Dildaar Hum Qismate Sauro Hira Ki Hirs Hai Chahte Hain Dil Mein Gehra Gaar Hum Chashm Poshi Wa Karam Shaane Shuma Kaare Ma Bebaaki Wa Israar Hum Fasle Gul Sabza Saba Masti Shabaab Chchode(N) Kis Dil Se Dare Khummar Hum Maikada Chut-Ta Hai Lillah Saaqiya Ab Ke Saagar Se Na Ho(N) Hoshiyaar Hum Naazishe Karte Hain Aapas Mein Malak Hain Ghulamane Shahe Abraar Hum Lutf Az Khud Raftagi Ya Rab Naseeb Ho Shaheede Jalwaye Raftaar Hum Unke Aage Da’waye Hasti Raza Kya Bake Jaata Hai Ye Har Baar Hum

৪৮৩

Parda Rukhe Anwar Se Jo Utha Shabe Meraj

Parda Rukhe Anwar Se Jo Utha Shabe Meraj Jannat Ka Hua Rang Do Baala Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Hooron Ne Bhi Gaaya Hai Tarana Shabe Meraj Khaliq Ne Muhammad Ko Bulaya Shabe Meraj Khursheed O Qamar Arzo Sama Arsh O Malaik Kisne Nahi Paya Tera Sadqa Shabe Meraj Aye Rehmate Aalam Teri Rehmat Ke Tasadduq Har Ek Ne Paaya Tera Sadqa Shabe Meraj Jis Waqt Chali Shahe Madina Ki Sawaari Sajde Mein Jhuka Arshe Mu’alla Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Mehmaan Bulane Ke Liye Apne Nabi Ko Allah Ne Jibreel Ko Bheja Shabe Meraj Ye Shaane Jalaalat Ke Nihaayat Hi Adab Se Jibreel Ne Aaqa Ko Jagaaya Shabe Meraj Jibreel Bhi Hairaan Huwe Dekh Ke Rutba Sidra Se Qadam Jab Ke Badhaya Shabe Meraj Jibreel Take Ho Gaye Sarkaar Rawaana Woh Takta Huwa Reh Gaya Sidra Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Yun Masjide Aqsa Me Namaaz Usne Padhai Talib Se Mile Padke Dogana Shabe Meraj Har Ek Nabi Balke Sab Aflaq Ke Qudsi Padte The Shahensha Ka Qutba Shabe Meraj Muddat Se Jo Armaan Tha Woh Aaj Nikaala Hooron Ne Kiya Khoob Nazaara Shabe Meraj Dulha The Muhammad To Barati The Ferishte Is Shaan Se Pohche Mere Maula Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Jab Pohche Maqaam E Fatadalla Pe Muhammad(Saw) Qaliq Se Raha Kuch Bhi Na Parda Shabe Meraj Arsh O Malak O Arzo Sama Jannat O Dozaq Us Shah Ne Har Cheez Ko Dekha Shabe Meraj Bhejoon Ga Mai Ummat Ko Teri Quld Me Pehle Haq Ne Kiya Mehboob Se Waada Shabe Meraj Us Me Se Jameel E Razvi Ko Bhi Ataa Ho Rehmat Ka Bata Qaas Jo Hissa Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj Shabe Meraj

৪৮৪

Parho Durood Ke Molood Ki Ghari Aayi

Parho Durood Ke Molood Ki Ghari Aayi Ya Rasool Allah Salla Alaik Ya Habib Allah Sallim Alaik Aye Sarkar Aye Mere Dil Daar Aye Har Ek Saa’at-O-Lamha Hai Qeemti Is Ka Har Ek Raat Se Barh Kar Mila Isay Rutba Isi Liye To Ye Shab Behtreen Kehlaayi Khuda Ka Shukr Karo Or Parho Durood Un Per Ke Aaj Laaye Hain Tashreef Hadi-O-Rehbar Zamanay Bhar Mein Hai Mash’hoor Jin Ki Yaktayi Chhatay Hain Badal-E-Ghum Khushian Sath Laayi Hain Har Ek Chehray Pe Ab Muskurahat Aayi Hai Har Ek Dil Mein Khushi Ki Baji Hai Shehnai Jahan Mein Subz Parchamon Ki Bahar Aayi Hai Aur Aashiqon Ne Makaan Har Gali Sajaai Hai Hai Shaad Shaad Nabi Ka Har Ek Tamannayi Jahan Goonj Utha Marhaba K Naaron Se Khushi Hai Kaisi Na Poocho Ye Ghum K Maaron Se Yehi Wohi Raat Hai Jo Kaif Ka Samaan Layi Unhi K Dar Se Darya-E-Jood Behtay Hain Wo Aaye Jo Nahi Saail Ko Nahi Kehte Hain Sakhawat Aisi Ataa Rab Ne In Ko Farmayi Shab-E-Wiladat-E-Sarkar Ka Hai Ye Sadqa Ke Mil Gaya Hai Sana Ka Ubaid Ko Jazba Musafir Is Ki Ye Mehnat Jabeen To Rang Laayi

৪৮৫

Payaam Leke Jo Aayi Saba Madine Se

Payaam Leke Jo Aayi Saba Madine Se Marize Ishq Ki Laayi Dawa Madine Se Mile Humare Bhi Dil Ko Jilaa Madine Se Ke Mehro Maah Ne Paayi Ziya Madine Se Tumhari Ek Jhalak Ne Kiya Use Dilkash Farogh Husn Ne Paayi Shaha Madine Se Bata De Koi Kisi Aur Se Bhi Kuch Paaya Jise Mila Jo Mila Woh Mila Madine Se Tamam Shaaho Gada Pal Rahe Hai Us Dar Se Mili Jahaan Ko Rozi Sadaa Madine Se Woh Aaya Khuld Me Jo Aa Gaya Maine Me Gaya Woh Khuld Se Jo Chal Diya Madine Se Na Chain Paayega Ye Ghamzada Kisi Soorat Mareeze Gham Ko Milegi Shifa Madine Se Lagao Dil Ko Na Duniya Me Har Kisi Shai Se Ta'alluq Apna Ho Kaabe Se Ya Madine Se Chaman Se Phool Khile Murda Dil Bhi Jee Utthe Naseem Khuld Se Aayi Hai Ya Madine Se Madina Chasmaye Aabe Hayaat Hai Yaaron Chalo Humesha Ki Le Lo Baqaa Madine Se Humare Dil Ko To Bhaaya Hai Taiba Hi Zaahid Tumhe Hai Makka To Hoga Siwaa Madine Se Chale Jo Taiba Se Muslim To Khuld Me Pahuche Ki Seedha Khuld Ka Hai Raasta Madine Se Tumhare Qadmon Pe Sar Sadqe Jaan Fida Ho Jaaye Na Laaye Phir Mujhe Mera Khuda Madine Se Teri Habeeb Ka Pyara Chaman Kiya Barbaad Ilahi Nikle Ye Najdi Bala Madine Se Suno To Gaur Se Aayi Sadaa Madine Se, Kareen Hai Rehmat O Fazl E Khuda Madine Se Jo Aaya Le Ke Gaya Kaun Lauta Khaali Haath, Bataa De Koi Suna Ho Jo 'laa' Madine Se Tere Naseeb Ka Noorie Milega Tujh Ko Bhi Le Aaye Hissa Ye Shaaho Gada Madine Se.....!!

৪৮৬

Pekar E Dilruba Ban Kay Aaya

Pekar E Dilruba Ban Kay Aaya, Ruh E Arzo Sama Ban Kay Aaya Sab Rasul E Khuda Ban Kay Aa-Ay, Wo Habeeb E Khuda Ban Kay Aaya Hazrat E Amina Ka Dulaara, Wo Haleema Ki Aankhon Ka Taara Wo Shikasta Dilon Ka Sahaara, Bay Kason Ki Dua Ban Kay Aaya Dast E Qudrat Nay Esa Sajaya, Husn E Takhleeq Ko Rashk Aaya Jiss Ka Paya Kisi Nay Na Paya, Wo Khuda Ki Raza Ban Kay Aaya Taajdaaron Nay Di He Salami, Baadshahon Nay Ki He Ghulaami Bay Misaal Uss Ka Ism E Giraami, Mujtaba Mustafa Ban Kay Aaya Wo Nabi Rahmat E Aalameen Hai, Jo Bhi Unkay Zair E Nagiin Hai Esa Ghamkhuar Daykha Nahiin He, Jesa Kherulwara Ban Kay Aaya He Zahoori Barri Shan Unki, Madah Karta He Quraan Unki Naat Parrta He Hassaan Unki, Jo Mayra Rahnuma Ban Kay Aaya

৪৮৭

Peshe Haq Muzda Shafaat Ka Sunaate Jaayenge

Peshe Haq Muzda Shafaat Ka Sunaate Jaayenge Aap Rote Jaayenge Hum Ko Hansaate Jaayenge Dil Nikal Jaane Ki Jaa Hai Aah Kin Aankhon Se Woh Hum Se Pyaso Ke Liye Dariya Bahate Jaayenge Kusht-Gaane Garmiye Mehshar Ko Woh Jaane Maseeh Aaj Daaman Ki Hawa De Kar Jilaate Jaayenge Gul Khilega Aaj Ye Unki Naseeme Faiz Se Khoon Rote Aayenge Hum Muskurate Jaayenge Haan Chalo Hasrat Zado Sunte Hain Woh Din Aaj Hai Thi Khabar Jis Ki Ki Woh Jalwa Dikhaate Jaayenge Aaj Eide Aashiqaa(N) Hai Gar Khuda Chahe Ki Woh Abroo E Paiwasta Ka Aalam Dikhaate Jaayenge Kuch Khabar Bhi Hai Faqeero Aaj Woh Din Hai Ki Woh Ne’mate Khuld Apne Sadqe Mein Lutaate Jaayenge Khaak Uftado Bas Un Ke Aane Hi Ki Der Hai Khud Woh Gir Kar Sajda Mein Tum Ko Uthate Jaayenge Wus’ate Di Hain Khuda Ne Daamane Mehboob Ko Jurm Khulte Jaayenge Aur Woh Chupaate Jaayenge Lo Woh Aaye Muskurate Hum Aseeron Ki Taraf Khirmane Isyaa(N) Par Ab Bijli Giraate Jaayenge Aankh Kholo Ghamzado Dekho Woh Giryaa(N) Aaye Hain Lauhe Dil Se Naqshe Gham Ko Ab Mitaate Jaayenge Sokhta Jaano(N) Pe Woh Purjoshe Rehmat Aaye Hain Aabe Kausar Se Lagi Dil Ki Bujhaate Jaayenge Aaftaab Unka Hi Chamkega Jab Auro(N) Ke Charaag Sar-Sare Joshe Balaa Se Jhil-Milaate Jaayenge Paaye Koobaa(N) Pul Se Guzrenge Teri Aawaaz Par Rabbe Sallam Ki Sadaa Par Wajd Laate Jaayenge Sarware Dee(N) Leeje Apne Na-Tawaano Ki Khabar Nafso Shaitaa(N) Sayyida Kab Tak Dabaate Jaayenge Hashr Tak Daalenge Hum Paidaaishe Maula Ke Dhoom Misle Faaras Najd Ke Qil-Ae Giraate Jaayenge Khaak Ho Jaaye(N) Adoo Jal Kar Magar Hum To Raza Dam Mein Jab Tak Dam Hai Zikr Unka Sunaate Jayenge

৪৮৮

Phir Ke Gali Gali Tabaah

Phir Ke Gali Gali Tabaah Thokare(N) Sab Ki Khaye Kyun Dil Ko Jo Aql De Khuda Teri Gali Se Jaaye Kyun Rukhsate Qaafila Ka Shor Gash Se Humain Uthaye Kyun Sote Hain Unke Saaye Mein Koi Humain Jagaaye Kyun Baar Na The Habeeb Ko Paalte Hii Gareeb Ko Royen Jo Ab Naseeb Ko Chain Kaho Ganwaye Kyun Yaade Huzoor Ki Qasam Gaflate Aish Hai Sitam Khoob Hai Qaide Gham Mein Hum Koi Humein Chchudaye Kyun Dekh Ke Hazrate Ghani Fail Padhe Fakeer Bhi Chaayi Ab To Chauni Hashr Hi Aa Na Jaaye Kyun Jaan Hai Ishqe Mustafa Roz Fuzoo(N) Kare Khuda Jis Ko Ho Darf Ka Maza Naaze Dawa Uthaye Kyun Hum To Hain Aap Dil Figaar Gham Mein Hansi Hai Na Gawaar Ched Ke Gul Ko Nau Bahaar Khoon Humein Rulaye Kyun Yanto Yun Hi Tadap Ke Jaaye(N) Ya Wohi Daam Se Chchudaaye(N) Minnate Gair Kyun Uthaye(N) Koi Taras Jataaye Kyun Unke Jalaal Ka Asar Dil Se Lagaaye Hai Qamar Jo Ki Ho Lot Zakhm Par Daaghe Jigar Mitaaye Kyun Khush Rahe Gul Se Andaleeb Khaare Haram Mujhe Naseeb Meri Bala Bhi Zikr Par Phool Ke Khaar Khaye Kyun Garde Malaal Agar Dhule Dil Ki Kali Agar Khile Barq Se Aankh Kyun Jale Rone Pe Muskuraye Kyun Jaane Safar Naseeb Ko Kis Ne Kaha Maze Se Ho Khatka Agar Sehar Ka Ho Shaam Se Maut Aaye Kyun Ab To Na Rok Aye Ghani Aadate Sag Bigad Gayi Mere Kareem Pehle Hi Lukmaye Tar Khilaye Kyun Raahe Nabi Me Kya Kami Farshe Bayaaz Deeda Ki Chadare Zil Hai Malgaji Zere Qadam Bichaye Kyun Sange Dare Huzoor Se Hum Ko Khuda Na Sabr De Jaana Hai Sar Ko Jaa Chuke Dil Ko Karaar Aaye Kyun Hai To Raza Niraa Sitam Jurm Pe Gar Lajaaye Hum Koi Bajaaye Soze Gham Saaze Tarab Bajaaye Kyun

৪৮৯

Pooch Te Kya Ho Madine Se Mai Kya Laya Hoon

Pooch Te Kya Ho Madine Se Mai Kya Laya Hoon Apni Aankhaun Mein Madine Ko Basa Laya Hoon Dil Bhi Mera Hai Waheen Jaan Bhi Meri Hai Waheen Apne Kaandhaun Par Apne Laashay Ko Utha Laya Hoon Jisne Choome Hai Qadam Sarwaray Do ‘alam Ke Khaak E Taibah Ko Mai Apni Palkuan Pay Saja Laya Hoon Saya E Gumbade Khazra Me Ada Karke Namaaz Apne Sar Ko Mai Arsh Ka Hum Paya Bana Laya Hoon Shah-E-Kaonain Ki Midhat Ka Mila Hai Ye Sila Apni Bigri Hui Taqdeer Bana Laya Hoon Taiba-O-Batha Ke Purnoor Manazar Lekar Safha-E-Dil Pe Mai Tasweer Bana Laya Hoon Jaan O Dil Wahaan Rakh Ke Amanath Ki Tarha Phir Wahaan Janay Ke Asbaab Bana Laya Hoon

৪৯০

Poochte Kya Ho Arsh Par Yun Gaye Mustafa Ke Yun

Poochte Kya Ho Arsh Par Yu'n Gaye Mustafa Ke Yu'n Kaif Ke Parr Jaha'n Jale Koyi Bataye Kya Ke Yu'n Qasre D(A)na Ke Raaz Me Aqle To Gum Hai Jaisi Hai Ruhe Qudus Se Poochiye Tum Ne Bhi Kuch Suna Ke Yu'n Maine Kaha Ki Jalwa E Asl Me Kis Tarah Gume Subha Ne Noore Mehr Me Mitt Ke Dikha Diya Ke Yu'n Haaye Re Zouq E Bekhudi Dil Jo Sambhalne Sa Laga Chak Ke Mahak Me Phool Ki Gir Ne Lagi Sabaa Ke Yu'n Dil Ko De Nooro Daaghe Ishq Phir Mai Fida Do Neem Kar Maana Hai Sun Ke Shaqqe Maah Aankho Se Ab Dikha Ke Yu'n Dil Ko Hai Fikr Kis Tarah Murde Jhilate Hai Huzoor Ay Mai Fida Laga Kar Ek Thokar Use Bataa Ke Yu'n Baagh Me Shukre Wasl Tha Hijr Me Haay Haay Ghul Kaam Hai Unke Zikr Se Khair Wo Yu'n Hua Ke Yu'n Jo Kahe She'aro Paase Shar'a Dono Ka Husn Kyu'n Kar Aaye La Use Paishe Jalwa E Zam Zame Raza Ke Yu'n

৪৯১

Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah

Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habeeb Allah Nabi Ka Jhanda Lay Kar Niklo Dunia Par Chaa Jawo Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Ya Habib-E-Kibria Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Marhaba Ya Mujtaba Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Badlian Rehmat Ki Chaien Bondiaan Rehmat Ki Ayeen Ab Muradain Dil Paieen Aamad Shah-E-Arab Hay Tajdar-E-Anmbia Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Mursaleen Kay Paishwa Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Tum Bhi Kar Kay Un Ka Charcha Apnay Dil Chamkawo Oonchay Main Ooncha Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Abr-E-Rehmat Cha Gia Hay Kabay Pay Jhanda Gara Hay Bab-E-Rehmat Aaj Wa Hay Aamad-E-Shah-E-Arab Hay Ya Shah-E-Arz-O-Sama Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Sarwaray Har Dosara Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Tum Bhi Kar Kay Un Ka Charcha Apnay Dil Chamkawo Oonchay Main Ooncha Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Aa Gaey Khair-Ul-Wara Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Aaye Shah-E-Anmbia Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Tum Bhi Kar Kay Un Ka Charcha Apnay Dil Chamkawo Oonchay Main Ooncha Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Momino Waqt-E-Adab Hay Aamad-E-Mehboob-E-Rab Hay Jaaye Adab-O-Tarab Hay Aamad Shah-E-Arab Hay Razdar-E-Kibria Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Mazhar-E-Rab-Ul-Ulla Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Amina Kay Dilruba Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Aye Haleema Kay Pia Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Aanay Wala Hay Woh Piara Dono Alam Ka Sahara Kaabay Kay Hajat Rawa Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Aye Mairay Mushkil Kusha Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Tum Bhi Kar Kay Un Ka Charcha Apnay Dil Chamkawo Onchay Main Oncha Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Soyee Qismat Jagg Uthi Aour Sub Ki Bigri Bun Gayee Bab-E-Rehmat Wa Huwa Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Aatay Hee Sajday Main Gir Kar Rabi Habli Ummati Arz Haq Say Kar Dia Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Khoob Jhoomo Aasio Woh Muskaraty Aa Gaaye Shafe Rooz-E-Jaza Ahlann Wa Sahlann Marhaba Tum Bhi Kar Kar Kay Unn Ka Charcha Apnay Dil Chamkawo Oonchay Main Ooncha Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Main Lehrawo Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah -------------------Other Version------------------------ Tum Bhi Kar Key Unka Charcha, Apney Dil Chamkaaow Uchay Mey Ucha Nabi Ka Jhanda Azmat Wala Nabi Ka Jhanda Pyara Pyara Nabi Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Mey Lehraaow Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah Ya Rasool Allah Ke Naare Se Hum Ko Pyaar Hai Hum Ne Ye Naara Lagaya Apna Bera Paar Hai Mai Wo Sunni Hoon Jameel-E-Qadri Marne Ki Baad Mera Lasha Bhi Kahega As Salaatu Was Salaam Rabbi Habli Ummati Kehte Hue Paida Hue Haq Ne Farmaaya Ke Bakhsha As Salaatu Was Salaam But Shikan Aaya Ye Kehkar Sar Ke Bal But Gir Pare Jhoom Kar Kehta Tha Kaba As Salaatu Was Salaam Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah, Ya Habib Allah Nabi Ka Jhanda Le Kar Niklo Dunya Par Cha Jao Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Par Lehrao Pukaro Ya Rasulallah, Ya Habiballah Lab Par Naat Paak Ka Nagma Kal Bhi Tha Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Mere Nabi Se Mera Rishta Kal Bhi Tha Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Nabi Ka Jhanda Ooncha Rahega Naara Ye Hi Lagao Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Par Lehrao Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah, Ya Habiballah Qirya Qirya Basti Basti Zikr Nabi Ka Aam Karo Nabi Ki Azmat Ke Gun Gao Wird Ye Subho Shaam Karo Nabi Ka Jhanda Ooncha Rahega Naara Ye Hi Lagao Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Par Lehrao Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah, Ya Habiballah Rang Barange Jhanday Choro Thaam Lo Gunbad Wala Hum Sab Par Raazi Ho Jayega Piyara Madani Aaqa Iss Jhanday Ke Saye Talay Tum Mil Kar Qadam Barhao Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Par Lehrao Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah, Ya Habiballah Ya Rasool Allah Ke Naaray Se Hum Ko Piyaar Hai Hum Ne Ye Naara Lagaya Apna Bera Paar Hai Khuld Me Hoga Hamara Dhaakla Iss Shaan Se Ya Rasulallah Ka Naara Lagatay Jayenge Pukaro Ya Rasool Allah, Ya Habiballah Sabz Hilali Parcham Yaro Hum Ko Jaan Se Piyara Hai Iss Par Gunbad-E-Khizra Hoga Ye Manshoor Hamara Hai Iss Gunbad Ke Saye Talay Tum Sab Ek Ho Jao Nabi Ka Jhanda Aman Ka Jhanda Ghar Ghar Par Lehrao Pukaro Ya Rasulallah, Ya Habiballah

৪৯২

Pul Se Utaro Raah Guzar Ko Khabar Na Ho

Pul Se Utaaro Raah Guzar Ko Khabar Na Ho Jibreel Par Bichaye To Par Ko Khabar Na Ho Kaanta Mere Jigar Se Ghame Rozgaar Ka Yun Kheench Lijiye Ke Jigar Ko Khabar Na Ho Fariyaad Ummati Jo Kare Haale Zaar Mein Mumkin Nahi Ki Khaire Bashar Ko Khabar Na Ho Kehti Thi Ye Buraaq Se Uski Subuqrawi Yun Jaaiye Ki Garde Safar Ko Khabar Na Ho Farmate Hain Ye Dono Hain Sardare Do Jahaan Aye Murtaza! Ateeqo Umar Ko Khabar Na Ho Aisa Guma De Unki Wila Mein Khuda Humein Dhoonda Kare Par Apni Khabar Ko Khabar Na Ho Aa Dil ! Haram Ko Rokne Waalon Se Chupke Aaj Yoon Uth Chalen Ki Pehluoo Bar Ko Khabar Na Ho Taire Haram Hain Ye Kahi(N) Rishta Bapaa Na Ho Yoon Dekhiye Ki Taare Nazar Ko Khabar Na Ho Aye Khaare Taiba ! Dekh Ki Daaman Na Bheeg Jaaye Yoon Dil Mein Aa Ki Deedaye Tar Ko Khabar Na Ho Aye Shauqe Dil ! Ye Sajda Gar Unko Rawa Nahi Achcha ! Woh Sajda Keeje Ki Sar Ko Khabar Na Ho Unke Siwa Raza Koi Haami Nahi Jahaa(N) Guzra Kare Pisar Pe Pidar Ko Khabar Na Ho

৪৯৩

Purnoor Hai Zamana Subhe Shabe Wiladat

Purnoor Hai Zamana Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Parda Utha Hai Kiska Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Jalwa Hai Haq Ka Jalwa Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Saaya Khuda Ka Saaya Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Fasle Bahaar Aayi Shakle Nigaar Aayi Gulzar Hai Zamana Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Phoolo Se Baagh Mehke, Shakho Pe Murg Chehke Ahde Bahar Aaya Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Dil Jag-Maga Rahe Hai, Qismat Chamak Uthi Hai Faila Naya Ujala Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Aayi Nayi Hukumat Sikka Naya Chalega Aalam Ne Rang Badla Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Ruhul Amee(N) Ne Gaada Kaabe Ki Chat Pe Jhanda Ta-Arsh Uda Pharera Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Padhte Hai Arsh Waale, Sunte Hai Farsh Waale Sultane Nou Ka Khutba Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Din Fir Gaye Hamare, Sote Naseeb Jaage Khursheed Hi Wo Chamka Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Pyare Rabi-Ul Awwal, Teri Jhalak Ke Sadqe Chamka Diya Naseeba Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Noushah Banau Unko, Dulha Banau Unko Hai Arsh Tak Ye Shohra Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Shadi Rachi Hui Hai, Bajte Hai Shadiyane Dulha Bana Wo Dulha Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Hushiyar Ho Bhikari, Nazdeek Hai Suvaari Na Keh Raha Hai Danka Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Aamad Ka Shor Sunkar, Ghar Aate Hai Bhikari Ghere Khade Hai Rasta Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Har Jaan Muntazir Hai, Har Deed Rah-Nigaar Hai Gouga Hai Marhaba Ka Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Teri Chamak Damak Se Aalam Chamak Raha Hai Mere Bhi Bakht Chamka Sub-He Shabe Wiladat Baata Hai Do Jaha(N) Me Tune Ziya Ka Baada De De Hasan Ka Hissa Sub-He Shabe Wiladat

৪৯৪

Pyaari Maa Mujh Ko Teri Dua Chahiye

Pyaari Maa Mujh Ko Teri Dua Chahiye Tere Anchal Ki Thandi Hawaa Chahiye Lori Gaa Gaa Ke Mujh Ko Sulati Hain Tu Muskura Ke Sawere Jagati Hain Tu Mujh Ko Iss Ke Siwa Aur Kya Chahiye Pyaari Maa Mujhko Terii Dua Chahiye Tere Aanchal Ki Thandi Hawaa Chahiye Tere Mumtaa Ke Saaye Main Phoolo Phalo Thaam Ker Teri Ungli Main Badhta Chaloo Aasra Bas Tere Pyar Ka Chahiye Pyari Maa Mujh Ko Teri Dua Chahiye Tere Anchal Ki Thandi Hawa Chahiye Teri Khidmat Se Duniya Main Azmat Meri Tere Pairo Ke Niche Hai Jannat Meri Umar Bhar Sar Pe Sayaa Tera Chahiye Pari Maa Mujh Ko Teri Dua Chahiye Teri Anchal Ki Thandi Hawa Chahiye

৪৯৫

Qadam Qadam Pe Khuda Ki Madad Pohanchti Hai

Qadam Qadam Pe Khuda Ki Madad Pohanchti Hai Durood Se Mere Dil Ko Rasad Pohanchti Hai Ye Aasmaan Bhi Wahan Tak Nahi Pohanch Sakta Jahan Tak Aap K Qadmon Ki Hadd Pohanchti Hai Sir Apna Paaye Risalat Ma’aab Per Rakh Doon To Aasmaan Pe Bulandi-E-Qadd Pohanchti Hai Juloos-E-Ishq-E-Nabi Ka Ho Jis Taraf Se Guzar Mere Junoon Ko Bhi Lay Kar Khirad Pohanchti Hai Durood Ka Dia Jata Hai Jub Sawab Mujhe Bahisht Tak Meri Do Guz Lahad Pohanchti Hai Salaam-O-Naat Muzaffar Yahan Mein Parhta Hoon Qubooliat Ki Haram Se Sanad Pohanchti Hai.

৪৯৬

Qadmoun Mein Bula Leejiye Ya Nabi Madine Mein

Qadmoun Mein Bula Leejiye, Ya Nabi Madine Mein Kaash Mein Challa Jaon, Aaj He Madeenay Mein Samnay Jo Aathi Hai, Muskura Kay Aathi Hai Ehtraam Kerthi Hai, Mauth Bhi Madeenay Mein Dosto Dua Ki Jiye, Pir Mujh Ko Bula Lein Wo Hai Meri Dua, Jaein Aap Sab Madinay Mein Bhejiye Darood Un Par, Bhejiye Salam Un Par Aapni Roz Lagwayeh, Haazri Madinay Mein Ab Meri Nigaon Mein, Har Tharaf Madina Hai Meri Dil Ki Kulthi Hai, Har Gali Madinay Mein Is Kadar Barastha Hai, Noor Sabz Ghumbad Par Raat Ko Bhi Raithi Hai, Roshni Madinay Mein Qadmoun Mein Bula Leejiye Ya Nabi Madeenay Mein Kaash Mein Challa Jaon, Aaj He Madeenay Mein

৪৯৭

Qafile Ne Suye Taiba Kamar Aaraayi Ki

Qafile Ne Suye Taiba Kamar Aaraayi Ki Mushkil Aasaan Ilahi Meri Tanhai Ki Laaj Rakhli Ta-Maye Afw Ke Saudaayi Ki Aye Main Qurbaa(N) Mere Aaqa Badi Aaqaai Ki Farsh Ta Arsh Sab Aaina Zamaair Haazir Bas Qasam Khaaiye Ummi Teri Daanaai Ki Shash Jihat Samte Muqaabil Shabo Roz Ek Hi Haal Dhoom Wannajm Mein Hai Aap Ki Beenaai Ki Paansau (500) Saal Ki Raah Aisi Hi Jaise Do Gaam Aas Hum Ko Bhi Lagi Hai Teri Shinwaai Ki Chand Ishaare Ka Hila Huqm Ka Baandha Sooraj Wah Kya Baat Shaha Teri Tuwaanaai Ki Tang Thehri Hai Raza Jis Ke Liye Wus’ate Arsh Bas Jahag Dil Mein Hai Us Jalwaye Harjaai Ki

৪৯৮

Qareeb E Mustafa Hai Koii Koii

Qareeb E Mustafa Hai Koii Koii Mazay Yay Luutt-Ta He Koii Koii Bashar Samjha Unhayn Laakhon Nay Laykin Haqeeqat E Aashna He Koii Koii Ghaneemat Jaan Jitni Bhi Mili He Kay Mekhaana Khula He Koii Koii Madinay Pohnchtay Hain Yuun To Laakhon Par, Madina Dekhta He Koii Koii Tayray Rozay Ki Noori Jaaliyon Ko Nazar Say Choomta Hai Koi Koi Jise Dekho Wo Dam Bharta Hai Unka Lekin Ba Wafaa Hai Koi Koi

৪৯৯

Qaseeda E Mearaj

Woh Sarwar E Kishwar E Risalat Jo Arsh Per Jalwah Gar Huye Thay Naye Nirale Tarab Kay Saaman Arab Ke Mehman Kay Liye Thay. Bahar Hai Shadiyan Mubarak Chaman Ko Aabadiyan Mubarak Malak Falak Apni Apni Lay Main Yeh Ghar Ana Dil Ka Boltay Thay. Wahan Falak Per Yahan Zameen Main Rachi Thi Shaadi Machi Thi Dhoomein Udhar Say Anwar Hastay Aatay Idhar Say Naf-Haat Ooth Rahay They. Yeh Joot Padti Thi Unkay Rukh Ki Kay Arsh Tak Chandni Thi Chhatki Woh Raat Kya Jagmaga Rahi Thi Jagah Jagah Nasb Aainay They Nayi Dulhan Ki Phaban Main Kaaba Nikhar Kay Sanwara Sanwar Kay Nikhra Hajar Key Sadqay Kamar Key Eik Til Main Rang Lakhoon Banao Key They. Nazar Main Dulha Key Pyaray Jalway Haya Say Mehrab Sir Jhukaye Siyah Parday Kay Moun Per Aanchal Tajaliye Zaat E Bahat Say Thay. Khushi Kay Badal Umand Kay Aaye Diloon Kay Taoos Rang Laye Woh Naghma E Naat Ka Samaan Tha Haram Ko Khud Wajd Aa Rahe Thay Yeh Jhooma Mizab E Zar Ka Jhoomer Kay Aa Raha Kaan Per Dhalak Ker Phuhar Barsi To Moti Jhar Ker Hatim Ki Gaud Mein Bharay They. Dulhan Ki Khushboo Say Mast Kapray Nasim E Gustakh Aanchloon Say Gilaf E Mushkeen Jo Oord Raha Tha Ghazal Naafe Basaa Rahay Thay. Pahadiyoon Ka Woh Husn E Taz'ee Woh Oonchi Choti Woh Nazo Tamqeen Saba Say Sabzah Main Lehrein Aateen Dupattay Dhani Chunay Huye Thay. Naha Kay Nehroon Nay Woh Chamakta Libas Aabay Rawan Ka Pehna Ki Mauj E Chadiyaan Thi Dhaar Lachka Habab E Tabaan Kay Thal Takay Thay. Purana Purdag Malgaja Tha Utha Diya Farsh Chandni Ka Hajoom E Tare Nigah Say Kosoon Qadam Qadam Farsh Baadley Thay. Ghubar Ban Ker Nisaar Jayein Kahan Ab Uss Rah Guzar Ko Payein Hamaray Dil Huriyoon Ki Aankhein Farishtoon Kay Per Jahan Biche Thay. Khuda Hee Day Sabr Jaan E Purgham Dikhaoon Kyun Kar Tujhay Woh A'alam Jab Unko Jhurmat Main Lakay Qudsi Jinaa Ka Dulha Bana Rahay Thay. Utar Ker Unkay Rukh Ka Sadqa Yeh Noor Ka But Raha Tha Bada Kay Chand Suraj Machal Machal Ker Jabeen Ki Khairat Mangtay Thay. Wohi To Ab Tak Chalak Raha Hai Wohi To Joban Tapak Raha Hai Nahanay May Jo Gira Tha Pani Katoray Taroon Nay Bhar Liye Thay. Bacha Jo Talwoon Ka Unkay Dhouwan Bana Woh Jannat Ka Rang O Roghan Jinhoon Nay Dulha Ki Payi Utran Woh Phool Gulzar E Noor Kay Thay. Khabar Yeh Tehweelay Maher Ki Thi Kay Rut Sunhani Ghadi Phiray Gee Wahan Ki Poshak Zay-Bay Tan Ki Yahan Ka Joda Badha Chukay Thay. Tajaliy E Haq Ka Sehra Sar Per Salat O Tasleem Ki Nichawar Do Roya Qudsi Paray Jama Kar Kharhay Salami Kay Waastay Thay. Jo Hum Bhi Waan Hotay Khaq E Gulshan Lipat Kay Qadmoon Say Ley Tay Utran Magar Karein Kiya Naseeb Main To Yeh Namuradi Kay Din Likhay Thay. Abhi Na Aaye Thay Pusht E Zeen Tak Kay Sir Hui Maghfirat Ki Shallak Sada Shafa't Nay Di Mubarak! Gunaah Mastana Jhoomtay Thay. Ajab Na Tha Rakhsh Ka Chamakna Gazal E Dam Khurdasa Bhadakna Shuaein Bukkay Urha Rahi Theen Tadapte Ankhoon Pay Saieqay Thay. Hujum E Umeed Hai Ghatao Muradein Day Kar Inhein Hatao Adab Ki Baagein Liye Badhao Malaika May Yeh Ghal Ghale Thay. Uthi Jo Garde Rahe Munawar Woh Noor Barsa Kay Raaste Bhar Ghiray Thay Badal Bharay Thay Jal Thal Umand Kay Jangle Ubal Rahay Thay. Sitam Kiya Kaisi Mat Kathi Thi Qamar Woh Khak Unkay Rah Guzar Ki Utha Na Laya Kay Miltay Miltay Ye Daagh Sab Dekhte Mite They Burraq Kay Naqshe Sum Kay Sadqe Woh Gul Khilaye Kay Saray Rastey Mehaktay Gulban Mehakte Gulshan Hare Bhare Lahlaha Rahe Thay. Namaz E Aqsa Main Tha Yehi Seer Ayan Houn Ma'ni E Awwal Akhir Key Dast Basta Hain Pichey Hazir Jo Salatanat Aagay Kar Gaye Thay. Yeh Unki Aamad Ka Dab-Daba Tha Nikhar Her Shaiy Ka Ho Raha Tha Nujoom O Aflak Jam O Mina Ujaltay Thay Khangaltey They. Naqab Ultay Woh Mehr E Anwar Jalal O Rukhsar Garmiyoon Per Falak Ko Hebat Say Tap Charhi Thi Tapaktay Anjum Kay Aablay Tha Yeh Joshishe Noor Ka Asar Tha Key Aabay Gohar Qamar Qamar Tha Safaey Rah Say Phisal Phisal Kar Sitare Qadmon Pay Laut'tay Thay. Badha Ye Lehra Kay Behr O Wahdat Key Dhul Gaya Naam E Raige Kasrat Falak Key Teloon Ki Kiya Haqeeqat Yeh Arsh O Kursi Do Bulbule Thay. Woh Zill E Rehmat Woh Rukh Key Jalwe Ke Taare Chupte Na Khilne Paate Sunehri Zarbaft Udi Atlas Yeh Than Sab Dhoop Chaoon Ke The. Chala Woh Serve E Chamaan Kharamaa Na Ruk Saka Sidra Say Damaan Palak Jhapakti Rahi Woh Kab Kay Sab Aeno Aan Say Guzar Chuke Thay. Jhalak See Eik Qudsiyoon Per Aayi Hawwaa Bhi Daman Ki Phir Na Payi Sawari Dulha Ki Dur Pohnchi Barat Main Hosh Hi Gaye Thay. Thakay Thay Ruhul Amin Key Bazu Chuta Woh Daman Kahan Woh Pehloo Rikab Chooti Ummeed Tuti Nigah E Hasrat Key Walwaley Thay. Ravish Ki Garmi Ko Jis Ney Socha Dimag Say Eik Bhabuka Phoota Khirad Key Jungle Main Phool Chumka Dahar Dahar Ped Jal Rahe Thay. Jiloo Main Jo Murgay A'qal Uray Thay Ajab Booray Haloon Girtay Partay Woh Sidrah Hee Per'rahay Thay Thak Kar Charha Dam Tewar Aa Gaye Thay. Qavi They Nurgan E Waham Kay Per Uray To Urdnay Ko Aur Dam Bhar Utha'ee Seenay Ki Aisi Thokar Kay Khoonay Andesha Th'oo'ktay Thay. Suna Yeh Itnay Mein Arsh E Haq Nay Kay Lay Mubarak Ho Taaj Waley Wohi Qadam Khair Say Phir Aaye Jo Pehle Taaj E Sharaaf Tere Thay. Yeh Sunkay Bay Khud Pukar Utha Nisar Jaoon Kahan Hain Aaqa Phir Unkay Talwoon Ka Paoon Bosa Yeh Meri Aankhon Kay Din Phire Thay. Jhuka Tha Mujre Ko Arsh E Aala Gire They Sajde May Bazme Bala Yeh Aankhein Qadmoon Say Mal Raha Tha Woh Girde Qurbaan Ho Rahay Thay Ziyaein Kuch Arsh Per Yeh Aaein Kay Sari Qindileen Jhilmilayeen Huzoor E Khurshid Kya Chamaktay Chairagh Moun Apna Dekh Tay Thay. Yehi Sam'an Tha Kay Paikay Rehmat Khabar Yeh Laya Kay Chaliye Hazrat Tumhari Khatir Kushada Hain Woh Jo Kalim Per Band Rastaay Thay. Badh Ay Muhammad Qaree Ho Ahmed Qareeb Aa Sarwar E Mumajjad Nisar Jaoon Yeh Kiya Nida Thi Yeh Kiya Samaan Tha Yeh Kiya Mazay Thay. Tabarakallah Shan Teri Tujhi Ko Zaiba Hai Bay Niyazi Kahin To Woh Josh E Lan-Tarani Kaheen Takazay Visal Kay Thay. Khirad Say Keh Do Kay Sir Jhuka Le Gumaan Say Guzray Guzarnay Walay Pare Hain Yahan Khud Jaihat Ko Laalay Kisay Bataye Kidhar Gaye Thay. Surag Aino Mataa Kahaan Tha Nishan E Kaifo Illa Kahan Tha. Na Koi Rahi Na Koi Sathi Naa Sang E Manzil Naa Merhalay Thay. Udar Say Payham Taqazay Aana Idhar Say Mushkil Qadam Barhana Jalal O Haibat Ka Saamna Tha Jamalo Rehmat Ubhartay Thay. Barhay To Lekin Jhee-Jhaktay Dartay Haya Say Jhuktay Adab Say Ruktay Jo Qurb Unhi Ki Ravish Pay Rakhtay To Lakhoon Manzil Kay Fasilay Thay Per Unka Barhna To Naam Ko Tha Haqeeq'tan Fail Tha Udhar Ka Tanazuloon Mein Taraki Afza Dana Tadalla Key Silsilay Thay. Hua Yeh Aakhir Kay Aik Bajra Tamojay Bahrey Hoo Mein Ubhra Dana Ki Godi Mein Unko Lekar Fana Kay Langar Utha Diye Thay. Kisay Milay Ghat Ka Kinara Kither Say Guzra Kahan Utra Bhara Jo Misle Nazar Tarara Woh Apni Aankhoon Say Khud Chupay Thay. Uthay Jo Qasray Dana Kay Parde Koi Khabar Dey To Kiya Khabar Day Wahan To Ja Hee Nahin Duee Ki Na Keh Kay Woh Bhi Na Thay Aray Thay. Woh Baag Kuch Aisa Rang Laya Kay Guncha O Gul Ka Faraq Uthaya Girah Mein Kal'liyoon Ki Baag Phoolay Guloon Kay Takmay Lagay Huay Thay Muhito Markaz Mein Faraq Mushkil Rahe Na Faasil Khutoot E Wasil Kamaan E Hairat Mein Sir Jhukaye Ajeeb Chakar Mein Da'eray Thay. Hijab Uhnay Mein Lakhoon Parde Har Aik Parday Main Lakhon Jalway Ajab Ghari Thi Kay Waslo Furqat Janam Kay Bichray Galay Milay Thay. Zabanein Sukhi Dikha Kay Mojein Tarap Rahi Thien Kay Pani Paein Bhanwar Ko Yeh Zofay Tashnagi That Kay Halqay Aankhoon Mein Par Gaye Thay. Wohi Hai Awwal Wohi Hai Aakhir Wohi Hai Batin Wohi Hai Zahir Usi Kay Jalway Usi Say Milnay Usi Say Uski Taraf Gaye Thay. Kaman E Imakan Kay Jhutay Nukto Tum Awwal Akhir Ki Phair Mein Ho Muhit Ki Chal Say To Pucho Kidhar Say Aaye Kidhar Gaye Thay. Udhar Say Theen Nazray Shah Namaz'ain Idhar Say Inaam E Khusravi Mein Salam O Rehmat Kay Haar Gundh Ker Glue E Pur Noor Mein Paray Thay. Zabaan Ko Intezar Guftan To Gos Ko Hasrat E Shunidan Yahan Jo Kehna Tha Keh Liya Tha Jo Baat Sun'ni Thi Sun Chukay Thay. Woh Burj E Batha Ka Mahpara Bahishat Ki Sair Ko Sidhara Chamak Pay Tha Khuld Ka Sitara Kay Iss Qamar Kay Qadam Gaye Thay. Suroor E Maqdam Ki Roshni Thi Kay Tabishoon Say Mah E Arab Ki Jina Kay Gulshan Thay Jhaar Farshi Jo Phool Thay Sab Kanwal Banay Thay. Tarab Ki Nazish Kay Haan Lachakiye Adab Woh Bandish Kay Hill Na Sakiye Yeh Josh E Ziden Tha Keh Poday Kasha Kish E Arah Kay Talay Thay. Khuda Ki Qudrat Keh Chand Haq Kay Karoroon Manzil Mein Jalwa Kar Kay Abhi Na Taroon Ki Chaoon Badli Keh Noor Kay Tarkay Aa Liye Thay. Nabi E Rehmat Shafi E Ummat Raza Pay Lillah Ho Inayat Isay Bhi Unn Khal'atoon Say Hisa Jo Khas Rehmat Kay Waan Bate Thay Sana E Sarkar Hai Wazifa Qabool E Sarkar Hai Taman'na Na Shayari Ki Hawas Na Muhammad Pyare Bane Hein Dulha

৫০০

Qaseedah E Noor

Subha Taibah Me Hui Bat'ta Hain Baada Noor Ka Sadqa Lene Noor Ka Aaya Hain Taara Noor Ka Baaghe Taibah Me Suhana Phool Phoola Noor Ka Mast Bu Hain Bul Buley Padhti Hain Kalmah Noor Ka Baarhvi Ke Chaand Ka Mujra Hai Sajdah Noor Ka Baarah Burjo Se Jhuka Ik Ik Sitara Noor Ka Unke Kasre Kadr Se Khuld Ek Kamra Noor Ka Sidra Paayi Baagh Me Nanha Sa Pauda Noor Ka Arsh Bhi Firdaus Bhi Us Shahe Waala Noor Ka Yeh Musagman Burj Wo Muskuye A'ala Noor Ka Aayi Bida'at Chayi Zulmat Rang Badla Noor Ka Maahe Sunnat Mehre Tala'at Le Le Badla Noor Ka Tere Hi Maathe Raha Ay Jaan Sehra Noor Ka Bakht Jaaga Noor Ka Chamka Sitara Noor Ka Main Gada Tu Baadshah Bharde Piyala Noor Ka Noor Din Duna Tera De Daal Sadqa Noor Ka Teri Hi Jaanib Hai Paanchi Waqt Sajdah Noor Ka Rukh Hain Qibla Noor Ka Abru Hai Qa'aba Noor Ka Pusht Par Dhalka Sar-E-Anwar Se Shimla Noor Ka, Dekhein Moosa Tur Se Utra Sahifah Noor Ka Pech Karta Hai Fida Hone Ko Lamha Noor Ka, Gird-E Sar Phirne Ko Banta Hai Imamah Noor Ka Kya Bana Naam-E Khuda Asra Ka Dulha Noor Ka, Sar Pe Sehra Noor Ka Bur Main Shahana Noor Ka Wasf-E Rukh Main Gati Hain Hoorein Tarana Noor Ka, Qudrati Binau Mai Bajta Hai Lehra Noor Ka Taaj Waale Dekh Kar Tera Imama Noor Ka Sar Jhukate Hai Ilahi Bol Baala Noor Ka Sham'a Dil Mishkaat Tan Seena Zujaja Noor Ka Teri Surat Ke Liye Aaya Hain Sura Noor Ka Tere Aage Khaaq Par Jhukta Hai Maatha Noor Ka Noor Ne Paaya Tere Sajde Se Seema Noor Ka Tu Hain Saaya Noor Ka Har Azwa Tukda Noor Ka Saaye Ka Na Saaya Hota Hain Na Saaya Noor Ka Kya Bana Naame Khuda Asra Ka Dulha Noor Ka Sar Pe Sehra Noor Ka Bar Me Shahana Noor Ka Naariyon Ka Daur Tha Dil Jal Raha Tha Noor Ka (Ay Umar)tumko Dekha Ho Gaya Thanda Kaleja Noor Ka Jo Gada Dekho Liye Jaata Hai Toda Noor Ka Noor Ki Sarkaar Hai Kya Isme Toda Noor Ka Bheek Le Sarkaar Se La Jald Kaasa Noor Ka Maahe Nau Taiba Me Bat'ta Hai Mahina Noor Ka Teri Nasl-E-Paak Me Hain Bachha Bachha Noor Ka Tu Hain Aine Noor Tera Sab Gharana Noor Ka Noor Ki Sarkaar Se Paaya Do-Shala Noor Ka Ho Mubarak Tumko Zunnurain Joda Noor Ka Tab Mehr Hashr Se Chaunke Na Kushtah Noor Ka, Bhundiya Rehmat Ki Dene Ayei Chinta Noor Ka Tab-E Sum Se Chaundhiya Kar Chand Unhee Qadmo Phira, Hans Ke Bijli Ne Kaha Dekha Chalawa Noor Ka Aankh Mil Sakti Nahi Dar Par Hai Pehra Noor Ka Taab Hain Be-Hukm Par Maare Parinda Noor Ka Chaand Jhuk Jaata Jidhar Ungli Utha De Mahd Me Kya Hi Chalta Tha Isharo Par Khilona Noor Ka Ek Seene Tak Mushabeh, Ik Wahan Se Pa'oon Tak, Husn-E Sibtayn Unke Jamaun Main Hai Nima Noor Ka Kaaf Gesu Haa Dahan Ya Abru Aankhein Ain Swaad Kaaf Haa Ya Ain Swaad Unka Hain Chehra Noor Ka Ay Raza Ye Ahmed E Noori Ka Faize Noor Hain Ho Gayi Meri Ghazal Badh Kar Qaseedah Noor Ka

৫০১

Qismat Meri Chamkaayi Hai Aaqa Ne Bulaakar

Qismat Meri Chamkaayi Hai Aaqa Ne Bulaakar Jholi Bhi Meri Bhardi He Data Ne Bulaakar Bey Misl Sakhi Tum Ho To Main Adnaa Bhikaari Hasnain Ka Sadqa Do Mujhe Dar Pe Bithaa Kar Hai Aarzoo Itni Ke Rahoon Dar Ka Hee Mangtaa Rakhna Mere Aaqa Mujhe Apnaa Hee Banaa Kar Apni Hi Nigaahon Ki Nigehbaani Me Rakhna Iss Bekas O Majboor Ko A’daa Se Bachaa Kar Keh Dijye Shaamil Hai Gulaamon Me Tu Shakir Baitha Hoon Main Chowkhat Pe Yehi Aas Lagaa Kar ‘jaaooka’ Sunaa Mai Ne Chala Aaya Main Aaqa Kar Dijye Bakhshish Ki Du’a Lab Ko Hilaa Kar Jub Hashr Me Shakir Ho Pareshaan To Maula Rakh Lena Use Apne Hi Daaman Me Chupaa Kar

৫০২

Qurbaan Me Unki Bakhshish Ke

Qurbaan Me Unki Bakhshish Ke Maqsad Bhi Zabaan Pe Aaya Nahi Bin Maange Diya Aur Itna Diya Daaman Me Humaare Samaaya Nahi Imaan Mila Un Ke Sadqe Quraan Mila Un Ke Sadqe Rahmaan Mila Un Ke Sadqe Wo Kya Hain Jo Hum Ne Paaya Nahi Dil Bar Gaye Mangto Ke Lekin Dene Se Teri Neeyat Na Bari Jo Aaya Usse Bar Bar Ke Diya Mahroom Koi Lotaaya Nahi Un Ka Tho Shiaar Kareemi Hain Ma’il Ba Karam Hi Rehte Hain Mangto Ki Hamesha Laaj Rakhi Mahroom Kabhi Lotaaya Nahi Khursheed E Qayaamat Ki Taabish Maana Ke Qayaamat Hi Hogi Hum Unke Hain Ghabraaye Kyun Kya Hum Pe Nabi Ka Saaya Nahi Us Mohsin E Azam Ke To Khalid Pe Hazaaro Ehsaan Hain Qurbaan Maghar Is Ehsaan Ke Ehsaan Bhi Kiya To Jataya Nahi Aawaaz Karam Deta Hi Raha, Thak Haar Gaye Lene Waale Mangto Ki Hameshaah Laaj Rakhi, Mehroom Kabhi Lautaaya Nahi Wo Rehmat Kaisi Rehmat Hai Mafhoom Samjh Lo Rehmat Ka Usko Bhi Gale Se Lagaya Hai Jise Apna Kisi Ne Banaya Nahi Main Ap Kahun Rakh Lije Bharam Lillah Karam Lillah Karam Tawan E Amal Mein Neki Ka Sarkar Koi Sarmaya Nahi

৫০৪

Raahe Irfaa(N) Se Jo Hum Nadeeda Ru Mahram Nahi Mustafa Hai Masnade Irshad Par Kuch Gham Nahi Hoon Musalma Garche Naakis Hi Sahi Aye Kaamilo Maahiyat Paani Ki Aakhir Yam Se Nam Mein Kam Nahi Gunche Maa Auha Ke Jo Chatke Danaa Ke Baagh Mein Bulbule Sidra Tak Unki Boo Se Bhi Mahram Nahi Usme Zamzam Hai Ke Tham Tham Is Mein Jam Jam Hai Ke Besh Kasrate Kausar Mein Zam Zam Ki Tarah Kam Kam Nahi Panjaye Mehre Arab Hai Jis Se Dariya Beh Gaye Chashmaye Khursheed Mein To Naam Ko Bhi Nam Nahi Aisa Ummi Kis Liye Minnate Kashe Ustaad Ho Kya Qifaayat Usko 'qra Rabbukal Akram' Nahi Ous Mehre Hashr Par Pad Jaaye Pyaaso To Sahi Us Gule Khanda Ka Rona Girya E Shabnam Nahi Hai Unhi Ke Dam Qadam Ke Baaghe Aalam Mein Bahar Woh Na The Aalam Na Tha Gar Woh Na Ho Aalam Nahi Saaya E Deewaro Khaake Dar Ho Ya Rab Aur Raza Khwahishe Daiheeme Qaisar, Shauqe Takhte Jam Nahi

৫০৫

Raaste Saaf Batate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain

Raaste Saaf Batate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain Hum To Mehfil Ko Sajate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain. Ahl-E-Dil Geet Ye Gate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain Aankh Raahon Mein Bichaate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain. Unki Aamad Ke Payami Hain Saba Ke Jhonke Phool Shakhoon Ko Hilaate Hain Ke Aap Aate Hain. Unke Jalwon Se Nikharne Lagi Dil Ki Raunaq Meri Taqdeer Jagaate Hein Ke Aap Aate Hein. Marhaba Salle Ala Ki Hain Sadayein Har Soo Yaume Milad Manaate Hein Ke Aap Aate Hein. Chand Taaron Mein Nasir Aaj Badi Hal Chal Hai Hum Ko Aasar Batate Hein Ke Aap Aate Hain.

৫০৬

Raate Bhi Madine Ki Baate Bhi Madine Ki

Raate Bhi Madina Kee Baate Bhi Madina Kee Jeena May Yah Jeena Hai Kiya Baat Hai Jeena Ki Arsa Hua Taiba Ki Galiyoun Say Ya Guzra Hai Is Waqt Bhi Galiyoun May Khushbu Hai Paseena Ki May Madina Ki Galiyoun Pay Qurban Jinsa Juzra Hai Shah-E-Madina Is Tarha Say Mekhta Hai Rasta Eatr Jaisa Lagay Hua Hai Arsa Hua Taiba Ki Galiyoun Say Ya Guzra Hai Is Waqt Bhi Galiyoun May Khushbu Hai Paseena Ki Kiya Mahakta Ta Hai Mahakna Wala Kay Bu Pay Chalta Hai Bhatkna Wala Ambar Zami Abeer Hawa Musktar Gubar Adna Ki Shankt Tera Rah Guzar Ki Hai Arsa Hua Taiba Ki Galiyoun Say Ya Guzra Hai Is Waqt Bhi Galiyoun May Khushbu Hai Paseena Ki Wallah Jo Miljaya Mera Gul Ka Paseena Manga Na Kabhi Eatr Na Phir Chaya Dulan Phool Arsa Hua Taiba Ki Galiyoun Say Ya Guzra Hai Is Waqt Bhi Galiyoun May Khushbu Hai Paseena Ki Yah Zakam Hai Taiba Ka Yah Sabko Nahi Milta Koshish Na Kare Koi Is Zakam Ko Seena Ki Yah Apni Nigaho Say Mastana Banata Hai Mastana Banata Hai Deewana Banata Hai Zahmat Hi Nahi Dayta Mahkar Ko Peena Ki Har Saal Madina May Mirza Ko Bulata Hai Sarkar Jagata Hai Takdeer Kamina Ki

৫০৭

Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ka Mahina

Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ka Mahina Jismani O Rohani Ibaadat Ka Mahina. Ramzan Hai Islam Ki Azmat Ki Nishani Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ki Nishani Roze Ka Silah Deta Hai Khud Khaliqe Akbar Saaim Ke Liye Roza Hai Jannat Ki Nishani Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ka Mahina Jismani O Rohani Ibaadat Ka Mahina. Ho Jaata Hai Shaitan Bhi Pabande Salaasil Hai Jurm O Khata Se Ye Baraa’at Ki Nishani Ik Khaas Sila Milta Hai Har Achche Amal Ka Ye Maah Hai Rehman Ki Rehmat Ki Nishani. Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ka Mahina Jismani O Rohani Ibaadat Ka Mahina. Ik Raat Ke Hai Baraah Mahinon Se Bhi Afzal Yani Hai Shabe Qadr Bhi Azmat Ki Nishani Ho Jaati Hai Paida Dile Muslim Mein Akhuwat Ramzan To Hai Mehro Muhabbat Ki Nishani. Ramzan Hai Allah Ki Qurbat Ka Mahina Jismani O Rohani Ibaadat Ka Mahina.

৫২০

Rubaaiyaat By Aala Hazrat

Aate Rahe Ambiya 'kama-Qeela- Lahum' 'wal Khaatamu Haqqu Kum' Ki Khaatim Huye Tum Ya'ni Jo Hua Daftare Tanzeel Tamaam Aakhir Mein Hui Mohr Ki 'akmaltu Lakum' Shab Lihya Wa Shaarib Hai Rukhe Roshan Din Gesu Wa Shabe Qadro Baraate Momin Mizgaa(N) Ki Safe Chaar Hain Do Abroo Hain 'wal Fajr' Ke Pehlu Mein 'layalin Ashr' Allah Ki Sarta Ba Qadam Shaan Hain Yeh Insa Nahi(N) Insaan Woh Insaan Hain Yeh Qur'an To Imaan Batata Hai Inhe Imaan Yeh Kehta Hai Meri Jaan Hain Yeh Bosa Gahe Ashaab Woh Mehre Saami Woh Shaanaye Chap Mein Us Ki Ambar Faami Yeh Turfa Ki Hai Kaaba E Jaano Dil Mein Sange Aswad Naseeb Rukne Shaami Kaabe Se Agar Turbate Shah Faazil Hai Kyun Baayi Taraf Uske Liye Manzil Hai Is Fikr Mein Jo Dil Ki Taraf Dhyaan Gaya Samjha Ki Woh Jism Hai Yeh Markade Dil Tum Jo Chaaho To Qismat Ki Musibat Tal Jaaye Kyun Kar Kahoon Saa'at Se Qayaamat Tal Jaaye Lillah Utha Do Rukhe Raushan Se Naqaab Maula Meri Aayi Hui Shaamat Tal Jaaye Yaa(N), Shuba Shabeeh Ka Guzarna Kaisa Be Misl Ki Timsaal Sanwarna Kaisa In Ka Mu-Taalliq Hai Taraqqi Pe Mudaam Tasveer Ka Phir Kahiye Utarna Kaisa Yeh Shah Ki Tawaazo' Ka Taqaazaa Hi Nahi Tasveer Kheence Unko Ganwaara Hi Nahi Maa'naa Hain Yeh Maani Ki Karam Kya Maane Kheencha To Yaha Kisi Se Thehra Hi Nahi

৫২১

Rukh Din Hai Ya Mehre Samaa

Rukh Din Hai Ya Mehre Samaa, Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Shab Zulf Ya Mushke Khuta, Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Mumkin Me Ye Qudrat Kaha, Waajib Me Abdiyat Kaha Haira(N) Hu Ye Bhi Hai Khata, Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Haq Ye Ki Hai Abde Ilah Aur Aalam E Imkaa(N) Ke Shah Barzakh Hai Wo Sirre Khuda, Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Bulbul Ne Ghul Unko Kaha, Kumree Ne Sarve Jaanfiza Hairat Ne Jhunjhla Kar Kaha Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Khursheed Tha Kis Zour Par Kya Badh Ke Chamka Tha Qamar Be-Parda Jab Wo Rukh Hua Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Dar Tha Ki Isyaa(N) Ki Saza Ab Hogi Ya Rouze Jaza Dee Unki Rehmat Ne Sadaa Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Koyi Hai Naazo Zuhad Par Ya Husne Tauba Hai Sipar Yaa(N) Hai Faqat Teri Ataa Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Din Lahv Me Khona Tujhe, Shab Subha Tak Sona Tujhe Sharme Nabi Khaufe Khuda Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Rizq E Khuda Khaya Kiya, Farmaan E Haq Taala Kiya Shukre Karam Tarse Saza Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi Hai Bulbule Rangi Raza Ya Tutiye Nagma Saraa Haq Yeh Ki Wasif Hai Tera Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi

৫২২

Rukh E Mustafa Ko Dekha

Rukh E Mustafa Ko Dekha To Diyon Ne Jalna Seekha Yeh Karam Hai Mustafa Ka Shab E Gham Ne Dhalna Seekha Yeh Zameen Ruki Hui Thi Yeh Falak Thama Hua Tha Chale Jab Mere Muhammad To Jahan Ne Chalna Seekha Bara Khush Naseeb Hoon Main Meri Khush Naseebi Hay Daikho Shah-E-Anbiya Kay Tukrhoon Pe Hay Main Palna Sekha Man Gira Nahin Jo Ab Tak Ye Kamal-E-Mustafa Hay Meri Zaat Nay Nabi Say Hay Sadaa Sanbhalna Sekha Mera Dil Barha Hi Bay Has Tha Kabhi Nahi Ye Tarhpa Suni Naat Jab Nabi Ki To Ye Dil Machlna Sekha Main Talash Main Tha Rabb Ki Kahan Dhoondhta Main Us Ko Lia Naam Jab Nabi Ka To Kuda Say Milna Sekha Man Raha Khalash Muzafar Darr-E-Pak Mustafa Par Meri Jazzb-E-Aashiqi Nay Kahan Ghar Badalna Sekha ----------------- More Stanzas ----------------- Kis Ne Zarron Ko Uthaya Aur Sahra Kar Diya Kis Ne Qatron Ko Milaya Ayr Darya Kar Diya Kis Ki Hiqmat Ne Yateemon Ko Kiya Durre Yateem Aur Ghulamon Ko Zamane Bhar Ka Maula Kar Diya Admiat Ka Gahraz Saama Muhayya Kar Diya Ik Arab Ne Aadmi Ka Bol Bala Kar Diya Chale Jab Mere Muhammad To Jahan Ne Chalna Seekha Bara Khush Naseeb Hoon Main, Meri Khush Naseebi Dekho Barri Kam Seeni Se Main Ne Hai Yeh Naat Parhna Seekha Apni Bakhshish Apni Bhalai Ka Samaan Nikala Hai Main To Nabi Ke Gun Gata Hoon Jab Se Hosh Sambhala Hai Bachpan Mein Pehle Din Se Nabi Ka Liya Tha Naam Us Din Se Aaj Tak Mere Munh Mein Mithaas Hai Barri Kamseeni Se Main Ne Hai Yeh Naat Parhna Seekha Main Raha Khalish Muzaffar Dar E Paak E Mustafa Par Mere Jazb E Aashiqi Ne Kahan Ghar Badalna Seekha Aa Ke Baitha To Na Uththa Woh Teri Mehfil Se Phir Kahin Yaar Tera Chahne Wala Na Gaya Mere Jazb E Aashiqi Ne Kahan Ghar Badalna Seekha

৫২৩

Rukh Pe Rehmat Ka Jhoomar Sajaaye

Rukh Pe Rehmat Ka Jhoomar Sajaaye Kamli Waale Ki Mehfil Saji Hai Mujh Ko Mehsoos Yoon Ho Raha Hai Un Ki Mehfil Mein Jalwa Gari Hai Naat Husne Shahe Do Saraa Hai Naat Hi Zikre Rabbe Jali Hai Naat Likhna Meri Zindagi Hai Naat Kehna Meri Bandagi Hai Mufliso Tum Agar Chahte Ho Ho Ziyaarat Dare Mustafa Ki Dil Ki Jaanib Nigaahen Jhukaa Lo Saamne Mustafa Ki Gali Hai Mujh Jo Fikre Shafaa’at Ho Kyun Kar Do Kareemon Ka Saaya Hai Sar Par Ik Taraf Rehmate Mustafa Hai Ik Taraf Lutfe Rabbe Ula Hai Woh Samaa Kaisa Zeeshan Hoga Jab Khuda Mustafa Se Kahega Ab To Sajde Se Sar Ko Uthaa Le Aap Ki Saari Ummat Baree Hai

৫২৪

Rusul Unhi Ka To Muzdah Sunane Aaye Hai

Rusul Unhi Ka To Muzdah Sunane Aaye Hai Unhi Ke Aane Ki Khushiya Manane Aaye Hai Firishte Aaj Jo Dhume Machane Aaye Hai Unhi Ke Aane Ki Shadi Rachane Aaye Hai Falak Ke Hur O Malak Geet Gaane Aaye Hai Ki Do Jahan Me Ye Danke Bajane Aaye Hai Yeh Sidha Raasta Haq Ka Batane Aaye Hai Yeh Haq Ke Bando Ko Haq Se Milane Aaye Hai Ye Bhoole Bichdo Ko Raste Pe Laane Aaye Hai Ye Bhoole Bhatko Ko Hadi Banane Aaye Hai Khuda E Paak Ke Jalwe Dikhane Aaye Hai Dilo Ko Noor Ke Buqqe Banane Aaye Hai Ye Qaid O Bande Alam Se Churane Aaye Hai Lo Mujdaron Ki Rihai Dilane Aaye Hai Chamak Se Apni Jahan Jagmagane Aaye Hai Mahak Se Apni Ye Kunche Basane Aaye Hai Naseem E Faiz Se Gunche Khilane Aaye Hai Karam Ki Apni Bahaare Dikhane Aaye Hai Yahi To Sote Huwo Ko Jagane Aaye Hai Yahi To Rote Huwo Ko Hasane Aaye Hai Ye Kufr O Shirk Ki Neeve Hilane Aaye Hai Ye Shirk O Kufr Ki Tameere Dhaane Aaye Hai Hazaar Saal Ki Raushan Shuda Bujhi Aatishe Ye Kufr O Shirk Ki Aatish Bujhane Aaye Hai Sahar Ko Noor Jo Chamka To Shaam Tak Chamka Bata Diya Ke Jahaan Jag Magaane Aaye Hai Unhe Khuda Ne Kiya Apne Milk Ka Maalik Unhi Ke Qabze Me Rabb Ke Khazane Aaye Hai Jo Chahenge Jise Chahenge Ye Use Denge Kareem Hai Ye Khazane Lutane Aaye Hai Jo Gir Rahe The Unhe Naibo Thaam Liya Jo Gir Chuke Hai Ye Unhe Uthane Aaye Hai Maseeh E Paak Ne Ajsa Me Murda Zinda Kiye Ye Jaan E Jaan Dil O Jaan Ko Jilane Aaye Hai Bulawa Aap Ka Ab Tak Diya Kiye Naaib Ab Aap Bando Ko Apne Bulane Aaye Hai Kitabe Hazrate Moosa Me Wasf Hai Unke Kitabe Isa Me Unke Fasane Aaye Hai Unhi Ki Naat Ke Nagme Zaboor Se Sunlo Zabane Qur’an Pe Unke Tarane Aaye Hai Sabhi Rasool Ne Kaha Iz Habu Ila Gairi Ana Laha Ka Ye Muzda Sunane Aaye Hai Rauf Aise Hai Ye Aur Raheem Hai Itne Ki Girte Padto Ko Seene Lagane Aaye Hai Sunoge 'la' Na Zabaan E Kareem Se Noori Ye Faiz O Jood Ke Dariya Bahane Aaye Hai Naseeb Tera Chamak Utha Dekh To Noori Arab Ke Chand Lahad Ke Sirhane Aaye Hai

৫২৫

Saara Jahaan Hai Noor Mein Dooba Saari Fiza Hai Raushan Raushan

Saara Jahaan Hai Noor Mein Dooba Saari Fiza Hai Raushan Raushan Kamli Waale Ki Aamad Par ‘kohe Safa’ Hai Raushan Raushan Aamina Ke Hujre Ki Jaanib Taare Sajda Rez Hai Saare Wadi E Makka Ka Har Zarra Aur Hawa Hai Raushan Raushan Liye Durood Salaam Ke Gajre Hoorein Naate Padhti Aayi Har Ek Cheez Ko Noore Nabi Ne Khoob Kiya Hai Raushan Raushan Shab Ko Chand Subah Ko Suraj Raushni De Kar Chup Jaate Hai Aamina Ka Khursheed O Qamar Par Subh O Masaa Hai Raushan Raushan Padha Salaam, Qayaam Mein Humne Isse Pehle Paak Nabi Par Arsh Ke Jaanib Jaane Wali Apni Dua Hai Raushan Raushan Hum Duniya Ke Andhe Dastooron Mein Kyun Hai Khoye Phirte Jab Sarkaar Ne Qur’ani Dastoor Diya Hai Raushan Raushan Noor Se Unke Wadi Wadi Chamak Rahi Hai Damak Rahi Hai Jable Noor Hai Raushan Raushan Gaare Hira Hai Raushan Raushan Saaim Noor Ki Bazm Saji Hai Noor Ki Chaadar Paak Tani Hai Jo Bhi Aap Ki Bazm Mein Aaya Ho Ke Raha Hai Raushan Raushan

৫২৬

Sab Ke Sab Loh O Qalam Hain Lab Kusha Tere Liye

Sab Ke Sab Loh-O-Qalam Hain Lab Kusha Tere Liye Chand Ki Qindeel Sooraj Ka Diya Tere Liye Kiya Shab-E-Meraj Istiqbal Khaliq Ne Kiya Kona Kona Aasmanon Ka Saja Tere Liye Chand Do Tukre Kiya Baik Janbish Angush Se Chand Sheeshe Se Ziada Kuch Na Tha Tere Liye Hum To Ajiz Hain Teri Midhat Se Aae Mamhoh-E-Rab Khud Sarapa Naat Hia Tera Khuda Tere Liye Rang,khushboo,chandni,barsaat Badal Sab Tere Khak Per Yeh Farsh Sabze Ka Bicha Tere Liye Hamid-O-Mahmood-O-Ahmad Majid-O-Amjad Hai Tu Ha Karan Taaba Karan Yeh Silsila Tere Liye Un Ki Had Hai Tur-E-Sina Tu Hadoon Se Mawara Manzil Kosin Tu Hai Ibtida Tere Liye

৫২৭

Sabse Aula Wo Aala Hamara Nabi

Sabse Aula Wo A'ala Hamara Nabi Sabse Baala Wo Waala Hamara Nabi Apne Maula Ka Pyara Hamara Nabi Dono A'alam Ka Dulha Hamara Nabi Bazme Aakhir Ka Shamae Faraouza Hua Noor-E-Awwal Ka Jalwah Hamara Nabi Bujh Gayi Jiske Aage Sabhi Mashaley Shama'a Woh Le Kar Aaya Hamara Nabi Jiske Talwon Ka Dhovan Hai Aabe Hayaat Hain Wo Jaane Maseeha Hamara Nabi Khalq Se Auliyah, Auliyah Se Rasool, Aur Rasoolon Se A'ala Hamara Nabi Husn Khaata Hain Jinke Namak Ki Qasam Woh Maleehe Dilaara Hamara Hamara Nabi Zikr Sab Pheeke Jab Tak Na Mazkur Ho Namakeen Husn Waala Hamara Nabi Jiski Do Boond Hain Kausaer O Salsabeel Hain Wo Rehmat Ka Dariya Hamara Nabi Jaise Sab Ka Khuda Aik Hai Waise Hi, Inka Unka Tumhara Hamara Nabi Karno Badli Rasoolo Ki Hoti Rahi Chaand Badli Ka Nikla Hamara Nabi Kaun Deeta Hain ৫২৮

Sachi Baat Sikhatay Ye Hain

Sachi Baat Sikhatay Ye Hain Seedhi Raah Chalatay Ye Hain Naz-E-Rooh Mein Aasani Dain Kalma Yaad Dilatay Ye Hain Marqad Mein Bandon Ko Thpak Kar Meethi Neend Sulaatay Ye Hain Qasr-E-Dana Tak Kis Ki ৫২৯

Sahab E Rehmat E Baari Hai Barahvi Tareekh

Sahab E Rehmat E Baari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Karam Ka Chashma E Jaari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Hame To Jaan Se Pyari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Aduu Ke Dil Ko Katari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Isi Ne Mousame Gil Ko Kiya Hai Mousame Ghul Bahar E Fazl E Bahari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Falak Pe Arshe Baree Ka Ghuman Hota Hai Zameen E Khuld Ki Kyari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Tamaam Ho Gayi Meelad E Ambiya Ki Khushi Hamesha Ab Teri Baari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Khuda Ke Fazl Se Imaan Me Hai Hum Poore Ke Apni Rooh Me Saari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Wiladat E Shahedee Har Khushi Ki Ba-Is Hai Hazaar Eid Se Bhaari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Hamesha Tune Ghulamo Ke Dil Kiye Thande Jale Jo Tujhse Wo Naari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Aduu Wiladat E Shaita(N) Ke Din Manaye Khushi Ke Eid Eid Hamari Hai Barahvi Tareekh Hasan Wiladat E Sarkaar Se Huva Roushan Mere Khuda Ko Bhi Pyari Hai Barahvi Tareekh

৫৩০

Sahara Chahiye Sarkar Zindagi Ke Liye

Mere Aaqa Madine Bula Lijiye Mere Aaqa Madine Bula Lijiye Sahara Chahiye Sarkar Zindagi Ke Liye Tadap Raha Hoon Madine Ki Hazri Ke Liye Taiba Ke Jaane Wale, Jakar Bade Adab Se Mera Bhi Qissa E Gham, Kehna Shah E Arab Se Kehna Ke Shah-E-Aalam, Ek Ranjo Ghum Ka Maara Dono Jahaan Mein Jiska Hain Aap Hi Sahara Haalaat E Pur Alam Se, Iss Dum Guzar Raha Hai Or Kaampte Labon Se Fariyaad Kar Raha Hai Paaye Gunaah Apna Hai Dosh Par Uthaye Koi Nahi Hai Esa Jo Puchne Ko Aaye Bhula Hua Musafir Manzil Ko Dhoondta Hai Taarikiyo Ko Maah-E-Kaamil Ko Dhoondta Hai Seene Mein Hai Andhera, Dil Hai Siyaah Khana Yeh Hai Meri Kahaani Sarkar Ko Sunana Kehna Mere Nabi Se Mehroom Hu Khushi Se Kehna Mere Nabi Se Mehroom Hu Khushi Se Sarwar Qabr-E-Ghum Hai, Ashkon Se Aankh Nam Hai Paamaal-E-Zindgi Hoon, Sarkar Ummati Hoon Ummat Ke Rehnuma Ho, Kuch Arz-E-Haal Sun Lo Fariyaad Kar Raha Hoon, Main Dil Figaar Kab Se Mera Bhi Qissa-E-Ghum Kehna Shah-E-Arab Se Huzoor Aisa Koi Intezam Ho Jaye Salam Ke Liye Hazir Ghulam Ho Jaye Sahara Chahiye Sarkar Zindagi Ke Liye Tadap Raha Hoon Madine Ki Hazri Ke Liye Mera Dil Tadap Raha Hai, Mera Jal Raha Hai Seena Ke Dawaa Wahi Milegi, Mujhe Le Chalo Madina Nahi Maal-O-Zar To Kya Hai, Main Garib Hoon Yahi Na Mere Ishq Mujhko Le Chal, Tu Hi Janib-E-Madina Aaqa Na Toot Jaye, Ye Dil Ka Aabghina Ab Ke Baras Bhi Maula, Reh Jaoon Main Kahin Na Dil Ro Raha Hai Jin Ka, Aansoo Chalak Rahe Hain Un Aashiqon Ka Sadqa Bulwayiye Madina Mere Aaqa Madine Bula Lijiye Mere Aaqa Madine Bula Lijiye Madine Jaaoon Phir Aaoon Dobara Phir Jaaoon Yeh Zindagi Meri Yunhi Tamaam Ho Jaye Sahara Chahiye Sarkar Zindagi Ke Liye Tadap Raha Hoon Madine Ki Hazri Ke Liye Ae Aazam-E-Madina Jaakar Nabi Se Kehna Soze Gham E Alam Se Ab Jal Raha Hai Seena Kehna Ke Badh Rahi Hai Ab Dil Ki Iztraabi Qadmo Se Door Hoon Mein Qismat Ki Hai Kharaabi Kehna Ke Dil Main Mere Armaan Bhare Huwe Hai Kehna K Hasraton Ke Nashtar Choobe Huwe Hai Hain Aarzoo Yeh Dil Ki, Mein Bhi Madine Jaoon Sultan-E-Do Jahaan Ko Daagh-E-Jigar Dikhaoon Kaatoon Hazaar Chakkar Taiba Ki Har Gali Ke Yunhi Guzaar Doon Mein Ayyaam Zindgi Ke Phoolon Pe Jaan Nisaaroon, Kaanton Pe Dil Ko Waaroon Zarron Ko Doon Salaami, Dar Ki Karoon Ghulami Deewar-O-Dar Ko Choomoon, Chokhat Pe Sar Ko Rakh Doon Roze Ko Dekh Kar Main Rota Rahoon Baraabar Aalam Ke Dil Mein Hai Yeh Hashrat Najaane Kab Se Hum Sab Ke Dil Mein Hai Yeh Hashrat Najaane Kab Se Mera Bhi Qissa-E-Ghum Kehna Shah-E-Arab Se Sahara Chahiye Sarkar Zindagi Ke Liye Tadap Raha Hoon Madine Ki Hazri Ke Liye Ek Roz Hoga Jana Sarkar Ki Gali Mein Hoga Wahi ৫৩১

Sakhi Piya Ko Jo Main Na Dekhoun

Sakhi Piya Ko Jo Main Na Dekhoun To Kaise Katoun Andheri Ratiya Utha Do Pardah Dikha Chehra Ke Noore Bari Hijab Me Hai Zaman Tareek Ho Raha Hai Ke Mehar Kab Se Nikab Me Hai Unhi Ki Boomaya-E-Saman Hai Unhi Ka Jalwa Chaman Chaman Hai Unhi Se Gulshan Mahak Rahe Hai Unhi Ki Rangat Gulab Me Hai Wo Gul Hai Labha-E-Naaz Unke Hazaaro Jharte Hai Phool Jinse Gulaab Gulshan Me Dekhe Bul Bul Ye Dekh Gulshan Gulaab Me Hai Jali Jali Boo Se Uski Paida Hai Sozishe Ishq-E-Chashme Wala Khabaab-E-Aaho Me Bhi Na Payaa Maza Jo Dil Ke Khabaab Me Hai Kareem Aisa Mila Ke Jiss Ke Khule Hain Haath Aur Bhare Khazane Batao Aey Mufliso Ke Phir Kyun Tumara Dil Iztiraab Me Hai Siya Libasa Ne Dar-E-Duniya Wo Sabz Posha Ne Arsh-E-Alaa Har Ek Unke Karam Ka Pyasa Ye Faiz Unki Janaab Me Hai Khare Hai Murkar Nakeer Sar Par Na Koi Hamee Na Koi Yaawar Batado Aakar Mere Payambar Ke Saqt Mushkil Jawaab Me Hai Kareem Apne Karam Ka Sadqa Layeem Bekad Riko Na Sharma Tum Aur Raza Se Hisaab Lena Bhala Raza Bhi Koi Hisaab Me Hai

৫৩২

Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah

Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Wa Sallam Alayka Ya Sayyedi Ya Habeeb Allah! Mayoosi Ki Kari Dhoop Ne Jab Mujh Ko Sataya, Tab Aap Ki Rehmat Ne Diya Mujh Ko Saaya, Rehna Hai Ab To Is Saaye Mein, Mujh Ko Har Pal Sadaa, Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Wese To Mujh Pe Hein Kiye Rab Ne Kai Ehsaan, Lekin Jis Ehsaan Se Pehchan Mili, Mili Shaan, K Kiya Us Ne Mujhe Aap Ki Ummat Mein Paida, Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Jab Se Aap Ka Noor Utra Is Dil K Andar, Tab Se Yeh Dil Hai Ban Chuka, Muhabbaton Ka Ik Samandar, Noor-E-Muhammad Ne Nafraton Ko Dil Se Diya Mitaa, Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Hai Mili Mujhe Aap Hi Se Har Mor Pe Rehnumai, Jab Bhi Mein Bhoola Raasta, Aap Hi Ne Raah Dikhai, Samajh Na Aaye K Aap Ka Karun Kese Shukar Adaa, Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Hojatay Hein Gunah Bhi, Aakhir Hun Mein Bhi Insaan, Par Aap Ki Rehmat To Har Shay K Liye Hai Yaksaan, To Is Gunahgaar Pe Bhi Ho Karam Ki Ik Nigaah, Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Salallaho Alayka Ya Rasul Allah! Wa Sallam Alayka Ya Sayyedi Ya Habeeb Allah!

৫৩৩

Sallallah Jaane Aalam Tere Naaz Uthaye Allah Ne

Salallah Jaane Aalam Tere Naaz Uthaaye Allah Ne Tere Hi Liye Aye Pyare Nabi Kaunain Banaaye Allah Ne Maulood E Nabi Ki Mehfil Ko Jo Log Sajaya Karte Hai Firdaus E Bari Me Unke Liye Hai Mehel Banaaye Allah Ne Salallah Jaane Aalam Tere Naaz Uthaaye Allah Ne Tere Hi Liye Aye Pyare Nabi Kaunain Banaaye Allah Ne Ma Ahsanaka Teri Seerat Hai Ma Ajmalaka Teri Soorat Hai Warafana Laka'zikrak Keh Kar Tere Rutbe Badhaaye Allah Ne Salallah Jaane Aalam Tere Naaz Uthaaye Allah Ne Tere Hi Liye Aye Pyare Nabi Kaunain Banaye Allah Ne Imaan Ki Taabaani Ke Liye Kya Khoob Nagine Humko Diye Khawaja Ajmeri Gaus Jali Aur Raza Banaaye Allah Ne Salallah Jaane Aalam Tere Naaz Uthaaye Allah Ne Tere Hi Liye Aye Pyare Nabi Kaunain Banaye Allah Ne

৫৩৪

Salle Ala Nabi Ye Na Salle Ala Muhammadin

Salle Ala Nabi Ye Na Salle Ala Muhammadin Salle Ala Shafi Ye Na Salle Ala Muhammadin Wo Jo Na The To Kuch Na Tha, Wo Jo Na Ho To Kuch Na Ho Jaan Hai Wo Jahaan Ki, Jaan Hai To Jahaan Hai Aamade Mustafa Se Hai Phoola Phala Chaman Chaman Ayi Bahaar Har Taraf Khilne Laga Chaman Chaman Aamade Mustafa Huwi Roshan Zamaana Ho Gaya Jin Ke Huzoor Ho Gaye Unka Zamaana Ho Gaya Ham Bhi Madine Jayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sahi Aaqa Humein Bulayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sahi Galiyon Mein Ghuum Ghuum Kar Khaake Madinah Chuum Kar Nazron Se Ham Lagayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sahi Galiyon Mein Jhuum Jhuum Kar Khaakhe Madinah Chuum Kar Naat-E-Nabi Sunayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sahi Dekha Jo Unko Baanethe Mein Ne Bhi Bar Ke Shawk Se Daste Ataa Ke Samne Daste Talab Barha Diya No Matter Is Taiba Far Away, We Have To Go And Visit One Day Aqa Will Call Us Day One Day, Murshid Will Show The Way One Day Haal Dil Sunayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sahi Bighri Apni Banayenge Aaj Nahi To Kal Sah Hum Ne To Maan Hi Liya Ke Aap Hai ৫৩৫

Sambhal Jaa Aye Dile Muztar Madina Aane Wala Hai

Sambhal Jaa Aye Dile Muztar Madina Aane Wala Hai Lutaa Aye Chashme Tar Gohar Madina Aane Wala Hai Qadam Ban Jaaey Mera Sar Madina Aane Wala Hai Bichhoon Reh Mai Nazar Ban Kar Madina Aane Wala Hai Jo Dekhein Un Ka Naqshe Paa Khuda Se Woh Nazar Maangoon Charaghe Dil Chaloon Lekar Madina Aane Wala Hai Karam Unka Chalaa Yoon Dil Se Kehta Raahe Taiba Mein Dile Muztar Tasalli Kar Madina Aane Wala Hai Nichaawar Hai Madine Ki Yeh Mera Dil Meri Aankhen Nichaawar Hoon Madina Par Madina Aane Wala Hain Ilaahi Main Talabgaare Fanaa Hoon Khaake Taiba Main Ilaahi Kar Nisaare Dar Madina Aane Wala Hai Madine Ko Chala Main Beniyaaze Rehbare Manzil Rahe Taiba Hai Khud Rehbar Madina Aane Wala Hai Mujhe Kheenche Liye Jaataa Hai Shouqe Kooncha'e Jaana Khinchaa Jaata Hoon Mein Yaksar Madina Aane Wala Hai Woh Chamka Gumbade Khazraa Woh Shaire Pur Ziya Aaya Dhale Ab Noor Main Pekar Madina Aane Wala Hai Jahaan Se Bekhabar Ho Kar Chalo Khulde Madina Main Chalo Ab Hosh Ki Peekar Madina Aane Wala Hain Madeene Mein Khule Baabe Hayaate Nau Batarze Nau Badal Daalo Kohan Daftar Madina Aane Wala Hai Zara Aye Markabe Umre Rawaan Chal Barq Ki Soorat Dikha Parwaaz Ke Jowhar Madina Aane Wala Hai Talabgaare Madina Tak Madina Khud Hi Aajaaye Tu Duniya Se Kinaara Kar Madina Aane Wala Hai Madina Aagaya Ab Der Kya Hai Sirf Itni Si Tu Khaali Kar Yeh Dil Ka Ghar Madina Aane Wala Hai Falak Shaayad Zameen Par Rehgaya Khaake Guzar Bankar Bichhe Hai Raah Mein Akhtar Madina Aane Wala Hai Ghubaare Raahe Anwar Kis Qadar Purnoor Hai Akhtar Tani Hai Noor Ki Chaadar Madina Aane Wala Hai

৫৩৬

Sanu Koji Vekh Na Chad Ve

Sanu Koji Vekh Na Chad Ve Tussan Bhaleya De Hath Lajj Ve Asan Chandna Tuada Dar Na Tuade Qadman De Vich Marna Sanu Roz E Hashr Da Darna Sade Tussan Wakeel Te Judge Ve Sanu Tuadi Zaat Te Maan Ae Qurban Tussan Ton Sadi Jaan Ae Tuada Mukh Jivein Quran Ae Tuadi Deed Ae Sada Hajj Ve Tuade Naa Nun Choomde Lab Ve Wichon Disda Sanu Rab Ve Hath Ban Ke Naal Adab De Tuadi Deed Karan Raj Raj Ve

৫৩৭

Sar Se Paa Tak Har Adaa Hain Lajawaab

Sar Se Paa Tak Har Adaa Hain Lajawaab Khoobrooyo Me Nahi Tera Jawaab Husn Hain Bemisal Surat Lajawaab Me Fida Tum Aap Ho Apna Jawaab Pooche Jaate Hain Amal Me Kya Kahoo Tum Sikaa Jao Mere Maula Jawaab Palte Hain Hum Se Nikamme Beshumaar Hain Kahi Us Aastaane Ka Jawaab Roz E Mahshar Aik Tera Aasra Sab Sawaalo Ka Jawaab E Lajawaab Me Yad E Baydaa Ke Sadqe Ae Kaleem Par Kahaa Un Ki Kaf E Paa Ka Jawaab Kya Amal Tu Ne Kiye Us Ka Suwaal Teri Rahmat Chaahi Hain Mera Jawaab Mehr O Maa Zare Hain Un Ki Raah Ke Kaun De Naqsh E Kaf E Paa Ka Jawaab Tum Se Us Beemaar Ko Sehat Mile* Jis Ko Dede Hazrat E Esa Jawaab Dekh Rizwaan Dasht E Taiba Ki Bahaar Meri Jannat Ka Na Paaye Ga Jawaab Shor Hain Lutf O Ataa Ka Shor Hain Maangne Waala Nahi Sunta Jawaab Jurm Ki Paataash Paate Ahle Jurm Ulti Baato Ka Na Ho Seeda Jawaab Par Tumhare Lutf Aare Aagaye De Diya Mahshar Me Bepursish Jawaab Ae Hasan Mehw E Jamaal E Rooh E Dost Ae Nakeerain Is Se Phir Lena Jawaab

৫৩৮

Sar Sue Rouza Jhuka Phir Tujhko Kya

Sar Sue Rouza Jhuka Phir Tujhko Kya Dil Tha Sajid Najdiya Phir Tujhko Kya Baith-Te Uth-Te Madad Ke Waaste Ya Rasool Allah Kaha Phir Tujhko Kya Ya Garaz Se Choot Ke Mahje Zikr Ko Naam E Paak Unka Japa Phir Tujhko Kya Bekhudi Me Sajda E Darr Ya Tawaaf Jo Kiya Achha Kiya Phir Tujhko Kya Unko Tamlee Ke Malikul Mulq Se Maalik E A'alam Kaha Phir Tujhko Kya Unke Naam E Paak Par Dil Jaano Maal Najdiya Sab T(A)j Diya Phir Tujhko Kya Ya Ibadi Kehke Humko Shah Ne Apna Banda Kar Liya Phir Tujhko Kya Dev Ke Bando Se Kab Hai Ye Khitaab Tu Na Unka Hai Na Tha Phir Tujhko Kya La Ya'udun Aage Hoga Bhi Nahi Tu Alag Hai Daaima Phir Tujhko Kya Dashte Gardo Peshe Taiba Ka Adab Makka Sa Tha Ya Siwa Phir Tujhko Kya Najdi Marta Hai Ke Kyu Ta'azeem Ki Ye Hamara Deen Tha Phir Tujhko Kya Dev Tujhse Khush Hai Phir Hum Kya Kare Humse Hai Raazi Khuda Phir Tujhko Kya Dev Ke Bando Se Humko Kya Garaz Hum Hai Abad E Mustafa Phir Tujhko Kya Teri Dohzakh Se To Kuch Cheena Nahi Khuld Me Pohcha Raza Phir Tujhko Kya

৫৩৯

Sar Ta Ba Qadam Hai Tan E Sultane Zaman Phool

Sar Ta Ba-Qadam Hai Tan E Sultane Zaman Phool Lab Phool, Dahan Phool, Zakan Phool, Badan Phool Sadqe Me Tere Baagh To Kya Laye Hai Ban Phool Iss Guncha E Dil Ko Bhi To Imaa Ho Ki Ban Phool Tinka Bhi Hamare To Hilaye Nahi Hilta Tum Chaho To Ho Jaye Abhi Kohe Mehan Phool Wallah Jo Mil Jaye Mere Ghul Ka Paseena Maange Na Kabhi Itr Na Fir Chahe Dulhan Phool Dil-Basta Wa Khu-Gashta Na Khusbu Na Latafat Kyo Guncha Kahu Hai Mere Aaqa Ka Dehan Phool Shab Yaad Thi Kin Daanto Ki Shabnam Ki Dam E Subh(A) Shokhane Bahari Ke Jada-U Hai Kiran Phool Dandaan O Lab O Zulf O Rukhe Shah Ke Fidayi Hai Durre Adan La'ale Yaman Mushke Khotan Phool Bu Hoke Nahi Ho Gaye Taabe Rukhe Shah Me Lo Ban Gaye Hai Ab To Haseeno Ka Dahan Phool Ho Baare Gunah Se Na Khazil Doshe Azeeza(N) Lillah Meri Na'ash Kar Aaye Jane Chaman Phool Dil Apna Bhi Shaidayi Hai Us Naakhun E Paa Ka Itna Bhi Mahe Nou Pe Na Ay Charkhe Kuhan Phool Dil Khol Ke Khu Ro Le Game Aarize Shah Me Nikle To Kahi Hasrat E Khu-Naaba Shudan Phool Kya Gaaza Mala Garde Madeena Ka Jo Hai Aaj Nikhre Hue Joban Me Qiyamat Ki Phaban Phool Garmi Ye Qiyamat Hai Ki Kaante Hai Zabaa(N) Par Bulbul Ko Bhi Ay Saaqi E Sahba Wa Laban Phool Hai Kaun Ki Girya Kare Ya Faatiha Ko Aaye Bekas Ke Uthaye Teri Rehmat Ke Bharan Phool Dil Ghum Tujhe Ghere Hai Khuda Tujhko Wo Chamkaye Suraj Tere Khirman Ko Bane Teri Kiran Phool Kya Baat Raza Us Chamanistaan E Karam Ki Zahra Hai Kali Jisme Husain Aur Hasan Phool

৫৪০

Sare Nabiyan Da Nabi Tu Imam Soneya

Sare Nabiyan Da Nabi Tu Imam Soneya, Lakha Tere Te Durood Te Salaam Soneya Tere Sadqe Jahaan Sara Baneya, Tere Waaste Quraan Saara Baneya Paya Tere Jeya Kisse-Na Maqaam Soneya, Lakha Tere Te Durood Te Salaam Soneya Aay Dar Te Sawali Nu Nahi Moryaa, Dil Kissey Wi Ghareeb Da Nahi Toryaa Sab Kawndein Sadqa Tera, Subho O Shaam Sohneya, Lakha Tere De Durood Te Salaam Sohneya Tere Warga Habeeb Das Qera Ay, Ayna Rab De Qareeb Das Qera Ay Tainu Aeho Jeya Milya Inaam Soneya, Lakha Tere Te Durood Te Salaam Soneya Tannu Arsha Te Rab Ne Bulaaya Ay, Shaan Tere Jeya Hor Kinne Paya Ay. Hoyi Tere Te Nabuwat Tamaam Soneya, Lakha Tere Te Durood Te Salaam Sohneya

৫৪১

Sarkaar E Do Aalam Ki Nazar Mujh Pe Padi Hai

Sarkaar E Do ‘aalam Ki Nazar Mujh Pe Padi Hai Pohchaa Hoon Wahan Khuld E Bareen Ki Jo Gali Hai Aaya Jo Madine Me To Qismat Ne Pukaara Bigri Huwi Taqdeer Yahan Aake Banee Hai Qadmon Ko Zara Hosh Se Is Khaak Pe Rakhna Yeh Koo-E-Nabi Hai Arre Yeh Koo-E-Nabi Hai Mehshar Ki Karee Dhoop Ka Khatka Nahi Mujh Ko Chaadar Merey Sarkaar Ke Gesu Ki Tanee Hai Lillah Mujhe Apna Rukhe Zaibaa Dikhaado Palkon Me Meyri Deed Ki Khaatir Namee Hai Aaqa Ke Dar E Paak Ke Mangte Hain Malaa-Ik Maayoos Nahi Koi Yeh Darbaar E Nabi Hai De Daaliye Mujh Ko Bhi Ghulaami Ki Sanad Ab Bakhshish Ko Mere Shah Yeh Khairaat Baree Hai Shab Rote Huwe Sajde Me Sarkaar Guzaarein Ummat Ki Ho Bakhshish Yahi Armaan E Nabi Hai Allah Ko Mehboob Se Kitni Hai Mohabbat Haan Taaha Wa Yaaseen Me Asraar E Jali Hai Bulwate Rahe Mujh Ko Madine Me Hamesha Ummeed Meri Aap Se Sarkaar Yahi Hai ‘aalam Me Musalmaan Pareshaan Hain Pareshaan Be Chain Nazar Aap Key Dar Pe Hee Jamee Hai Maange Hee Chale Jaao Yahan Milta Hain Sab Kuch Kis Cheez Ki Dar Par Mere Maula Ki Kamee Hai Shakir Na Ho Ghamgeen Teri Jholi Bharain Ge Moonh Maanga Milega Key Yeh Darbaar E Nabi Hai

৫৪২

Sarkaar Yeh Naam Tumhara Sab Namoon Say Hai Piyara

Sarkaar Yeh Naam Tumhara Sab Namoon Say Hai Piyara Iss Naam Say Chamka Sooraj Aur Chamka Chaand Sitara Hua Her Suu Khoob Ujala Hua Roshan Alam Sara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Lehroon Nay Meri Yeh Khashti Her Janib Say Hay Gayhri Sarkaar Khaber Lo Meri Sarkaar Khaber Lo Meri Milay Mujh Ko Afeeyat Ka Mere Aqa(S.a.w) Jald Kinara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Sa’el Hoon Teray Dar Ka Milay Mujh Ko Bheek Karam Ki Rekh Laaj Ay Mere Aqa Iss Mere Chashm-E-Naam Ki Karoon Gumbad-E-Ghazra Ka Phir Ankhoon Say Apni Nazara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Jo Mujh Per Beet Rahi Hay Wo Kiss Ko Kesay Bataoon Aur Apnay Dil Ki Hikayat Bhala Kiss Ko Ja Ker Sunaoon Tum Mehram-E-Raaz Ho Mere Meri Daadrasi Ho Khudara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Meri Arz Khudara Sunn Lo Mere Haal Pay Mujh Ko Na Choro Zara Apni Chashm-E-Inayat Baybass Ki Teraf Bhi Moroo Baykass Ka Tum Ho Sahara Baycharay Ka Tum Ho Chara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Jab Rab-E-Qadeer Tumhari Keray Khud Hi Midha Saraye Her Ek Kay Laboon Pay Phir To Tareef Tumhari Aye Sadd Shuker Kay Zikr Tumhara Rahay Her Dam Wird Hamara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Her Waqt Per Hum Nay Dekha Hay Tumhain To Ma’el Dar-E-Pak Pay Aya Jab Bhi Kesa Hi Koi Sa’el Ay Rehmat-E-Alam Tum Nay Usay Ker Hi Leya Hay Gawara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Jab Roz-E-Qayamat Her Aik Bolay Ga Nafsi Nafsi Aur Daad Kisi Ki Day Ga Mehshar Main Jab Na Koi Aisay Main Ata Ho Mujh Ko Ay Shahfa-E-Hasher Sahara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara Do Apnay Ishq Ki Dolat Tujhay Apni Aal Ka Sadqa Yeh Riaz Faqeer Azal Say Tere Dar Ka Hi Hay Shaha Tere Dast-E-Aata Kay Agay Daaman Hay Iss Nay Pasara Mera Naam Keray Ga Roshan Do Jagg Main Naam Tumhara

৫৪৩

Sarkar Aap Jaisa Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga

Zamane Bhar Ne Azeem Jana Qasam Khuda Ki Azeem Jana Nahi Hai Unsa Koi Nahi Hai Hamare Aaqa Azeem Tar Hai Sarkar Aap Jaisa Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Jaise Hai Aap Waisa Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Bakhshish Ko Asiyon Ki Duniya Me Aake Fauran Sajde Me Jaane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Meraj Ke Safar Me Ummat Ko Yaad Karke Aasu Bahane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Jab Jhoom Kar Hai Toote Pyase To Ungliyon Se Darya Bahane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Insaan To Phir Hai Insaan Par Sari Khalkato Par Rehmat Lutane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Bandhe Shikam Pe Pathar Chulah Jale Na Ghar Par Phir Bhi Khilane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Tha Ek Hi To Pyala Sattar Jo The Sahaba Sabko Pilane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Mehshar Ki Dhup Me Bhi Unke Siwa Karam Se Saya Dilane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Allah Wo Kayamat Aur Pyas Ki Wo Shiddat Kausar Pilane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Yume Hisaab Jis Dam Sakhti Hume Rulaye Aasaan Karane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga La Taqnatu Hai Muzda Hum Par Karam Ka Parda Bakhshish Karane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Mutthi Me Bu Jehel Ki Bejaan Kankari Ko Kalma Padhane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Ungli Ek Ishare Se Chand Shaq Hua Hai Suraj Phirane Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Jab Nafsi Nafsi Saare Abraar Khehte Honge Humko Bachne Wala Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga Duniya Se Kheh De Rizwan Tu Hai Ghulame Hassan Unse Bhala Sanakhawn Koi Tha Na Hai Na Hoga

৫৪৪

Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Me

Hazir Ho Dare Aqdas Pe Gada Sarkar Bulayein Qadmon Mein Mohtaaj Pe Ho Rehmat Ki Rida Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Mein Woh Izn Salaami Ka Mujh Ko Ik Kaife Dawaami Ka Mujh Ko Dhadkan Dhadkan Ki Hai Ye Dua Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Mein Taareeki Mere Gunaahon Ki Sab Ud Jaaye Jo Aa Jaaye Zulmat Ko Meri Ho Noor Ata Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Mein Mai Pyaas Ke Sehra Me Khoya Kaante Se Halaq Me Chubte Hain Ho Sabz Sunehre Jaam Ata Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Mein Jaaunga Ujaagar Qadmon Mein Phir Chulunga Mein Arshe Baree Ho Jaayenge Mere Arzo Samaa Sarkar Bulaye Qadmon Mein Wo Lamhe Aeyen Qurbat Ke Simtee Ho Sadhiyan Lamhon Mein Takhta Hoon Jadah Rehmat Ka Sarkar Bulayein Kadmon Mein

৫৪৫

Sarkar Jaante Hai

Kis Lab Pe Kya Dua Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai, Kis Ke Dilo Main Kya Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai, Murda Hai Ya Ke Zinda, Bache Hai Ya Ke Bacha Pukhta Hai Ya Ke Kacha, Or Kis Ka Hai Ye Nutfa Kis Ko Bhala Khabar Hai, Majboor Har Bashar Hai Maa Ke Shikam Mai Kya Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai Shakhe Khujoor Lekar, Qabro Pe Dalte Hain, Mayyat Ki Har Sazaa Ko, Pal Bhar Main Taalte Hai, Murda Hai Kis Jage Ka, Iska Hai Majara Kya Qabro Mai Haal Kya Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai Kabhi Swaad Keh Rahe Hai, Kabhi Qaaf Keh Rahe Hai, Kabhi Ayn Keh Rahe Hai, Kabhi Haa Keh Rahe Hai, Jibreel Keh Rahe Hai, Ye Raazgi Ki Baatein Maana Mafhoom Kya Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai Meraj Ka Safar Hai, Sarkar Ja Rahe Hai, Sidrah Se Aage Jaake, Tashreef Laa Rahe Hai, Meraj Hai Haqiqat, Imaan Hai Ye Warna Parde Main Kya Rakha Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai Sidra Pe Leke Pohnche, Jibreel Saath Chore, Mujhko Na Kuch Pataa Hai, Kehte Hain Haath Jore Aage Huzoor Jaaye, Ye Meri Intehaa Hai, Sidrah Ke Aage Kya Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai Shisho Ke Ghar Me Rehkar, Pathar Uchaalte Hai Ushaaqe Mustafa To, Taqdeer Taalte Hai, Haamil Rab Hai Khaaliq, Mere Mustafa Hai Maalik Qismat Mai Kya Likha Hai, Sarkar Jaante Hai
