৫৪৬

Sarkar Jeya Sohna

Sarkar Jeya Sohna Na Aya Na Awna Ey Na Rab Ney Banaya Ey Na Rab Ney Banawna Ey Weykho Jee Har Ik Shey Tey Peya Nur Barasta Ey Lag Da Ey Huney Eytay Sarkar Ney Awna Ey Sarda Ey Sarey Koi, Larda Ey Larey Koi Sunniya Ney Tey Gaj Waj Key Milad Manawna Ey Jee Karda Ey Mar Jawa Jis Din Da Suniya Ey Wich Qabr Dey Aqa Ney Deedar Karowna Ey Ungli Nu Halawndey Ney Pey Chan Nu Bulawndey Ney So Rab Di Ey Chan Falki Aqa Da Khilona Ey Ban Jaani Ey Gal Teri Wich Hashr Dihaarey Dey Jadun Sohney Aqa Ney Tanuw Gal Nal Lawna Ey Munkar Odun Nas Jaan Dey Mushkil Wich Pas Jandey Ey Sunni Jadu Wi Tu Nara Haidri Lana Ey Rab Aap Banaya Ey Dildaar Bara Sohna Naley Khud Farmaya Ey Mera Yaar Bara Sohna Sab Daayan Halimah Nu Hayrat Nal Puch Diyan San Kithun Ley Key Aa’ee Ey Dildaar Bara Sohna Mey Unj Tey Maari Aa Meri Kuli Maari Ey Meri Gowd Wich Nabiyan Da Sardar Bara Sohna Sarkar Jeya Sohna Na Aya Na Awna Ey Na Rab Ney Banaya Ey Na Rab Ney Banawna Ey

৫৪৭

Sarkar Ke Hum Deewane Hain

Sarkar Ke Hum Deewane Hain Sarkar Ke Hum Kehlate Hain Sarkar Ka Sadqa Peete Hain Sarkar Ka Saqda Khate Hain Yeh Un Ki Nigahein Rahmat Hain Yeh Maal-O-Zar Ki Baat Nahin Bas Wohi Madine Jaate Hain Sarkar Jinhein Bulwate Hain Jab Mauj Mein Woh Aa Jate Hain Bigdhi Sab Ki Ban Jati Hai Jab Un Ka Karam Ho Jata Hai Din Mangton Ke Phir Hi Jate Hain Fiazan Ek Akela Mai Hi Nahi Karta Kamli Wale Ki Sana Kya Ghous-E-Jali Kya Mehr-E-Ali Sab Geet Unhi Ke Gate Hai Kya Khoob Suhana Mausam Tha Jibril Manadi Karte The Tashreef Muhammad Latein Hain Tashreef Muhammad Latein Hain Lajpaal Madine Wale Ke Andaaz Sakhawat Kya Kehna Dunya Ke Shahanshah Is Dar Par Ban Ban Ke Bhikari Aate Hain

৫৪৮

Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein

Allah Ne Pohnchaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Sadd Shukar Keh Mein Phir Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Rad Kaisay Bhala Hogi Ab Koi Dua Meri Mein Rub Ko Pukar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Kuch Der Salaami Ko Thehraya Mawaja Par Phir Mujhko Adab Laaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Kuch Kehne Se Pehle Hee Puri Hoi Har Khuwahish Jo Socha Wohi Paaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Kuch Lamhay Huzoori Ke Paaye Tou Ye Lagta Hai Ik Umar Guzaar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Mujh Jaisa Tahee Damaan Kiya Nazar Ko Lejaata Ik Naat Suna Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmon Mein Sarkar Salaami Ko Har Saal Talab Kije Yeh Arz Bhi Kar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Yaad Aayei Sabih Apni Har Aik Khata Mujh Ko Amaal Pe Sharmaaya Sarkaar Ke Qadmon Mein ------------------Other-------------------- -----------------Version------------------- Kuch Aisa Sukoon Paya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Dil Kaif Se Bahar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Masjid Ka Har Ek Chappa Wallah Noorani Hai Kuch Noor Ajab Paya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Ramzan E Madina Ki Raunaq Hi Niraali Iftaar Bhi Kar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Ab Meri Duao Me Kuch Kaif Nirala Hai Aasu Jo Baha Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Bheje The Salaamo Ke Ehbaab Ne Jo Tohfe Mai Peysh Wo Kar Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Sarkar Qayamat Me Qausar Bhi Pilayenge Zam Zam To Mai Pe Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Sab Kuch To Unhi Ka Hai Mai Nazar Hi Kya Karta Bas Naat Suna Aaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me Rizwan Ki Ye Kismat Hai Tu Inka Sana Khawa Hai Paaya Hai Ye Sarmaya Sarkar Ke Qadmo Me

৫৪৯

Sarkar Yun Laga Hai Tumhe Dekhne Baad

Sarkar Yun Laga Hai Tumhe Dekhne Baad Allah Ko Pa Liya Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad Dunya Ki Bheer Mein Kahin Gum Ho Gaya Tha Apna Pata Chala Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad Husne Jahan Hai Garche Hasin Se Hasin Tarr Nazron Mein Kab Jacha Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad Aya Jo Teri Bazm E Mohabbat Mein Eik Baar Tera Hi Ho Gaya Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad Dil Hai Keh Manta Hi Nahi Ab Kisi Ki Baat Deewana Ho Gaya Hai Tumhe Dekhne K Baad Aisa Hasin Aisa Nahi Koi Khoob Ruh Dil Ne Mujhe Kaha Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad Bhule Se Bhi Na Jaunga Kisi Ghaur Ki Taraf Yeh Mera Faisla Hai Tumhe Dekhne Ke Baad

৫৫০

Sarkare Do Alam Ke Rukh Par

Sarkare Do Alam Ke Rukh Par, Anwaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jab Zulf Ka Zikr Hai Qur’an Mein, Rukhsar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Mehboobe Khuda Ke Jalwon Se, Iman Ki Ankhen Raushan Hain Bin Dekhey Hi Jab Yeh Alam Hai, Didar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jab Unke Gada Bhar Detey Hain, Shahane Zamana Ki Jholi Mohtaj Ki Jab Yeh Halat Hai, Mukhtar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Hai Naam Mein Unka Itna Asar, Ji Uthte Hai Murdey Bhi Sun Kar Woh Haal Agar Khud Puchein To, Bimar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jab Unke Ghulamon Ke Dar Par, Jhukte Hain Salaati-Ne Alam Phir Koi Bataey Aqa Ke, Darbar Ka Alam Kya Ho Ga Jab Sunke Sahaba Ki Baaten, Kuffar Musalman Hote Hain Phir Donon Jahan Ke Sarwar Ki, Guftar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Taibah Se Hawa Jab Ati Hai, Bekal Ko Sukun Mil Jata Hai Is Paar Ka Jab Yeh Alam Hai, Us Par Ka Alam Kya Hoga Sarkare Do Alam Ke Rukh Par, Anwaar Ka Alam Kya Hoga Jab Zulf Ka Zikr Hai Qur’an Mein, Rukhsar Ka Alam Kya Hoga

৫৫৩

Sayyid E Kawnayn Sultan E Jahan

Sayyid-E-Kawnayn, Sultan-E-Jahaa(N) Zill-E-Yazdaa(N), Shah-E-Dee(N), Arsh Aastaa(N) Kul Se A'ala, Kul Se Aula, Kul Ki Jaa(N) Kul Ke Aaqa, Kul Ke Hadi, Kul Ki Shaa(N) Dil Kusha, Dil Kash, Dil Aara, Dil Sitaa(N) Kaan-E-Jaan-O-Jaan-E-Jaan-O-Shaan-E-Shaa(N) Har Hikayat, Har Kinayat, Har Adaa Har Isharat, Dil Nasheen-O-Dil Nishaa(N) Dil De, Dil Ko Jaan, Jaa(N) Ko Noor De Aey Jahaan-E-Jaan-O-Aey Jaan-E-Jahaa(N) Aankh De, Aur Aankh Ko Didaar-E-Noor Rooh De Aur Rooh Ko Raah-E-Jinaa(N) Allah Allah Yaas Aur Aisi Aas Se Aur Yeh Hazrat Yeh Dar Ye Aastaa(N) Tu Sanaa Ko Hai, Sanaa Teray Liye Hai Sanaa Teri Hi Deegar Daastaa(N) Tu Na Tha Tou Kuch Na Tha, Gar Tu Na Ho Kuch Na Ho, Tu Hi To Hai Jaan-E-Jahaa(N) Tu Hai Daata, Aur Auro(N) Se Rajaa Tu Ho Aaqa, Aur Yaad-E-Digaraa(N) Jis Tarha Hont Iss Ghazal Se Door Hain Dil Se Yun Hi Door Ho Har Zinn-0-Zaa(N) Iltija! Iss Shirk-O-Shar Se Door Rakh Ho Raza Tera Hi, Gayr Az Een-O-Aa(N)

Shah E Madina Mujh Ko Taiba Bulaa Liye Hain

Shah E Madina Mujh Ko Taiba Bulaa Liye Hain Soyee Huwi Thi Qismat Aaqa Jagaa Diye Hain Qismat Pe Rashk Meri Karte Hain Sub Farishte Phir Se Madine Mujh Ko Aaqa Bulaa Liye Hain Maanga Hai Jo Bhi Jab Bhi Uss Se Siwa Milaa Hain Jholi Ko Sab Ki Bhar Ke Aaqa Du’a Diye Hain Ek Ko Mili Sadaqat Ek Ko Mili ‘adaalat Sadqe Unhi Ka Dedo Daaman Bichaa Diye Hain ‘uthman ‘ali Ka Sadqa ‘ilm O ‘amal ‘ataa Ho Armaan Liye Yeh Dar Pe Bistar Jamaa Diye Hain Shakir Pe Jab Bhi Chaaye Huzn O Alam Ke Baadal Aaqa Nibha Liye Hain Daata Bachaa Liye Hain

Shahe Deen Ki Milad Ka Hai Mahina Nibhaaya Mujhe Aur Bulaaya Madina Rahe Mujh Pe Rehmat Ka Aaqa Tasalsul Talab Ka Nahin Mujh Me Daata Qareena Mubarak Ho Yaum E Wiladat Mubarak Gulaamon Ki Jaanib Se Aaqa Mubarak Khudaara ‘ataa Ho Hame Bhi To ‘eidee Mile Hum Ko Shah Ki Taraf Se Mubarak Nigah E Karam Mujh Pe Aaqa Ne Daali Dikhayi Mujhe Apne Rouze Ki Jaali Mere Dil Ke Armaan Bhi Poore Karenge Nahin Lauta Is Dar Se Koi Bhi Khaali Mili Itni Rif’at Ke ‘arsh E Bareen Par Nishaan E Qadam Hai Ye Uss Ki Jabeen Par Me Baitha Hoon Qadmon Me Ab To Khudaara Pade Naqsh E Paa Mere Dil Ki Zameen Par Khada Hai Hawaadis Me Shakir Tumhaara Bajuz Aap Ke Ab Nahin Hai Sahaara Mite Ranj O Gham Ke Hain Jitne Bhi Baadal Karam Ka Kare Ab Khudaara Ishaara

Shahe Madina, Shahe Madina, Shahe Madina Yas Rab Kay Wali Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Jalwe Hai Sare Terey Hi Dam Se, Aabad Aalam Terey Karam Se Baqi Har Ek Shay Naqshe Qayali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Terey Liye Hi Dunya Bani Hai, Neele Falak Ki Chadar Tani Hai Tu Agar Na Hota Dunya Thi Khali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Tune Jahan Ki Mehfil Sajai, Taarikyon Mein Shamma Jalai Kandhe Pe Tere Kamli Hai Kaali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Mazhab Hai Tera Sab Ki Bhalai, Maslak Hai Tera Mushkil Kushai Dekh Ke Apni Umat Ki Khasta Haali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Hai Noor Tera Shamso Qamar Mein, Tere Laboon Ki Laali Sahar Mein Phoolon Ne Teri Khusbu Chura Li, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Kaba Ka Kaba Tera Hi Ghar Hai, Tere Karam Pe Sab Ki Nazar Hai Dikhlade Hum Ko Darbare Aali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Hain Ap Dukhyon Ke Aaqa Sahare, Taje Shafa At Hai Sar Pe Tumhare Ham Ko Aata Ho Roze Ki Jaali, Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Taiba Ke Wali Sare Nabi Tere Dar Ke Sawali Shahe Madina, Shahe Madina, Shahe Madina

৫৬০

Shan E Ilahi Noor E Haqiqat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Mazhar E Rehmat Rehmat Hi Rehmat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Gesu E Mushki Shame Masarrat, Ruh E Munawwar Subhe Basharat Chashme Gazali Baada E Ulfat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Hoorein Tasaduq Qudsi Hai Hairan, Shaan E Haqiqat Surate Yasdaan Unko Bana Kar Nazaan Hai Qudrat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Faqr Ke Rahi Pet Hai Qali, Lab Pe Tabassum Shukr E Ilahi Khadmo Me Jinke Daulat O Sarwat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Man Raani Shaan Kisi Ki, Maa Ramaita Aan Kisis Ki Haq Ki Gilimi Shaklo Shabahat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam ------------------------ More ------------------------ ----------------------- Verses ----------------------- Saahibe Taaj Khatme Nubuwat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Sadre Nasheen Bazme Risalat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Unki Gali Ka Zarra Zarra, Mahre Daraqsha Banke Chamka Faqre Qadam Aflaak Ki Azmat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Darse Murawwat Farma Unka, Nue Bashar Par Ehsaan Unka Aman-O-Muhabbat Unki Hai Shariyat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Noor E Jabeen Insaan Ka Chamka, Farq Mita Mohtaaj-O-Ghani Ka Ek Hue Sarmaaya Wa Mehnat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Deen E Mubeen Faizaan Hai Unka, Joke Yaqi Ehsaan Hai Unka Unke Ke To Dar Ki Khaak Me Hikmat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam Khurbe Ilahi Sunnat Unki, Husne Amal Hai Taa-At Unki Haasil E Iman Unki Muhabbat, Salallahu Alayhi Wasallam

Ramzan Ke Maheene Kaa Ehsaan Utha Ke Dekh Jo Kuch Kaha Allah Ne Us Ko Nibha Ke Dekh Jaan-E-Ramzan Jaan Shan-E-Ramzan Jaan Zindagi Sabr Se Aashna Ho Gai Shaane Ramzan Deher Main Ayaan Ho Gai Jo Nazar Main Nahi Tha Kinara Mila Aisa Maahe Karam Ka Sahaara Mila Ashq Aankhon Se Daaman Main Aa Ke Gira Khud Khatakaar Ko Kiya Se Kiya Kar Gaya Banda Karney Laga Rab Se Yun Guftugu Allah Hu Allahu Allah Hu Allahu Shaane Ramzan Aaya Chaar Soo Maahe Ramzan Yun Aagaya Ban Ke Rehmat Ye Phir Chagaya Kesay Tujh Se Karoon Samna Gir Raha Hoon Zara Thaamna Khaali Daaman Liye Aagaya Bin Teray Meray Hasti Hai Kiya Laaj Rakhna Meri Aye Khuda Waasta Maahe Ramzan Ka Bas Jhuka Hai Yeh Sar Aur Kya Maagna Banda Parwar Hai Tu Bas Zara Dekhna Teri Marzi Ko Paana Meri Justuju Allah Hu Allahu Allah Hu Allahu Shaane Ramzan Aaya Chaar Soo Barkatein Yun Falak Se Utarne Lagi Kirnay Jaise Zameen Par Bikharne Lagi Silsila Rehmaton Ka Dua Se Mila Nematon Ka Yeh Kesa Maheena Mila Aao Mil Baat Ke Baat Lo Har Khushi Haan Yeh Hi Hai Ibadat Yeh Hi Bandagi Shaane Ramzan Hai Dil Kasho Khoob Roo ------------------- More -------------------- ------------------ Verses ------------------- Rehmatein Kibriya Jalwa Ghar Hogai Shan E Ramzan Se Roshan Sahar Hogai Bandagi Ka Qarina Badal Ne Laga Qidmate Qalk Ko Dil Machal Ne Laga Ashq Aankhon Se Daaman Main Aa Ke Gira Khud Khatakaar Ko Kiya Se Kiya Kar Gaya Banda Karney Laga Rab Se Yun Guftugu Allah Hu Allahu Allah Hu Allahu Shaane Ramzan Aaya Chaar Soo

৫৬২

Shan Wala Sohna Nabi Sada Lajpaal Eh

Shan Wala Sohna Nabi Sada Lajpaal Eh Allahumma Salli Ala Sayyidina Muhammadin Jhulliyan Hanerian Te Rehmatan Sanwareya Bujheya Na Diwa Jedha Nabi Sohne Baleya Naam Nabi De Naal Sadi Jaan Te Pehchan Eh Is Naam Nal Sada Naam Te Nishan Eh Sanu Te Huzoor Diyan Nisbatan Ne Paaleya Barkatan Te Rehmatan Da Ant Nai Hisab Nai Roz-E-Nabi Da Hor Kite Wi Jawab Nai Sara Jag Akhiyan Ne Wekheya Te Bhaleya Kinne Sade Aqa Wangon Sade Lai Rohna Eh Ohde Jaya Sohna Aya Eh Na Auna Ae Koi Na Sawali Jithe Buhe Utton Taleya Qainaat Wich Sada Sohna Bemisaal Eh Us Da Sahara Rehnda Sade Naal Naal Jadon Assi Digge Sanu Us Ne Sambhaleya Sohne Piche Unan Sara Gham Dukh Sehna Ae Aashiqan Zahoori Kadon Thande Hoke Behna Ae Jinna Nun Wichone Wali Agg Ne Ubaleya Shan Wala Sohna Nabi Sada Lajpaal Eh Allahumma Salli Ala Sayyidina Muhammadin

৫৬৩

Shehr E Taiba Ke Chaman Ki Har Kalli Ki Khayr Ho

Shehr-E-Taiba Ke Chaman Ki Har Kalli Ki Khayr Ho. Mere Aaqa Ke Madine Ki Galli Ki Khayr Ho. Su-E-Taiba Jaa Rahe Hain Kafile Ushaaq Ke. Har Gadda-E-Mustafa Ki Hazri Ki Khayr Ho. Maangte Hain Khayr Aksar Log Apne Waste. Mustafa Ke Labb Pe Hai, Har Ummati Ki Khayr Ho. Aap Ke Siddique Ka Rutba Rahe Baala Sadda. Aap Ke Shabbir O Shabbar, Aur ‘ali Ki Khayr Ho. Jab Bilal-E-Basefa Ko Kafiron Ne Di Saza. Ishq Bola Tere Ashiq Ki Ashiqi Ki Khayr Ho Aap Ko Pohncha Diya Jab Ghaar Mein Siddique Ne. Khud Khuda Bola Tumhari Dosti Ki Khayr Ho. Karbala Mein Haqq Ada Tune Kiya Islaam Ka. Aaye ‘ali Ke Laal Teri Bandagi Ki Khayr Ho. Likh Rahe Hain Jo Sana-E-Mustafa, Nasir Sadda. Aise Saare Shayaron Ki Shayari Ki Khayr Ho. Shehr-E-Taiba Ke Chaman Ki Har Kalli Ki Khayr Ho. Mere Aaqa Ke Madine Ki Galli Ki Khayr Ho.

৫৬৪

Shore Mahe Nau Sun Kar Tujh Tak Main Dawaan Aaya

Shore Mahe Nau Sun Kar Tujh Tak Main Dawaa(N) Aaya Saaqi Main Tere Sadqe Mai De Ramaza Aaya Is Gul Ke Siwa Har Phool Baa Goshe Giraa(N) Aaya Dekhe Hi Gi Aye Bulbul Jab Waqte Fugaa(N) Aaya Jab Baame Tajalli Par Woh Nayyare Jaa(N) Aaya Sar Tha Jo Gira Jhuk Kar Dil Thanjo Tapaa(N) Aaya Jannat Ko Haram Samjha Aate To Yaha Aaya Ab Tak Ke Har Ik Ka Muh Kehta Hoo(N) Kahaa(N) Aaya Taiba Je Siwa Sab Baag Pamale Fana Honge Dekhoge Chaman Walo! Jab Ahde Khazaa(N) Aaya. Sar Aur Woh Sang-E-Dar Aankh Aur Woh Bazm-E-Noor, Zaalim Ko Watan Ka Dhyaan Aaya To Kahan Aaya. Kuch Naat Ke Tabqe Ka Aalam Hi Niraala Hai Sakte Me Padi Hai Aql Hairat Me Ghumaa(N) Aaya Jalti Thi Zamee Kaisi Thi Dhoop Kadi Kaisi Lo Woh Qade Be Saaya Ab Saaya Qunaa(N)aaya Taiba Se Hum Ate Hain Kahiye To Jinaa(N) Walo Kya Dekh Ke Jeeta Hai Jo Waa(N) Se Yaha(N) Aaya Le Tauqe Alam Se Ab Azad Ho Aye Kumri Chitthi Liye Bakhshish Ki Woh Sarve Rawa(N) Aaya Naame Se Raza Ke Ab Mit Jaao Bure Kaamo Dekho Mere Palle Par Ab Achche Miya(N) Aaya Badkaar Raza Khush Ho Badkaam Bhale Honge Woh Achche Miya(N) Pyara Achcho Ka Miya(N) Aaya

Shukr E Khuda Ki Aaj Ghari Us Safar Ki Hai

Shukr E Khuda Ki Aaj Ghari Us Safar Ki Hai Jis Par Nisaar Jaan Falaaho Zafar Ki Hai Garmi Hai Tap Hai Dard Hai Kulfat Safar Ki Hai Na Shukr Ye To Dekh Azeemat Kidhar Ki Hai Kis Khaaqe Paak Ki Tu Banee Taibah Rashk E Jinah Khuld Zaar Allah Allah Allah Jis Tarah Dekhiye Hai Bahar Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Allah Yahan Raat Deen Hai Farishte Utarte Mazar E Nabi Per Salam Arza Karte Merhaba Roza E Tajdar Allah Allah Allah Tabassum May Unke Hai Jannat Ki Kunji, Ishare May Unke Shafa-At Ki Kunji Shafa-O-Maunis-O Gamgushar Allah Allah Allah Sana Unki Aayat E Qur-An May Aayi, Unhi Ke Liye Rab Ne Duniya Banayi, Hai Wohi Rehmat-E-Kirdigar Allah Allah Shafa-At Ka Shehra Bandha Unke Sar Per, Kiya Rab Ne Unko Ataa Houz-E-Kausar, Unka Hai Khuld Per Ikhtiyar Allah Allah Allah Sabhi Ambiya Ko Hai Haajat Unhi Ki, Hai Bakshish Ka Saman Inayat Unhi Ki, Mere Aaqa Ki Hai Sab Bahar Allah Allah Allah Unhe Gaib Ka Ilm Rab Ne Diya Hai, Khazano Ka Mukhtar Unko Kiya Hai, Hai Wohi Qasim E Rozgar Allah Allah Allah Woh Mairaajwale, Wohi Raajwale, Woh Minhaajwale, Wohi Taajwale, Jannato Ke Wohi Sehr-E-Yaar Allah Allah Allah Sadaqat Unhi Ki, Adalat Unhi Ki, Sakhawat Unhi Ki, Shuja-At Unhi Ki Hai Wohi Taajwar Taajdar Allah Allah Allah Wohi Sarwar-E-Kishwar-E-Mursala Hai, Woh Mamdooh-E-Qur-An, Woh Ima-N Ki Jaan Hai, Unke Awsaf Hai Beshumar Allah Allah Allah Woh Ikhlaswale, Woh Ikhlaqwale, Woh Ejazwale, Woh Misaqwale , Shan-E-Rabzi Hashma Bawaqar Allah Allah Allah Fashat May Yakta Balagat May Yakta Nabuwat May Yakta, Risalat Yakta, Aap Hai Yaka-E-Rozgar Allah Allah Allah Padho Nazmi Unki Sana Padhte Jao, Har Ek Saans Salle Ala Padhte Jao, Wajda May Jhoomkar Bar-Bar Allah Allah Allah

৫৮০

Taj Walon Ke Saron Par Paye Aqdas Aap Ke

Taj Walon Ke Saron Par Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Main Bhi Choomon Ga Payambar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Aap Ke Qadmon Ke Neeche Narm Pathar Ho Gaye Kya Kahoon Allahu Akbar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Sust Aur Kamro Sawari Tez Ho Jati Wahin Jab Lagate Eik Thokar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Meri Qismat Bhi Khule Gi Mere Ghar Bhi Ayein Ge Dekhoon Ga Mein Zindagi Bhar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Is Liye Makkah Madina Ban Gaye Dono Haram Aa Gaye Jab Banda Parwar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Khak Pay-E-Mustafa Ki Khai Quran Ne Qasm Tayyib-O-Tahir Munawwar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Kya Makan Ho La Makan Tak Chap Hai Qadmain Ki Sidra-O-Raf Raf Se Uppar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke Hashr Tak Mit Ta Nahi Hai Mit Gaya Jo Aap Par Aye Ujagar Thaam Mit Kar Paye Aqdas Aap Ke

৫৮১

Tajdar E Haram Ho Nigah E Karam

Kismat Mein Meri Chain Se Jeena Likh De Doobe Na Kabhi Mera Safeena Likh De Jannat To Thikana Hai Maghar Duniya Mein Aye Katib E Taqdeer, Madina Likh De Tajdar E Haram, Hoo Nigah E Karam Hum Gareebon Ke Din Bhi Sanwar Jayenge Hamiy E Bay Kasa, Kya Kahe Ga Jahan App Kay Dar Se Khali Agar Jayenge Tajdar E Haram, Nigah E Karam Chashm E Rahmat Ba Khusha Sooh E Malandaz E Nazar Aie Quraishi La Khabi O Hashmi O Muttalabi Tajdar E Haram, Ho Nigaah E Karam Kya Tumse Kahoon Aie Rab Ke Kuwar Tum Jaanat Ho Mann Ki Battiyaa Dar Furqat Toh Aye Ummi Laqab Kaate Na Katak Hai Ab Ratiyaa Turi Preet Mein Sudh Bhudh Sab Bisri Kab Tak Ye Rahegi Be Khabri Daah E Ka Pigan Duzdi Da Nazar Kabhi Sun Bhi Toh Lo Humri Batiyaa Tajdar E Haram, Ho Nigaah E Karam Koi Apna Nahi Ghum Ke Maare Hain Hum Aap Ke Dar Pe Faryaad Laye Hain Hum Ho Nigah E Karam, Warna Chhokat Pe Hum Aap Ka Naam Le Le Ke Marjayenge Tajdar E Haram, Nigah E Karam Maikasho Aao Aao Madine Chalein Aao Madina Chalein Aao Madina Chalein... Chashm E Saakiye Kausar Se Peene Chalein Yaad Rakho Agar, Uth Gayi Ek Nazar Jitne Khaali Hain Sab Jaam Bhar Jayenge Tajdar E Haram, Nigah E Karam Khauf E Toofan Hai, Bijliyo Ka Hai Darr Sakht Mushkil Hai Aaqa Kidhar Jaye Hum Ap Hi Gar Na Lenge, Hamari Khabar Hum Museebat Ke Maare Kidhar Jayege Tajdar E Haram, Hoo Nigah E Karam Hum Gareebo Ke Din Bhi Sanwar Jayenge Tajdar E Haram, Ho Nigaah E Karam Tajdar E Haram, Nigah E Karam Tajdar E Haram, Karam Karam Mai Saahil Hoon Meri Auqaat Kya Hai Tum Aaqa Ho, Tumhari Baat Kya Hai Chashm-E-Rahmat-Ba-Khusha Soohe-Malan Daaz Nazar Aye Quraishi-La-Kabi Hasmhi-O-Muttalabi Tajdar-E-Haram, Ho Nigaah-E-Karam Kehna Saba Huzoor Se, Kehta Hai Ek Ghulam Bass Ek Nazar Ho, Ek Nazar Ka Sawaal Hai Ya Mustafa Sallealah, Ya Mustafa Sallealah Ya Mustafa Sallealah, Ya Mustafa Sallealah Phir Ujdiyon Ko Laal De, Jaan Paththaron Mein Daal De Haavi Ho Mustaqbil Pe Hum, Maazi Sa Humko Haal De Daawa Hai Teri Chaah Ka, Is Ummat-E-Gumraah Ka Tere Siva Koi Nahi, Ya Rahmat-Al-Lil-Alameen Ya Mustafa Sallealah, Ya Mustafa Sallealah Ya Mustafa Sallealah, Ya Mustafa Sallealah Ya Mustafa, Ya Mujtaba, Eraham-Lana, Eraham-Lana Dast-E-Hama, Bechara Ra Daama Tuhi, Pursa Tuhi Mann Aasiyam, Mann Ajizam Mann Bekasam, Haal-E-Mara Ya Shafaye, Roz-E-Jazaa Pursa Tuhi, Pursa Tuhi Aye Mushtub-E-Zambar Fishaan Paike Naseem-E-Sub Haram Aye Charagar Insanafas Aye Munise Beemar-E-Gham Aye Kaasid-E-Parkhundapaye Tujhko Usi Gul Ki Kasam Ibnil Tayari Has Saba Yauman Ila-Ar-Dil-Haram Ballib Salami Roza Tann Fi-Han Nabi-Al-Mohtaram Tajdar-E-Haram, Ho Nigaah-E-Karam Hum Ghareebon Ke Din Bhi Sanwarjayenge Haami-E-Bekasaan Kya Kahega Jahan Aapke Darr Se Khaali Agar Jayenge Tajalliyon Ki Ajab Hai Fazaa Madine Mein Nigah-E-Shauk Ki Hai Inteha Madine Mein Gham-E-Hayat Na Khauf-E-Khazaa Madine Mein Namaz-E-Ishq Karenge Adaa Madine Mein Idhar Udhar Na Bhatakte Phiro Khuda Ke Liye Barah-E-Raas Hai Raahe-E-Khuda Madine Mein Madine Chalen, Aao Madine Chalen Isi Mahine Chalen, Chalo Madine Chalen Maikashon Aao Aao Madine Chalen Dast-E-Saakhi-E-Kausar Se Peene Chalen Yaad Rakho Agar, Uthgayi Ek Nazar Jitne Khaali Hai Sabb Jaam Bharjayenge Tajdar-E-Haram, Ho Nigaah-E-Karam Aapke Darr Se Na Koi Khaali Gaya Apne Daaman Ko Bhar Ke Sawaali Gaya Ho Habeeb-E-Hazin Par Bhi Aaqa Nazar Warna Auraq-E-Hasti Bikhar Jayenge Tajdar-E-Haram, Ho Nigaah-E-Karam Taaaajdaaar-E-Harammm!!!!!

৫৮২

Tala Al Badru Alayna

Tala’al-Badru ‘alayna, Min Thaniyyatil-Wada’ Wajaba Al-Shukru ‘alayna, Ma Da’a Li Llahi Da’ English Translation: O The White Moon Rose Over Us From The Valley Of Wada’ And We Owe It To Show Gratefulness Where The Call Is To Allah Ayyuha Al-Mab’uthu Fina Ji’ta Bi-Al-Amri Al-Muta’ Ji’ta Sharrafta Al-Madinah Marhaban Ya Khayra Da’ English Translation: O You Who Were Raised Amongst Us Coming With A Work To Be Obeyed You Have Brought To This City Nobleness Welcome! Best Call To God’s Way

৫৮৩

Tamanna E Madina

Madina Madina, Madina Madina… Hai Itni Shadeed Ab To Tamanna E Madina Har Sans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Isne Bhi Madina Dekhliya, Usne Bhi Madina Dekhliya Sab Ne Hi Madina Dekhliya, Wo Din Bhi To Aye Mai Bhi Kahoon Maine Bhi Madina Dekhliya Har Saans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Raiyan Jaandeyan Shehr Madine Nun Sarkar Deya Mehmano Lae Pegham Mera Wi Jawin Nale Hanjuan Da Nazrana Aakhin Har Sans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Ae Baad E Saba Pegham Mora Sultan E Madina Ko Dijo Ke Har Sans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Bimaar Ko Ghaflat Hai Behosh Si Taari Hai Har Saans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Kadi Ave Ga Din Ya Rab Jadon Bat-Ha Nun Jawan Main Kadi Tehran Main Makke Wich Madina Ghar Banawan Main Na Khwahish Khuld Di Dil Wich Na Hooran Di Talab Mainu Eho Kaafi Ae Jannat Tere Kuche Nun Banawan Main Madine Waleya Main Nun Wikha Rasta Adine Da Bana Ke Pair Akhiyan Nun Te Sir De Bhaar Aawan Main Har Saans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Aqa Mere Aqa Mujhe Taiba Mein Bula Lo Sone Nahi Deti Hai Tamanna E Madina Har Saans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina Madina Madina, Madina Madina… Sukun Mile Ga Wahin Jab Madine Jaon Ga Par Sawal Yeh Hai Ke Main Kab Madine Jaon Ga Madina Madina, Madina Madina… Jindh Ghol Ghumawan Main Ik Wari Sad Sohneya Fir Murh Ke Na Awan Main Madina Madina, Madina Madina…. Hai Apna Kaam Madine Ki Aarzoo Rakhna Phir Unka Kaam Hai Jazbe Ki Aabroo Rakhna Madina Madina, Madina Madina Barri Hasrat Hai Tere Dar Utte Maththa Tek Da Tek Da Mar Jawan Eade Ishq Da Paal Ke Mach Sohna Wal Sekh Da Sekh Da Mar Jawan Painda Dooriyan Da Naal Hanjuan De Inj Meich Da Meich Da Mar Jawan Howe Waqt Akheer Te Mukh Sohna Tedha Wekh Da Wekh Da Mar Jawan Madina Madina, Madina Madina Koi Parde Chaliyan De Sanu Naqshe Nai Bhul De Taiba Diya Galiyan De Madina Madina, Madina Madina Mat Aur Kisi Shehr Ki Rudaad Sunao Shaida E Madina Hoon, Main Shaida E Madina Har Saans Se Aati Hai Sada Haaye Madina ------------------------------------------ -------------Other Version---------------- ------------------------------------------ Hai Itni Shadeed Ab To Tamanna E Madina Har Sans Se Aati Hai Sada Haae Madina Jaagun To Isi Dhun Mein Rahun Raat Gaye Tak So Jaaun To Khwabon Mein Nazar Aaye Madina Mat Aur Kisi Shaher Ki Rudad Sunao Shaida E Madina Hun Mein Shaida E Madina Makka Tu Bhi Afzal Hai Magar Itna Batade Har Shaher Se Bad Kar Muje Kyun Bhaye Madina Ho Jaae Ata Rakhte Safar Izne Safar Bhi Ho Jaae Karam Mujpe Ab Aaqa E Madina Khwahish Hai Ke Ab Jaake Na Lotun Mein Waha Se Nazish Muje Takdeer Jo Dikhlae Madina

৫৮৪

Tanam Farsooda Jaa Para

Tanam Farsooda Jaa Para Ze Hijra, Ya Rasulallah Dillam Paz Murda Aawara Ze Isyaa, Ya Rasulallah! My Body Is Dissolving In Your Separation And My Soul Is Breaking Into Pieces, Ya Rasulallah! Due To My Sins, My Heart Is Weak And Becoming Enticed, Ya Rasulallah! Choon Soo'e Mun Guzar Aari Manne Miskeen Zanaa Daari Fida-E-Naqsh-E-Nalainat Kunam Ja, Ya Rasulallah! When You Pass By Me Then Even In My Immense Poverty, Ecstatically, I Must Sacrifice My Soul On The Impression Of Your Blessed Sandal, Ya Rasulallah! Ze Jaame Hubb To Mustam Ba Zanjeere To Dil Bustam Nu'mi Goyam Ke Mun Bustum Sukun Daa, Ya Rasulallah! I Am Drowned In The Taste Of Your Love And The Chain Of Your Love Binds My Heart. Yet I Don't Say That I Know This Language (Of Love), Ya Rasulallah! Ze Kharda Khaish Hairaanam Siyaa Shud Roze Isyaanam Pashemaanam, Pashemaanam, Pashemaanam, Ya Rasulallah! I Am Worried Due To My Misdeeds; And I Feel That My Sins Have Blackened My Heart, Ya Rasulallah! I Am In Distress! I Am In Distress! I Am In Distress! Ya Rasulallah! Choon Baazoo'e Shafaa'at Raa Khushaa'i Bar Gunaagara Makun Mahruume Jaami Raa Daraa Aan, Ya Rasulallah! Ya Rasulallah! When You Raise Your Hands To Intercede For The Sinners, Then Do Not Deprive Jami Of Your Exalted Intercession.

৫৮৫

Taron Mein Roshni Mere Nabi Se Hai

Taron Mein Roshni Mere Nabi Se Hai Chanda Mein Chandi Mere Nabi Se Hai Kaliyon Mein Tazgi Mere Nabi Se Hai Phulon Mein Dilkashi Mere Nabi Se Hai Roshan Jahan Tha Kal Bhi Huzoor Se Yeh Noor Aaj Bhi Mere Nabi Se Hai Rangeen Yeh Jahan Tha Kal Bhi Huzoor Se Jannat Ka Husn Bhi Mere Nabi Se Hai Chumein Na Kyon Qadam Kaba Bhi Shauk Se Nisbat Bilal Ki Mere Nabi Se Hai Woh Jo Na Hon To Kuch Bhi Na Ho Jahan Mein Dunya Mein Zindagi Mere Nabi Se Hai Farooq Kyoun Kahon Main Khud To Kuch Nahi Izzat Hai Jo Meri Mere Nabi Se Hai

৫৮৬

Tera Khawan Main Tere Geet Gawan

Tera Khawan Mein Tere Geet Gawan Ya Rasulallah Tera Milad Mein Kyun Na Manawan Ya Rasulallah Halima Kar Kadi Wekhey Kadi Sarkar Nu Wekhey Mein Kedi Sej Tere Laiyy Sajawan Ya Rasulallah Mera Dil Wi Chonda Aye Tusi Mere Wi Ghar Aao Mein Kede Maan Thi Tennu Bulawan Ya Rasulallah Jagao Bhag Mere Wi Abu Ayyub De Wagoon Muqaddar Oas Da Kettho Le Aawan Ya Rasulallah Mein Kuj Wi Naeen Che Tere Naal Meri Koi Nisbat Naeen Mein Sab Kuchh Haan Che Mein Tera Sadawan Ya Rasulallah Suna Hai Aap Har Aashiq Ke Ghar Tashrif Late Hein Mere Ghar Mein Bhi Ho Jaye Charagan Ya Rasulallah Madine Paak De Andar Meri Ae Ho Ibadat Aye Tere Roze To Na Nazran Hatawan Ya Rasulallah ---------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------More--------------------------- May(N) Har Dum Teriyaa(N) Na’ataa(N) Sunaawa, Ya Rasoolallah Khuda Vi Teri Yaad Karta Sanaawa, Ya Rasoolallah Ajal De Au(N) To(N) Pehle Je Teri Deed Ho Jaave May(N) Aesi Maut To(N) Qurbaan Jaawaa(N), Ya Rasoolallah Jina Ne Tere Yaa(N) Qadmaa(N) Nu Sine Naal Laayaaey Nasiba Waliya(N) Ho(N)eeya Oththaawaa(N), Ya Rasoolallah Keve(N) Sud Aashna Tehrir Ho Jaaey Zahoori Di Qalam Jaami Daa(N) May(N) Kiththo Le Aawaa(N), Ya Rasoolallah

৫৮৭

Tera Naam Virde Zubaan Rahay

Tera Naam Virde Zubaan Rahay, Meri Aur Koi Dua Nahin Mujhay Apnay Dar Ki Bheek Day, Kay Teray Khazanay Main Kiya Nahin. Ho Karam Nawazi Huzoor Ki, Meray Ghamkaday Mein Bhi Aa Kabhi Meray Chara Ghar Aie Meray Nabi, Mera Koi Teray Siwa Nahin. Yeh Teray Niyazi Ki Eid Hai, Abhi Aur Hasratay Deed Hai Isay Choom Lenay Do Jaliyaan, Abhi Dil To Iss Ka Bhara Nahin. Rukhay Mustafa Hai Woh Aaina, Kay Ab Aisa Dusra Aaina Na Hamari Bazmay Khiyal Mein, Na Dukanay Aaina Saaz Mein. Tera Jalwa Paishay Nazar Rahay Tujhay Dekh Ker Mein Jiya Karoon Jahan Koi Teray Siwa Na Ho, Mein Ussi Faza Mein Raha Karoon. Rukhay Mustafa Woh Kitaab Hai, Jo Muhabatoon Ka Nisaab Hai Wohi Meray Paishay Nazar Rahay, Yehi Raat Din Mein Parha Karoon. Teri Yaad Meri Namaz Hai, Teri Yaad Gham Ka Woh Saar Hai Tera Shukar Rehmatay Do Jahan, Mein Karoon To Kaisay Aada Karoon. Jo Kabhi Naseeb Ho Hazri, To Milay Naseeb Ko Yawareen Teray Sangay Dar Pay Jhuka Kay Sir, Mein Namaz E Ishq Aada Karoon. Mujhay Apna Jalwa Dikhaye Ja, Meray Dil Mein Aakay Simaye Ja Mein Sharab E Marafat E Khuda, Tera Naam Lekay Piya Karoon.

৫৮৮

Teray Rowzay They Aawan Mey Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya

Teray Rowzay They Aawan Mey, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya Jali Aakhiyan Naal Lawan Mey, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya Wich Qabr Dey Aaja Lagiyan Towd Nibhaa Jana Tera Ummati Sada Waan Mey, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya Jad Waqt Naza Howey, Bas Teri Nigha Howey Tera Deedar Pawan Mey, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya Sadqah Shaane Kareemi Da Bharam Rakhna Naeemi Da Teriyan Ne’matan Sanawaan Mey, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya Sadqah Shaane Kareemi Da Bharam Rakhna Ham Sab Ka Teriyan Ne’matan Sunandey Rawa, Madinay Wich Rehn Waleya

৫৮৯

Tere Daamane Karam Mein Jise Neend Aa Gayi Hai

Tere Daamane Karam Mein Jise Neend Aa Gayi Hai Jo Fanaa Na Hogi Aisi Use Zindagi Mili Hai Mujhe Kya Padi Kisi Se Karu Arz Mudda`aa Mai Meri Lau To Bas Unhi Ke Dare Jood Se Lagi Hai Woh Jahaan Bhar Ke Daata Mujhe Pher Denge Khaali Meri Tauba Aye Khuda Ye Mere Nafs Ki Badi Hai Main Gunaahgaar Hu Aur Bade Martabo Ki Khwaahish Tu Magar Kareem Hai Jo Teri Banda Parwari Hai Jo Paye Sawaal Aaye Mujhe Dekh Kar Ye Bole Ise Chain Se Sulaao Ke Yeh Bandaye Nabi Hai Main Maru To Mere Maula Ye Malaaika Se Keh De Koi Is Ko Mat Jagaana Abhi Aankh Lag Gayi Hai Teri Yaad Thapki Dekar Mujhe Ab Shahaa Sulaa De Mujhe Jaagte Hue Yoon Badi Der Ho Gayi Hai Aye Naseeme Kooye Jaana Zaraa Sooye Bad Naseebaan Chali Aa Khuli Hai Tujh Pe Jo Humaari Bekasi Hai Tera Dil Shikastah Akhtar Isi Intizaar Mein Hai Ke Abhi Naweede Waslat Tere Dar Se Aa Rahi Hai

৫৯০

Tere Ishq Di Dolat Mil Jaye

Tere Ishq Di Dolat Mil Jaye Duniya Di Dolat Ki Karnii Tere Dar Di Gadai Mil Jawe Shahi Di Shokat Ki Karni Iho Aarzu Mere Seene Wich Mar Jiwan Sheher Madine Wich Bane Qabr Madine Wich Meri Ithon Di Turbat Kii Karnii Mil Jawe Madine Diya Galiyan, Ja Rob Kashi Leyi Je Mainu Aisi Khidmat Wich Barri Azmat Hai, Shahaa Di Khidmat Ki Karni Jindi Naal Tu Raazi, Rab Raazi Jindie Naal Khafa Tuun Rab Wi Khafa Teri Chahat Andar Sub Kujj Hy Kisi Or Di Chahat Kii Karnii Rahway Merey Labaan Te Teri Sana Mera Dil Wi Rahway Tera Madha Sara Parhaan Naatan Teriyan Har Wailay Kisi Or Di Midhat Ki Karni Iho Aarzu Riaz Di Aey Iho Aarzu Puri Ho Jaway Rahwan Zikr Tera Karda Har Dam Kise Wele Di Fursat Ki Karni Tere Ishq Di Dolat Mil Jaye Duniya Di Dolat Ki Karni Tere Darr Di Gadaai Mil Jaye Shahi Di Shokat Ki Karni…

৫৯১

Tere Karam Ke Agey

Tere Karam Ke Agey Meri Zaat Kuch Nahi Hai Tu Hai Karam Ka Data Tere Darr Pey Chandni Hai Tera Darr Hai Mera Kaba Tera Kucha Meri Jannat Tere Chehre Ki Tilawat Aqa Mera Hajje Akbari Hai Tere Naam Se Ey Aqa Mujhe Janti Hai Dunya Tere Naam Ki Badolat, Aqa Mera Kaam Chal Raha Hai Meri Laaj Rakhne Wale Meri Laaj Ko Nibhana Teri Ik Nazar Ke Sadqey, Aqa Meri Baat Ban Gayi Hai Kahan Teri Shaan Aali Kahan Mujhsa Yeh Sawali Mujhe Dard Dene Wale, Aqa Teri Banda Parwari Hai Tere Naam Ne Ata Ki Hai Bheek Mustafa Ki Isi Bheek Per O Saifi Tera Naam Chal Raha Hai Ishqe Nabi Mein Barsen Pal Pal Unhi Ko Tarsen Rehna Faqat Unhi Ka Bimaar Chahti Hai Kya Shan Beyniazi Haq Ne Tujhe Ata Ki Tere Darr Ka Jo Bhikari Dunya Ka Voh Wali Hai Tu Chahe Jise Dey De Mehboob Teri Marzi Mukhtar Banaya Hai Tujhe Apne Khazanon Ka Jis Jis Ko Pilai Hai Mere Aqa Ke Ankhon Se Voh Bhul Gaya Rasta Harr Ik Maikhane Ka Kuch Aisi Pila Dalo, Murshid Beykhud Bana Dalo Jo Dekhe Kahe Mujhko Yeh Hai Mera Diwana Bhar Bhar Ke Pilaya Hai Mastanon Ko Ey Murshid Us Jaam Ke Kuch Qatrey Mujh Ko Bhi Pila Jana Hai Tu Chum Ley Kalion Ko Kafuri Honton Se Andaz Sikhaya Hai Khud Rab Ne Jagane Ka Ik Parda Uthao Na, Ya Rasulallah Ik Jalwa Dikhao Na Is Shauqe Mohabbat Ne Harr Raat Jagaya Hai

৫৯২

Tere Naam Pe Waaru Jaan Ya Rasoolallah

Tere Naam Pe Waaru Jaan Ya Rasoolallah Ye Naara Pyara Lagta Hai, Ye Naara Pyara Lagta Hai Har Mehfil Me Ye Sajta Hai Mere Maslak Ki Pehchan Ya Rasoolallah Lo Jhoom Ke Naam Muhammad Ka Ye Naam Suhana Lagta Hai Is Naam Se Raunaq Hoti Hai Purnoor Zamaana Lagta Hai Hai Dil Ki Ziya Aankhon Ki Chamak Is Naam Me Hai Kuch Aisi Mahak Imaan Ko Mu’attar Kar Jaye Khushboo Ka Khazana Lagta Hai Jo Arsh Pe Ahmed Kehlaye Wo Zaate Muhammad Hai Beshak Mehmood Aur Haamid Mere Nabi Hasnain Ka Naana Lagta Hai Ye Naam Waseela Bakshish Ka La Raib Zariya Barkat Ka Wo Khulqe Azeem Allah Allah Jo Sabse Yagana Lagta Hai Taha Bhi Wahi Yaseen Bhi Wahi Wo Bashir-O-Nazeer Hai Salle Ala Barkat Ka Khazina Naam E Nabi Har Roz Shabana Lagta Hai Naato Ki Sajate Hai Mehfil Padhte Hai Salaamo Ke Nagme Jab Jab Bhi Liya Hai Naame Nabi Kya Khoob Tarana Lagta Hai Kya Wasf Likhe Rizwan Unka Hai Jinka Khuda Khud Madha Sara Kuch Husne Amal To Paas Nahi Bas Unka Deewana Lagta Hai Tere Naam Pe Waaru Jaan Ya Rasoolallah Ye Naara Pyara Lagta,ye Naara Pyara Lagta Hai Har Mehfil Me Ye Sajta Hai Mere Maslak Ki Pechan Ya Rasoolallah

৫৯৩

Tere Roze Te Awan Main Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya

Tere Roze Te Awan Main, Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya Tere Sadqe Jawan Main, Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya Ponch Jawan Je Tere Dawar-E-Shaha Sabz Gumbad De Wekhan Nazare Shaha Mana Thandian Chawan Main Madine Sanu Sad Sonhneya Arzan Sun Gade Ajiz Kamine Diyan Wekhan Raj Raj Ke Galiyan Madeene Diyan Ro Ro Tarle Pawan Main Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya Ki Karan Kol Shae Nai Koi Wechan De Lai Dil Bada Tarsda Roza Wekhan De Lai Tarsda Mar Na Jawan Main Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya Madni Mahi Sajan Diyan Sun Zariyan Beet Mudatan Gaiyan Aiyan Nai Wariyan Aa Ke Arzan Sunawan Main Madine Sanu Sad Sohneya

Raoshan Talwa La Ilaha Illallah Hasbi Rabbi Jallallah Maafi Qalbi Ghairullah Noor E Muhammad Sallallah La Ilaha Illallah Pehle Musalmano Par Wo Zulm-O-Tashadud Karte The Shere Rab Me Rehte The Par Boot Ki Ibadat Karte The Ahle Kufar Ko Macca Se Bhaag Ne Ka Rasta Na Mila Charo Taraf Jab Goonj Utha La Ilaha Illallah Hasbi Rabbi Jallallah Maafi Qalbi Ghairullah Noor E Muhammad Sallallah La Ilaha Illallah Kehne Laga Abu Jahal Ke Hum Kabe Me To Jate Hai Boot Khane Me Mere Bhala Aap Kyun Nahi Aate Hai Aap Ne Paak Khadam Ko Jab Boot Khane Me Tha Rakha Bol Uthe Sab Jhoote Khuda La Ilaha Illallah Hasbi Rabbi Jallallah Maafi Qalbi Ghairullah Noor E Muhammad Sallallah La Ilaha Illallah Aap Waqar-E-Deen E Mubeen Aap Sa Aaqa Koi Nahi Aap Ke Hi Hai Zair-E-Nadi Chahe Falak Ho Chahe Zameen Aap Se Aalam Mehek Utha Khatm Hui Zulmat Ki Ghata Bacha Bacha Kehne Laga La Ilaha Illallah Hasbi Rabbi Jallallah Maafi Qalbi Ghairullah Noor E Muhammad Sallallah La Ilaha Illallah Lab Par Naat-E-Paak Ka Naghma Kal Bhi Tha Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Mere Nabi Se Mera Rishta Kal Bhi Tha Aur Aaj Bhi Hai Aap Jo Aaye Duniya Me Kufr Ki Zulmat Door Hui Noor Jahan Me Phelgaya La Ilaha Illallah Hasbi Rabbi Jallallah Maafi Qalbi Ghairullah Noor E Muhammad Sallallah La Ilaha Illallah

৫৯৫

Teri Jaaliyoun Ke Niche

Teri Jaaliyoun Ke Niche Teri Rehmatoun Ke Saaye Jise Dekhni Ho Jannat, Wo Madina Dekh Aye Lo Chala Houn Main Lahad Mein Mere Mustafa Se Keh Do Ke Hawa Teri Gali Ki Mujhe Chorne To Aye Roze Ke Samne Mein Ye Dua’aen Mangtha Tha Meri Jaan Nikal To Jaye Ye Samaan Badal Na Jaye Taiba Ko Jaane Wale Tujhe Deta Houn Dua’aen Dar-E-Mustafa Pei Ja Kar To Jahan Ko Bhul Jaye Kaisi Wahan Ki Raatein Kaisi Wahan Ki Baatein Unnhe Poch’ Lo Nabi Ka Jo Madina Dekh Aye Na Ye Baat Shaan Se Hai Naa Yee Baat Maal-O-Zar Ki Wohi Jata Hai Madine Aqa Jisse Bulaye Wahi Ghaam Ghusaar Mera Wo Zahoori Yaar Mera Meri Qabar Par Jo Aa Ke Naat Nabi Sunaye

৫৯৬

Teri Wehshaton Se Ae Dil Mujhe Kyun Na Aar Aaye

Teri Wehshaton Se Ae Dil Mujhe Kyun Na Aar Aaye Tu Unhi Se Door Bhage Jinhein Tujh Pe Pyaar Aaye Dam-E-Iztirab Mujhko Jo Khayal-E-Yaar Aaye Mere Dil Main Chain Aaye,to Isse Qarar Aaye Na Habeeb Se Muhib Ka Kahin Aisa Pyaar Dekha Woh Bane Khuda Ka Pyaara, Tumhen Jiss Pe Pyaar Aaye Mujhe Kiya Ho Gham Alam Ka,mujhe Kiya Ho Gham Alam Ka Ke Ila'aj Gham Alam Ka,mere Gham Gusa'ar Aaye Jo Chaman Banaye Ban Ko, Jo Jina'a Kare Chaman Ko Mere Baagh Main Ilahi, Kabhi Woh Baha'ar Aaye Sabab-E-Gufoor-E-Rehmat Meri Bezubaniyan Hain Na Fuga'an Ke Dhang Jaano'n, Na Mujhe Pukaar Aaye Teri Rehmaton Se Kam Hain, Mere Jurm Iss Se Za'aid Na Mujhe Hisaab Aaye,na Mujhe Shuma'ar Aaye Tere Sadqe Jaaye Sha'aha Yeh Tera Zaleel Mangta Woh Waqar Le Ke Jaaye Jo Zaleel-O-Khwar Aaye Woh Kareem Hain Yeh Sarwar Ke Likha Howa Hai Dar Par Ke Jisse Lene Hon Do Ala'am Woh Umeed Waar Aaye Tere Dar Ke Hain Bhikari, Mile Khair Dam Ha Dam Ki Tera Naam Sun Ke Da'ata, Hum Umeed Waar Aaye

৫৯৭

Thandi Thandi Hawa Rehmatoon Ki Chali

Thandi Thandi Hawa Rehmatoon Ki Chali Ban Ke Mouj E Karam, Mustafa Aa Gaye. Hal Meri Ho Gayein Khud Ba Khud Mushkalein Saray Aalam Kay Mushkil Kusha Aa Gaye Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye… Amina Ka Muqadar Sanwara Gaya Goud Main Chand Jiski Utara Gaya Hoor O Ghulman Salami Ko Jhuknay Lage Partay Rizwan Salle Ala Aagaye. Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye… Dono Aalam Ki Kismat Badalne Lagi Noor Main Sari Konain Dhalne Lagi Khush Muqadar Halima Mubarak Tujhe Goud Mein Teri Khirul Wara Aagaye. Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye… Ban Gayi Hai Zameen Rashk E Bagh E Jinnah Sajh Gaye Asman Khil Utha Gul Sitan Mang Lo Rehmatein Khol Lo Jholiyan Denay Khairat Hajat Rawan Aagaye. Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye… Aaj Koi Bhi Sa’im Na Khali Rahe Sab Muradein Milein Har Musibat Talay Madni Aaqa Ki Aamad Ka Sadqa Mile Bheek Leney Ko Hum Ya Khuda Aagaye. Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye… Thandi Thandi Hawa Rehmatoon Ki Chali Ban Ke Mouj E Karam, Mustafa Aa Gaye. Hal Meri Ho Gayein Khud Ba Khud Mushkalein Saray Aalam Kay Mushkil Kusha Aa Gaye Aagaye Aagaye Mustafa Aagaye…

৫৯৮

There Was Merriment And Joy (Madinah Tun Nabi)

There Was Merriment And Joy A Smile On The Face Of Every Girl And Boy The Streets Of Yathrib Welcomed In The Prophet Of Allah Muhammad, Salla Allahu ‘alayhi Wa Sallim A Full White Moon Shone Down Upon The Land Rising From The Valley Between The Hills Of Sand Being Grateful To Allah Was The Prophet’s Demand Spreading Peace Through The Streets Of Madinah Madinah Tun-Nabi! Madinah Tun-Nabi! The City Of The Prophet Is Like Home To Me! I’ll Travel Through The World, But I Doubt That I Will See A City With Such Wonder As Madinah Now The Narrow Winding Roads Are So Full Of History Streets Shake With The Adhan From Masjid Un-Nabi I Feel The Shadow Of The Prophet Gently Cooling Me As I Walk Through The Streets Of Madinah Madinah Tun-Nabi! Madinah Tun-Nabi! The City Of The Prophet Is Like Home To Me! I’ll Travel Through The World, But I Doubt That I Will See A City With Such Wonder As Madinah The Man Who Reads Qur’an ‘neath A Date Palm Tree And The Smile From The Child On The Street Selling Tea Enchant Me With Their Beauty And Their Simplicity As I Walk Through The Streets Of Madinah Madinah Tun-Nabi! Madinah Tun-Nabi! The City Of The Prophet Is Like Home To Me! I’ll Travel Through The World, But I Doubt That I Will See A City With Such Wonder As Madinah Al Madinatul Munawarah! Oh Englightened City! Al Madinatul Munawarah, Even In My Sleep You Call To Me! Time Has Hurried By, Time Has Travelled On So Fast And Though Wisdom And Truth Will Always Last I Wish, I Wish, I Wish, That I Could Climb Into The Past… …and Live With The Prophet In Madinah! Madinah Tun-Nabi! Madinah Tun-Nabi! The City Of The Prophet Is Like Home To Me! I’ll Travel Through The World, But I Doubt That I Will See A City With Such Wonder As Madinah My Heart Is Never Far From The Home Of The Ansar And The City Of The Prophet, Al-Madinah.

৫৯৯

Thi Arsh Pe Ahmed Ki Rasayi Shabe Meraj

Thi Arsh Pe Ahmed Ki Rasayi Shabe Meraj Khaliq Ki Hui Jalwa Numayi Shabe Meraj Kuch Aisi Hui Jalwa Numayi Shabe Meraj Shaida Thi Muhammad Pe Khudayi Shabe Meraj Jo Chaha Nabi Ne Kiya Manzoor Khuda Ne Har Baat Muhammad Ki Ban Aayi Shabe Meraj Saath Aana Sake Roohul Amee(N) Bhi To Waha Tak Aaqa Ne Jaha Paayi Rasaayi Shabe Meraj Aaqa The Imaam Aur Nabi Sab The Musalli Ahmed Ne Namaaz Unko Padhayi Shabe Meraj

৬০০

Tooba Mein Jo Sab Sey Oonchi Naazuk Seedhi Nikli Shaakh

Tooba Mein Jo Sab Sey Oonchi Naazuk Seedhi Nikli Shaakh, Maangun Naat E Nabi Likhne Ko Rooh E Quds Se Aysi Shaakh. Mawla Gulbun Rahmat Zahra Sibtain Uski Kaliyan Phool, Siddique O Farooq O Usman O Haidar Har Ek Uski Shaakh. Shaakh E Qaamat Sheh Me Zulf O Chashm O Rukhsaar O Lab Main, Sunbul Nargis Gul Pankhariyan Qudrat Ki Kya Phooli Shaakh. Apne In Baaghon Ka Sadqa Woh Rahmat Ka Paani De, Jis Sey Nakhl E Dil Mein Ho Paida Pyaare Teri Wilaa Ki Shaakh. Yaad E Rukh Mein Aahein Kar Key Ban Mein Main Roya Aayi Bahaar, Jhoomein Naseemein Nisaan Barsa Kaliyan Chatkein Mehki Shaakh. Zaahir O Baatin Awwal O Aakhir Zeb E Faroo’ O Zain E Usool, Bagh E Risaalat Mein Hay Tu Hi Gul Ghuncha Jar Patti Shaakh. Aal E Ahmad Khuzbiyadi Yaa Sayyad E Hamza Kun Madadi, Waqt E Khazaan E Umre E Raza Ho Barg E Huda Se Na Aari Shaakh

৬০১

৬০২

Tu Shamme Risalat Hain

Tu Shamme Risalat Hain A’alam Tera Parwana Tu Mahe Nubuvvat Hain Ay Jalwa E Janana Jo Saaqi E Kausar Ke Chehre Se Nikaab Uththe Har Dil Bane Maikhana Har Aankh Ho Paymana Dil Apna Chamak Utthe Imaan Ki Tal'at Se Kar Aankhein Bhi Noorani Ay Jalwa E Jaanana Kyu Zulfe Muambar Se Kooche Na Mahak Uthe He Panja Qudrat Jab Zulfo Ka Tere Shaana Tum Aye Chati Baazi Ronak Huwi Phir Taazi Kaaba Hua Phir Kaaba Kar Daala Tha Butt Khana Peete Hain Tere Dar Ka, Khate Hain Tere Dar Ka Pani Hain Tera Pani, Dana Hain Tera Dana Sarshar Ise Kar De Ik Jaam E Labalab Se Taa Hashr Rahe Saaqi Aabad Ye Maikhana Is Darr Ki Huzoori Hi Isyan Ki Dawa Thahri Hai Zehre Ma Aasi Ka Taibah Hi Shifa Khaana Har Phool Me Boo Teri Har Sham-A Me Zao Teri Bulbul Hai Tera Bulbul Parwaana Hai Parwaana Duniya Mein Hume Tum Ne Jab Apna Banaaya Hai Mehshar Me Bhi Keh Dena Yeh Hai Mera Deewana Gir Pad Ke Yaha Pohcha, Mar Mar Ke Ise Paya Chute Na Ilahi Ab, Sange Dare Jaana Na Sange Dare Jaana Hain, Thokar Na Lage Kisko Ay Kash Wo Sun Lete, Mujhse Mera Afsana Sange Dare Jaana Par, Karta Hu Jabee Sayi Sajda Na Samajh Najdi, Sar Deta Hu Nazrana Woh Kehte Na Kehte Kuch Woh Karte Na Karte Kuch Ay Kash Wo Sunn Lete Mujh Se Mera Afsana Sarkaar Ke Jalwon Se, Roushan Hain Dile Noori Ta Hashr Rahe Roshan, Noori Ke Ye Kaash Aana

৬০৩

Tum Chalo Hum Chale Sab Madine Chale

Tum Chalo Hum Chale Sab Madine Chale Jaanibe Taiba Sab Ke Safeene Chale Maikashon Aao Aao Madine Chale Baadaye Khuld Ke Jaam Peene Chale Zindagi Ab Sare Zindagi Aa Gayi Aakhri Waqt Hai Ab Madine Chale Unki Shaane Karam Ki Kashish Dekhiye Kaasa Le Kar Kaha Khusraweene Chale Jee Gaya Woh Madine Mein Jo Mar Gaya Aao Hum Bhi Waha Mar Ke Jeene Chale Khaake Taiba Mein Apni Jagah Ho Gayi Khoob Muzda Sunaaya Khushi Ne Chale Raahe Taiba Mein Jab Naatawaan Reh Gaye Dil Ko Kheencha Kaha Be Kalee Ne Chale Agle Pichle Sabhi Khuld Mein Chal Diye Roze Mehshar Kaha Jab Nabi Ne Chale Be Takalluf Shahe Do Jahan Chaldiye Sadagi Sai Kaha Jab Kisi Nai Chale Akhtar E Khasta Bhi Khuld Mai Chal Diya Jab Sadaa Di Use Murshidi Ne Chale

৬০৪

Tum Ko Mai Kya Batau Taiba Nagar Me Kya Hai

Tum Ko Mai Kya Batau Taiba Nagar Me Kya Hai Bakhshish Karam Ataa Hai Har Dard Ki Dawa Hai Mangta Ka Haat Uthne Se Pehle Hi Diya Hai Jo Manga Maine Unse Us Se Siwa Mila Hai Manzaara Qabri Us Par Waajib Meri Shafa’at Muzda Yeh Mustafa Ne Kya Khoob Hi Diya Hai Taiba Ki Har Gali Me Khusboo Basi Hai Unki Har Ek Gul Yaha Ka Dulha Bana Huwa Hai Baadal Umad Ke Aaye Jal Thul Huwa Madina Rehmat Ka Ek Ishara Aaqa Ne Jab Diya Hai Hai Qiblatain Me Woh Ulfat Ka Raaz Wallah Qibla Wahi Hai Jisme Mehboob Ki Raza Hai Qadmain Me Joh Baitha Khudse Hi Poochta Hai Jannat Yeh Gar Nahi Hai Batlao Aur Kya Hai Sarkar Fir Bulana Jaisa Bhi Hu Nibhana Yeh Aaj Waqt E Rukhsat Rizwan Ki Duwa Hai

৬০৫

Tum Pe Qurbaan Bulaane Waale

Tum Pe Qurbaan Bulaane Waale Bakhte Khufta Ko Jagaane Waale Naar E Dozakh Ka Nahin Khauf Mujhe Woh Salaamat Hai Bachaane Waale Koi Pooche Yaa Na Pooche Mujhko Shaah E Taiba Hai Nibhaane Waale Garmi – E – Hashr Se Ghabraaye Kyun Woh Hai Daaman Mein Chupaane Waale Tere Sadqe Me Meyri Baat Bani Khoty Sikke Ke Chalaane Waale Kaif Jannat Ka Milaa Dar Pe Tere Kyaari Jannat Ki Dikhaane Waale De Ke Lena Nahi Aadat Teri Mujhko Jannat Me Bithaane Waale Hai Mareezon Ki Shifaa Na’at E Nabi Woh He Burdah Ke Urhaane Waale Sharbat E Deed Pilaado Aaqa Jaam E Kausar Ke Pilaane Waale Ilm E Naaf’i Ki Mile Bheek Mujhe Rab Ki Ne’mat Ke Lutaane Waale Hogayi Qabr Munawwar Meri Rukh E Anwar Ke Dikhaane Waale Ho Gayi Phir Se Mayassar Chowkhat Mujhko Qadmon Me Bithaane Waale Ban Gaye Mere Yahaan Bigde Kaam Tum Ho Roton Ko Hansaane Waale Kufr Kaafir Se Chutaa Mulk E Hijaaz Sham’e Tauheed Jilaane Waale Phir Chalaa Hoon Main Watan Ki Jaanib Jald Bulwaana Bulaane Waale Shakir E Razvi Pe Hai Khaas Karam Kehte Hai Ab To Zamaane Waale

৬০৬

Tumhara Naam Musibat Mein Jab Liya Hoga

Tumhara Naam Musibat Mein Jab Liya Hoga Hamara Bigda Huwa Kaam Bann Gaya Hoga Gunahgaar Pe Jab Lutf Aapka Hoga Kiya Bagair Kiya Be-Kiya Kiya Hoga Khuda Ka Lutf Huwa Hoga Dastageer Zaroor Jo Girte Girte Tera Naam Le Liya Hoga Dikhayi Jayegi Mehshar Mein Shaan E Mehboobi Ke Aap Hi Ki Khushi Aapka Kaha Hoga Khuda E Paak Ki Chahenge Agle Pichle Khushi Khuda E Paak Khushi Unki Chahta Hoga Kisi Ke Paanv Ki Bedi Ye Kaat-Te Honge Koyi Aseer E Gham Unko Pukarta Hoga Kisi Taraf Se Sada Aayegi Huzoor Aao Nahi To Damm Mein Ghareebo Ka Faysla Hoga Kisi Ke Palle Pe Ye Honge Waqt E Wazn E Amal Koyi Ummeed Se Muh Unnka Tak Raha Hoga Koyi Kahega Duhayi Hai Ya Rasoolallah To Koyi Thaam Ke Daman Machal Gaya Hoga Kisi Ko Le Ke Chalenge Firishte Suwe Jaheem Woh Unka Raasta Phir Phir Ke Dekhta Hoga Shikashta Pa Hu Mere Haal Ki Khabar Kar Do Koyi Kisi Ye Ro Ro Ke Keh Raha Hoga Khuda Ke Waaste Jald Unse Arz E Haal Karo Kise Khabar Hai Ke Damm Bhar Mein Haaye Kya Hoga Pakad Ke Haath Koyi Haal E Dil Sunayega To Ro Ke Qadmo(N) Se Koyi Lipat Gaya Hoga Zaban Sukhi Dikha Kar Koyi Lab E Kausar Janaab E Paak Ke Qadmo Pe Gir Gaya Hoga Nishaan E Khushrave Di Door Ki Ghulamo Ko Liwaye Hamd Ka Parcham Bata Raha Hoga Koyi Qareeb E Tarazu Koyi Lab E Kausar Koyi Siraat Se Unko Pukaarta Hoga Ye Beqaraar Karegi Sadaa Ghareebo Ki Muqaddas Aankhon Se Taar Ashq Ka Bandha Hoga Wo Paak Dil Ke Nahi Jisko Apna Andesha Hujoom E Fiqr O Taraddud Mein Ghir Gaya Hoga Hazaar Jaan Fida Narm Narm Pau Se Pukaar Sun Ke Aseero(N) Ki Daudta Hoga Azeez Bachhe Ko Maa(N) Jis Tarah Talaash Kare Khuda Gawah Wahi Haal Aapka Hoga Khudayi Bhar Inhi Haathon Ko Dekhti Hogi Zamana Bhar Inhi Qadmo(N) Pe Laut-Ta Hoga Bani Hai Damm Pe Duhayi Hai Taaj Waale Ki Ye Ghul Ye Shour Ye Hungame Ja-Ba-Ja Hoga Maqaam Faasilo(N) Par Kaam Mukhtalif Itne Ye Din Zuhoor E Kamaal E Huzoor Ka Hoga Kahenge Aur Nabi 'iz Habu Ila Gayri' Mere Huzoor Ke Lab Par 'ana Laha' Hoga Dua E Ummate Badkaar Wird E Lab Hogi Khuda Ke Saamne Sajdeh Mein Sarr Jhuka Hoga Ghulam Unki Inayat Se Chayn Mein Honge Aduu Huzoor Ka Aafat Mein Mubtala Hoga Main Unke Dar Ka Bhikari Hu Fazl E Maula Se Hasan Faqeer Ka Jannat Mein Bistara Hoga

৬০৭

Tumhare Joodo Karam Ka Koi Hisaab Nahi

Tumhare Joodo Karam Ka Koi Hisaab Nahi Tumhare Husn Ka Jag Me Koi Jawaab Nahi Ataa Kiya Jo Khuda Ne Tumhe Mere Aaqa Yaqeenan Uski Tarah Aur Koi Kitaab Nahi Tumhare Qadmon Me Dono Jahaan Ki Behbood Tumhare Dar Se Phira Jo Wo Kaamyaab Nahi Tumhi Habeeb Ho Rab Ke Tumhe Chuna Rab Ne Tumhari Misl Shaha Koi Intekhaab Nahi Tumhare Dar Pe Mila Phir Se Haziri Ka Sharaf Sukoon Zahn Me Hai Dil Me Izteraab Nahi Magar Ye Kooch Ka Manzar To Hai Qayamat Khaiz Ke Aankhen Nam Hain Aur Is Dil Ko Ab Hai Taab Nahi Jo Apni Jaame Jam Aankhon Se Wo Pilate Hain Jahaa Me Uski Tarah To Koi Sharaab Nahi Karaya Deed Unhe Jaagte Me Aaqa Ne Raza Ke Ishq O Mahabbat Ka Koi Jawab Nahi Shifa Ali Ko Ho Aashobe Chashm Se Fauran Luaabe Aaqa Ke Jaisa Koi Luaab Nahi Jo Chashma Aaqa Ki Ungli Se Ho Gaya Jari Jahaan Me Us Ki Tarah Aur Koi Aab Nahi Ghulamiye Shahe Kaunain Me Jo Milta Hai Kisi Bhi Kaam Me Aisa Koi Sawaab Nahi Unhi Ka Noor Hai Maaho Fataab Me Shakir Hai Jag Me Kuun Jo Is Dar Se Faizyaab Nahi

৬০৮

Tumhare Zarre Ke Partau Sitaarhaye Falak

Tumhare Zarre Ke Partau Sitaarhaye Falak Tumhare Na’al Ki Naqis Misal Ziyaae Falak Agarche Chaale Sitaro Se Pad Gaye Laakhon Magar Tumhari Talab Me Thake Na Paaye Falak Sare Falak Na Kabhi Taab Aastaa(N) Pahucha Ki Ibtidaaye Bulandi Thi Intihaaye Falak Ye Mitke Unki Ravish Par Hua Khud Unki Ravish Ki Nakshe Paaye Zamee(N) Par Na Saute Paaye Falak Tumhari Yaad Me Guzri Thi Jaagte Shab Bhar Chali Naseem, Hue Band Deedhaaye Falak Na Jaag Utthe Kahi(N) Ahle Baqi Kachchi Neend Chala Ye Narm Na Nikli Sadaye Paaye Falak Ye Unke Jalwe Ne Ki(N) Garmiya(N) Shabe Asra Ki Jab Se Charkh Mein Hain Nuqra-O Tilaaye Falak Mere Gani Ne Jawahir Se Bhar Diya Daaman Gaya Jo Kaasaye Mah Le Ke Shab Gadaaye Falak Raha Jo Qaane-A Yak Naane Sokhta Din Bhar Mili Huzoor Se Kaane Guhar Jazaaye Falak Tajammule Shabe Asra Abhi Simat Na Chuka Ki Jab Se Waise Hi Kotal Hain Sabzhaaye Falak Khitabe Haq Bhi Hai Dar Baabe Khalq Min Ajalik Agar Idhar Se Dame Hamd Hai Sadaaye Falak Ye Ahle Bait Ki Chakki Se Chaal Seekhi Hai Rawaa(N) Hai Be Madade Dast Aasitaaye Falak Raza Ye Naate Nabi Ne Bulandiya(N) Bakhshi Laqab 'zameene Falak' Ka Hua 'samaaye Falak'

৬০৯

Tumhari Hi Chaukhat Mera Ek Sahara

Tumhari Hi Chaukhat Mera Ek Sahara Tumhare Hi Tukdo Mein Mera Guzara Bhawar Mein Phasi Hai Ye Ummat Ki Kashti Ata Kardo Isko Khudara Kinara Mitey Dam Zadan Mein Mere Saare Iseeya Agar Aap Ek Baar Kardo Ishaara Mujhe Haath Uthhane Se Pehle Mila Hai Tumhi Ne Shaha Haal Mera Sawara Mujhe Kaash Aaye Mayyesar Wo Lamha Karu Main Shahe Ambiya Ka Nazara Guzaru Umar Khidmat E Deen Mein Ya Rab Karu Jaan O Dil Deen Ki Khatir Nisaara Mile Gar Madine Mein Do Gaz Zameen To Main Kar Bathu Saare Jaha Se Kinara Dam E Wapsi Jab Madine Mein Pohchu Na Lautu Main Su E Watan Phir Dobara Mere Mustafa Ab Karam Ki Nazar Ho Khada Hai Ye Chaukhat Pe Shakir Tumhara

৬১০

Uchiyan Ne Shaana Sarkaar Diyan

Uchiyan Ne Shaana Sarkaar Diyan, Sohne Man Mohne Manthaar Saare Nabi Ne Mere Nabi Toun, Thalle Thalle Mere Nabi Diyan Shaanan Balle Balle Rab Sohne Ne Ay Kainat Banayi Ai Yaar Di Khathir Saari Kaydh Rachai Ai Ghallan Bathan Saariyan Nai Piyar Diyan Sohne Man Mohne Manthaar Diyan Saare Nabi Ne Mere Nabi Toun, Thalle Thalle Mere Nabi Diyan Shaanan Balle Balle Mere Te Vi Keeta Karam Da Saya Ay, Main Je Mandre Nu Vi Seenai Laya Ay Lajpaaliyan Ne Sarkaar Diyan Uchiyan Nay Shaanan Sarkaar Diyan Saare Nabi Ne Mere Nabi Toun, Thalle Thalle Mere Nabi Diyan Shaanan Balle Balle Allah Di Rehmat Da Baddal Warya Ay, Mahe Rabi Ul Awwal Da Chand Chareya Ay Ruthan Aiyan Jagh Te Bahaar Diyan Sohne Man Mohne Manthaar Diyan Saare Nabi Ne Mere Nabi Toun, Thalle Thalle Mere Nabi Diyan Shaanan Balle Balle Jagh Saara Audi Aal De Sadke Pal Da Ai, Har Paasse Panjtan Da Langhar Chal Da Ay Lagiyan Nay Maujan Sansaar Diyan, Sohne Man Mohne Manthaar Diyan Saare Nabi Ne Mere Nabi Toun, Thalle Thalle Mere Nabi Diyan Shaanan Balle Balle

৬১১

Ummataan O Siyaah Kaarehaa

Door Az Kooye Saahib-E-Kausar, Chashm Daarad Che Ashkbaarehaa. Dar Firaaq-E-Tu Yaa Rasoolallah, Seenah Daarad Che Bey Qaraarehaa. Zulmat Aabaad-E-Gowr Raushan Shud, Daagh-E-Dil Raast Noor Baarehaa. Che Kunad Nafs Pardah Dar Mawlaa, Choon Tooyi Garm-E-Pardah Daarehaa. Sag-E-Kooye Nabi-O-Yak Nak-Hey, Man-O-Taa Hashr Jaan Nisaarehaa. Saufa Yu’teeka Rabbuka Tardaa, Haq Namoodat Che Paasdaarehaa. Daaram Aay Gul Bayaad-E-Zulf-O-Rakht, Sahar-O-Shaam Aah-O-Zaarehaa. Taa Zeh Lutf-E-Tou Bar Raza Har Dam, Marham-E-Kuhnah Dil Figaarehaa.

৬১২

Unki Jaame Jam Aankhen Sheesha Hai Badan Mera

Unki Jaame Jam Aankhen Sheesha Hai Badan Mera Unki Band Mutthii Me Saara Baakpan Mera Arze Gang Meri Hai Khittaye Jaman Mera Mai Gulame Khwaja Hu Hind Hai Watan Mera Aashiqe Nabi Hu Mai Warise Ali Hu Mai Maila Ho Na Payega Hashr Tak Kafan Mera Naate Mustafa Kehna Naate Mustafa Sunna Mujhko Bakshwayega Haa Yahi Chalan Mera Hashr Me Nida Hogi Yeh Gulam Kiska Hai Mujh Ko Dekhe Aur Kehde Ya Shahe Zaman Mera Arsh Jhoom Jhoom Utha Qudsiyo Ko Wajd Aaya Naate Mustafa Me Jab Khul Gaya Dahan Mera Taaqe Dil Pe Rakhi Hai Shamma Ishqe Ahmed Ki Noor Ki Shuaon Se Bhar Gaya Hai Man Mera Aap Chahe Ho Jaaye Saari Mushkile Aasan Aap Chahe Mit Jaaye Ranj Aur Mihan Mera Lamha Lamha Yaad Unki Saans Saans Zikr Unka Haan Yahi To Rehta Hai Aaj Kal Jatan Mera Maine Saare Kaam Apne Mustafa Ko Saupe Hai Kya Bigaad Payega Daure Pur Fitan Mera Waqfe Zikre Ahmed Ho Ta Abad Qalam Ya Rab Hashr Tak Rahe Jaari Chashma E Sukhan Mera Azmate Mere Aage Sajda Rez Ho Jaye Unke Dar Se Choo Jaye Kash Pairahan Mera Kab Talak Duhayi Doon Bekasi Ke Aalam Me Bhagya Kab Sanwarenge Paak Panjatan Mera Hashr Me Taraazu Par Tole Jayenge Aamal Kaam Aahi Jayega Naat Ka Ye Fan Mera Arsh Se Pare Jaakar Mustafa Ne Batlaya Ye Zamee Bhi Meri Hai Aur Hai Gagan Mera Gulshane Madina Se Nazmi Mujh Ko Nisbat Hai Ek Ek Kali Meri Gul Mera Chaman Mera

৬১৩

Unki Lagan Dil Me Basaenge

Unki Lagan Dil Me Basaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Naato Ki Mehfil Sajaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Ek Din Chalegi Gulamo Ki Toli Salle Ala Salle Ala Ki Hogi Booli Naat E Nabi Hum Gungunaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Aaqa Ke Shehr Me Khajuro Ki Chao Me Dil Kash Havao Me Muatar Fazao Me Chota Sa Ek Ghar Banaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Khusiyo Ke Ja Hai Koi Gham Nahi Hai Taiba Nagar Khuld Se Kam Nahi Hai Zam Zam Se Har Ghadi Nahaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Taiba Nagar Ke Kash Hum Ho Kabutar Minaar O Gumbad Hamara Jo Ho Ghar Roze Ka Phira Lagaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Parwaz Ko Baal O Par De De Ya Rab Naat Padhne Ka Hunar De Ya Rab Aaqa Ko Jakar Sunaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge Ek Roz Dundhegi Rehmat Bahana Apna Bhi Palte Ga Raahi Zamana Dil Ki Lagi Dar Par Bujhaenge Nabi Nabi Kehte Madina Chale Jayenge

৬১৪

Unki Mahak Ne Dil Ke Gunche Khila Diye Hai

Unki Mahak Ne Dil Ke Gunche Khila Diye Hai Jis Raah Chal Diye Kunche Basa Diye Hai. Jab Aa Gayi Hai Joshe Rehmat Per Unki Ankhen Jalte Buja Diye Hai, Rote Hansa Diye Hai. Ek Dil Hamara Kya Hai, Aazaar Uska Kitna Tumne To Chalte Phirte Murde Jila Diye Hai. Unke Nisar Koi Kaisi Hi Ranj May Ho Jab Yaad Aa Gaye Hai Sab Gam Bhoola Diye Hai. Humse Faqir Bhi Abb Feri Ko Oothte To Honge, Abb To Gani Ke Dar Pe Bistar Jama Diye Hai. Asra May Guzre Jis Dam Baide Pe Qudsiyo Ke Hone Lagi Salami Parcham Jhooka Diye Hai. Aane Do Ya Doobo Do Abb To Tumhari Jaanib Kasti Tumhi Pe Chhodi Lanagr Ootha Diye Hai. Dulha Se Itna Keh Do Pyare Sawari Roko Mushkil May Hai Baraati Purkhaar Wadiye Hai. Allah Kya Jahannam Abb Na Shard Hoga Ro Ro Ke Mustafa Ne Dariya Baha Diye Hai. Mere Karim Se Gar Khatra Kisi Ne Manga Dariye Baha Diye Hai Dur Be Baha Diye Hai Mulke Shuqan Ke Shahi Tumko Raza Mussllam Jis Simt Aa Gaye Ho Sikke Bitha Diya Hai

৬১৫

Utha Do Parda Dikha Do Chehra Ke Noore Baari Hijab Me Hai

Utha Do Parda Dikha Do Chehra Ke Noore Baari Hijab Me Hai Zamana Taarik Ho Raha Hai Ki Mehr Kab Se Nikaab Me Hai Nahi Wo Meethi Nigaah Waala Khuda Ki Rehmat Hai Jalwa Farma Ghazab Se Unke Khuda Bachaye Jalaal E Baari Etaab Me Hai Jali-Jali Bu Se Uski Paida Hai Sozish E Ishqe Chashme-Wala Kabaabe Aahu Me Bhi Na Paaya Maza Jo Dil Ke Kabaab Me Hai Unhi Ki Bu Maya E Saman Hai Unhi Ka Jalwa Chaman Chaman Hai Unhi Se Ghulshan Mehek Rahe Hai Unhi Ki Rangat Ghulab Me Hai Teri Julu Me Hai Maahe Taibah Hilaal Har Margo Zindagi Ka Hayaat Jaa(N) Ka Rikab Me Hai Mamaate A'ada Ka Daab Me Hai Siy(A)h Libasane Daare Duniya Wa Sabz-Poshane Arshe Aala Har Ik Hai Unke Karam Ka Pyasa Ye Faiz Unki Janaab Me Hai Wo Ghul Hai Lub-Haye Naazuk Unke Hazaaro Jhadte Hai Phool Jinse Ghulab Ghulshan Me Dekhe Bulbul Ye Dekh Ghulshan Gulaab Me Hai Jali Hai Soze Jigar Se Jaa(N) Tak Hai Taalib E Jalwa E Mubarak Dikha Do Wo Lab Ki Aab E Haiwa(N) Ka Lutf Jinke Khitaab Me Hai Khade Hai Munkar Nakeer Sarr Par Na Koi Haami Na Koi Yaavar Bata Do Aakar Mere Payamabar Ki Sakht Mushkil Jawab Me Hai Khuda E Kahhar Hai Ghazab Par Khule Hai Badd-Kariyo(N) Ke Daftar Bacha Lo Aa Kar Shafe'e Mehshar Tumhara Banda Azaab Me Hai Kareem Aisa Mila Ki Jiske Khule Hai Haath Aur Bhare Khazane Batao Ay Mufliso Ki Fir Kyu Tumhara Dil Izterab Me Hai Gunah Ki Tareekiya Ye Chayi Umad Ke Kaali Ghata-E Aayi Khuda Ke Khursheed Mehr Farma Ki Zarra Bas Ijteraab Me Hai Kareem Apne Karam Ka Sadqa La-Eeme Be Qadr Ko Na Sharma Tu Aur Raza Se Hisaab Lena Raza Bhi Koi Hisaab Me Hai

৬১৬

Wah Kya Joodo Karam Hain

Wah Kya Joodo Karam Hain Shahe Bat-Ha Tera Nahi Sunta Hi Nahi Maangne Waala Tera Dhaare Chalte Hain Ataa Ke Wo Hain Qatra Tera Tare Khilte Hain Sakhaa Ke Wo Hain Zar-Ra Tera Faiz Hain Ya Shahe Tasneem Nirala Tera Aap Pyaso Ke Tajas-Sus Me Hain Dariya Tera Agniyan Palte Hain Dar Se Wo Hain Bada Tera Asfiya Chalte Hain Sar Se Wo Hain Rasta Tera Farsh Waale Teri Shaukat Ka Uloo Kya Jaane Khusrava Arsh Pe Udta Hain Pharera Tera Aasmaan Khwan, Zameen Khwan Zamana Mehmaan Sahibe Khana Laqab Kiska Hain Tera Tera Main To Maalik Hi Kahunga Ke Ho Maalik E Habeeb Ya’ani Mehboobo Muheeb Me Nahi Mera Tera Tere Qadmo Me Jo Hain Ghair Ka Muh Kya Dekhe Kaun Nazro Pe Chadhe Dekh Ke Talwa Tera Bahre Sa-Il Ka Hu Sa-Il Na Kuwe Ka Pyasa Khud Bujha Jaye Kaleja Mera Cheeta Tera Chor Haakim Se Chupa Karta Hain Ya Uske Khilaf Tere Daamam Me Chupe Chor Anokha Tera Aankhein Thandi Ho Jigar Taze Ho Jaan-E-Sairaab Sachhe Suraj Wo Dil-Aara Hai Ujala Tera Dil Abas Khauf Se Patta Sa Uda Jaata Hai Palla Halka Sahi Bhari Hai Bharosa Tera Aik Main Kya Mere Isyaan Ki Haqeeqat Kitni Mujhse Sau Laakh Ko Kaafi Hain Ishara Tera Muft Paala Tha Kabhi Kaam Ki Aadat Na Padee Ab Amal Poochte Hain Haaye Nikamma Tera Tere Tukdo Se Pale Ghair Ki Thokar Pe Na Daal Jhidkiya Khaaye Kaha Chor Ke Sadqa Tera Khwaro Bimaro Khatavaro Gunahgaar Hu Main Rafe’ao Nafe’ao Shafe’a Lakab Aaqa Tera Meri Taqdeer Buri Ho To Bhali Karde Ki Hain Mahwo Isbaat Ke Daftar Me Kadoda Tera Tu Jo Chahe To Abhi Mayl Mere Dil Ke Dhule Ke Khuda Dil Nahi Karta Kabhi Mayla Tera Kiska Muh Takiye Kaha Jaiye Kis Se Kahiye Tere Hi Qadmo Pe Mitt Jaye Yeh Paala Tera Tu Ne Islam Diya Aaqa Tu Ne Jama’at Me Liye Tu Kareem Ab Koi Phirta Hain Atiyya Tera Maut Sunta Hu Sitam Talkh Hain Jahraaba-E Nab Kaun La De Mujhe Talwo Ka Ghusala Tera Door Kya Janiye Bad-Kaar Pe Kaise Guzre Tere Hi Dar Pe Mare Be-Kaso Tanha Tera Tere Sadqe Mujhe Ik Boond Bohat Hain Teri Jis Din Achho Ko Mila Jam Chalakta Tera Haram-O-Taibah Wa Baghdad Jidhar Kije Nigah Jyot Padti Hain Teri Noor Hain Chanta Tera Teri Sarkaar Me Laata Hain Raza Usko Shafe’a Jo Mera Ghous Hain Aur Laadla Beta Tera ----------------- Other ----------------- ---------------- Version ---------------- Koi Duniya E Ata Me Nahi Hamta Tera Ho Jo Hatim Ko Mayassar Ye Nazara Tera Keh Uthe Dekh Ke Bakhshish Me Ye Rutba Tera Wah Kya Joodo Karam Hai Shahe Batha Tera Nahi Sunta Hi Nahi Mangne Wala Tera. Kuch Bashar Hone Ke Naate Tujhe Khud Sa Jaane Aur Kuch Mahaz Payaami Hi Khuda Ka Jaane Inki Aukaat Hi Kya Hai Ke Ye Itna Jaane Farsh Wale Teri Shaukat Ka Uloo Kya Jaane Kusrawa Arsh Pe Udta Hai Pharera Tera. Kai Pushton Se Ghulami Ka Ye Rishta Hai Bahaal Yahi Tifli Aur Jawaani Ke Bitaaye Maho Saal Ab Budhape Me Khudara Hume Yoon Dar Se Na Taal Tere Tukdon Pe Pale Ghair Ki Thokar Pe Na Daal Jhidkiya Khaaye Kaha Chchod Ke Sadqa Tera. Ghame Dauran Se Ghabraiye To Kisse Kahiye Ab Apni Uljhan Kise Batlaiye Kisse Kahiye Cheer Kar Dil Kise Dikhlaiye Kisse Kahiye Kiska Muh Takiye Kaha Jaaiye Kisse Kahiye Tere Hi Qadmon Pe Mit Jaaye Ye Paala Tera. Nazre Ushshaqe Nabi Hai Ye Mera Harfe Ghareeb Mimbare Waaz Pe Ladte Rahe Aapas Me Khateeb Ye Aqeeda Rahe Allah Kare Mujh Ko Naseeb Mai To Maalik Hi Kahunga Ke Ho Maalik Ke Habeeb Yani Mehboobo Muhib Me Nahi Mera Tera. Tujh Se Har Chand Woh Hai Qadro Fazaail Me Rafee' Kar Naseer Aaj Magar Fikre Raza Ki Tausee' Paas Hai Uske Shafa'at Ka Waseela Bhi Waqee' Teri Sarkar Me Laata Hai Raza Usko Shafee' Jo Mera Gaus Hai Aur Laadla Beta Tera.

৬১৭

Wasf Kya Likhe Koi Us Mahbatey Anwaar Ka

Wasf Kya Likhe Koi Us Mahbatey Anwaar Ka Mehro Mah Me Jalwa Hai Jis Chand Se Rukhsar Ka Arshe Aazam Pe Pharera Hai Shahe Abraar Ka Bajta Hai Kaunain Me Danka Mere Sarkaar Ka Do Jahaan Me Bat’ta Hai Baada Usi Sarkaar Ka Dono Aalam Paate Hain Sadqa Usi Darbaar Ka Jaari Hai Atho Pahar Langar Saqi Darbaar Ka Faiz Par Har Dam Hai Dariya Ahmade Mukhtaar Ka Rozaye Waala E Taiba Makhzane Anwaar Hai Kya Kahu Aalam Me Tujh Se Jalwa Gaahe Yaar Ka Dil Hai Kiska Jaan Kiski Sab Ke Maalik Hai Wohi Dono Aalam Par Hai Qabza Ahmade Mukhtaar Ka Faq Ho Chehra Mehro Mah Ka Aise Muh Ke Samne Jis Ko Qismat Se Mile Bosa Teri Paizaar Ka Laat Mari Tumne Duniya Par Agar Tum Chahate Silsila Sone Ka Hota Silsila Kohsaar Ka Main Teri Rehmat Ke Qurban Aye Mere Amno Amaan Koi Bhi Pursa Nahi Hai Mujh Se Bad Kirdaar Ka Hai Ma'asi Had Se Bahar Phir Bhi Zahid Gham Nahi Rehmate Alam Ki Ummat Banda Hoon Ghaffar Ka Tu Hai Rehmat Baabe Rehmat Tera Darwaaza Hua Saaya E Fazle Khuda Saaya Teri Deewaar Ka Kaaba O Aqsa O Arsh O Khuld Hai Noorie Magar Hai Niraala Sab Se Aalam Jalwa Gaahe Yaar Ka

৬১৮

Wasfe Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hai

Wasfe Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hai, Shar-He Wash-Shamso Zuha Karte Hai Unki Hum Madd-Ho Sana Karte Hai, Jinko Mahmood Kaha Karte Hai Maahe Shak Gashta Ki Soorat Dekho, Kaap Kar Mehr Ki Raj'at Dekho Mustafa Pyare Ki Qudrat Dekho, Kaise Ayjaz Hua Karte Hai Tu Hai Khursheed E Risalat Pyare, Chup Gaye Teri Ziya Me Taare Ambiya Aur Hai Sab Mah-Paare, Tujhse Hi Noor Liya Karte Hai Ay Balaa Be Khirdi-E Kuffar Rakhte Hai Aise Ke Haq Se Inkaar Ki Gawahi Ho Gar Usko Darkaar Be Zabaa(N) Bol Utha Karte Hai Apne Maula Ki Hai Bas Shaan E Azeem, Jaanwar Bhi Kare Jinki Ta'azeem Sang Karte Hai Adab Se Tasleem, Ped Sajde Me Gira Karte Hai Rif'ate Zikr Hai Tera Hissa, Dono A'alam Me Hai Tera Charcha Murge Firdous Pas Az Hamde Khuda Teri Hi Madho Sana Karte Hai Ungliya Paayi Wo Pyari-Pyari, Jinse Dariya E Karam Hai Jaari Josh Par Aati Hai Jab Gamkhwari, Tishne Sairaab Hua Karte Hai Haa Yahi Karti Hai Chidiya(N) Fariyaad, Haa Yahi Chahti Hai Hirni Daad Isi Darr Par Shutrane-Naashaad Gil-E Ranjo Ana Karte Hai Aasti Rehmat E A'alam Ulte Kamare Paak Pe Daaman Baandhe Girne Waalo Ko Kucha E Dohzakh Se Saaf Alag Kheench Liya Karte Hai Jab Sabaa Aati Hai Taibah Se Idhar Khilkhila Padti Hai Kaliya(N) Yaksar Phool Jaama Se Nikal Kar Baahar Rukhe Rangi Ki Sana Karte Hai Tu Hai Wo Badshah E Kouno Makaa(N) Ki Malak Haft Falak Ke Har Aa(N) Tere Maula Se Shahe Arsh Aywa(N) Teri Daulat Ki Dua Karte Hai Jiske Jalwe Se Uhud Hai Taba(N) Ma'adane Noor Hai Uska Damaa(N) Hum Bhi Us Chand Pe Ho Kar Kurbaa(N) Dil E Sangi Ki Jila Karte Hai Kyo Na Zeba Ho Tujhse Taajwari Tere Hi Dam Ki Hai Sab Jalwa Gari Malako Jinno Bashar Huuro Pari Jaan Sab Tujh Pe Fida Karte Hai Toot Padti Hai Balaye Jin Par, Jinko Milta Nahi Koi Yaavar Har Taraf Se Wo Pur Armaa(N) Fir Kar Unke Daaman Me Chupa Karte Hai Lab Par Aa Jaata Hai Naam E Janaab Muh Me Ghul Jaata Hai Shahde Nayab Wajd Me Ho Ke Hum Ay Ja(N) Betaab Apne Lab Choom Liya Karte Hai Lab Pe Kis Muh Se Ghum E Ulfat Laye(N) Kya Bala Dil Hai Alam Jiska Sunaye Hum To Unke Kafe Paa Par Mitt Jaye Unke Darr Par Jo Mita Karte Hai Apne Dil Ka Hai Unhi Se Aaram Soupe Hai Apne Unhi Ko Sab Kaam Lou Lagi Hai Ke Ab Us Darr Ke Ghulam Chara-E Dard E Raza Karte Hai

৬১৯

Wo Meri Jaan Bhi Jaan Ki Jaan Bhi

Wo Meri Jaan Bhi Jaan Ki Jaan Bhi Wo Iman Bhi Rooh E Iman Bhi Mahbate Wahi-E-Aayate Quraan Bhi Aur Quraan Bhi Ruhe Quraan Bhi Kya Bataoon Qayamat Ka Main Majra Rehmato Ghaflato Ka Hai Ik Marka Dil Ko Unki Shafa'at Pe Iman Bhi Aqal Apne Kiye Par Pashemana Bhi Ik Din Naz Pe Aapne Yun Kaha Tu Bata Ta-Ire Sidaratul Muntaha Hai Tere Samne Aalame Kun-Faka Tune Payi Kisi Main Meri Shan Bhi Bole Yoon Hazrate Jibril Bhi Aiy Nigahe Masiyat Ke Zohra Jabi Ho Tera Misal Koi, Kabhi Aur Kahi Rab Ne Rakhkha Nahi Iska Imkan Bhi Unki Rehmat Pe Akhtar Dilo Jaa Fida Jinko Kahta Hai Sara Jaha Mustafa Go Meri Zindagi Unse Gafil Rahi Wo Na Gafil Rahe Mujhse Aik Aan Bhi

৬২১

Woh Nabiyon Main Rehmat Laqab Panay Wala

----------------------------------- Ya Rab-E-Mustafa Baligh Maqasidana Waghfirlana Mata Ya Wasi Alkarami Ya Bari An Nasami Woh Nabiyon Main Rehmat Laqab Panay Wala Muradein Ghareebon Ki Bar Lane Wala Musibat Main Ghairon Ke Kaam Aane Wala Woh Apne Paray Ka Gham Khane Wala Faqeeron Ka Malja, Zaeefon Ka Mawa Yatemoon Ka Wali, Ghulamon Ka Moula Khatakar Se Darguzar Kerne Wala Bad-Andesh Ke Dil Main Ghar Kerne Wala Mafasid Ka Zair-O-Zabar Kerne Wala Qabail Ko Sheer-O-Shakar Kerne Wala Utar Ker Hira Se Suy-E-Qoum Aaya Aur Ik Nuskha-E-Keemya Saath Laya Mas-E-Kham Ko Jis Ne Kundan Banaya Khara Aur Khota Alag Ker Dikhaya Arab, Jis Pay Karno Se Tha Jehal Chahya Palat Di Bas Ik Aan Main Un Ki Kaya Raha Daar Na Bairay Ko Mouj-E-Bala Ka Idher Se Udher Phir Huwa Rukh Hawa Ka Woh Fakhr-E-Arab, Zaib-E-Mehrab-O-Mimbar Tamam Alh-E-Makkah Ko Hamrah Le Ker Gaya Eik Din Hasb-E-Farman-E-Dawar Sooye Dasht Aur Charh Ke Koh-E-Safa Per Yeh Fermaya Sab Se Ke Ah Aal-E-Ghalib! Samajhte Ho Tum Mujh Ko Sadiq K Kazib? Kaha Sab Ne Qoul Aaj Tak Koi Tera Kabhi Hum Ne Jhoota Suna, Aur Na Dekha Kaha Gar Samajhte Ho Tum Mujh Ko Aesa To Bawar Karo Gay Agar Main Kahun Ga Ke Fouj-E-Giran Kusht-E-Koh-E-Safa Per Pari Hai Ke Loote Tumhe Ghat Pa Ker Kaha Teri Her Baat Ka Yun Yaqeen Hai Ke Bachpan Se Sadiq Hai Tu Aur Ameen Hai Kaha Gar Meri Baat Yeh Dil Nasheen Hai To Sun Lo Khilaf Is Main Islah Nahi Hai Ke Sab Qafla Yan Se Hai Jane Wala Daro Us Se Jo Waqt Hai Aane Wala Balaghal Ula Bikamalihi Kasha Fad Duja Bijamalihi Hasunat Jameeo Khisalihi Salo Alaihe Wa Aalihi ***************************************** ******************other****************** *****************version***************** ***************************************** Woh Nabiyon Main Rehmat Laqab Panay Wala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala Woh Nabiyon Main Rehmat Laqab Panay Wala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala Woh Sar Chashmai Noor-E-Fathghay Mubeen Hai Wohi Mash Anayra Hay Azmo Yakeen Hai Usey Say Hamaray Dilon Main Ujala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala Usey Kay Yeh Ham Par Hai Ahsaan Saray Kadam Manzelaain Chomtey Hain Hamaray Usey Ney Andhayron Say Ham Ko Nikala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala Sahara Diya Us Kay Naqshey Qadam Nain Usey Kee Tawajo Usey Kay Kadam Nain Zamanain Kay Girtay Houon Ko Sanbhala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala Usey Kee Mohabat Hai Iman-E-Kamil Usey Say Mila Hum Ko Irfan-E-Manzil Usey Nain Hamain Jada-E-Haq Pay Dala Usey Say Hai Islam Ka Bola Bala

৬২২

Woh Suye Lalazaar Phirte Hain

Woh Suye Lalazaar Phirte Hain Tere Din Aye Bahaar Phirte Hain Jo Tere Dar Se Yaar Phirte Hain Dar Ba Dar Yun Hi Khwaar Phirte Hain Aah Kal Aish To Kiye Hum Ne Aaj Woh Be Karaar Phirte Hain Unke Imaan Se Donon Baaghon Par Khaile Lailo Nahaar Phirte Hain Har Charaghe Mazaar Par Qudsi Kaise Parwana Waar Phirte Hain Us Gali Ka Gada Hoon Main Jisme Maangte Tajdaar Phirte Hain Jaan Hain Jaan Kya Nazar Aaye Kyun Adu Girde Gaar Phirte Hain Phool Kya Dekhu Meri Aankhon Mein Dashte Taiba Ke Khaar Phirte Hain Laakhon Qudsi Hain Kaame Khidmat Par Laakhon Girde Mazaar Phirte Hain Wardiyaan Bolte Hain Harkaare Pehra Dete Sawaar Phirte Hain Rakhiye Jaise Hain Khanazaad Hain Hum Mol Ke Aibdaar Phirte Hain Haaye Gaafil Woh Kya Jagah Hai Jahan Paanch Jaate Hain Chaar Phirte Hain Baaye Raste Na Ja Musaafir Sun Maal Hai Raah-Maar Phirte Hain Jaag Sunsaan Ban Hai Raat Aayi Gurg Bahre Shikaar Phirte Hain Nafs Ye Koi Chaal Hai Zaalim Jaise Khaase Bijaar Phirte Hain Koi Kyun Pooche Teri Baat Raza Tujhse Kutte Hazaar Phirte Hain

৬২৩

Ya Muhammad Noor E Mujassam

Ya Muhammad Noor-E-Mujassam Ya Habibi Ya Maulai Tasweer-E-Kamal-E-Mohabbat Tanveer-E-Jamal-E-Khudayei Tera Wasf Bayaan Ho Kis Se Teri Kon Karega Barayei Iss Gard-E-Safar Mein Gum Hai Jibreel-E-Ameen Ki Rasayei Teri Ek Nazar Ke Taalib, Tere Ek Sukhan Par Qurabaan Ye Sab Tere Divaane, Ye Sab Tere Shayadai Ye Rung-E-Bahar-E-Gulshan Ye Gul Aur Gul Ka Joban Tere Noor-E-Qadam Ka Dhowan Uss Dhowan Ki Ra’nayei Ma Ajmalaka Teri Surat Ma Ah’sanak Teri Seerat Ma Akmalaka Teri A’zmat Teri Zaat Mein Gum Hai Khudayei Ae Mazhar-E-Shaan-E-Jamali Ae Khuwaja-O-Banda Aa’li Mujhe Hashr Mein Kaam Aajaye Mera Zoq-E-Sukhan Aarayei Tu Raees-E-Roz-E-Shafa’t Tu Ameer-E-Lutf-O-I’nayat Hai Adeeb Ko Tujhse Nisbat Ye Ghulam Hai Tu Aaqayei

৬২৪

Ya Mustafa Ata Ho Phir Izn Haazri Ka

Ya Mustafa Ata Ho Phir Izn Haazri Ka Karloon Nazaraha Aakar Phir Aapki Gali Ka Eik Bar Phir Dikha Do Ramzan Mein Madina Beshak Banalo Aaqa Mehman Do Ghari Ka. Rota Huwa Phir Aaon Daagh E Jigar Dikhaoon Afsana Bhi Sunaoon Main Apni Baykasi Ka. Phir Sabz, Sabz Gumbad Ki Dekhloon Baharein Ab Izn Day Do Aaqa Phir Mujh Ko Hazri Ka. Ya Mustafa! Gunahoon Ki Aadatein Nikal Jayein Jazbah Mujhay Aata Ho Sunnat Ki Pairwi Ka. Dil Say Ghuroor Niklay, Bahray Huzoor Niklay Ya Rab! Mujhay Bana Day Paikar Tu Aajzi Ka. Allah! Hub-E-Duniya Say Tu Mujhay Bachana Sa’il Houn Ya Khuda Main Ishq E Muhammadi Ka. Iman Pay Rab E Rehmat Day Day Tu Isteqamat Deta Houn Wasta Main Tujh Ko Teray Nabi Ka. Ulfat Ki Bheek Day Do! Deta Houn Wasta Mein Siddiq Ka Umar Ka, Usman Ka Ali Ka. Duniya Kay Tajdaro! Tum Say Mujhay Gharz Kiya! Mangta Hoon Main To Mangta Sarkar Ki Gali Ka. Meezaan Pay Sabh Khar’ay Hain Amaal Tul Rahay Hain Rakhlo Bharam Khudara! Attar E Qadri Ka ---------------------------------------- --------------Other Verses-------------- Day Do Gham E Madina, Day Do Gham E Madina! Aisa Gham E Madina Dekhoon Na Mooh Khushi Ka. Khoon-E-Jigar Say Se’ncha Hai Baagh E Sunniyat Ka Kardo Karam Waseelah Is Madni Murshidi Ka. Ya Syed E Madina! Bus Aap Hi Nibhana Go Houn Bada Kaminah, Par Houn To Aap Hi Ka. Houn Dur Sabh Balaein Deta Houn Wasta Mein Mazloom Karbala Ki Sarkaar! Bekasi Ka. Ho Har Nafas Madina Dharkan Mein Ho Madina Jab Tak Na Sa’ans Tutay Sarkaar Zindagi Ka. Allah! Is Say Pehlay Imaan Pay Maut De Day Nuqsaan Mare Sabab Say Ho Sunnat E Nabi Ka. Kuch Nekiyaan Kamale Jald Akhirat Banale Koi Nahi Bharosa Bhai! Zindagi Ka.

৬২৫

Ya Nabi Dekha Ye Rutba Aapki Naalein Ka

Ya Nabi Dekha Ye Rutba Aapki Naalein Ka Arsh Ne Chooma Hai Talwa Aapki Naalein Ka Aapki Khidmat Ka Mujhko Kaash Mil Jaata Sharaf Baandhta Haathon Se Tasma Aapki Naalein Ka Aapke Qadmon Ki Narmi Qalb Par Mehsoos Ki Jab Bhi Mein Ne Naqsh Dekha Aapki Naalein Ka Hashr Mein Jab Log Choomay Aapka Dust-E-Karam Sab Say Chup Kar Loon Mein Boosa Aapki Naalein Ka Daast Bosi Ke To Mai Bhala Kabil Kahan Dijye Bas Mujh Ko Boosa Aapki Naalein Ka Roz-E-Mehshar Sar Pe Soraj Jab Sawaa Neezay Pe Ho Aik Nezay Per Ho Saaya Aapki Naalein Ka Jiss Se Aagay Jaayein Tou Jal Jaye Par Jibril Ke Uss Se Aagay Jaana Dekha Aapki Naalein Ka Taaj Kyun Na Bheek Maangay Aapki Naalein Ki Taajwar Khaatay Hain Sadqa Aapki Naalein Ka Mujrim-O-Nakara Garche Aap Ka Rizwan Hai Dil Se Phir Bhi Hai Ye Shaida Aapki Naalein Ka

৬২৬

Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar

Main Dar E Mustafa Ka Mangta Hoon Bheek Milti Hai Aastane Se Jo Gada Hai Dar E Muhammad Ka Kuch Nahi Mangta Zamane Se Jab Koi Baat Na Bane Teri Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Kade Yusuf Zulaikha Di Kare Gallan Kade Musa Kade Koh E Toor Diyan Kade Shams Tabrez Te Tanz Karnae Kade Kare Gallan Shah Mansoor Diyan Tenu Apne Aap Di Khabar Koi Nai Dein Baitha Khabran Door Diyan Sajjan Rab Nun Je Razi, Rakhna I Gallan Kareya Kar Mere, Huzoor Diyan Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Auhde Naal Mukhalfat Sajdi Nai Bani Jis De Waaste Khudai Howe Kerhi Cheez Te Kerhi Baat Rab Ne Sohne Yaar De Kolon Lukai Howe Bhala Jannat Da Kinwe Haqdaar Howe Jinnan Mann Wich Adab Di Na Rai Howe Sajjan Tan Koi Ghar Apne, Warran Denda Je Ghar Wale Naal, Banai Howe Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Ae Wi Yaad Rakhin Roz E Hashr De Nun Hona Au Jo Mere Hazoor Chaunae Chauna Har Ik Mere Huzoor Ta’in Kisse Hor Nerhe Kisse Door Chaunae Par Jinne Noor Hazoor Nun Maneya Ae Ause Bashar Nun Rab E Ghafoor Chaunae Te Munkar Nabi Da Hoke Khuld Labbe Tenu Kisse Malaik Na, Hoor Chaunae Door Door Rehna, Tere Wargeya Ne Assan Hor Nerhe, Jagah, Malni Ae Sajjan Hukm Khuda Da Hi, Chalna Ae Marzi Mere Hazoor Di, Chalni Ae Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Kisse Pucheya Na Durr-E-Yateem Ta’in Puttar Amiran De Har Koi Naal Le Gai Sone Chandi De Koi Dter Lae Gai Koi Motiyan Warge Thaal Lae Gai Te Bakht Jag Paye Haleema Sadia De Kamli Wale Jeya Jehrri, La’al Lae Gai Jani Kyon Na Khushiyan, Manaye Haleema Do Jag Da Jedha Laj,paal Lae Gai Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Jo Asool Quran Ne Daseya Ae Nai Asool Ais Asool Warga Jane Jinnan Wi Pawein Haseen Howe Nayo Habshi De Pairan Di Dhool Warga Lakhan Mawan Ne Jaye Ne Put Hakim Put Jaya Nai Kisse, Batool Warga Ik Lakh Te Chawi, Hazar Wichon Koi Rasool Nai Mere, Rasool Warga Ya Nabi Ya Nabi Pukara Kar Kyoun Ke Woh Nawazein To Baat Banti Hai Aise Banti Nahi Banane Se

৬২৮

Ya Rab Mere Dil Me Hain Tamanna E Madina

Ya Rab Mere Dil Me Hain Tamanna E Madina In Aankho Se Dikhla Mujhe Sehraa E Madinah Nikle Na Kabhi Dil Se Tamanna E Madinah Zar Me Rahe Ya Rab Mere Sodha E Madinah Aisa Meri Nazro Me Samaa Jaaye Madinah Jab Aankh Uthaoo To Nazar Aaye Madinah Phirte Hain Yahaan Sindh Me Hum Be Sar O Saamaan Taiba Me Bulalo Hume Aaqa E Madinah Is Dar Ke Hain Mushtaq E Ziyaarat Meri Aankhe Dil Se Ye Nikalti Hain Sada Haaye Madinah Yaad Aata Hain Jab Roza E Purnoor Ka Gumbad Dil Se Ye Nikalti Hain Sada Haaye Madinah Main Wajd Ke ‘aalam Me Karu Chaak Ghareebaan Aankho Ke Mere Saamne Jab Aaye Madinah Quran Qasam Khaata Na Us Shehr Ki Har Giz Gar Hota Na Wo Gul Chaman Aaraa E Madinah Kyun Gor Ka Khatka Ho, Qiyamat Ka Ho Kya Ghum Shedaa E Madinah Hoon Mein Shedaa E Madina Bulwaake Madine Me Jameel E Razavi Ko Sag Apna Banaa Lo Isse Maula E Madina

৬২৯

Ya Rab Meri Soi Huyi Taqdeer Jaga De

Ya Rab Meri Soi Huyi Taqdeer Jaga De Aankhein Mujhay Di Hain To Madina Bhi Dikha De. Sun Nay Ki Jo Quwat Mujhe Bakhshi Hai Khuda Wand Phir Masjid E Nabawi Ki Azanein Bhi Suna De. Huroon Ki Na Ghulman Ki Na Jannat Ki Talab Hai Madfan Mera Sarkar Ki Basti Main Bana De. Mudat Say Mein Inn Hathoon Say Karta Hoon Duaein In Hathon Main Ab Jali Sunehri Bhi Thama De. Moun Hasher Mein Mujhko Na Chupana Parhay Ya Rab Mujh Ko Teray Mehboob Ki Chadar Mein Chupa De. Ishrat Ko Bhi Ab Khushbu E Hassan Aata Kar Jo Lafz Kahay Hein Unhein To Tu Naat Bana De. Ya Rab Meri Soi Hui Taqdeer Jaga De Ankhein Mujhe Di Hein To Madina Bhi Dikha De

৬৩০

Ya Rasool Allah Karam

Isyaan Mein Dooba Sar Basar, Aamal Nek Hain Sifar Sadqe Mein Ghous E Paak Ke Kar Do Karam Ki Ek Nazar. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Tum Ho Rasoolon Ke Rasool Door Hon Ranj O Malool Sadqe Mein Ghous E Paak Ke Karlo Ghulamoon Main Qabool. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Allah Ke Ho Tum Habeeb, Dono Jahaan Ke Ho Tabeeb Sadqe Mein Ghous E Paak Ke Ho Rooh Ko Shifa Naseeb. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Shakir E Razvi Ke Huzoor, Hon Maaf Sab Ke Sab Kusoor Sadqe Mein Ghous E Paak Ke Dar’ain Ka Mile Suroor. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Na Kaheen Se Door Hain Manzilein, Na Koi Kareeb Ki Baat Hai Jise Chahein Usko Nawaaz De, Yeh Dar E Habeeb Ki Baat Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Jise Chaha Dar Pay Bula Liya, Jise Chaha Apna Bana Liya Ye Bade Karam Ke Hain Faisle, Yeh Bade Naseeb Ki Baat Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Ba Khuda Nahin, Woh Khuda Nahin, Woh Magar Khuda Se Judaa Nahin Woh Hain Kiya Magar Woh Hain Kiya Nahin, Yeh Muhib Habeeb Ki Baat Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Woh Machal Ke Rah Main Reh Gayein, Yeh Tadap Ke Dar Se Lipat Gayein Woh Kisi Ameer Ki Shaan Thi, Yeh Kisi Ghareeb Ki Baat Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam Tujhe Aye Munawware Be Nawaa, Dar E Shah Se Chahiye Aur Kiya Jo Naseeb Ho Kabhi Saamna, Toh Bade Naseeb Ki Baat Hai. Ya Rasool Allah Karam Ya Habeeb Allah Karam

৬৩১

Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye

Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye Warna Ashqho Ke Mothi Bikhar Jayege Darde Furqat Se Ham Itne Majboor Hai Ab Inayath Na Hogi To Mar Jayege Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye Ye Zamane Ke Gham Ye Hazaron Sitam Baitha Jata Hai Dil Toot Jata Hai Dam Hum Pe Rehmat Na Hogi To Sarkar Ham Kis Ko Awaaj Denge Kidar Jayege Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye Aoj Par Ashiqo Ka Naseeb Aayega Noor Lekar Khayal E Habeeb Aayega Dekhna Jab Madina Khareeb Aayega Raaste Me Sitare Bikhar Jayege Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye Ghum Uthate Raho Muskurate Raho Naat Padhte Raho Gungunate Raho Afaten Unke Sadqe Me Tal Jaengi Dard O Gham Aenge Aur Guzar Jayege Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye Ham Ghareebo Ka Anwar Ye Imaan Hai Jab Bhi Koi Musibat Ka Daur Aayega Ya Muhammad Ke Naare Lagaate Hue Har Kathin Raaste Se Guzar Jayege Ya Rasool E Khuda Aasra Dijiye

৬৩২

Ya Rasoolallah Pukaro

Ya Rasoolallah Pukaro Ya Rasoolallah Ya Rasoolallah Pukaro Ya Rasoolallah Ya Rasoolallah Pukaro Ya Rasoolallah Ya Rasoolallah Pukaro Ya Rasoolallah Jo Be Un Kay Pyar Main Ko Jaata Hey Us Pey Aaqa Bee Karam Farmaatay Hein Hey Azl Sey Husn Walon Kee Ada Chahnain Walon Ko Wo Tarpaatay Hein Zindagi Miltee Hey Un Ko Daimee Jo Be Un Kay Ishq Main Mar Jaatay Hein Un Kay Sadqay Zindagi Kee Ronakain Un Ka Kaatay Hein Unhee Ka Gaatay Hein Saree Dunya Un Kay Dar Kee Khoshacheen Jo Meree Sarkar Kay Ban Jaatay Hein Mein Be Hamsar Arsh Ka Ho Jaata Hoon Jab Khayaalon Kay Angan Main Aatay Hein Jin Kee Nazron Main Samaey Hein Huzoor Wo Kisee Ko Kab Nazron Main Laatay Hein Kaaba Kiya Taqdeer Pir Jaey Odar Noor Woh Chehra Jidar Farmaatay Hein

৬৩৩

Ya Shafi E Umam Lillah Kar Do Karam

Ya Shafiye Umam Lillah Kar Do Karam Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Ham Ghulamo Ka Rakhna Khudara Bharam Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Muntashir Hain Khayalaat Ki Waadiyaan Lut Gaya Hai Sukoon Waaliye Do Jahaan Rehem Farma De Ab Teri Ummat Hain Hum Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Mere Haathon Main Kaasa Hai Umeed Ka Hoon Bhikaari Shaha Main Teri Deed Ka Main Gadaaye Haram Too Nabi Mohtaram Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Kis Ko Jaakar Kahein Taajdaare Haram Ghera Daale Hue Hain Zamane Ke Gham Door Ho Jaaye Gham Ya Nabi Mohtasham Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Tere Yaadon Maa'moor Seena Rahe Saamne Mere Tera Madina Rahe Dar Pe Baitha Rahoon Leke Main Chashme Nam Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Ya Nabi Apni Ulfat Ki Saugaat De Apni Shayane Shaan Hum Ko Khairaat De Is Se Matlab Nahi Hai Siwaa Ho Ke Kam Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Haazri Ho Niyazi Ki Darbaar Mein Umr Guzre Yoonhi Tere Azkaar Me Aate Jaate Rahe Teri Chaukhat Pe Hum Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Shala Wasda Rawe Taira Sona Haram Rab Salaamat Rakhe Tera Sohna Haram Rab Salaamat Rakhe Tera Sohna Haram Rab Salaamat Rakhe Tera Sohna Haram

৬৩৪

Ya Shah E Umam Ek Nazar E Karam

Ya Shah E Umam Ek Nazar E Karam Mori Laaj Tumhare Haath, Sarkaar Mori Nayya Laga Do Apne Karam Se Paar Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen, Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen Tooti Howi Aas Hun Main, Dukh Se Bhara Dil Hai Mera Nazr-E-Karam Behr-E-Khuda, Koi Nahi Hai Tere Siwa Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen, Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen Ghamkhar-E-Jahan, Taskeen-E-Jaan, Ek Shab Tu Mujhe Bhi Ho Deedar Mori Nayya Laga Do Apne Karam Se Paar... Baag-E-Iram Shehar Tera, Jiss Ki Hawa Mushk-E-Khutan Naam Tera Salle Alaa, Rooh-E-Bayan Jaan-E-Sukhan Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen, Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen Ho Door Mere Sab Ranj O Alam Phir Aoon Madine Main, Ek Baar Mori Nayya Laga Do Apne Karam Se Paar... Aaasi Hoon Main Bigr-E-Naseeb, Rakh Lo Bharam Rab Ke Habeeb Rooh-E-Adab Jaane Adeeb, Tum Hi Ho To Sab Ke Tabeeb Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen, Sallal La Syed Ul Mursaleen Tumhe Kiya Hai Kami, Makki Madani Tum Dono Jahan Ke Hoo, Mukhtaar Mori Nayya Laga Do Apne Karam Se Paar...

৬৩৫
