Ya Taiba Ya Taiba Ya Dawal Aiyyaana Shtiknaa Lak Wilhawana Daana Wilhawana Daana Qalbay Aashiq Dharak Utha Ik Dam Jab Chira Tazkirah Madinay Ka Ankh Say Ashq Hogaye Jari Jab Chala Qafilah Madinay Ka Qafilah Madinay Ka (Chorus) Ho Ghumay Mustafa Ata Ya Rabb Dard Barhta Rahay Madinay Ka Door Ranjo Alam Ho Duniya Kay Hum Ko Mil Jaye Gham Madinay Ka Gham Madinay Ka (Chorus) Aik Muddat Say Dil May Armaa Hai Jame Deedar Yaar Pinay Ka Mout Gar Aye Teray Qadmon May Lutf Ajaae Phir To Jenay Ka Phir To Jenay Ka (Chorus) Sab Ko Aaka Bulaengay Aik Din Izan Mil Jayega Madinay Ka Apni Ummat Pay Yu Karam Kardo Kaam Hai Na Koi Qareenay Ka Na Koi Qareenay Ka

৬৩৬

Yaad E Mustafa Aisi Bas Gayi Hai Seene Me

Yaad E Mustafa Aisi Bas Gayi Hai Seene Me Jism Ho Kahi Apna Dil Toh Hai Madine Me Mere Kamli Wale Ka Ghar Tu Hai Madine Me Haan Magar Wo Rehte Hain Ashiqon Ke Seenay Me Kaun See Jagah Unke Aashiko Se Khali Hai Har Jagah Hai Parwane Shamma Hai Madine Me Tu Ne Pee Kitabon Se Mein Ne Pee Nigahon Se Farq Itna Hai Ke Aray Tere Mere Peenay Me Kash Un Ke Koochay Se Layen Yeh Saba Pegham Chal Tujahy Bulatay Hain Mustufa Madine Me Jab Se Mil Gaya Mujhko Na Khuda Madine Me Lee Panah Tufan Ne Khud Mere Safine Me Un Guullo Ki Khusbu Ka Zikr Karu Aaqa Khuld Bhi Nahati Hai Aapke Pasine Me Koan Hai Ye Deevana Kis Ka Hai Ye Deevana Hashar Me Bhi Kehta Hai Jana Hai Madine Me Khauf Na Kar Mehshar Ka Gum Na Kar Iqba Ka Naam E Mustafa Likh Kar Daal Do Safine Me Koan Hai Tera Rehbar Puuchha To Khizar Bole Kali Kamli Walay Hai Rehtay Heyn Madine Me Baad Mere Marne Ke Har Zubaan Pe Charcha Tha Aadmi To Achha Tha Mar Gaya Madine Me Baat Yeh Yakin Hai Ki Who Mujhe Bulayenge Jaane Kaun Se San Me Jaane Kis Mahine Me

৬৩৭

Yaad Me Jiski Nahi Hoshe Tano Jaan Hum Ko

Yaad Me Jiski Nahi Hoshe Tano Jaa(N) Hum Ko Phir Dikhade Woh Rukh Aye Mehre Faroza Hum Ko Der Se Aap Mein Aana Nahi Milta Hain Humein Kya Hi Khud-Rafta Kiya Jalwaye Janaa(N) Hum Ko Jis Tabassum Ne Gulistaa(N) Pe Girayi Bijli Phir Dikhade Woh Adaaye Gule Khanda(N) Hum Ko Kaash Aaweezaye Kindeele Madina Ho Woh Dil Jis Ki Sozish Ne Kiya Rashke Charaaga Hum Ko Arsh Jis Khoobiye Raftaar Ka Paamaal Hua Do Qadam Chal Ke Dikha Sarve Khiraamaa(N)! Hum Ko Shamaye Taiba Se Main Parwana Rahoo(N) Kab Tak Door Haa(N) Jala De Sha-Rare Aatishe Pinha! Hum Ko Khauf Hai Sam'a Kharashiye Sage Taiba Ka Warna Kya Yaad Nahi(N) Naa-La O Afgaa(N) Hum Ko Khaak Ho Jaaye(N) Dare Paak Pe Hasrat Mit Jaaye Ya Ilahi Na Fira Be Saro Saamaa(N) Hum Ko Khaare Sahraaye Madina Na Nikal Jaaye Kahi(N) Wahshate Dil Na Fira Koho Bayaabaa(N) Hum Ko Tang Aaye Hain Do Aalam Teri Betaabi Se Chain Lene De Tape Seenaye Sozaa(N) Hum Ko Paau(N) Girbaal Huye Raahe Madina Na Mili Aye Junoo(N)! Ab To Mile Rukhsate Zindaa(N) Hum Ko Mere Har Zakhme Jigar Se Ye Nikalti Hai Sada Aye Maleehe Arabi! Karde Namakdaa(N) Hum Ko Saire Gulshan Se Aseerane Qafas Ko Kya Kaam Na De Takleefe Chaman Bulbule Bustaa(N) Hum Ko Jab Se Aankhon Me Samayi Hai Madine Ke Bahaar Nazar Aate Hain Khazaa(N)-Deeda Gulistaa(N) Hum Ko Gar Labe Paak Se Iqraare Shafa'at Ho Jaaye Yu(N) Na Bechain Rakhe Joshishe Isyaa(N) Hum Ko Nayyare Hashr Ne Ik Aag Laga Rakhi Hai! Tez Hai Dhoop Mile Saaya E Daamaa(N) Hum Ko Reham Farmaiye Ya Shah Ki Ab Taab Nahi(N) Tabake Khoon Rulaye Ghame Hijraa(N) Hum Ko Chaake Daamaa(N) Mein Na Thak Jaaiyo Aye Daste Junoo(N) Purze Karna Hai Abhi Jebo(N) Gharibaa(N) Hum Ko Parda Us Chehraye Anwar Se Utha Kar Ik Baar Apna Aaina Bana Aye Mahe Taabaa(N) Hum Ko Aye Raza Wasfe Rukhe Paak Sunane Ke Liye Nazr Dete Hain Chaman! Murge Ghazal Khwaa(N) Hum Ko

৬৩৮

Yaade Watan Sitam Kiya Dashte Haram Se Laayi Kyun

Yaade Watan Sitam Kiya Dashte Haram Se Laayi Kyun Baithe Bithaye Bad Naseeb Sar Pe Bala Uthayi Kyun Dil Mein To Chot Thi Dabi Haaye Gazab Ubhar Gayi Poocho To Aahe Sard Se Thandi Hawa Chalaye Kyun Chhod Ke Us Haram Ko Aap Ban Me Thago(N) Ke Aa Baso Phir Kaho Sar Pe Dhar Ke Haath Lut Gayi Sab Kamaayi Kyun Baaghe Arab Ka Sarve Naaz Dekh Liya Hai Warna Aaj Kumriye Jaane Ghamzada Goonj Ke Chah Chahayi Kyun Naame Madina Le Diya Chalne Lagi Naseeme Khuld Sozishe Gham Ko Hum Ne Bhi Kaisi Hawa Bataayi Kyun Kis Ki Nigaah Ki Hayaa Firti Hai Meri Aankh Mein Nargise Mast Naaz Ne Mujhse Nazar Churaayi Kyun Tu Ne To Kar Diya Tabeeb Aatashe Seena Ka Ilaaj Aaj Ke Doode Aah Mein Booye Kabaab Aaye Kyun Fikre Ma’aash Bad Bala Hole Ma’aad Jaa(N) Guzaa Laakhon Bala Mein Fasne Ko Rooh Badan Mein Aayi Kyun Ho Na Ho Aaj Kuch Mera Zikr Huzoor Mein Hua Warna Meri Taraf Khushi Dekh Ke Muskuraayi Kyun Hoore Jinaa(N) Sitam Kiya Taiba Nazar Mein Fir Gaya Ched Ke Pardaye Hijaaz Des Ki Cheez Gaayi Kyun Gaflate Shaikho Shaab Par Hanste Hain Tifle Sheer Khwaar Karne Ko Gudgudi Abas Aane Lagi Bahayi Kyun Arz Karu(N) Huzoor Se Dil Ki To Meri Khair Hai Peet-Tee Sar Ko Aarzoo Dashte Haram Se Aayi Kyun Hasrate Nau Ka Saaniha Sunte Hi Dil Bigad Gaya Aise Mareez Ko Raza Marge Jawaa(N) Sunai Kyun

৬৩৯

Ye Kehti Thi Ghar Ghar Me Ja Kar Haleema

Ye Kehti Thi Ghar Ghar Me Ja Kar Haleema Mere Ghar Me Khairul Waraa Aa Gaye Hai Bade Auj Par Hai Mera Ab Muqaddar Mere Ghar Rasool E Khuda Aa Gaye Hai Uthi Chaarsu Rehmato Ki Ghataye Mu-Attar Mu-Attar Hai Saari Fazae Khushi Me Ye Jibreel Nagme Sunaye Wo Sha-Faye Rouze Jaza Aa Gaye Hai Ye Zulmat Se Kehdo Andhere Uthale Ke Hai Har Taraf Ab Ujale Ujale Kaha Jinko Haq Ne Sirajammuneera Mere Ghar Wo Noor E Khuda Aa Gaye Hai Ye Sunkar Sakhee Aapka Aastaana Hai Daaman Pasare Hue Sab Zamana Nawaso Ka Sadqa Nigah E Karam Ho Tere Dar Pe Tere Gada Aa Gaye Hai Mukarrab Hai Be-Shaq Khaleelo Najee Bhi Badi Shaan Waale Kaleemo Maseeh Bhi Liye Arsh Ne Jinke Qadmo Ke Bouse Wo Ummi Laqab Mustafa Aa Gaye Hai Khuda Ke Karam Se Nakirain Aa Kar Kahenge Ziyarat Ka Muzdah Suna Kar Utho Behre Ta'azeem Noorul Hasan Ab Lahad Me Rasool E Khuda Aa Gaye Hai

৬৪০

Ye Kis Shehenshah E Wala Ki Amad Amad Hai

Ye Kis Shehenshah E Wala Ki Amad Amad Hai Bolo Marhaba Bolo Marhaba Ye Konse Shah E Bala Ki Amad Amad Hai Bolo Marhaba Bolo Marhaba Ye Aaj Taare Zameen Ki Taraf Hai Kyu Maayel Ye Aasmaan Se Paiham Hai Noor Kyu Naazil Ye Aaj Kya Hai Zamane Ne Rang Badla Hai Ye Aaj Kya Hai Ke Aalam Ka Dhang Badla Hai Ye Aaj Kaahe Ki Shadi Hai Arsh Kyu Jhooma Labe Zameen Ko Labe Aasmaan Ne Kyu Chooma Ye Aaj Kya Hai Ke Butt Aoudhe Ho Gaye Saare Ye Aaj Kyu Hai Shayateen Bandhe Hue Kaare Rusul Un Hi Ka To Musda Sunane Ae Hai Unhi Ke Ane Ki Khushian Manane Ae Hai Farishte Aj Jo Dhoomen Machane Ae Hai Unhi Ke Ane Ki Shadi Rachane Ae Hai Chamak Se Apni Jahan Jagmagane Ae Hai Mehek Se Apni Ye Koochey Basane Ae Hai Ye Seedha Rasta Haq Ka Batane Ae Hai Ye Haq Ke Bandon Ko Haq Se Milane Ae Hai Jo Gir Rahe Thay Unhe Naibon Ne Tham Lia Jo Gir Chuke Hai Ye Un Ko Uthane Ae Hai Rauf Aese Hai Aur Ye Raheem Hai Itne Ye Girte Parton Ko Seeney Lagane Ae Hai Inhe Khuda Ne Kia Apne Mulk Ka Malik Aur Inhi Ke Qabzey Me Rab Ke Khazaney Ae Hai Jo Chahen Ge Jisey Chahen Ge Ye Usey Den Ge Karim Hai Ye Khazaney Lutane Ae Hai Sab Rusul Ne Kaha Izhabu Ila Ghairi Ana Laha Ka Ye Musda Sunane Ae Hai Ajab Karam He Ke Khud Mujrimon Ke Hami Hai Gunah Garon Ki Ye Bakhshish Karane Ae Hai Suno Ge La Na Zaban E Karim Se Noori Kiunke Ye Faiz O Jod Ke Daria Bahane Ae Hai Naseeb Tera Chamak Utha Dekh To Noori Arab Ke Chand Lehed Ke Sirhane Ae Hai Ye Kis Shehenshah E Wala Ki Amad Amad He Bolo Marhaba Bolo Marhaba Ye Konse Shah E Bala Ki Amad Amad He Bolo Marhaba Bolo Marhaba

Yeh Naaz Yeh Andaz Hamare Nahi Hote Jholi Me Agar Tukre Tumhare Nahin Hote Jab Tak Madine Se Ishare Nahi Hote Raushan Kabhi Kismat Ke Sitare Nahi Hote Be Daam Hi Bik Jaye Bazar E Nabi Me Is Shaan Ke Saude Me Khasare Nahi Hote Daamaan E Shafa’at Me Hame Kaun Chupata Sarkaar Agar Aap Hamare Nahi Hote Milti Na Agar Bhik Huzoor Aap Ke Dar Se Is Thaath Se Mangto Ke Guzaare Nahi Hote Yeh Nisbat E Sarkaar Ka Aijaaz Hai Warna Toofaan Se Namoodaar Kinare Nahi Hote Khalid Yeh Tasaduq Hai Faqat Naat Ka Warna Mehshar Me Tere Waare Niyaare Nahi

৬৪৫

Zahe Izzato Aetala-E Muhammad Ke Hai Arsh E Haq Zere Paa-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Makaa(N) Arsh Unka Falak Farsh Unka Malak Khaadimane Sara-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Khuda Ki Raza Chahte Hai Do Aalam Khuda Chahta Hai Raza-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Ajab Kya Agar Raham Farma Le Hum Par Khuda-E Muhammad Baraa-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Muhammad Baraa-E Janaab E Ilahi Janaab E Ilahi Baraa-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Basi Itre Mahboobi-E Kibriya Se A-Baye Muhammad Kabaa-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Baham Ahad Bandhe Hai Wasl E Abad Ka Raza-E Khuda Aur Raza-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Dame Naz'a Jaari Ho Meri Zabaa(N) Par Muhammad Muhammad Khuda-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Asaa-E Kaleem Azdahaye Ghazab Tha Giro(N) Ka Sahara Asaa-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Main Kurbaan Kya Pyari Pyari Hai Nisbat Ye Aan-E Khuda Wo Khuda-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Muhammad Ka Damm Khaas Bahre Khuda Hai Siwaye Muhammad Bara-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Khuda Unko Kis Pyar Se Dekhta Hai Jo Aankhei(N) Hai Mahve Lika-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Zulu Me Ijabat Khawasi Me Rehmat Badhi Kis Tuzuk Se Dua-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Izabat Ne Jhuk Kar Gale Se Lagaya Badhi Naaz Se Jab Dua-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Izabat Ka Sehra Inayat Ka Joda Dulhan Banke Nikli Dua-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم Raza Pul Se Ab Wajd Karte Guzariye Ki Hai Rabbe Sallim Sada-E Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم

৬৪৬

Zahe Muqaddar Huzure Haq Se

Zahe Muqaddar Huzur-E-Haq Se Salaam Aaya Payam Aaya Jhukao Nazren Bichao Palken Adab Ka Aala Maqam Aaya Yeh Kon Sar Se Kafan Lapetey Chala Hai Ulfat Ke Raastey Par Farishtey Hairat Se Tak Rahe Hain Yeh Kon Zi Ehteram Aaya Faza Mein Labbaik Ki Sadain Za Farsh Ta Aarsh Goonjti Hain Har Ek Qurban Ho Raha Hai Zaban Pe Yeh Kis Ka Naam Aaya Yeh Rah-E-Haq Hai Sambhal Ke Chalna Yahan Hai Manzil Qadam Qadam Par Pohunchna Dar Par To Kehna Aaqa Salaam Lijiye Ghulam Aaya Yeh Kehna Aaqa Bohat Se Aashiq Taraptey Se Chhor Aaya Hoon Mein Bulawe Ke Muntazir Hai Lekin Na Subah Aaya Na Sham Aaya Dua Jo Nikli Thi Dil Se Aakhir Palat Ke Maqbool Ho Ke Aai Woh Jazba Jis Mein Tarap Thi Sachi Woh Jazba Aakhir Ko Kaam Aaya Khuda Tera Hafiz-O-Nigehban O Rahe Batha Ke Jaane Wale Nabi De Saad In Bisat Ban Kar Payam Darood-O-Salaam Aaya Zahe Muqaddar Huzur-E-Haq Se Salaam Aaya Payam Aaya Jhukao Nazreen Bichao Palkeen Adab Ka Aala Maqam Aaya

৬৪৭

Zairo Paas E Adab Rakhho Hawas Jaane Do

Zairo Paas-E-Adab Rakhho Hawas Jaane Do, Aankhein Andhi Huwi Hain Unnko Taras Jaane Do. Sookhi Jaati Hay Ummeed-E-Gurba Ki Kheti, Boondiya Lakka-E-Rehmat Ki Barras Jaane Do. Palti Aati Hay Abhi Wajd Mein Jaane Sheereen, Naghma-E-Qum Ka Zara Kaano Mein Ras Jaane Do. Hum Bhi Chaltay Hay Zara Kaafile Waalo Thehro, Gathriyaan Tosh-E-Ummeed Ki Kas Jaane Do. Deed-E-Gul Aur Bhi Karti Hay Qiyamat Dil Par, Hum-Safeero Humein Phir Sue Qafas Jaane Do. Aatish-E-Dil Bhi To Bharkaawo Adab Daa(N) Naalo, Kaun Kehta Hay Ki Tum Zabte Nafs Jaane Do. Yoon Tane Zaar Key Dar Pe Huwe Dil Key Sho’lo, Shewa-E-Khaanah Bar Andaziye Khas Jaane Do. Aay Raza Aah Ki Yoon Sahl Katein Jurm Key Saal, Do Ghari Ki Bhi Ibadat To Baras Jaane Do.

৬৪৮

Zamana Haj Ka Hai Jalwa Diya Hai Shahide Gul Ko

Zamana Haj Ka Hai Jalwa Diya Hai Shahide Gul Ko Ilahi Taaqate Parwaaz De Parhaye Bulbul Ko Bahare Aayi Joban Par Ghira Hai Abr Rehmat Ka Labe Mushtaaq Bheege(N) De Ijazat Saaqiya Mul Ko Mile Lab Se Woh Mushqee(N) Mohr Wali Dam Mein Dam Aaye Tapak Sun Kar Qume Isaa Kahu Masti Mein Qulqul Ko Machal Jaau Sawaale Mudda'aa Par Thaam Kar Daaman Behekne Ka Bahana Paau Qasde Be Ta-Ammul Ko Dua Kar Bakhte Khufta Jaag Hungame Ijaabat Hai Hataya Subhe Rukh Se Shah Ne Shab-Haaye Kaakul Ko Zabane Falsafi Se Amn Kharqo Iltiyaam Asara Panahe Daure Rehmat Haaye Yak Saa-At Tasalsul Ko Do Shamba Mustafa Ka Jum'aye Aadam Se Behtar Hai Sikhana Kya Lihaaze Haisiyat Khoo E Ta'ammul Ko Wufoore Shaane Rehmat Ke Sabab Jur'at Hai Aye Pyare Na Rakh Bahare Khuda Sharminda Arze Be Ta-Ammul Ko Pareshani Mein Naam Unka Dile Sad Chaak Se Nikla Ijaabat Shana Karne Aayi Gesuye Tawassul Ko Raza Nuh Sabzaye Gardoo(N) Hain Kotal Jiske Maukib Ke Koi Kya Likh Sake Uski Sawari Ke Tajammul Ko

৬৪৯

Zameen Maili Nahi Hoti

Zameen Maili Nahi Hoti, Zaman Maila Nahin Hota Muhammad Kay Gulamon Ka Kafan Maila Nahi Hota. Mohabbat Kamli Wale Say, Woh Jazba Hai Suno Logo Yeh Jis Man Main Sama Jaaye, Woh Mann Maila Nahi Hota. Gulon Ko Choom Laite, Hain Seharnam Shabnami Qatre Nabi Ki Naat Sun Lein Tu, Chaman Maila Nahi Hota. Jo Naam-E-Mustafa Chumein, Nahi Dukhti Kabhi Ankhein Pehen Le Pyaar Jo Unka, Badan Maila Nahi Hota. Nabi Ka Daman-E-Rehmat Pakar Lo Aey Jahan Walo Rahe Jab Tak Yeh Hathon Main, Chalan Maila Nahi Hota. Main Nazan Tu Nahi Fanpan Magar Nasir Yeh Dawa Hai Sana-E-Mustafa Karne Se Fan Maila Nahi Hota. ---------------------Other--------------------- --------------------Version-------------------- Mile Hai Khaak Se Lekin, Badan Maila Nahi Hota Fidayan-E-Mohammad Ka, Kafan Maila Nahi Hota Mohabbat Ahle Bait-E-Paak Ki Jis Dil Me Pinha Ho Sada Shafaaf Rehta Hai Wo Man Maila Nahi Hota Sana-E-Mustafa Likho Ke Unki Madha Karne Se Qalam Maila Nahi Hota, Sukhan Maila Nahi Hota Nabi Ke Deen Ki Qatir Jo Deta Hai Aqeedat Se Wo Daulat Kam Nahi Hoti, Wo Dhan Maila Nahi Hota Hamaare Jurm Ki Kaalak, Hai Hazir Banke Faryadi Libaase Paak-E-Shahe Zul Minan Maila Nahi Hota Zabaan Tar Jin Ki Rehti Hai Sana-E-Shahe Batha Se Ubaid E Qadri Unka Dahan Maila Nahi Hota

Zarrey Jhar Kar Teri Payzaron Ke Taj E Sar Bante Hain Sayyaro Ke Hum Se Chooro Pe Jo Farmaye Karam Khil’ate E Zarr Bane Pushtaaron Ke Mere Aaqa Ko Wo Dar Hai Jis Par Maathe Ghiss Jaate Hai Sardaaro Ke Mere Ishaa Tere Sadqe Jaau Tor Be Tor Hai Beemaaro Ke Mujrim O Chashm-E-Tabassum Rakho Phool Banjaate Hai Angaaro Ke Tere Abroo Ke Tassaduq Pyare Bandh Kule Hain Gar Iftaro Ke Jaan O Dil Tere Qadam Par Waarey Kya Naseebey Hai Tere Yaaro Ke Sidq O Adl O Karam O Himmat Me Chaar Soo Shohrey Hai In Chaaro Ke Siddique Ki Sadaqat -Zindabad! Zere Saya Ae Ghumbad Shaam Ka Basera Hai

Zere Saya Ae Ghumbad Shaam Ka Basera Hai Aur Sunahri Jali Mein Roohnuma Sawera Hai Jaabaja Madine Me Hajioun Ka Dehra Hai Mustafa Ke Kuche Mein Saailoun Ka Pehra Hai Har Nazar Hi Raasa Hai Har Bashar Paresha Hai Aasiyon Ne Mehshar Me Mustafa Ko Ghera Hai Qabr Mein Farishtoun Se Jab Nabi Ne Farmaya Jaao Is Ko Sohne Do Ye Ghulam Mera Hai Kaash Hashr Ke Din Main Is Tarha Uthu Ya Rab Khud Huzoor Farmadein Ummati Ye Mera Hai Tahiroun Ki Jurmat Mein Wo Kalas Ka Nazara Shama Ko Pathangoun Ne Har Taraf Se Geera Hai Kitni Khuld Manzar Hai Raat Bhi Madine Ki Aik Zara Ujala Hai Aik Zara Andhera Hai Meri Khush Naseebi Par Rashq Aye Rizwan Ko Mustafa Agar Keh De Ye Ghulam Mera Hai Raat Bhi Madine Ki Din Se Kam Nahi Ajmal Shaam Bhi Madine Ki Khushnama Saweera Hai

Zikr E Khuda Mein Harr Dum Rahna Sabke Bus Ki Baat Nahi

Zikr E Khuda Mein Harr Dum Rahna, Sabke Bus Ki Baat Nahi Khaahish-E-Nafs Se Bachtey Rahna, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Ungli Se Ishaara Chaand Ki Jaanib, Saarey Insaan Kartey Hain, Ungli Se Chaand Ke Tukrey Karna, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Deen Ki Khaatir Ghar Ghar Jaana, Taaif Jaa Kar Pathar Khaana, Phir Bhi Duaayein Detey Rahna, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Ashaab-E-Rasool To Sab Ke Sab, Makhlooq Mein Sab Se Akbar Hai, Siddiq Ka Jaisa Aashiq Hona, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Duniya Ke Salaafi Duniya Bhar Mein, Ghashtey Lagaatey Phirtey Hai, Farooq Ka Jaisa Ghasht Lagaana, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Usman-E-Ghani Ka Hamsar Hona, Maal Mein Beyshak Mumkin Hai, Deen Aur Haya Ka Haamil Hona, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi Dushman Se Badle Lene Kaa Har Ek Ke Dil Me Jazba Hai Dushman Ko Gale Se Apne Lagana Sab Ke Bas Ki Bath Nahi Pyaare Sahaaba Deen Ki Khaatir, Jaaney Qurbaan Kartey Thay, Deen Ki Khaatir Jaan Ka Dena, Sabke Bus Ki Bat Nahi, Kufr Ki Aisi Zulmat Me Imaan Ka Bachana Mushkil Hai Momin Bankar Zulm Me Rehna Sab
